2) The guide places both hands gently on the partner's shoulders.
3) Move to background music following signals: push both shoulders to walk forward, lift right hand to turn right, lift left hand to turn left, stop both hands to halt.
4) Walk safely matching the rhythm without running, then switch roles.
pe-02447:
1) Two turners swing a long rope turning toward the direction runners enter.
2) Identify the highest peak of the rope arc as it turns upward off the floor.
3) Run or walk smoothly through the middle without jumping over the rope.
4) The next student enters consecutively without hesitation right as the preceding friend clears.
pe-02448:
1) On the signal, players from both sides run to the center line to grab the 5 balls.
2) Players who retrieve a ball must retreat behind their back white line before throwing at opponents.
3) Attackers can advance up to the cones near the center line to throw, and must release the ball quickly without holding it too long.
4) Catching a ball on the fly revives an eliminated teammate, and held balls can be used to block incoming throws.
pe-02449:
1) Divide players into two equal teams and send one designated outfielder to the opponent's outfield.
2) Infielders and outfielders pass the ball and attempt to hit opposing infield defenders.
3) Hit infield players are eliminated and move to the opponent's outfield as attacking players.
4) When a teammate is eliminated and comes to the outfield, the initial outfielder returns to the infield.
pe-02450:
1) In palm-up underhand throw, bring hand back and swing forward to release the ball.
2) In palm-down underhand throw, reach forward, lower arm downward, and release the ball.
3) Practice each step sequentially and smoothly transition into continuous throwing motions.
4) Choose the appropriate throwing posture depending on whether distance or accuracy is needed.
pe-02451:
1) Fold socks and turn the ankle cuff inside out to form a compact round ball.
2) Wrap colored tape around sock balls to distinguish teams by color.
3) Spread a t-shirt or thin clothing on the floor as the target zone.
4) Use underhand throws to toss sock balls onto the t-shirt target in a mini-game.
pe-02452:
1) Decide who goes first via rock-paper-scissors and play an even number of ends (2, 4, or 6 ends).
2) The starting team throws the white target ball (jack) first, followed by their colored ball.
3) The team farthest from the target ball continues throwing balls until closer or out of balls.
4) After throwing all balls, score 1 point for each ball closer to the target than the opponent's closest ball.
pe-02453:
1) March in place and perform V-steps to warm up to the rhythm.
2) Walk forward 3 steps with a finger-gun motion and walk back 3 steps.
3) Perform chest expansions (airplane arms), elbow strikes with arm circles, knee kicks, and overhead punches.
4) Conclude with vertical jumps, kicks, jumping jacks, and deep breathing.
pe-02454:
1) Arrange desks in a square formation and have each player sit on a desk with legs crossed or tucked.
2) Determine the first throw via rock-paper-scissors, and players throw a bounce ball across at opponents sitting on the opposite side.
3) Hit players move down to the floor area inside the desks and act as bodyguards by reaching up to deflect balls for their teammates.
4) Retrieve loose balls through designated aisle openings, and conclude the match with a final showdown without bodyguards to count remaining survivors.
pe-02455:
1) For 3-3-3 stacking, alternate hands to upstack three sets of 3 cups starting from either the left or right, then return to the beginning to downstack.
2) For 3-6-3 stacking, upstack 3, 6, and 3 cups in order, then return to the start to downstack them sequentially.
3) For Cycle stacking, perform 3-6-3, downstack both sides, transition into 6-6 stacking, and then build the 1-10-1 stack.
4) In the 1-10-1 phase, grasp both outer cups, slide down in one direction, gather all cups into columns, and stop the timer.
pe-02456:
1) Run from the starting line, stack the jumbo cups in a 3-6-3 pattern, and head around the turning point.
2) On the way back, downstack the 3-6-3 jumbo cups into order and stop the timer.
3) In the modified version, complete a designated mission at the turning point such as bottle flipping before downstacking the cups.
4) After packing the cups, throw a ball into target cups or hula hoop zones (100 to 400 points) to combine placement and mission points for the final score.
pe-02457:
1) The match is best-of-5 sets; the first team to win 3 sets wins the match.
2) Sets 1 and 5 are 3-6-3 Team Relay (4 players, best-of-3 rounds).
3) Set 2 is Individual Cycle (5 players, best-of-5 rounds), and Set 3 is Doubles Cycle (best-of-3 rounds).
4) Set 4 is 3-6-3 Team Timed Relay where the fastest time among 3 attempts wins.
pe-02458:
1) Hold a towel shoulder-width apart and stretch arms forward or overhead behind the head.
2) Move the arms side to side while holding the towel to stretch the sides.
3) Wrap the towel behind the neck and lean the head back to relieve neck tension.
4) Sit on a chair, loop the towel around the bottom of one foot, and lift the leg straight to stretch the hamstring.
pe-02459:
1) Wrap a toilet paper roll with clear tape so it does not unroll during practice.
2) Assume the basic upper and lower body posture for an underhand volleyball toss.
3) Toss the toilet paper roll upward repeatedly without dropping it.
4) Challenge yourself to achieve 10 consecutive underhand tosses.
pe-02460:
1) Perform neck exercises for 8 counts on each side.
2) Roll shoulders backward for 8 counts.
3) Stretch and swing arms up and down for 8 counts.
4) Proceed with side stretch, back/abdomen, torso, ankles, and knees, finishing with 10 jumping jacks.
pe-02461:
1) Stretch both arms overhead and roll sideways 3 rotations each way.
2) Hold both feet curled up and roll sideways 10 times.
3) Hold knees, roll sideways, and stand back up 5 times each side.
4) Round the back like a roly-poly toy, rolling back and forth to stand up 10 times.
pe-02462:
1) Each student takes a position on a spot marker placed on the floor.
2) Perform exercises including Mountain Climber, Cross Jack, Full Elbow, Back Pitch, Pitch Clap, Jump Lunge, Elbow Twist, and Jumping Jack in intervals of 20 seconds of work and 10 seconds of rest.
3) Rapidly repeat each movement to the rhythm and cues during the given time.
pe-02463:
1) Prepare with proper posture on an exercise mat.
2) Perform eight exercises in sequence—Burpee Test, Trunk Twist, Superman, Seated Russian Twist, Bridge, Sit-up, Plank, and V-Up—with 20 seconds of exercise and 10 seconds of rest.
3) Repeat the movements keeping proper core engagement as directed.
pe-02464:
1) Sit on a mat and gently stretch the neck in all directions holding for 10 counts, then slowly rotate.
2) Extend one arm forward and pull fingers back to stretch the wrist, then pull the arm across the chest for shoulder stretch.
3) Extend legs, fold one leg inward, bend forward to stretch hamstrings, and twist the torso across the knee.
4) Bring soles of the feet together in butterfly pose and lower the torso forward keeping the back straight.
pe-02465:
1) Rotate wrists and ankles lightly to warm up the joints.
2) Stand on one leg and pull the opposite ankle behind to touch the heel to the glute, stretching the quadriceps.
3) Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and sit back like sitting in a chair to stretch hips and glutes.
4) Spread feet wider than shoulder-width, lunge side to side to stretch inner thighs, and extend the torso sideways.
pe-02466:
1) Standing long jump: Jump with both feet simultaneously from behind the takeoff line and measure to the rearmost mark.
2) Sit and reach: Keep legs straight against the board and push the slider forward with fingertips, holding for 2 seconds.
3) Grip strength: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and squeeze the dynamometer twice on each hand with proper arm spacing.
4) Step test: Step up and down 72 times to the metronome beat, rest on a chair for 1 minute, and record pulse 3 times.
pe-02467:
1) Players bend at the waist and place a disc cone on their back to start.
2) Players try to knock off opponents' disc cones while protecting their own.
3) A player is eliminated if the cone falls off their back.
4) Players must strike only the opponent's cone without touching their body.
pe-02468:
1) Divide into 4 teams wearing pinnies and stack 15 jumbo cups (5-4-3-2-1) into a pyramid to build each castle.
2) Assign 1 defender per team to guard the castle while the remaining players line up as attackers.
3) On start, attackers run toward any opposing castle and play rock-paper-scissors against the defender.
4) If the attacker wins, they take 1 jumbo cup back to stack beside their own castle; if they lose, they return and high-five the next attacker.
pe-02469:
1) Take a ready stance to throw the flying disc.
2) Step forward with an approach step to put power into the throw.
3) Maintain a horizontal angle and adjust height to throw as far as possible.
pe-02470:
1) Practice 1-on-1 backhand passes with a partner, advancing to using 2 discs simultaneously.
2) Form a triangle of 3 players to circulate passes, then progress to using 2 discs.
3) Lead a sprinting teammate by passing into the open space ahead for a running catch.
4) When guarded, pivot on one foot while switching between backhand and forehand grips to bypass the defender safely.
pe-02471:
1) Set up disc catchers on the schoolyard as holes and designate teeing areas with large cones.
2) Form groups such as 4 players per squad and take turns throwing discs toward the target disc catcher.
3) The player whose disc is farthest from the target throws next.
4) Record the total number of throws on the score sheet until the disc lands inside the disc catcher.
pe-02472:
1) Make a Curl-Ball board and form a team of 3 players.
2) Each player shoots 3 stones one by one, giving each team a total of 9 chances.
3) On each turn, players can hit or push out stones on the board, and landing in the item zone grants an item card to use.
4) Add up points from the point zones where stones remain, and the team with the highest score wins.
pe-02473:
1) Lie down with a partner and perform shoulder and thoracic rotation stretches 6 reps on each side.
2) Lie prone to do gentle torso twists (6 reps) and superman back extensions.
3) Perform knee push-ups (10 reps x 2 sets) and glute bridges (6 reps x 2 sets).
4) Perform side-lying adductor hip lifts (6 reps each side x 2 sets).
pe-02474:
1) Divide all players into groups of 4, decide the running order, and wait at the starting point.
2) On the starting signal, the first runner sprints to flip 1 cone, returns, and tags the next runner.
3) Continue the relay until all cones are flipped.
4) The team whose final runner flips the last cone and crosses the finish line first wins.
pe-02475:
1) Divide players into two teams and arrange each team in pairs seated in a straight line toward the turning point.
2) Partners sit facing each other with soles touching, and the player closest to the starting line holds the handball.
3) On signal, pass the ball to the facing runner of the next pair, then quickly stand up with your partner and run to the back of the line.
4) The receiver passes short to their partner, who then passes long to the next pair; repeat this cycle, and the first team to round the cone and return wins.
pe-02476:
1) Divide into groups of 5 and stand in a circle.
2) On the start signal, pass the ball to the right.
3) Before passing or receiving, students must wrap the ball around their torso in a full circle before throwing it.
4) The person holding the ball when the time limit (30 seconds) expires receives a penalty.
pe-02477:
1) Divide into groups of 4 and have one person stand at each corner of a square.
2) One player spins a hula hoop upright in the center of the square, returns to position, and starts passing clockwise.
3) The team must complete a designated number of passes (30) before the hula hoop stops spinning.
4) Continue until successful; the team that finishes last receives a penalty.
pe-02478:
1) Divide players into groups of 4 to 8 and distribute them evenly at each corner of a square.
2) On the start signal, pass the ball clockwise and move in the direction of the pass.
3) The team that finishes 30 passes first wins.
4) Vary the activity by changing the type of pass and direction.
pe-02479:
1) Four participants each choose a hula hoop (house) and stand next to their ring.
2) On the start signal, take cones from other players' rings and bring them to your house.
3) Only one cone can be moved at a time, and carrying cones is not allowed except when moving one to your house.
4) When the time limit (30 seconds) ends, the person with the most cones in their ring wins.
pe-02480:
1) Divide participants into groups of 4 to 6, selecting 1 tagger and 1 king.
2) All players except the tagger hold hands to form a circle and move together.
3) The tagger must touch the king from outside the circle, while teammates protect the king with their bodies.
4) Teammates must not let go of each other's hands, and roles are rotated.
pe-02481:
1) All participants prepare outside the cones placed around the center line.
2) On the start signal, run to the right.
3) When the instructor's whistle sounds once, change running direction.
4) When the whistle sounds twice, quickly grab a cone in front; the player who fails to grab a cone is eliminated, one cone is removed, and continue until the final winner remains.
pe-02482:
1) Divide participants into groups of 3; A and B each hold a ball while C stands opposite ready to receive.
2) A rolls a ball firmly on the floor to C, who catches it with one hand and throws it back to A.
3) Simultaneously, B rolls a ball, and C catches it with one hand and throws it back to B.
4) Once 10 passes are completed, players rotate clockwise to switch roles; the first team where all members complete 10 passes wins.
pe-02483:
1) From a forward-moving stance, jump with both feet and spread arms and legs as wide as possible to narrow the shooting angle against open shots.
2) Take one step forward from a standing position and jump off one foot, spreading arms and legs wide to block.
3) Take two steps forward to meet the shooter's timing, extending arms and legs fully to make the save.
pe-02484:
1) Place an exercise mat on the floor and secure a safe workout space.
2) Learn proper form for the Burpee Test combining squat, plank, and jump while protecting the lower back.
3) Perform Mountain Climbers by holding a steady plank posture and driving knees alternately toward the chest.
4) Execute Jumping Jacks by rhythmically jumping while spreading and clapping arms overhead and legs outward.
pe-02485:
1) Spread two-colored square cards across the floor.
2) Play rock-paper-scissors to determine each team's designated card color.
3) On the whistle, players run in and flip cards to show their team's color for 30 seconds.
4) Hands off the cards immediately upon the ending whistle, progressing through 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 rounds until all members have participated.
pe-02486:
1) [Stage 1 - Individual Pass] Each runner runs forward, lifts 2 hula hoops lying on the floor over their body one by one, runs back, and tags the next runner.
2) [Stage 2 - Pairs Pass] Pairs hold hands firmly and step through 2 hula hoops on the floor without letting go of their hands.
3) [Stage 3 - Group Pass] The entire group holds hands in a chain and moves the hula hoop along the line using only body movements without using hands.
4) The group that successfully moves the hula hoop to the final person without breaking hands wins the challenge.
pe-02487:
1) Divide into two teams at the starting line and place a cone at the turning point for each team.
2) The first runner of each team places a balloon between their knees or thighs and gets ready.
3) On the start signal, hop forward with both feet without dropping the balloon, circle around the cone, and return.
4) Hand the balloon to the next teammate at the starting line; the team whose members all finish first wins.
pe-02488:
1) Begin with 3-6-3 stacking by up-stacking and down-stacking.
2) Continue with 6-6 stacking by up-stacking and down-stacking.
3) Finish by completing 1-10-1 stacking and down-stacking back into the initial 3-6-3 formation.
pe-02489:
1) Divide into a kicking (batting) team and a fielding (pitching) team, and set up 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and home bases.
2) The pitcher rolls the ball along the ground inside the guide line toward home; three strikes result in an out, while three balls grant a walk to 1st base.
3) The kicker kicks the rolling ball into fair territory and immediately runs toward 1st base.
4) If the runner touches the base before the fielded ball arrives, they are safe; if the ball arrives first or a fly ball is caught, the runner is out, and touching home scores 1 point.
pe-02490:
1) Divide into three teams of four (Pink, Grey, Black) within a 20m x 20m court.
2) Three players hold the ball while the hitter shouts 'Omnikin + defending team color' before hitting it above the waist.
3) The designated defending team must catch the ball before it touches the ground; after the third touch, players may only pivot.
4) If defense fails or a foul occurs, the other two teams each score 1 point simultaneously.
pe-02491:
1) The court is divided into three sections (two goal thirds and one center third) for play.
2) Players can only move within designated areas based on their 7 positions.
3) Dribbling is not allowed; the ball moves only by passing, and players cannot walk once they receive the ball.
4) Physical contact is prohibited, and defenders must stay at least 90cm away from the opponent.
pe-02492:
1) The game begins with an entry pass crossing the center median line from beyond the endline, and teams may attack either frame rebounder.
2) Players cannot dribble and may take up to 3 steps, hold the ball for up to 3 seconds, and execute up to 3 passes before shooting at the rebounder frame.
3) The attacking team scores if the bounced ball hits the floor outside the forbidden zone, whereas defensive catches cause an immediate change of possession.
4) When an infraction occurs, play restarts with a breakdown by touching the ball to the floor with both hands before passing.
pe-02493:
1) Each team consists of 7 players assigned to specific court zones according to their positions.
2) The game starts with a center pass from inside the center circle.
3) Players cannot dribble and must pass or shoot within 3 seconds using pivot footwork.
4) Only the Goal Shooter and Goal Attack can shoot for goals.
pe-02494:
1) Teams of 10 players take turns kicking a rugby ball placed on a cone.
2) The kicker runs around teammates lined up 20 meters away (3 laps for boys, 2 laps for girls).
3) Fielders line up behind the fielder who caught the ball and pass it backward through their legs to the quarterback, who passes to the base.
4) The runner scores 1 point by reaching base safely before the ball arrives, and teams switch after 3 outs.
pe-02495:
1) Each class selects 20 students, where 2 turn the long rope and 18 jump.
2) In stage 1, all 18 runners take turns jumping through the rope to the other side one by one.
3) In stage 2, pairs jump together (9 pairs), followed by stage 3 with groups of three (6 groups).
4) In stage 4, 6 selected students jump together for 40 consecutive jumps while the total time is measured.
pe-02496:
1) Players compete individually (4 stones each) or in teams (2 stones each), deciding first/second throwers.
2) Deliver wheeled stones from the delivery line; any stone failing to cross the hog line (4m ahead) is removed.
3) Teams alternate throwing stones one by one until all stones are delivered to complete an end.
4) Only the team closest to the target center scores, earning 1 point for each stone closer than the opponent's best stone.
pe-02497:
1) Rotate arms left and right in time with music rhythm, then rotate both arms twice.
2) Tap foot with hand on the same side, followed by cross tapping opposite hand to foot.
3) Perform side-to-side skating movements in place and taking two steps across.
4) Place hands on head to stretch waist sideways, followed by high knees and quad stretches.
pe-02498:
1) The tagger faces the wall and recites the signal while runners advance forward.
2) Substitute the flower name with specific poses such as "One-leg balance" or "Hooray".
3) When the call ends, players must freeze in the exact pose called; anyone moving or posing wrong is caught.
4) Once someone tags the tagger's hand, everyone flees to the starting line, and whoever gets caught becomes the next tagger.
pe-02499:
1) Sit in a circle on chairs and create a personal 4-beat rhythm using various body parts.
2) Take turns demonstrating personal 4-beat rhythm patterns around the circle.
3) Observe carefully and imitate each classmate's body percussion rhythm together as a whole group.
4) Perform the rhythmic patterns along with a 4/4 time song such as "Do-Re-Mi Song" until the music ends.
pe-02500:
1) Stand in place and perform jump rope motions with empty hands.
2) Perform butt kickers, fast feet, and high knees in sequence.
3) Do jumping jacks in place.
4) Finish by stretching the shoulders, touching toes with crossed arms, and doing arm swings.
pe-02501:
1) Sit straight on a chair, nod the head, and march in place lightly.
2) Open and clench fingers, then perform breathing exercises to the rhythm.
3) Perform seated exercises targeting the wrists, shoulders, neck, chest, sides, back, and torso.
4) Add clapping to whole-body and shoulder motions, then finish with breathing regulation.
pe-02502:
1) Sit comfortably on a chair and shrug shoulders up and down to relax.
2) Rotate the shoulders forward and backward.
3) Alternate between archery draw motions and diagonal punch extensions.
4) Follow by rolling the neck, shaking shoulders, reaching arms backward, and crossing arms.
pe-02503:
1) Practice 2-bounce jumps 8 times and fast 1-bounce jumps 16 times in 16-beat sets.
2) Learn alternating-foot jumps 8 times and 4-way cross jumps (left, right, front, back) twice.
3) Practice front-swing kicks 8 times and back-lift jumps 8 times.
4) Practice 8-figure rotations 8 times, then challenge the randomized number sequence drill.
pe-02504:
1) Divide into two teams of 3 to 4 players each, create a court about 10 meters on each side, and all players enter inside.
2) The tagger team passes the ball around while the opposing team runs away to avoid being tagged.
3) The tagger holding the ball cannot move from that spot, while other taggers can move freely within the court.
4) If a tagger holding the ball tags an opposing player with the ball, the tagger team wins.
pe-02505:
1) Face each other with both hands and feet on the floor.
2) One player calls out a target body part like back, knees, or hips.
3) The player who touches the specified target within the time limit wins.
pe-02506:
1) Place various types of balls in the center of the court and assign home zones for each team.
2) On signal, run to the center and dribble one ball at a time back to the home zone using feet.
3) Once all balls from the center are taken, the team that collected the most balls wins.
4) Apply variations such as stealing balls from other teams or delivering balls into opponent zones where the team with the fewest balls wins.
pe-02507:
1) Set up a low vaulting box with a springboard and landing mats.
2) Run up and jump completely over the vaulting box with both feet without placing hands on it.
3) Increase the height, jump onto the top of the box with both feet without hands, and dismount sideways or backwards.
4) Place a marker cone on the mat and practice jumping far toward the cone target.
pe-02508:
1) Form a line of 2-3 students connected by holding the shoulders or clothes of the person in front.
2) The front leader keeps eyes open to navigate, while all followers close their eyes.
3) Followers move together while strictly maintaining physical contact without letting go.
4) Adjust speed, make turns, and maneuver curves following the lead of the front partner.
pe-02509:
1) A partner holds the runner's pelvis from behind to restrain forward propulsion.
2) The runner pushes forward against the resistance.
3) After running a predetermined number of steps (3 or 5 steps) to the count, the partner releases the grip and the runner dashes forward.
pe-02510:
1) Walk up to the mat, bring your feet together, and perform a forward roll.
2) Side-jump like a crab, bring your feet together, and roll.
3) Walk backward, turn around, and roll.
4) Skip or imitate animals such as a frog, tiger, or gorilla before rolling.
pe-02511:
1) Fold a towel and tuck it into the back of your shorts to make a tail.
2) Perform a forward roll on the mat.
3) Immediately stand up and run so the tagger does not grab your tail.
4) Look at your tail between your legs while rolling to keep your body curled into a ball.
pe-02512:
1) Flip mini cones using only your feet or toes.
2) Move around in a seated position and flip cones with your feet.
3) Crawl backward on all fours (bear crawl) and flip cones with your feet.
4) Roll and tap a ball with your sole, and jump to catch a ball gripped between your feet.
pe-02513:
1) Start in a push-up plank position with feet together.
2) Step one foot forward next to your hand to stretch the hip, return, and alternate sides.
3) Jump to switch foot positions dynamically back and forth.
4) Jump and clap the soles of your feet together in mid-air before landing.
pe-02514:
1) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.
2) The winner places an object (towel, newspaper, book) on the loser's head.
3) The player with the object turns around in a full circle without dropping it.
4) If any object falls while walking, playing rock-paper-scissors, or stacking, that player loses.
pe-02515:
1) Roll up a bath towel as a starting line and place a hand towel 4 feet away.
2) Step with the opposite foot and roll the sock ball toward the target.
3) If the ball lands on or touches the towel, score 1 point and flip the towel forward by its edge.
4) Repeat rolling and flipping for 1 minute to score points.
pe-02516:
1) Watch the leader perform movements while the first guitar part plays.
2) Copy and repeat the exact movements when the second guitar part plays.
3) Do not move at the same time as the leader; alternate turns following the musical cues.
pe-02517:
1) Sit comfortably on a chair and relax both body and mind.
2) Inhale slowly through the nose for 3 seconds following the on-screen cue.
3) Hold breath steadily for 3 seconds.
4) Exhale slowly through the mouth for 3 seconds and repeat the square breathing cycle.
pe-02518:
1) Set up an 8-interval Tabata timer with 20 seconds of work and 10 seconds of rest.
2) Perform alternating toe taps and bicycle crunches while lying on the mat.
3) Execute high knee taps and jump tucks, followed by toe touches and crunches.
4) Complete the routine with oblique twists and a held core balance posture for 4 minutes.
pe-02519:
1) Line up according to an 8-interval Tabata timer consisting of 20 seconds work and 10 seconds rest.
2) Perform jumping jacks and squats for 20 seconds each to warm up the lower body and full body.
3) Jog in place, followed by inchworms walking hands out and in from a standing position.
4) Complete push-ups, invisible jump rope, elbow-to-knee touches, and lunge jumps to finish the circuit.
pe-02520:
1) Set up an ice rink with 6 cones, where each student places a scarf under each foot and slides around like skating.
2) Two or three taggers equipped with pool noodles also slide on scarves and attempt to tag runners.
3) Tagged students remove their scarves, run one full lap around the rink, retrieve scarves, and rejoin the game.
pe-02521:
1) The thrower stands on passing dots and prepares an overhand pass like a football quarterback.
2) The catcher selects a colored hula hoop placed at different distances ($1 to $100) and must keep at least one foot inside.
3) If caught successfully inside the hoop, the pair collects play money; if missed, they switch roles and try again.
pe-02522:
1) Perform ski jumps over the noodle on the floor, Jedi lightsaber moves, and noodle squats.
2) Practice balancing the noodle on body parts, and catch a standing noodle before it falls after clapping.
3) Complete sequential coordination tasks including hand tosses, flip catches, drops, throws, and palm pops.
pe-02523:
1) Build hula huts to toss stuffed toys into, and shoot from poly spots to collect spots into buckets.
2) Roll hoops to encircle batting tees, and practice dribbling inside a moving hoop pulled by a jump rope.
3) Build bucket towers with circle bounce passes, and transfer beanbags between hoops while holding a plank.
pe-02524:
1) 8 to 10 battleship drivers push scooters with large cones and wiffle balls across the gym without touching the balls.
2) The remaining attackers pick up gator balls and position themselves inside 10 to 12 designated hula hoops.
3) Attackers throw overhand or roll underhand from inside hoops to knock wiffle balls off the moving battleships.
4) An attacker who knocks off a wiffle ball takes over that battleship, and the previous driver becomes an attacker.
pe-02525:
1) Choose one of the two exercises shown on the screen.
2) Work hard performing the chosen exercise for 30 seconds.
3) Rest for 10 seconds and prepare for the next exercise.
4) Repeat the cycle until finished.
pe-02526:
1) Set up a target (e.g., a toilet roll) and take steps backward equal to your age.
2) Throw or roll rolled-up socks to knock down the target.
pe-02527:
1) Place a hula hoop on the floor for each student and stand behind it.
2) Follow the song lyrics to put right foot, left foot, or hands into the hoop, take them out, and shake them.
3) When singing the "hokey pokey turn yourself around" line, run around your own hula hoop one time.
pe-02528:
1) Two teams of three players compete using a single basketball hoop.
2) Before putting the ball into play at the start, after a basket, or when out of bounds, players must check the ball with the opponent.
3) If a shot hits the rim or backboard and the defending team gets the rebound, they must take the ball outside the three-point line before attacking.
4) There are no referees, so students must call their own fouls.
pe-02529:
1) Split the gym into two halves, with two teams throwing foam balls to eliminate opponents.
2) Players who are hit are eliminated and move to the side of the court.
3) If a team throws a ball and hits the opponent's basketball backboard, all eliminated teammates return to the game.
4) If a player throws a ball into the basketball hoop, their team wins the round automatically.
pe-02530:
1) One or two taggers (chefs) stand in the middle, and the remaining students wear red, blue, green, and yellow pennies representing different food groups.
2) When the chef calls out a specific food, only the students representing that food group run across to the other side without getting tagged.
3) Players who are tagged move to the side to do a food group activity or join the chef in the middle.
pe-02531:
1) Set up plastic bowling pins or cones all around the gym.
2) Divide the class in half: one half knocks pins down, and the other half picks them up.
3) Knockers knock down the pins using their hands or arms, while pickers stand the fallen pins back up.
pe-02532:
1) Perform a forward roll by placing hands on the mat, tucking the body round, and standing up using rotational force.
 2) Perform a backward roll by placing palms beside the ears, tucking backward, and pushing the mat to stand.
 3) Execute a straddle forward roll by spreading legs wide at the final landing stage to stand up.
 4) Learn straddle backward roll and pike backward roll sequentially with knees straight.
pe-02533:
1) Lightly jog in place to loosen up the body and start the warm-up routine.
 2) Stretch joints and muscles with arm, arm-leg, chest, and side movements to the count.
 3) Increase exercise intensity with back-abdominal, trunk, jumping, and full-body exercises.
 4) Finish by taking deep breaths to cool down and stabilize heart rate.
pe-02534:
1) Step 1: Alternate tossing one ball from outside to inside in an arc between both hands.
 2) Step 2: Hold one ball in each hand, toss alternately from outside inward, and catch both.
 3) Step 3: Hold two balls in one hand and one in the other, practicing two-ball throws.
 4) Steps 4 & 5: Release all three balls in rhythm and maintain a continuous cascade pattern.
pe-02535:
1) Toss the ball slightly and hit it with the racket angled at about 45 degrees as it descends.
 2) The hit ball must bounce once on your own table side first, cross over the net, and bounce on the opponent table court.
 3) You must serve from behind and outside the table, never over the table surface.
 4) The serve fails if the ball hits the net, crosses without bouncing on your side, or lands outside the opponent table.
pe-02536:
1) Overhand throw: Turn the hips back, point toward the target, and rotate the hips leading with the elbow to throw forcefully overhead.
 2) Sidearm throw: Turn the body and release the ball sideways, controlling left/right direction with release timing.
 3) Underhand throw: Step forward with one foot and throw from below for maximum accuracy.
 4) Catching: Move the body to meet the ball and catch securely according to the incoming ball's height.
pe-02537:
1) Perform an approach using either 3-step or 2-step footwork to jump.
 2) After jumping, pull the arm back, open the torso, and keep the elbow slightly above the shoulder.
 3) Watch the ball closely and extend the arm in a semi-circular motion to strike with the palm.
 4) Connect with an overhead set from a setter to practice spike attacks.
pe-02538:
1) Grip the disc using a backhand or forehand grip with the thumb on top and fingers supporting beneath.
 2) Stand in line with the target, rotate the waist first, and release using arm follow-through and wrist snap.
 3) Practice throwing repeatedly at a distance of around 20 meters to understand disc rotation and flight paths.
pe-02539:
1) Stand with feet aligned, knees slightly bent, and lower your waist for balls coming to your left.
 2) Tilt the racket face slightly forward around 90 degrees and keep a fist's distance from the body.
 3) Keep the swing compact without making it large, push forward lightly, and press down slightly at the end to return the ball.
pe-02540:
1) For a jump shot, bend your elbow at 90 degrees, cock your wrist back, and use your left hand only as a guide.
 2) Jump by extending your knees and release the ball using your elbow extension and wrist snap.
 3) For a layup, approach the basket taking right foot then left foot steps before leaping up.
 4) Softly lay the ball toward the corner of the backboard square at the peak of your jump.
pe-02541:
1) From a low stance with knees bent, step forward with the right foot to execute a backhand push.
 2) When the ball goes deep to the backhand, step with the left foot and return immediately to ready position.
 3) Open the racket face and lead with the elbow rather than swinging the whole arm, flexing the wrist slightly.
 4) Brush the ball slightly above the center to generate backspin and send it over the net.
pe-02542:
1) Position 6 players per team on opposite sides of the net.
 2) For the underhand pass, spread your legs, lower your knees and hips, and extend both arms forward together to receive the ball.
 3) For the overhand pass, form a triangle with your hands and prepare above your forehead.
 4) Extend your knees and arms simultaneously to pass the ball.
pe-02543:
1) Spread feet wider than shoulder-width and lower your hips into a stable athletic stance.
 2) Push the ball down using the forearm below the elbow rather than the entire shoulder, cushioning it with full hand pads.
 3) Keep the opposite off-hand close to the ball ready to protect and secure possession.
 4) Once comfortable with knee-height middle dribbles, advance to high chest-level dribbles and cross-over dribbles.
pe-02544:
1) Choose a suitable bat and adjust the batting tee to appropriate height.
 2) Grip the bat with the bottom hand below (left hand for right-handers) and prepare in backswing stance.
 3) Keep eyes focused on the ball and rotate hips and torso quickly into a level swing.
 4) Follow through smoothly after impact by rolling the wrists and extending arms.
pe-02545:
1) Perform knee push-ups for 10 reps across 3 sets keeping the back straight with knees on the floor.
 2) Perform standard push-ups maintaining a straight line through the legs and torso.
 3) Perform shoulder taps by touching the opposite shoulder from a push-up plank position for 20 reps across 3 sets.
 4) Perform squats and jump squats pushing hips back without knees moving forward, followed by forward and backward lunges.
pe-02547:
1) For a one-hand shot, stabilize the ball with the thumb and pinky, cock the wrist back, and shoot using a three-finger snap.
 2) Step left then right after a pass or dribble to transition smoothly into a jump shot.
 3) If lacking strength, hold the ball with both hands in front of the chest with thumbs up and execute a two-hand shot while jumping.
 4) When shots miss, aim directly at the inner white square on the backboard.
pe-02548:
1) Take a basic stance with the left foot forward and right foot back.
 2) Place the ball on the palm and toss it straight up at least 16 cm above the rubber without spin.
 3) Strike the falling ball from behind and below the table using wrist snap.
 4) Immediately return to the ready position to prepare for the return.
pe-02549:
1) Step one foot slightly back, lift the rear heel, and lower your lower body stance.
 2) Bring both hands together, press thumbs down, and extend arms straight to form a flat platform.
 3) Practice tossing the ball upward individually using knee spring and weight transfer rather than swinging arms.
 4) Toss the ball against a wall and execute continuous underhand passes off the rebound.
pe-02550:
1) For chest pass, grip with thumb/index/middle fingers, step forward, and push until backs of hands face each other.
 2) For bounce pass, bounce the ball at two-thirds distance between you and the teammate.
 3) For one-hand pass, hold ball in one hand and pass by stepping forward with the same foot using wrist snap and body momentum.
 4) For overhead pass, raise ball above head with both hands and pass using step and waist momentum.
pe-02551:
1) Sit comfortably, rotate ankles inward and outward, and place each foot on the opposite thigh to loosen joints.
 2) Massage calves and thighs, take deep abdominal breaths, and gently tap the soles of your feet.
 3) Twist the torso left and right, then spread legs wide and stretch forward as far as possible.
 4) Lie down or turn over to extend arms and legs diagonally, stretching the spine and hips thoroughly.
pe-02552:
1) Perform forward steps jumping across the line and back steps jumping backward.
 2) Practice side jump steps along the line and 3-beat steps incorporating knee bends and rebounds.
 3) Practice two-steps using both feet and cross jumps alternating foot positions.
 4) Carry out half steps, 360-degree turns, side-to-side steps, and heel-touch steps to the rhythm.
pe-02553:
1) Face right, hold hands by placing the right hand forward and left hand backward to connect the line.
 2) The leader moves largely to the left, winding inward like a snail to form a spiral.
 3) Once rolled tightly, jump in place and pause as the circle becomes compact.
 4) To unroll, the leader retraces the path coming out between students or everyone moves backward along the path to open the circle.
pe-02554:
1) Learn movement 1: clap once, tap cup, clap once, then pick up and place down cup.
 2) Learn movement 2: clap twice, tap cup, clap once, then pick up and place down cup.
 3) Learn movement 3: tap floor first without clap, then clap and grasp cup.
 4) Learn movement 4: clap, tap cup into opposite hand, switch hands, and link all to music.
pe-02555:
1) Sit straight on a chair, interlock fingers, and stretch arms upward.
 2) Roll shoulders and stretch chest muscles with extended arms.
 3) Mimic jumping rope without a rope by rotating wrists and lifting feet rhythmically.
 4) Straighten one leg upward or cross legs to twist the torso for a stretch.
pe-02556:
1) Place one ankle inside the loop of the ankle skip ball and keep the rope horizontal.
 2) Swing the rope backward and jump over it with the opposite foot.
 3) Jump one foot at a time while lightly stepping side-to-side or forward-and-backward.
 4) Once mastered, switch feet or have two students jump together.
pe-02557:
1) Take the basic ready position with heels slightly raised, knees bent, elbows close to the body, and hands positioned slightly forward at waist height.
 2) Practice the two-foot basic jump, keeping elbows close to the body and jumping just high enough to clear the rope.
 3) Practice alternate-foot jumping like running in place, landing on one foot at a time for 3 minutes.
pe-02558:
1) Partners face each other and alternate clapping hands and kicking feet in rhythm.
 2) Turn around in a full circle to the right and clap, then turn to the left and clap.
 3) For solo practice, step on the right foot, kick the left foot upward, and clap hands in time.
 4) Combine clapping, knee slapping, and pushing gestures to the traditional rhythm.
pe-02559:
1) Sit straight on a chair with good posture and puff out your chest.
 2) Interlock fingers and stretch both arms overhead to lengthen the torso.
 3) Stretch neck, shoulders, arms, and flanks sequentially, relaxing the waist and back muscles.
 4) Extend legs forward, pull toes back, and push heels outward to loosen lower body muscles.
pe-02560:
1) Two players face each other, and the first player taps the balloon using one body part to send it over.
 2) The receiver must use the previous player's body part first, then add a new body part before sending it back.
 3) Players take turns adding body parts one by one to keep the balloon aloft continuously.
 4) A player loses if they catch the balloon, drop it, or fail to hit it in the designated sequence.
pe-02561:
1) Students form a single line where each person holds the front person's hand with the right hand and places the left hand behind the waist.
 2) Move stepping right foot first, bending knees and shifting weight side to side in rhythm.
 3) To weave the herring, the leader guides the line through the arch formed by the last two players, placing hands on the front person's right shoulder after passing.
 4) To unweave, the leader turns clockwise and passes through the arms of the front players to restore the line.
pe-02562:
1) Participants hold hands and sit with one knee up while swaying forward and backward to the rhythm.
 2) Leading people move forward and pass under the joined hands of participants.
 3) Participants who have been passed turn in place, hold the next person's hand, and stand up.
 4) Continue the sequence until everyone stands up while singing together.
pe-02563:
1) Roll up a homemade grip trainer (water bottle tied to yarn) using wrist movements, then unwind it in reverse.
 2) Stand with feet chest-width apart, keep legs stationary, crawl forward on hands slowly, and return.
 3) Stand with feet narrowly apart front and back, squat, jump to switch feet in the air, and land softly.
pe-02564:
1) Hold a ball in the right hand, toss it straight up to head height, and catch it with the same hand for 8 to 16 counts.
 2) Switch to the left hand, tossing and catching the ball at head height to the beat.
 3) Toss the ball in an arc diagonally from the right hand to the left hand, then from the left hand to the right hand.
 4) Toss the ball diagonally across, clap hands once or twice while it is airborne, and catch it safely with the opposite hand.
pe-02565:
1) Learn closed stance (Moa-seogi), ready stance (Joonbi-seogi) with feet shoulder-width apart, and horse-riding stance (Joochoom-seogi).
 2) Practice walking stance (Ap-seogi) stepping forward naturally and back stance (Dwit-goobi) with weight distribution 8:2 on the back foot.
 3) Perform middle punch (Momtong-jireugi) toward the solar plexus from the horse stance, keeping the non-punching fist at the waist.
 4) Execute low block, middle block, and high block sequentially, returning the opposite fist to the waist each time.
pe-02566:
1) Face each other and toss 1 ball diagonally in an arc from right hand to right hand.
 2) Practice tossing 1 ball where one person throws straight and the partner throws diagonally.
 3) Both hold a ball in the right hand; player 1 tosses first, immediately followed by player 2.
 4) One person acts as the right hand (2 balls) and the partner acts as the left hand (1 ball) to juggle together.
pe-02567:
1) Hold one ball in each hand and practice throwing and catching them to head height 8 times.
 2) Practice throwing the balls diagonally one after another and catching them 8 times.
 3) Hold two balls in one hand, throw the front ball first, and throw the rear ball as the first one falls to catch them consecutively.
pe-02568:
1) Perform warm-up stretches starting from extremities like wrists, ankles, and knees.
 2) Stand upright with chest open and look straight ahead.
 3) Land heel-to-toe, rolling smoothly through the foot.
 4) Swing the opposite arm naturally with each forward step.
pe-02569:
1) Practice by throwing ball 1 from the hand holding two balls, throwing ball 2 from the opposite hand, and catching ball 1.
 2) Once comfortable throwing and catching balls 1 and 2, proceed to releasing ball 3.
 3) If tossing ball 3 upward is difficult, practice simply dropping it downward to empty the hand.
 4) Catch the thrown balls with alternating hands to connect the continuous three-ball juggling motion.
pe-02570:
1) Balance various objects vertically on the tip of a finger.
 2) Start with long objects and increase difficulty using shorter or irregularly shaped items.
 3) Keep balance without dropping by slightly moving the finger while sitting or standing.
pe-02571:
1) Position feet shoulder-width apart and bend knees for Balance.
 2) Focus Eyes on the back of the rim.
 3) Keep the shooting Elbow pointing down without flaring outward.
 4) Extend legs while shooting, snap the wrist, and hold the Follow-through.
pe-02572:
1) Perform a plank by holding your body straight on your forearms.
 2) Lie on your back, lift your hips into a bridge, and raise one leg.
 3) In a forearm plank position, extend one arm forward alternately.
 4) Perform side planks holding, raising an arm, and raising a leg, then finish with a reverse forearm plank lifting hips.
pe-02573:
1) Complete up-stacking and down-stacking in a 3-6-3 formation from left to right.
 2) Hold 2 cups in each hand to build and then down-stack a 6-6 formation.
 3) Hold 5 cups in the right hand and 4 cups in the left hand to build and down-stack a 1-10-1 formation.
 4) Return to the initial 3-6-3 formation to finish the cycle.
pe-02574:
1) Bend your knees and hold the standing position.
 2) Maintain a proper squat posture.
 3) Place your hands on the wall and lift one leg.
 4) Lie or face down on the floor and lift your legs using your elbows and heels for support.
pe-02575:
1) Prepare stretching slowly within one's ability while maintaining correct posture and breathing.
 2) Practice inhaling and exhaling deeply with the teacher.
 3) Slowly and frequently repeat stretching movements under controlled breathing to improve flexibility.
pe-02576:
1) Prepare stacking cups by poking 6 holes in the bottom of 12 paper cups using a pen.
 2) For 3-3-3 stacking, divide 9 cups into three sets of 3, stack them up from left or right, and downstack them in the same order.
 3) For 3-6-3 stacking, divide 12 cups into 3, 6, and 3, stack them into pyramids, and then downstack.
 4) Use a mobile finger timer app by pressing buttons with both hands to start and stop the timer to measure record.
pe-02577:
1) Rotate wrists and ankles, shake hands and feet, and swing arms while twisting the torso.
 2) Rotate knees, perform short and long inner thigh stretches, and stretch the lower body with lunges.
 3) Loosen up the torso by circling the waist, rotating the shoulders, and slowly rolling the neck.
 4) Interlock fingers to stretch the neck downward and upward, pull neck laterally, and stretch shoulder muscles.
pe-02578:
1) Sit on a mat, place soles together, flutter legs up and down 10 times, then lean forward for 3 breaths (Butterfly Pose).
 2) From hands and knees, bend one leg forward next to hands and lower upper body to mat for 3 breaths (Pigeon Pose).
 3) Spread legs wide, bend one knee with arms extended parallel to floor, and hold for 3 breaths (Warrior Pose).
 4) Extend arms sideways, reach down to touch the lower leg, and hold for 3 breaths (Triangle Pose).
pe-02579:
1) Begin with the cat stretch pose.
 2) Perform prone simultaneous arm-leg raises, prone alternating arm-leg raises, and prone double arm raises in order.
 3) Lie on the back and perform glute bridges, straight leg raises, and simultaneous arm-leg raises.
 4) Finish by performing alternating elbow-to-knee crunches.
pe-02580:
1) Hold two scarves in the right hand and one in the left hand.
 2) Throw the inner scarf from the right hand first, then throw the left-hand scarf and catch them.
 3) Repeat throwing and catching to a 1-2-3 rhythm.
pe-02581:
1) Straight-Arm Plank Hold: Support the body with fully extended arms and hold the position.
 2) Bent-Arm Plank Hold: Lower into a bent-elbow position and hold while keeping the core tight.
 3) Knee Push-Up: Place knees on the floor and perform push-ups to build basic upper body strength.
 4) Progressively perform full push-ups, single-leg elevated push-ups, plank knee-to-elbow drives, and push-ups with superman extensions.
pe-02582:
1) Prepare stacking cups with holes at the bottom so they can be stacked and separated quickly.
 2) Learn the basic movements of upstacking and downstacking 3 cups and 6 cups.
 3) Upstack and downstack the 3-3-3 stack consisting of three sets of 3 cups.
 4) If stacking cups are unavailable, paper cups can be used as an alternative.
pe-02583:
1) Set up by placing a cup upside down on the desk.
 2) Clap hands twice, tap the desk three times (right-left-right), clap once, lift the cup with the right hand, and place it down.
 3) Clap once, grip the cup with a reverse hand position, tap the rim against the left palm, and tap the bottom edge on the desk.
 4) Pass the cup to the left hand, tap the desk with the right hand, place the cup down, and repeat in rhythm with the music.
pe-02584:
1) At the start signal, the first runners from both teams sprint forward at the same time.
 2) When they meet, they play rock-paper-scissors; the winner keeps advancing forward, while the loser runs back to their team.
 3) As soon as teammates see the runner returning, the next runner starts without delay and plays rock-paper-scissors where they meet.
 4) If a runner steps on the opponent's yellow marker line and wins rock-paper-scissors, they take one cone; the team that captures all 3 cones wins.
pe-02585:
1) Each team secretly designates one queen without letting opponents know, informing only the referee.
 2) Play under standard dodgeball rules while the queen acts like a regular player to avoid revealing identity.
 3) When all teammates except the queen are eliminated and only one player remains, that player becomes an invincible bodyguard immune to outs.
 4) The team that hits and eliminates the opposing hidden queen wins the game.
pe-02586:
1) Keep your own balloon in the air by tapping it continuously with one hand or finger.
 2) Use your other hand to strike and knock down the opponent's balloon.
 3) Win by keeping your balloon afloat while forcing the opponent's balloon to drop.
pe-02587:
1) Face each other, hold hands, and clap hands together once on the Dragon Ball chant.
 2) Choose one action: charge energy, fire an energy blast, or dodge.
 3) An energy blast requires at least 1 charged energy; if the opponent dodges, all charged energy is lost.
 4) Charging energy 3 times unlocks the undodgeable Kamehameha, eliminating the opponent if hit.
pe-02588:
1) Play inside a circle without a centerline, using team vests to tell teams apart.
 2) Players holding the ball inside must pivot on one foot and cannot run.
 3) Holding the ball for more than 8 seconds is a foul and turns possession over.
 4) Hit players go outside the circle and are allowed to run while throwing.
pe-02590:
1) Teams face each other with safety zones marked by ropes and decide their animal sequence.
 2) On the leader's signal, both teams perform their chosen animal's action and sound.
 3) The losing team based on rock-paper-scissors rules sprints to safety while winners chase and tag.
 4) Tagged players switch teams until one team captures all participants.
pe-02591:
1) The defending team places number spots from 1 to 10 around the court area.
 2) The attacking runners wait outside the starting line in order.
 3) On the start signal, the runner steps on all the number spots in order from 1 to 10 (or in reverse from 10 to 1).
 4) Measure the total time for all runners to complete the course, switch offense and defense, and the team with the shorter time wins.
pe-02592:
1) Tuck a handkerchief into the waistband to make a tail of appropriate length and sit down in position.
 2) Stand up and begin chasing to snatch other players' tails when the song's lyrics begin after the intro.
 3) Take any captured tail immediately to the collector and return to the playing area.
 4) Eliminated players sitting upright can be revived by receiving a collected tail, continuing until survivors remain.
pe-02593:
1) Played as an individual free-for-all where the last survivor wins.
 2) A player is out if hit below the calf after the ball bounces on the ground.
 3) If hit on the fly (up-ball) or above the calf, it is not an out.
 4) Eliminated players move to spot markers and act as taggers to get other players out.
pe-02594:
1) One partner wears a blindfold and stands at the starting line.
 2) The sighted partner guides them verbally with directions and steps.
 3) The blindfolded partner listens carefully, stops, or turns to navigate through the obstacles.
 4) If they reach the other side without touching any obstacles, partners switch roles.
pe-02595:
1) Walk around with one milk carton ddakji each, find a partner, and play rock-paper-scissors.
 2) The loser places their ddakji on the floor, and the winner strikes it with their own ddakji.
 3) If the floor ddakji flips, the striker wins and writes the opponent's name on it; if not, the defender gets one turn to strike back.
 4) Collect the ddakji, find new partners to play, and whoever collects the most names when time expires wins.
pe-02596:
1) Rub a rubber balloon with fur to give it a negative electric charge.
 2) Rub a plastic bag with fur so that it also gains a negative electric charge.
 3) Use the electrostatic repulsive force between the balloon and plastic bag to levitate the bag above the balloon.
 4) The player who keeps the plastic bag airborne above the balloon for the longest time wins.
pe-02597:
1) Walk freely along pathways between classroom desks.
 2) Stop and play rock-paper-scissors when meeting another student.
 3) The loser places hands on the winner's shoulders and follows behind.
 4) When chains meet, leaders play rock-paper-scissors and the losing chain attaches behind the winning chain.
pe-02598:
1) Taggers hold hands to form a continuous fishing net and chase fleeing players.
 2) A runner who steps outside the boundary line automatically becomes a tagger.
 3) When the net encircles and tags a runner, that runner joins hands to enlarge the net.
 4) If hands disconnect and the net breaks at the moment of tagging, the catch is invalid.
pe-02599:
1) Set up stations from closest to farthest from the disc golf target labeled Cheonmin, Sangmin, Jungin, Yangban, and King, and have students line up.
 2) A player throws the flying disc into the basket from Cheonmin; if successful, they proceed to Sangmin, but if they fail, the next player takes their turn.
 3) When their turn comes back, they resume throwing from the spot where they previously failed.
 4) Successfully making the shot from Yangban allows moving another player between Cheonmin and Jungin up or down one rank, and the game ends when a player hits the shot from the King station.
pe-02600:
1) Perform a plank by supporting the body with forearms and feet for 30 seconds across 3 sets.
 2) From a seated position, extend one leg and stretch the upper body toward the foot, repeating 10 times per side.
 3) Perform burpees by placing hands on the floor, jumping feet back, jumping forward, and standing up, for 10 reps across 3 sets.
pe-02601:
1) Warm up with 15 jumping jacks.
 2) Bend knees, bring arms together, and hold for 10 seconds.
 3) Perform 3 sets of 10 wide squats.
 4) Complete 3 sets of 30-second planks and 3 sets of 10 side leg lifts.
pe-02602:
1) Stand in riding stance by spreading feet wider than shoulder-width, bending knees slightly, and lowering fists to the navel.
 2) Execute a middle punch from the waist toward the solar plexus while pulling the other hand back to the waist.
 3) Perform a front kick by raising the rear foot to chest level and snapping it forward.
 4) Form a crane stance by slightly bending one knee and lifting the other foot against it.
pe-02603:
1) Practice dribbling using infront, inside, and outside of the foot.
 2) Dribble zigzag through traffic cones.
 3) Keep your own ball inside the circle while kicking other players' balls out.
pe-02604:
1) Learn the connected attack and defense movements of Taegeuk 1 Jang.
 2) Practice continuously while checking posture in front of a mirror.
pe-02605:
1) Understand the principle of aiming for spots out of the goalkeeper's reach.
 2) Practice inside shooting using the inside of the foot for accurate finishing at close range or 1-on-1 situations.
 3) Practice kicking toward specific targets, changing target positions, and aiming at the corners of the goal.
 4) Practice instep shooting using the laces for powerful shots from a distance while bending the supporting knee and ankle to keep the ball low.
pe-02606:
1) Practice fundamental defense skills including low block, middle block, and high block.
 2) Execute middle punches from a horse-riding stance and practice front kicks and roundhouse kicks.
 3) Perform the crane stance to train balance and center of gravity.
 4) Link learned blocking and striking techniques together to perform Taegeuk 1 Jang poomsae.
pe-02607:
1) Warm up the body with jumping jacks to raise heart rate.
 2) Perform bodyweight squats ensuring knees do not track past toes while keeping the back straight.
 3) Do push-ups with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, dropping knees to the floor if modified.
 4) Follow up with core endurance drills including planks, air bicycles, and burpee tests.
pe-02608:
1) Warm up with in-place high jumps on an exercise mat to prevent noise.
 2) Perform 3 sets of 10 squats keeping knees behind the toes and the back straight.
 3) Complete 3 sets of 10 push-ups with hands shoulder-width apart (knees on the ground if needed).
 4) Stand on one leg with hands gathered in front of the chest and hold for 10 seconds to practice balance.
pe-02609:
1) Lie comfortably on your back, brace your core, and lift your straight legs (3 sets of 10 reps).
 2) Stand with hands interlaced behind your head and lift each knee sideways alternately (3 sets of 10 reps).
 3) Get into a push-up plank position and lift each leg alternately toward the ceiling (3 sets of 10 reps).
pe-02610:
1) Find rhythms in surrounding sounds and learn basic rhythmic steps such as walking, jumping, reaching, and tapping.
 2) Express movement rhythms by connecting hand claps, side steps, and arm/leg extensions.
 3) Use towels as props to create rhythmic gestures including swinging, pulling, and wrapping.
 4) Combine the practiced movements into an integrated rhythmic routine set to music.
pe-02611:
1) Listen carefully to surrounding sounds such as water droplets to identify rhythm and beat.
 2) Practice step 1 marching in place and step 2 rhythmic clapping to the beat.
 3) Sequentially learn step 3 kicking, step 4 jumping, and step 5 clapping under the legs.
 4) Combine all learned rhythmic movements to dance freely and expressively to the music.
pe-02612:
1) Warm up with a fan stretch by sitting, extending one leg diagonally, and reaching across.
 2) Lie down and pedal your legs like a bicycle for 30 seconds across 3 sets.
 3) Perform the butterfly pose by bringing heels toward the hips and flapping the knees for 30 seconds across 3 sets.
 4) Lie on your stomach, lift arms and legs to hold the airplane pose for 5 seconds, repeating 5 times for 3 sets.
pe-02613:
1) Listen to the forest sounds and music and move your body to the beat.
 2) Connect various arm and leg movements to the rhythm following the verbal cues.
 3) Repeat the motions to the music to complete the physical expression activity.
pe-02614:
1) Draw a circle on the field and place one tagger inside the circle.
 2) Players outside the circle pass the ball to each other.
 3) The tagger attempts to intercept or steal the incoming passes.
 4) The player who loses the ball becomes the new tagger.
pe-02615:
1) Grip the disc using a backhand power grip with thumb on top and four fingers underneath.
 2) Stand sideways toward the target direction.
 3) Release the disc at knee height with strong spin so it rises into the air.
pe-02616:
1) Fold thick paper in half, cut along the line to make two long strips.
 2) Overlap the two strips in a cross shape, fold the corners into triangles counter-clockwise, and tuck the last flap inside.
 3) Grip the outer side of the ddakji with four fingers and the edge with your thumb, keep your back straight and bend your knees.
 4) Swing your arm and shoulder to strike the center of the opponent's ddakji on the ground to flip it over.
pe-02617:
1) Scatter 5 gonggi stones evenly on the floor.
 2) Catch stones one by one in level 1, two at a time in level 2, three then one in level 3, and all four at once in level 4.
 3) Perform 'gochujang' by sweeping the floor with the index finger while tossing one stone upward.
 4) Toss stones from the palm onto the back of the hand and catch them again ('kkeokgi') to score points.
pe-02618:
1) Step one foot forward, bend the knees into a lunge position, and hold for 10 seconds.
 2) Perform elbow planks holding a straight body alignment for 30 seconds across 3 sets.
 3) Lie face down and lift both arms and legs to hold for 5 seconds (Superman pose), repeating 5 times for 3 sets.
 4) Perform push-ups with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width for 10 reps across 2 sets.
pe-02619:
1) Focus on sounds and execute attack and defense movements according to the scenario.
 2) Practice low block, middle punch, roundhouse kick, straight middle punch, and high block reacting to sounds from behind.
 3) Practice while observing your movements in a mirror to identify strengths and areas for improvement.
pe-02620:
1) Form proper fists, step forward, and raise one arm from opposite waist to forehead level to perform high block.
 2) Raise the hand on the same side as the forward foot to protect the center of the trunk with middle block.
 3) Bring fist near opposite shoulder and strike downward to perform low block.
pe-02621:
1) Form a circle holding hands like interlocking hooks with the right arm lowered 45 degrees forward and left hand near the waist.
 2) Step with the right foot first from heel to toe, using knee up-and-down flexion to walk at a moderate tempo to Jungmori rhythm.
 3) Hop lightly upward while holding hands to move together quickly to the faster Jajinmori rhythm.
 4) Move at a very slow pace to the Jinyangjo rhythm by stepping with the right foot and bringing the left foot together.
pe-02622:
1) Hold with a forehand grip extending thumb, index, and middle fingers—index and middle inside the rim, thumb outside.
 2) Face the target directly with feet shoulder-width apart.
 3) Snap the wrist to add spin and release the disc from beside the body forward.
 4) Step slightly forward with the foot on the throwing side at the moment of release to hit and knock down cup targets.
pe-02623:
1) Set up targets with hoops and bowling pins on the court floor across the net.
 2) Serve the big volleyball from the service area to knock down the bowling pins.
 3) Pass the ball twice among teammates before serving it over to hit the pins.
 4) The team that knocks down the most bowling pins wins.
pe-02624:
1) Lie down, raise and lower legs, then cross one leg over the other and pull toward the body to stretch.
 2) Keep the upper body upright and jump single-legged onto a jump box as high as possible.
 3) Move sideways jumping feet apart and together, squat, and throw and catch a ball.
 4) Keep the torso straight and hop single-legged onto marked spots in front, back, left, and right directions.
pe-02625:
1) Keep the upper body upright, bend the leg at a right angle, and lift and rotate the knee outward.
 2) Maintain balance and height while extending legs sideways to accurately touch the spot marker.
 3) Cross legs forward and backward to move sideways through the ladder without stepping on it.
 4) Jump and rotate with both feet simultaneously through the ladder, ensuring safe landing without ankle strain.
pe-02626:
1) Twist Spine: Lift one leg over the pelvis while fixing the other to the floor, twisting the upper body for flexibility.
 2) T-Balance: Extend one leg back with upper body leaning forward in a straight line while moving the hand holding a ball.
 3) Ladder Exercise: Move through the agility ladder using forward, lateral, and cross steps.
 4) In-and-Out Touching: Raise legs forward and backward while cross-touching with hands.
pe-02627:
1) Perform high knees running in place, alternating legs and lifting knees high.
 2) Perform the V-stretch by lifting legs into a V-shape and maintaining body balance.
 3) Perform seated straddle forward bends while exhaling and pressing the torso forward.
 4) Perform climbing knee-ups from a plank position by pulling one knee laterally toward shoulder level.
pe-02628:
1) Perform the cat-cow stretch by dropping the hips and arching the back upward.
 2) Bend the torso forward and sideways with gentle bounces to stretch the legs.
 3) Execute cross-over burpees by touching the foot across in plank position and jumping high.
 4) Perform the balance exercise by standing on one leg and tapping target points with the opposite foot.
pe-02629:
1) Move a ball along the leg line keeping it close to the body.
 2) Perform knee push-ups pushing the chest toward the floor.
 3) Do a lunge twist turning the upper body toward the front leg.
 4) Lie down, tighten the core, and raise the hips into a bridge.
pe-02630:
1) Wake-up stretching: Make a triangle pose, stretch legs forward, raise arms, and lean the upper body back.
 2) Back extension: Keep the abdomen on the floor and lift both upper and lower body to hold.
 3) Rolling squat: Squat down, roll backward with feet up, and return to the squat position.
 4) Side walk: Step one leg sideways, lower upper body, and touch the foot.
pe-02631:
1) Maintain a plank position with the core engaged so that the head, shoulders, hips, and ankles form a straight line.
 2) Perform in-and-out touches by lifting legs forward and backward while crossing hands to touch.
 3) Perform the star drill by moving from the center to both target spots, moving one beanbag at a time.
 4) Perform twist jumping lunges by switching feet in mid-air, landing in a lunge, and bringing the ball down diagonally.
pe-02632:
1) Perform jumping jacks by spreading arms and legs wide and jumping high.
 2) Do push-ups with knees on the floor keeping elbows close to the body.
 3) Hold a plank position keeping head, shoulders, hips, and ankles in a straight line.
 4) Lie facing up and lift hips into a bridge position.
pe-02633:
1) Start on hands and knees with the body forming a tabletop shape.
 2) Extend one leg straight back so the leg, hip, back, and shoulders form a straight line.
 3) Repeat the extension 5 times on each side.
pe-02634:
1) Perform jumping lunges by crossing feet and landing in a lunge stance.
 2) Perform split jump squats by alternating feet forward and backward, then landing in a wide squat.
 3) Perform cross hopping jumps on one foot jumping forward, backward, left, and right.

 2) Kick both legs back into a plank, then jump them back in.
 3) Stand back up and raise both hands overhead in celebration.
 4) Perform 15 repetitions as one set, repeating for a total of 3 sets.
pe-02760:
1) Stand shoulder-width apart and perform squats, keeping knees behind toes and pushing hips back.
 2) Step one foot forward into lunges, dropping vertically down as if holding water bottles in both hands.
 3) Lie flat and elevate upper body and legs into a V-hold position, holding for 10 seconds.
 4) Perform air cycling by pedaling legs in the air while lying on the mat to build abdominal strength.
pe-02761:
1) Grip the hula hoop with both hands and swing it around like a jump rope.
 2) Lean slightly forward while turning the hoop so it does not catch on the body.
 3) Use wrist movement to turn the hoop and jump at the right timing as it approaches the feet.
pe-02762:
1) Set up 4 bases, assigning one stationary baseman and moving fielders.
 2) The player who throws the ball immediately runs to an open base.
 3) The receiver catches the ball cleanly and throws to another open space.
 4) Dropping the ball or throwing wildly results in an out.
pe-02763:
1) Toss a handkerchief upward and catch it with your hand as it falls.
 2) Toss the handkerchief upward, spin around 360 degrees, and catch it before it hits the floor.
 3) Practice for 30 seconds across 3 sets, alternating turning directions between right and left.
 4) Modify the activity by punching into the falling handkerchief to keep it from hitting the ground.
pe-02764:
1) Check the distance to your teammate.
 2) If the teammate is far away, throw an overhand pass along a 45-degree arc.
 3) If the teammate is close, deliver an accurate and gentle underhand pass.
pe-02765:
1) Step on the center of the band (or elastic strap/belt) firmly with both feet.
 2) Keep upper arms pinned to the sides and curl forearms upward slowly against the resistance.
 3) Pull the band diagonally sideways at a 45-degree angle to engage the shoulders and arms.
 4) Raise the band forward or hold it short with both hands and pull horizontally outward across the chest.
pe-02766:
1) Call out "mine" loudly before catching so surrounding teammates do not collide.
 2) For high balls, track the ball to the end without fear and pull it toward the chest with both hands.
 3) For chest-high balls, secure the ball firmly against the chest to prevent fumbles.
 4) For ground balls, narrow the stance or drop one knee to block the ball from slipping through the legs.
pe-02767:
1) The receiver must watch the ball without fear, pull it to the chest, and shout 'Mine' when catching it.
 2) At close distance, use an underhand pass to deliver the ball accurately without dropping it.
 3) At longer distances, use an overhand pass to deliver the ball directly.
 4) When 3 or more players form a circle, each player must pass the ball within 3 seconds of catching it.
pe-02768:
1) On count 1, spread arms to shoulder level and jump feet shoulder-width apart, then return.
 2) On count 2, raise arms overhead and clap or touch hands together.
 3) Perform repetitions continuously to counts (20 times) keeping arms fully extended.
pe-02769:
1) Batter stands sideways with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
 2) Lightly toss the ball upward in front of the body with one hand.
 3) Pull the punching fist back and strike the falling ball squarely while keeping eyes fixed on it.
 4) Strike the lower part to hit an upward fly ball, or strike the center to punch a flat line drive.
pe-02770:
1) Lower your stance by crouching down and stand up to create momentum.
 2) Rotate your waist and hips sufficiently.
 3) Keep your arm as straight as possible and snap your wrist quickly to hit the ball.
pe-02771:
1) For fast rolling, pitchers stay low and release quickly along the ground using wrist snap.
 2) For accurate rolling, slightly turn the body and roll smoothly toward the target.
 3) Kickers strike a stationary ball using the instep for power or the inside of the foot for directional control.
 4) For moving balls, kickers count a 1-2-3 rhythm internally to time the kick.
pe-02772:
1) Spread feet shoulder-width apart and bend knees slightly into a low fielding stance.
 2) Keep eyes focused on the trajectory of the incoming ball.
 3) Catch the ball securely with both hands upon arrival and pull it into the chest to absorb impact.
 4) Call out "Mine!" clearly when catching to prevent collisions with nearby teammates.
pe-02773:
1) Place the hula hoop on the floor in front of you and practice stepping in and out.
 2) Step laterally to the side and return to your starting position beside the hoop.
 3) Lightly jog or step around the perimeter of the hula hoop.
 4) Hold the hula hoop overhead and twist your torso and legs to stretch both sides.
pe-02774:
1) Thoroughly stretch your wrists before starting to prevent injury.
 2) Position your hands back near your shoulders with palms ready to press against the mat.
 3) Tuck your knees close to your chest, round your back, and roll backwards starting from the hips.
 4) Push off the ground with your feet and push the mat with your hands to complete the rotation, then land safely on your feet.
pe-02775:
1) Keep the racket upright, place the index finger like pointing a gun, place the thumb on the wide surface, and wrap the remaining fingers for a forehand grip.
 2) For a backhand grip, press the thumb flat against the wider bevel and hold lightly with the other fingers.
 3) Practice switching between forehand and backhand grips repeatedly.
 4) Use the backhand grip lightly when serving as well.
pe-02776:
1) Divide players into offense and defense, wearing team vests to distinguish sides.
 2) The kicker kicks the rolling sponge ball into the field.
 3) The runner runs through first, second, third, and home base to score a run.
pe-02777:
1) Start with neck stretches by gently rotating the head to both sides.
 2) Rotate the shoulders and hips in both directions counting to the rhythm.
 3) Rotate knees, do short and deep knee presses, and rotate ankles.
 4) Finish by clasping hands to stretch the neck and doing jumping jacks to engage the entire body.
pe-02778:
1) Thoroughly stretch and warm up the neck to prevent injuries.
 2) Perform regular push-ups or knee push-ups to build sufficient arm and chest strength.
 3) Place hands shoulder-width apart and rest the head on the mat to form a stable triangle.
 4) Kick legs up toward a wall to practice holding a supported handstand/headstand posture.
pe-02779:
1) Place numbered sticky notes on the floor in four directions (front, back, left, right) and stand in the center.
 2) While running in place, step on each note in sequence and return to center, then repeat in the reverse direction.
 3) In pairs, listen to the number called out by your partner and quickly step on that note; choosing the wrong number or reacting too slowly is a foul.
 4) When practicing alone, call out numbers yourself while running in place and quickly tap the designated notes.
pe-02780:
1) Place safety mats against a wall and secure surrounding area.
 2) Place hands apart on the mat creating a triangle base with the head and hands.
 3) Lower head and kick the back leg up forcefully toward the wall.
 4) Engage arms and core to hold handstand for 10 seconds, then step down one foot at a time.
pe-02782:
1) Divide the court into two zones with cones and place one upright milk carton (or tumbler) inside each team's court.
 2) Play dodgeball under standard rules, throwing the ball to eliminate opposing players.
 3) If a team's milk carton is knocked down by a throw, that team loses the right to attack and must return all balls to opponents.
 4) A grounded milk carton can be set upright again and attack rights restored only when a player catches an opponent's throw.
pe-02783:
1) Place 10 colored pencils on each desk to start.
 2) Follow the leader's action only when the command begins with 'Simon says'.
 3) If you move without the cue, put one colored pencil away into your pencil case.
 4) The game continues without eliminating players, and the student with the most pencils left wins.
pe-02784:
1) Bounce and catch the basketball with the right hand for set counts (1, 3, 5, 7, 10 times).
 2) Switch feet and repeat the test using the left hand.
 3) Practice alternating dribbling with both hands.
 4) Dribble while walking toward the cone, turn around it, and return to the starting line.
pe-02785:
1) Squat down and jump high while reaching both arms overhead, repeating 10 times.
 2) Jump high while switching feet front and back with arms outstretched, repeating 10 times.
 3) Tuck knees up toward the chest and jump as high as possible, repeating 10 times.
pe-02786:
1) Stand in place and bounce the shuttlecock upward repeatedly with the racket at least 10 times without letting it drop.
 2) Continuously bounce the shuttlecock while alternating and flipping the racket face between forehand and backhand.
 3) Place a turning marker 3 to 5 meters away, bounce the shuttlecock continuously while walking around the marker, and return to the start.
pe-02787:
1) Place 5 plastic cups horizontally and throw a ball from 3 meters to hit them from left to right (5 rounds).
 2) Arrange 5 cups vertically in a row and hit them sequentially from nearest to farthest (5 rounds).
 3) Throw a ball 20 times at a circular target from 3 meters and tally the points.
pe-02788:
1) Hit the shuttlecock over a desk net into baskets arranged horizontally.
 2) Adjust hitting strength to land shuttlecocks in baskets placed vertically.
 3) Practice placing shots deep and short into corner baskets.
pe-02789:
1) Place two paper cups 2m apart, side-step back and forth to touch each cup three times, and complete 10 sets.
 2) Arrange cups in a cross pattern around a center spot and perform 5 repetitions of the cross-step touch drill.
 3) Line up 5 paper cups at equal intervals and complete 10 zigzag shuttle sprints.
pe-02790:
1) Spread arms, close eyes, and balance on one foot for one minute.
 2) Place a book on the head and walk back and forth for at least 10 steps minimizing wobbling.
 3) Hop on one foot over 4 paper cups on the floor and stack 6 paper cups into a 3-tier pyramid.
pe-02791:
1) Place unbreakable paper or plastic cups on the floor.
 2) Hop forward on one foot and stack the cups one by one.
 3) Return to the starting position after stacking all the cups.
 4) Practice for 5 sets.
pe-02792:
1) Set up a makeshift net using desks or chairs and place four character value baskets across the net.
 2) Use a backhand stroke to serve the shuttlecock into the closer baskets.
 3) Step forward and use a forehand stroke from below waist height to hit the shuttlecock into deeper baskets.
 4) Practice the high clear stroke by hitting the shuttlecock high and deep across the net.
pe-02793:
