1) Keep a balloon bouncing 10 times consecutively in place using different body parts such as head, shoulders, hands, and feet.
 2) Hit the balloon over a net, move quickly to the other side, and hit it back repeatedly.
 3) Pop the balloon high up, sprint around a turnaround marker, and hit it again before it lands.
pe-02794:
1) Divide the court into four areas to set one home area and three opposing areas.
 2) Serve the ball using an underhand or overhand serve to start the game.
 3) Hit the ball within three touches over to one of the three opponent areas.
 4) Strategically hit the ball toward open or difficult spots for the opponents.
pe-02795:
1) Juggle 2 lightly inflated plastic bags with one hand without dropping them for 10 or more repetitions.
 2) Juggle 3 inflated plastic bags using both hands alternately for 10 or more repetitions.
 3) Kick an inflated plastic bag like a jegi 10 or more times, tapping the foot on the ground between kicks.
 4) Vary the kicking by alternating feet or kicking continuously without letting the foot touch the floor.
pe-02796:
1) Place two cups on opposite sides and stand in the middle.
 2) Step side to side toward each cup for 10 repetitions to complete 1 set.
 3) Arrange 5 paper cups in a star shape on the floor and stand at the center.
 4) Step quickly back and forth between the center and each star point diagonally.
pe-02797:
1) Bounce lightly in stance and play the foot-stepping game trying to tag the partner's foot.
 2) Practice low and middle blocks, followed by counter-punches delivered right after defending.
 3) Bounce in fighting stance and practice front kicks, roundhouse kicks, and side kicks 10 times each.
pe-02798:
1) Mark the playing area and set center cones to designate the movement zone for the net.
 2) Run from one end to the other on signal; tagged runners become part of the net by holding hands.
 3) Gradually widen the boundary to adjust running space.
 4) The last 2-3 surviving runners become the net for the next round.
pe-02799:
1) Seal a large ziploc bag except for a small gap, inflate it fully through a straw, and close it tightly.
 2) Kick the inflated bag upward using the right foot, left foot, or alternating feet without dropping it.
 3) Practice individually to reach continuous target kicks such as 3 or 5 repetitions.
 4) Take turns with friends or family members to kick the bag in a relay to see how many total kicks can be connected.
pe-02800:
1) Place 10 beanbags in a basket at one end of a mat and an empty basket at the other end.
 2) On the start signal, log-roll sideways across the mat to transfer one item to the opposite basket.
 3) Roll back and repeat until all 10 items have been successfully moved to the other side.
 4) For cooperative or team competition play, set up additional mats and race to see which team finishes fastest.
pe-02801:
1) Team members sit in a circle on chairs and hold hands.
 2) Keep the balloon aloft using heads, bodies, or feet while keeping hands joined.
 3) Count consecutive hits until hands disconnect or the balloon touches the floor.
 4) Try multiple rounds to reach the class goal or challenge the highest record.
pe-02802:
1) Form balanced groups by grouping students of similar heights together.
 2) The first player stretches their legs as wide as possible and shouts the team cheer, signaling the next runner to start.
 3) In the same manner, each subsequent runner stretches and connects, and after the last member calls the cheer, the first runner goes again to continue the chain.
 4) The team that rounds the designated cone first wins.
pe-02803:
1) Set numbered cones 1 through 6 in a straight line and arrange 1-on-1 matchups.
 2) Both runners roll their dice simultaneously at the starting line.
 3) Sprint to and round the cone matching the rolled dice number, then race back to the start line.
 4) Tally the winning rounds; the team with the most victories wins the game.
pe-02804:
1) Launch a balloon into the air using hands or feet.
 2) Safely catch and land the balloon into a funnel before it hits the floor.
 3) Challenge players to see how many balloons they can land within a set time, or launch multiple balloons at once and land as many as possible before they touch the ground.
 4) Apply bonus rules where catching a balloon in a funnel and immediately tossing it back up to catch it again awards multiplier points (2x, 3x).
pe-02805:
1) Set up courses from hole 1 to hole 5 using cones and spot markers, placing cups as obstacles.
 2) Use a foam stick as a golf club to hit the balloon toward each hole marker in order.
 3) Touching the numbered spot marker with the balloon counts as completing the hole.
 4) If an obstacle cup is knocked down, add penalty strokes equal to fallen cups, reset them, and proceed.
pe-02806:
1) Place the wide, flat side of a beanbag on your head and walk around the classroom.
 2) Keep the beanbag balanced on your head without touching it, counting how many times it falls.
 3) On cue, sit down on the nearest empty chair within 5 seconds without using your hands to hold the beanbag.
 4) Stand up again without hands, walk or jog clockwise or counterclockwise, and quickly sit on an empty chair on command.
pe-02807:
1) Divide into teams and have each half stand facing each other about 10 meters apart.
 2) Kick the ball and run to the back of the opposing line.
 3) If the receiver traps the ball in place, they kick and advance to the opposite side.
 4) If the ball is not caught in place, the player retrieves it and kicks again; if missed a second time, hand the ball to the teammate and go to the back of the line or perform 10 star jumps.
pe-02808:
1) Set up rope turners and teams jumping over the long rope.
 2) The designated number of players (3 players) enter the turning rope based on the dice mission.
 3) Jump over the turning rope for the required number of times (3 jumps) and exit.
 4) After succeeding, rotate positions and continue the challenge.
pe-02809:
1) Arrange 6 desks marked with 1 to 4 points to set up a landing area.
 2) Stand at the throw line and toss a flying disc (or paper plate) toward the desks.
 3) Score points when the disc lands directly on a desk or rebounds off a wall onto a desk.
 4) Each player throws 10 times, and the one with the most landings and highest score wins.
pe-02810:
1) In pairs, one person alternates between lying flat and pushing up on their arms.
 2) The other partner jumps over them when they are down, and crawls underneath when they push up.
 3) Continue cooperatively until completing the designated number of repetitions.
pe-02811:
1) Mark lines numbered 1 to 6 on the floor.
 2) Roll the first die and place your foot on the corresponding numbered line.
 3) Roll the second die and place your hand on that numbered line.
 4) Both teams compete simultaneously, and the team that touches correctly first wins.
pe-02812:
1) Crumple newspapers to make newspaper baseballs.
 2) Roll several sheets of newspaper to make a newspaper bat.
 3) Take turns pitching and batting with the newspaper equipment.
 4) Initially score 1 point per hit, and as players improve, set designated scoring areas or divide into offense and defense teams for a match.
pe-02813:
1) A partner rolls balls at a steady speed from the opposite side.
 2) Catch the rolling ball accurately on the first attempt using a cone or paper cup.
 3) Count how many balls you catch out of the total rolled.
pe-02814:
1) Set up an obstacle course in various shapes and prepare a stick and a balloon.
 2) Dribble the balloon with the stick through the course like playing hockey.
 3) Complete two laps around the course.
 4) Compete based on elapsed time, fewer obstacles hit, or as a relay race.
pe-02815:
1) Float a balloon in the air and write numbers on paper.
 2) If the balloon touches the floor, the next person takes over.
 3) Play as a relay; the team that writes more numbers within 1 minute 30 seconds or reaches 100 first wins.
pe-02816:
1) Draw footprints (and handprints) on paper and arrange them irregularly on the floor to form a path.
 2) Divide into two teams, mark the start and final defense lines, and have the first runners jump along the path according to the shapes.
 3) When meeting in the middle, play rock-paper-scissors; the loser goes to the back of the line while the next player starts, and the winner advances.
 4) The team that passes the opponent's final defense line and wins rock-paper-scissors wins the game.
pe-02817:
1) Stand in a circle and pass the ball to each other.
 2) The two people on either side of the ball receiver must squat and stand up within one second.
 3) Players are eliminated if they fail to catch the ball or do not squat in time.
pe-02818:
1) Divide into teams and play standard dodgeball.
 2) When a player catches an opponent's throw, pause the game and roll the dice.
 3) Choose 2 lucky numbers beforehand: the first revives 1 teammate, and the second eliminates 1 opponent.
 4) If any other number is rolled, resume immediately; the team that eliminates all opponents or has more survivors wins.
pe-02819:
1) Scatter disc cones between the goal and the penalty kick spot.
 2) Determine attacker and goalkeeper by rock-paper-scissors; the attacker shoots while the keeper defends.
 3) If a goal is scored, the shooter retrieves disc cones one by one until the keeper brings the ball back.
 4) If the shot misses, the keeper collects disc cones one by one until the shooter retrieves the ball.
pe-02820:
1) Arrange cones in a circle and place defensive throwers around the perimeter.
 2) One runner enters the circle and tries to knock down all the cones using hands or feet.
 3) Outside players throw a dodgeball to hit the runner before all cones are knocked down.
 4) If hit, the runner performs a forfeit task; if all cones are knocked down, all throwers perform the task.
pe-02821:
1) Mark a scoring area in the center of the classroom floor using chalk or masking tape.
 2) Players slide rings from their seated positions across the floor toward the target.
 3) Score 10 points if the ring is completely inside the scoring area, and 5 points if it touches the line.
 4) Add 1 bonus point each time a ring hits another ring, and the team with the highest total score wins.
pe-02822:
1) Perform consecutive underhand tosses in place with a volleyball.
 2) Count the total number of successful tosses before the ball drops.
 3) Take a second turn and accumulate the scores from both attempts.
 4) All group members take turns, and team rankings are decided by total accumulated tosses.
pe-02823:
1) Divide into teams of 3-4 players and give each player a noodle stick.
 2) Inflate a balloon and practice keeping it in the air using the noodle sticks.
 3) Take turns hitting the balloon to see which team can keep it up the longest and achieve the highest count.
 4) The turn ends if the balloon touches the floor, if turn order is broken, or if one player hits it twice in a row.
pe-02824:
1) Line up in teams holding the shoulders of the player in front.
 2) The front player leads the line to chase and tag the tail of another team.
 3) If a team's tail is tagged or the chain breaks, that team is eliminated.
pe-02825:
1) Set up 10 traffic cones in a triangle bowling pin formation (1-2-3-4).
 2) Divide into teams, set a kicking order, and kick the soccer ball from the mark toward the cones.
 3) Each kicker follows the sequence of kick, reset fallen cones, and retrieve ball, scoring points equal to knocked cones.
 4) The team that clears all 10 cones first or accumulates the highest score wins.
pe-02826:
1) Build a castle with Kapla blocks featuring walls and a central target.
 2) Build and shoot a Kapla cannon toward the target.
 3) Players attack each other's castles simultaneously, and the first to knock down the opponent's castle wins.
pe-02827:
1) Taggers hold foam noodles to link together side-by-side like a fishing net.
 2) On signal, the net tags runners by chasing and cornering them.
 3) Runners tagged by the net must take a foam stick and attach to either end of the net.
 4) Once the net reaches its maximum set size, any additional players tagged are eliminated.
pe-02828:
1) Set up 3-4 safe zones using mats or vaulting boxes and create an attacking zone in the middle.
 2) On the move command, runners must dash to another safe zone within 5 seconds.
 3) Attackers stationed in the center throw dodgeballs at the runners moving between zones.
 4) Players hit by a ball or failing to arrive within 5 seconds are out; the team with more survivors after a full cycle wins.
pe-02829:
1) Draw footprints on drawing paper and arrange them irregularly on the floor to make a course.
 2) Determine the turn order for jumping along the footprints.
 3) Jump according to the footstep patterns in sequence to reach the finish.
 4) If a mistake is made, freeze for 3 seconds before resuming; the fastest player/team to finish wins.
pe-02830:
1) Set up cones on the opposite side of the court.
 2) Hit an underhand serve over the net.
 3) If a cone is hit and knocked down, retrieve and collect that cone.
 4) Take turns serving until all cones are knocked down; the team with the most cones wins.
pe-02831:
1) Build a castle using jumbo cups or cones.
 2) Divide into teams and set the order for dribbling.
 3) Dribble the ball and knock down the opposing team's castle with a shot.
 4) Rebuild the castle after knocking it down and return to the starting line.
 5) The first person to return wins and earns points.
pe-02832:
1) Player 1 holds a fan, approaches Player 2, and challenges them to rock-paper-scissors.
 2) Roll a die, and the loser fans the winner with utmost care for the number of times shown (e.g., 6 times for 6, twice for 2).
 3) Proceed in order to Player 3 and Player 4 to play rock-paper-scissors and fan them in the same way.
 4) The next player then takes the fan and visits all classmates sequentially to complete the mission.
pe-02833:
1) Designate a tagger defender for each team and hand them a foam stick.
 2) The defender cannot cross the centerline and must defend by tagging attacking opponents with the foam stick.
 3) Tagged attackers must run back and touch their own goalpost before rejoining play.
 4) Once a defender tags an opponent, they pass the foam stick to the nearest teammate to switch defender roles.
pe-02834:
1) Kick the shuttlecock as many times as you can.
 2) After the kick, a teammate catches it with a basket.
 3) If caught, the team scores points (kicking twice and catching earns 2 points).
pe-02835:
1) Divide players into offense and defense teams.
 2) The defensive team stacks a 3- to 5-level tower using blocks inside the marked area.
 3) The offensive team throws a foam die to knock down the tower within 5 attempts.
 4) Once knocked down, the offense retrieves the die to tag defenders while the original builder rebuilds the tower.
pe-02836:
1) Two players lie down side by side facing opposite directions on a mat with hips aligned.
 2) On the count of "One, Two," each raises and lowers their leg once.
 3) On the count of "Three," hook legs together and attempt to flip or pin the opponent.
 4) Flipping the opponent results in an immediate win; if tied, hold for 5 seconds and whoever presses the opponent's leg down longer wins.
pe-02837:
1) Prepare an inflated zip-lock bag and a basket to use as a hoop.
 2) Take turns practicing shooting the zip-lock bag into the basket.
 3) Pass the bag consecutively from the back and let the last player shoot into the basket.
 4) The last shooter gets as many shots as the number of bags received, aiming to score 10 points within the time limit.
pe-02838:
1) Place cones worth 1 to 5 points according to distance.
 2) On start, run, choose which cone to round, and return.
 3) The person who crosses back first earns points equal to the distance of the rounded cone.
pe-02839:
1) Place cups on a desk while two players hold both ends of string to create a track for a table tennis ball.
 2) Roll the ball on the string and pull strings apart to drop it into a cup.
 3) Earn 1 point for every ball successfully dropped into a cup; the team with more points wins.
pe-02840:
1) Place a disc cone on your head and get ready at the starting line.
 2) Move toward the target point while keeping the cone balanced on your head.
 3) If the cone falls during the run, return to the very end of the line.
 4) The next runner departs once high-fived by the returning runner.
pe-02841:
1) One player from each team places a cone on their head and waits for the signal.
 2) On signal, throw the cone toward the central scoring cone.
 3) Points are awarded in the order cones are stacked onto the target.
 4) The next players take turns, and the team with the highest total score wins.
pe-02842:
1) Draw a looping track on the classroom floor using chalk or masking tape.
 2) Take turns flicking markers (such as pebbles) along the track with fingers.
 3) The next teammate continues from where the marker stopped; if it goes off the track, it must restart from the beginning.
 4) The team that reaches the final space first or advances the furthest within the time limit wins.
pe-02843:
1) Place baskets on both sides of the mat and fill one basket with beanbags.
 2) A runner holds 1 beanbag and rolls sideways across the mat to the opposite basket.
 3) Place the beanbag into the basket and roll back to the starting point.
 4) Tag the next runner upon returning; the team that transfers more beanbags within the time limit wins.
pe-02844:
1) Mark a boundary line on the floor that players cannot cross.
 2) One person tosses a target duck balloon into the air.
 3) Hunters throw or kick their own balloons without stepping over the line to hit the duck balloon.
 4) The team that hits the target balloon the most times in the allotted time with fewer attempts wins.
pe-02845:
1) Form teams in an open and safe space.
 2) Hold hands in a circle, designate a king inside, and place the tagger on the opposite side.
 3) For a set time, the tagger tries to tag the king while teammates rotate while maintaining the circle to protect the king.
 4) The round ends if the king is tagged, teammates lose hands, or someone falls.
pe-02846:
1) Divide into teams, set the running order, and place a defender in the opponent's face-off zone.
 2) Run from the starting zone to the face-off zone and play rock-paper-scissors with the defender.
 3) If you lose to the defender, say "Wait!" and run back to the starting line before running back.
 4) If you win, return to the start line and bring 1 teammate along to run together.
 5) Add 1 player each time you win; all members must enter the face-off zone before playing rock-paper-scissors, and the team that brings all members first wins.
pe-02847:
1) Set the throwing spot and target spot, then line up in single file by team.
 2) Take turns throwing cones to stack them over the base cone.
 3) If you fail, put the cone back, touch the opposite wall, and go to the back of the line; if successful, go directly to the back to try again.
 4) The team that stacks all cones first or stacks more within the time limit wins.
pe-02848:
1) Sit on chairs facing each other in two rows and check the passing order.
 2) The first player taps the balloon into the air toward the next player.
 3) Without catching or holding the balloon, players tap it along the line to the last person without letting it hit the floor.
 4) Once reached to the end, challenge sending it all the way back in reverse.
pe-02849:
1) Start a pedometer app on a smartphone and place it into a pocket or pouch.
 2) Move actively in place by running or jumping during the set time to rack up steps.
 3) Shaking the device directly with hands is forbidden; pass the device to the next teammate when time runs out.
 4) The team with the highest total step count wins.
pe-02850:
1) Prepare a set of cone discs in 3-4 colors, marker cones, and a scoreboard.
 2) Hold multiple cone discs together and throw them into the air at once.
 3) Run to catch your assigned team color cone disc and return first to earn points, or win instantly by catching it in midair.
 4) Take turns competing and the team with the higher score wins.
pe-02851:
1) Line up at the starting line holding a disc cone.
 2) Toss the cone into the air simultaneously on the starting signal.
 3) Sprint to where the cone landed, pick it up, and prepare to throw it again.
 4) Repeat tossing and chasing around the turning point, scoring or winning in order of returning to the start.
pe-02852:
1) Face each other holding foam noodles and prepare to pass the ring.
 2) Slide the ring along the floor accurately toward your partner across the space.
 3) Successfully catching the sliding ring with the foam noodle before it stops scores 1 point.
 4) Take turns upon failure or switch pairs, competing to achieve the highest score within the given time.
pe-02853:
1) Clear classroom desks to create a course and set up starting and turnaround cones.
 2) Move forward while bouncing the shuttlecock upward with the paddle without letting it hit the floor or ceiling.
 3) If the shuttlecock drops or hits the ceiling, complete a penalty mission (e.g., 3 star jumps) before resuming.
 4) Round the turnaround marker and pass the equipment to the next runner in a relay race.
pe-02854:
1) Each student prepares a cushion to throw.
 2) Mark the starting line and scoring zones (foul, 1 point, 2 points, 1 point, etc.) on the classroom floor using tape.
 3) Set a throwing order and take turns tossing the cushion from the starting line.
 4) Tally the points based on where the cushion lands across multiple rounds.
pe-02855:
1) Divide into teams, set the throwing and catching order, and have two players step forward.
 2) Throw the ball high overhead from a spot and run to the opposite side.
 3) The player on the opposite side runs in and catches the ball before it touches the ground.
 4) Earn 1 point by catching the ball before it drops; the team with the most successful catches within the time or round limit wins.
pe-02856:
1) Divide into teams and line up with feet touching the starting cone at the end of the field stands.
 2) On signal, run along the bleachers toward the disc cones placed on top of the cones at the far end.
 3) The first player to grab a disc cone scores 1 point and runs back to the starting point.
 4) The first player to stack the disc cone onto the starting cone earns 1 point; the team with the highest total score after everyone takes turns wins.
pe-02857:
1) Each student folds a paper airplane using an A4 sheet.
 2) Stack 10 cups in a pyramid (4-3-2-1) on a desk as the target.
 3) Teammates take turns throwing paper airplanes toward the cup pyramid from the designated line.
 4) The team earns points equal to the total number of cups knocked down within the given time.
pe-02858:
1) Divide into teams, stand in a circle holding cups, and decide the order of throwing and catching.
 2) The first player bounces a ping-pong ball off the floor toward the next teammate.
 3) When caught with the cup, the team earns 1 point, and that player bounces it to the next teammate.
 4) If missed, the next player restarts the bounce, and total points are tallied after everyone finishes.
pe-02859:
1) Sit on chairs in a circle.
 2) The first player places the ball on their feet or grips it with both feet to prepare.
 3) Pass the ball sequentially onto the next person's feet to complete a full loop.
 4) If the ball drops to the floor, restart from that player and complete the loop.
pe-02860:
1) Mark the start line and destination line, then roll the hoop forward.
 2) Run to where the hoop rolls and pick it up only after it comes to a complete stop, then roll it again.
 3) The player or team that reaches the destination or circles back to the start line first wins.
 4) Alternatively, players can compete to reach the target with fewer rolling attempts.
pe-02861:
1) Divide into teams and get ready at the starting cone with a hand on the cone.
 2) The first runner dribbles the soccer ball with feet, places it inside the hula hoop, and runs back to the start cone.
 3) The next runner sprints to the hoop and dribbles the ball back.
 4) Teams alternate, and the team whose runners return and touch the cone first wins.
pe-02862:
1) Set up 5 targets and draw a kicking line at a distance.
 2) Each player kicks a ball 3 times to knock down the targets.
 3) If all 5 targets are knocked down within 3 kicks, re-stack them and use remaining kicks to score more points.
 4) Any targets left standing after 3 kicks become the opponent team's points.
pe-02863:
1) Decide whether to participate sitting on a chair or standing.
 2) Players sitting must not rise from their chairs, and standing players are eliminated if they lift either foot.
 3) Teammates take turns keeping the balloon airborne without letting it hit the ground.
 4) The team that keeps the balloon aloft until the time limit wins.
pe-02864:
1) Place 5 cones on each side and start with 5 dish cones.
 2) Place a dish cone on the left cone, turn around the turning point, and move cones to the right repeatedly.
 3) For a 1-on-1 match, use different colored cones and start from opposite sides to see who finishes first.
 4) If cones are unavailable, paper cups and masking tape can be used as alternatives.
pe-02865:
1) Set up goals on both ends using cones.
 2) Hold a plank position and use your hands to slide marker cones to score and defend.
 3) Score a point whenever the cone passes through the opponent's goal.
 4) Touching your knees to the ground is a foul, and the player with the most points wins.
pe-02866:
1) Divide into teams and determine the dribbling order.
 2) Dribble the soccer ball by kicking it, turn around the turning point, and return to the start line.
 3) Pass the ball accurately to the next runner upon returning and move to the back of the line.
 4) As a variation, pairs hold hands or hold a foam noodle while taking turns kicking the ball around the turning point.
pe-02867:
1) Fold origami paper ddakji tiles with team members within a set time.
 2) Write 'Treasure' on both sides of one ddakji and place it on the floor.
 3) One player from each team steps forward to flip the treasure tile; failed ddakji remain on the floor.
 4) Successfully flipping the treasure tile allows the player to sweep all accumulated tiles, and the team with the most tiles wins.
pe-02868:
1) Mark shooting spots in numerical sequence starting from spot 1 using spot markers.
 2) Players take turns shooting at the basketball hoop starting from spot 1.
 3) If a shot misses, move to the end of the line and wait for the next turn.
 4) If the shot goes in, advance to the next spot number, and the player clearing the most spots within the time limit wins.
pe-02869:
1) Lie down side-by-side on exercise mats, with each player holding a dodgeball or bouncy ball.
 2) Push the ball upward with both hands high toward the ceiling without touching it.
 3) Catch the falling ball while remaining completely flat on the mat to score 1 point.
 4) Dropping the ball or sitting up off the mat results in elimination, and the player with the most catches wins.
pe-02870:
1) Gather various classroom items such as brooms, umbrellas, markers, and foam sticks along with a trash bin.
 2) Divide into teams and have one representative from each team step forward.
 3) Play rock-paper-scissors to select a throwing item, then throw it toward the bin from behind the foul line.
 4) Score points for each item successfully landing inside the bin, and the team with the higher score wins.
pe-02871:
1) Two players face each other at the basic distance cones and throw a flying disc.
 2) Upon a successful catch, take one step back to increase the distance.
 3) If a catch fails, step one step forward to try again from a closer distance.
 4) Keep one pivot foot planted without lifting it while throwing.
pe-02872:
1) Set up an upright object as a target and prepare a flying disc with a hole in the center.
 2) Throw the flying disc from a distance.
 3) Score 1 point if the disc hits the target.
 4) Score 10 points if the disc rings around the target like a necklace.
pe-02873:
1) Four players decide their order and set up 10 targets.
 2) Without crossing the line, the first player throws an object by hand to knock down the targets.
 3) If all targets fall, reset 10 targets; if any remain, the next player continues.
 4) Modify the activity by kicking the object instead of throwing.
pe-02874:
1) Place a balloon on a plate in each hand, start from the line, and loop around the turning point.
 2) If a balloon falls to the floor, stop in place, pick it up, perform 5 jumping jacks, and then resume.
 3) Return to the starting line and take turns with the next person in line.
pe-02875:
1) Form groups of four with 1 king, 2 bodyguards, and 1 tagger.
 2) The king and bodyguards hold hands in a circle while the tagger attempts to tag the king.
 3) Bodyguards rotate left and right to shield the king from the tagger.
 4) Compete for a set duration; the tagger succeeds if they tag the king within the time limit.
pe-02876:
1) Divide into teams and set the starting line and target point.
 2) Kick the ball in the order decided within the team.
 3) The next person kicks the ball from the spot where it stopped.
 4) Repeat taking turns until hitting the target cone, and the team reaching it in fewer kicks or first wins.
pe-02877:
1) Place 5 traffic cones at regular intervals and stand at both starting lines holding 2 dome cones.
 2) On signal, run and place a foot on the side cone, then toss a dome cone to cap it like a hat.
 3) After capping the side cone, attempt to cap the center traffic cone.
 4) The player who caps the center cone first wins, and if time runs out, decide by rock-paper-scissors.
pe-02878:
1) Divide into teams and decide the running order in front of the desk.
 2) The first runner runs with 1 cup, places it on the desk, and returns.
 3) The next runner carries 1 cup, stacks it on the desk, and returns.
 4) Continue taking turns within the time limit; the team that stacks more cups or higher without toppling wins.
pe-02879:
1) Stack 12 cups and place one different-colored cup on the top.
 2) Hold one end of a towel with one hand and keep the other hand on the waist.
 3) Flick the towel quickly to hit the target cups with the end of the towel.
 4) Score 1 point per fallen cup and an additional 10 points for knocking down the top cup.
pe-02880:
1) Divide into teams and prepare 4-5 flying discs per team.
 2) Take turns throwing flying discs from a designated spot into hula hoops.
 3) The team that completes a line horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
 4) As a variation, knock an opponent's disc out of a hoop to claim the spot.
pe-02881:
1) Place a cone in the center and divide students into two competing teams behind the starting lines.
 2) One player from each team dribbles a soccer ball forward simultaneously.
 3) Dribble within shooting distance and kick the ball toward the cone.
 4) Score 1 point for hitting the cone and 5 points for knocking it down; the team with the higher score wins.
pe-02882:
1) A designated roller rolls the ball from the starting line at a steady pace.
 2) Other participants rush forward to catch the ball before it rolls away or drops.
 3) From the spot where it is caught, the next player rolls the ball again for another teammate.
 4) Progressively challenge the group by varying the ball's speed and size.
pe-02883:
1) Divide into 2 to 4 teams and start with one hand and foot touching the lockers at the starting line.
 2) Run forward and stack six large cups into a 3-tier pyramid at the midway point.
 3) Touch the turning point (such as the blackboard) with your hand.
 4) Collapse and repack the 3-tier cup pyramid into a single stack, and the player who returns to the starting line first wins.
pe-02884:
1) Set up a circular court using saucer cones.
 2) Start running in the same direction while jumping rope.
 3) The player who covers more distance within the set time and catches up to the opponent wins.
 4) A player wins immediately if the distance to the opponent becomes within 1 meter even if time remains.
pe-02885:
1) Make scoring zones on the classroom floor using masking tape.
 2) Divide into teams and set the throwing order.
 3) Roll 4 Yut sticks together toward the scoring zones.
 4) Score points based on the zones they land in, and the team with higher points wins.
pe-02886:
1) Clear space by moving desks and pair up into teams of two.
 2) Practice rallying the shuttlecock back and forth without letting it touch the ground.
 3) Earn 1 point together each time a successful rally pass is made.
 4) Take turns, and the team with the most points wins.
pe-02887:
1) Divide into teams and decide offense and defense order.
 2) Player 1 on defense stacks foam dice into a tower, while player 1 on offense prepares with a ball at a distance.
 3) Offense throws the ball to knock down the tower, retrieves the ball, and chases the defense inside the court to tag them.
 4) The number of players tagged until the defense reassembles the tower and calls "Stop!" becomes the offensive score.
pe-02888:
1) Draw a target on the chalkboard using chalk or magnets.
 2) Divide into teams and set the throwing order.
 3) Soak tissue paper in water and throw it at the chalkboard target from a designated line.
 4) Points are awarded only if the tissue sticks to the board for at least 3 seconds, and the team with the higher score wins.
pe-02889:
1) Set up a basket on the classroom floor as a goal.
 2) Practice kicking the Jegi individually.
 3) Kick the Jegi as many times as possible and kick it toward the basket on the final hit.
 4) Earn bonus points if the Jegi lands inside the basket, and the team with the most points wins.
pe-02890:
1) Set a cleaning area using wet wipes or cleaning cloths.
 2) Four players participate, moving around to clean the designated area using the soles of their feet.
 3) Measure the time taken to wipe the entire designated area.
pe-02891:
1) Tie a balloon connected to two rubber bands around the ankle and arrange cones in a circle to form a course.
 2) Start from the mark and run the set number of laps without hitting cones to record the fastest time (penalty time added per cone touched).
 3) Two runners start from opposite sides in the same circular direction to chase the opponent and pop their ankle balloon with their foot.
 4) Avoid touching cone obstacles while protecting your own balloon and attempting to pop the opponent's balloon.
pe-02892:
1) Prepare at the starting line, excluding the tagger.
 2) Jump forward the designated number of steps.
 3) Turn around and face the tagger after completing the jumps.
 4) The tagger jumps one fewer step than the designated number.
 5) Players tagged are out and move to the mission area to perform a task.
 6) If untagged, jump back across the starting line to survive.
pe-02893:
1) Prepare to kick the balloon shuttlecock using only feet.
 2) Each person attempts twice, recording the higher count as their score.
 3) The attempt ends immediately if the balloon touches another surface or falls to the floor.
pe-02894:
1) Place the treasure ball in the center and line up by number on both sides.
 2) When a number is called, rush to grab the central treasure and return to the team zone to score 1 point.
 3) If you fail to grab the ball first, tag the opponent carrying the treasure back to score 1 point.
 4) The losing team performs 5 star jumps as a mission before the next round.
pe-02895:
1) When the tagger stands up, an empty seat is created, and the people directly next to the empty seat cannot move into it.
 2) The tagger walks toward the empty seat while other players move and sit in it first to defend.
 3) If the tagger successfully sits in the empty seat, the tagger wins and the remaining players perform a penalty.
pe-02896:
1) Teams position runners at different starting points along a circular track.
 2) On start, runners sprint in the assigned direction chasing opponents ahead.
 3) Touching an opponent in front eliminates them from the round.
 4) If neither is caught, the runner returning to their starting point first wins.
pe-02897:
1) Pair up facing each other and practice passing the flying disc.
 2) Take one step back every time you successfully catch the disc.
 3) Take one step forward toward your partner whenever you fail to catch it.
 4) Challenge yourselves to reach the furthest distance within the time limit.
pe-02898:
1) Pair up facing each other with a cone placed midway between you.
 2) Shift one spot to the left on the "Left" call, and to the right on the "Right" call.
 3) Spin 360 degrees in place when you hear "Spin".
 4) Quickly snatch the cone between you the moment "Grab" is called.
pe-02899:
1) Two defenders hold a hula hoop together to surround and protect the leader inside.
 2) The tagger starts from the opposite side and moves quickly left and right to touch the leader.
 3) Defenders rotate and move together holding the hoop to keep the leader from being touched.
 4) The tagger's team wins by tagging the leader, or if the defenders let go of the hoop.
pe-02900:
1) Three players from each team step forward and roll the dice simultaneously.
 2) The player with the higher dice roll wins and must jump rope that exact number of times without tripping.
 3) Successfully completing the number scores 1 point, and each additional completed set adds bonus points.
 4) The opposing player keeps rolling the dice for defense until rolling a 6, which immediately stops the jumper's turn.
pe-02901:
1) Move the cones from the starting point to the second zone one at a time, running back and forth.
 2) Once all cones in the first zone are moved to the second zone, move them from the second to the third zone.
 3) The activity ends when all cones are carried and stacked in the final fourth zone.
pe-02902:
1) Set up paper cups on a desk or floor to create targets.
 2) Toss the zipper bag upward with one hand.
 3) Strike the zipper bag downward with the opposite hand toward the paper cup targets.
 4) In multi-player variations, take turns tossing, spiking, and receiving.
pe-02903:
1) Set up mats, balls, and a storage bin on the floor.
 2) Lie on your back on the mat and clamp a ball between your feet.
 3) Lift your legs overhead using abdominal strength to drop the ball into the bin behind you.
 4) Take turns within the time limit, and the team that transfers the most balls wins.
pe-02904:
1) Place a dish cone on your head and stand ready at the starting line.
 2) Run or walk fast toward the turning point when the signal is given.
 3) If the cone falls, perform 5 star jumps on the spot before continuing.
 4) Turn around the marker and return to the start line; the first one back wins.
pe-02905:
1) Two players stand facing each other with their front toes touching.
 2) Play rock-paper-scissors.
 3) The winner pulls their front foot back to touch their rear heel.
 4) The loser slides their front foot forward to touch the winner's front foot, stretching their legs.
 5) Continue until a player loses balance or can no longer stretch.
pe-02906:
1) Divide into two teams, line up, and hold cones upside down.
 2) The first player tosses the ball resting on their cone to the next player.
 3) The next player catches the ball with their cone and tosses it to the next teammate.
 4) Pass the ball all the way to the end and back without dropping it; the faster team wins.
pe-02907:
1) Prepare an unbreakable object or ball and face each other.
 2) The first student turns left and hands the object over.
 3) Without dropping it, the student turns right to pass it, repeating 5 times each side or 10 times in total.
pe-02908:
1) Set up cones to create a catching area and have players step in by turn.
 2) Catch table tennis balls bouncing once off the floor at 1-second intervals using a cup.
 3) Score points equal to the number of balls successfully caught out of the predetermined total bounces.
 4) The player or team with the highest score wins.
pe-02909:
1) Roll the dice to check the resulting number from 1 to 6.
 2) If the number is high, turn around a closer cone; if low, turn around a farther cone.
 3) After returning, players equal to the dice number enter the long rope and jump.
pe-02910:
1) Set up a 3x3 bingo grid on the classroom floor using Speed Stacks cups.
 2) Divide into teams and practice bouncing table tennis balls off the floor into the cups.
 3) Take turns within each team bouncing a ball off the floor once into a cup.
 4) A ball that bounces out of a cup does not count, and the first team to complete a line of bingo wins.
pe-02911:
1) Move classroom desks and chairs to secure open space and divide into teams.
 2) Two players from each team step out facing each other; one holds puff balls to throw, and the other holds a cone upside down.
 3) The thrower tosses a puff ball from low to high underhand.
 4) Catching the puff ball in the cone scores 1 point, and players switch roles after a designated number of throws (5 attempts).
pe-02912:
1) Set up cones at the starting line and turning point, and divide into teams wearing team vests.
 2) The first runner runs alone around the turning point and returns.
 3) Return to the start line and hold hands with the next runner to run around the turning point together.
 4) Add one teammate by holding hands each lap; the team whose entire group finishes together first wins.
pe-02913:
1) Set a center showdown line and safety zones on both sides using cones.
 2) Divide into teams and line up along the center showdown line.
 3) Play rock-paper-scissors with the facing partner.
 4) The winner chases while the loser runs toward their safety zone.
 5) If tagged before reaching the safety zone, perform a penalty mission (5 jumping jacks).
pe-02914:
1) Draw concentric score rings on the floor around a cone.
 2) Divide into teams and take turns tossing beanbags or pom-pom balls toward the target from a set distance.
 3) Score 3, 2, or 1 points from the innermost ring outward, with a 5-point bonus if touching the cone.
 4) Tally up the total points after all tosses; the team with the higher score wins.
pe-02915:
1) Set up a circular track using cones.
 2) One player from each team steps out on opposite sides ready to start.
 3) Dribble a basketball in the designated direction while trying to chase down the opponent.
 4) Catch up to the opposing player within the time limit or set laps to win.
pe-02916:
1) Hit the ring on the floor using a foam stick toward the goal.
 2) Score points when the ring passes completely through the goal.
 3) Points are awarded even if you strike a teammate's ring into the goal.
 4) You can try shooting two rings in a row for extra points.
pe-02917:
1) Stand in line maintaining distance so you do not collide with adjacent students.
 2) On cue, throw the flying disc straight up into the air.
 3) Catch your own flying disc before it touches the ground.
 4) If the disc hits the ground, sit down and you are eliminated.
pe-02918:
1) Set up numbered cones irregularly on the floor and set a target score of 50 points.
 2) Players take turns throwing a foam die toward the cones from the throwing line.
 3) Add the number on the knocked-down cone and the number rolled on the die to the team score, then set the cone back up.
 4) The first team to reach the target score wins, but exceeding the target cuts the score in half.
pe-02919:
1) Line up behind the start line by team, with the first runner holding a basketball.
 2) On the start signal, dribble toward the basketball hoop.
 3) Take a shot near the basket, scoring 1 point for every successful basket.
 4) Dribble back after retrieving the ball and hand it off to the next player; the first team to reach 10 points wins.
pe-02920:
1) One player from each team lines up on either side of the mini goal, with a ball placed on the far side.
 2) On signal, both run toward the ball; the player who touches it first with their foot gains possession to attack.
 3) The player who misses the ball must run back to defend the goal as a goalkeeper.
 4) The attacker dribbles and shoots to score, while the defender successfully defends by blocking the ball or sending it out.
pe-02921:
1) Set up a designated playing area using cones and divide students into two teams wearing bibs.
 2) Establish a team running order, and the first runners from both teams step forward to roll foam dice simultaneously.
 3) Pick up the dice once it settles and chase opposing team members to tag the exact number shown on the dice.
 4) The first tagger to tag the required number of opponents while carrying the dice and return to base wins, while tagged runners sit outside.
pe-02922:
1) The tagger plays rock-paper-scissors against all students.
 2) Except for those specified by the round rule, all players stand up and rush to find an empty chair.
 3) Players must move at least two seats away and cannot return to their original or adjacent seat.
 4) The tagger also sits; the person left without a chair completes a short mission and becomes the next tagger.
pe-02923:
1) Set up a throwing line and an obstacle with a center opening using boxes.
 2) A player throws the flying disc 10 times through the opening.
 3) Score 10 points for passing cleanly, and 5 points if it touches the frame while passing (up to 100 points).
 4) Take turns with a partner to compare scores after 10 throws.
pe-02924:
1) Face your partner and toss the ball back and forth using an underhand technique.
 2) Count the number of consecutive successful tosses without dropping the ball.
 3) Attempt twice and keep the higher count as the team score.
 4) Switch pairs and the team with the highest record wins.
pe-02925:
1) Pairs stand holding upright newspaper sticks and exchange sticks while chanting 'one, two, three, four'.
 2) Form a large circle, walk in a line, and catch the forward player's stick before it falls on cue or with music.
 3) Move to songs and switch sticks when the music stops or commands are given.
pe-02926:
1) Players form a large circle in attention stance and hold hands to create a fence.
 2) Select players to act as the rabbit and the hunter.
 3) The players forming the fence raise their joined hands to open doors or lower them to close doors.
 4) Players open gates to help the rabbit escape and close gates to block the hunter from tagging the rabbit.
pe-02927:
1) All participants hold hands to form a continuous line.
 2) The leader moves into the center, spiraling outward to wind the thread.
 3) After fully winding, the leader raises hands to create an open arch gate.
 4) The line passes through the arch and forms a large circle turning right to unwind the thread.
pe-02928:
1) Set up a jumping board over a central support such as a straw roll.
 2) Two players stand facing each other at opposite ends of the wooden plank.
 3) When one player jumps and lands, the rebound launches the player on the other side.
 4) Take turns jumping rhythmically into the air to increase height.
pe-02929:
1) All players begin in the egg stage, crouching low and making an egg shape with their hands while moving around.
 2) Players challenge others in the same evolution stage to rock-paper-scissors; winning allows promotion to the next stage (Egg-Chick-Chicken-Tiger-Hunter-King).
 3) Winning at the hunter stage earns the right to challenge the king.
 4) Defeating the king in rock-paper-scissors allows you to inherit the crown and become the new king.
pe-02930:
1) Play volleyball using a fabric cloth to bounce and pass the traditional shuttlecock.
 2) The attacking team holds a cloth with four players and bounces the shuttlecock three times to send it over.
 3) The defending team catches the shuttlecock with their cloth and returns it in three bounces.
pe-02931:
1) Pairs hold hands facing each other to form rabbit holes across the area.
 2) The fleeing rabbit chased by the tagger enters a hole and grabs the hand of one partner.
 3) The player whose hand was not taken becomes the new fleeing rabbit and must run away.
 4) If tagged, roles swap, and the new tagger must shout loudly before chasing others.
pe-02932:
1) Fasten an even number of fabric ribbons to a central pole and have each student hold one ribbon.
 2) Alternate numbering as odd and even, with odd numbers facing right and even numbers facing left to face each other.
 3) Sing and move along the circle, alternating between holding the ribbon high to go over and ducking under the next person's ribbon.
 4) Once braided down the pole, reverse movement directions using the same pattern to unbraid the ribbons.
pe-02933:
1) Hold hands in a circle and follow the leader while singing the herring weaving song.
 2) The leader ducks under the arms of the chain so dancers fold their arms across shoulders to be weaved.
 3) Once everyone is weaved in sequence, maintain the chain shape.
 4) Sing the unweaving song while the leader guides players out to untangle one by one.
pe-02934:
1) Hold hands and sing call-and-response while marching in place and walking slowly.
 2) Follow the leader to wind into a spiral shape and unwind back out.
 3) Two players form an arch with raised arms and everyone passes underneath in turn.
pe-02935:
1) Hold hands in a circle and walk slowly to the right following the song.
 2) The leader guides the line inward into a spiral shape (Deokseok Molgi).
 3) Unwind the wrapped circle smoothly outward to return to the original circle (Deokseok Pulgi).
pe-02936:
1) One rabbit is chosen by rock-paper-scissors, and players form a circle around the rabbit.
 2) Players chant and ask questions while circling, and when the rabbit says 'Alive', players run on two feet as the rabbit chases them.
 3) If the rabbit answers 'Dead', players freeze in place, and anyone who laughs or moves when inspected becomes the next rabbit.
 4) If the rabbit answers 'Half-dead', both players and the rabbit must hop on one foot, and the tagged player becomes the next rabbit.
pe-02937:
1) Divide into two groups and select a "cat" (tagger) from one group and a "mouse" from the other.
 2) Both the cat and the mouse are blindfolded with cloths.
 3) The remaining students sit in a large circle to form the playing area.
 4) Inside the circle, the blindfolded cat attempts to tag the mouse; if the mouse steps outside the circle, it is considered caught.
pe-02938:
1) Place a hula hoop on the floor or set up a target board on the wall as a target area.
 2) Throw beanbags toward the target from a designated distance.
 3) Score points by landing inside the hoop or hitting target zones.
pe-02939:
1) Each team designates a coach and a player, using shuttlecocks as game tokens.
 2) Players throw flying discs with hammer throws from behind the green line to hit target boards marked with Yut results.
 3) Move the team tokens according to the target hit, earning an additional throw if rolling Yut, Mo, or capturing an opponent token.
 4) The team that brings both of its tokens off the board first wins.
pe-02940:
1) Draw a 1-meter diameter circle on the floor.
 2) Stay inside the circle and perform consecutive overhand tosses at least 50 cm high using fingertips and knee spring.
 3) A player is out if both feet leave the circle or the ball touches the floor.
 4) Each player gets two attempts to record their highest consecutive toss count.
pe-02941:
1) Start three steps away from the wall and spike the ball to hit the wall.
 2) Step back one pace after each successful attempt to increase distance.
 3) A spike is a foul if it misses or drifts sideways, with two chances allowed.
 4) Compete to see who can successfully hit the wall from the farthest distance.
pe-02942:
1) Arrange hula hoops at varying distances and assign point values.
 2) Throw the disc using either a backhand or forehand grip according to preference.
 3) Earn points if the disc lands inside or rests on the edge of a hula hoop.
 4) The team with the highest total score after all players throw wins the game.
pe-02943:
1) Mark a 1-meter diameter circle on the floor and prepare a balloon inside the circle.
 2) Bounce the balloon upward repeatedly using only your head so that it hits the ceiling each time.
 3) Stepping out with one foot is allowed, but stepping out with both feet or letting the balloon hit the floor ends the attempt.
 4) Players get 2 attempts, and only bounces that successfully touch the ceiling are counted toward the score.
pe-02944:
1) Each player prepares 4 discs.
 2) Throw discs into the targets sequentially starting from level 1.
 3) The disc must land completely inside the designated level zone to score 1 point.
 4) Advance through level 1, level 2, and level 3 challenges.
pe-02945:
1) Draw a circle on the floor.
 2) Stand inside the circle and perform foot digs using only feet and knees to keep the ball (balloon) in the air.
 3) The ball (balloon) must rise at least 30 cm upward, and it must not go outside the circle or touch hands.
 4) Two chances are given, aiming for a maximum of 20 successful digs.
pe-02946:
1) Perform stacking sequentially from left to right.
 2) Stack cups alternating right and left hands (upstacking).
 3) Lower the stacked cups back down in the same order (downstacking).
 4) In doubles play, one player uses only the right hand and the partner uses only the left hand to cooperate.
pe-02947:
1) Set up 10 plastic bottle pins in a triangle formation from back to front with 4, 3, 2, and 1 pin.
 2) Divide into two teams, and each player rolls the toilet paper roll ball twice.
 3) The total number of knocked-down pins becomes the team score, and a strike on the first roll awards 2 bonus points.
pe-02948:
1) Warm up with basic stretches using a bouncy ball.
 2) Perform bouncy ball movement exercises from level 1 through level 6.
 3) Perform stretching movements using a hula hoop.
 4) Rotate the hula hoop around the waist or neck and execute exercises from level 1 through level 5.
pe-02949:
1) Cast 4 yut sticks and move markers by Do (1), Gae (2), Geol (3), Yut (4), Mo (5), or Back-do (back 1).
 2) Landing on designated squares requires performing a movement challenge such as ten walking, side steps, or hopping.
 3) Landing on an opponent's marker captures it, grants a bonus throw, and the first team with two markers home wins.
 4) Kick a handmade newspaper jegi using one-foot, alternating-foot, or raised-foot styles to achieve the highest count.
pe-02950:
1) Bounce the table tennis ball once and land it into the egg carton.
 2) Score points based on the carton colors: blue is 5 points, green is 3 points, and orange is 1 point.
 3) Each player gets 3 turns, and the player with the highest total score wins.
pe-02951:
1) Walk lightly in place moving forward, backward, and side to side to warm up.
 2) Raise and lower arms rhythmically with the music to exercise the upper body.
 3) Move the whole body actively by shaking arms and legs in time with the beat.
 4) Stretch various body parts including side bends, back rolls, overhead reaches, and lunges to enhance flexibility.
pe-02952:
1) Bounce lightly with knees and torso to the up-rhythm beat.
 2) Connect arm extension and pulling movements to the rhythm.
 3) Combine footwork and full-body dance movements in time with music.
pe-02953:
1) Perform 10 push-ups at a slow pace for set 1, then rest for 10 seconds.
 2) Perform 10 push-ups at a fast pace for set 2, then rest for 10 seconds.
 3) Complete set 3 slowly for 10 reps and set 4 quickly for 10 reps, resting 10 seconds between sets.
 4) In the final 5th set, perform as many push-ups as possible without stopping for 30 seconds.
pe-02954:
1) Start warming up with basic steps on the spot to the rhythm of the song.
 2) Follow the arm reaches and footwork shown on screen.
 3) Continue with full-body stretching and jumping during the chorus and interlude.
pe-02955:
1) The front student wears a blindfold while the rear student places hands on their shoulders to form a train.
 2) Tapping both shoulders means move forward, while tapping the right or left shoulder signals a turn.
 3) Pressing down on both shoulders signals a stop, and gently pressing the head signals to sit down.
 4) Move through the area using only touch signals without speaking or making any vocal sounds.
pe-02956:
1) Extend arms, wrap the rope around the right hand with the left hand, and pop it out to catch the handle.
 2) Step the left foot forward into a cross stance, pull the rope taut, cross the arms, and spin the left hand upward to release and catch.
 3) Swing the rope sideways in front of the body, bring the left hand behind the lower back, release and catch, then wrap and catch with the opposite hand.
 4) Connect techniques 1 through 3 sequentially in rhythm.
pe-02957:
1) Practice the wrap position on both sides by placing one hand over the opposite shoulder and the other behind the lower back.
 2) Alternate between opening both arms outward and returning to the cross-wrap position.
 3) Practice lifting one knee in sync with the wrap motion.
 4) Keep the toes pointed, lift the knee at least up to waist height, and jump continuously over the rope.
pe-02958:
1) Ensure proficiency by being able to perform 100 to 200 consecutive double-unders.
 2) Practice side swing to open (SO) combinations while pausing to establish control on both sides.
 3) Practice side swing to cross-open (SCO) by crossing arms close to the body.
 4) Progressively connect swing-open-cross (SOC) and swing-cross-cross (SCC) into a seamless multi-under jump.
pe-02959:
1) Two players stand staggered each holding two jump ropes together.
 2) Practice turning ropes one at a time starting from the left by fully extending arms in large circles.
 3) Practice jumping in place whenever the rope hits the floor.
 4) Match timing to jump consecutively from 1, 2, up to 4 beats.
pe-02960:
1) Perform consecutive open double unders to establish a steady rhythm.
 2) Connect cross-open, open-cross, and cross-cross sequences in order.
 3) Transition to advanced variations: cross-double, toad double under, AS double under, and CL double under.
pe-02961:
1) Cross the first arm (e.g., left hand) inside.
 2) Raise hands to shoulder height instead of keeping them low when switching.
 3) Move only as much as necessary to cross the opposite hand inside.
pe-02962:
1) Walk together with peers with arms around each other's shoulders to the rhythm of the song.
 2) Have one student sit down every two musical phrases.
 3) Bring each seated student back up one by one following the continuing song lyrics.
pe-02963:
1) Draw a peanut-shaped boundary on the ground with smaller circles inside based on the number of players.
 2) One tagger starts outside while runners start inside small circles.
 3) The tagger tags runners, only one runner can stay in a circle, and stepping into an occupied circle or spanning two circles causes elimination.
 4) Tagged or eliminated players become taggers, cooperating to catch all runners.
pe-02964:
1) Shuffle the round ddakji and divide them equally among players.
 2) Chant 'high stars' or 'low stars', flip a token, and the player with more or fewer stars takes both.
 3) Call 'high letters' or 'low letters' to compare syllable counts, leaving tokens pooled if tied.
 4) Call 'Power Jjang Rock-Paper-Scissors' to match symbols, where the Power Jjang token automatically wins.
pe-02965:
1) Face a partner and clap hands together to the rhythm of the chant.
 2) Tap feet together in sync with the song lyrics.
 3) Spin around and clap hands in place according to the rhythm.
 4) Form a large circle holding hands and hop lightly from foot to foot as a group.
pe-02966:
1) Scatter five gonggi stones on the floor and catch them through levels 1 to 4 while tossing one up.
 2) In level 5, perform egg-laying technique by holding stones between finger joints.
 3) In level 6, set and pick stones between finger spaces across the floor.
 4) Finish with the final throw by flipping all 5 stones onto the back of the hand and snatching them down firmly.
pe-02967:
1) Draw a square box and 'O' and 'X' zones on the ground, then decide the tagger and players.
 2) Players start from inside the box and hop forward on one foot for the number of steps set by the tagger.
 3) The tagger takes one less hop than the players and attempts to tag them.
 4) Players tagged or failing to return within their steps go to 'X', while successful players go to 'O'.
pe-02968:
1) Hold the ends or inner part of the exercise band and wrap it around your hands once so it does not slip.
 2) Step on the band with both feet, keep elbows tucked to your torso, and slowly pull up for arm curls.
 3) Perform shoulder exercises by rotating palms upward or pressing up overhead from a 90-degree elbow position.
 4) Sit on the floor, loop the band around your feet, keep your back straight, and pull elbows behind your torso for back rows.
pe-02969:
1) Interlock fingers and stretch forward, upward, sideways, and downward.
 2) Push the chin up with thumbs or pull the head forward and sideways to stretch the neck.
 3) Cross arms or bend them behind the head to stretch shoulders and arms.
 4) Rotate hips slowly in both directions to finish.
pe-02970:
1) Stand behind the court end line within the designated service area.
 2) Toss the ball lightly and strike it using the instep, top, or outside of the foot.
 3) Send the ball over the net so that it lands inside the opponent's court.
pe-02971:
1) Straighten one leg, bend the other, push hips back while pressing the knee, pull toes toward you, and hold for 10 seconds.
 2) Crouch to one side with the other leg extended, pulling toes toward your body to stretch the lower leg muscles.
 3) Lift one knee, hold it with both hands, and pull it toward your chest while balancing.
 4) Bend one leg backward, hold the top of the foot with your hand, pull the heel toward your glute, and extend the opposite arm for balance.
pe-02974:
1) Practice hopping by bounding upward and moving forward.
 2) Perform leaping by driving arms forward and bounding high into the air.
 3) Practice sliding by leading with the foot facing the target direction.
 4) Perform galloping without letting the trailing foot pass the lead foot, followed by skipping with double hops per foot, all while holding a flying disc.
pe-02975:
1) Start by throwing the blue bag from the dominant hand, then the yellow bag from the other hand, and catching only the blue bag.
 2) Practice throwing the blue then yellow bag and catching both bags.
 3) Hold two beanbags in one hand and throw the front blue one first followed by the rear yellow one.
 4) Hold two bags in one hand and one in the other, then toss blue-red-yellow in order to continue 3-bag partner juggling.
pe-02976:
1) Hold the racket grip adjusting the face to use both forehand and backhand swings.
 2) Step back with the right foot and execute a high clear shot.
 3) Step forward with the left then right foot to strike shuttles incoming in front using pushes, drives, or hairpins.
 4) Use the thumb-pressed backhand grip and establish the contact point in front of the right eye for smash practice.
pe-02977:
1) Start from the starting point on signal.
 2) Pass turning points A, B, and C in order, then re-pass turning point D.
 3) Pass turning point E and cross the finish line to record the time.
pe-02978:
1) Stand behind the step box and step up and down to the music rhythm performing basic steps.
 2) Step on the box with one foot and raise the opposite knee toward the chest three times consecutively in a Three Knee Up motion.
 3) Step onto the platform and lightly tap the floor laterally with the toe.
 4) Alternate V-steps by widening feet onto the platform and fast-paced Cha Cha Cha foot switches in rhythm with the beat.
pe-02979:
1) Perform a dip motion by lowering the ball and body.
 2) Execute the delivery by raising arms up into a jump.
 3) Follow through by quickly extending the elbow and wrist upwards.
 4) Release the ball off the fingertips to finish the shot.
pe-02980:
1) Instep dribble: Push the ball lightly forward using the instep.
 2) Two-foot dribble: Move side-to-side tapping the ball gently with the big toe/inside.
 3) Sole pull: Drag the ball back lightly using the ball of the foot.
 4) Sole step: Guide and step over the ball using the sole to maintain control while moving.
pe-02981:
1) Practice stepping off a floor spot marker with the right foot, then gradually with both feet.
 2) Practice small quick steps and take off with the right or left-right feet according to the shuttlecock.
 3) Take small steps and perform larger backward footwork when the shuttlecock flies deep.
 4) Perform side steps, press the back left foot, turn the body, and step forward.
pe-02983:
1) Place balls along the centerline and have both teams line up at their baseline.
 2) On the signal, rush to retrieve the balls and start throwing.
 3) Eliminate opponents by hitting them with throws, and players may block incoming balls with a ball in hand.
 4) Hit players are eliminated, and the last team standing wins.
pe-02984:
1) Place the non-kicking foot one step back rather than ahead of the ball.
 2) Insert the instep deep under the ball and scoop it up like a spoon.
 3) For a right-footed kick, follow through with hands moving 11 to 1 o'clock and the body 1 to 7 o'clock.
 4) Practice aiming and kicking toward a goalpost target.
pe-02985:
1) Stand facing a solid wall and practice repetitive wall touches to master ball control.
 2) Open your shoulder outward and align your body so the ball stays directly in front of your forehead.
 3) Meet the ball early before it drops and spike it downwards diagonally so it bounces off the floor to the wall.
 4) Continuously repeat the wall spikes while maintaining consistent contact angles and rhythm.
pe-02986:
1) Learn the three fundamental blocking techniques: low block, inner block, and high block.
 2) Follow along with the video demonstration to practice Taegeuk 2 Jang.
 3) Review and practice Taegeuk 1 Jang by following the instructor.
pe-02987:
1) Perform a bounce pass using the chest pass motion, bouncing the ball at two-thirds of the distance toward the teammate.
 2) Perform an overhead pass by holding the ball above the head and using hip recoil, shoulder, and wrist snap to pass over defenders.
 3) Practice selecting the bounce pass when closely guarded and the overhead pass when passing over a defensive block.
pe-02988:
1) One player is the tagger and runners flee freely, calling Freeze to stop in place when about to be tagged.
 2) Frozen players cannot be freed by peers; once all runners are frozen, the tagger raises a hand and shouts Bom-Bom.
 3) Upon the call, all frozen players thaw and sprint to hoop or spot-marker safe zones, with the last arriving player becoming the new tagger.
 4) In safe zone variations, only one player can occupy a zone at a time, requiring the previous occupant to leave when a new runner enters saying hello.
pe-02989:
1) Two teams stand facing each other at both ends; the first runners walk forward, high-five upon meeting, play rock-paper-scissors, and the winner continues while the loser's team sends the next runner.
 2) A team wins by reaching and stepping on the opponent's spot marker.
 3) Change the locomotion to two-foot jumps or one-foot hopping.
 4) In Revival Frog, players who lose sit to the side and can revive to rejoin the back of the line when tagged by a passing winning teammate.
pe-02990:
1) Pair Balloon Tap: Partners stand on spot markers two steps apart, tap the balloon back and forth, and step back one pace after each success.
 2) Balloon Fencing: Representatives keep their own balloon airborne while tapping opponents' balloons down to determine the surviving team.
 3) Balloon Keep-Up: Team members hold hands in a circle and tap a balloon upward; letting go of hands or hitting twice consecutively eliminates the team.
pe-02991:
1) Group members line up in a single file, and the first runner runs around the target cone and returns.
 2) The runner must high-five the next runner's hand to tag and switch, then moves to the back of the line.
 3) In the rock-paper-scissors relay, the first runner moves to the spot marker and plays rock-paper-scissors against an opposing runner.
 4) Upon winning, the runner circles around their own group before tagging the next runner; the team whose members all finish and sit down first wins.
pe-02992:
1) The giant octopus tagger holds a foam stick and walks around tagging fleeing players.
 2) Tagged players must freeze in place and become baby octopuses who can only tag nearby players without moving.
 3) When the teacher blows the whistle, surviving players play rock-paper-scissors to select the next giant octopus.
 4) Advance the game by allowing running, or permitting baby octopuses to walk while tagging others.
pe-02993:
1) Form a group of four and gather 10 small cups in the center.
 2) Each member holds a string and pulls the rubber band together to grab and move a cup.
 3) Stack 4 cups on the first layer, 3 on the second, and 2 on the third.
 4) The team that finishes by placing 1 cup on the fourth layer wins.
pe-02994:
1) Stand in a circle on spot markers with three markers in the center, and students assigned to the animal role mimicked by the tagger move to an open spot stepping on a center marker, with the left-out student becoming the next tagger.
 2) Move around performing paired animal actions, play rock-paper-scissors upon meeting a different animal, and the loser imitates the winner's animal until everyone becomes the same animal.
 3) Two students jump in opposite directions around the circle as a lion and an eagle passing the action along until facing each other to play rock-paper-scissors, where the winning group chases the losing group.
pe-02995:
1) [Line Tag] Taggers hold foam batons and walk only along lines; tagged runners do 3 squats to become taggers.
 2) [Chestnut Tree Tag] The tagger wears a team vest while runners balance cones on heads.
 3) If a runner's cone drops, they kneel, and teammates can revive them by placing the cone back on their head.
 4) [Dongdaemun Tag] Pairs hold hands, and raising their arms to form a gate makes them temporarily immune to taggers.
pe-02996:
1) Step on numbered spot markers 1 to 10 with both feet in order, and return by stepping only on blue markers with both feet.
 2) Hold a hula hoop, stretch hands overhead, and pass through shoulders and waist to stand up.
 3) Complete designated movement tasks moving through each course.
 4) Practice scooping rolling balls with a scoop and placing them into a basket.
pe-02997:
1) Grip the stick and practice diamond-direction dribbling moving forward, sideways, and backward.
 2) Control the ball on the stick blade while moving toward various clock directions.
 3) Practice look-up dribbling by lifting the head and keeping the gaze forward rather than watching only the ball.
pe-02998:
1) Perform inchworm push-ups followed by push-up & twists.
 2) Move on to plank side knee strikes and flutter kicks.
 3) Complete squat & lateral lunges followed by burpees.
 4) Finish with jumping jacks and high-knee running in place.
pe-02999:
1) Perform a 4-minute cycle consisting of 8 rounds with 20 seconds of exercise followed by 10 seconds of rest.
 2) Do lunges by keeping the torso upright and bending the back knee to 90 degrees without letting the front knee past the toes.
 3) Do squats by keeping the back straight and looking forward while ensuring knees do not extend past toes.
 4) Complete push-ups, leg raises, planks, side planks, and stretching in sequence.
pe-03000:
1) Practice steps 1 through 6 (basic, jogging, side-to-side, rock-paper-scissors, etc.) for 8 repetitions each.
 2) Mix steps 1 to 6 and jump rope to music for at least 3 minutes.
 3) Aim to complete the routine without tripping more than three times.
pe-03001:
1) Select the appropriate stick (left/right grip) and jog lightly around the gym to get accustomed to ball control.
 2) Stand shoulder-width apart and practice short dribbles by gently pushing the ball inside your body frame.
 3) Split your feet forward and backward to practice linear front-to-back short dribbles.
 4) Widen your grip and practice long dribbles, shifting the ball across a width of 1.5 to 2 meters.
pe-03002:
1) Face teammates and pass the ball back and forth using forehand or backhand.
 2) After making a pass, run across to the back of the opposite line.
 3) Continue passing without interruption to reach the target count (30 or 50 passes).
 4) If a pass is missed, retrieve the ball immediately and resume the passing sequence.
pe-03003:
1) Perform 8 exercises for 20 seconds each with 10 seconds of rest to complete a 4-minute cycle.
 2) Complete Round 1 Lunges and Round 2 Squats.
 3) Complete Round 3 Push-ups and Round 4 Leg Raises.
 4) Perform Round 5 Plank, Rounds 6 and 7 Side Planks (left/right), and Round 8 Stretching, finishing 2 cycles in total.
pe-03004:
1) Two players face each other with feet and sticks aligned parallel.
 2) On the referee's signal, pull the ball toward yourself or pass it backward to teammates.
 3) Press the opponent's stick or push the ball sideways to gain possession.
pe-03005:
1) Keep the ball centered between your feet and gently sweep it forward using the forehand blade to pass.
 2) Cushion incoming passes by easing the blade back slightly to absorb impact and control the ball.
 3) Switch the grip facing to practice backhand passes and receives.
pe-03006:
1) Hold one ball in each hand and prepare.
 2) Throw the first ball up in an arc starting with your dominant hand.
 3) Throw the second ball from the opposite hand just as the first ball reaches its peak.
 4) Catch both balls in order with both hands to the verbal cue 'throw, throw, catch, catch'.
pe-03007:
1) Perform push-ups with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, lowering the body sufficiently (knees can be placed on the floor if needed).
 2) Perform crunches by lying down with knees bent and hands on the abdomen, exhaling as you lift your upper body.
 3) Perform the seated forward bend by reaching for your toes and holding for 10 seconds.
 4) Perform squats by pushing the hips back until knees reach a 90-degree angle, then stand up.
pe-03008:
1) Divide into two teams and face each other in lines.
 2) Pass the ball to the opposite player using forehand and backhand passes.
 3) After passing, run behind the opposite line so passes can continue seamlessly.
 4) Practice reaching a target count (e.g., 30 or 50 passes) without losing the ball.
pe-03009:
1) Grip one ball with three fingers and hold the other ball with the remaining two fingers.
 2) Practice the fundamental drill of tossing and catching the balls straight up one after another (Step 2-1).
 3) Once comfortable, change the pattern so the balls rotate in a circle while continuously tossing and catching (Step 2-2).
 4) If continuous juggling is difficult, break it down by practicing tossing and catching on a one-two count.
pe-03010:
1) Hold two balls in your right hand and one ball in your left hand.
 2) Throw the first ball from your right hand, then throw the ball from your left hand, catching and throwing in rhythm.
 3) Practice by chanting 'throw, throw, catch, catch' out loud to maintain proper timing.
 4) Wait patiently for the ball to descend instead of reaching up to snatch it.
pe-03011:
1) Sit comfortably on a mat with crossed legs, close your eyes, regulate your breathing, and meditate.
 2) Stretch your neck upwards, downwards, and side to side, then roll your shoulders and arms.
 3) Place one hand on the mat and stretch the opposite arm overhead to elongate the torso, then move the spine forward and backward.
 4) Sit with legs extended, twist the body, and then stand up to perform the tree pose by placing one foot against the opposite inner thigh and holding for 10-20 seconds.
pe-03012:
1) Practice side swings by swinging the rope from side to side at least 10 times.
 2) Practice the cross-open swing recovery technique 10 times by folding and extending the arms.
 3) Perform high-knee jump rope by lifting one thigh upward while maintaining basic two-foot jumping rhythm.
pe-03013:
1) Set a pattern consisting of left, right, forward, and backward footwork as one set.
 2) Repeat the 4-direction pattern 10 times consecutively.
 3) Challenge jumping continuously through stage 1 to stage 5 doing 10 reps each set without pause.
 4) Practice separately with 50 to 100 repetitions per type if continuous connection is difficult.
pe-03014:
1) Split into two teams wearing bibs, secretly assign numbers 1 to 5 and 2 bombs among 6 to 8 players without the opponent knowing.
 2) The numbers and bombs take a run-up, sprint 10 strides from the start line, place a spot cone down, and stand in place.
 3) Runners take off on signal to tag opposing players, who call out their assigned number; players tagged in correct numerical order from 1 upward sit down.
 4) If a bomb is tagged, all seated numbers stand up and swap spots within 3 seconds; the team that successfully seats all numbers in order first wins.
pe-03015:
1) Pairs hold a winter jacket between them and line up along the classroom perimeter.
 2) Place a ball onto the jacket and transfer it from jacket to jacket without using hands.
 3) If the ball drops to the floor, pick it up and resume from the spot where it fell.
 4) The ball must move only to the adjacent jacket, and the team completing the set laps faster wins.
pe-03016:
1) Start with one finger raised and sing along while doing the hand motions.
 2) At the end of the song, shout 'I love my friend' and play rock-paper-scissors.
 3) Only the winner extends one more finger, while the loser or drawing player keeps the same number of fingers.
 4) Repeat for a set number of rounds (e.g., 5 rounds), and the player with the most extended fingers wins.
pe-03017:
1) Split into two teams lined up by the blackboard, with chairs placed along the lockers.
 2) Play rock-paper-scissors against the leader; winners step forward doing a leg split, while losers bend down touching the floor for 3 seconds.
 3) When reaching a chair, sit on it to check its hidden assigned number.
 4) Teams must occupy chairs in exact numerical order; landing on a bomb chair sends the player back to the start.
pe-03018:
1) Batter stands before an angled desk bounce-board with 3 balls while defenders sit scattered near bases and the field.
 2) Batter throws 3 balls onto the board and sprints to tag the base runner desk, while defenders gather the bounced balls into base baskets.
 3) If defenders catch a pop-fly off the board in the air, that ball does not need to be placed into a basket; if a batter is hit by their own bounced ball, they are out.
 4) The batter scores if they touch the runner desk and sit down before defenders fill the baskets, and the team with more runs after all turns wins.
pe-03019:
1) Stand at the starting and finish lines keeping an arm's distance apart.
 2) Move forward only while the tagger chants "Mugunghwa flower has bloomed."
 3) If you move when the tagger turns around or violate spacing, you are out and return to the start line.
 4) Score 1 point by successfully reaching the opposite line.
pe-03020:
1) Fix one foot to the floor and blow on a single-ply tissue to keep it airborne as long as possible.
 2) Place a tissue over your face, blow it up, and tap it repeatedly with your palms to prevent it from touching the floor.
 3) Blow the tissue into the air and catch it solely on a pencil tip, balancing it for at least 3 seconds.
