 4) Blow the tissue high and clap in a low stance before catching it, or toss two tissues and catch them cross-handed.
pe-03021:
1) Place a spot marker on the floor, stand with one foot anchored on it, and hold 1 towel or team vest per person.
 2) Toss the towel above the head and catch it 10 times using both hands or one hand.
 3) Toss the towel upward and clap 1, 2, 3 times, or in a 1-2-3-2-1 sequence before catching.
 4) Toss the towel, catch it on a body part (head, shoulder, knee, foot) holding for 3 seconds, or squat down and stand up before catching.
pe-03022:
1) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.
 2) Only the player who wins moves forward one step.
 3) If there is a tie, neither player moves and both stay in place.
 4) Count how many laps are completed around the seated group.
pe-03023:
1) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.
 2) Score 1 point if the finger count equals exactly 5 through wins or ties.
 3) If the sum exceeds 5, no point is awarded and the player turns around.
 4) Accumulate points to reach the target score.
pe-03024:
1) Form a circle over 9 meters using cones; defenders stand inside while attackers stand outside.
 2) Outside attackers kick or stick-push rings into the circle targeting the defenders' feet.
 3) Attackers must kick the ring within 3 seconds of receiving it, while defenders can kick stopped rings back out.
 4) Defenders hit by a moving ring are out, perform 3 jumping jacks at the scoreboard, add 1 fault point, and re-enter.
pe-03025:
1) Two teams start from opposite ends of a single straight line and walk toward each other.
 2) When players meet, they stop and play rock-paper-scissors.
 3) The loser steps off the line and returns to the back of their team line, while the winner continues moving forward.
 4) The losing team's next runner must immediately sprint along the line to meet and challenge the advancing opponent.
pe-03026:
1) Form teams of 4 to 6 students based on seating arrangement and turn chairs to face one another.
 2) Keep balloon floating in the air using hands while remaining seated without standing up.
 3) Count aloud together the cumulative number of successful balloon hits.
 4) If one player hits the balloon twice consecutively or the balloon touches the floor, stop counting and restart.
pe-03027:
1) One runner from each team steps up to the center marker and plays Rock-Paper-Scissors.
 2) The loser picks up the toy hammer and chases the winner toward the start line.
 3) If the winner returns safely without being tagged, their team gets 1 point; if tagged, the loser's team gets 1 point.
 4) Return the toy hammer to the center cone and repeat until every team member takes a turn.
pe-03028:
1) Wear a party cone hat with the tip cut off slightly to leave a tiny eyehole.
 2) Move toward the colorful balls placed on top of cones.
 3) Swing a long balloon stick to knock the balls off the cones.
 4) The player or team that knocks off more balls within the time limit wins.
pe-03029:
1) Bounce the balloon on the floor 10 times like a basketball and catch it.
 2) Toss the balloon up high and catch it.
 3) Hit the balloon upward with appropriate force and catch it.
 4) Keep the balloon up by tapping it 10 consecutive times without letting it drop.
pe-03030:
1) Assemble a hoop with strings tied around it so teammates can hold them.
 2) The tagger wears a blindfold, holds a balloon, and stands inside the hoop.
 3) Teammates hold the strings to lift the hoop and move together without letting it touch the tagger's body until reaching the goal.
 4) Take turns being the tagger to reach the finish line.
pe-03031:
1) Form teams in single files, and each starting runner holds three balloons: one under each armpit and one between the thighs.
 2) On signal, runners hop or waddle toward the turning marker without dropping the balloons.
 3) Turn around the marker, run completely around the seated teammates, and hand the balloons over to the next runner.
 4) If a balloon drops, pick it up and secure it in place before continuing the run.
pe-03032:
1) Form teams and set a designated target location as the hole.
 2) Team members take turns kicking the balloon ball with their feet.
 3) Hole out at the target in as few kicks as possible.
pe-03033:
1) Prepare 6 paper cups, 1 intact rubber band, and 6 cut rubber bands.
 2) Use only the rubber bands without touching the paper cups by hand.
 3) Build the cups according to the photo shown by the teacher.
 4) The first stage must be completed without speaking.
pe-03034:
1) Line up 10 cups on a table and prepare several table tennis balls.
 2) Bounce the table tennis ball on the table into the cups.
 3) The first side to fill all 10 cups wins.
 4) As a cooperative variation, pairs use 15 balls to fill the 10 cups together, or play 1 vs. team matches.
pe-03035:
1) Set up safe zones using hoops, cones, or circles drawn on the floor.
 2) The tagger chases other players while carrying a soft ball.
 3) If a running player steps into a safe zone (on a cone or inside a circle), the tagger cannot catch them.
 4) When tagged with the soft ball, the caught player becomes the new tagger.
pe-03036:
1) Divide into teams and line up in order.
 2) The runner selects a ball with a different score value (1, 2, or 3 points) from the basket and runs through the zigzag obstacle course.
 3) Upon reaching the designated desk, the runner throws the ball into the catcher's basket while the catcher stands on a spot marker.
 4) The runner returns to tag the next player, and the team with the highest total score when time expires wins.
pe-03037:
1) Divide into teams and prepare for the game in order.
 2) When the game starts, two players come out in order; player 1 sits cross-legged on the chair and player 2 pushes the chair.
 3) Player 1 must throw the ball brought from the start into the bin without crossing the designated line.
 4) Whenever player 1 misses, player 2 retrieves the ball and passes it back, continuing the relay until the last player arrives.
pe-03038:
1) Prepare at one end of a long connected table.
 2) Flick a bottle cap with your finger toward the opposite edge.
 3) The team whose cap stops closest to the edge without falling off wins.
 4) Players can also knock away opponents' caps off the table.
pe-03039:
1) Group members stand in a circle holding sticks upright against the ground using the sides of their fingers.
 2) On cue, players let go of their own stick and move to catch the stick of the person next to them before it falls.
 3) Cooperate to help others catch their sticks and increase the consecutive success count.
 4) Challenge the group to complete a full rotation around the circle without dropping any sticks.
pe-03040:
1) All runners and taggers may only move along the marked court lines on the floor.
 2) Runners can freeze by crossing arms and calling freeze before being tagged.
 3) Stepping off the lines onto the floor or getting tagged before freezing results in an out.
 4) Free teammates can unfreeze frozen players by tagging them so they can move again.
pe-03041:
1) A group of three players works together to guide a balloon toward a turning cone using a badminton racket or bare hands.
 2) The remaining students throw bouncy balls at the group trying to hit the balloon.
 3) If the balloon is hit by a bouncy ball or touches the floor, the team is out.
 4) Teammates not guiding the balloon use their bodies to block incoming balls and safely round the turning cone.
pe-03042:
1) Teams line up behind the starting line facing a table with a cup stack topped with a different colored cup.
 2) On signal, the first runner sprints to the table and moves cups one by one from the bottom to the top.
 3) Once the original top colored cup cycles all the way back to the top, place the stack down and run back.
 4) Tag the next teammate to continue the relay; the first team to complete all turns wins.
pe-03043:
1) Place the ball on the paddle and move without dropping it.
 2) Turn around the cone and pass the paddle and ball to the next runner.
 3) If the ball drops, perform the penalty of bouncing and catching it three times before continuing.
 4) The team whose final runner finishes first wins.
pe-03044:
1) Teams line up behind the starting line with reindeer antlers set at the target area.
 2) On signal, throw rings from the line to land them onto the antlers.
 3) If you miss, retrieve the ring, bring it back, and let the next runner try.
 4) Total the points labeled on the antlers; the team reaching the target score first wins.
pe-03045:
1) Keep your palm horizontal to the ground to hit a balloon upward, practicing with the palm, the back of the hand, and alternating between both.
 2) Use your non-dominant hand (left hand) to hit the balloon upward using the palm and the back of the hand alternately.
 3) Alternate between right and left hands to tap the balloon with either palm or back of hand.
 4) Keep two balloons from hitting the ground by tapping them with one or both hands, or practice wall-hitting with palms and backs of hands.
pe-03046:
1) Five players form a team and score points by putting the ball into the opponent basket.
 2) The offensive team moves into the opponent area by passing to teammates or dribbling the ball.
 3) Players cannot take three or more steps while holding the ball without dribbling, and must dribble before taking three steps.
 4) The group that scores more goals within a set time wins.
pe-03047:
1) Walk and dribble with the right hand when the left foot lands, and with the left hand when the right foot lands.
 2) Dribble while matching the tempo quickly on both feet.
 3) Practice pocket dribbling while moving.
 4) Perform running dribbles placing the ball slightly ahead, and practice direction changes as well as leg-through dribbles.
pe-03048:
1) The batter hits the ball off the tee and runs touching 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and home base in order.
 2) The fielding team retrieves the ball and throws it sequentially through designated bases (e.g., 1st-2nd-3rd-home).
 3) The batter scores points corresponding to each base touched before the ball reaches home base.
 4) Completing a full circuit and reaching 1st base again earns 5 points; teams compare total scores.
pe-03049:
1) Wrap one palm over the back of the other hand and tilt wrists downward to fully extend elbows.
 2) Quickly move with your feet to where the balloon drops and receive it directly in front of your body.
 3) Bend your knees to lower your stance, then push the balloon up with both arms using leg extension, hitting it above the wrists.
 4) Sit cross-legged and challenge yourself to keep the balloon aloft in place for 1 minute or clap before receiving it.
pe-03050:
1) Elementary students stand at the starting line set at a distance of 15 meters.
 2) Start with the signal bell and reach the target point before the next bell rings.
 3) If the bell rings halfway, turn around immediately and keep running.
 4) The first failure is marked with a triangle and allows continuation, while the second failure is marked with an X and ends the test with the previous count.
pe-03051:
1) Divide into batting and fielding teams; fielders spread out evenly while kickers take turns kicking the ball from the corner of home plate into the field.
 2) If the kicked ball lands in fair territory without being caught, the runner advances to 1st base; the runner is out if the fielder touches the base with the ball or tags the runner before they arrive.
 3) If the runner arrives first, they are safe and may choose to advance further toward 2nd or 3rd base.
 4) Tagging with the ball is required when a runner can retreat, while stepping on the base is sufficient for a force out when runners cannot retreat; scoring 1 point occurs upon safely reaching 3rd base.
pe-03052:
1) The fielding team takes positions across the field, and batters wait for their turn before stepping to home base.
 2) A player kicks or throws three balls into fair territory and runs through first, second, third, and home base.
 3) Fielders collect all three balls into a basket and shout 'Stop Running' as soon as the third ball is placed inside.
 4) The batting team scores 1 point for reaching 1st, 2 for 2nd, 3 for 3rd, and 4 points for reaching home plate when called.
pe-03053:
1) Hold the ball with both hands, pull it toward your chest, and extend your arms forward to practice chest passes 10 times.
 2) Step forward with one foot and practice chest passes 10 times.
 3) Practice bounce passes by bouncing the ball off the floor 10 times.
 4) Practice overhead passes, one-hand passes, and baseball passes 10 times each.
pe-03054:
1) Divide into two teams (runners and blockers) and play for 3 minutes per set.
 2) Runners cross sections one by one avoiding tags from blockers to reach the end zone.
 3) If tagged, step outside the court boundaries and return to the start line to try again.
 4) Runners who reach the final area take a ball back to the start-line basket to score 1 point.
pe-03055:
1) Divide into two teams of six players each across the net.
 2) Serve the ball from behind the end line upon the referee's whistle.
 3) The receiving team must return the ball into the opponent's court within three hits.
 4) The first team to score 25 points wins the set, and winning three out of five sets wins the match.
pe-03056:
1) Pairs run together while passing a basketball back and forth.
 2) Move toward the opposite basket and take a shot.
 3) On the way back, switch roles so the other partner takes the shot.
pe-03057:
1) Set up cups in the center and have each team line up behind their spot marker.
 2) Players take turns throwing or bouncing a table tennis ball into the center cups.
 3) Scoring a ball into a cup allows the player to bring that cup to their spot marker, and scoring into an orange cup grants an extra throw.
 4) The team that first stacks their collected cups in a 3-2-1 pyramid structure wins.
pe-03058:
1) Step forward with the left foot and practice laying the ball against the backboard from a stationary position.
 2) Take two steps back, walk forward, and shoot with the right hand as the left foot lands.
 3) Lightly jump off the left foot while lifting the right knee to perform a layup shoot.
 4) Run slowly then build up speed, jumping to shoot 10 times to achieve a personal target score.
pe-03059:
1) Lightly pinch the exact center of one scarf with the thumb and index finger, toss it up with the right hand, catch it with the same hand, and repeat with the left hand.
 2) Toss one scarf diagonally with the right hand to catch with the left hand, and vice versa.
 3) Hold two scarves to toss and catch simultaneously, or toss them diagonally one after another to catch with alternate hands.
 4) Hold two scarves in one hand and one in the other, then toss and catch all three in continuous diagonal succession.
pe-03060:
1) Divide into two teams; each batter kicks or throws three balls consecutively onto the field.
 2) After launching all three balls, the batter runs around 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and home bases.
 3) The fielding team gathers all three balls and places them into the collection basket; foul balls landing out of bounds do not need to be collected.
 4) The runner scores points based on the base safely reached before all balls are in the basket (1pt for 1st, 2pts for 2nd, 3pts for 3rd, 4pts for Home), switching sides after all players bat.
pe-03061:
1) Throw the yut sticks and perform the designated fitness exercise according to the cast.
 2) Do sit-and-reach for Do, curl-ups for Gae, burpees for Geol, squats for Yut, push-ups for Mo, and back extensions for Baek-do.
 3) Move the game piece forward corresponding to the cast after completing the exercise.
 4) Throw again when rolling Yut/Mo or capturing an opponent's piece until completing the board.
pe-03062:
1) Divide the class into two teams (e.g., 12 orange and 12 green) wearing team vests and velcro tail belts.
 2) Both teams line up on opposite sides of a rectangular field measuring approximately 20 to 30 meters.
 3) On the whistle, players run to pull opponents' tails; snatched tails are placed in the tail box and one beanbag is moved to the score box.
 4) Players who lose all tails must step out to retrieve a tail from the box before re-entering, and the team with more beanbags transferred when time expires wins.
pe-03063:
1) Tape newspaper onto a door or wall as a target and blow up a balloon.
 2) Stand two steps away from the newspaper with the left foot forward.
 3) Toss the balloon upward with the left hand, raise the right elbow above shoulder level, and spike the balloon toward the target.
 4) Attempt 10 spikes with the goal of hitting the target 5 times, increasing distance or adding underhand/overhead sets as mastery improves.
pe-03064:
1) The kicker kicks the ball and runs around the bases.
 2) When the fielding team secures the ball, all fielders line up and pass the ball backward between their legs while counting to 10.
 3) Points are scored based on the number of base laps completed before the last fielder throws the ball to the base or touches it.
 4) Completing two laps scores 1 point and three laps scores 2 points, and teams switch sides after three outs.
pe-03065:
1) Make a circular hoop using a long balloon and tape it to a door or window, then make a ball using a regular balloon filled with 1/5 cup of water.
 2) Set the scoring zones from the front: 1 step away is 2 points, 2 steps is 3 points, 3 steps is 4 points, and 4 steps is 5 points.
 3) Take a total of 10 shot attempts.
 4) Add up the points from successful shots to determine your final score.
pe-03066:
1) Set hurdle 1 at 6m from the start line, hurdles 2 to 4 at 2m intervals, and an opposite cone 6m past hurdle 4.
 2) Divide 6 runners into two groups: starting side (runners 1, 3,
 5) and opposite side (runners 2, 4, 6).
 3) On signal, runner 1 jumps over hurdles to the other side; runner 2 receives the ring baton and sprints back through the straight lane.
 4) When the final runner returns to start and hangs the ring baton on the starting cone, time is recorded.
pe-03067:
1) Start with one balloon placed on each palm (two balloons total).
 2) On start, begin tapping and bouncing both balloons upward with palms.
 3) Keep bouncing both balloons continuously so neither falls to the floor.
pe-03068:
1) Draw a triangular play court with three 'homes' on the ground; attackers enter the homes while defenders position in inner and outer courts.
 2) On start, attackers depart from home and race along the path following the arrows to return to home.
 3) Defenders may push or pull attackers to eliminate them, while attackers can also eliminate defenders by forcing them to step on boundary lines.
 4) If an attacker is pushed out once, they must hop on one foot, and being pushed out twice results in an out; the game is won by eliminating the other side or completing 2 to 3 laps safely.
pe-03069:
1) Rotate shoulders and shake wrists thoroughly before hanging.
 2) Grip the bar with hands placed shoulder-width apart.
 3) Relax shoulders and hang naturally, holding on as long as possible.
 4) Gradually increase hanging time from 10 seconds up to 1 minute.
pe-03070:
1) Divide into two teams of 1 to 4 players and decide who goes first.
 2) Bounce a ping-pong ball on the table at least once into the egg carton.
 3) If the ball misses or lands on top of another ball, the turn ends.
 4) The first team to make a line of three balls horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
pe-03071:
1) Designate one tagger while the remaining runners (thieves) wear hats and avoid the tagger.
 2) The tagger places one hand on their head and uses the other hand to remove hats from the thieves.
 3) When a hat is taken, the tagger wears it and links hands with the caught thief to chase as a pair.
 4) Free thieves can retrieve stolen hats to liberate captured teammates, and the game ends when all are caught.
pe-03072:
1) Attackers throw the ball toward the rebounder frame from outside the 3m forbidden zone.
 2) The attacking team must shoot at the rebounder mesh within a maximum of 3 passes.
 3) If the ball bounces off the rebounder net and hits the floor outside the forbidden zone, the attacking team scores 1 point.
 4) If the defending team catches the rebounded ball, play transitions to the defenders' attack.
pe-03073:
1) All students form a circle, hold hands, and bring their feet together
 2) Jump in the direction called by the leader (right, left, forward, backward) while shouting the direction together
 3) When the leader calls two directions in a row, execute both jumps sequentially
 4) Increase difficulty with the 'Tree Frog' version by jumping in the opposite direction of the command
pe-03074:
1) With two separate bases set up, the kicker kicks the ball and loops around their queued teammates twice to score 1 point.
 2) Fielders catch the ball and must pass it through every teammate's hands before reaching the defensive base to record an out.
 3) If a fielder catches a fly ball before it bounces, they can throw directly to the base or run to it without passing to every player.
 4) Teams alternate kicking and fielding for designated innings, and the team with the higher score wins.
pe-03075:
1) While seated, place one foot against the opposite inner thigh, straighten your back, and reach forward to touch your toes on an exhale.
 2) Sit with both legs together straight, reach forward to touch your toes or heels, and hold.
 3) Stand, bend one knee slightly while extending the other foot forward with hands on the knee, and stretch.
 4) Lie down, hold one leg up at 90 degrees with hands behind the thigh, and raise and lower the other leg for dynamic stretching.
pe-03076:
1) Place spot markers on the floor equal to the number of students, dance around them to music, and step on a marker when the music stops.
 2) The teacher removes one marker at a time, giving simple fitness tasks like jumping jacks to those left without a marker.
 3) Follow a line of spot markers from start to finish using jumping, hopping, or skipping steps.
 4) Balance a spot marker on the back of the hand and try to knock off opponents' markers while keeping your own safe.
pe-03077:
1) Toss a stone upward, tap the floor with the hand, and catch the falling stone.
 2) Practice continuously until succeeding 5 consecutive times (restart count from the beginning upon failure).
 3) Once mastered, toss one stone up and practice picking up one stone from the floor.
 4) Repeat until successfully picking up 5 stones in a row to establish core mechanics.
pe-03078:
1) Stand in a line linking arms around each other's shoulders.
 2) Squat down together matching the traditional rhythmic song lyrics.
 3) Stand back up together in sync with the chant.
 4) Repeat moving forward or backward while squatting and standing together.
pe-03079:
1) In stage 1, place 4 ttakji tiles and challenge yourself to flip all 4 within 10 hits using 1 tile.
 2) In stage 2, teams take turns hitting 15 tiles on the floor in a relay, claiming a tile only by flipping it twice consecutively.
 3) In stage 3, players face off 1-on-1 using their earned tiles to win opponents' tiles by flipping them twice in a row.
pe-03080:
1) Proceed through the 12 steps of gonggi representing a chicken's life cycle, from peck to eat.
 2) Successfully complete actions such as drinking water, nest building, egg laying, raising, hatching, swapping, and pot placing.
 3) Go through the chili paste/bean paste step and catch stones on the back of the hand to gain age.
 4) The player who reaches the target age first wins the match.
pe-03081:
1) Stick 6 Post-it notes on the floor at two-step intervals.
 2) Move forward two notes with large steps, then move backward one note with quick small steps.
 3) Swing arms actively and increase the speed gradually from set 1 through set 5.
 4) Rest for 10 seconds between sets and complete a total of 5 sets.
pe-03082:
1) Place a plastic bottle, walk 10 steps to place paper, and hit the ball focusing on direction.
 2) Place a hula hoop, walk 5 steps to place paper, and hit the ball focusing on hitting power.
 3) Place sticks around paper marked with scores and traps to keep the ball from bouncing out; the game ends when a total of 10 points is reached.
pe-03083:
1) Look directly at the ball before approaching for a kick.
 2) Approach the ball from an angled direction rather than running in a straight line.
 3) Place your non-kicking plant foot right beside the ball.
 4) Bend the kicking leg back, strike with the instep, and swing opposite arm for balance.
pe-03084:
1) Set up 2 plastic bottles two hand-spans apart as a target goal.
 2) Roll a ball so it passes between the bottles without knocking them down.
 3) Take a step back at each progressive stage to increase throwing distance.
 4) Alternatively set up 9 bottles and roll the ball to knock them down.
pe-03085:
1) Place sticky notes on the floor at equal intervals to prepare.
 2) In step 1, perform forward two-foot steps without stepping on the sticky notes.
 3) In step 2, perform crisscross jumping steps without stepping on the sticky notes.
 4) In step 3, perform forward single-leg steps alternating each foot.
pe-03086:
1) Stand in front of a wall that is at least twice your height.
 2) Use the inside of the foot to repeatedly kick the ball high against the wall and receive it, using the head if possible.
 3) Start practicing close to the wall, then step back and practice as you get used to it.
 4) Practice instep spikes by striking the top part of the ball downward.
pe-03087:
1) Balance a book on your head and throw the ball with two hands then one hand while keeping the upper body upright.
 2) Raise both arms, shift weight onto the right foot, and transfer weight to the left foot upon throwing.
 3) Hold a jump rope and snap the wrist downward like cracking a whip to build wrist snap power.
pe-03088:
1) Place 4 Post-it notes in a straight line at intervals of one step.
 2) Place the remaining Post-its in a diagonal direction at intervals of four steps.
 3) Weave through the spaces between the Post-it notes with quick steps.
 4) Increase speed with each round and complete a total of 5 sets.
pe-03089:
1) Prepare and spread out a yoga mat.
 2) Pull the left leg toward the chest while keeping the opposite leg flat on the floor and hold for 30 seconds.
 3) Raise the left leg, rotate the ankle slowly, and flex the foot up and down.
 4) Cross the left foot over the right knee to pull the right leg, then twist the lower body with crossed legs, repeating the sequence for the opposite leg.
pe-03090:
1) Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes pointing slightly outward.
 2) Push hips back, keep weight on heels, and squat down until thighs are parallel to the ground.
 3) Push through heels and core to return to standing position.
 4) Perform 10 reps across 10 stages to complete a total of 100 squats.
pe-03091:
1) Place mats at opposite ends of the gym and divide into offense and defense.
 2) A defensive player rolls the volleyball, the kicker kicks it and runs to the opposite mat.
 3) Defending players throw the ball to hit the runner or catch it in the air for a fly out.
 4) The offense scores 1 point upon successfully returning to the home mat, while backward kicks count as fouls.
pe-03092:
1) Place Post-it notes on the floor at equal distances in a straight row.
 2) Single Leg In & Out: Run sideways quickly, stepping one foot at a time into each space between notes.
 3) Two Forward One Back: Hop forward two spaces and step back one space repeatedly to advance.
 4) Two Foot Hop: Keep both feet together and hop zigzagging left and right over the line of notes.
pe-03093:
1) Place one cone and dribble quickly around it with your dominant hand while staying low.
 2) Line up three cones and navigate through them using single-hand dribbling to control ball direction.
 3) Practice crossover dribbling back and forth between left and right hands around a single cone.
 4) Weave through the three cones using continuous alternating two-hand crossover dribbling.
pe-03094:
1) Relax shoulders and lightly toss the ball with completely relaxed arms for at least 10 repetitions.
 2) Throw shortly and quickly toward the partner's chest and chin level with an extended arm and consistent release point.
 3) Step forward with the opposite foot using a 3-step sequence to throw long distances.
 4) Practice fielding bouncing balls by staying low and covering the glove with the bare hand, followed by overhead catches.
pe-03095:
1) Rotate the ankles and perform short and long leg stretches for the lower body.
 2) Rotate the knees and do light squats.
 3) Pull each arm across the chest while looking the opposite direction, then stretch the arms behind the head.
 4) Rotate shoulders, neck, and waist in sequence to loosen up the entire body.
pe-03096:
1) Hold the end of the stick with your dominant hand, place the other hand lower, and lower your stance.
 2) Practice tap dribbling by tapping the ball lightly in five directions: sides, diagonals, and front.
 3) Set up a cone as a defender and practice turn dribbling by shielding the ball with your body as you move around it.
pe-03097:
1) Open health textbook page 28 and review the physical fitness improvement plan chart.
 2) Design a weekly schedule assigning specific exercise components such as power, agility, balance, and coordination to each day.
 3) Practice the planned workouts for a week, then record strengths and areas for improvement on the self-checklist.
pe-03098:
1) Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and squat down.
 2) Place both hands far forward on the mat and look toward your navel/feet.
 3) Push with your legs and roll forward keeping the body rounded so the back of your head touches the mat.
 4) Helpers can support the student's body from the side to help them roll gently.
pe-03099:
1) Hold the stick comfortably and sweep the ball across the floor to learn the basic shooting posture.
 2) Set up a cone as a target and practice shooting accurately from a stopped position.
 3) Once proficient in a stationary position, practice shooting while dribbling and moving in different directions.
pe-03100:
1) Form teams for singles (1 vs 1) or doubles (2 vs 2).
 2) When serving, keep the racket below the waist and hit from low to high.
 3) Serve diagonally from the right court when the score is even (including 0) and from the left court when odd.
 4) In doubles, only the serving side that wins a point swaps left and right positions, while the receiving team stays in place.
pe-03101:
1) Step forward and extend arms from chest level to practice basic chest passes.
 2) Bounce the ball off the floor for a bounce pass when a defender blocks high lanes.
 3) Throw from above the head for an overhead pass to bypass tight defense or send it long distances.
 4) Shield defenders and push the ball with one hand for a one-hand pass.
pe-03102:
1) Connect previously learned movements such as mounting, dismounting, walking, and running on the balance beam.
 2) Express a story through facial expressions and gestures using walking and changing directions.
 3) If you fall off, step back up and continue the routine.
pe-03103:
1) Lightly toss the ball upward using the inside of the foot for an attacker.
 2) When the ball rises, spike it toward open space using the inside of the foot or the toe.
 3) Focus on sending the ball into open areas or the opponent's weak spots rather than kicking with pure power.
pe-03104:
1) Practice handstands against a wall or mat by stepping forward and kicking up hard with your legs.
 2) Start with low leg kicks and gradually kick higher with repeated practice.
 3) For right-handers, step forward with the left foot and follow the sequence of left hand, right hand, right foot, left foot.
 4) For left-handers, step with the right foot and place right hand, left hand, left foot, right foot to complete the turn.
pe-03105:
1) The game begins with a jump ball and is played in four 10-minute quarters.
 2) Five players per team participate on the court with unlimited substitutions allowed.
 3) Field goals beyond the 3-point line award 3 points, inside award 2 points, and free throws award 1 point.
 4) Taking three or more steps with the ball is walking, and dribbling again after catching the ball is a double dribble.
pe-03106:
1) Support the ball from below with your shooting hand, guide it with the other hand, and bring your elbow to about 90 degrees.
 2) Shoot toward the hoop using both the extension of your arm and the force from bending and straightening your knees.
 3) Practice shooting from a close distance right in front of the hoop.
 4) As you make shots, take two or three steps back to gradually increase the distance.
pe-03107:
1) Score points by hitting the ball over the net to land on empty areas of the opponent's court.
 2) Touching the ball twice consecutively by one person results in a foul and gives a point to the opponent.
 3) Teams must pass the ball within 3 touches to send it over without contacting the net.
 4) The game starts with a serve made from behind the court boundary line using underhand or overhand hits.
pe-03108:
1) Practice individual receives by bouncing the ball in place and lifting it high using the inside of the foot or the instep.
 2) For high balls, practice heading receives by watching the ball closely and meeting it with the forehead to direct it upward without sudden body lunges.
 3) Backline defenders practice passing the ball accurately toward the setter near the net with proper height and distance without sending it straight over the net.
 4) For beginners who find kicking difficult, modify the rules into hands-and-feet Jokgu where catching or passing with hands is permitted.
pe-03109:
1) Step up slowly with both feet onto a low balance beam placed over safety mats.
 2) Look forward toward the top of the beam rather than down at your feet while walking slowly.
 3) Spread both arms out to the sides to maintain balance whenever stability is needed.
 4) Upon reaching the end of the beam, jump and land safely onto the mat or practice turning around.
pe-03110:
1) Attackers tap the ball to change direction and quickly penetrate past the defender.
 2) Defenders lower their stance and close the gap without recklessly extending their feet first.
 3) Defenders stand diagonally rather than flat to quickly track back and take the ball when within reach.
pe-03111:
1) In a two-player doubles setup, divide positions into front and back rather than standing side by side.
 2) The front player is responsible for defending short shots.
 3) The back player is responsible for defending deep shots.
pe-03112:
1) Stand in a circle or sit in places and determine the turn order.
 2) The first student says 'When I go to school' and mimics an object found at school with a stretching motion.
 3) The next student must accurately replicate all preceding stretching movements before adding their own new motion.
 4) If someone forgets or makes a mistake on the sequence, they receive a fun penalty or begin a new round.
pe-03113:
1) Two players face each other across the badminton net with rackets and a shuttlecock.
 2) Hit the shuttlecock short or clear it deep toward empty spaces on the opponent court.
 3) Alternate between short and deep shots to make the opponent move and create scoring chances.
pe-03114:
1) Set up target cones on the opposite court: green cones for 1 point, orange cones for 2 points, and red cones for 3 points.
 2) Set up serving positions by the net: green for x1, orange for x2, and far red for x3 multiplier.
 3) Serve the ball into a target zone; points earned equal target value multiplied by serving position value.
 4) The player or group with the most points wins.
pe-03115:
1) Place the plant foot next to the ball, lean forward slightly, and dribble with light, short taps.
 2) Keep the ball within reachable foot range so it does not drift far from the body.
 3) Use the inside and outside of the foot alternately to change directions.
 4) Practice using both feet alternately while maneuvering around space to gradually increase speed.
pe-03116:
1) Infielders lower their knees with heels slightly raised and gloves open ready to react in any direction.
 2) Move laterally toward the ball and field forehand grounders by securing the ball with both hands.
 3) For backhand grounders hit to the opposite side, cross the feet over and block the ball in front of the body.
 4) Practice securing the ball inside the glove with the throwing hand to immediately transition into throwing.
pe-03117:
1) Place a marker in the center of the court to set the home position.
 2) Move forward quickly to hit short shots.
 3) Return to the center home position immediately after hitting to prepare for the next defense.
pe-03118:
1) Hold the padminminton racket in a forehand or backhand grip with the thumb on the shorter side.
 2) Practice lifting the shuttlecock repeatedly on the racket center in place.
 3) Serve from below upward to send the shuttlecock into the opposing court.
 4) Rally 1-on-1 or 2-on-2, and execute a downward smash attack when the shuttlecock flies high.
pe-03119:
1) Simulate an imaginary defender in front and practice shooting after dribbling and feinting.
 2) Practice half-volley shooting by striking the ball with the instep right as it drops after bouncing off the ground.
 3) Practice heading by throwing the ball with your hands and hitting it cleanly with the forehead area just above the eyebrows.
 4) Have a partner toss the ball toward the goal, keeping your eyes on it until connecting with a header shot.
pe-03120:
1) Stand facing away from the mat and sit down naturally by bending the knees.
 2) Bring feet slightly together and position hands beside the ears with palms facing up and back.
 3) Roll sequentially on hips, back, and back of the head while tucking chin toward navel.
 4) Push the mat firmly with palms while maintaining a rounded body to complete the roll.
pe-03121:
1) Place the non-kicking foot beside the ball and balance with knees and upper body.
 2) Use inside-of-foot kick for accurate low shots.
 3) Use instep kick with the top of the foot for distant and powerful shots.
 4) Keep toes pointing down after follow-through to prevent the ball from sailing high.
pe-03122:
1) Spread arms for balance and slowly step onto the beam with a comfortable foot.
 2) When dismounting onto the mat, jump lightly and bend your knees to absorb shock.
 3) When walking forward, slide your foot smoothly along the beam surface.
 4) For backward walking, feel the beam with your toes and move slowly; for sideways walking, maintain balance using the arches of your feet.
pe-03123:
1) Practice jumping and landing on a line drawn on the floor first by bending knees to lower center of gravity.
 2) Mount the beam, lower posture, balance with arms, and jump lightly, bending knees upon landing.
 3) Perform stride jumps by extending and alternating legs back and forth.
 4) Lower upper body, swing arm toward desired direction, and move feet to turn around.
pe-03124:
1) Listen to the given prompt such as victory, sadness, animals, or vehicles.
 2) Freeze your body like a paused video, adjusting body posture and scale without moving.
 3) The teacher counts down from three, and everyone simultaneously freezes into their chosen pose.
 4) Check each other's frozen shapes to see how many players made the identical movement.
pe-03125:
1) Play rock-paper-scissors; the losing side sets up their stone markers.
 2) The winning side draws a starting line about 3-4 meters away.
 3) Throw or kick your stone to knock down the opponent's standing stone.
 4) If a player fails to knock down a stone, the turn passes to the opposing team.
pe-03126:
1) Align desks in a long line and place five beanbags at the starting edge.
 2) Players take turns sliding or tossing beanbags down the row of desks.
 3) A throw is successful if the beanbag stops on the target desk; dropped beanbags must be retrieved.
 4) In competitive play, players can knock off the opponent's beanbags, and the team that lands all bags first wins.
pe-03127:
1) The tagger faces the wall while other players line up at the starting line.
 2) The tagger chants variations such as 'Clock flower has bloomed' or 'Wave flower has bloomed'.
 3) Players advance and freeze in a pose matching the announced keyword when the tagger turns around.
 4) Players who fail to strike the pose or get caught moving must step forward or get eliminated.
pe-03128:
1) Arrange multiple hula hoops in a grid layout on the classroom floor.
 2) Four students stand at the outer corners and step inward on cue.
 3) Jump and step rhythmically forward, backward, left, and right to the musical beat.
 4) Coordinate footwork with group members moving from different directions without bumping.
pe-03129:
1) Players stand at the baseline with a stack of colored saucer cones.
 2) On the start signal, run around the classroom and place cones on top of desks.
 3) Steal cones placed by the opponent on desks and bring them back to your base.
 4) The player or team with more cones collected on their holder at the end wins.
pe-03130:
1) Jump rope continuously for 32 beats without tripping.
 2) Level 1 consists of swing, open, open, cross.
 3) Level 2 consists of swing, cross, open, open, and Level 3 consists of swing, cross, cross, open.
 4) Level 4 consists of swing, cross, cross, cross.
pe-03131:
1) When throwing, place the ball at forehead level and lightly support the bottom with both hands.
 2) Check the partner's position and throw forcefully while slightly bending and straightening knees.
 3) When catching, extend arms toward the incoming ball to prepare.
 4) Move quickly toward the ball, lower posture, and pull the ball toward chest.
pe-03132:
1) Select two gatekeepers who hold both hands together to form an overhead gate.
 2) The remaining students line up single file and place their hands on the shoulders of the child in front.
 3) The line of students walks through the gate while singing a question-and-answer song with the gatekeepers.
 4) When the final line of the song ends, the gatekeepers lower their arms and the captured player becomes the new gatekeeper.
pe-03133:
1) Four players pair up and divide into a Challenger group and a Caller group.
 2) The Caller group chooses one holding or bending movement (chair pose, plank, lunge, lying leg raise, etc.), rolls a die twice, and adds the two numbers together.
 3) While the Caller group counts up to the added sum, the Challenger group maintains the chosen posture.
 4) For each player who maintains the hold or bend without breaking posture while the count continues, one point is awarded, and the group with the most points after switching roles wins.
pe-03134:
1) Divide the class into teams, assign a color to each team, and prepare a color dice.
 2) Form a circle and throw the dice in the center of the circle.
 3) The team whose color matches the rolled dice throws the dice to tag other teams.
 4) Catching the thrown dice grants attack rights, while being hit results in elimination; the last remaining team wins.
pe-03135:
1) Ball Rolling: Bring both hands forward, raise them upward, and roll the ball from top to bottom.
 2) Ball Bouncing: Bounce the ball on the floor with one hand.
 3) Ball Shaking: Hold the ball with both hands and shake it side to side.
 4) Hula Hoop Rolling: Bend your wrist inward, pull the hoop toward your body, and cast it onto the floor so it rolls back to you.
 5) Hula Hoop Spinning: Stand the hula hoop upright on the floor and spin it in place with your palm.
 6) Hula Hoop Shaking: Hold the hoop with both hands and shake it from bottom to top.
pe-03136:
1) Bounce the shuttlecock upward with a padminton racket without letting it drop.
 2) Lightly bounce a rebounding ball continuously using the palm of your hand.
 3) Dribble the ball with feet passing between the saucer cones.
 4) Stand facing a partner and toss/catch the ball with scoops, or bounce it off the floor once to exchange.
pe-03137:
1) Form two teams, choose leaders, and arrange the defending team on spot markers in a pyramid formation.
 2) Attack runners match the number of front-row defenders, run up, and play rock-paper-scissors.
 3) Winning advances to the next row; losing sends the runner back to the line while the next teammate departs.
 4) Defeating the leader at the apex scores 1 point, and roles switch after a set time.
pe-03138:
1) Divide the class into two groups and line up behind opposite starting lines.
 2) One side walks forward like a bear on hands and feet with knees raised.
 3) The opposite side walks sideways like a crab with pinching claw hands.
 4) Upon reaching the opposite line, switch movements and walk back in turn.
pe-03139:
1) Gently stretch the neck forward, backward, left, and right.
 2) Interlock fingers, extend arms, and stretch shoulders and torso.
 3) Bend and arch the waist, then rotate ankles smoothly.
 4) Pull knees to chest and heels to buttocks to stretch legs.
pe-03140:
1) Teammates sit in a single file line with legs stretched forward, holding the ankles of the person behind them.
 2) On the team cadence chant, bend knees and pull the hips forward in unison to advance.
 3) The student at the very back steers and turns the team around the turning marker cone.
 4) If the caterpillar chain disconnects along the way, pause in place for 3 seconds before reconnecting and racing back to the start.
pe-03141:
1) Place colored spot markers 1m apart (fewer than the number of players) and designate a tagger wearing a vest or cap.
 2) The tagger stands in the center and calls out a color available in the area.
 3) Players must quickly find that color on markers, clothing, or equipment and touch it with part of their body.
 4) Up to two players can share a spot; whoever is tagged within 15 seconds becomes the next tagger.
pe-03142:
1) Stand in place and march in sync with your partner.
 2) Stand back-to-back and twist your torsos in opposite directions to touch hands together.
 3) Face your partner, hold their shoulder with your left hand, and pull your right foot back with your right hand.
 4) Hold each other's shoulders and bend forward counting to ten, followed by back-to-back and seated stretches.
pe-03143:
1) Form two teams of 6 players each and take attacking and defending positions.
 2) The batter punches the ball with a fist, steps on first base, and runs back to home plate.
 3) Defenders field the ball and throw it to the final defender stationed at home base.
 4) If the runner returns to home before the final defender catches the ball, the team earns 1 point; teams switch after all players bat.
pe-03144:
1) Prepare hoops, foam balls, and team vests, divide into two teams, and take positions.
 2) The team with the ball passes and catches while moving to deliver the ball to their teammate inside the hoop.
 3) The team scores 1 point when the teammate inside the hoop successfully catches the ball.
 4) If the ball drops, goes out of bounds, or is intercepted, possession switches to the opponent; the team with the most points wins.
pe-03145:
1) Balance on one hand and feet on the mat while extending both feet straight and stretching the other arm.
 2) Place one hand and opposite knee on the floor while keeping the other hand and foot off the ground.
 3) Balance on one foot with arms spread and one leg lifted back, or balance weight between hands and hips.
 4) Partner balance by sitting foot-to-foot holding hands and straightening legs, or hooking inner arms while standing foot-to-foot.
pe-03146:
1) Form groups of 4 and prepare floorball sticks and 3 floorball balls at the start line.
 2) Players stand sideways in turn and push the ball toward target hoops.
 3) Score the points designated on each hoop where the ball lands.
 4) The team with the highest combined total score from all members wins.
pe-03147:
1) Form two teams of four players each, decide which team starts with the ball, and take positions on the field.
 2) The team with the ball uses various kicking and stopping skills to pass the ball to a teammate in the scoring zone.
 3) A point is scored when the teammate standing inside the scoring zone successfully receives and stops the ball.
 4) If the opposing team intercepts the ball or kicks it out of bounds, possession switches, and the team with the highest score within the time limit wins.
pe-03148:
1) Slowly rotate the wrists and alternately rotate both ankles.
 2) Stretch your arms upwards and then extend them sideways.
 3) Slowly roll your neck, then slowly rotate your waist.
 4) Hop lightly upwards.
pe-03149:
1) Face your partner with a set distance between you.
 2) Decide the direction of rotation, and one person calls out 'one, two, three.'
 3) Turn in the decided direction on the cue and catch the stick released by the partner.
 4) If the stick does not fall, repeat to count successful catches, then expand the activity with the whole class forming a single group.
pe-03150:
1) Practice spinning the hula hoop around the waist, wrist, or ankle.
 2) When spinning on the ankle, hop back and forth with the hooped foot while jumping over it with the other foot.
 3) Use wrist snap to throw and roll the hula hoop with backspin.
 4) Hold the hoop with both hands like a jump rope and jump over it with both feet together.
pe-03151:
1) Grip the golf club with both hands, wrapping the right hand around the left thumb.
 2) Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in parallel and look at the target.
 3) Take a backswing and hit the ball lightly while keeping shoulders and arms in a straight line for accuracy.
 4) Lift the club handle to shoulder height, rotate the hips, and swing through to hit the ball far.
pe-03152:
1) Stand in a circle, each holding a long wooden stick.
 2) When one person gives the signal 'one, two, three,' everyone releases their stick and quickly moves forward to catch the stick in front of them.
 3) Players who catch the stick before it falls continue playing.
 4) When two players remain, they determine the winner through rock-paper-scissors.
pe-03153:
1) Divide into an attacking team and a defending team.
 2) Defenders stand freely inside the court and place a plastic bottle upright beside themselves.
 3) Attackers roll balls from outside the court to knock down the bottles, while defenders catch the balls by hand and send them out.
 4) Switch roles and repeat; the team with the most standing bottles at the end of the time wins.
pe-03154:
1) Step onto the balance beam while shifting your weight from the floor and spread both arms for balance.
 2) Touch the side of the beam with your stepping foot to check it and move forward one foot at a time to the end.
 3) Turn sideways, spread both arms, move the front foot forward, and pull the back foot in to walk sideways.
 4) Lower your posture, spread both arms, reach your foot below the beam surface and bring it back up while walking.
pe-03155:
1) Sit backward on the mat and push with feet to shift center of gravity backward.
 2) Keep knees close to the face while sitting backward.
 3) Bring knees toward the chest and send legs behind the head when the waist touches the mat.
 4) Spread both legs when the back of the head touches the mat and push the mat firmly with both hands to stand up.
pe-03156:
1) Tie both ends of a long rope to make a circular train shape.
 2) The designated engineer steps inside the rope and holds it around waist height.
 3) The engineer drives around picking up passengers one by one, and all passengers hold the rope while moving together.
 4) In a team race, the train that goes around the turning point and returns first wins.
pe-03157:
1) Divide students into attacking and defending groups and put on team pinnies.
 2) Defenders stand inside the playing area and set up foam bowling pins next to themselves.
 3) Attackers bend down outside the court to roll foam balls inward to knock down pins, while defenders block balls with hands and roll them out.
 4) Switch roles and repeat the game, with the team protecting the most pins within the allotted time winning.
pe-03158:
1) Divide into two groups of 6; one group holds ropes at different heights to form an entrance and exit.
 2) The other group passes through the ropes one by one from entrance to exit.
 3) A player is eliminated if their body touches a rope.
 4) Teams switch roles, and the team with more successful passes wins.
pe-03159:
1) Select one tagger, and when the game starts, the tagger chases the monkeys.
 2) Monkeys find safe places to hang and suspend themselves to avoid the tagger.
 3) The tagger cannot tag hanging monkeys, but monkeys must move to another spot before the tagger counts to five.
 4) If the tagger tags an unhung monkey, that monkey becomes the next tagger.
pe-03160:
1) Learn the 4 stages: Stage 1 (crawling/scooting on the floor), Stage 2 (sitting on a chair), Stage 3 (walking upright), Stage 4 (standing with one hand raised high).
 2) Everyone starts on the floor, roams the classroom, and plays rock-paper-scissors with peers in the same stage.
 3) The winner evolves to the next stage, while the loser remains in the current stage to play again.
 4) Students who reach Stage 4 gather at the blackboard; once more than half the class arrives, all sing together to finish.
pe-03161:
1) Form groups, and on the start signal, the first runner in each group moves carrying a ball on a racket.
 2) If the ball is dropped halfway, place it back on the racket and resume.
 3) After rounding the cone and returning to the starting line, pass the ball to the next teammate who starts.
 4) The group whose final runner arrives first wins.
pe-03162:
1) Stand sideways facing the throwing direction.
 2) Step the back foot toward the throwing direction while bringing the throwing hand back.
 3) Step forward with the opposite foot, rotate the hips and torso, and extend the throwing arm forward to release the ball.
 4) Measure the shortest straight-line distance from the throw line to where the ball landed using a tape measure.
pe-03163:
1) Strike the bamboo sticks twice open and once closed according to a three-beat rhythm.
 2) Jump twice between the sticks and jump landing with both feet apart outside.
 3) Hop one foot at a time alternately between the moving bamboo sticks.
 4) Jump twice between the sticks and turn around to jump landing with both feet apart.
pe-03164:
1) Insert thumb, middle, and ring fingers into the mini bowling ball holes.
 2) Relax shoulders and face toward the target pins.
 3) Step forward, push arms forward, and swing the ball back.
 4) Lower posture, shift weight onto one foot, and roll the ball to knock down the pins.
pe-03165:
1) Divide the class into two teams, with one catcher from each team standing in the receiving area facing their group.
 2) The first player bounces a table tennis ball on the floor, and the catcher catches it with a cone.
 3) If missed, retry; if successful, the thrower becomes the new catcher and the previous catcher goes to the back of the line.
 4) The team that successfully catches all table tennis balls first wins.
pe-03166:
1) The tagger wears a typhoon necklace around their neck to be marked.
 2) The tagger shouts in place, 'One, two, three, four, I am a typhoon!' to start the game.
 3) The typhoon chases other players dodging around, and anyone tagged becomes a 'little typhoon' who stands in place and only swings their arms.
 4) If a player touches a little typhoon's hand, they also become a little typhoon standing in that spot, and the game ends when everyone is tagged.
pe-03167:
1) Form teams of players numbered 1 through 4, standing in a straight line with their backs to the finish line.
 2) On the starting signal, the front player passes the ball backward overhead.
 3) After passing the ball, quickly run to the very end of the line to get ready to receive the ball again.
 4) Keep passing backward, and when the ball crosses the finish line, shout hurrah; the team that finishes first wins.
pe-03168:
1) Bend neck forward and backward, then tilt side to side using hands.
 2) Place hands on shoulders and rotate shoulders forward and backward.
 3) Pull palm backwards, and stretch arms across the chest alternately.
 4) Clasp hands overhead to stretch the sides, then sit down to stretch legs and rotate ankles.
pe-03169:
1) Line up in rows of four behind the starting line.
 2) At the start signal, identify the animal assigned to the first section and run while mimicking its movement.
 3) When reaching the next section, change the running gait according to the newly designated animal.
 4) Shout 'Finished!' loudly upon reaching the finish line; the next group starts when all four members arrive.
pe-03170:
1) Divide the class into two teams, determine the running order, and line up at the starting line.
 2) On the signal, the first runner runs and passes the hula hoop zone using their own method (spinning, jumping over, etc.), which becomes the team's official rule.
 3) Upon reaching the turning point, pick up the hula hoop from the cone, perform the established hoop rule, place it back on the cone, and run back.
 4) Tag the next runner's hand at the starting line; all subsequent runners repeat the same hoop action, and the first team whose final runner returns wins.
pe-03171:
1) The whole class forms a large circle around floor spot markers.
 2) Choose two taggers to enter the center markers.
 3) The two taggers play rock-paper-scissors to assign upper-body and lower-body roles.
 4) When music plays, taggers demonstrate their movements and other students combine and imitate them.
pe-03172:
1) Divide into two teams of three, determine the running order, and line up at the starting line.
 2) At the signal, the first runner runs zigzag between cones in zone 1.
 3) In zone 2, hop forward with joined feet, and in zone 3, make an elephant trunk with arms and spin three times in place.
 4) In zone 4, roll three times on the mat, cross the finish line, and send the next runner; the team whose final runner finishes first wins.
pe-03173:
1) Four students form a team and line up along a series of hula hoops.
 2) The first runner takes a beanbag from the first hoop and moves it to the second.
 3) Each subsequent teammate takes the beanbag and moves it to the next hoop in order.
 4) The team that successfully transfers all beanbags to the final hoop first wins.
pe-03174:
1) Divide into two teams and set the running order.
 2) At the signal, the first runner wearing a team vest takes a beanbag and jumps over obstacles (mini-hurdles) with both feet together to put it in a basket.
 3) Jump back over the obstacles with both feet together to return.
 4) The next runner starts when the previous runner crosses the start line, and the team whose final runner finishes first wins.
pe-03175:
1) Form groups of four, wear team vests, and decide the order of players.
 2) When the opposing group calls out a marker color, step on that spot marker in order and hold balance on both feet.
 3) Once all teammates are positioned, opposing players enter one by one and initiate a palm-push battle.
 4) The group earns 1 point for each player who withstands the push without falling, and the team with the most points wins.
pe-03176:
1) Line up at the start line in pairs, and the first pair holds a scarf with a fluff ball placed on it.
 2) On signal, hold the scarf together and walk around the cone and back.
 3) When the previous pair returns, the next pair receives the scarf with the fluff ball and starts.
 4) The team whose final pair finishes first wins.
pe-03177:
1) Divide students into groups and set up triangular cones numbered 1 through 6 in front of the teams.
 2) Runners from each group take turns rolling a die and checking the rolled number.
 3) The runner sprints to turn around the cone corresponding to the rolled number and runs back.
 4) The group whose members finish running first wins the game.
pe-03178:
1) Sit on a towel with knees bent, keeping both hands and feet outside the towel on the floor.
 2) On the start signal, push the floor with hands and feet while simultaneously pulling forward with hips.
 3) Repeat the gliding motion to go around the turning marker and return to the starting line.
 4) Can be played as tournament races or group relay challenges.
pe-03179:
1) Place both feet on the take-off board and face forward.
 2) Bend knees to lower posture, swing arms back and forward, then push off powerfully with both feet.
 3) Jump high while raising arms upward and arching the back slightly in mid-air.
 4) Extend arms and legs forward, tuck the body, and bend knees upon landing.
pe-03180:
1) Form two teams of 5 and stand in designated zone positions.
 2) The offensive goalkeeper initiates play by passing to the forward zone, and attackers advance the ball avoiding defenders.
 3) The front attacker shoots on goal while defenders attempt to block the shot.
 4) Scoring in the opposing goal awards 1 point, and turnovers switch offense and defense until the team with more points wins.
pe-03181:
1) Runner 2 lowers their posture to start quickly and watches Runner 1 approaching.
 2) Runner 1 approaches without slowing down.
 3) When Runner 1 reaches the agreed mark, Runner 2 sprints forward extending a hand backward, and Runner 1 calls out a signal to pass the baton.
 4) Runner 2 receives the baton and dashes vigorously forward.
pe-03182:
1) Set cones 15m apart for forward sprints, or set saucer cones in a 3m zigzag for lateral runs.
 2) On signal, run forward and turn around the opposite cone.
 3) For lateral runs, use side steps from the first cone to touch left and right cones in sequence.
 4) Repeat within one's own capability to build physical endurance.
pe-03183:
1) Put on the uniform and take the ready stance.
 2) Perform low block, reverse punch, middle inside block, and return punch in designated order.
 3) Perform high block followed by right front kick and reverse punch, then high block followed by left front kick and reverse punch.
 4) Perform low block and reverse punch, then return to the ready stance.
pe-03184:
1) Prepare cones and an agility ladder.
 2) Perform rapid burpee get-ups and quickly mirror a partner's movements.
 3) Run zig-zag through cones or run to touch 5 cones placed in a star pattern.
 4) Move laterally stepping one foot per ladder rung or jump forward alternating feet apart and together.
pe-03185:
1) Interlock fingers and rotate wrists while rolling each ankle sequentially to the count.
 2) Place hands on waist and rotate head and hips in 4-count turns left and right.
 3) Stretch arms across the chest or pull foot backwards to stretch legs while holding for 10 counts.
 4) Interlock fingers, reach forward, and hold the full-body stretch.
pe-03187:
1) Form two teams of four students each, arrange eight desks in two rows of four, and place three beanbags on the first desk.
 2) The first runner performs a push-up against the desk and moves the three beanbags to the next desk in that position, repeating until the last desk.
 3) The next runner starts from the opposite side and moves the beanbags in the same manner.
 4) The team whose final runner finishes moving all the beanbags first wins.
pe-03188:
1) Hold the rope with both hands, swing it, and jump over it with one or both feet.
 2) Hook one toe onto the rope, extend the leg straight up, and balance.
 3) Hold the rope with both hands and swing one arm to wrap the rope.
 4) Hold the cloth with one or both hands, wave, spin, or throw and catch it above the head.
pe-03189:
1) Underhand serve: Place the ball on the palm with feet staggered, bring the other fist forward to strike the ball.
 2) Overhead set: Place both hands above the head forming a triangle with fingers, bend and extend knees, pushing the ball with wrists and fingers.
 3) Spike: Approach, jump, swing arm upward to hit the ball with the open palm, and snap the wrist downward.
 4) Block: Jump near the net with arms extended to block the ball, angling hands slightly forward.
pe-03190:
1) Extend arms and legs, exhaling through the nose underwater.
 2) Circle arms outward to pull water, and inhale through the mouth as the head surfaces.
 3) Bend elbows to bring hands in front of the chest, draw heels in, and turn ankles outward.
 4) Extend arms forward, push water backward using ankles, bring legs together, and glide in a straight body line.
pe-03191:
1) Form a group of 5 players and choose 2 players to hold the elastic cord.
 2) Other players call out the target height and take turns cartwheeling over the elastic cord.
 3) Earn 1 point for clearing ankle height, 2 points for knee height, and 3 points for waist height.
 4) The group with the highest score after the set number of attempts wins.
pe-03192:
1) Stagger feet forward and backward, pushing and rolling a large ball with both hands.
 2) Kneel on one knee and roll an oval-shaped ball along the floor with both hands.
 3) Stagger feet, bend at the waist, and roll a small ball with one hand.
pe-03193:
1) Jump with both feet together jumping side to side over dish cones.
 2) Jump with both feet together while quickly swinging the jump rope twice for double unders.
 3) Bend knees into a squat and jump up explosively.
 4) Jump over obstacles with both feet together and throw a tee-ball ball quickly with one hand.
pe-03194:
1) Raise one knee and extend the foot straight ahead to kick forward.
 2) Raise one knee, turn your gaze backward, and kick behind you.
 3) Stand facing forward, turn 90 degrees to the right, and kick using the outer edge of your foot.
 4) Stand facing forward, turn 90 degrees to the left, and kick using the outer edge of your foot.
pe-03195:
1) Ride the bouncing ball by kicking the floor and moving straight ahead while bouncing up.
 2) Ride the bouncing ball by kicking the floor with both feet, alternating left and right to move in curves.
 3) Place one foot on the center of the kickboard deck and push against the ground to move in a straight line.
 4) Place one foot on the center of the kickboard deck and steer with the handlebars to move in curves.
pe-03196:
1) Form two teams of 5 players each, and pairs of players take their assigned positions.
 2) The team with the ball passes it with their feet toward a teammate in the scoring zone using various methods.
 3) If the teammate in the scoring zone receives the ball, the team earns 1 point.
 4) If the opposing team intercepts the ball, possession switches, and the team with the most points within the set time wins.
pe-03197:
1) For backhand throwing, pull the disc to chest height and release horizontally by extending the arm and wrist.
 2) For forehand throwing, raise the disc vertically at shoulder height and release horizontally extending arm and wrist.
 3) For pancake catching, reach toward the incoming disc, pull toward the body, and clamp hands together like clapping.
 4) For two-handed rim catching, extend both hands toward the disc, pull toward the body, and grip the rim.
pe-03198:
1) Stand properly in front of the mat in ready position for a backward roll.
 2) Place both hands by the mat and tuck your chin toward your chest.
 3) Push the floor firmly with both feet and roll backward keeping the body rounded.
 4) Stand up and regain balance to finish the roll.
pe-03199:
1) Hold the ball with both hands above your head to throw forward, and catch balls arriving overhead.
 2) Throw at chest height by extending arms, and catch incoming chest-level balls by pulling toward the chest.
 3) Hold the ball with one hand and throw upward from below waist level.
 4) Lower your stance and catch the falling ball using your palms and fingers.
pe-03200:
1) Form two teams of 6 players wearing team vests and stand in designated positions.
 2) Start play with a serve upon the signal, allowing one bounce on the floor, and hit the ball back over the net within three touches.
 3) Score 1 point when the opposing team fails to receive the ball or cannot return it over the net.
 4) The team with more points scored during the set time limit wins.
pe-03201:
1) Pair up in twos and throw and catch a soft ball while singing a song.
 2) When the song ends, the player holding the ball becomes the tagger and chases their partner.
 3) If caught, that player becomes the new tagger, performs 3 jumping jacks, and chases the partner.
 4) When the signal sounds, gather again to start the next round.
pe-03203:
1) Run with relaxed shoulders and minimal upper body movement.
 2) Take shorter strides so that the entire sole of the foot touches the ground lightly.
 3) When feeling breathless or tired while running, walk with an upright back, look forward, regulate breathing, and maintain proper posture.
 4) Resume running once your breathing becomes comfortable.
pe-03204:
1) Divide into batting and fielding teams of 6 players each and stand at assigned positions.
 2) After hitting, the batter runs around 1st and 2nd base and returns home to score 1 point.
 3) A batter is out if they miss three swings, hit a fly ball that is caught, or if the ball reaches base before the runner.
 4) Switch sides after 3 outs, play 4 innings, and the team with the most points wins.
pe-03205:
1) Practice forward hopping on one foot and jumping forward off both feet.
 2) Jump sideways over spot cones with both feet by bending and extending knees.
 3) Jump upward on the spot while opening and closing legs, or jumping high stretching both arms.
 4) Place both hands on the floor in a squat position and spring forward extending knees.
pe-03206:
1) Divide into 4 teams of 3 players each, stationed in four court zones divided by crossed nets.
 2) Start the rally with a serve from the service area upon the signal.
 3) Return the ball within 3 touches, without passing to the same team twice in succession.
 4) Score a point when an opposing team fails to return the ball; the team with the highest score at the end wins.
pe-03207:
1) Dribbling with hands: Bounce the ball on the floor using the arm and wrist while moving.
 2) Dribbling with feet: Slowly guide the ball along using the inside of the foot while moving.
 3) Dribbling with a stick: Keep the ball in the center of the body and guide it using both the inside and outside faces of the stick.
pe-03208:
1) Divide into groups of three for offense and defense.
 2) On the signal, attackers start from the line, pass and dribble, and score 1 point per basket.
 3) Attackers cannot take more than two steps while holding the ball.
 4) When out of bounds, the opposing team restarts from that spot; the team with the most points when time expires wins.
pe-03209:
1) Divide into two teams and take positions on the court.
 2) On the signal, hit the ball with the floorball stick to start the game.
 3) If an attacker pushes or holds a defender, roles switch; if a defender fouls, play restarts from that spot.
 4) Hit the opponent's plastic bin to score 1 point, and the team with the most points when time expires wins.
pe-03210:
1) Inflate a balloon to a suitable size and tie it off.
 2) Bounce the balloon above head level for 1 minute each using hands, feet, head, knees, and volleyball set posture while counting reps.
 3) Compete to see who can bounce the balloon overhead the most without lifting their feet off the ground.
 4) Play balloon volleyball in pairs using hands or feet.
pe-03211:
1) Clap 3, 5, and 10 times, then clench and open fists 3, 5, and 10 times.
 2) Interlock fingers and rotate wrists in both directions for 8 counts each.
 3) Make an elephant-trunk arm lock and pull while turning your head, then pull your elbow behind your head.
 4) Stretch interlocked hands forward, upward, and sideways, stretch the neck in all directions, and pat the shoulders and arms.
pe-03212:
1) Spread numbered spot markers across the floor and determine turn order.
 2) Stand at spot marker 1 and toss the beanbag toward spot marker 2.
 3) If the beanbag misses, the next player takes a turn; on the next turn, throw again from where the beanbag landed.
 4) Successfully landing on a spot allows an immediate throw toward the next numbered hole until reaching hole 10.
pe-03213:
1) Spread dish cones across the play area with roughly equal numbers facing upright and upside down.
 2) Divide into two teams, assigning one team to flip cones upright and the other team upside down.
 3) On the signal, players race to flip cones to their assigned orientation within the time limit.
 4) When time is called, count the cones; the team with the most cones facing their orientation wins.
pe-03214:
1) Balance a ball horizontally on the bounda-loon without dropping it while navigating obstacles.
 2) Bounce and volley a balloon or bouncy ball into the air or off the ground.
 3) Strike a tossed fleece ball using the bounda-loon into a hula hoop target.
 4) Rally a balloon back and forth in pairs to see who maintains the longest rally.
pe-03215:
1) Clap and rotate wrists, ankles, and knees to warm up the joints.
 2) Make large circles with shoulders and arms forward and backward, then spread legs wide and press down on knees.
 3) Lie face down, place hands firmly on the floor, extend legs, and hold the body straight 5 times.
 4) Catch your breath after each round and repeat for a total of 3 sets.
pe-03216:
1) Jump rhythmically with feet together, heels lifted, upper body slightly leaned forward, and eyes looking straight ahead.
 2) Hold the rope in one hand at waist height and rotate it using the wrist while jumping, alternating hands.
 3) Hold the rope with both hands, rotate it from waist height, and practice 100 jumps per day.
 4) Once mastered, challenge single-foot jumps or alternating side-straddle jumps.
pe-03217:
1) Grip the disc with the thumb on top and four fingers underneath, then practice throwing from inside to outside.
 2) Set up a scoring target on the floor and throw discs to score points or knock away opponent discs.
 3) Throw discs toward pins set on a table to see who can knock down the most pins.
 4) Run from the start line, pick up a disc, check the written number, and hit the matching target.
pe-03218:
1) Draw a starting line, set obstacles in pairs at equal intervals, and line up two teams of 3 to 5 players behind the start line.
 2) The first runner dribbles the ball zigzag through the obstacles and returns.
 3) If an obstacle is knocked over upon returning to the line, reset it before the next runner starts.
 4) The team whose final runner finishes dribbling and returns first wins.
pe-03219:
1) Form 4 teams of 3; two teams wait at the start line and two teams position one player per tag grid.
 2) Runners attempt to cross from the start line to the finish line avoiding taggers.
 3) Taggers catch runners only within their designated grids, and reaching the finish line scores 1 point.
 4) Tagged runners and those reaching the finish return to start over, then teams switch roles.
pe-03220:
1) Mark the starting zone, ocean, and safe zone on the ground, then divide roles into fish and sharks.
 2) Fish start in the starting zone and sharks wait in the ocean, with only 3 fish allowed in the ocean at the same time.
 3) Fish try to reach the safe zone without getting tagged; tagged fish must return to the start and try again.
 4) A shark scores 1 point for tagging a fish, and a fish scores 2 points for reaching the safe zone safely; the team with more points wins.
pe-03221:
1) Form groups of 4 to 6 students and decide the order.
 2) The first player performs a chosen basic movement learned earlier.
 3) The second player repeats the first movement and then adds their own movement.
 4) Subsequent players repeat all previous movements in sequence and add a new one, applauding anyone who remembers the full sequence without mistakes.
pe-03222:
1) Draw a playing area on the floor and set up goals on both sides.
 2) Divide into two teams of 5 players each.
 3) Dribble or pass the ball to advance into the opponent's area.
 4) Stealing the attacker's ball switches offense and defense.
 5) The goalkeeper can block shots using any part of the body, including hands, in front of the goal.
 6) Scoring a goal earns 1 point, and the team with more points within the set time wins.
pe-03223:
1) Form two teams of two and set up cones at 5m, 7m, and 9m from the starting line for each team.
 2) At the start signal sounding every 10 seconds, the first runner sprints to a chosen cone.
 3) Returning before the next signal awards points based on distance (5m: 1 pt, 7m: 2 pts, 9m: 3 pts); failing to return yields no points.
 4) When the next signal sounds, the next runner must depart regardless of the previous runner's return, and points are totaled over the set time.
pe-03224:
1) Divide into two teams of 5 players each on a basketball court.
 2) The team with the ball dribbles or passes into the opponent's area; if the opponent intercepts the ball, offense and defense switch.
 3) Scoring inside the semi-circle area yields 1 point, while scoring from outside gives 2 points.
 4) The team with more points at the end of the designated time wins.
pe-03225:
1) In a circular running course, divide two teams in half to prepare at the starting point and opposite side.
 2) At the starting signal, the team on the inside runs as close as possible to the curve, while the team on the outside runs far away from the curve.
 3) Record each team's time.
 4) Swap the positions of both teams, run again, and record the times.
pe-03226:
1) Draw a deserted island and three islands on the ground, placing 4 treasures on each island.
 2) Form groups of 4 students, assigning 1 guardian and 3 explorers per group.
 3) Guardians protect treasures while explorers take one treasure at a time from other islands; tagged explorers leave the treasure and go to the deserted island.
 4) Trapped players return when high-fived by a teammate; after time expires, treasures on the island score 2 points each and carried treasures score 1 point, highest score wins.
pe-03227:
1) Draw a court with cones in the middle, and pairs of two hold blankets to get ready inside their zone.
 2) Partners bounce the ball using the blanket to send it to the opponent's area or pass among teammates before sending it over.
 3) Score 1 point if the opponents fail to catch the ball or if it lands on the center cones.
 4) Score 1 point if the same pair on the opponent team catches it twice in a row or passes 5 or more times.
pe-03228:
1) Lower your body posture and bend your knees slightly into ready position.
 2) Bounce the ball against the floor using wrist snap and fingertips.
 3) Keep your eyes up toward the moving direction and opponents rather than down at the ball.
 4) Move forward smoothly while continuing the rhythmic dribble.
pe-03229:
1) Set up goals and plastic bottles at one end of each team lane and place a ball at the opposite end, with team members lined up in front of the goal.
 2) Both teams start simultaneously, passing the ball in sequence with their feet to the next teammate.
 3) The last teammate receives the ball in front of the bottles and kicks it from that spot to knock them down.
 4) Once knocked down, pass the ball back to the start, reset the bottles, repeat for the set time, and score 1 point per fallen bottle.
pe-03230:
1) Draw a circular court, divide into two teams of 4, with 3 players per team standing alternately around the outer circle and 1 player inside.
 2) Outer players pass the ball to each other avoiding the opposing player in the center.
 3) The center player tries to intercept the opponents' pass and connect it to their own outer teammates.
