 3) Swing the right arm back moderately and follow through forward.
 4) Practice serving facing a partner.
pe-03643:
1) Both taggers and runners are allowed to move only a single step simultaneously when the tagger shouts "One step!".
 2) Any player who moves out of sync or takes two steps instead of one is immediately called out and leaves the field.
 3) Stepping outside the designated boundary line or being touched by a tagger results in elimination.
 4) Two taggers herd the runners like sheep to tag them until only the final two survivors remain.
pe-03644:
1) Sit in a circle and roll a gymball toward the player in the center.
 2) If tagged by the ball, the player is out and replaced by the next player.
 3) In the second round, expand the circle and throw the ball to hit the center player.
 4) If the center player catches the thrown ball, the thrower must turn around to be hit on the back or legs.
pe-03645:
1) Determine serve order by rock-paper-scissors; each player serves twice alternately, bouncing the ball once on their table then onto the opponent's.
 2) Catch the served ball using the cup.
 3) During rallies, hit the ball directly onto the opponent's desk without touching your own desk.
 4) If a player fails to return the ball properly or catch it with the cup, the opponent scores a point.
pe-03646:
1) Taggers chase and touch fleeing players using foam sticks.
 2) Players directly caught by taggers go outside the court boundary to serve as referees.
 3) When about to be tagged, players clasp hands overhead shouting banana to freeze, and lower one hand when a teammate taps them.
 4) When another teammate taps them again, they are fully rescued to run, and taggers win if they catch everyone within 5 minutes.
pe-03647:
1) Students choose their own shooting position and distance.
 2) Choose any shooting technique among jump shot, set shot, or layup shot.
 3) Shoot the ball within the given time limit.
 4) The score is evaluated based on the number of successful baskets made within the time limit.
pe-03648:
1) In swing step, alternate feet by kicking one back on count 1 and forward on count 2.
 2) In high knees step, lift each knee until the thigh forms a 90-degree angle.
 3) Complete one high knee repetition after 4 rope turns.
 4) For the 360-degree turn, divide the rotation into small angles and turn gradually.
pe-03649:
1) Lie down with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees and arms extended forward.
 2) Engage the abdominal muscles and curl the upper body upward reaching toward the knees.
 3) If struggling independently, have a partner hold the feet or brace feet under a sturdy base.
pe-03650:
1) Set the basic plank posture keeping the body in a straight line from head to heels (or knees).
 2) Step 1: Stand and push against a wall.
 3) Step 2: Perform push-ups with hands placed at waist height.
 4) Step 3: Perform push-ups with hands at knee height; Step 4: Perform push-ups on the floor (with knees on the ground if needed).
pe-03651:
1) Stand facing a wall and perform calf raises rapidly without your heels touching the floor roughly.
 2) Set feet 5–15 degrees apart and perform seated squats on a chair or quick-tempo tension squats at knee level.
 3) Place one foot on a chair or sofa and perform split squats alternately on both legs.
 4) Rest shoulders on a sofa with toes raised, lowering and explosively lifting your hips for hip thrusts.
pe-03652:
1) Select and arrange 7 different jump rope footwork skills into a personalized continuous routine.
 2) Start with foundational steps such as 15 basic jumps and 10 alternate-foot steps.
 3) Transition smoothly without stopping into side straddle cross jumps, forward-backward swings, and 360-degree turning jumps.
 4) Complete advanced skills such as criss-cross jumps (5-10 reps) and double unders (10-20 reps) continuously to clear all 7 levels.
pe-03653:
1) Interlock fingers and stretch arms upward and backward.
 2) Lean the torso slowly to the left and right while keeping fingers interlocked.
 3) Extend one arm across the chest and pull it close using the opposite elbow.
 4) Raise one arm behind the head and gently pull the elbow down with the opposite hand.
pe-03654:
1) Set up a badminton net on a badminton court with 6 players per team (or adjusted numbers).
 2) Serve underhand without stepping on the service line; play continues even if the serve hits the net.
 3) Pass or return the ball to the opponent court in 1 to 5 touches, and using feet is allowed during play.
 4) The team that wins 2 out of 3 sets wins the match, while touching an out ball or returning a serve directly with an overhand results in a lost point.
pe-03655:
1) Set up the badminton court and net, with two players on each side for a doubles match.
 2) Start the rally using a short or long serve diagonally into the opponent's service court.
 3) Continue the rally by executing various strokes such as high clears, drops, smashes, pushes, and drives.
 4) A point is scored when the shuttlecock lands on the court floor or out of bounds.
pe-03656:
1) From attention stance, squat down and place hands on the floor shoulder-width apart.
 2) Jump both feet back into a plank position with the body in a straight line.
 3) Jump feet back in toward hands into the squat position.
 4) Use momentum to jump straight up into the air to complete one repetition.
pe-03657:
1) For the forehand serve, place the racket-side foot back, hold the shuttlecock between waist and chest, drop it without tossing, and hit it high and far.
 2) For the backhand serve, put the racket-side foot forward, position the shuttlecock below 115cm, draw the racket back, and push gently.
 3) The shuttlecock must be struck below 115cm from the floor (around the chest).
pe-03658:
1) Fold the rope in half, step on the center with one foot, and adjust the handles to chest/pit-of-stomach height.
 2) Stand straight, slightly raise the heels, and bend the knees to absorb landing impacts.
 3) Keep arms close to the torso and turn the rope lightly using only wrists while bouncing gently.
 4) Challenge yourself to complete 500 consecutive basic jumps at a pace of 100 jumps per minute.
pe-03659:
1) Divide the skills into groups A through G and write down the order of your choice on the evaluation sheet.
 2) In Group A, perform 10 repetitions of two-bounce jumping and 10 repetitions of basic bounce jumping.
 3) In Group B, perform single-foot jump (5 each), alternate-foot jump (5 times), and alternate double-bounce jump (3 each).
 4) Practice the assigned jump rope movements to build physical fitness.
pe-03660:
1) Divide into two teams, stack jumbo stacks in two rows in front of each team, and set up a model target pattern behind a screen partition.
 2) On signal, one runner from each team runs behind the partition to observe the colors and arrangement of the target stack.
 3) Return to the team and place one matching jumbo stack, with each player allowed to move only one cup per turn (or fix one misplaced cup).
 4) High-five the next runner before they can start, and the team that perfectly matches the target stack first wins.
pe-03661:
1) All players gather and stand in a circular formation.
 2) One player in the center spins a water bottle on the floor.
 3) The player pointed to by the tip of the bottle when it stops becomes the runner.
 4) The chosen runner immediately flees while everyone else chases them within 10 seconds.
pe-03662:
1) Divide players into 2 teams; the first runner of each team holds a handball and starts on the signal.
 2) Upon reaching the goal area line, shoot into the handball goal.
 3) After one shot attempt, quickly run back and hand the ball to the next runner to continue the relay.
 4) Goals scored into an already completed target hole do not count; the team that fills all target holes first wins.
pe-03663:
1) Decide the initial service order by a toss before the match starts.
 2) The server serves diagonally from the right court when the score is zero or even, and from the left court when odd.
 3) Deliver the service hit below a height of 1.15 meters from the floor.
 4) Score a point when the shuttlecock lands within the opponent's boundary, and concede a point if it goes out or hits the net.
pe-03664:
1) Determine the first server by a toss and serve diagonally from the right court at 0-0
 2) Serve diagonally from the right court when the serving side's score is even (including 0) and from the left court when odd
 3) Only when the serving team wins a rally and scores consecutively do partners switch service courts and the same player serves again
 4) When winning the serve back from the opponent, players do not switch sides; the player standing in the court corresponding to their score serves
pe-03665:
1) Lightly jump in place four times with feet together without a jump rope.
 2) Practice opening the feet shoulder-width apart and closing them across four beats.
 3) Jump lightly just as the rope approaches right in front of your feet.
 4) Turn the rope to the rhythm and continuously perform the open-and-close jumps.
pe-03666:
1) Stretch the right thigh, then stretch the other leg.
 2) Hold ankles and repeat sitting down and standing up.
 3) Tap toes while extending arms, raise elbows, and tap up and down.
 4) Stretch legs while seated, then stand up and interlock fingers to stretch upward.
pe-03667:
1) Push the chair back to make room between the desk and chair, and gently warm up the neck and shoulders.
 2) Keep feet on the floor, bring knees together, hold the lower chair back, open the chest, and hold Camel Pose for 10 seconds.
 3) Round the spine inward looking at the belly button and hold Cat Pose for 10 seconds.
 4) Perform Chair Pose hovering slightly off the seat, Crescent Pose bending to each side, knee-to-chest pulls, and finish with Child's Pose.
pe-03668:
1) Sit properly on a chair in front of the desk and wait for the music.
 2) Follow the rhythmic upper-body choreography to the song 'Balloons'.
 3) Float or wave balloons with both hands during the chorus or ending part to express freely.
pe-03669:
1) Partners face each other holding hands and step in rhythm to Jajinmori jangdan while singing the traditional song 'Play Namsaeng'.
 2) Change the lyrics to movement words such as jumping, wiggling, fluttering, or moving slowly.
 3) Create and perform corresponding body movements along with the new descriptive words in time with the rhythm.
pe-03670:
1) Perform reverse lunges alternating right and left legs.
 2) Do jumping jacks and forward crawl walkouts from standing.
 3) Perform burpees and starfish crunches touching alternating hands and feet while lying down.
 4) Complete superman holds, skate jumps, no-hands sit-ups, and punch-kick combinations.
pe-03671:
1) Perform jumping jacks in place.
 2) Perform high-knee running by lifting knees up toward the waist.
 3) Perform cross-jumping by opening and crossing arms and legs.
 4) Continue with butt kicks, jump squats, and lunges.
pe-03672:
1) Divide the class into 2 teams and put on team vests.
 2) Write down the names of team members and each member's target number of shuttlecock hits on a score sheet.
 3) Players take turns stepping forward to hit the shuttlecock without dropping it until their target number is reached before passing the racket to the next player.
 4) Waiting teammates count the reps out loud; if the shuttlecock drops, restart from 1, and the team that finishes first wins.
pe-03673:
1) Form pairs where one person bends down as the horse and the other leapfrogs over using both arms.
 2) The horse bends forward, tucking the head as low as possible toward the feet.
 3) Switch roles back and forth to see how many times you can vault in 10 seconds.
 4) Extend the game into a moving leapfrog relay race toward the cone markers.
pe-03674:
1) The tagger chases on all fours in a bear walk, while runners escape using a crab/spider walk (facing upward).
 2) Mats act as spider webs where runners can rest by sitting with their bottoms on the mat for up to 10 seconds.
 3) After 10 seconds, runners must move to a different spider web mat before resting again.
 4) Runners win if they keep fleeing in spider walk until time runs out.
pe-03675:
1) Prepare targets using cardboard boxes or plastic bottles.
 2) Decide on the throwing position and draw a throw line on the floor.
 3) Throw the ball forcefully at the targets ensuring feet do not cross the line.
 4) The player who hits or knocks down the most targets wins; points can vary by target size/distance or played as teams.
pe-03676:
1) Choose one leader and have other players line up horizontally.
 2) Play rock-paper-scissors with the leader.
 3) Players who win move forward by jumping like a frog: 3 jumps for Rock ("Gu-ri-ko"), 6 jumps for Scissors ("Chi-yo-ko-re-i-to"), and 6 jumps for Paper ("Pa-i-na-tsu-pu-ru").
 4) The first player to cross the goal line wins; it can also be played as a 1-on-1 match.
pe-03677:
1) Set up a course with lines or obstacles and form teams of 4 to 5 lined up at opposite ends.
 2) On start signal, the first runners run along the line or leap over obstacles toward the opponent base.
 3) When meeting in the middle, say Don, touch both hands together, and play rock-paper-scissors.
 4) The winner keeps moving forward while the loser steps aside and returns to the end of their team line so the next runner starts; the team that reaches the opponent base first wins.
pe-03678:
1) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.
 2) The winner calls out "Jump over there, hop!".
 3) In time with "hop", both players jump in one of four directions (forward, backward, left, or right).
 4) In a mirror view, if both players jump in the same direction, the rock-paper-scissors winner wins; if different, return to start and repeat.
pe-03679:
1) Form a group of four and stand at four evenly spaced points around a circle.
 2) On the starting signal, run clockwise simultaneously and try to tag the person in front.
 3) When the caller gives another signal after 3 to 5 seconds, switch and run counterclockwise.
 4) A player is out if tagged.
pe-03680:
1) Divide into Salmon and Orca teams and stand facing each other.
 2) When the caller shouts 'Salmon', the Salmon team swims forward to chase the Orca team.
 3) The Orca team swims back toward their baseline to avoid being tagged.
 4) When the caller shouts 'Orca', the Orca team chases the Salmon team back to their line.
pe-03681:
1) Divide players into one fisherman (tagger) and fish.
 2) When the fisherman signals 'Throwing the net,' fish run to the safe zone on the opposite side without getting tagged.
 3) Fish tagged while running become fishermen and hold hands to form a net.
 4) As the net grows, split it into smaller groups, or adjust initial taggers and distance to the safe zone.
pe-03682:
1) Hold a paper cup as a racket and use rolled tissue paper instead of a shuttlecock.
 2) The winner of rock-paper-scissors serves to start the match.
 3) Launch the tissue ball from inside the cup toward the opponent's court.
 4) If the tissue falls inside one's court, the opponent scores 1 point, and the first to reach 5 points wins.
pe-03683:
1) Fold a towel and tie a knot at one end.
 2) Stand diagonally beneath a basketball hoop, spread feet wider than shoulder-width, and extend arms into a wide stance.
 3) Shift weight onto the foot on the side holding the towel, pointing the other hand and shoulder toward the net.
 4) Swing the towel broadly over the head so that the knotted tip hits the basketball net.
pe-03684:
1) Sit side by side with legs stretched out forward at the starting line.
 2) Play rock-paper-scissors, and the winner moves forward by walking on their hips.
 3) Move forward 3 steps for rock, or 6 steps for paper or scissors based on the syllable count.
 4) When feet touch the towel turn around, hip-walk backwards, and the first to touch the starting line with their hips wins.
pe-03685:
1) Rock is squatting down, scissors is putting both hands forward with scissor signs and legs split front-to-back, and paper is spreading arms and legs wide.
 2) Players play continuous body rock-paper-scissors to the chant.
 3) Compete to see how many times you can win within the time limit.
pe-03686:
1) Pair up and sit on chairs facing each other.
 2) Lift both feet off the floor and play rock-paper-scissors with feet (closed feet for rock, vertical split for scissors, horizontal spread for paper).
 3) Match feet gestures simultaneously on cue.
 4) Vary the game with delayed-call rules where the late throw must either win or lose.
pe-03687:
1) Stand facing each other in pairs.
 2) The leader holds a newspaper and moves it freely.
 3) The other partner pretends to be the newspaper and mimics its movements.
 4) Play using a large plastic bag instead of a newspaper.
pe-03688:
1) One player is chosen as the cat, and the other players hold hands in a circle and choose one player as the mouse.
 2) The circle rotates and moves to prevent the cat from tagging the mouse, without stepping outside the center marker.
 3) If the cat tags the mouse, the cat wins; if not tagged within the time limit, the mouse wins.
 4) The game can be varied by increasing the number of players forming the circle or the number of mice.
pe-03689:
1) Select taggers using the lines on the gymnasium floor.
 2) On the start signal, both taggers and runners move only on the floor lines.
 3) Anyone tagged switches roles and becomes the new tagger.
 4) (Variation) Place markers on lines to jump over, or modify court size and number of taggers.
pe-03690:
1) Form pairs and sit facing each other on a mat.
 2) Roll backward into a cradle rock and sit back up.
 3) Call rock-paper-scissors while rocking back again and throw your hand upon sitting up (if tied, rock again to replay).
 4) The player who wins the hand match wins the round.
pe-03691:
1) Decide the cat, mouse, and leader; the cat and mouse stand back-to-back.
 2) When the leader calls 'Cat', both do a designated move (e.g., 10 side steps), then the cat flees forward while the mouse turns around to tag.
 3) When the leader calls 'Mouse', both do the move, then the mouse flees forward while the cat turns around to tag.
 4) The runner only takes a single step forward; if they take that step without being tagged they win, but if tagged before moving they lose.
pe-03692:
1) Form groups of three divided into an attacking team and a defending team.
 2) Defending players line up along the boundary facing the attackers; on the start signal, attackers sprint toward the area.
 3) Defending players must stay outside the area and tag attackers as they approach.
 4) Attackers win if at least one player safely enters the area; defenders win if they tag all attackers.
pe-03693:
1) When tagged by the tagger, mimic the animal specified by the tagger on the spot.
 2) Runners who are not tagged try to guess the animal to free the tagged runner.
 3) The tagged runner must continue mimicking until someone guesses correctly.
 4) Variations include adding more taggers or mimicking sports movements instead of animals.
pe-03694:
1) Stand facing each other in pairs.
 2) Play catch while playing shiritori.
 3) Play catch while each holding one ball and playing shiritori.
 4) Play catch while moving front, back, left, and right during shiritori.
pe-03695:
1) Jump over the rubber band to the rhythm of the music.
 2) Form groups of three where one person jumps over the rubber band.
 3) Progress by increasing the number of jumpers, changing the rhythm, or adjusting the height of the rubber band.
pe-03696:
1) Two players stand facing each other and play rock-paper-scissors with hand signs.
 2) The player who loses spreads both feet apart to the left and right.
 3) Continue playing rock-paper-scissors, opening feet further by about one foot-width each loss.
 4) The player who can no longer stand upright loses the game.
pe-03697:
1) Decide facial movements for rock, paper, and scissors.
 2) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors with facial expressions.
 3) The loser opens both feet slightly to the sides (about one foot-width each).
 4) Continue playing, and the player who can no longer remain standing loses.
pe-03698:
1) Jump rope to the music.
 2) Try various jumping styles.
 3) Change the music midway and jump to different rhythms.
 4) Face a partner and jump using one rope, or jump together with two ropes.
pe-03699:
1) Divide into two teams of 4 players.
 2) One team enters the court and forms a single line with hands on the shoulders of the person in front.
 3) The other team stays outside the court passing the ball to target the last player in line.
 4) A hit on anyone other than the last player is safe, breaking hands is an out, and count how many times the target is hit within the time limit.
pe-03700:
1) Divide into two teams and line up in a single rank.
 2) Scatter an equal number of balls for each team on one side of the court.
 3) On the start signal, run all at once to grab a ball and throw it with all might toward the opposite side of the court.
 4) Players cannot throw the ball ahead of the initial line, can only throw one ball at a time, and the team that throws all balls first wins.
pe-03701:
1) Sit side by side with both legs stretched out forward.
 2) Set a finish line using a towel or marker.
 3) Play rock-paper-scissors; the winner moves forward using hip walking (rock moves 3 steps for 'Glico', scissors/paper moves 6 steps).
 4) The person whose feet touch the finish line first wins.
pe-03702:
1) The leader says 'Say together, do together' and directs directions such as front, back, up, or down.
 2) Others jump while saying the direction instructed by the leader.
 3) Vary the game with commands like 'say together, do opposite' or 'say opposite, do together'.
 4) Play by increasing the number of participants or holding hands in a circle.
pe-03703:
1) Set up a square court approximately 6 meters per side, placing one outfielder along each edge.
 2) On the start signal, outfielders pass the ball around and throw it to hit the infielder.
 3) Compete to see how many times the infielder is hit within a 1-minute time limit.
 4) Rotate positions once time expires so every student gets a turn as an infielder.
pe-03704:
1) Form teams of 4 to 6 players and prepare a tee stand and bat for each team.
 2) Line up tee stands in a row, draw a home run line, and place balls behind.
 3) On start, the first player runs to fetch a ball, sets it on the tee, and hits it; the next player then runs for a ball.
 4) Repeat until balls run out, and the team with the most balls beyond the home run line wins.
pe-03705:
1) Two children become okonomiyaki and lie face down.
 2) A parent acts as the cook and tries to flip the okonomiyaki over.
 3) The okonomiyaki resist being flipped.
 4) If the cook flips both okonomiyaki within the time limit, the cook wins; if not, the children win.
pe-03706:
1) Select a few players to act as the fish.
 2) Players acting as the net join hands to form a circle around the fish.
 3) On the start signal, the fish try to slip through the net while the net players hold hands tightly to prevent escape.
 4) The fish win if all escape within the time limit; the net wins if even one fish remains inside.
pe-03707:
1) Two players balance on one foot and hop while playing Rock-Paper-Scissors.
 2) The winner calls out "Jump over there, hop!"
 3) On the count of "hop!", both players jump in one of four directions (forward, backward, left, or right).
 4) If both jump in the same direction (mirror view), the Rock-Paper-Scissors winner wins the round; if different, return and repeat until a winner is decided.
pe-03708:
1) Pair up with a partner, face each other, and stand on one foot.
 2) Play Shiritori (word chain) while maintaining balance.
 3) A player loses if the lifted foot touches the floor or if they cannot continue the word chain.
 4) Once accustomed, play with eyes closed or add jumps matching the syllable count.
pe-03709:
1) Form teams of 4 to 6 players and line up in a single file.
 2) Place about 10 balls in front of the leader and a hoop behind the last person.
 3) On start signal, twist your body to pass balls one by one to the person behind.
 4) Put the ball into the hoop at the end of the line, and the first team to place all balls wins.
pe-03710:
1) Inflate a plastic bag to use instead of a volleyball.
 2) Sit facing each other with a towel or similar item placed between as a center line.
 3) Rally like volleyball by receiving, tossing, and attacking to return the bag to the opponent court.
 4) The player who scores 5 points first wins.
pe-03711:
1) Form a circle with 7 to 8 players.
 2) Pass a ball to each other within the circle.
 3) The two players next to the receiver must quickly squat down.
 4) Count how many successful passes can be made within the time limit without making mistakes.
pe-03712:
1) Inflate and tie a plastic bag to use in place of a ball.
 2) Two players play Shiritori (word chain) while hitting the plastic bag back and forth like volleyball.
 3) Hit the bag toward where the opponent can easily return it to keep the rally going.
 4) If the bag falls to the floor while thinking of a word or if a player fails to continue the word chain, that player loses.
pe-03713:
1) Tuck a towel into the back of your pants and face each other.
 2) Move in a circle to the right or left at the start signal.
 3) Try to grab your opponent's towel while protecting your own.
 4) The player who takes the opponent's towel first wins.
pe-03714:
1) Decide who touches and who runs away, then face each other and shake hands.
 2) The runner specifies a body part to be touched, such as the hips.
 3) If touched on the specified spot within the time limit, the tagger wins; if evaded, the runner wins.
 4) Switch roles or change the target area to knees or back.
pe-03715:
1) Twist newspaper and secure it with tape to make rings.
 2) One person lies on their back and raises both arms and legs.
 3) Another person tosses the ring like a ring toss.
 4) The person lying down catches the ring with their hands or feet.
pe-03716:
1) Hold hands and play rock-paper-scissors with your feet.
 2) The winner tries to tag the opponent's hips while the loser dodges.
 3) The player who tags the opponent's hips first wins.
pe-03717:
1) Decide who will flee and who will take the plastic bag.
 2) The fleeing player holds the bag between both feet and spins around on the spot to protect it.
 3) The chaser moves around the fleeing player and attempts to take the bag.
 4) If the chaser takes the bag within the time limit, they win; otherwise, the fleeing player wins, then switch roles.
pe-03718:
1) Two players face each other with a towel placed on the floor between them.
 2) A caller gives deceptive words until shouting 'Catch', at which point both try to grab the towel.
 3) Progress the starting stance from standing to sitting down or lying flat on the floor.
 4) The player who grabs the towel first scores the point.
pe-03719:
1) Each person holds one ball and stands in a circle facing inward.
 2) Throw the ball straight above your head and move to catch the ball of the person to your left.
 3) Bounce the ball once and catch the ball thrown by the person to your left.
 4) Once comfortable, switch to the right direction and gradually increase the number of players.
pe-03720:
1) A parent sits on the floor while the child walks or runs around them.
 2) When "touch" is called, the child touches the floor as quickly as possible.
 3) When a specific body part such as "hips" is called, the child touches the floor with that body part.
 4) Players can take turns or vary the game by having the child touch the named body part of the parent.
pe-03721:
1) Two partners hold a towel ball (or ball) together between their open palms and move in all directions in sync.
 2) Progress to holding and moving it with three fingers, two fingers, and finally one fingertip.
 3) Drop a ball from above and coordinate catching it softly between both partners palms without using fingers.
 4) Each player places a ball on an open palm without gripping it, balancing while trying to slap down the opponent ball to score 1 point.
pe-03722:
1) Two players face each other and play basic catch.
 2) Players throw the ball using their non-dominant hand.
 3) Throw two-handed from overhead like a throw-in, or toss from below waist-level.
 4) Stand backward and throw between the legs or backward over the head.
pe-03723:
1) Hold a ball between the feet or in the hands without touching behind the head, curl the body into a ball, and roll forward.
 2) Roll forward while holding the ball with one hand, then switch to the other hand.
 3) Hold a ball in both hands or clamp the ball between the legs and roll forward.
pe-03724:
1) Jump the long rope in place while counting out loud to reach at least 10 jumps.
 2) Jump 3 times with eyes closed to internalize the rope's rhythm.
 3) Practice gallop steps and rotating jumps in place to develop balance and rhythm.
 4) Practice exiting after 3 jumps and timing the entrance before putting it all together into continuous figure-8 jumping.
pe-03725:
1) The child lies prone on the floor while the partner holds the feet, and escapes upon signal.
 2) The partner lies on the child's back, and the child uses whole-body strength to crawl out.
 3) The partner locks the child between seated legs, and the child tries to break free within the time limit.
 4) The partner stays on all fours, and the child holds the waist and crawls forward to escape.
pe-03726:
1) Sit on the floor, use one foot like a brush, and write numbers 1 to 5 in the air.
 2) Write numbers with the other foot without supporting hands on the floor behind, or raise both feet and write large numbers.
 3) Stand up, balance on one foot to write numbers, and try with eyes closed.
 4) Practice jumping and landing still, turning jumps and stopping, and rolling backward to stand up on one foot.
pe-03727:
1) Lie down or sit facing a partner, then quickly react and sprint upon receiving tactile, visual, or auditory signals.
 2) Divide into 'Cat' and 'Mouse' teams and lie face down.
 3) When the leader calls 'Cat' or 'Mouse', the named team sprints to escape while the other team stands up to chase and tag.
 4) The escaping runner scores or remains safe by crossing the goal line first.
pe-03728:
1) Stand at the edge of the mat while a helper stands opposite holding balls.
 2) Perform a forward roll on the mat and stand up to catch the ball thrown by the helper.
 3) Catch balls thrown with spin or select the designated color called out between two balls.
 4) Start facing away from the mat or from the opposite side, turning to catch the ball.
pe-03729:
1) The adult lies down and places the child on their back or chest.
 2) Hold the child securely by hands or clothing and lift them up so they feel floating.
 3) Start from low slide-like heights and gradually increase height and movement.
pe-03730:
1) The assistant lies face down to form a rounded mountain base.
 2) The child leans back against the assistant's back, legs, and hips sequentially.
 3) The child practices crossing laterally over the assistant's body.
 4) The child places both hands on the mat over the assistant, tucks the head toward the navel, and rolls forward safely without knees hitting the head.
pe-03731:
1) Stand behind the mat and roll the ball forward.
 2) Perform a forward roll smoothly while keeping the back of the head on the mat.
 3) Stand up quickly and catch the rolling ball before it stops or falls off.
 4) (Variation) Roll or gently kick the ball by oneself before rolling forward to catch it.
pe-03732:
1) Start in a tripod headstand on a mat and use leg momentum to push up into a handstand.
 2) Tap up and down with one fist while rubbing back and forth with the other palm, then alternate hands.
 3) Sit and spin on the hips by pushing the floor, aiming for more than 2 rotations with a single push.
 4) Toss a ball upward, quickly touch multiple body parts (head, shoulders, stomach, knees), and catch it.
pe-03733:
1) Form a circle with cones and place the tagger inside the circle.
 2) The tagger cannot step outside the circle, and players enter one by one.
 3) Players try to grab cones without being tagged, and must return the cone if tagged.
 4) The team that collects more cones wins.
pe-03734:
1) A parent gets down on all fours, and the child crawls underneath or jumps over their legs.
 2) The child climbs up onto the parent's back or shoulders and climbs down.
 3) The child places hands on the parent's back to support their weight and leap over.
 4) Transition into vaulting-like support movements while maintaining firm arm support.
pe-03735:
1) Practice arm swinging evenly back and forth at roughly 90 degrees while keeping the torso stable.
 2) Learn the forward-leaning start posture with hands on the front knee and one leg pulled back.
 3) Practice Mario jumps by leaping and switching feet while keeping the torso straight upon landing.
 4) Stretch hip flexors and do alligator switches and lying bicycle pedals to build stride and pitch.
pe-03736:
1) Sit or stand in place, throw the ball upward, and catch it.
 2) Walk to pick up a stationary ball, then walk and throw-catch, and finally run and throw-catch.
 3) Gently throw a soft ball upward and head it with your forehead.
 4) Toss the ball up and form a circle with both hands for the ball to pass through.
pe-03737:
1) Step in place to a 3-beat rhythm of 'one, two, three'.
 2) Lift one knee high on count 'one', alternating between right and left legs.
 3) Change the movement by lifting and touching the heel with your hand on count 'one' or 'three'.
 4) Combine knee lifts on 'one' and heel touches on 'three', or raise the opposite hand simultaneously to the rhythm.
pe-03738:
1) Hold each other and rock gently from side to side to get used to the motion.
 2) Rock and then make a full turn around.
 3) Rock and then drop down slightly together.
 4) Rock and lean back gently.
pe-03739:
1) Two players face each other, each holding one ball, and throw and catch simultaneously.
 2) One player bounces the ball while the other throws in the air so balls do not collide, then they switch roles.
 3) One player tosses their ball straight up, catches and returns a pass from the partner, and then catches their own falling ball.
 4) One player holds a ball while the partner tosses another ball to balance on top of it without direct hand contact.
pe-03740:
1) The leader calls out instructions or shows rock-paper-scissors signs for mat movements.
 2) Perform the assigned movement such as pencil roll for rock, regular forward roll for scissors, or airplane forward roll for paper.
 3) In a variation, determine the sign that loses to the leader and execute the corresponding roll.
pe-03741:
1) Jump the turning long rope 3 times and crawl through the rope turner's legs to exit.
 2) Enter the rope and jump the exact number of letters spoken in a word before exiting.
 3) Line up in two queues and alternate entering the rope in a cross pattern.
 4) Two jumpers enter together, jump continuously while playing rock-paper-scissors, and the winner exits first (or jump into a reverse-turning rope).
pe-03742:
1) Hold the back of your head, look down at your navel, and stretch the back of your neck for 5 seconds.
 2) Pull your head to touch your ear to your shoulder while pushing down with the opposite hand for 5 seconds per side.
 3) Push under your chin upward with your thumbs to stretch the front of your neck for 5 seconds.
 4) Pull one arm across your chest for shoulders, pull elbow behind head for sides, and press hands on the floor to stretch wrists for 5 seconds.
pe-03743:
1) Lay a full sheet of newspaper on the floor and balance on it for 5 seconds.
 2) Fold the newspaper in half each round to gradually reduce its size.
 3) As it becomes smaller, balance on one foot and hold for 5 seconds.
 4) Add variations such as standing on tiptoes or closing eyes.
pe-03744:
1) Face belly toward the wall, climb up with feet, and gradually move hands closer to the wall.
 2) Count to ten, then look at the navel and perform a forward roll.
 3) Place feet against the wall, climb up, and walk sideways.
 4) As you get used to it, walk with feet higher, and finish by looking at the navel and rolling forward.
pe-03745:
1) Face each other and simultaneously stop the tossed ball using both hands or one hand.
 2) Face forward and coordinate together to catch the side-tossed ball between your arms or sides.
 3) Stand back-to-back and cooperate to catch and trap the ball between your backs.
 4) Lower your stance and trap the incoming ball securely between both of your hips.
pe-03746:
1) Two partners face each other, and one person acts as a stiff wooden pole keeping the entire body straight.
 2) As the person leans forward or backward, the partner catches and supports them with both hands to push them back up safely.
 3) Switch roles so the child stiffens into a straight pole and leans, while the adult securely catches their back.
 4) Once comfortable, try leaning sideways or briefly releasing and catching hands to maintain core tension.
pe-03747:
1) Two partners sit facing each other; one holds arms tightly together while the other tries to pull them apart.
 2) Switch roles and repeat the arm-holding challenge.
 3) Sit with legs extended straight and together, resisting the partner's attempt to pull them apart.
 4) Sit with knees bent, holding legs firmly together using full-body strength while the partner tries to open them.
pe-03748:
1) Perform rotation exercises such as hip spins, belly spins, and pencil rolls.
 2) Practice diverse animal walks like alligator, inchworm, and backward bear crawls.
 3) Train core strength through daruma roll-ups, air cycling, and spider holds.
 4) Conduct dynamic stretches and bilateral movements including pendulum swings and leg switches.
pe-03749:
1) Support your body on the bar with arms straight in a swallow position.
 2) Bring your legs forward and hook the back of your knees over the bar to sit down.
 3) Keep your gaze forward without looking down and release your hands from the bar to balance.
pe-03750:
1) The child acts as a lion, and the partner forms a hoop shape using hands, arms, or legs.
 2) The child crawls through the hoop carefully without touching the partner's body.
 3) Challenge various hoop shapes such as low poses or arches made with arms and legs.
 4) Switch roles so the child forms the hoop and the partner passes through.
pe-03751:
1) For horizontal balance, extend one leg backward and lean forward to keep the body horizontal.
 2) For V-sit balance, sit with legs extended, stretch arms to the sides, and raise the legs.
 3) For one-hand balance, support the body in a push-up position and lift one hand straight up.
 4) Practice various solo balance skills such as seal, bridge, killer whale, and shoulder stand step by step.
pe-03752:
1) A partner kneels or crouches down in a stable position.
 2) The child places hands on the partner's shoulders and rolls forward over the back.
 3) The partner supports the child's back firmly with both hands throughout the roll.
pe-03753:
1) Roll a ball on your legs and stop it at the edge.
 2) Roll balls toward each other into a ring for Ball Curling.
 3) Roll a ball through teammates' spread legs in the Tunnel Challenge.
 4) Practice Bounce Catch by calling out bounce counts or playing Shiritori.
pe-03754:
1) Sit with legs extended and swing bent arms rhythmically, progressing to kneeling, half-kneeling, and single-leg standing.
 2) Hold a wall and swing one leg forward-backward and side-to-side like a pendulum to enhance hip mobility while keeping the core stable.
 3) Assume a low alligator push-up stance and alternate legs forward to the hands in rhythm.
 4) In a push-up position, alternate knees rapidly to the chest for 10 seconds, then lie down and pedal legs quickly like a bicycle for 10 seconds.
pe-03755:
1) Move sideways to crawl under or step over two rubber bands without using hands.
 2) Adjust the height and width of the rubber bands to challenge movement.
 3) Increase the number of rubber bands to perform the activity.
pe-03756:
1) Perform marching in place.
 2) Practice the step-touch by stepping sideways and bringing feet together, and the hop-step on one foot.
 3) Execute the V-step stepping forward in a V shape and walking four steps forward and backward.
 4) Add head claps to step-touch, cross legs in grapevines, raise arms during V-steps, combine kicking with walking, or hold water bottles for progression.
pe-03757:
1) Bend your knees, bend your upper body forward, and roll the ball around your body.
 2) Breathe out slowly and relax your body while rolling the ball.
 3) Try varying your posture, such as straddle sitting or straight-leg sitting.
 4) Adjust the challenge by varying equipment, such as using a smaller ball.
pe-03758:
1) Toss the ball upward with both hands.
 2) Catch the falling ball with both hands.
 3) Try clapping hands before catching or using balls of different sizes.
pe-03759:
1) Place Ken Step rings on the floor.
 2) Alternate left and right feet while jumping or running rhythmically through the rings.
 3) Vary the activity by matching hand claps, jumping together with a partner, stepping only on specific colors, or hopping on one foot.
pe-03760:
1) Move beanbags while mirroring a partner's side-step movements.
 2) Vary the activity by moving in a cross pattern or in opposite directions from your partner.
pe-03761:
1) Check your flexibility level using the 11-step assessment.
 2) Perform standing knee extensions (front, side, back) and leg swings (front-back, side-to-side).
 3) Stretch with single-leg forward bends and deep lunges.
 4) Face a partner for Nabenabe towel moves and PNF stretching (twist and seated), then re-measure flexibility.
pe-03762:
1) Set up a course of about 60 meters per lap.
 2) Run 5 to 10 laps while maintaining a steady pace, regulating breathing, and swinging arms in rhythm.
 3) Use record cards to observe classmates' running pace and give helpful advice to each other.
pe-03763:
1) Two players face each other, and one player initiates a step movement.
 2) The follower performs the same stepping motion one tempo behind.
 3) After taking a step, players must always take a step to return to their original position.
 4) Once familiar, vary the activity by speeding up the rhythm or changing posture such as hopping on one foot.
pe-03764:
1) Place the homemade throwing mat marked with positions 1, 2, and arrow 3 on the floor.
 2) Stand with heels aligned on markers 1 and 2 (right-handers face right).
 3) Lift the front foot (2) and step out straight toward arrow 3.
 4) Plant firmly and follow through with the throwing motion.
pe-03765:
1) Place a large bath towel flat on top of the vaulting box.
 2) Run up toward the vaulting box and vault over by placing both hands firmly on the towel.
 3) Strike the top firmly so a clear sound is made without crumpling or shifting the towel.
 4) Practice repeatedly ensuring the towel remains unwrinkled and neat.
pe-03766:
1) Crumple or roll newspaper into a ball or stick shape.
 2) Wrap the shaped newspaper with aluminum foil to complete the ball or throwing stick.
 3) Hold the foil stick, rotate the hips, and throw it forward.
pe-03767:
1) Roll newspaper into rings and connect them to make throwing rings.
 2) Toss rings toward a target on the floor or try to catch rings thrown by a partner.
 3) Insert crumpled paper balls into an umbrella plastic bag and inflate it with air.
 4) Throw the completed umbrella rocket to see how far it flies.
pe-03768:
1) Sit on a mat, hug your knees with a rounded back, tuck your chin, and rock backward and forward.
 2) Try rocking with hands released and legs extended.
 3) Pull knees in quickly to increase the rotational rocking speed.
 4) When rocking backward, practice placing hands on the mat and pushing lightly to support the body.
pe-03769:
1) Connect mats in the gymnasium tightly together without leaving gaps.
 2) Roll across the mats inventing various rolling styles.
 3) Move freely along the mat path while being careful not to bump into peers.
 4) Rearrange mats into circular loops or add narrow mats when congestion occurs.
pe-03770:
1) Sit at the poolside and practice stirring the water using the soles of the feet.
 2) Walk in shallow water while feeling the water push back against the soles.
 3) Turn the toes outward before kicking.
 4) Push the water backward with the soles of the feet and extend the legs straight together.
pe-03771:
1) Discuss various flying birds such as sparrows, eagles, and swans.
 2) Imitate an eagle by flapping wings broadly and swooping down quickly for prey.
 3) Express a sparrow hopping and fluttering swiftly.
 4) Mimic a swan flying smoothly and gracefully over long distances.
pe-03772:
1) Kick using the hips and thighs while keeping the ankles extended and knees relatively straight.
 2) When lifting the head, press the front of the kickboard onto the surface and practice kicking.
 3) When breathing with face in the water, keep elbows straight while lifting the head.
pe-03773:
1) When the fielding team gathers at one spot and calls out after the ball is hit, the runner is out.
 2) The batter may run clockwise or whichever direction is easiest to run.
 3) Runners advance around bases according to student-determined running directions rather than fixed baseball force rules.
pe-03774:
1) Each class lines up in a single file.
 2) Except for the last runner, all students raise both hands in front of their faces to prepare for high-fives.
 3) On the signal, the last runner runs forward high-fiving everyone while shouting cheerily.
 4) The runner stays at the front, and the process repeats until reaching the finish line about 15m ahead.
pe-03775:
1) Divide players into three teams (Red, White, Black) and create bases for each team.
 2) Red chases White, White chases Black, and Black chases Red.
 3) Tagged players are taken to the opponent's base and wait by holding hands in a line.
 4) Teammates can rescue everyone by tagging the front person in the line, and the game ends when one team is completely captured.
pe-03776:
1) Play Daruma-san (Red Light, Green Light) replacing the cue with sports or animals and freezing in that pose.
 2) Move to traditional song rhythms and step forward or sideways only on specific cue words.
 3) Work in pairs or small groups using whiteboards to invent and practice new movement rules.
 4) Modify folk dance steps such as the Jenkka by changing foot directions to create novel movement routines.
pe-03777:
1) Step straight along parallel lines, placing the right foot on the right line and the left foot on the left line.
 2) Run straight along the lines while swinging arms at a 90-degree angle.
pe-03778:
1) Set cones about 7m apart and line up 3 players on each side facing each other.
 2) On the signal, throw the ball overhand across to the partner; a successful catch counts as 1.
 3) After throwing, move to the end of the line and wait for the next turn.
 4) Count and record the total number of successful catches made by the team within 2 minutes.
pe-03779:
1) Form teams of about 3 players each and compete over 3 innings based on the total runs scored from 3 offensive chances per team.
 2) A batter throws a soft volleyball from home and runs forward high-fiving teammates standing inside hula hoops placed 5 meters apart, then circles a color cone 5 meters past the last hoop.
 3) The batter also high-fives teammates on the return run, scoring up to 4 points based on the number of touches before being called out.
 4) Fielders make an out immediately by catching the ball in the air, or by fielding a bounced ball and stepping into their designated hula hoop to call an out.
pe-03780:
1) Set the boundary (about gym size), limit time to under 2 minutes, and assign 1/5 to 1/6 of the class as taggers.
 2) Tagged players must immediately freeze or crouch on the spot.
 3) Free runners rescue frozen players by tagging them or completing assigned conditions (one hand, both hands, paired encirclement, crawling under legs, or exercise penalties).
 4) Rescued players chant a designated response ("meow", "oink", "ding") or finish their penalty to rejoin the game.
pe-03781:
1) Decide the initial zombie taggers (around 4 players for a class of 40).
 2) Zombies crawl on the floor to chase, while human players run freely to escape.
 3) When tagged by a zombie, that player immediately becomes a zombie.
 4) The game proceeds as an infection-style tag game where the number of zombies increases.
pe-03782:
1) Set up a 'Lucky Man Zone' outside the sideline during a goal-type game such as basketball.
 2) Rotate the student taking on the Lucky Man role throughout the game.
 3) Only the Lucky Man can enter this zone, and they are allowed to carry the ball by running without dribbling.
pe-03783:
1) Set up targets such as cones and drawings, then individually throw beanbags to hit them and score points.
 2) Transition from individual target practice into team-based target throwing matches.
pe-03784:
1) Each player wears a tail belt.
 2) Players run around inside the court to take opponents' tails while avoiding having their own taken.
 3) Even if your tail is taken, you are not eliminated and can continue taking others' tails.
 4) The player who collects the most tails within the time limit wins.
pe-03785:
1) Divide into Group A and Group B facing each other.
 2) Move forward using the designated movement method (e.g., skipping) when the signal starts.
 3) Meet in the middle and play Rock-Paper-Scissors.
 4) The winner takes the defeated opponent to their group, and the group that takes all opposing players wins.
pe-03786:
1) Mark the boundary using cones.
 2) Select two it-players (1 to 3 players) who hold small cones in their hands.
 3) All participants sit on the floor and move only by shuffling their buttocks forward and backward without standing up.
 4) The it-players shuffle on their hips to tag runners using their cones.
pe-03787:
1) Set up a cross-shaped court on the floor and place two taggers inside along the cross lines.
 2) Runners evade the taggers while moving clockwise around the cross.
 3) When tagged by a tagger, the runner must return to the starting point to restart.
 4) The runners win if they successfully complete two full laps.
pe-03788:
1) Set markers on the floor in 12 stages ranging from 1m to 2.2m at 10cm intervals.
 2) Students select a marker interval suited to their physique and run across them.
 3) Practice expanding stride length by bouncing off the ground.
pe-03789:
1) Stretch the torso sideways from the navel with arms extended upward.
 2) Clasp hands behind the back to open the chest, and rotate elbows and shoulder blades 10 times in each direction.
 3) Stretch front thigh by pulling an ankle on one leg, and stretch hamstrings by grasping toes in a squat and extending knees.
 4) Maintain prone and side stabilization in a straight line for 30 seconds each (or perform 10-second abdominal draw-in).
pe-03790:
1) Hold wrists and stretch sideways to warm up the torso.
 2) Open legs wide, bend knees, and push shoulders inward to increase hip flexibility.
 3) Swing arms back and forth in rhythm while stepping in place, forward, backward, and sideways.
 4) Perform butt kicks, high knee lifts, and large lunges in time with music.
pe-03791:
1) Run placing the right foot along the right line and the left foot along the left line on the floor.
 2) Pump arms bent at a right angle while keeping eyes forward and running straight ahead.
pe-03792:
1) Clasp hands behind head and round upper back then open chest for 10 reps.
 2) Lean upper body side to side for 10 reps, then twist torso left and right with hips forward for 10 reps.
 3) Squat holding ankles with chest on thighs, slowly raise hips to stretch back side of body for 5 seconds across 10 reps.
 4) Cross legs and squat with arms extended for 10 reps alternating sides, then pull elbows down from overhead reach for 10 reps.
pe-03793:
1) Interlock hands overhead with feet shoulder-width apart and tilt the torso side to side 10 times around the navel axis.
 2) Stretch chest upward with arms raised, holding chin up for 5 seconds, repeated 5 times.
 3) Bend elbows to touch shoulders and rotate them in large circles 10 times forward and 10 times backward.
 4) Keep head forward and rotate torso 10 times side to side without swaying, then balance on one leg pulling the ankle to stretch the quadriceps.
pe-03794:
1) Roll up two pieces of paper and tape the center to create two paper rockets.
 2) Perform a cross jump before attempting the toss.
 3) Hold both paper rockets gently in one hand and swing the other hand up to launch them into the air.
 4) Catch one rocket with each hand simultaneously to score one point, continuing for one minute.
pe-03795:
1) Start with feet and hands together, holding a soft teddy bear (or pillow) in one hand by your side.
 2) Perform a jumping jack and transfer the bear to the other hand overhead halfway through.
 3) Return hands and feet together to complete one repetition.
 4) Continue performing repetitions for a full one-minute challenge to get the highest score.
pe-03796:
1) Crumple and wrap three pieces of paper to create a paper volleyball.
 2) Perform one scissor jump with feet apart.
 3) Toss the paper ball upward with an underhand throw.
 4) Form a bumping stance with hands clasped, hit the ball with your forearms, and catch it to score one point, continuing for one minute.
pe-03797:
1) Stand with feet together, step right foot out and together twice, then left foot out and together twice.
 2) Step right foot back and together twice, then left foot back and together twice.
 3) Touch right knee to left elbow twice, switch to left knee and right elbow twice, then switch once each.
 4) Clap once, make a quarter turn to the right, and repeat the entire sequence.
pe-03798:
1) Listen to the emotion called out by the teacher, such as happy, shy, mad, tired, or excited.
 2) Move your whole body creatively and expressively according to each specific feeling.
pe-03799:
1) Students stand in their personal floor spots.
 2) Check the target word (such as their last name) given by the teacher.
 3) Walk to the wall poster to check the exercise assigned to each letter.
 4) Return to their spot, perform the exercise, and repeat for the next letter.
pe-03800:
1) Place a cup on the floor, hold a crumbled paper ball in one hand, and extend your arm forward at shoulder height.
 2) Drop the paper ball into the cup to score 3 points, score 1 point if it hits the cup and bounces out, and 0 points if it misses completely.
 3) After each attempt, gallop around the cup once before taking the next turn.
 4) Repeat for 1 minute to collect as many points as possible.
pe-03801:
1) Place pieces of paper at distances of 4, 5, 6, and 7 feet from the starting line.
 2) Step over the starting line and flip a water bottle to land upright on the paper.
 3) Return to the starting line and perform one jumping jack.
 4) Throw a paper ring like a frisbee to land around the bottle and repeat across all four spots within 1 minute.
pe-03802:
1) Place two paper plates on the floor at the starting line, stand on them, place a sock ball on your head, and hold arms out for balance.
 2) Slide the paper plates across to the opposite line without dropping the sock ball.
 3) Upon reaching the line, place the sock ball on your back and assume a high plank position.
 4) Using only your arms, slide your feet forward back across the line to earn 1 point.
pe-03803:
1) Set a sock ball and a paper target 10 feet apart, placing a 1/3-filled water bottle in the middle.
 2) Hop 6 times on one foot to the sock ball, turn, and hop 6 times on the other foot back.
 3) Attempt the bottle flip 3 times, scoring 1 point for each upright landing.
 4) Repeat the sequence for 1 minute to achieve your highest score.
pe-03804:
1) Hold the sneaker upside down by the back and toss it underhand straight up into the air.
 2) Score 1 point if it lands upright with the laces on top; score 0 points if it lands on its side or upside down.
 3) Perform a ski jump over and back across the sneaker after each turn, then flip again.
 4) Accumulate as many points as possible within the 1-minute time limit.
pe-03805:
1) Place a basket on a chair and set four items in a line at 6, 8, 10, and 12 feet.
 2) Jump over the first item, turn, and shoot a ball into the basket within 1 minute.
 3) If made, jump over subsequent items up to that level and shoot again.
 4) If you miss, start over from the first item and attempt to make 4 shots in a row.
pe-03806:
1) Place a basket on a chair and set a rolled-up towel 6 to 8 feet away on the floor.
 2) Stand behind the towel and take a basketball shot into the basket to score 1 point.
 3) Retrieve the sock ball and place it on the floor next to the chair leg closest to the towel.
 4) Perform an inside-foot soccer pass to hit the towel for 1 point, repeating for 1 minute to collect points.
pe-03807:
1) Place a piece of paper on the floor with a water bottle on it, do one jumping jack, and attempt to flip the bottle onto the paper.
 2) If the bottle lands upright on the paper, remove it and fold the paper in half once.
 3) Do another jumping jack and flip the bottle onto the folded paper; if successful, fold the paper in half one last time.
 4) Each time you land it upright, unfold the paper step by step, and the challenge is completed when you land it on the fully unfolded paper.
pe-03808:
1) Watch the two humorous video options displayed on screen.
 2) Take 10 seconds each round to choose which option you find funnier.
 3) Check the exercise paired with your chosen option when the slide transitions.
 4) Perform the assigned exercise continuously for 30 seconds across all 8 rounds.
pe-03809:
1) Start behind the line, squat down, and walk hands out into a high plank position.
 2) Reach for one coin from the plate ahead, walk hands back, stand up, and drop it into the chair plate for 1 point.
 3) To challenge, perform one push-up touching your chest to the sock ball to retrieve 3 coins for 3 points.
 4) Repeat within the time limit and sum up your total score based on retrieved coins.
pe-03810:
1) Crumple one sheet of paper into a ball and hold another flat sheet with both hands.
 2) Place the paper ball in the center of the flat paper and perform a squat.
 3) Swing arms up while rising to launch the paper ball overhead, and catch it on the flat paper to score 1 point.
 4) Repeat the squat and catch routine for 1 minute to collect as many points as possible.
pe-03811:
1) Roll up a piece of paper, tape the middle with a strip of tape to form a tube, and prepare a sock.
 2) Jump side to side with feet together for one ski jump.
 3) Hold the bottom of the rolled paper in one hand and toss the sock in the air underhand with the other hand.
 4) Move the paper to catch the falling sock on top to score one point, continuing for one minute.
pe-03812:
1) Draw a calculator layout with numbers 0 to 9, operation symbols, and an ON button on the ground using chalk.
 2) Jump with both feet onto the ON button to start.
 3) Jump sequentially onto the numbers, operation symbols, and equals sign according to the math problem.
 4) Jump onto the correct answer numbers to solve the problem.
pe-03813:
1) Stand feet shoulder-width apart, reach arms up for Mountain Pose, and breathe deeply 3 times through the nose.
 2) Slowly bend forward toward feet for Standing Forward Bend and breathe 3 times.
 3) Bend at the waist with hands on shins keeping back flat for Half-Lift Pose and breathe 3 times.
 4) Finish with fists clenched for the Take Five cool-down breathing.
pe-03814:
1) Each round, pick your favorite spring picture from the choices.
 2) Perform the designated exercise displayed above that picture for 30 seconds.
 3) After the exercise is over, points hidden behind the items are revealed.
 4) Collect and add points together after each round to earn bronze (8-14 pts), silver (15-20 pts), or gold (21-24 pts).
pe-03815:
1) Wiggle your whole body loosely for "runny eggs"
 2) Quickly shake arms and legs for "scrambled eggs" and sizzle in place for "fried eggs"
 3) Sit on the floor with legs extended forward for "egg omelette" and push up into a tabletop pose smiling for "sunny-side up"
 4) Flip over for "over easy" and freeze into a tight ball for "hard-boiled egg", changing poses to the music and callouts
pe-03816:
1) Place a shirt on the floor, set the first book 3 feet away, and place two more books spaced 2 feet apart.
 2) Start behind the furthest book and perform an underhand throw aiming for the shirt.
 3) If the coin lands on the shirt, earn 1 point, retrieve it, and hopscotch back across the books.
 4) Repeat the throwing and hopscotch sequence to collect as many points as possible within 1 minute.
pe-03817:
1) Start by doing one cross jump.
 2) Toss a paper ball up and hit it with the side of the cup.
 3) Catch the ball inside the cup as it comes down.
 4) Repeat the sequence for 1 minute to collect points.
pe-03818:
1) Sit at the front of the chair with knees bent, interlock fingers with palms facing out, raise arms overhead, and hold for 30 seconds while breathing.
 2) Extend arms to a T-shape, inhale through the nose while touching shoulders, and exhale through the mouth while extending back to a T.
 3) Shrug shoulders up to ears while inhaling and release down while exhaling for 30 seconds.
 4) Stand behind the chair, hold the back with one hand, grab the ankle with the other, and hold a quadricep stretch for 30 seconds.
pe-03819:
1) Watch two funny video clips on screen and take 10 seconds to choose the funnier one.
 2) When the slide changes, see the specific exercise matched to your chosen option.
 3) Perform the assigned exercise movement along with the demonstration for 30 seconds.
 4) Repeat the process through eight consecutive rounds of fitness activities.
pe-03820:
1) Place a sneaker on the floor facing away from you.
 2) Kneel down and squeeze your knees together to lift the sneaker off the floor.
 3) Use your elbows to take the sneaker from your knees.
 4) Flick your elbows upward to release the sneaker, catch it, and raise it above your head to earn 1 point within a 1-minute challenge.
pe-03821:
1) Set up 4 plastic cups 6 to 8 feet away from the starting line, spaced 1 to 1.5 feet apart.
 2) From the starting line, shoot a sock ball with a hockey stick (or broomstick) toward the cups.
 3) If a cup is hit, run to pick it up, stack it on another cup, and dribble the sock ball back to the starting line.
 4) Continue shooting and dribbling within the 1-minute time limit until the final cup is stacked.
pe-03822:
1) Place one sock ball on the floor as a target, step one foot-length away with heel touching target, then turn around.
 2) Use an underhand throw with a tick-tock motion to hit the target sock ball.
 3) If you hit it, retrieve the ball and step back heel-to-toe 2 steps, 3 steps, 4 steps, increasing distance by one step each time.
 4) If you miss, do not go back to the beginning but try that same distance again, challenging your best score in 1 minute or without a timer.
pe-03823:
1) Place a plastic cup or toilet paper roll under the chest to mark proper push-up depth.
 2) Get into push-up position with a straight back, aiming to bend elbows to 90 degrees.
 3) Follow the recorded alphabet from A to Z, holding at the bottom on 'A', coming up on 'B', and continuing down and up through 'Z'.
 4) Modify by dropping knees to the floor or holding a plank and tapping opposite shoulders if needed.
pe-03824:
1) Set up three stackable cups 2 feet apart from each other, 10 feet away from the starting line.
 2) Roll a sock ball underhand from behind the starting line to knock down one cup.
 3) Retrieve the hit cup, stack it on top of another cup, return to the line, and roll again.
 4) After hitting all three cups, build a three-cup castle (two on bottom, one on top), step back, and knock it down within a one-minute limit.
pe-03825:
1) From the starting line, take a shot with a sock ball using a hockey stick or broomstick through the goal.
 2) After scoring, retrieve and dribble the ball back to the starting line and put the stick down.
 3) Go to the goal post and flip the water bottle until it lands upright on the paper target.
 4) Once it lands upright, pick up the stick again to take another shot, counting how many goals you can score in one minute.
pe-03826:
1) All students start as a "fly" by crouching low and flapping their elbows to search for another fly.
 2) When meeting a student of the same level, play Rock-Paper-Scissors.
 3) Winning advances the student along the food chain from fly to frog (hopping), snake (slithering hands), and hawk (flying arms), while losing drops them down one level.
 4) If a player wins a match as a hawk, they earn one point, return to a fly, and continue playing.
pe-03827:
1) Roll up a piece of paper and tape the center to create a paper rocket.
 2) Perform one straddle jump (jump opening and closing feet).
 3) Make a fist (rock) with one hand and balance the paper rocket on top of it (paper).
 4) Swing the arm up to launch the paper rocket into the air and catch it with finger scissors on the way down to score a point.
pe-03828:
1) Place three books in a line at distances of 2 feet, 4 feet, and 6 feet from the starting line.
 2) From behind the line, step with the opposite foot and use an underhand throw to land a coin on top of the first book.
 3) Once the coin lands, perform a hopscotch routine to all three books and pick up the coin on the way back while balancing on one foot.
 4) Repeat the process for all three books and complete the entire challenge in under one minute.
pe-03829:
1) Roll up a piece of paper and tape the middle to make a paper rocket.
 2) Jump forward and back with feet together.
 3) Step forward with the foot on the same side holding the rocket and slap the edge to send it spinning into the air.
 4) Catch the spinning rocket with one hand to score one point, collecting as many points as possible in one minute.
pe-03830:
1) Choose one of the two Halloween-themed options shown on screen.
 2) Perform the exercise assigned to your choice, such as push-ups or hype dance.
 3) Rest and recover when the round ends before the next choice.
pe-03831:
1) Students divide into 5 stations: fitness tubes on squares, cup stacking, RPS Olympics, movement skills around cones, and rock wall climbing.
 2) In the movement skills station, travel along the line of cones with the correct motor skill.
 3) Rotate stations according to the Tabata music interval timers and teacher instructions.
pe-03832:
1) Choose one of two exercises shown on screen.
 2) Follow and perform the chosen exercise for 30 seconds along with the music.
 3) Rest for 5 seconds when the timer ends and prepare for the next move.
pe-03833:
1) Players are divided into Jedis and Stormtroopers with lightsabers, and must skip, gallop, or speed walk without running.
 2) If a Jedi is tagged by a lightsaber, they must freeze and do jumping jacks or high knees until they receive a medicine pack from a space doctor.
 3) Upon receiving a medicine pack, the Jedi goes to the fitness zone to do 5 push-ups, then delivers a medicine pack to help another frozen Jedi.
 4) If a Stormtrooper is tagged by Master Yoda's gravity force ball, they put away their lightsaber, do 10 mountain climbers, and become a Jedi, while the last remaining Stormtrooper becomes Darth Vader with two lightsabers.
pe-03834:
1) Line up at the start on the word start.
 2) Complete a single lap in a straight line each time you hear the signal, with running speed getting faster each minute.
 3) Perform push ups to the cadence of down and up.
 4) Perform curl ups to the cadence of up and down.
pe-03835:
1) Perform neck stretch for 15 seconds followed by a 5-second rest following the countdown.
 2) Perform arm circles and kneeling hip flexor stretch with 15 seconds of work and 5 seconds of rest.
 3) Follow with quadriceps, calf, and lower back stretches.
 4) Finish by relaxing muscles with ankle on the knee and side stretches.
pe-03836:
1) Toss the left flag up, tap your right shoulder, catch the flag, and alternate with the right hand.
 2) Toss a flag, tap the opposite knee, catch it with the throwing hand, and alternate sides.
 3) Toss a flag, reach behind your back to tap the opposite heel, and catch the flag.
 4) Progress to touching elbow to knee, or toss flags consecutively, clap hands, and catch both flags.
pe-03837:
1) Double punch when you see a pumpkin.
 2) Jump kick when you see a ghost.
 3) Squat when you see a bat, and jump when you see a cat.
 4) Freeze and hold your balance for a scarecrow, and dodge when cobwebs or spiders appear.
pe-03838:
1) Perform body twists, quad pulls, and hip flossing in place.
 2) Complete push-ups, curl-ups, dips, and squats focusing on form.
 3) Follow along with music to perform full-body warm-up exercises.
 4) Sit down to recover with deep breathing and finish with light yoga.
pe-03839:
1) Divide the class into two halves: one in the center and one on the outside.
 2) When the screen turns green, students in the center perform the displayed exercises in place, while students on the outside jog around them.
 3) When the screen turns red or indicates rest, outside students walk to catch their breath.
 4) Repeat the intervals of jogging and walking for the duration of the activity.
pe-03840:
1) Check the surrounding area to ensure there is nothing to bump into.
 2) Balance on one foot while keeping both hands and the other foot in the air.
 3) Keep your chin tucked to your neck and squat all the way down until your bottom touches the ground before pushing back up.
 4) Switch legs after every successful attempt for an added challenge.
pe-03841:
1) Look at the wildlife picture shown on screen.
 2) Identify the animal by performing the matching physical exercise.
 3) Follow along with the dance party movements at the end.
pe-03842:
1) Divide into a bug team and an exterminator team; players cannot run and must only skip, gallop, or speed walk.
 2) Bugs tagged by a bug sprayer must stop immediately and perform jumping jacks or high knees in place.
 3) Once tagged bugs receive medicine from a bug doctor and assist another tagged bug, they may return to play.
 4) Bugs tagged by a bug zapper must two-foot hop to the fitness area and complete 10 lunge jumps before returning.
pe-03843:
1) Follow the Tabata interval rhythm of 20 seconds of work and 10 seconds of rest.
 2) Perform exercises including trail running in place, push-ups, jump tucks, and mountain bikers.
 3) Move into stone steps lunges and hold a cliffside elbow plank.
 4) Complete the session with mogul skiers jump twists.
pe-03844:
1) Box Jumps: Keep your feet together and jump over the left and right side of your box.
 2) Mountain Skiers: Split your feet over the front and back of the box.
 3) Jumping Jacks: Perform jumping jacks at the square marker.
 4) Speed Ladder & Ickey Shuffle: Quickly tap your feet in and out or to the left and right side of the box.
pe-03845:
1) Place the ball on the floor and hop laterally back and forth over it with feet together.
 2) Alternate hopping over the ball balancing between the right and left leg.
 3) Stand behind the ball and quickly alternate trapping it with the left and right foot.
 4) Squeeze the ball between both feet, jump into the air, and catch it with hands.
pe-03846:
1) Perform the Calf Stretch for the designated time and switch sides half way.
 2) Lie down to perform the Single Leg Hamstring stretch, alternating legs.
 3) Stand up and do the Arm and Shoulder Stretch on both sides.
 4) Continue sequentially through Ankle on the Knee, Hurdlers Stretch, Arm Circles, Seated Hamstring, Side Stretch, and Overhead Arm Pull.
pe-03847:
1) Line up at the agility cone station with cones arranged in a straight line.
 2) Wait for the person in front of you to complete three cones before beginning.
 3) Move through the cones practicing chosen footwork skills such as jump tucks, jump splits, zigzag, shuffle, W drill, walking lunges, squat jumps, high steps, skate and leap, or foot fire.
 4) After finishing the skills, slowly jog back to the end of the line.
pe-03848:
1) Stand and get ready in your personal square fitness area.
 2) When the music gets louder and the screen turns green, work hard and copy the exercise movements.
 3) When the music gets quiet and the screen turns red, rest, catch your breath, and stretch tight muscles.
pe-03849:
1) Place a hula hoop on the floor, keep your feet together, and quickly hop over each side of the hoop.
 2) Quickly step over each side of the hula hoop in order: front, left, right, and back.
 3) Perform jump lunges at the front and back of the hoop, and jumping jacks on the left and right.
 4) Start outside the hoop, then step into the middle, to the right, back to the middle, and then to the left.
pe-03850:
1) Line up at the green sign (or green cone) to begin the activity.
 2) When at the green sign, jog steadily for about 100 yards toward the next marker.
 3) Upon reaching the red sign (or red cone/reflector), slow down to walk and take a quick break.
 4) Resume jogging once arriving at the next green sign and continue around the loop.
pe-03851:
1) Get comfortable and relax your mind and body.
 2) Breathe in slowly through your nose for three seconds.
 3) Hold your breath for three seconds.
 4) Exhale slowly through your mouth for three seconds.
pe-03852:
1) Sit in your personal fitness area, hold the ball with both hands, and keep your feet balanced in the air.
 2) Twist your torso quickly side to side to perform side taps on the floor.
 3) Circle the ball around your waist, head, and legs, and pedal your feet like a bicycle to pass the ball in a figure-eight.
 4) Perform around-the-world sequences or transfer the ball between hands and feet while executing crunches.
pe-03853:
1) Follow the cadence audio to perform push-ups on the 'down, up' command.
 2) After completing the set repetitions, switch immediately to the curl-up section.
 3) Perform curl-ups following the 'up, down' rhythmic audio commands.
 4) Alternate between push-ups and curl-ups across progressive repetition stages.
pe-03854:
1) A prompt starting with "Never have I ever..." appears on the screen with a specific experience.
 2) Two different exercises are assigned: one for students who have never done it and one for those who have.
 3) Students perform their corresponding exercise (e.g., heel kicks, sit-ups, squats, burpees, punches) for the timed interval.
 4) Take a brief recovery rest between rounds and repeat with the next prompt.
pe-03855:
1) Line up and wait in front of the agility cones.
 2) Wait until the person in front of you completes three cones before starting.
 3) Perform designated movement skills such as jump tucks, zigzags, or shuffles through the cones.
 4) Jog slowly back to the end of the line after finishing the course.
pe-03856:
1) Punch when a pumpkin appears on screen
 2) Jump when a cat appears
 3) Duck down when a bat flies by
 4) Kick when a ghost appears and dodge sideways when a cobweb appears
pe-03857:
1) Each student receives one pin, one noodle, and one bean bag.
 2) Balance the bean bag on top of the pin like a Santa hat.
 3) Only poke or tag at others' pins and bean bags with the noodle, never touching their bodies.
 4) If you touch the bean bag or it falls, you are out and must return safely to your area.
pe-03858:
1) When the screen turns green and music gets louder, all players travel around the gym copying the required movement skill.
 2) Tagged players must immediately go to the fitness zone and perform the exercises shown on screen in place.
 3) When the music stops and the screen turns red, all players take a rest.
 4) During the rest interval, players safely return to the playing area and taggers hand off their roles to new players.
pe-03859:
1) Set up 4 lanes of agility cones in the gymnasium.
 2) Wait until the student ahead completes three cones before starting.
 3) Move through the lane practicing self-selected footwork and agility movement skills.
 4) After finishing the last cone, walk around the outside of the cones to recover while returning to the line.
pe-03860:
1) Follow along with the music and mirror the character's dance moves.
 2) When the 'Freeze' prompt appears, immediately stop moving.
 3) Hold the demonstrated yoga or stretch pose for 10 seconds.
 4) Resume dancing when the dance party music starts again.
pe-03861:
1) Divide the group into two teams and line up behind the starting line.
 2) On go, the first runner grabs a wet sponge from the kiddie pool and runs to the team bucket.
 3) Squeeze every drop of water into the bucket, sprint back, and high-five the next player.
 4) Continue the relay until one bucket overflows, and the first team to overflow wins.
pe-03862:
1) Place mats in four corners for four-player teams and mark a center circle with cones as the fishbowl.
 2) On the signal, runners carrying a pool noodle chase the player in front of them to tag them before completing a lap.
 3) Tagged runners go to the fishbowl, but can use an immunity card or a revive card to bring back an eliminated player.
 4) Under the Iron Man rule, if a team has only one player left and completes 5 laps without being tagged, they revive a teammate.
pe-03863:
1) Pair up with another student in the gym as quickly as possible.
 2) Say your names to each other and perform a fist bump.
 3) Play rock-paper-scissors in a best two out of three format.
 4) The winner raises their hand to find a new opponent, while the runner-up becomes their dedicated cheerleader following behind them.
pe-03864:
1) Find a partner in the gym as quickly as possible.
 2) Introduce yourselves by saying names and do a fist bump.
 3) Play rock paper scissors best two out of three.
 4) The winner raises a hand to find the next opponent, while the non-winner becomes a cheerleader cheering loudly for the winner.
pe-03865:
1) The teacher turns a long jump rope fixed to a volleyball pole with steady swings over the center X jump zone.
 2) In Twisting, students time the rope, run underneath, and circle back to the end of the line.
 3) In Graduation, students start on the X mark and jump through each grade level sequence.
 4) Students who maintain control and complete the levels graduate to independent single rope practice.
pe-03866:
1) Place four mats on one end of the gym to designate team stations, then place six matching colored hula hoops and cones in front of each team.
 2) On the signal, a runner dashes forward to flip and stand up cones, and may continue advancing down the court as long as flips are successful.
 3) Players are allowed up to three flip attempts on the first section and up to five on the second section.
 4) The first team to light up all six cones and have all members sit down on their mat wins the game.
pe-03867:
1) Step on the middle of the rope and pull handles to armpit height to adjust rope length.
 2) Practice 10 rainbow turns without stepping or jumping.
 3) Practice rainbow turns by stepping forward one foot at a time over the rope.
 4) Perform rainbow turns jumping forward softly over the rope and continue free jumping.
pe-03868:
1) Place 8 hula hoops on the court with a tag stick and a ball (brain) in each, and assign 8 defenders.
 2) The rest of the class acts as zombies and slowly walks toward the defense force.
