 3) Zombies attempt to steal the balls from the hoops without being touched by the tag sticks.
 4) If tagged, a zombie must try another hoop; if they steal a ball, they switch roles with that defender.
pe-03869:
1) Place 8 gym mats around each three-point arc to mark defensive zones and set up two portable goals at each end.
 2) Divide the class into two teams of six, playing 5-on-5 on the court with one substitute rotating in.
 3) The ball must be passed at least once between players before shooting, not counting a pass from the goalie.
 4) Offensive players must pass or shoot within a slow 3 seconds and may jump before the 3-point line to shoot in the air.
pe-03870:
1) Students are placed into teams representing 5 countries along the cone track course.
 2) All four team members push the scooter bobsled at the start.
 3) Two team members become riders at half court.
 4) Penalties are handed out for course violations, and all four team members must cross the finish line on the bobsled.
pe-03871:
1) Place four gym mats on one side and set up six colored hula hoops with matching cones along the court.
 2) On start, the first player runs out to flip cones upright, attempting up to 3 times on the first half and 5 times on the second half.
 3) If successful, the runner may continue down the court; otherwise players take turns.
 4) The first team to light up all six cones and have all members sit down on their mat wins.
pe-03872:
1) Build a tower by squaring up a mat, placing another mat on top, adding a hula hoop, upside-down scooter, and beach ball.
 2) Defenders guard the tower using pool-noodle lightsabers.
 3) Attackers throw balls to knock down the Death Star beach ball from the tower in the target zone.
 4) Once achieved, move to attack another team's tower.
pe-03873:
1) Cowboy and cowgirl taggers ride oversized scooters and tag other students.
 2) Tagged students go directly to the horse stable in the center of the court.
 3) The sheriff drags the horses by hula hoop to the courthouse in the corner for processing and returns them to play.
pe-03874:
1) Divide the gym in half with mats, setting up cone flip on one side and spin the pin on the other.
 2) In the cone flip area, students battle 1-on-1 to flip their cone upright twice to win and move to spin the pin.
 3) In the spin the pin area, one spins a bowling pin to determine the tagger, who gets a slow 5-second count to tag someone.
 4) If tagged, that runner moves to cone flip; if the tagger misses within 5 seconds, the tagger moves to cone flip.
pe-03875:
1) Divide the court into squares 1, 2, 3, and Big Bear, with the Big Bear serving from one foot behind the service line.
 2) The ball must bounce once and only once in a square, struck underhanded or without slammers.
 3) When a player makes an error, they are eliminated and remaining players rotate up toward Big Bear.
 4) Disputes are resolved by Big Bear's call or rock-paper-scissors.
pe-03876:
1) One student is chosen to be Cupid equipped with a pool noodle arrow tag stick.
 2) Cupid tags other players around the gym using the foam arrow stick.
 3) Tagged players head to a designated gym corner to draw a Valentine's fitness exercise card from the instructor.
 4) Players perform the designated exercise, return the card to a drop bucket, and re-enter the game.
pe-03877:
1) Team B selects their mouse, and Team A selects the cat to chase the mouse.
 2) On the go signal, the cat chases the mouse through standing gym mat walls and has 20 seconds to make a tag.
 3) If the cat tags the mouse within 20 seconds, their team scores a point.
 4) The player who ran as the cat becomes the new mouse for the next round, and the opposing team chooses a new cat.
pe-03878:
1) Set up a zone for each team in the gym and place hula hoops for jails.
 2) Steal cones from other teams' zones and return to your own zone without being tagged.
 3) If tagged, report to that team's jail.
 4) A tag from a teammate frees you from jail, and both players raise their hands for a free pass back to their zone.
pe-03879:
1) Build a Death Star structure by standing a mat upright in a square, placing a mat on top, followed by a hula hoop, an inverted scooter, and a beach ball.
 2) Place cones around the Death Star perimeter to prevent tall defenders from standing directly next to it to block throws.
 3) Students throw dodgeballs aiming exclusively to hit and knock down the beach ball target on top.
pe-03880:
1) Set up mats or cones at the four corners of the gym and divide students into two teams.
 2) The first runner holding a foam tag stick runs one lap around the gym.
 3) The runner hands off the stick to the next teammate and moves to the end of the line.
 4) Chase the opposing runner and tag them with the foam stick to score one point.
pe-03881:
1) Stand feet shoulder-width apart and reach down for toe touches.
 2) Lift one leg to the side and switch sides for leg lifts.
 3) Run in place driving knees up toward the chest for high knees.
 4) Perform jumping jacks, followed by jack squats combining arm movements with squats.
pe-03882:
1) Assign one student as a bear, two as wolves, and the rest as pronghorn deer, with wolves staying together inside two hula hoops, the bear in the center, and wolves in the corner.
 2) The bear walks slowly until 'hungry bear' or 'angry bear' is called to sprint for 5 seconds, while wolves stay together in their hoops and run anytime.
 3) Deer tagged by the bear go to the harder exercise mat, and those tagged by wolves go to the easier exercise mat.
 4) When 'angry bear' is called, the bear can tag the wolves which must sit out if caught, and students must react within 5 seconds when a natural disaster is called.
pe-03883:
1) Place the horse stable in the center of the court and the courthouse in the corner, with two taggers riding oversized scooters.
 2) Cowboy taggers ride around on scooters to tag regular scooter riders.
 3) Once tagged, a wrangler slides a hula hoop over the rider's shoulders like a lasso and gently tows the scooter to the stable.
 4) The sheriff escorts the horse to the courthouse for processing before sending them back into the game.
pe-03884:
1) Set up 6 character stations around the gym perimeter and place labeled gift bags in the center.
 2) Teams take turns; on the start signal, students sprint to the center.
 3) Carry only one present at a time and deliver it to the designated character mat before returning.
 4) When all presents are delivered, the whole team races back to the center circle to stop the clock.
pe-03885:
1) One player lies on their stomach in the middle of the floor like a spider.
 2) All other students gather quietly close to the spider.
 3) On the signal that the spider is awake, students scatter as the spider crawls to tag them.
 4) Anyone tagged flips onto their belly to become a spider until only one runner remains.
pe-03886:
1) Students (deer) at one end line shout "What time is it Grizzly Bear?" toward the bear at the opposite end.
 2) The bear answers with a time between 3 and 11, and deer take that many steps forward.
 3) If deer reach the end line, they turn around and walk back.
 4) When the bear yells lunchtime or midnight, the bear chases the deer; tagged players become bears and the last deer wins.
pe-03887:
1) Divide the class into three even teams; two compete while one waits.
 2) Players move the football down the court only by throwing and catching, without running with the ball.
 3) Score points by throwing the football through the basketball hoop.
 4) Close shots near the hoop are worth one point, and shots from farther court zones earn more points.
pe-03888:
1) When the last student arrives, call out a first letter of a name to assign taggers for 3 minutes.
 2) Students must identify who the taggers are and run away to avoid being tagged.
 3) Tagged students must freeze and dance in place.
 4) Another student can unfreeze them and return them to the game by performing the exact same dance.
pe-03889:
1) Place mats in opposite corners and line up 17 hula hoops between them (8 on each side and 1 in the middle).
 2) On go, students from each team hop through hoops toward each other and do a rock-paper-scissors battle when one hoop apart.
 3) The winner continues hopping forward, while the loser steps out and goes to the end of their line.
 4) The next teammate must immediately start hopping when their runner loses, and reaching the opposing team's mat scores 1 point.
pe-03890:
1) Set up three gym mats upright on each end of the gym as goals and line up three crazy balls in the middle.
 2) Divide into two teams, pick three goalies per team to protect goals, and send others to the floor.
 3) Play with all three balls at the same time and score by kicking a ball into an opponent's goal mat.
 4) When you score, yell "Score!" and run back to touch your own wall before touching another ball.
pe-03891:
1) On the teacher's command, lie flat on your back in the beach position to reset.
 2) Take slow breaths in through the nose and out through the mouth to calm down.
 3) When called upon, stand up quietly.
 4) The designated student taps the raised thumb of a classmate with their head down, plays one round of rock-paper-scissors; the winner lines up, and the other student picks the next person.
pe-03892:
1) Set up a neutral zone at half court with cones or mats and tape a tic-tac-toe board on the floor, then divide the class into Team X and Team O.
 2) Toss a bean bag marked with X and O in the air; the team whose letter lands face up chases and tags the other team back to their zone.
 3) Tagged players switch to the opposing team for the next toss, and a player from the tagging team places a bean bag on the game board.
 4) Making a tic-tac-toe scores one point, and the first team to three points wins.
pe-03893:
1) Flip the cone inside the hula hoop or within one arm's length.
 2) Shake hands or fist bump after a successful flip.
 3) The student who doesn't win the flip jogs one full lap.
 4) Find someone raising their hand to play again.
pe-03894:
1) Set up two hockey nets facing opposite ways in the middle and place mats around the perimeter as beach blankets.
 2) Select one lifeguard per team in the center area while teammates remain behind the mats.
 3) When music plays, students throw smaller balls at the beach balls to knock them into the opposing goal.
 4) Lifeguards retrieve smaller balls by kicking or throwing them back to teammates without touching the beach balls.
pe-03895:
1) Form a circle at center court using 5 standing mats with one entrance and place 6 cones inside.
 2) A tagger uses a foam tag stick to chase and tag students.
 3) Tagged students report inside the fishbowl and get up to 5 flips to land a cone upright.
 4) Students rejoin after landing a cone, or after completing 5 jumping jacks if unsuccessful.
pe-03896:
1) Set up 15 to 30 hula hoops in a track around half court as board game spaces, and place mats and colored cones for four teams.
 2) Players shoot basketballs in turn from designated shooting spots (1 under hoop, 2 at free throw line, 3 at three-point line).
 3) When a player makes a basket, they move their team cone along the hoop track according to the movement card inside (1 to 3 forward or backward).
 4) Teams take turns shooting and advancing their markers around the board game track to finish the course first.
pe-03897:
1) Set up 3 to 4 belt stations along each wall using 4 cones per station to form a jump zone, and select 6 student judges.
 2) On the go signal, students may visit any of the first 6 belt stations in any order to attempt the jump rope requirements.
 3) Upon successful completion, the judge stamps the student's scorecard, and the jumper signs their name on the wall poster.
 4) The final three boss levels (red, brown, black) must be completed in order, judged by teachers only, with a maximum of three attempts per day.
pe-03898:
1) Connect three scooters and place a mat on top to build a cart, and set a track with six stations using cones.
 2) Three to four riders board the cart while one or two drivers push it around the track when music plays.
 3) When music stops, drivers park at the next station where riders unload and act out Halloween characters.
 4) When music resumes, riders and pushers rotate roles and continue along the track.
pe-03899:
1) Students sit on their own scooter around the center gym circle, with one designated spider in the center.
 2) The spider begins by spinning slowly in the middle or lying on their scooter pretending to sleep.
 3) On the signal "Spider's awake!" or a countdown, the spider chases students around the gym trying to tag them.
 4) When tagged, players flip onto their stomachs to become spider taggers as well, playing until one last person remains to be the next spider.
pe-03900:
1) Students line both sidelines of the gym and throw Gator Skin balls across to each other.
 2) Three defenders in the middle run with noodle broomsticks to intercept balls and drop them into baskets.
 3) To retrieve lost balls, students run to a mat, complete five sit-ups or jumping jacks, and take one ball back.
 4) Rotate new defenders into the center every two minutes.
pe-03901:
1) Set up 5 mats (corners and center) with 5 hula hoops and cones laid down along each path, dividing students into 4 teams.
 2) One player runs out to flip a cone upright within 5 attempts; if successful, move to the next, if unsuccessful, return to the mat to tag the next player.
 3) Reaching the end, players can challenge an opposing team to rock-paper-scissors before picking up their scoring cup.
 4) Winning the rock-paper-scissors challenge knocks down the opponent's previous cone forcing them back, and upon scoring, the player must knock down their own cones before returning.
pe-03902:
1) Set up parachutes over the volleyball net across the gym so teams cannot see each other.
 2) Each team uses 9 hula hoops to build 3 ships (4-hoop, 3-hoop, 2-hoop) and places a bowling pin inside each hoop.
 3) Each team gets 5 to 6 gator balls and launches them over the wall on 'go' to knock down the opponents' pins.
 4) Play until one side sinks every ship or for about two songs, then count the standing pins.
pe-03903:
1) Students take roles of animals like bears, wolves, or deer and play within court lines.
 2) The teacher simulates a forest fire using two red pool noodles while students run away.
 3) The teacher uses blue noodles to simulate an avalanche or water flood that students must avoid.
 4) The teacher spins with a purple pool noodle to simulate a tornado, and students touched by it must spin around in place.
pe-03904:
1) Place bowling pins and tag sticks around hula hoops and have four players stand around the hoop.
 2) The new player spins the bowling pin, and the player it points to becomes the tagger.
 3) The tagger picks up the tag stick and has five slow seconds to tag another player.
 4) If the tagger tags someone, that tagged player switches sides; if they fail within 5 seconds, the tagger switches sides instead.
pe-03905:
1) Students pair up, each holding a pickleball paddle, sharing one balloon between two players.
 2) One partner strikes the balloon upward with the paddle 10 times.
 3) The other partner takes a turn and strikes the balloon upward 10 times.
 4) Partners hit the balloon back and forth to each other 10 times.
pe-03906:
1) Perform 5 squats with arms extended forward and back straight.
 2) Extend arms wide horizontally and twist shoulders side to side while keeping hips forward.
 3) Keep guard up and alternate kicks simulating movement through snow drifts.
 4) Run with high knees, bounce in place, freeze on cue, then perform slide steps and fast feet.
pe-03907:
1) Divide students into two teams, assign pairs, and have each pair stand at a poly spot marker.
 2) One partner from each pair takes a pool noodle lightsaber and enters the battlefield.
 3) Players attempt to tag opposing Jedi players strictly below the knee using their noodles.
 4) When tagged, players raise their hands, run back to their partner's spot, hand over the noodle, and switch places.
pe-03908:
1) Students lie side-by-side on the floor on their stomachs or backs to form the train tracks.
 2) A designated conductor rolls the Kin-Ball (the train) across the students' bodies.
 3) Once the ball passes over a student, that student gets up and runs to the front of the track to lie down again.
 4) The team cooperates to keep the track going until the train reaches the other side of the gym.
pe-03909:
1) Choose desired activities from various physical and special challenges on the Google Slides board.
 2) Check the instructions on the specific slide and complete each task with family using household items.
 3) Return to the main page after each activity and log the completed task.
 4) Aim for medal benchmarks based on total completed events (10 for Bronze, 15 for Silver, 20 for Gold).
pe-03910:
1) Separate the gym floor into a competition dance floor and a practice dance floor.
 2) Turn on music and students dance freely moving around using skips, gallops, or animal movements.
 3) When the music stops, all students must freeze immediately.
 4) If a student moves after the music stops, they are eliminated to the practice dance floor to keep dancing.
pe-03911:
1) Set gym mats on their sides as barricades and mark a fitness area using cones.
 2) Assign one tagger; upon the whistle, students run around the gym or hide behind the mats.
 3) Tagged students must go directly to the designated fitness area.
 4) Complete a predetermined exercise (such as jumping jacks or push-ups) to re-enter the game.
pe-03912:
1) Follow along and copy each yoga pose shown by characters on the screen.
 2) Focus on relaxing the body and taking slow deep breaths while holding the poses.
 3) Switch legs and arms to the opposite side whenever instructed by the audio cue.
pe-03913:
1) Write letters on paper, cut them out, and have a non-player hide them throughout the area.
 2) Players search to find and collect as many hidden letters as possible within a set time limit.
 3) Gather together after time is up, and use the collected letters to construct words within a new time limit.
 4) Total up points based on the number of letters in each word or the total number of words built.
pe-03914:
1) Use basketball or volleyball court lines and designate one player as the infected zombie tagger.
 2) All running students and zombie taggers must strictly travel along the lines on the court.
 3) The infected zombie chases and tags other students running along the lines.
 4) Tagged students become zombies, stretch their hands out in front, limp like zombies, and help tag remaining runners.
pe-03915:
1) Mark the designated area using cones; gazelles wear flag belts while lions do not.
 2) Lions chase gazelles inside the marked area to grab their flags.
 3) Lions can only pull one flag at a time and must immediately place it into a hula hoop.
 4) Caught gazelles turn into lions to help chase, and the round ends when all gazelles are caught or time runs out.
pe-03916:
1) Line up behind the last poly spot of 10 spots set in a line.
 2) Choose any poly spot to stand on and toss the bean bag underhand toward the target.
 3) If made, pick up the poly spot and bean bag, return to make a single pile, and hand off to the next player.
 4) If missed, leave the spot, retrieve only the bean bag, and tag the next teammate to try.
pe-03917:
1) Place a pin inside a hula hoop where one defender stands outside the hoop to protect it.
 2) Surrounding players must keep one foot on their poly spot and strike the rolling ball with an open hand toward the pin.
 3) The defender blocks incoming balls with hands or body without stepping inside the hula hoop and without kicking.
 4) The player who successfully knocks down the pin switches spots with the defender.
pe-03918:
1) Form groups of 3 to 4, give each base 4 bean bags, and designate one player wearing a blue pinnie as the guardian.
 2) Guardians must stand to defend their bean bags and can tag opposing raiders only when they touch or hold a bean bag.
 3) Raiders can take only one bean bag at a time and return it to their home base.
 4) Tagged players go to the middle to perform 5 jumping jacks before re-entering, and players rotate guardian roles periodically.
pe-03919:
1) Place bean bags inside each team's hula hoop and designate defenders wearing team jerseys while others attack without jerseys.
 2) Attackers sneak into other bases to take one bean bag at a time, while defenders in jerseys cannot take bean bags.
 3) The jersey-wearing defender can tag an attacker before the bean bag enters their own team's hoop.
 4) If tagged, the attacker returns the bean bag to the base, moves to the middle to perform five jumping jacks, and re-enters the game.
pe-03920:
1) Form groups of 3 to 5 lined up behind a cone, with a poly spot and a hula hoop set out in front.
 2) Keep one foot on the poly spot and perform an underhand toss aiming bean bags into the hula hoop.
 3) Retrieve the tossed bean bag, place it at the cone, and rotate to the end of the line.
 4) Once all team bean bags land inside the hoop, gently flip the hoop forward to advance to the next level.
pe-03921:
1) Divide students into two teams, assign numbers to players, and place stacking cups in the center.
 2) Call out a number and a target level (e.g., number 4, level 2), prompting the called students to run to the center.
 3) Students race to stack the cups into the designated pyramid pattern and immediately tear them down back into a single stack of six cups.
 4) The player who finishes building and collapsing the stack first wins the round for their team.
pe-03922:
1) All students start at cone 1 and pair up with a partner.
 2) Partners play rock-paper-scissors against each other.
 3) The winner moves on to the next numbered cone, while the loser stays at the current cone to play a new partner.
 4) A player earns 1 point after advancing through all 4 cones.
pe-03923:
1) One caller closes their eyes with their back turned next to the teacher.
 2) Students move around the gym while music is playing.
 3) When the music stops, every student must choose one colored cone corner.
 4) The caller announces a color, and students at that corner perform 5 jumping jacks before rejoining.
pe-03924:
1) Form groups of 4 to 6 with one thrower at the cone and the others across as catchers.
 2) Throwers launch the frisbee; picking it up off the ground earns 100 points, while catching it in the air earns 200 points.
 3) Throw the frisbee back to continue until a catcher reaches 300 points.
 4) The player who reaches 300 points becomes the new thrower, and all scores reset to zero.
pe-03925:
1) Designate four taggers with jerseys, while all students walk exclusively along court lines and poly spots.
 2) Neither taggers nor runners may leave the lines or cut corners, and running is strictly prohibited.
 3) Tagged players must step off the line and take a knee.
 4) Another runner can tag them back into the game by giving them a high five.
pe-03926:
1) Find a partner and have one partner line up on the number 1 side and the other on the number 2 side.
 2) When the beep sounds, number 1 runners take off and run across at the same time.
 3) Run all the way to the opposite line and give your partner a high-five to tag them in.
 4) The partner who received the high-five waits for the next beep before starting to run.
pe-03927:
1) In Level 1, everyone plays solo, tags anyone, and tagged players must take a knee.
 2) Tagged players rejoin the game as soon as the person who tagged them gets tagged out.
 3) In Level 2, players work in pairs and must tag the specific opponent who got their partner out.
 4) In Level 3, players form groups of 4, and Level 4 adds flags while repeating previous levels.
pe-03928:
1) Taggers hold an object like a bean bag to tag with, and Savers hold a power-up in hand.
 2) If a player gets tagged, they take a knee.
 3) Savers toss a power-up underhand to a downed player so they can power up and stand back up.
pe-03929:
1) Agents cross over to the safe zone and pick up one beanbag at a time to bring back.
 2) When leaving the safe zone, taggers can pull your flag belt.
 3) If your flag is taken, return the beanbag to its spot, go get your belt from the teacher, and restart.
 4) The agent team wins if they retrieve all 100 beanbags within the 5-minute time limit.
pe-03930:
1) Designate four numbered corners in the room while one caller faces the board.
 2) Students quietly move to one of the four corners within 10 seconds without stopping in the middle.
 3) Once the count ends, the caller points to a corner first before turning around to look.
 4) Players standing in the pointed corner are eliminated and sit down, with the caller getting 3 attempts.
pe-03931:
1) Zookeepers start at the hula hoop, while tigers wearing tails run inside the zoo area.
 2) Zookeepers enter the zoo and try to pull the tigers' tails, taking only one tail at a time.
 3) Once a tail is taken, the zookeeper must drop it into the hula hoop to score one point before chasing more tails.
 4) Tigers whose tails are pulled move to the end of the line, rest, and re-enter after putting on a new tail.
pe-03932:
1) Mark the designated boundary with cones and have gazelles wear flags while lions wear no flags.
 2) Lions chase gazelles within the boundary and pull their flags one at a time.
 3) Placed pulled flags into the hula hoop; tagged gazelles become lions and help chase others.
 4) The round ends when time expires or no gazelles are left.
pe-03933:
1) Place a bowling pin inside a hula hoop, and the defender defends the pin while staying outside the hoop.
 2) Surrounding players keep one foot on their poly spot behind the line and slap, roll, or throw the ball to knock down the pin.
 3) When the pin is knocked down, the thrower runs to the hoop to set the pin back up and becomes the new defender.
 4) The previous defender retrieves the ball and takes the thrower's poly spot to switch roles.
pe-03934:
1) Place poly spots on the basketball court and divide students into teams of five or fewer in lines.
 2) The first shooter moves to any chosen poly spot on the court to attempt a basket.
 3) If the shot is made, take the poly spot to the team pile and pass the ball to the next teammate.
 4) If the shot is missed, leave the spot on the floor, retrieve the ball, and go to the end of the line.
pe-03935:
1) Form groups of up to five players and build a hula hut using six hoops: a base, two walls, two doors, and a roof.
 2) Have one player sit inside while teammates build the hut around them, then gently take it down.
 3) Have the entire team crawl or crab-walk through the assembled hula hut.
 4) Lift the entire hula hut together, carry it to a cone 5 feet away, and set it down without it collapsing.
pe-03936:
1) Form groups of 3 to 4, head to a hula hoop, and race to build a castle the fastest using balls.
 2) The team that builds their castle the fastest in the build phase scores 1 point.
 3) In the rebuild phase, throw dodgeballs to knock down opposing castles, scoring 1 point per castle knocked down.
 4) Teams whose castle is knocked down cannot throw balls until they completely rebuild their castle.
pe-03937:
1) Find a partner and play rock-paper-scissors to determine who becomes the tagger (the loser).
 2) Before chasing, the tagger performs an exercise and follows movement restrictions (walking, skipping, jogging, or running) while the partner runs away for 10 seconds.
 3) The tagger is only allowed to chase and tag their own partner.
 4) Once tagged, the tagged partner must do the exercise while the tagger runs away, switching roles.
pe-03938:
1) Select four players to wear blue jerseys as ghosts while all other players become Pac-Man.
 2) All players must only walk along the white floor lines or poly spots that connect the lines, with running and jumping prohibited.
 3) When tagged by a ghost, a player must step off the white line, take a knee, and raise a hand.
 4) If any teammate gives the tagged player a high five, that player stands up, returns to the white line, and resumes walking.
pe-03939:
1) Form equal teams and give each member a hula hoop placed in a line to build a train.
 2) The caboose player at the end steps forward into the next hoop and passes the trailing hoop forward.
 3) The front conductor receives the hoop and places it down ahead so the train inches forward.
 4) The train navigates around the gym to collect their assigned color bean bags and return home.
pe-03940:
1) Set up 20 to 30 hula hoops in a rectangular grid and mark start and finish points with cones.
 2) The teacher draws an invisible secret path on a whiteboard from start to finish.
 3) Students step into the hula hoops one by one to navigate and figure out the path.
 4) If a student chooses correctly they keep moving forward; if incorrect, the teacher says 'Boom' and they go to the back of the line.
pe-03941:
1) Set up a running course starting at the number one cone and follow colored poly spots in order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple.
 2) Begin at the starting cone and follow the poly spots along the designated pathway.
 3) Pass through the purple spot and make your way back to the starting line cone.
 4) Continue pacing through the course for approximately five minutes using an on-screen timer.
pe-03942:
1) Hand out long pool noodles to five taggers and start the game.
 2) When a tagger tags someone, they set the pool noodle down on the floor in front of them.
 3) The tagged person must perform ski jumps side to side over the pool noodle with two feet close together for a set number of times.
 4) After finishing the jumps, that person picks up the noodle and becomes the new tagger chasing others.
pe-03943:
1) Teams line up on one end of the gym facing baskets of Easter eggs across from them.
 2) On the start signal, one student at a time travels to the basket by hopping on one foot or jumping with two feet.
 3) The student picks up one Easter egg containing three Scrabble tiles, runs or jogs back, places it in their team bucket, and tags the next runner.
 4) Once all eggs are collected, teams open them and use the tiles to complete challenges such as forming 2-3 letter words or writing sentences.
pe-03944:
1) Learn the definition of teamwork and cooperation, focusing on accomplishing shared goals.
 2) Discuss success strategies: calm communication, listening to all ideas, mutual encouragement, and learning from mistakes.
 3) Introduce the upcoming home cooperative obstacle game called Lava River.
pe-03945:
1) Attach six colored hula hoops to basketball goals and assign six taggers equipped with matching short pool noodles.
 2) Taggers chase and tag other students using their pool noodles.
 3) Tagged students become the new Cupid taggers, but before tagging anyone, they must throw their noodle like an arrow through the matching colored hoop from a spot marker.
 4) After attempting three throws (or successfully passing through), they retrieve the noodle and chase other runners.
pe-03946:
1) Get into a straight plank position with both hands on the ground, keeping your body flat.
 2) Slide your puck (such as a pair of socks) across the smooth floor toward the tape goal line.
 3) Score one point only if the sock touches the tape line, playing until reaching 5 points.
 4) As a partner variation, a partner holds a plank with arms spread and you score by sliding the sock between their arms.
pe-03947:
1) Scatter 20 to 30 small cones across the gym floor with half upright and half tipped over.
 2) Divide the class into two equal groups assigned as Builders and Bulldozers.
 3) Builders run to place cones upright while Bulldozers knock cones over.
 4) Switch roles every minute and apply different locomotor movements such as skipping or hopping.
pe-03948:
1) Divide the class into two teams on opposite halves of the gym, setting up 3 bowling pins and 1 green hula hoop on each side.
 2) Roll or throw balls to attack and knock down the other team's bowling pins without crossing the center line.
 3) Knocking down a pin earns one green bean bag to place in the team's hula hoop, while the knocked pin is immediately reset.
 4) At the end of the time limit, the team that collected the most bean bags wins.
pe-03949:
1) Connect four scooters with a mat on top to form a bobsled for groups of 4 to 5 students.
 2) Half of the students ride on the mat while the other students push and steer the sled.
 3) The bobsled must pass through six colored cone checkpoints in rainbow order to complete a lap.
 4) After finishing a lap, riders and pushers switch roles and continue.
pe-03950:
1) Form groups of 3 to 5 students and set up a hula hoop, bowling pin, and short pool noodle on one side, with a matching color cone on the opposite side.
 2) One student spins the bowling pin inside the hula hoop.
 3) When the pin stops, the student it points to becomes the tagger and grabs the pool noodle.
 4) The remaining students race toward the opposite cone while the tagger tries to tag them.
pe-03951:
1) Place rainbow buckets inside a large square and have each student stand on a colored spot marker around it.
 2) Each student takes two snowballs filled with foam pellets and tosses or throws them into the buckets.
 3) If they make it into a bucket, they take the bucket behind their dot to begin stacking a tower; if they miss, they retrieve the balls and try again.
 4) Each time an additional bucket is collected, turn it upside down and stack it to make the tower higher.
pe-03952:
1) Start at the corner cone and roll a dice.
 2) Keep rolling until the designated magic number (e.g.,
 6) appears.
 3) Run a full lap around the gym once the magic number is rolled.
 4) Collect a popsicle stick feather, decorate the turkey, and head back to the cone to repeat.
pe-03953:
1) Select a desired size and type of football or activity ball from the bin.
 2) Place the ball on a low-profile cone used as a kicking tee.
 3) Kick the ball through the upright goal posts to score 3 points.
 4) Perform a low squib kick hitting any part of the green wall pad to score 1 point.
pe-03954:
1) Each student holds a rock-paper-scissors die and starts at one corner of the gym.
 2) Challenge a peer to a rock-paper-scissors roll challenge.
 3) The winner runs a full loop around the perimeter of the gym to the starting and finish line.
 4) The winner grabs a popsicle stick feather, places it around a turkey body, and returns to the corner to challenge another student.
pe-03955:
1) Tie a rope between volleyball standards across the floor.
 2) Students place a scooter on the ground and choose to sit, kneel, or lie on their bellies.
 3) Pull along the rope using arm strength to glide the scooter sled across to the opposite end.
 4) Once reaching the end of the rope, pick up the scooter, carry it back, and mark the turn.
pe-03956:
1) Form pairs with one hula hoop, one small pool noodle, and three beanbags placed around the hoop rim.
 2) One student acts as the guardian defending inside the hoop with the noodle, while the other acts as the collector.
 3) Collectors run to opponent hoops to steal beanbags and return them to place around their own spaceship.
 4) Guardians must stay inside the hoop and tag intruders; tagged collectors must drop the beanbag and return empty-handed.
pe-03957:
1) Divide the class into 6 teams lined up behind colored rainbow cones.
 2) On their turn, a runner sprints across to look underneath one poly spot.
 3) If they find the hidden groundhog picture, they bring the spot back to their team to score a point.
 4) If they don't find it, they leave the spot, stop on their team-colored spot on the way back giving a thumbs down, and wait until their teammates finish jumping jacks before tagging the next runner.
pe-03958:
1) Divide into teams of 3 to 5 inside hula hoops, placing cones concealing colored bean bags in the center.
 2) On the start signal, one player per team runs to the center and checks under one cone.
 3) If it is not their team's color, cover it back up; if it matches, leave the cone tipped over and take the bean bag.
 4) Teammates take turns until a team finds all 5 matching bean bags.
pe-03959:
1) Teams receive one more poly spot than members (e.g., 3 students and 4 spots) with 6 target pins placed across the gym.
 2) Students must keep their feet strictly on the dots as they move along the path.
 3) Players cooperate to pass the rearmost poly spot forward to place it in front and advance step by step.
 4) Retrieve one snowman pin, return the same way to place it in their home hoop, and repeat until all 6 are saved.
pe-03960:
1) Divide the class into equal teams, set up each team's island with a cone and a hula hoop, and place beanbag treasures inside.
 2) When the game starts, all students run simultaneously to other teams' islands to retrieve one treasure at a time.
 3) A retrieved treasure must be placed inside their own team's island before going to steal another piece.
 4) At the end of the round, students tally their score based on point values revealed for each treasure color.
pe-03961:
1) Hang a parachute over a volleyball net to block the view, and place buckets and a goal target on the opposite side.
 2) Assign students colored balls and divide them into military branch teams to wait.
 3) When their branch is called, players step forward and use overhand throwing technique to launch the ball over the parachute into the targets.
 4) After throwing, players walk around the net to retrieve their numbered ball and return to the waiting line.
pe-03962:
1) Fold a post-it note diagonally twice and secure it with a staple or tape to create a paper football.
 2) Set up 1 or 2 players on each side of a table and take turns flicking the paper football.
 3) Try to flick the ball past the opposite line into the end zone without going off the edge within 3 flicks.
 4) If a touchdown is not scored by the third flick, attempt a field goal flick with one finger.
pe-03963:
1) Form groups of two or three and stand at a station.
 2) Take turns rolling the ball to knock over the bowling pin.
 3) If you knock down the pin, collect one small Pokemon card from the center bucket.
 4) Collecting three small cards allows you to trade them in for a mega Pokemon card.
pe-03964:
1) Pick two foam noodles of matching color from the bucket and hold them like ski poles.
 2) Jump through the rainbow hoops with both feet together while holding noodles at sides.
 3) Step onto the elevated mat and leap off onto the flat landing mat.
 4) Place a matching colored cone to mark the landing distance and try to beat the score next round.
pe-03965:
1) Split the station group into two halves standing on opposite sides of the gym.
 2) The first runner holds the football securely and runs zigzag through defender noodles.
 3) Upon reaching the opposite side, hand the ball off to the waiting student like a quarterback to a running back.
 4) The next student runs back across to keep the relay going continuously.
pe-03966:
1) Set up poly spots in a circle with one for each student, and place a bucket with an inflatable animal (Nemo) in the center.
 2) The starting student tosses the gator ball to the next student on the adjacent spot.
 3) Students continue tossing the ball around the circle from spot to spot without letting it touch the ground.
 4) If the ball travels completely around back to the starter, that student gets one throw at the target to knock it off and earn points.
pe-03967:
1) Place cones 1 through 4 around the gym and have each student roll their own die.
 2) Students move to the cone matching their rolled number, re-rolling or picking any cone if they roll a 5 or 6.
 3) Upon reaching the cone, students perform a designated warm-up exercise (such as 10 seconds of jumping jacks or arm circles).
 4) Two roulette wheels spin on screen, and students at the winning cone collect the matching dollar amount from the bank.
pe-03968:
1) Teams line up along the perimeter with targets (hula hoops and a baby pool) in the center.
 2) Students take turns throwing or rolling a ball into the center targets.
 3) Successfully landing in a hula hoop earns 1 card, while the baby pool earns 2 to 3 cards.
 4) Teams take turns in relay fashion to collect as many cards as possible.
pe-03969:
1) Squeeze a small noodle between both feet or ankles.
 2) Jump with both feet all the way down toward the bowling pin.
 3) Twist the body to smack down the bowling pin with the noodle while keeping it between the feet.
 4) Set the bowling pin back up, walk back to the start, and pop a dot on the poppet to score.
pe-03970:
1) Stand in front of a bucket holding two pool noodles (drumsticks) in both hands.
 2) Click the noodles together overhead in rhythm with the song 'Pump It Up'.
 3) Strike the sides and top of the bucket with the noodles to the beat.
 4) Alternate striking the floor, bucket, and sticks together following the music routine.
pe-03971:
1) Mark a square on the floor with tape or a blanket and place a basket or bucket inside the square.
 2) Prepare a rolled-up sock ball (or paper ball) and position yourself outside the marked square.
 3) Start a 1-minute timer and shoot the ball into the basket from any side outside the square.
 4) Count each successful basket as 1 point until the 1-minute timer runs out to calculate the total score.
pe-03972:
1) Divide into six teams with a home base basket (8 small cones inside), a four-spot path, and a hula hoop finish line.
 2) All players dribble their basketball to their assigned goal and take three shots simultaneously.
 3) Players return to their home basket and advance their game piece along the spot path by the number of shots made.
 4) Pieces reaching the hula hoop remain there, and the team that advances all pieces into the hoop first wins.
pe-03973:
1) Set up white laundry baskets and poly spots around them on the gym floor, placing a hula hoop and a Gator ball per team at the starting area.
 2) In teams of 2 to 3, players take turns running out to stand on any poly spot and taking one shot at a white basket.
 3) If successful, the player picks up the poly spot they shot from and brings it back to their team's hula hoop.
 4) If they miss, they retrieve the ball and bring it back to their teammate for their turn.
pe-03974:
1) Choose a couple students to be taggers holding a pool noodle, while groundhogs run around an open space trying not to get tagged.
 2) Groundhogs being chased may squat down and wrap their arms around their knees to 'dig a hole' and become safe.
 3) The safe digging posture can only be held for up to 5 seconds, after which the player must stand up and run.
 4) When tagged with the noodle, the tagger hands the noodle to that person, who becomes the new tagger.
pe-03975:
1) Students acting as robots march in a single file line continuously.
 2) Robots cannot change direction by themselves and cannot stop moving at any time.
 3) Robot engineers holding pool noodles tag a robot to allow it to change to a new direction.
 4) Engineers rescue robots that are stuck on a wall or path by tagging them to redirect them.
pe-03976:
1) Set up bowling pins in front and take a football at each station.
 2) Get into the offensive line position and snap the ball backwards between your legs to knock over the bowling pins.
 3) Each time a bowling pin is knocked down, record a point on the poppet and set the pin back up.
 4) Alternatively, simply roll the football towards the pins instead of hiking.
pe-03977:
1) The teacher becomes the drill sergeant and students stand in line as soldiers.
 2) Soldiers follow various verbal commands (Salute, At ease, Hit the deck, Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, etc.) as quickly and safely as possible.
 3) Soldiers march back to the line upon command.
pe-03978:
1) Divide into six teams, placing a basket of various throwing items, a hula hoop, and a spot marker in front of each team with target pins set up ahead.
 2) The first runner selects an item from the basket and rolls or tosses it from the hula hoop toward the first target pin.
 3) If the pin is knocked down, retrieve it back to the team, set up the next colored pin, and hand off to the next teammate.
 4) If the target is missed, run to retrieve the item, place it back into the box, and the next person takes their turn.
pe-03979:
1) Grab a dice from a bucket and roll it on the ground.
 2) Pick the corresponding numbered card and perform the designated exercise.
 3) Earn one roll after finishing the exercise.
 4) Roll a ball down a slanted table ramp to score in target rings.
pe-03980:
1) Roll up a pair of socks into a sock ball to use as a beanbag.
 2) Find an open space such as a living room or garage and establish a balanced ready position.
 3) Toss the sock ball into the air and catch it while keeping your body upright and controlled.
 4) Advance the challenge by clapping hands once before catching the sock ball.
pe-03981:
1) Set up team bases with a hula hoop, parking spot dot, and scooter, with food bean bags in the center restaurant.
 2) One student at a time rides the scooter on their bottom to their matching parking spot dot.
 3) The student enters the restaurant, grabs one colored food bean bag, and delivers it back to home base.
 4) The team determines which food group the color represents and names specific food examples.
pe-03982:
1) Set up colored cones in a zigzag rainbow path around the gymnasium from red to purple.
 2) Each student holds a die and starts at the first cone.
 3) Roll the die and advance forward that many cone spaces.
 4) Reach the finish line to collect one gold coin, then restart and collect as many coins as possible within the time limit.
pe-03983:
1) Bounce the ball off the ground and catch it with two hands, or touch your head before catching it to make it more difficult.
 2) Dribble low using fingertips with the dominant hand, then switch to the opposite hand.
 3) Rotate the ball around the body and perform a figure eight between the legs by rolling or passing.
 4) Perform defensive slides holding the ball overhead, or toss the ball up and pass it through an arm hoop before it lands.
pe-03984:
1) Taggers start by holding a noodle, a poly spot, and a rubber chicken folded inside the spot like a taco.
 2) Taggers run around chasing all other participants attempting to tag them.
 3) Once tagged, that student receives the noodle and chicken taco from the tagger and becomes the new tagger.
 4) Players cannot immediately tag back the person who just tagged them.
pe-03985:
1) Spike or bounce a ball downward onto a ground net.
 2) Aim for the ball to bounce off the net and land directly into the target bucket.
 3) Upon a successful shot, walk over to the cart and pick up one pizza box.
 4) Balance and stack the pizza box on top of the blue bucket to build a tower.
pe-03986:
1) Designate the floor as hot lava and set up a path from the starting point to the destination mat.
 2) Team members cross without touching the floor using stepping stones and items such as pillows, paper bags, or ropes.
 3) If anyone touches the lava floor, they must return to the beginning and restart.
 4) Increase difficulty by blindfolding a teammate with verbal guidance or adding obstacle baskets to cross over.
pe-03987:
1) Set up folding tables with pool noodles taped along the sides, marking goal lines at both ends and a center line
 2) Use plunger handles as paddles and a bean bag as the puck
 3) Push the bean bag across the opponent's goal line using the paddle to score a point
 4) If the bean bag gets stuck out of reach, walk along the side and retrieve it to hit
pe-03988:
1) Design a wellness wheel on cardboard or a paper plate with various calming activities.
 2) Insert a thumbtack into an eraser through the center and attach a paperclip as a spinner.
 3) Flick and spin the paperclip when needing a brain break or feeling stressed.
 4) Perform the activity that the spinner lands on to calm down.
pe-03989:
1) Taggers with pool noodles chase students around while plumbers hold plungers.
 2) Tagged students must freeze and hold a squat position with one arm out like a toilet flusher.
 3) A plumber holding a plunger rescues the frozen student by placing the plunger on their head and flushing the arm lever, allowing them to run again.
pe-03990:
1) Set up hula hoops in tiered color layers to form a mountain, placing a bucket at the peak.
 2) In pairs, one partner tosses a beanbag or koosh ball into the hoop mountain.
 3) The thrower collects the object and visits the bank to take the pretend bill corresponding to the landed color layer.
 4) The thrower high-fives or elbow-bumps their partner, who then takes their turn to toss.
pe-03991:
1) Assign taggers (Darth Vader) with red noodles and 2-3 rescuers (Baby Yoda) with green noodles, placing green hula hoops on the floor.
 2) Red noodle taggers chase running students and tag them carefully.
 3) Tagged students must go to the closest green hula hoop, place one foot inside, and remain frozen.
 4) Rescuers travel between green hula hoops to tag and free trapped students so they can return to the game.
pe-03992:
1) A cup-stacking formation picture and a cardio exercise pop up on screen.
 2) Participants have 1 minute to build the exact same cup stack shown in the image.
 3) Once finished, perform the assigned cardio exercise for the remainder of the round.
 4) Use the 10-second rest period between rounds to reset the cup stack.
pe-03993:
1) Animated Halloween character targets appear and move across the screen.
 2) A student stands at a safe distance in front of the screen with a ball.
 3) Time your throw and toss the ball to hit the moving targets on the wall/screen.
 4) Retrieve the thrown ball quickly and aim at the next moving targets.
pe-03994:
1) Set up Angry Birds plush toys and jumbo eggs on cones and perches in the center, and divide the class into two teams.
 2) A player grabs a frisbee from their side, runs to the designated throwing line, and throws it at the targets.
 3) If a bird is knocked down, place it into the team bucket; whether you hit or miss, high-five your waiting partner to switch.
 4) Continue rotating until all birds and eggs are knocked down, and the team with the most items in their bucket wins the round.
pe-03995:
1) Cookie Exchange: One flips a bean bag with a racket and the partner catches it with a lid.
 2) Sleigh Rides: One sits crisscross on a scooter and the partner walks while pulling with pool noodles.
 3) Snowball Throw: Players throw 3 balls from behind their spot to knock down snowman bowling pins.
 4) Snowboarding: One balances on a balance board while the partner turns a 30-second timer.
pe-03996:
1) Look at the cup stack picture and cardio exercise shown on the screen.
 2) Take 1 minute to create the same stack as seen in the picture.
 3) When finished stacking, perform the cardio exercise for the remainder of that round.
 4) Reset the stack during the 10 seconds between rounds.
pe-03997:
1) Perform the designated dribbling skill shown on the screen anywhere inside the boundary.
 2) When the whistle blows, find a poly spot to stand on.
 3) Perform the ball-handling skill that matches the color of your chosen poly spot.
 4) Switch the dribbling type and ball-handling skills with each new round.
pe-03998:
1) Assign four taggers (cops) equipped with noodles and scooters, while non-taggers line up behind designated cones with at least five in line.
 2) When a scooter is free, the next player in line places it wheels down and enters the game.
 3) Players are out if they go out of bounds, get tagged below the shoulders, or fall off the scooter.
 4) Eliminated players carry their scooter back, flip it wheels up, and join the end of the line.
pe-03999:
1) Perform the locomotor movement shown on screen anywhere inside the boundary.
 2) When the whistle blows, find a poly spot to stand on.
 3) Perform the exercise shown on screen matching your spot's color.
 4) Switch the locomotor movement and exercises each round.
pe-04000:
1) Walk within the black court boundaries without touching anyone else while keeping the assigned speed limit.
 2) Freeze immediately when the teacher calls freeze, standing tall with eyes on the speaker ready to listen.
 3) Practice walking and marching locomotor movements, then quickly navigate back to designated home spots upon the cue.
pe-04001:
1) Choose one preferred option between the two choices displayed on the screen.
 2) Perform left-hand dribbling if left is chosen, or right-hand dribbling if right is chosen.
 3) Practice the assigned ball-handling skill such as between the legs, behind the back, or figure-eight dribble.
 4) In the bonus round, freely practice a favorite ball-handling skill or one to improve.
pe-04002:
1) Choose your favorite option between two fall-themed choices shown on the screen.
 2) Move to the left if you pick the left option, or move to the right if you pick the right option.
 3) Perform the assigned exercise or dance move for your choice during the 30-second timer.
pe-04003:
1) Stand on spot markers with a partner and execute flat push passes keeping the puck on the floor.
 2) Stick handle through a slalom course of three cones and return.
 3) Navigate obstacles and gates within the boundary markers while controlling the puck.
 4) Take one shot on goal to knock down a bowling pin, then retrieve the puck with your stick.
pe-04004:
1) Move around the track using the designated locomotor movement while music plays.
 2) Move quickly to the nearest marked corner (1 to
 4) when the music stops.
 3) A dice is rolled; students in the rolled corner number move to the center circle to do follow-the-leader exercises.
 4) If a 5 is rolled everyone completes 5 exercise reps, and if a 6 is rolled everyone in the center rejoins the track.
pe-04005:
1) Divide the class into two teams with all players lining up behind a large cone behind the shooting line.
 2) On the start signal, the first two opposing players take their first shot from behind the designated line simultaneously.
 3) Players can move closer to the basket to shoot continuously until one of the two players scores.
 4) The player who scores passes the ball to the next teammate in line and stays in the main game line, while the player who missed goes to the locker room line marked by a small cone.
 5) Each time a player makes a shot, one teammate from the locker room returns to the main line, and the objective is to eliminate all opposing players into the locker room.
pe-04006:
1) The reindeer team pulls scooter sleds loaded with buckets from one endline to the other while teammates help guard them.
 2) If a bucket falls off the scooter, students must stop immediately, reload it on the sled, and resume pulling.
 3) Throwers stay behind the court sidelines and roll or toss balls underhand to knock off the passing sled packages.
 4) When the 4 to 5-minute timer expires, teams count how many packages successfully reached the end and rotate roles.
pe-04007:
1) A pun appears on the screen, and students rest for 5 seconds while the coach reads it.
 2) Once read, students perform the designated exercise (such as floss dance, jumping jacks, or high knees) for 30 seconds.
 3) Reset during the next 5-second reading break and continue with subsequent exercises.
pe-04008:
1) Each team sets up one pin at the number one spot and waits behind their cone.
 2) The bowler rolls the ball using step and lunge cues, and if they knock down the pin, they add another pin.
 3) If all pins are not knocked down, do not add a pin and reset the existing pins for the next turn.
 4) Continue adding pins on strikes until reaching 10 pins, and sit behind the cone with hands up once the final strike is scored.
pe-04009:
1) Choose one leader in each group to roll the dice first.
 2) The leader rolls the dice, and the entire group performs the assigned exercise (e.g., rolling a one equals 10 squats).
 3) After completing the exercise, the group jogs one lap around the gym.
 4) The leader selects the next roller to lead the subsequent exercise.
pe-04010:
1) Choose one exercise from the two options presented on screen.
 2) Work hard and perform the chosen exercise for 35 seconds.
 3) Rest for 10 seconds.
 4) Repeat the sequence with the next set of exercises until finished.
pe-04011:
1) Observe two basketball skill options presented on the screen and choose one challenge to attempt.
 2) Practice the chosen basketball drill (such as leg rolls, waist wraps, or dribbling variations) for 30 seconds.
 3) When the 30-second timer ends, view the next pair of skill options and repeat the practice routine.
pe-04012:
1) All students start at Corner 1 and find a partner to play rock-paper-scissors.
 2) The winner jogs to the next corner, while the loser stays at the current corner, performs an exercise (e.g., 10 jumping jacks), and finds a new partner.
 3) Students continue moving forward from corner to corner upon winning and never go backward.
 4) After winning at Corner 4, the student picks up one bracelet before returning to Corner 1 to start again.
pe-04013:
1) Stand on the home spot, toss the balloon just above the head, and catch with two hands.
 2) Toss the balloon, tap gently with the right palm, and catch.
 3) Toss the balloon, tap gently with the left palm, and catch.
 4) Stay on the home spot and challenge consecutive hits using single hands, elbows, or rainbow taps between hands.
pe-04014:
1) Choose one of two scarf challenges presented on the screen.
 2) Perform the chosen challenge such as passing around the waist or legs, or clapping before catching.
 3) Attempt advanced tasks including catching on the shoulder/head while kneeling, catching on the knee/foot, or spinning before catch.
 4) In the final round, create and perform your own scarf challenge.
pe-04015:
1) Sit crisscross and roll the tennis ball around your body in both directions.
 2) Kneel on both knees, drop the ball with one hand, and catch it with two hands using both sides.
 3) Stand up, balance the ball on the palm of one hand, and perform squats, then switch hands and repeat.
 4) Sequentially perform two-hand toss and catch, drop-clap-catch, and bouncing and catching using right, left, and alternating hands.
pe-04016:
1) Scatter hula hoops and poly spots across the gym; each student receives a balloon and stands inside a hoop.
 2) Strike the balloon above the head using designated body parts (hands, elbows, knees) while remaining in the hoop.
 3) Travel around the gym striking the balloon when music plays, then find the nearest hoop when music stops.
 4) Compete with a partner in a hoop to see who can keep striking the balloon longest without stepping out.
pe-04017:
1) Choose a favorite option between two video game choices displayed on screen.
 2) If you prefer the option on the left, move to the left; if you prefer the option on the right, move to the right.
 3) Perform the designated exercise or dance move for your chosen option during the countdown.
pe-04018:
1) Choose one of the two exercises shown on screen.
 2) Work hard performing that exercise for 35 seconds.
 3) Rest for 10 seconds.
 4) Repeat the pattern with the next set of exercises until finished.
pe-04019:
1) All students face the same direction to prevent ropes from colliding and warm up with free choice jumping.
 2) Practice single bounce, double bounce, and backward jumping for one minute each following the teacher's instruction.
 3) Choose one of the three jump styles and perform a 1-minute endurance challenge, counting cumulative jumps even if tripping up.
 4) Progress to jogger, skier, and bell jumps before conducting another 1-minute challenge and moving to partner activities.
pe-04020:
1) A math fact flashes across the screen and students have 10 seconds to solve the problem.
 2) Perform the exercise shown next to the chosen answer for 30 seconds.
 3) Check the answer and take a short Rest & Reset break before the next question.
pe-04021:
1) Perform 10 rounds of physical activity with each round lasting 30 seconds.
 2) Learn about heart-healthy foods during the rest breaks.
 3) Perform jumping jacks, skaters, mountain climbers, side lunges, squats, push-ups, squats with side leg lifts, running in place, and burpees in order.
pe-04022:
1) Each student receives a beanbag and places it on top of a small cone inside the court to establish their home.
 2) Guard the cone from all directions so that other players do not knock down the beanbag with thrown balls.
 3) Players may leave their cone to retrieve a ball, but they must keep at least one foot at their home cone when throwing.
 4) If your beanbag is knocked off by a ball or accident, pick it up, run one full lap outside the two large cones, and return to find a new house.
pe-04023:
1) A two-choice trivia question about the human heart is presented on screen.
 2) Choose the option you believe is correct.
 3) Perform the physical exercise shown underneath your chosen answer for 30 seconds.
 4) Check the correct answer revealed after the countdown and proceed to the next trivia question.
pe-04024:
1) Look at the displayed food and decide whether it is Go, Slow, or Whoa within 10 seconds.
 2) Check the specific physical exercise assigned under your chosen answer.
 3) Perform the exercise alongside the video characters during the 30-second timer.
 4) Confirm the correct answer and proceed to the next food fitness challenge.
pe-04025:
1) Choose a preferred design option between two choices for each body part shown on the screen
 2) Perform the designated physical exercise for 30 seconds based on your choice
 3) Spend the next 30 seconds drawing that monster feature on paper
 4) Color and finish your monster drawing during the extra time provided at the end
pe-04026:
1) Read the basketball trivia question presented on the screen.
 2) Perform the exercise shown underneath your chosen answer for the 30-second duration.
 3) Check whether your answer was correct when the answer is revealed, then proceed to the next question.
pe-04027:
1) A target letter appears on the screen.
 2) Participants have 45 seconds to arrange their cups on the floor.
 3) Form the exact shape of the letter shown using the cups before time runs out.
pe-04028:
1) Pipeline Challenge: Team members use one pipe piece each to transport 4 items to the opposite bucket without dropping them.
 2) Backwards Relays: Pass a ball backward over heads down the line, with the front runner peeling off to the end of the line.
 3) Relay variations: Alternate passing through legs, alternating over-under, or twisting left and right.
 4) River Crossing: Using poly spots (equal to or one fewer than team size), teams cross to the other side and return without stepping in the water.
pe-04029:
1) Dribble the soccer ball using only your feet and move freely around the area while the music plays.
 2) Keep the ball under control and avoid making contact with anyone else.
 3) When the coach says 'Freeze' or the music stops, immediately stop moving and trap the ball.
 4) When the music resumes, continue dribbling around the area.
pe-04030:
1) Stand facing across from your partner, designating Partner A and Partner B.
 2) Partner A performs exercises using the hockey stick while Partner B rests.
 3) When the horn sounds, switch roles with your partner to take turns exercising.
pe-04031:
1) The defending team lines up along the center line, while runners wait at the boundary line.
 2) On signal, runners sprint across the center line toward the opposite safe boundary.
 3) Defenders move along the line trying to tag the runners attempting to cross.
 4) Runners who make it to the other side without being tagged successfully clear the round.
pe-04032:
1) Listen to commands called out by the captain (teacher) and perform the matching action immediately.
 2) Salute for 'Salute the Captain', scrub the floor for 'Scrub the deck', and swim for 'Man overboard'.
 3) Freeze completely when 'Shark' is called, and pretend to row vigorously for 'The ship is sinking'.
 4) Climb ropes or do jumping exercises as directed when other captain orders are given.
pe-04033:
1) Go down onto your knees and place hands on two stepping stones.
 2) Lower yourself to drink water and push back up.
 3) Repeat the movement as fast as you can for 40 seconds while coming up to breathe.
pe-04034:
1) Stand upright in a clear space.
 2) At the countdown signal, jump spreading arms and legs into a star shape and land.
 3) Complete as many star jumps as possible within 20 seconds to record your score.
pe-04035:
1) Perform skipping with a rope (or imaginary rope) for 30 seconds followed by 10 seconds of rest.
 2) For the next 30 seconds, jump and wave arms big to get the attention of pirate ships.
 3) For the next 30 seconds, kick with both legs as if kicking coconuts off the beach.
 4) For the final 30 seconds, stand tall and look out as far as possible looking for pirate boats.
pe-04036:
1) Lie down flat on your stomach on the floor.
 2) Whenever the call "Help" is shouted, raise both hands and feet up into the air.
 3) Lower hands and feet back down to the floor on command.
 4) Continue the lifting movement for 40 seconds before quickly jumping back up to your feet.
pe-04037:
1) Hold a balled-up pair of socks in hand and stand on one leg with the other knee raised.
 2) Pass the socks beneath the raised thigh from one hand to the other.
 3) Bring the socks over the thigh to complete a continuous circle.
 4) Count how many full circles you can complete in 20 seconds while maintaining single-leg balance.
pe-04038:
1) Balance on the right leg for 10 seconds.
 2) Switch to the left leg upon the cue and hold for 10 seconds.
 3) Continue alternating legs until the stop command is given.
pe-04039:
1) Get down on the floor supporting your body on your forearms and toes in a plank position.
 2) Hold the bridge position steadily for 40 seconds to let the pirate crew cross the stream.
 3) If it gets too difficult, place your knees on the ground while keeping your back held up high.
pe-04040:
1) Place buckets of cold water in the center of the field and split students into two teams.
 2) At the start, one or two designated students run to the center buckets to grab wet sponges.
 3) Throw the wet sponges across to the other side to hit and get opponent players out.
 4) Continue dodging and throwing until the opposing team players are eliminated.
pe-04041:
1) Stand with your feet together.
 2) Jump onto the stones without falling into the water.
 3) Turn around and jump back.
 4) Keep jumping back and forth without stopping for 40 seconds.
pe-04042:
1) Hold a cushion with both hands and place a sock on it facing away from you.
 2) Flip the cushion like a pancake to flip the sock in the air and catch it on the cushion again.
 3) Score 1 point for each successful catch of the sock on the cushion.
 4) Complete as many sock flips as you can within the 20-second time limit.
pe-04043:
1) Knock the sensory sound ball back and forth between feet to explore the sound (boxing the ball).
 2) Close eyes, drop the ball from overhead, track the bouncing sound, and trap it with a foot.
 3) Bounce the ball off a wall with hands, close eyes, listen to the rebound, and stop it with a foot.
 4) Have a partner stand with eyes closed, bounce-pass the ball to them, and let them trap and kick it softly back.
pe-04044:
1) Practice floorball stick handling and passing with bent knees and proper grip.
 2) Form teams with one defenseman and two forwards to pass and shoot toward the goal.
 3) Advance the ball and score by shooting into the opponent net while keeping sticks below waist level.
pe-04045:
1) Stand on both sides of the duck walker with knees bent and back straight.
 2) Practice rocking left and right in place to get a feel for your balance.
 3) Race forward around the left side of the pylon and return to the starting line.
 4) Flip the board over to practice full circles, squats, or catch a ball with a partner while balancing.
pe-04046:
1) Two players face each other on either side of the box and start with a 1-2-3 face-off.
 2) Use the sticks to push the puck through the arches into the scoring zone and score a goal into the net.
 3) If the puck flies out in the attacking zone, reset with a face-off in that zone.
 4) As a variation, add defensive/offensive players for a 2-on-2 match or add a second puck.
pe-04047:
1) Sit on the Roller Racer with your feet on top and wiggle the handlebars back and forth to move.
 2) Practice maneuvers including straight riding, circles, and figure eights.
 3) Slalom in and out through a zig-zag line of cones.
 4) Ride down to the far end, pick up one chick item at a time, and bring it back to the starting line.
pe-04048:
1) Perform the Turnstile challenge by running through a rotating 30-foot rope consecutively without jumping over it.
 2) Enter the rope exactly when it comes toward you and passes your nose, run through around the rope turner, and return to the line.
 3) Aim for the highest consecutive streak by having each runner go through on every single consecutive turn of the rope.
 4) Progress by sending partners through in pairs, groups of three, or playing Over and Back where a runner returns and brings another teammate.
pe-04049:
1) Form two teams of pairs with partners stationed at opposite target cans.
 2) A player throws the flying disc toward the target can at the opposite end.
 3) Hitting any part of the can directly scores 1 point, and entering the can unassisted scores 5 points.
 4) The partner may deflect the incoming disc to hit the can for 1 point or redirect it inside for 2 points, playing to 21 points.
pe-04050:
1) Stand in a circle with each participant holding one arm of the elastic Octaband.
 2) Pull the band toward the chin or balance on one foot according to the teacher's color cues for upper body and core exercise.
 3) Place a ball in the center of the band and coordinate movements up, down, and walking without letting the ball drop.
 4) Pass the band legs sideways using the right hand to give and left hand to receive, reversing directions on cue.
pe-04051:
1) Teams line up in rows with numbered cones 1 through 6 spread out in the activity area.
 2) On the go signal, the first runner sprints out to touch the tops of cones 1 through 6 in sequential order.
 3) After touching cone six, the runner races back and high-fives the second runner to take their turn.
 4) The first team whose members all complete touching the cones in order wins.
pe-04053:
1) Bounce and catch the foam ball individually.
 2) Squeeze and release the foam ball with both hands.
 3) Face a partner and pass one or two balls back and forth.
 4) Pass the balls sequentially in a larger group.
pe-04054:
1) Line up facing the quiver with the shoulder holding the bow pointing toward the target.
 2) Nock the arrow with the odd-colored fletching facing up.
 3) Place three fingers on the string with one above and two below the arrow.
 4) Aim, pull back, and release to shoot at the target.
pe-04055:
1) Grip the band with both hands and pull outward repeatedly to warm up shoulders.
 2) Place one hand on the knee and slowly pull the other arm upward along a diagonal plane.
 3) Shorten the band grip in front of the chest and pull apart rapidly.
 4) Hold the band behind the back and push outward alternately and together to strengthen upper body.
pe-04056:
1) Place the elastic jump bands around two partners' ankles while a jumper stands in the center.
 2) Step out-out-in-in with alternating feet as quickly as possible.
 3) Perform two-foot straddle jumps jumping outside the bands and back into the center.
 4) Gradually raise the band height from the ankles up to increase the challenge level.
pe-04057:
1) Hold the stick with two hands, keep the stick below waist height, and dribble the ball through cones.
 2) Shoot the ball under the target cones at the end, retrieve your own ball, and jog back.
 3) One partner stays in a hoop while the other jogs to find an open hoop and calls for a pass.
 4) Score 1 point if the receiver stops the pass with at least one foot in the hoop, then switch roles.
pe-04058:
1) Players take turns hitting their balls in a fixed sequence (Blue, Red, Black, Yellow, Green, Orange).
 2) From the starting end, players hit the ball through wickets across the course toward the stake at the far end.
 3) Every time a ball passes through a wicket, the player earns an extra shot (two shots for two wickets), and hitting another player's ball also awards an extra shot.
 4) The player who successfully navigates all wickets and strikes the finishing stake first wins the game.
pe-04059:
1) Toss above the head, let it bounce once, and catch with two hands.
 2) Toss higher and catch after two bounces.
 3) Toss to a partner so it bounces once before being caught.
 4) Dribble the ball toward the called cone number.
pe-04060:
1) Each player holds a hula hoop like a steering wheel inside a play area marked by four cones.
 2) On 'green light', drive around without hitting others, and on 'highway', move fast inside the cones.
 3) Swerve on 'oil slick', get low on 'tunnel', stop on 'red light', and go in reverse making beeping sounds on 'reverse'.
 4) If you bump into someone, take your hoop to the outside area, do 5 jumping jacks while naming 5 different vegetables, and rejoin.
pe-04061:
1) Divide into builders (up-stackers) and bashers (down-stackers) on opposite sides of the gym.
 2) The up-stack team finds down-stacked cups and builds them up into pyramids.
 3) The down-stack team finds up-stacked pyramids and slides them down into stacks.
 4) Players run out one by one in a relay format to stack or unstack cups, returning to tag the next teammate.
pe-04062:
1) Pick one of the poly spots on the floor as a target.
 2) Throw the flying disc onto the chosen spot to earn a point.
 3) You cannot throw to the same spot twice in a row and must aim for a different spot.
pe-04063:
1) Teams work together to assemble hoops with one on the bottom, two on the sides, and one on top.
 2) The smallest team member carefully steps inside the assembled hoop structure.
 3) Push the ball in a zigzag pattern to the end and bring it straight back.
 4) Hand off to the next person upon returning to continue the timed run.
pe-04064:
1) A group of up to 10 students stands together on a fully spread-out tarp.
 2) Students must remain on the tarp at all times without stepping off onto the ground.
 3) Working together and jumping in unison, the group folds the tarp in half repeatedly without stepping off.
 4) The group then challenges themselves to unfold the tarp back completely or rotate it to move a marker to a new position.
pe-04065:
1) Two teams face each other and pass the weighted slow-motion soccer ball back and forth.
 2) Toss the ball to the other team, let it bounce, pick it up, and toss it back.
 3) Students sit on scooter boards with their feet in front and pass the ball along the floor.
pe-04066:
1) Balance a pool noodle between partners without dropping it while moving around.
 2) Hold a pool noodle and catch a tossed deck ring onto the noodle.
 3) Switch places and step back to the next numbered spot after each successful catch.
 4) Progress to holding two pool noodles and catching a ring on each one simultaneously.
pe-04067:
1) Students start one at a time when the teacher gives the signal.
 2) Crawl through the four-piece tunnel and climb over the steps.
 3) Crawl under the doughnut halves, go back through the tunnel, and navigate around the cylinder.
 4) Return through the red tunnel and finish the sequence of over, under, around, and through.
pe-04068:
1) Hold and lightly shake the MyPlate parachute featuring food group sections (fruits, vegetables, protein, grains, dairy).
 2) Perform assigned movements when a food group is called (fruit-up, vegetable-down, protein-back, grain-in).
 3) Cooperate to move the object on the parachute onto the designated food group color.
 4) Exercise by shaking the parachute with only one hand to bounce items off.
pe-04069:
1) Bounce and catch the ball with the same hand for 5 repetitions, switch to the other hand, and then alternate hands.
 2) Bounce the ball, clap hands in front and behind your back, and catch it.
 3) Gently throw the ball against the wall letting it bounce in front of you, or bounce it on the floor first before hitting the wall and catching it.
 4) Face a partner and bounce balls to each other simultaneously, or have one player bounce two balls at once for the partner to catch both.
pe-04070:
1) Divide students into batting and fielding teams, setting up wickets and base spots in the gym.
 2) The bowler bounces the ball toward the wicket, and the batter hits it into open space using a wooden paddle.
 3) The batter runs to touch the base spot and returns to the wicket while holding the bat, scoring one point per round trip.
 4) The batter must return safely before fielders retrieve the ball and hit the wicket.
pe-04071:
1) Practice tossing and catching the rubber chicken, then catch it only by specified parts like the head, neck, or feet.
 2) Add tricks while tossing, such as clapping or clapping behind the back before catching.
 3) Flick the chicken off your foot and catch it, adding turns or tricks.
 4) Have a partner hold and move a bucket to catch the tossed rubber chickens.
pe-04072:
1) Drop the reaction ball and catch it after one bounce, or toss it up and catch after one or two bounces.
 2) Throw the ball against the wall underhand or overhand and catch it after one or two bounces.
 3) One person rolls the ball on the floor and the partner scoops and tosses it back, advancing to two balls.
 4) Drop two balls simultaneously from shoulder height and catch both after one bounce.
pe-04073:
1) In the scavenger race, the first runner checks under cones to find hidden noodle bits, takes one back to their hoop, or returns if empty before the next runner goes.
 2) In the scooter race, pairs push a partner on a scooter to retrieve one noodle bit into their bucket, then rotate roles.
 3) In the back-to-back race, pairs carry a yoga ball between their backs without hands around a cone and back, restarting if it drops.
 4) In the belly-to-belly race, pairs lean into the yoga ball belly-to-belly without using hands to complete the relay.
pe-04074:
1) Using a ringed ball, practice throwing it like a frisbee, trapping/kicking it like soccer, and shooting it like basketball.
 2) Players cannot run while holding the ball, but pivoting is allowed as teams execute pass-and-go movement.
 3) No one may enter the circle safe zone around the goal, and all shots must be taken from outside the zone.
 4) Throwing the ball into the goal scores 1 point (must bounce), kicking it into the goal scores 2 points, and shooting it into the basketball hoop scores 2 points.
pe-04075:
1) Mark a goal line with two cones and place two large visualizer balls in front of it.
 2) Stand behind the throwing line and use underhand throws to toss small balls and bean bags at the large balls.
 3) Move the large balls across the goal line solely by hitting them with thrown objects without touching them directly.
 4) When out of throwing items, call time-out to retrieve equipment, return to spots, and continue until both large balls cross the line.
pe-04076:
1) Set up striker sheets in the middle as nets with partners facing each other on opposite sides.
 2) Use plastic paddles and foam tennis balls to rally back and forth over the net on one bounce.
