 3) Expand to doubles play or introduce a target challenge where players aim to bounce the ball into a bucket.
 4) Arrange striker sheets into four squares to play a four-square style game where players hit the ball into another square when it bounces in theirs.
pe-04077:
1) Scatter number spots from 1 to 30 inside the playing area and assign a runner.
 2) The runner enters the field and touches numbers 1 through 30 in sequential order with guidance from teammates.
 3) In a relay variation, two teams start from different markers, touch their assigned sequential numbers, and sprint back to tag the next partner.
 4) In the elimination variation, one team counts up from 1 and the other counts down from 30, with the first team to grab number 15 winning.
pe-04078:
1) Insert the straight stick into the ring and practice stick handling while keeping the stick on the floor.
 2) Practice accurate target passing toward cones by following through toward the target.
 3) Practice receiving passes with a partner by placing the tip of the stick directly into the moving ring.
 4) Practice shooting on net, then play a full ringette match focusing on continuous passing and shooting.
pe-04079:
1) Each team lines up with one die and six numbered cones (1 to 6).
 2) The first runner rolls the die, runs out with that numbered cone, and flips the cone to land it upright.
 3) Once successfully landed, the runner returns and the next person immediately rolls the die.
 4) If a number of an already placed cone is rolled, that cone must be brought back.
pe-04080:
1) Practice balancing a ball on the foam paddle while walking.
 2) Practice hitting the ball upward (ups) and dribbling it toward the floor (downs), then alternate down and up.
 3) Practice flip-flops by turning the paddle over to hit the ball with alternating sides.
 4) Bounce and hit the ball against a wall, or switch to a badminton shuttle to achieve 8-9 consecutive hits and flip-flops.
pe-04081:
1) Divide into red and blue teams and place a bucket with a chicken inside a target circle.
 2) Attackers try to cross without getting tagged and enter the circle to pick up the chicken.
 3) Defenders tag invading attackers and must escort them one at a time to the timeout hoop.
 4) A tagged player in timeout can be freed by a teammate's tag, and grabbing the chicken wins the game.
pe-04082:
1) Hold a tennis ball in your dominant hand and a multi-bucket in the opposite hand
 2) Bounce the ball off the floor and catch it inside the bucket
 3) Progress to bouncing the ball, spinning around in place, and catching it, or catching it on the flat bottom of the bucket
 4) Challenge yourself to catching the bounced ball in a bucket balanced on your head or bouncing it off a grounded bucket and catching it
pe-04083:
1) Sit on the scooter, place hands inside the handle holes, and use feet to propel forward from the starting point.
 2) Travel down around the cone and return to pass the turn to the next runner.
 3) Hook scooters together so one person faces forward and the other faces backward to take pins down and set them up.
 4) Hold a bowling pin between feet or connect three people to navigate around the cone as a team.
pe-04084:
1) Team members take turns stepping through the grid maze to find the hidden path from one side to the other.
 2) The facilitator holds a secret map and makes a sound if a player steps on an incorrect square.
 3) When a player steps on a wrong square, they step off, and the team remembers the mistake for the next attempt.
 4) The team succeeds by cooperating to memorize and find the complete correct path across the maze.
pe-04085:
1) Move freely throughout the classroom space following the teacher's cues.
 2) Gallop on 'Gallop' and freeze on 'Freeze'.
 3) Switch the rules so 'Freeze' means gallop and 'Gallop' means freeze.
 4) Add Woo, Twist, Jump, and Side Slide movements and perform the opposite actions.
pe-04086:
1) Hold and stretch the elastic rope with both hands to form assigned shapes like V-shapes, rectangles, and right triangles.
 2) Look at alphabet spots on the floor and spell words in your mind starting with those letters.
 3) Hold up the correct letter spots to form words and sentences using body movement.
 4) March in place or in line while collecting the alphabet spots in the correct sequence.
pe-04087:
1) Students gather around and hold the handles of the planetary parachute featuring solar system graphics.
 2) Place a ball onto the parachute and roll it around cooperatively, trying not to let it fall into any planet hole.
 3) When the ball nears an unwanted hole, shake the parachute together to bounce the ball back into play.
 4) When the teacher calls out specific planets (e.g., Earth, Neptune, or Saturn and Jupiter), cooperate to maneuver the ball into that specific target hole.
pe-04088:
1) Each player places their own pin anywhere on their half of the court and defends it.
 2) If a player's pin is knocked down, they pick it up and move to the opposite wall behind the other team.
 3) From the opposite wall, they can throw balls to knock down opponent pins from behind; successfully knocking one down allows them to return to their team's side.
pe-04089:
1) Roll a golf ball down half pipes across the gym floor without touching it.
 2) The ball may not stop, drop, or go backwards and must keep moving forward.
 3) If the ball stops or moves backwards, restart from the beginning.
 4) Successfully drop the ball into the tub at the other end so it stays inside.
pe-04090:
1) Assemble an obstacle course creatively using pool noodles, connectors, elbow joints, and heavy bases.
 2) Design the course layout and define movement rules (such as running laps or performing push-ups) from start to finish.
 3) The first runner navigates the course for two laps, after which the next runner takes their turn in succession.
pe-04091:
1) Bounce and catch the foam tennis ball alternating hands.
 2) Perform tricks such as spinning around, clapping hands, or touching head, shoulders, knees, and toes before catching.
 3) Throw the ball against the wall, catch it after one bounce, and return to the back of the line.
 4) Use pickleball paddles to bounce the ball up and down, hit it off the floor against the wall, or rally back and forth with a partner.
pe-04092:
1) In pairs, one partner sits crisscross applesauce on the scooter board.
 2) The standing partner pushes the scooter down, around the cone, and back.
 3) Partners switch roles and repeat the relay.
 4) As a variation, the sitting student faces backwards holding the scooter and pushes backwards using their feet.
pe-04093:
1) Balance the ball on the foam paddle and wiggle it back and forth without letting it fall.
 2) Lightly pop the ball upward and try to get ten consecutive taps.
 3) Tap the ball downward while flipping the paddle side on each tap.
 4) Partner up with one ball to tap back and forth with one bounce or without bouncing.
pe-04094:
1) Lie on your stomach on the scooter board at the start line, paddle forward using arms, and dismount.
 2) Pass through rings, crawl under tunnels, and clear hurdles by walking or jumping.
 3) Hop across on one foot for balance, followed by heel rolls following along the rope path.
 4) At designated yellow markers, perform assigned fitness exercises (squats, lunges, jumping jacks, sit-ups, planks, or push-ups) before sprinting through the corridor to finish.
pe-04095:
1) Line up in parallel lines to practice catching discs with one hand on top and one on the bottom (alligator catch).
 2) Form groups of three where the two outer players try to pass the disc to each other.
 3) The player in the middle attempts to intercept and catch the disc in a keep-away game.
 4) Move around the track and toss the disc into the designated ozone hole target upon hearing freeze.
pe-04096:
1) Level 1: Underhand throw against the wall and catch it 4 times in a row, then jog one lap.
 2) Level 2: Overhand throw against the wall and catch it 4 times in a row, then jog one lap.
 3) Level 3: Go to the center, hold the ball up to find a partner, complete 4 underhand catches together, and jog one lap.
 4) Level 4: Complete 4 overhand catches with a partner, and restart from level 1 with a different ball once completed.
pe-04097:
1) Sit on the mat in a pike position with personal space.
 2) Perform a salute signal by raising and lowering arms straight before starting and after finishing each travel.
 3) When the music plays, travel across the mat practicing the instructed movement such as duck walk.
 4) When the music stops, sit back down in a pike position with self-control without crashing.
pe-04098:
1) Teams line up behind the starting line facing a set of 6 (or 10) stacked cups.
 2) The first runner sprints, stands behind the cups, down-stacks them, and stacks them back up.
 3) The runner sprints back and tags the hand of the next teammate in line.
 4) Once every member completes their turn, the entire team sits down and claps to claim victory.
pe-04099:
1) Hold the torch below the tape with one hand and place the other hand behind your back with a ball balanced on top.
 2) Run forward around the cone while balancing the ball and return to your line.
 3) If the ball falls off, stop moving immediately and put the ball back on before continuing.
 4) Hand off the torch to the next runner so each team member runs once.
pe-04100:
1) Get a balloon and a hockey stick at the station.
 2) Practice controlling the balloon with the stick all the way down around the orange cone and back.
 3) If desired, race against a group member to see who can go around the cone and back first.
 4) For a hockey battle, start at the center black line and hit the balloon past the opponent's black line.
pe-04101:
1) Two partners take turns shooting at the basketball hoop.
 2) When one player makes a shot, the partner must copy and recreate the exact same shot from that same spot.
 3) If the copying partner misses the shot, they receive a letter starting with P.
 4) The game ends when a player accumulates all three letters to spell P-I-G, followed by a fist bump before starting a new round.
pe-04102:
1) Teams line up behind their bucket containing identical color-coded items at the starting line.
 2) The first runner takes 1 item, runs to touch the jogging line with their foot, returns, and hands it to the next runner.
 3) The next runner takes the handed item along with the next ready item to carry 2 items, increasing by one item each round.
 4) If an item drops at any time, the team must restart at 1 item; the team that successfully carries all items or holds the most items when time expires wins.
pe-04103:
1) Lift the parachute high overhead while holding tight, keeping hands up as it floats down, then bring hands back down to abs on cue (Jellyfish).
 2) Perform the jellyfish movement and listen for the teacher to call out a specific color.
 3) Students holding that called color run underneath the parachute across to an open spot of the same color.
 4) If your color spot is already taken when you exit, run around to find any open color spot.
pe-04104:
1) Place spot markers (islands) with one bean bag (coconut) each inside the gym boundaries for each participant.
 2) When music starts, leave your island to take a coconut from another island and bring it back to your own.
 3) You cannot block or guard others from taking coconuts from your island, and you may only carry one coconut at a time.
 4) Throwing coconuts is prohibited, and the participant with the most coconuts when the music stops wins.
pe-04105:
1) Line up at the team cones and head to the center line.
 2) Build a hula hut using six hoops by placing one flat on the floor, inserting two wall hoops inside it, adding a front door, a back door, and a roof on top.
 3) Once the hut is built, send one teammate through the inside of the hut.
 4) After finishing the challenge, move to the finish line on the other side of the gym, sit down, and clap.
pe-04106:
1) Locate your assigned home base spot using the wall number and letter grid coordinates.
 2) Walk around open space while maintaining a safe personal space bubble.
 3) On the stop signal, freeze and return promptly to your assigned home base spot.
 4) Progress movement challenges to sliding sideways and galloping before returning to spots.
pe-04107:
1) Students stand in a circle holding the perimeter of the parachute.
 2) Place a ball in the middle and align holding heights at the abdominal level.
 3) On the count of up-up-up-down, pull the parachute down together to launch the ball upward.
 4) Cooperatively propel the ball to hit the ceiling, earning bonus points if caught back in the chute.
pe-04108:
1) Students rotate in order through numbered stations including jumping and landing, balance beam, pull-ups, traveling, vaulting, and rope swing.
 2) Each station features progressive levels of difficulty, requiring students to master the current level before advancing.
 3) When the music stops, all students line up and rotate together to the next numbered station.
pe-04109:
1) Form lines of 5 to 6 players with the first two students each holding a basketball.
 2) The first shooter must take their first shot from behind the line, and immediately the next person shoots.
 3) If the first shot misses, retrieve the rebound and shoot from anywhere near the basket.
 4) If the player behind scores before the player in front, the front player is knocked out; otherwise, pass the ball to the next person.
pe-04110:
1) The batter hits the ball off the batting tee with the bat.
 2) Immediately after hitting, the batter drops the bat, runs to tag first base with their foot, and runs back to home plate.
 3) The fielders field the ball and throw it to first base to tag the base before the runner returns home.
 4) The batter scores a point if they touch home plate before the base is tagged, but is out if caught in the air or if they sling the bat.
pe-04111:
1) Each student stands on a spot marker placed around the room, which acts as their driveway.
 2) While the music plays, students pretend to drive cars into open space performing designated locomotor skills (walk, skip, slide, jog, gallop, hop, jump, leap over spots).
 3) Students must look where they are going to avoid bumping into anyone or anything.
 4) When the music stops and the teacher calls 'Red light', all students must immediately freeze in place.
pe-04112:
1) Students pair up, with one climbing and the other coaching from off the mat.
 2) Climbers move across the wall in the same direction, keeping feet below the red safety line and staying one person per section.
 3) When falling or reaching the end, climbers walk around the mat instead of walking behind active climbers.
 4) Partners switch roles so the coach climbs and the climber coaches.
pe-04113:
1) Set up 10 lanes using dome cones across the gym, placing one bowling pin at the back wall and one ball on the middle line per lane.
 2) Partners play 1v1 with one student standing by the wall to reset pins while the other bowls.
 3) The bowler chooses a distance line worth 1, 2, 3, or 4 points and rolls underhand to knock down the single pin, scoring the chosen point value upon success.
 4) Partners switch roles after each roll for 3 minutes, after which students wearing a bracelet rotate one lane over to face a new opponent.
pe-04114:
1) Line up at the cone in a ready position and sit on the hippity hop when given the signal.
 2) Bounce on the hippity hop down around the turning cone while holding the handle tightly.
 3) Stop bouncing as you get close to the cone line and hand the ball to the next person.
 4) Once all teammates finish their turn, sit down and clap; the first team to finish wins.
pe-04115:
1) Start with one finger on the wall, and begin when the ball bounces three times chanting 'Ga-Ga-Ball'.
 2) Strike the ball with hands to hit other players from the knees down to eliminate them.
 3) A player cannot touch the ball twice in a row (double tap) unless it hits a wall or another player's foot first.
 4) Players are out if they fall to their knees, touch the wall, hit the ball over the wall, or have their aerial hit caught.
pe-04116:
1) Two players face each other using two squares of a four-square court with one ball.
 2) The server bounces the ball once in their own square before hitting it underhand into the opponent's square.
 3) The receiving player must let the ball bounce once in their square and hit it underhand back across.
 4) A point is scored if a player double bounces, hits the inside line, or hits the ball out of turn; after 1 point, the winner raises their hand and stays while the loser jogs one lap to find a new partner.
pe-04117:
1) Hold the ball out in front without touching your belly and practice slaps and taps with finger pads.
 2) Drop the ball, spin after one bounce, and catch it using finger pads.
 3) Dribble at waist level using the right hand and then switch to the left hand.
 4) Perform V dribbles side to side, and practice sitting down and standing up while maintaining the dribble.
pe-04118:
1) When a conflict or rule break occurs during PE, students go to the Conflict Corner poster before talking to the teacher.
 2) Step 1: Hold both hands out with palms facing up to relieve stress and reduce tension.
 3) Steps 2-3: One student explains the problem calmly while the other student listens to understand the context.
 4) Steps 4-5: Brainstorm a fair solution together, shake hands, give each other a compliment, and return to the game.
pe-04119:
1) Place two jump ropes parallel on the ground to form a river, with students lined up behind a cone.
 2) The first student runs and jumps across the river between the ropes.
 3) Students must land securely on their feet without falling down.
 4) Anyone who touches the ropes, lands in the water, or crashes down is eliminated and sits behind their cone as the river widens each round.
pe-04120:
1) Measure personal success in games or sports by the effort put in rather than the win-loss record.
 2) Even when losing a game, hold your head high and feel proud if you gave 100 percent effort.
 3) Congratulate the opposing team after the game knowing you did your absolute best.
pe-04121:
1) Remove your shoes, place one foot flat against the sit-and-reach box, and keep the other foot flat on the floor.
 2) Place hands together with fingers aligned and stretch forward along the measurement scale.
 3) On the fourth reach, push as far as possible and hold the position for measurement.
 4) Switch legs and repeat the exact same procedure on the opposite side.
pe-04122:
1) Taggers hold foam noodles while students disperse into open spaces around the gymnasium.
 2) Players are out if they are tagged, step outside boundaries, or fall down.
 3) Tagged students go directly to the teacher standing on the poly dot.
 4) Name one thing they are thankful for to immediately re-enter the game.
pe-04123:
1) Two players enter the yellow square court across the net, while the remaining students wait in line behind the bucket.
 2) Players hit the balloon over the net, using up to three hits (or over in one hit).
 3) A player is out if they hit it four times, hit it out of the court boundaries, or let it land on the floor in their square.
 4) The winner of the single point stays on the court to play the next challenger, while the eliminated player passes the paddle and joins the back of the line.
pe-04124:
1) Set up two stations with a tournament rope and a practice rope, and have students line up in order.
 2) Turners rotate the long jump rope in a large, slow circle moving away from the waiting line.
 3) After the first jumper enters and jumps once, the next student must immediately enter so the rope never turns empty.
 4) If someone misses their turn and let the rope rotate empty or gets caught, they move to the practice rope station.
pe-04125:
1) When the teacher calls out "1, 2, 3", students freeze, drop to sit or take a knee, and focus on the teacher.
 2) If holding equipment, place it on the ground and listen attentively.
 3) While music plays, students jog along the long lines and walk along the short lines.
 4) Maintain personal space and pace without turning it into a race so energy lasts for the warm-up.
pe-04126:
1) Set up 45 numbered cones around the gym with three different rope sizes and hula hoops at each station.
 2) Divide incoming students into small groups of 2 to 3 per cone.
 3) Let students choose either jump ropes or hula hoops at their stations, practicing long ropes and partner tricks.
 4) Students who jump continuously without stopping for 1, 2, 3, or 4 minutes get to write their names on the challenge wall.
pe-04127:
1) Put on jerseys and form teams of three or four; if playing four, rotate players in each time a basket is scored.
 2) Play rock-paper-scissors to determine the first possession on a half court with one hoop.
 3) Every time possession changes, the team must pass the ball to every teammate before taking a shot.
 4) Play continuously without out-of-bounds rules for 3 minutes, scoring one point per made basket.
pe-04128:
1) Set up four cones in the corners of the gym to create a running track.
 2) Set a 5-minute timer and have all students run, jog, or walk around the room as many times as they can in 5 minutes.
 3) Count each lap completed by students using a clicker counter as they run past the teacher.
 4) Divide the total number of laps by the number of students present to determine each class's average laps per student.
pe-04129:
1) Reinforce the most important rule of soccer: no hands.
 2) Each student takes a ball and places it on the floor in their open designated space without dribbling by hand.
 3) Practice various footwork drills with feet while music plays.
 4) When the music stops, immediately tap the top of the ball with the foot to perform a trap and freeze the ball.
pe-04130:
1) Move to the blue square station and prepare for the rope activities.
 2) Complete the 5-second hold test with feet off the ground, or climb the rope to touch the pink scarf at the top.
 3) Students who pass the hold test proceed to the designated start side for rope swinging.
 4) Swing across in one direction toward the mat, land safely, drop the rope, and walk it over to hand it to the next person.
pe-04131:
1) Grip the frisbee with your thumb on top and fingers underneath the rim
 2) Stand sideways, point the disc at your partner, bring it across your body, step forward, and flick your wrist flat
 3) The receiver catches the disc using either a crab claw or an alligator snap
 4) Once partners reach 4 catches together, fist bump, jog a lap around the gym, and repeat
pe-04132:
1) Find an open personal space and jump rope continuously along with the clock and music without making mistakes.
 2) Side swings are not allowed because you must jump over the rope.
 3) If you mess up within the first 15 seconds you get a free restart, but after 15 seconds you must stop and drop your rope.
 4) Jump continuously for 1, 2, or 3 minutes without error to join that endurance club and sign your name on the wall.
pe-04133:
1) One partner stands still in open space with legs apart to make a bridge and raises a hand to watch their partner.
 2) The partner with the soccer ball dribbles through as many bridges as possible in 60 seconds.
 3) Players cannot dribble through the same bridge twice in a row, and the standing partner counts each score.
 4) Partners switch roles after 60 seconds and later attempt to beat their previous high score.
pe-04134:
1) Two students stand on opposite ends of a balance board holding a ball between them.
 2) When the whistle blows, bounce, pull, or bump to make the opponent lose balance.
 3) If your hands come off the ball, drop it, or if your feet step off the board, you lose.
 4) The player who maintains balance on the board the longest without dropping the ball wins.
pe-04135:
1) Enter the gym and immediately find your assigned home base spot.
 2) Following the daily warmup poster, perform the sit-and-reach stretch for 16 counts with one leg straight to prevent injuries.
 3) Perform push-ups or modified push-ups on knees to build upper body strength while maintaining a straight line from shoulders to knees.
 4) Lie flat on the mat and perform curl-ups on teacher cadence to strengthen the abdominal muscles.
pe-04136:
1) Level 1: Perform underhand throws against the wall and catch the ball 5 times in a row.
 2) Level 2: Step back and perform overhand throws with a body twist against the wall, catching 5 times in a row.
 3) Level 3: Move to the center square, find a partner holding up 3 fingers, and complete 5 underhand catches together.
 4) Level 4: Switch to overhand throws with your partner and successfully catch 5 times in a row.
pe-04137:
1) Check the colored cones, line up behind the front knot on the rope, and space out in a zigzag pattern.
 2) Lower your stance to establish a wide base of support while waiting.
 3) Start pulling on the command "Ready, Set, Pull" to drag the knot past the cone.
 4) Let go of the rope immediately when the whistle blows.
pe-04138:
1) Complete a 2 to 3 minute instant activity and return to assigned home base spots.
 2) Follow the stretching routine poster while alternating counting with the teacher.
 3) Perform a couple of curl-ups and push-ups to warm up the whole body.
 4) After several weeks, assign a responsible student leader with a cheat sheet poster to lead the class.
pe-04139:
1) Pair up with a partner where one person serves as the batter and one as the fielder.
 2) The batter hits the ball off the tee aiming to drive it past the fielder to the wall.
 3) The fielder tries to field and stop the ball, preventing it from getting past to the wall.
 4) Switch batter and fielder roles after every single hit.
pe-04140:
1) Rotate through 4 basketball skill stations spending about two minutes at each station.
 2) When called to the quiz station, answer the teacher's assessment questions.
 3) State the three critical cues for basketball dribbling: finger pads, waist level, and eyes up.
pe-04141:
1) A limbo stick is held high at both ends while participants line up to take turns passing underneath.
 2) Players must lead with their belly button first and have their head go last, keeping only their feet touching the ground.
 3) If a player leads with their head, touches the floor with their hands/body, or touches the stick, they are eliminated and sit at their cone to cheer.
 4) After each round where everyone takes a turn, the stick is lowered slightly until only one person remains.
pe-04142:
1) Pair up with one ball and one cone per group.
 2) The player with the ball chooses a throwing line on the gym floor, and the partner sets up the cone anywhere.
 3) Step with the opposite foot and roll the ball underhand close to the floor toward the cone.
 4) Take turns after each roll, and the first person to reach three points wins.
pe-04143:
1) Prepare the throw by swinging the arm holding the ball back (Swing).
 2) Step forward with the foot opposite to the throwing hand (Step).
 3) Follow through smoothly and release the ball toward the target (Throw).
pe-04144:
1) Each child holds a hula hoop like a steering wheel to drive around the room.
 2) React according to traffic commands: walk slowly on yellow, run on green, and stop immediately on red.
 3) Jump in place when pink light is called, and step backward watching your rear on blue light.
 4) Move smoothly around the classroom circle without bumping into others.
pe-04145:
1) Scatter colorful disc cones on the floor while the tagger holds a foam stick.
 2) Players collect safe cones without touching the designated bomb color cones.
 3) Touching the forbidden bomb color or getting tagged by the foam stick results in elimination.
 4) Successfully retrieve all permitted cones while evading the tagger.
pe-04146:
1) Pairs hold a mat together like an ambulance.
 2) Move to the station and place one foam block (patient) onto the mat.
 3) Carefully transport the block to the hospital area without dropping it.
pe-04147:
1) Children warm up in a circle and crawl like various animals such as lions and cats.
 2) One leader becomes a hunter with a foam noodle while the children choose bird or animal roles and flee.
 3) The hunter chases and tags the moving animals while the children dodge around the room.
pe-04148:
1) The teacher walks around knocking down plastic traffic cones onto the floor.
 2) Students must not use their hands and must use only their feet to stand the knocked-down cones back upright.
 3) Students run around to restore all fallen cones as quickly as possible while the teacher continues knocking them down.
pe-04149:
1) Run and escape from the tagger carrying thorns without getting touched.
 2) If touched by the thorn, the student falls asleep on the floor until a friend wakes them up.
 3) While the tagger plays the drum, students run to collect scattered cones one by one.
 4) As soon as the drum sound stops, students must freeze like statues immediately.
pe-04150:
1) The tagger (monster) pretends to sleep guarding the door while runners enter through the allowed gate.
 2) Runners take one food item at a time while the tagger sleeps and run back out.
 3) When the monster wakes up, run back to the safe zone without getting tagged.
 4) Tagged players are put into the prison area.
pe-04151:
1) Set up numbered skittles about 3 to 4 meters away from the launching zone.
 2) Throw the skittle to knock down the target pins.
 3) If you knock down a single pin, you score the points written on that pin; if you knock down more than one pin, you score one point per pin knocked over.
 4) Knocked down pins are set back up right where they fell, and the first to reach exactly 50 points wins (exceeding 50 drops you back to 25).
pe-04152:
1) Set up a 20-meter running track with marked lines and five-meter intervals.
 2) Run from the starting line to the turning line in time with the audio beeps.
 3) Turn around at the 20-meter mark and run back with the next beep.
 4) As levels progress and beeps get faster, run as far as possible to track personal improvement.
pe-04153:
1) Stand behind the throwing line and aim throws at the opponent's row of targets.
 2) Landing in the opponent's target awards points or assigns that number of exercises to the opponent.
 3) Landing in your own target requires you to perform the assigned exercises.
 4) If an object lands in the final target and 'Moose' is called, sprint around the playing area; the first one back earns bonus points.
pe-04154:
1) Check the animal shown on the alphabet card.
 2) Leap around the room 10 times like an alligator.
 3) Jump 20 times in place.
 4) Imitate the featured animal movements such as balancing and looking around like a bear.
pe-04155:
1) Spin a wheel featuring various Fortnite emotes to select which dance to learn.
 2) Break down the chosen dance steps into simple arm and leg movements together with the instructor.
 3) Combine the upper and lower body movements to the beat and practice the routine repeatedly.
pe-04156:
1) Learn three body levels: Bear (high), Ninja (medium), and Cowboy (low), where Bear beats Ninja, Ninja beats Cowboy, and Cowboy beats Bear.
 2) Move freely around the play area in an everybody's-it tag format.
 3) Tag others to make them sit; if two tag each other simultaneously, play Bear Ninja Cowboy by turning back-to-back, jumping, spinning, and showing poses.
 4) The loser sits and watches the player who tagged them, returning to the game once that player gets eliminated.
pe-04157:
1) Line up behind a cone facing a 4x4 grid of 16 cups concealing pairs of shapes underneath.
 2) The first runner rushes out and flips over two cups to check for matching shapes.
 3) If they match, keep the shapes and leave the cups overturned; if not, re-cover them and return to tag the next teammate.
 4) Communicate positions verbally with teammates until all matching pairs are solved.
pe-04158:
1) Practice keeping the balloon in the air by striking it softly with an open hand.
 2) Practice setting by pushing like a jack-in-the-box and forearm passing with clasped hands using leg power.
 3) Practice spiking through the superhero progression of Thor, Hawkeye, and Hulk smash.
 4) Play a game where one person tries to hit the balloon down while two players try to keep it up.
pe-04159:
1) Two or more players stand facing each other or sit down in a ready position with knees bent.
 2) Players toss a ball back and forth continuously without letting it touch the ground or any objects.
 3) Count the total number of catches or the length of time sustained until the ball is dropped.
pe-04160:
1) Divide the field into two halves using cones and set up team boxes on opposite ends.
 2) Cross the center line toward the opposite box without getting tagged; the team that gets all players into the opposing box wins.
 3) If tagged across the center line, sit down immediately; a teammate must cross over and high-five you to grant a safe walk back with hands on heads.
 4) When the leader calls 'Yoshi!', all tagging stops and everyone sprints to the opposing box, while sitting players must run to touch the center line first before sprinting to the box.
pe-04161:
1) Partners face each other, step into the middle to greet on a 4-count, and return to their spots.
 2) Hook right arms to skip in a circle for 8 counts, then repeat with left arms for 8 counts.
 3) Do-si-do around the right shoulder for 8 counts, then repeat around the left shoulder for 8 counts.
 4) As the class stomps and claps, the lead couple shuffles down and back, peels to the outside to form a bridge, and other dancers pass through.
pe-04162:
1) Set up two posts with a cone and a ball on top of each post, and prepare one frisbee.
 2) Players throw the frisbee from behind their own post toward the opponent's post and ball.
 3) Hitting the post or cone and knocking the ball down scores 1 point, while hitting the ball directly scores 3 points.
 4) If the defending team catches the falling ball before it hits the ground no points are scored, and teams typically play to 11 points (going over 11 drops back to 5).
pe-04163:
1) Divide the gym into two halves with a center line and place a bench near the back wall on each side.
 2) Players hit by a ball put hands on their heads and move to the opposing bench jail.
 3) A player escapes jail when catching an airborne ball thrown by a teammate while keeping both feet on the bench.
 4) In-court defenders can block or catch passes intended for prisoners on the bench.
pe-04164:
1) Begin by throwing and catching underhand with two hands to get in position.
 2) Progress to throwing and catching with one hand.
 3) Strike the ball over the net using hands instead of paddles.
 4) Use actual paddles to strike the ball across the net or marked line.
pe-04165:
1) Divide into one thrower and a catching group (4-6 players) and set a target score of 10 points.
 2) The thrower calls out a point value and condition (alive in the air, or dead after bouncing) then throws the ball.
 3) Catchers who successfully catch the ball according to the condition earn and accumulate those points.
 4) The player who reaches 10 points or catches a jackpot ball becomes the new thrower.
pe-04166:
1) Start nice and close to the basketball hoop and take a shot.
 2) Once you make the shot, back up to the next target further away and shoot again.
 3) If you miss a shot, your turn ends and you pass the ball to the next player; when your turn returns, you resume from your last achieved target.
 4) After making the furthest shot, gradually move back closer to the hoop to finish the course.
pe-04167:
1) Set up 3 bowling pins near each team's end line and place balls on the centerline.
 2) Assign 1-2 secret or designated doctors per team who can revive eliminated players.
 3) Hit players sit down and rejoin the game when their doctor taps their shoulder.
 4) The team that knocks over all 3 opposing pins or eliminates all opposing players wins, and downing a pin frees all teammates.
pe-04168:
1) Place a beanbag on a spot marker and have partners stand facing each other about one meter away.
 2) While music plays, both students perform predetermined exercises or follow a leader at their own pace.
 3) The instant music stops, both react immediately to grab the beanbag first.
 4) The student who gets the beanbag celebrates with good sportsmanship, returns the beanbag to the spot marker, and resets.
pe-04169:
1) Distribute pennies so participants are green (plants 50-60%), yellow (herbivores 20-30%), and red (omnivores 10-20%) and set the boundary.
 2) Green players run to survive and avoid being tagged by yellow and red.
 3) Yellow players can tag green while trying to avoid being tagged by red.
 4) Red players can tag anyone in yellow or green and cannot be tagged.
pe-04170:
1) Two players lie on their backs side by side facing opposite directions with elbows near the center of the mat.
 2) Interlock arms, lift the inside legs, and count to two while touching toes.
 3) On the count of three, lock legs together and pull the opponent toward your direction.
 4) The losing player rolls over backward across their shoulder.
pe-04171:
1) A group of 5 (or 4–12) students forms a circle, ensuring each person passes across rather than to the person directly beside them.
 2) The ball starts at number 1 and follows a fixed sequence (1 to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 4, 4 to 5, 5 back to 1) to trace a star pattern.
 3) Work cooperatively to send and receive the object as quickly and smoothly as possible without dropping it.
 4) Progress by adding a second ball or having players run to switch spots after passing.
pe-04172:
1) Stand with your opposite shoulder and foot facing the target.
 2) Step forward with the opposite foot, rotate hips, and lead with the elbow to release.
 3) Beginners catch by pointing pinkies together to form a basket in front of the body.
 4) As proficiency improves, use hands to form a window triangle to catch the ball.
pe-04173:
1) Get ready to move along colorful shape decals placed on the hallway floor.
 2) Stay on your feet without running, crawling, or lying down in the hallway.
 3) Walk on the right side of the hallway, follow the directional arrows, and move at a controllable pace.
 4) Move quietly and respectfully to keep your body regulated without disrupting neighboring classrooms.
pe-04174:
1) Form a small group of 2 to 5 players and have the first player take a shot from any chosen spot or style.
 2) If the first player makes the shot, the next player must attempt the exact same shot.
 3) If a player fails to replicate the successful shot, they receive a letter of the word HORSE.
 4) If the shooter misses, the turn ends without penalty; the game ends when a player completes the word HORSE, and the player with the fewest letters wins.
pe-04175:
1) Set up five baseline kubbs on each side and place one king in the center.
 2) Throw batons underhand from behind the baseline to knock down opponent kubbs.
 3) Knocked kubbs are thrown into the opposing half as field kubbs and must be downed before baseline kubbs.
 4) The team that downs all opponent kubbs and then successfully knocks down the king wins the game.
pe-04176:
1) Divide the playing field into four quadrants, placing a large pylon and a bucket in each quarter with 10 saucer cones stacked on each pylon.
 2) Players choose to play defense protecting their own cones or offense stealing opponent cones.
 3) Offensive players enter opposing zones to steal one cone at a time and return it to their team bucket.
 4) If tagged by a defender in an opposing zone, the attacker must put hands on head and return to their own quadrant before attempting another steal.
pe-04177:
1) Divide students into small groups of 2-3 behind perimeter cones, with the first player holding a pool noodle.
 2) Enter the designated rectangle arena on signal and attempt to tag opponents below the waist using the pool noodle.
 3) Block incoming strikes with your noodle; players simultaneously hitting each other below the waist are both out.
 4) When tagged below the waist, hold the noodle over your head, run back to hand it to the next teammate, and join the back of the line.
pe-04178:
1) Place three coins on a long table with space between each coin.
 2) Slide one coin completely through the space between the other two coins to continue your turn down the table.
 3) Your turn ends if a coin fails to pass through, collides with another coin, or slides off the table.
 4) After crossing the center line, take a shot off the far end of the table and catch the coin to score a goal.
pe-04179:
1) Perform ball-handling drills in place by wrapping the ball around the waist, knees, and head in both directions.
 2) Practice the corkscrew pattern (head-waist-knees-knees-waist-head) and roll the ball in a figure-eight pattern through the legs.
 3) Assume the triple-threat stance and practice stationary dribbling with both hands at low, medium, and high heights.
 4) Practice crossovers, front and side windshield wipers, through-the-legs dribbling, and behind-the-back dribbling.
pe-04180:
1) Start with a free-for-all setup where every player is standing and can move anywhere in the gym.
 2) Pick up a ball and try to hit other players from the waist down, and hit players must sit on the floor.
 3) A sitting player who gets a ball can stand back up by hitting any standing player in the legs.
 4) Sitting players can pass the ball to each other to form a chain, and if the last player hits a standing player, everyone in that chain stands back up.
pe-04181:
1) Divide the class into two teams, with each team standing on one half of the gym.
 2) Distribute dodgeballs to each team or line them up on the center line for players to rush and grab at the start.
 3) If a player gets hit by a ball, they are out and must sit down where they were hit or on the side of the gym for the remainder of the game.
pe-04182:
1) Display pictures of Nazca lines such as birds, geometric shapes, or school initials on a screen.
 2) Students collaborate and communicate to recreate the shape by laying down on the gym floor.
 3) Start with simple shapes like circles and advance to more complex figures.
pe-04183:
1) Hold the cut-off top funnel section of a plastic bottle in your hand.
 2) Line up along markers or cones placed on the floor.
 3) Catch the small ball tossed by the teacher or student thrower using the bottle.
 4) The player who successfully catches the ball moves forward to the next marker, aiming to be the first to reach the furthest point.
pe-04184:
1) Divide the gym into a daytime side and a nighttime side, then select two taggers and two fairies with wands.
 2) Tagged runners go to the nighttime side, lie down, and count down from 10 to 1.
 3) Fairies tap the sleeping students with magic wands to free them back to the daytime side.
pe-04185:
1) Choose one favorite option between two Christmas items shown on the screen.
 2) Do side lunges if choosing candy cane, or high kicks if choosing hot chocolate.
 3) Do moving tree if choosing Christmas tree, or gallop if choosing sleigh ride.
 4) Hold a side plank if choosing presents, or do toe touches if choosing Christmas dinner.
pe-04186:
1) Set up small duel arenas using lines or cones where two fighters enter and others cheer along the boundary.
 2) Each dueler holds a pool noodle sword in one hand and balances a bean bag on a racket in the other.
 3) On the go signal, players attempt to knock the bean bag off the opponent's racket while keeping their own balanced.
 4) The player whose bean bag falls off exits, and the winner stays in the arena to face the next challenger.
pe-04187:
1) Form a circle with cones, place one sleeping bear curled up in the center, and have hunters kneel or sit around the circle.
 2) The bear secretly chooses a number between 1 and 12 without saying it aloud.
 3) Hunters chant until the count matches the secret number, at which point the bear wakes up and tags players for 1 minute.
 4) Tagged players enter the cave and become bears alongside the original bear for subsequent rounds.
pe-04188:
1) Students pair up in a wheelbarrow walk stance with one holding the ankles of the other.
 2) On the whistle, pairs head toward one of three cones placed at varying distances representing bronze, silver, and gold.
 3) Move around the chosen cone without breaking apart and return.
 4) Switch roles and attempt another distance challenge.
pe-04189:
1) Set up two lines about 20 feet apart in the gym and have students line up.
 2) The first runner walks to the end line and stares at a brick on the wall without looking back.
 3) The second runner sneaks up quietly and taps the first runner on the shoulder or back.
 4) The tapped runner immediately turns around and chases the tagger back to the starting line, then joins the back of another line.
pe-04190:
1) Set up mats as pyramids with bean bags underneath and assign team hoops; the defending team guards inside the designated middle area while attacking caravans move out together.
 2) Evade defenders to retrieve one bean bag at a time from a pyramid and return it to your hoop for points (side pyramids 1 point, great pyramid 3 points).
 3) If tagged in the guard zone, freeze in place until a teammate riding a scooter board (camel) rescues you and brings you back to touch your hoop.
 4) If tagged while carrying a bean bag, return the bean bag neatly under the pyramid and wait at the tagged spot for camel rescue.
pe-04191:
1) Place crash mats in the center of both goal areas and surround them with exercise mats.
 2) Play with team handball rules allowing players a maximum of three steps and 3 seconds of ball possession.
 3) Score a point by making a diving catch towards the crash mat and landing successfully on it.
 4) Restrict diving to only one offensive player and one defensive player at a time to prevent collisions.
pe-04192:
1) Build Stonehenge structures with mats, place cones on top, and set plastic pins in the center.
 2) Defenders in the center knock balls away to protect structures.
 3) Attacking teams throw foam balls to knock down pins (1 pt), cones (3 pts), or stone structures (5 pts).
 4) Throwers who knock down an item must retrieve it and bring it to their team corner.
pe-04193:
1) Partners face each other with a plastic pin placed between them.
 2) The player with the ball rolls it on the floor trying to knock down the pin.
 3) If the ball misses, the partner collects it and rolls it back.
 4) When a player knocks the pin over, the pin advances one spot closer to that player until it reaches the goal line.
pe-04194:
1) Place one playground ball in the middle of the parachute while students hold the edges.
 2) Position designated catchers around the outside area of the parachute.
 3) Students holding the parachute work together to launch the ball high into the air.
 4) The outside players try to catch the ball before it hits the ground, and a player who catches it switches spots with someone holding the parachute.
pe-04195:
1) All students spread out across the gym with no teams in a free-for-all format.
 2) Before throwing at an opponent, players must bounce the dodgeball off the wall and catch their own rebound.
 3) Hit players must sit down.
 4) A sitting player rejoins the game when the person who knocked them out gets hit.
pe-04196:
1) Extend arms out to the sides to act as an airplane throughout the round.
 2) Balance across the bench and fly low underneath the skipping rope tied to chairs.
 3) Dodge through the cones, kick foam balls, and spin inside hula hoops.
 4) Jump over hurdles, move backwards through the agility ladder, and rest on mats if tired.
pe-04197:
1) From the starting line, players use an underhand toss to land a beanbag into a hula hoop on the court line.
 2) Each successful toss allows them to move the hoop to the next line, returning to start and repeating until finished.
 3) Balance the beanbag on the head while spinning a hula hoop in hand and travel across the gym and back.
 4) Kick the hula hoop along the floor so that it touches each subsequent line until reaching the goal.
pe-04198:
1) Divide into two teams separated by the center line on their respective sides.
 2) Throw dodgeballs at the opposing team's players.
 3) If a player gets hit, that player crosses over to the opposing team's side and touches the back wall.
 4) After touching the wall, that player becomes a member of the opposing team.
pe-04199:
1) Mark out a center circle or area as the barn, and all players sit on scooters.
 2) A few cowboys hold hula hoops while riding scooters, and the rest are horses on scooters.
 3) Cowboys try to round up horses into the barn, and caught horses must go inside.
 4) As a variation, place orange beanbags as carrots on the floor for horses to collect before being caught.
pe-04200:
1) Follow the teacher in the snow to stamp out pathways that form the shape of a sliced pizza.
 2) Place one tagger in the center of the pizza.
 3) The tagger chases the runners while staying strictly on the stamped lines.
 4) Tagged players become the new tagger in the middle and perform 10 repetitions of an exercise before chasing.
pe-04201:
1) Four students start as astronauts with a balloon tied to their ankle with string.
 2) The rest of the students act as Martians and try to pop the astronauts' balloons.
 3) When an astronaut's balloon is popped, they become a Martian and help pop remaining balloons.
 4) Once all balloons are popped, four new students become astronauts for the next round.
pe-04202:
1) Set up mats on their ends as goals on both sides and divide into two teams.
 2) Throw beach balls into play; players move freely between halves and kick the balls.
 3) Use feet, knees, or head to keep the ball up and pass without using hands or arms.
 4) Score one point whenever a beach ball lands inside the opponent's mat goal.
pe-04203:
1) Players form groups of four, where three players join hands facing inward to form a triangle and one player becomes the tagger.
 2) The player in the triangle positioned across from the tagger is designated as the target.
 3) The tagger moves clockwise or counterclockwise around the outside to tag the target, while the triangle players work together to block.
 4) The tagger cannot pass through the triangle; once a tag is made, players switch roles.
pe-04204:
1) The first player walks about 20 ft to the end line, stares at a brick on the wall, and never looks back.
 2) The second player quietly sneaks up behind the first player.
 3) The second player taps the first player on the shoulder or back and sprints back toward the start line.
 4) As soon as tapped, the first player turns around and chases to tag the runner before they reach the start line.
pe-04205:
1) Cut recycled plastic bottles in half, flip the top half upside down as the shuttle, and place the bottom half on the ground.
 2) Set up a series of cones from the starting line to the finish line, with players lining up at the start.
 3) Hold the shuttle part and drop it, aiming to land it into the bottom bottle container on the floor.
 4) Advance to the next cone only when the shuttle successfully lands inside, and the first player to reach the finish line wins.
pe-04206:
1) Place 10 to 15 different exercise posters in the middle circle.
 2) When music plays, perform the chosen exercise continuously for 1 minute.
 3) Take a quick 20-second break when the music stops to rest and transition to a new exercise.
 4) Take an extended water/rest break after completing 6 to 10 minutes of exercise.
pe-04207:
1) Place four nets in the corners facing the wall and divide into four teams.
 2) Introduce four bouncy balls and strike them with open hands to move them.
 3) Throwing, catching, rolling, or running with the ball is not allowed; only striking is permitted.
 4) Score goals by striking the ball directly or off walls into the nets.
pe-04208:
1) Place five large objects in a semicircle within the playing area and number them 1 to 5 from left to right.
 2) The counter closes their eyes at the center and counts down from 10 to 1 while players hide behind one of the objects.
 3) When the count ends, the counter calls out a player's name and a number; if that player is behind that object, they are out.
 4) Shorten the countdown by one second in each subsequent round (9, 8, 7...) until the last remaining player wins.
pe-04209:
1) Divide the gym into two halves, keeping each team strictly on its own side.
 2) Players throw foam footballs to hit targets on the perimeter such as pins, tchoukball rebounders, or basketball rims.
 3) Hitting a target earns the thrower a basketball skill attempt: a layup for hitting a pin, a jump shot for a rim, or player's choice for a rebounder.
 4) Successfully making the shot allows the player to place one bean bag into their scoring bin after returning the basketball; score is tallied after 3-5 minute rounds.
pe-04210:
1) Each student tucks a tail flag or scarf into their shorts and spreads out in the gym.
 2) Run around trying to protect your own tail while swiping as many tails as possible from others.
 3) A player whose tail is taken is not out and can continue swiping tails from others.
 4) The round ends when time is called or all tails are taken, and the player with the most tails wins.
pe-04211:
1) Spread colored poly spots around the gym with basic math equations hidden underneath.
 2) Most students stand on a poly spot while a few extra students start without a spot.
 3) When the teacher calls out two colors, players on those colors and the extra players race to switch and claim a spot.
 4) Players who secure a spot check their hidden math problem and perform that number of jumping jacks.
pe-04212:
1) Set up a canyon zone 15 to 20 feet wide in the middle with cones or lines and place benches behind both team areas.
 2) Play with standard dodgeball rules; a tagged player must enter the canyon and run across to the other side to rejoin the team.
 3) If hit again while running in the canyon, the player must go to the far bench behind the opposing team.
 4) A player on the bench is freed and rejoins the team if they catch a throw launched by a teammate, and the team wins by sending all opponents to the bench.
pe-04213:
1) Two to six players determine shooting order, and the first shooter attempts a set shot from any spot of their choice.
 2) If the set shot goes in, each subsequent player must shoot from that exact same spot.
 3) If a player fails to match the made shot, that player receives a letter toward spelling HORSE.
 4) If the set shooter misses, they do not receive a letter, the turn rotates to the next player to set a new shot, and the first player to spell the complete word is eliminated.
pe-04214:
1) Divide the area into two halves; statues stand on chairs at each end while one player per team starts as the thrower behind the throwing line.
 2) On the whistle, throwers toss foam balls to their teammates standing on the chairs.
 3) When a player on a chair catches a ball, they are saved and join the throwing line to become additional throwers.
 4) Throwers may enter the court to retrieve loose balls but must return behind the throwing line before throwing again.
pe-04215:
1) Place multiple hula hoops on one end of the gym and put toys or bean bags inside each hoop.
 2) Teams line up in relay formation behind a designated line set at an appropriate distance from the hoops.
 3) The first player of each team rolls or kicks a foam ball toward the hoops to hit a toy.
 4) If a toy is hit, the player retrieves both the ball and the toy back to the team line; if missed, they retrieve only the ball and pass the turn to the next player.
pe-04216:
1) Choose one tagger.
 2) Everyone including the tagger wears a blindfold.
 3) The tagger moves making slight sounds using fun sticks.
 4) When touched by a fun stick, take off the blindfold and move to the wall.
pe-04217:
1) Participants stand by the cones and attach a tail to their back.
 2) On the signal, run around the cone.
 3) Move to the next cone and run around it in the same way.
 4) If you pull off the person in front's tail, you score 1 point and they are out.
pe-04218:
1) Run to the turning point holding the long rope
 2) Add one person into the rope after returning
 3) The person who enters the rope waits until it becomes taut
 4) The team that gets everyone inside the rope first wins
pe-04219:
1) Arrange chairs in a circle, leaving one empty.
 2) The 'it' tries to sit in the empty chair, while others move to block them.
 3) If the 'it' sits in the empty chair, the roles switch.
pe-04220:
1) Perform the action when the teacher says "Simon says" before the instruction.
 2) If the instruction is given without "Simon says" or if you trip on the rope, perform 2 squats.
 3) Continue jumping rope after the squats.
pe-04221:
1) Hold two long ropes at different heights to define the area.
 2) If you touch the rope, you are out.
 3) The person who survives without touching the rope wins.
pe-04222:
1) Stand in a line and hold hands
 2) The person on the inside starts by stepping on a hula hoop or marker with one foot
 3) Move on the signal; if hands break or the foot leaves the marker, the team loses
 4) The team that returns to the start and holds hands first wins
pe-04223:
1) Sandwich catch: Stand sideways and catch the disc by pressing it from above and below.
 2) One-hand catch: Catch the disc with one hand.
 3) Two-hand catch: Use both hands if one-hand catch is difficult.
 4) Throwing: Place your index finger on the side of the disc, put your thumb on top, and throw using wrist snap.
pe-04224:
1) Pairs take three markers each.
 2) One person stays in place and jumps.
 3) The other places markers forward to move.
 4) Switch roles and repeat.
pe-04225:
1) Run to the spot on the start signal and bounce the ball.
 2) Bounce the ball 5 times with the left hand and 5 times with the right hand.
 3) Bring back one marker after completing the mission.
 4) Complete 100 bounces using this method.
pe-04226:
1) Set up buckets and face each other in groups.
 2) Score 1 point if the flying disc hits the bucket, or 2 points if it goes directly inside.
 3) Score 3 points if a teammate waiting behind the bucket hits it in with their hand.
 4) Catching the disc and placing it in the bucket by hand is not allowed.
pe-04227:
1) It is a competition played in pairs taking turns.
 2) Place an odd number of soccer balls in the center of the game area, and put the balls into goals placed upside down on both sides.
 3) Before high-fiving the next team member, the waiting friend continues to switch their feet on the soccer ball.
pe-04228:
1) Two people play rock-paper-scissors.
 2) The winner becomes a star and struts around proudly.
 3) The loser becomes a fan and follows behind cheering for the star.
 4) Switch partners and repeat the rock-paper-scissors game.
pe-04229:
1) Divide into 3 teams of 2, with 2 attacking teams and 1 defending team.
 2) The attacking team must hit the balloon over to the opponent's side within 3 hits.
 3) The defending team can only move sideways and scores 1 point by touching the balloon.
 4) The attacking team scores like in volleyball, and roles rotate after 3 points.
pe-04230:
1) Everyone except the ghost train conductor sits in a circle and closes their eyes.
 2) The conductor walks around the circle and taps one person on the shoulder at a time.
 3) Those who become ghosts join the back of the train and hold hands.
 4) If you think you are the last one left, open your eyes.
 5) The train circles the last person.
pe-04231:
1) Stand with 2 people on each side of the net.
 2) Serve by scooping the ball from bottom to top with both hands.
 3) When receiving a serve, let the ball bounce once before hitting it up.
 4) Every player must touch the ball in turn before sending it over.
 5) Once practiced, try to send it over in three touches with one bounce.
pe-04232:
1) Arrange hula hoops in a 4x4 or 5x5 grid
 2) Team members take turns running to place a team vest inside an empty hoop
 3) The first team to complete a line horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins
pe-04233:
1) Run around the cones placed in a circle.
 2) Pass the baton to the next runner.
 3) The game ends when the last runner touches the finish.
 4) Change the running direction when the whistle blows twice.
pe-04234:
1) Keep the ball alive in a team one-bounce volleyball rally.
 2) Compete in inter-team one-bounce volleyball passing endurance.
 3) Give each team 3 attempts.
 4) Compare team wins and losses based on the longest count among the 3 attempts.
pe-04235:
1) Stand in a circle and spread your legs shoulder-width apart.
 2) Roll the ball with your hands to pass it between another friend's legs.
 3) Block the ball coming toward your legs with your hands and counterattack immediately.
 4) If you fail to block the ball, you are out and play the role of picking up the ball from outside.
pe-04236:
1) Divide into Team A and Team B and take positions in the designated areas.
 2) Determine the starting order with rock-paper-scissors and start from the goalkeeper.
 3) Pass the ball in sequence from the goalkeeper through each zone to the goal, or pass between teammates using the middle player.
 4) Players can hit or catch the ball to gain possession for their team.
pe-04237:
1) Press your head down with both hands for 10 seconds
 2) Push your chin up with both hands for 10 seconds
 3) Pull your head to the side with one hand for 10 seconds
 4) Rotate your wrists, ankles, and waist
pe-04239:
1) Place action markers on the ground to indicate the starting point and direction for long jump rope.
 2) Students move along the arrow directions while jumping in the figure-8 rope.
pe-04240:
1) Distribute police and villain cards to students.
 2) Set the timer for 1 minute and 30 seconds.
 3) Students walk around and play rock-paper-scissors when they meet.
 4) The loser must walk like a duck, while the winner walks normally.
 5) Students walking like ducks play against each other, and standing students play against each other to stand up.
 6) The team with more standing students at the end wins.
pe-04241:
1) Half the class sits on chairs and the other half stays in the center space
 2) Students on chairs throw the ball to hit those in the center
 3) If hit, the student sits on a chair and the student on the chair enters the center
 4) The team in the center gets 1 point when the 3-minute timer ends
pe-04242:
1) While the tagger says "The Mugunghwa flower has bloomed" with their back turned, students clap their hands back and forth in place.
 2) When the tagger gives a mission, students perform it.
 3) If a student moves when the tagger turns around, they must restart clapping.
 4) The first to clap 30 times and stand on a chair with their hands up wins.
pe-04243:
1) Move around to the music
 2) Hit the desk on the first beat and clap on the remaining beats
 3) You cannot hit the same desk twice in a row
 4) When the teacher rings the bell, the last desk you hit becomes your seat
pe-04244:
1) Divide into two zones and give each team a ball of a different color.
 2) Start by rolling your team's ball to hit the opponent's legs.
 3) If the opponent's ball stops in your zone, kick it back within 3 seconds.
 4) If hit by the opponent's ball, you are out and sit around the opponent's zone.
pe-04245:
1) Choose 2 to 4 taggers and send them to the waiting room.
 2) The remaining students check the given animal problem.
 3) At the teacher's start signal, students simultaneously express the problem with their bodies.
 4) Taggers type the answer in the chat, and the student who writes it correctly first earns 1 point.
pe-04246:
1) Start from the starting line and run through the zigzag cones
 2) Return through the zigzag cones
 3) Tag the next runner
 4) If a cone falls, it must be set up again
pe-04247:
1) Place 10 jumbo stacks and 4 beanbags for each team and assign a guardian.
 2) Run from the start line to the opponent's stack and play rock-paper-scissors with the guardian.
 3) If you win, bring the stack to your team's marker; if you lose, return empty-handed.
 4) Once all stacks are taken, compete for beanbags; each stack is 1 point and each beanbag is 2 points.
pe-04248:
1) Gather in a circle and cross your arms in front of your chest.
 2) The tagger outside the circle tries to touch those inside.
 3) Those inside push back with their backs to stay in.
 4) If you are touched or pushed out, you become the tagger.
pe-04249:
1) Create an S-shaped court and place treasures at both ends.
 2) Teams start from their respective bases.
 3) Hop along the outside of the S-shaped court and play Rock-Paper-Scissors when meeting an opponent.
 4) The winner continues, while the loser returns to the base to restart.
 5) The team that reaches the opponent's base and takes the treasure first wins.
pe-04250:
1) Set up signals like hula hoops, cones, and sticks on the field.
 2) Perform the designated movement for each signal.
 3) Move to the finish line as quickly as possible while performing movements accurately.
 4) If a movement is incorrect, restart from the beginning of that signal.
pe-04251:
1) Set up bases at both ends and line up in teams
 2) At the signal, the leaders run to meet
 3) Play rock-paper-scissors
 4) The loser returns to their base, and the winner continues forward
pe-04252:
1) Divide the court into two with a line in the middle.
 2) Scatter balls in both team's zones.
 3) On the signal, pick up balls and throw them into the opponent's zone.
 4) Count the balls in each zone when the signal ends; the team with fewer balls wins.
pe-04253:
1) Decide roles for 'Okonomiyaki' and 'The person who bakes'.
 2) The 'Okonomiyaki' lies in a prone position.
 3) 'The person who bakes' tries to flip the Okonomiyaki, while the 'Okonomiyaki' tries not to be flipped.
 4) If successfully flipped, 'The person who bakes' wins, and players switch roles to play again.
pe-04254:
1) Move with rhythm using hop-skips and play rock-paper-scissors with someone nearby.
 2) The loser stops behind the winner and places their hands on their shoulders.
 3) Move with rhythm using hop-skips while connected.
 4) Change the music rhythm to play.
pe-04255:
1) Prepare the court according to the number of people.
 2) Crouch down and grab both ankles with both hands.
 3) Move while crouching and push opponents with your shoulders or back to knock them down.
 4) If knocked down, you go out of the court, and the person who remains without falling within the time limit wins.
pe-04256:
1) The leader says the starting phrase.
 2) The leader calls out a direction such as front, back, left, or right.
 3) Participants jump while saying the directed direction.
pe-04257:
1) Three people form a team and hold poles to make a triangle.
 2) All three let go of their hands simultaneously, move to the next pole, and catch the pole before it falls.
 3) If even one pole falls, it is disqualified.
 4) The team that travels a longer distance wins.
pe-04258:
1) Prepare one ball for a pair.
 2) Pass the ball and run to the opposite side to catch it.
 3) The person who receives the ball turns around and passes it.
 4) Once comfortable, run around the partner after passing and catch the ball.
pe-04259:
1) Place your hands and feet on the floor with your belly facing up.
 2) Lift your hips high.
 3) Move forward, backward, and sideways.
pe-04260:
1) Grab the bar and hold the 'swallow' pose with arms straight.
 2) Look at your belly button and roll forward slowly.
 3) Bend your arms to land slowly.
pe-04261:
1) Step into each square with one foot
 2) Step into each square with two feet
 3) Step sideways into each square with two feet
 4) Step sideways into each square with two feet in the opposite direction
pe-04263:
1) Stand facing your partner
 2) One person kicks the ball to the other
 3) The partner stops the ball
 4) Take turns repeating the process
pe-04264:
1) Lift the ball high
 2) Turn your body
 3) Bounce the ball with your calf
 4) Kick the ball up with your heel to continue lifting
pe-04265:
1) Lie on your stomach
 2) Lift your right leg
 3) Lift your left arm
 4) Hold for 10 seconds and repeat with the opposite arm and leg
pe-04266:
1) Stand in two lines of 4 people facing each other
 2) Throw and catch the ball
 3) Practice with one bounce first
 4) Once comfortable, try without bouncing
pe-04267:
1) The coach tosses the ball and the player performs a volley shot while watching the ball carefully
 2) Practice inside volley shots
 3) Practice instep volley shots
pe-04268:
1) The attacker throws the ball.
 2) The defender watches the ball closely.
 3) The defender moves sideways quickly to dodge the ball.
pe-04269:
1) Keep arms close to your sides and use wrists to turn the rope
 2) Keep body straight and face forward
 3) Bend knees slightly and jump on toes
pe-04271:
1) Swing the rope over your head
 2) Cross your arms at waist level as the rope passes over your head
 3) Cross your arms deeply so that your elbows overlap
pe-04272:
1) Stand in a straight posture and jump in place on your toes.
 2) Land with feet together without bending your knees.
 3) In pairs, one person jumps while the other gently presses on their shoulders to help with the rhythm.
pe-04273:
1) Jump onto the bar holding it with both hands
 2) Place the area slightly below the navel on the bar
 3) Bend the waist to fold the body in two and hang
 4) Shift the bar position toward the navel to lift the body
pe-04274:
1) Turn the rope quickly while standing straight.
 2) Jump high and pass the rope twice.
 3) Use elbows and wrists to draw small circles without swinging arms too wide.
pe-04275:
1) Dodge the incoming ball and turn your body in the dodging direction following the instructor's demonstration.
 2) Catch the incoming ball firmly with both hands.
 3) Throw the ball accurately by rotating your torso.
pe-04276:
1) Hold the jump rope with both hands.
 2) Jump continuously one by one at your own pace.
 3) Keep your body straight and avoid bending your knees backward.
pe-04277:
1) Practice pushing the vaulting box backward while placing hands.
 2) Practice placing hands and feet on the floor while spreading legs.
 3) Practice taking a run-up and jumping onto the vaulting box.
 4) Practice landing on the mat and raising both hands high.
pe-04278:
1) Jump upward on your toes without bending your knees deeply.
 2) Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your body while jumping.
 3) Cross your arms deeply without using them too excessively when doing cross jumps.
 4) Jump high in a 1, 2, 3, 4 rhythm when performing double unders.
pe-04280:
1) Observe the basic concept and method of lifting introduced in the video.
 2) Practice keeping the football in the air by tapping it with your feet without dropping it.
 3) Examine the detailed footwork by watching the advanced slow-motion demonstration.
 4) Practice consistently while having fun.
pe-04281:
1) Sit shallowly on the chair.
 2) Face the upper body and lower body in the throwing direction.
 3) Relax your shoulders and swing your entire arm widely to throw the ball.
pe-04282:
1) Hold the edges of the cloth and balance it
 2) Put the balls on the cloth into each container
 3) Place the containers with the balls on the stand to succeed
pe-04283:
1) The radish group sits on the floor, back-to-back, and links arms
 2) The human group works together to pull the radish group
 3) The time limit is 1 minute
pe-04284:
1) Practice basic rocking by hugging knees on the floor.
 2) Practice rocking larger by lifting legs high.
 3) Practice straddle forward roll rocking by opening legs wide near the floor.
 4) Practice in a zigzag formation on the mat to avoid collisions.
pe-04285:
1) The tagger and the runner stand facing each other 1-on-1
 2) On the signal, the runner tries to reach the goal (cone) without being tagged
 3) The first to reach the goal wins
pe-04286:
1) Crouch with hands on the mat
 2) Kick legs into the air while supporting with hands
 3) Keep eyes between hands
 4) Slightly bend elbows to feel the weight
pe-04287:
1) Crossing the river: Squat down, place hands on the mat, and move to the other side.
 2) Jumping over sideways: From a standing position, place hands on the mat, support the body, and move to the other side.
pe-04288:
1) Cross by holding one bar at a time
 2) Cross by skipping one bar
 3) Cross by holding bars sideways
 4) Climb on top and cross
 5) Swing and jump while hanging
 6) Swing and move to the next bar while hanging
pe-04289:
1) Stand in a pike position with hands and head on the mat.
 2) Swing legs forward once hips pass over the head.
 3) Extend the waist, arch the back, and push off the mat to spring up.
 4) Land with toes close to the body.
pe-04290:
1) Place your hands far ahead and roll with your legs extended.
 2) After rolling, look at your stomach, round your body, and touch the back of your head, back, waist, and hips in order.
 3) Land on both feet and stand up.
pe-04291:
1) Start from a four-point kneeling position.
 2) Support your body with your elbows and toes, keeping your body straight.
 3) Hold the position for 30 seconds.
 4) Once comfortable, alternate lifting your right arm and left leg.
pe-04292:
1) Preparation) Stand in front of the mat, bend your knees, sit down, and roll backward.

 3) Repeat the activity by moving around the gym in order.
pe-04419:
1) Transport pool noodles (fossils) using only the assigned body part per group.
 2) Pass through the hula hoop (cleaners) obstacles to the other side.
 3) Ensure only the designated body part is used to get through the hoops.
 4) Drop off the fossil at the landing pad mat on the other side.
pe-04420:
1) Start with an RPS Evolution game for warm-up.
 2) Dribble and trap the ball inside the designated colored hula hoops placed on the floor.
 3) Complete the Soccer Pass Quest tasks by passing and trapping against the wall.
 4) Track progress on a whiteboard and conclude with a pair-share discussion.
pe-04421:
1) Two sharks stand in the middle and minnows stand at one end with flag belts.
 2) When the sharks count down 3, 2, 1, go, minnows run to the safe zone.
 3) Minnows who lose their flags become sharks.
 4) Minnows are safe once they reach the safe zone.
pe-04422:
1) Move to the desired poly spot from the starting line.
 2) Toss the bean bag underhand toward the bucket from the spot.
 3) If the bean bag lands in the bucket, pick up the spot and return.
 4) The first team to collect all their spots and stack them into one pile wins.
pe-04423:
1) Stand behind the mat.
 2) Take a beanbag from the bucket.
 3) Underhand toss the beanbag into the hula hoop.
 4) If successful, move to the next hula hoop.
pe-04424:
1) Teams of three are formed with a scooter board, a hula hoop, and a bucket.
 2) The scooter boarder retrieves a beanbag and passes it to the tosser in the hoop.
 3) The tosser throws the beanbag to the catcher.
 4) The catcher attempts to catch the beanbag in the bucket.
pe-04425:
1) Identify students who are doing an exceptional job
 2) Students write their names on the WOW board
 3) Students fill out a slip with their name, grade, and color group and put it in the drawer
 4) Draw names weekly to post on the board and celebrate
pe-04426:
1) Partners stand on the basketball and volleyball lines.
 2) One player dribbles to the center to draw a card.
 3) Return to the partner and pass the ball as many times as the number on the card.
 4) Black cards are for bounce passes, red cards are for chest passes.
pe-04427:
1) Lay out 4 socks like rungs of a ladder.
 2) Step between the rungs along the ladder and back again.
 3) Count how many you can do in 20 seconds.
 4) There and back equals one.
pe-04429:
1) Set up an agility ladder, line markers, or cones and have students go individually or in pairs mimicking each other.
 2) Hop in and out on one foot zigzagging forward or perform two-footed sideways jumps.
 3) Step left then right foot in each square quickly or perform forward and backward four-step patterns.
 4) Leap forward using frog jumps over one or two squares, perform hip twists, or balance on tiptoes.
pe-04430:
1) Pair up at cones where one student acts as the feeder tossing the ball high and the other as the passer.
 2) Straighten both arms, place one hand over the other, and align thumbs together to form a platform.
 3) Step forward and dig the tossed ball using the forearms rather than the hands back to the partner.
 4) Switch roles after completing ten repetitions.
pe-04431:
1) Dribble along a line of cones using gentle touches with the inside and outside of both feet.
 2) Keep the ball close to the body and do not kick with the toes.
 3) Stop the ball upon reaching the end cone.
 4) Dribble back carefully to the starting point.
pe-04432:
1) Step on the spot marker next to a tall cone, tap the cone, swing back, and kick it with laces.
 2) Take a running approach, plant the support foot beside the tall cone, and kick with a full swing.
 3) Step beside a ball placed on top of a cone and strike it firmly with the laces.
 4) Run up from the cone to a ball placed on the ground and shoot into the target goal.
pe-04433:
1) Stand with knees bent, bounce the ball with two hands inside the hoop, and catch it comfortably.
 2) Bounce with two hands while walking around the hoop in both directions, and wrap the ball around the body.
 3) Use finger pads to bounce the ball between knee and hip height, practicing both hands and crossover V-bounces.
 4) Dribble along court lines avoiding collisions and play Follow the Leader.
pe-04434:
1) Practice static floor positions including tuck sit, pike, l-sit, straddle sit, and pencil/log shape.
 2) Practice balances including tuck balance, V-balance, flamingo, arabesque, and front/back core supports.
 3) Perform jump rotations (quarter, half, full turns landing in motorbike stance), log rolls, and egg rolls.
 4) Progress through forward rolls, backward rolls with a neck shield, bunny hops, donkey kicks, cartwheels, and round-offs.
pe-04435:
1) Throw the ball up with two hands and catch it with one hand cushioning underneath.
 2) Throw the ball as high as possible straight up using leg power and catch with two hands.
 3) Throw the ball up, clap three times quickly, and catch; then progress to spinning full circle before catching.
 4) Throw the ball up, quickly touch the ground with both hands and catch, or practice one-hand to other-hand juggling catches.
pe-04436:
1) Perform toe reaches lying flat on a mat and sitting up to touch toes keeping legs together.
 2) Perform ski hops between two cones and spot markers, hopping and balancing on one foot.
 3) Perform mountain climbers with straight arms and alternating knees driven forward.
 4) Complete pistol squats with wall support, bench dips on a bench or chair, and squat-and-push holding a ball overhead.
pe-04437:
1) Race to dribble and transfer small cones one by one onto another tower before shooting in 'Stack the Towers'.
 2) Dribble through slalom poles, perform 5 toe taps inside a hoop, and return in a 1-minute 'Snake Weaving' challenge.
 3) Dribble through as many arches/cones as possible in 1 minute to score points, avoiding 'poison mine' cones that subtract points.
 4) Dribble to called color targets in 'Color Calls Out', and run circle tag dribbling in 'Cops and Robbers'.
pe-04438:
1) Hop on one foot and jump with both feet forward and sideways along lines of spot markers.
 2) Clear hurdles and practice running long jumps, sticking the motorbike landing position for 2 seconds.
