 3) Practice jump turns (quarter, half, full turns), leaping with 3-second balances, and zigzag ice-skate leaps.
 4) Perform low sideways crab walks touching cones, figure-eight agility around cones, and snake sprint weaving with balls.
pe-04439:
1) Body wraps: Wrap the ball around the waist in both directions, then down around the legs or around a single leg.
 2) Drop and catch: Bend knees, stay low, hold the ball between legs with one hand in front and one behind, release slightly, and quickly switch hands to catch.
 3) Step and through: Step forward passing the ball through the legs with every step, and repeat moving backwards.
pe-04440:
1) Footwork warmup: Perform quick feet in and out of the box marker, sideways steps, figure eights, and letting rolling balls pass through the legs.
 2) Forehand: Adopt the prep position at belly-button height, swing through in a C-motion finishing over the shoulder, and step through with the right foot.
 3) Backhand: Use a two-handed grip with the racket head pointed back, swing low-to-high, and step through with the left foot.
 4) Rally: Alternate between forehand and backhand from the ready position inside the service boxes, aiming for 20 consecutive hits.
pe-04441:
1) Perform whole-body movements including side shuffle lunges, wood chop twists, crab taps, and plank leg raises.
 2) Execute sprint starts (driving the back knee forward from a sprint stance) and frog jumps (touching the floor and jumping forward).
 3) Continue with high knee jumps, lay-down twists, side hops, and sprint step-backs.
pe-04442:
1) Juggling: Start tossing 1 ball consistently between hands, practice releasing a 2nd ball right before the other lands, then complete with 3 balls.
 2) Head balance: Place the ball on the forehead to locate the sweet spot, remove hands, and continually adjust body position to stay underneath the ball.
 3) Finger spin: Spin the ball sideways using fingers, add speed with the other hand, balance it on the index finger, and slice to maintain spin.
pe-04443:
1) Grip the disc (thumb on top, four fingers under rim) and practice backhand wrist flick from 5 meters away aiming at partner's chest.
 2) Step across the body, keep the disc flat, rotate shoulders back, and release pointing arm straight ahead.
 3) Grip disc with two fingers under rim like a gun, step out sideways, and release forehand flick with wrist snap.
 4) Catch incoming discs using crocodile catch (hands top/bottom), hamburger catch (hands on sides), or crab claw (one hand).
pe-04444:
1) Toss the ball slightly behind your head and catch it behind your back with two hands.
 2) Sit on the floor or kneel, throw the ball straight up, and catch it switching hands.
 3) Stand 1.5 meters away from a wall and throw underarm or overhead against the wall, catching without a bounce.
 4) Balance on one leg without hopping while tossing and catching the ball.
pe-04445:
1) Hold the stick with two hands, placing one hand at the top and the other hand halfway down.
 2) Bend knees to stay low and contact the ball using the center part and both sides of the stick head.
 3) Dribble along the cone line to the end using small touches, stop the ball, and dribble back.
 4) Dribble to the end of the cones, stop the ball, step forward, and take a shot on goal.
pe-04446:
1) Serve: Toss ball straight up, set trophy pose with elbow bent behind, strike at highest point, and follow through across body.
 2) Ready Position: Keep feet wide, knees bent, weight forward on balls of feet ready to react left and right.
 3) Forehand & Backhand: Position behind ball, swing low to high finishing over opposite shoulder, using two hands for backhand stroke.
 4) Net Volley: Before ball bounces, form an L-shape with elbow and step forward to block the ball back.
pe-04447:
1) Rotate arms forward and backward from small to giant circles, followed by scissor crosses and lever arm swings for 15 seconds.
 2) Step and swing legs high to kick opposite hands, followed by calf raises on tiptoes and ankle rolls.
 3) Perform butt kicks, knee hugs tightly to the chest, and open-the-gate hip circles for 10-15 reps.
 4) Complete 20 star jumps, 20 wide opposite-toe reaches with straight legs, and sprint on the spot for 20 seconds.
pe-04448:
1) For the tennis forehand, pick up the racket with one hand, stand side-on to the target, and swing from low to high as the ball arrives.
 2) Practice racket ball handling by balancing the ball on the racket, bouncing and catching, and continuous ground bouncing.
 3) For the overhead strike, toss the ball high, scratch the back with the racket, and swing at the highest reach.
 4) For batting off a tee, hold the bat with two hands, square up side-on to the belly-button-height ball, take a step, and swing through.
pe-04449:
1) The teacher sets out pairs of cones as gates all around the playing area.
 2) Students work in pairs sharing one ball between them.
 3) One partner acts as the leader, dribbling to a gate while the other partner positions at the opposite side.
 4) The pair passes through the gate three times, then switches roles to dribble to another gate, completing as many gates as possible before time is up.
pe-04450:
1) Plant the non-kicking foot next to the ball for balance, lock the ankle with the toe pointing down, and strike with the laces.
 2) Line up five balls, run around a pole, and strike each ball into the goal to practice foot placement.
 3) Dribble through cones, take a touch outside, align hips, and aim for the bottom corner of the goal.
 4) Dribble at pace with chest over the ball or receive a pass to strike first time, concluding with a 5-shot penalty shootout.
pe-04451:
1) Divide into batting and fielding teams, with batters coming up one at a time to hit from home plate.
 2) After hitting a fair ball, the batter runs touching first, second, third, and home plate in order to score a run.
 3) The fielding team tries to get three outs by catching fly balls, tagging runners, throwing to bases before runners arrive, or recording three strikes.
 4) Teams switch sides after three outs, and pitching can be adjusted to underarm pitches or batting off a tee.
pe-04452:
1) Choose your favorite creature between two options within 10 seconds.
 2) Perform the designated exercise for your chosen creature for 30 seconds.
 3) Complete five rounds featuring movements like jump lunges, wide reaches, sprint starts, scissors, and side stars.
 4) Finish with a 3-question quiz, doing two push-ups for every incorrect answer.
pe-04453:
1) Hold the rugby ball like a hamburger and exchange pop passes with a partner at 5 meters.
 2) Practice spiral passes using your power hand to spin the ball across 7 to 8 meters.
 3) Practice the grubber kick in pairs by guiding the ball down and kicking it along the ground.
 4) Practice the punt kick and a zig-zag running drill tucking the ball away from defenders.
pe-04454:
1) Adjust rope length so handles reach armpits when standing on the middle.
 2) Practice basic bounces using wrists with elbows tucked in.
 3) Progress to single-leg hops and running on the spot.
 4) Practice footwork variations such as skier, bell, side straddles, scissors, and crisscross.
pe-04455:
1) Identify the laces part of the shoe and point toes to the ground.
 2) Place a soccer ball on top of a cone, take a small run-up, and strike with the laces into the goal.
 3) Transition to shooting a stationary ball from the ground using the laces.
pe-04456:
1) Divide the area into 3 sections using 8 cones and distribute 10 beanbags across the play area.
 2) On signal, run to the opposing side, grab one beanbag at a time, and bring it back to your side.
 3) After 2 to 3 minutes, the team with the most beanbags on their side wins.
 4) Variations include balancing the beanbag on the head or hopping with it between the legs.
pe-04457:
1) Practice individual jumping mechanics by bending knees, swinging arms, and landing softly on the balls of the feet.
 2) Divide into three groups across 3 stations: jumping over 4 hurdles, long jump onto markers, and zigzag jumping through hoops.
 3) Relay through each station, high-fiving the next teammate, and rotate stations every 5 to 10 minutes.
 4) Practice bonus challenges including spin jumps, lateral cone jumps, and throwing and catching a ball in midair.
pe-04458:
1) Choose your favorite ocean item on screen within 10 seconds.
 2) Perform the exercise designated for that choice for 30 seconds.
 3) Progress through 5 rounds: Turtle (Wide Toe Reaches) vs Crab (Crab Kicks), Dolphin (Airplane Lunges) vs Killer Whale (Surf Switches), etc.
pe-04459:
1) Stand in your own individual space.
 2) Spread arms wide for balance, lift one straight leg to the side, and swing it across the body like a pendulum for 5 to 10 seconds on each leg.
 3) Perform hip circles by drawing small circles with a straight leg, and hold airplane balances for 5 seconds on each leg.
 4) Continue with knee hugs, sumo squat kicks, arm levers, and superman holds for 3 to 10 seconds each.
pe-04460:
1) Form pairs facing each other, with each player standing at a cone.
 2) One player tosses the volleyball up high to themselves.
 3) Take a step and hit the ball with a big open hand like giving a high five, striking the ball high and in front toward the partner.
 4) The partner catches the incoming ball and performs the same spike back.
pe-04461:
1) All players start by finding a spot along any court lines.
 2) The teacher selects two players in the middle to be the Pacmen (taggers).
 3) Everyone runs strictly along the lines trying to avoid getting tagged by the Pacmen until time is up.
 4) Tagged players must sit down on the line to become obstacles that blocks everyone except the Pacmen, or play with an appointed doctor who can revive them.
pe-04462:
1) Form groups of 2 to 4 with one basketball per group, taking turns performing drills before passing the ball.
 2) Dribble crossing over between hands to a hoop 8-10m away, wrap the ball around the waist 5 times, and dribble back.
 3) Dribble backwards stay low using fingertips to a cone 8-10m away and return.
 4) Practice step-through legs, fake step dribbling around a middle cone, and spin moves without carrying the ball.
pe-04463:
1) Split the class into two groups with 4-5 balls each, navigating identical circuit layouts.
 2) Dribble and weave in and out of the cones using both feet.
 3) Perform 10 toe taps in a hoop, roll the ball with the sole at the cone, and do 10 inside side-to-side touches in the next hoop.
 4) Flick the ball over mini hurdles, weave through poles, do 5 step-overs, dribble through cone gates, and shoot into the goal.
pe-04464:
1) Divide into 4 or 5 teams sitting in lines behind the starting line.
 2) One runner from each group travels to the end cone using a specific animal movement, touches it, and runs back to high-five the next player.
 3) Race using cheetah runs (sprinting) and frog jumps (two-footed jumping).
 4) Progress through crab crawls (moving sideways), bee runs (carefully running backwards), and horse gallops (straight-legged galloping).
pe-04465:
1) Bend your knees, stay low, and bounce the ball using your fingertips.
 2) Keep your head up so you can see what is happening around you instead of looking down at the ball.
 3) Practice crossovers by bouncing the ball across your body from left to right.
 4) Practice windscreen wipers moving the ball side-to-side with one hand and dribble forwards and backwards beside the body.
pe-04466:
1) Practice toe taps tapping the top of the ball alternating feet and side-to-side taps using the inside of the feet.
 2) Practice step overs circling the ball without touching it and balance the ball on the foot like an egg on a spoon.
 3) Practice trapping and rolling the ball with the sole in multiple directions and dragging the ball between spot markers.
 4) Practice inside passing and trapping with a partner, trap-stepover-pass, rolling two balls simultaneously, and drop kicks.
pe-04467:
1) Create a forearm platform and use legs to pass the ball (dig/bump) back and forth with a partner 5 times each.
 2) Form a triangle/basket with ten fingertips above the head and push through with the whole body to set the ball.
 3) Approach with a left-right-left step pattern, jump off both feet, and snap the elbow and wrist to spike the ball at the highest point.
 4) Stand behind the service line and serve the ball into the court using an underarm or overarm swing.
pe-04468:
1) Dribble at hip height using fingertips while staying low with knees bent, practicing windshield wipers and crossovers.
 2) Perform layups leaping off one foot near the hoop, driving the opposite knee high and banking the ball off the backboard.
 3) Practice shooting form with the strong hand underneath and guide hand on the side, flicking the wrist for backspin with a high arc.
 4) Learn and adhere to key dribbling rules including carry, double dribble, and traveling violations.
pe-04469:
1) Stand at individual cones and jog on the spot with high knees for 15 seconds, followed by 10 star jumps.
 2) Stretch shoulders by making arm circles progressing from small to large in both directions, opposite rotations, and arm scissors.
 3) Perform 10 jumping lunges and 10 calf raises on tiptoes, progressing to 5 single-leg calf raises.
 4) Complete ankle circles, step and swing leg touches, wide toe-touches, opening/closing hip gates, and knee-to-elbow hops.
pe-04470:
1) Practice running while pumping arms and lifting knees quickly and high.
 2) Practice skipping by hopping and landing on the same foot before switching, and practice single-leg hopping on toes.
 3) Practice jumping off both feet with knees together, and galloping with one lead leg in front and the other behind.
 4) Practice sidestepping while staying low on toes, and leaping by jumping off one foot and landing on the opposite foot.
pe-04471:
1) Practice inside foot passes along the ground by placing the non-kicking foot next to the ball.
 2) Move behind incoming balls and control them close to the body using the sole, laces, knee, or chest.
 3) Strike the ball with the laces toward the corners of the goal after a run-up.
 4) Dribble keeping the ball close with small touches using both feet and change directions.
pe-04472:
1) Perform toe taps alternating feet on top of the ball on the spot, then progress moving between cones.
 2) Do side taps moving the ball left and right using the inside of the feet, then move forward and back.
 3) Drag the ball back with the outside foot, tap behind the standing leg, and trap with the other foot.
 4) Dribble between two closely placed cones in an infinity loop pattern using small touches with both feet.
pe-04473:
1) Perform jump lunges by lunging forward and jumping to switch legs while pumping arms.
 2) Complete hand walkouts by bending down, walking hands out into a push-up, doing a push-up, and walking back up.
 3) Execute slalom jumps by keeping knees and feet together and twisting hips while jumping side to side.
 4) Lie face down and lift feet, head, and arms simultaneously to hold for three seconds before lowering.
pe-04474:
1) Roll the ball side to side using the underneath part of the feet while staying on your toes.
 2) Alternate feet tapping on top of the ball using the underneath part of the foot.
 3) Perform stepovers by stepping over the ball without touching it, alternating feet.
 4) Drag the ball forwards and backwards with the sole, and tap the ball side to side using the inside of both feet.
pe-04475:
1) Hold the ball straight out in front and form a fist with the hitting arm swung all the way back.
 2) Take a big forward step, give the ball a gentle toss, and swing low to high to strike an underarm serve.
 3) For an overarm serve, pull the hitting arm back by the ear like drawing a bow and toss the ball straight up.
 4) Contact the ball at the highest reachable point with an open hand giving it a big high five over the net.
pe-04476:
1) Mark two end lines at opposite ends of the area using court markings or cones, and line up all students at one end.
 2) Check heartbeat and breathing for 10 seconds before starting to establish a baseline.
 3) Move across the area performing dynamic exercises such as hamstring kicks, sumo squat stomps, one-legged jumps, side leaps, bear walks, and duck waddles.
 4) Check heartbeat and breathing again at the finish to feel the increased circulation and body readiness.
pe-04477:
1) Balance a bean bag on your foot and flick it up to catch it with both feet and hands.
 2) Bounce a basketball, quickly run around it, and catch it before it stops bouncing.
 3) Fling a bean bag into the air and catch it on a racket, and try sitting down and standing up with a bean bag on your head.
 4) Complete soccer ball dragging traps, hurdle stick taps, and high bouncy ball catches inside a cone.
pe-04478:
1) Set up circuit stations using household items such as towels, water buckets, ropes, markers, bottles, and a ball.
 2) Perform each exercise station for 30 seconds followed by a 15-second rest.
 3) Carry out towel long jumps, bucket drags, hose battle whips, slalom hops, side shuffles, and bottle arm lifts.
 4) Complete ball squat jumps, pass-through abdominal crunches, and alternating ball push-ups.
pe-04479:
1) Place three balls in line for each team, with two balls resting on cones and one ball inside a hoop at the far end.
 2) The first runner runs to the first cone, throws the ball up, claps three times, catches it, and places it back.
 3) The runner repeats the same throw, 3-clap, and catch at the second cone.
 4) At the hoop, throw the ball as high as possible, catch it, put it back in the hoop, and run back to high-five the next teammate.
pe-04480:
1) Raise both hands above your head and shape your thumbs and index fingers into an upward-pointing triangle or diamond.
 2) Spread your fingers wide and look at the incoming ball through the triangle window.
 3) Push the ball straight up toward the sky as high as possible to pass it back to your partner.
 4) Beginners may catch the ball briefly before pushing it up, gradually progressing to pushing it off instantly within one second.
pe-04481:
1) Extend one arm with the thumb down and pull it across the chest to stretch for 10-15 seconds.
 2) Pat your back with one hand and gently push the elbow down with the other arm to stretch the triceps.
 3) Step forward keeping the back leg straight with toes forward to stretch calf muscles.
 4) Pull one heel up to the bum while balancing to stretch the thigh.
pe-04482:
1) Set up 10 targets with large rubber balls on tall cones (5 for each team) and mark throwing lines with markers.
 2) Divide into two teams behind the throwing lines with 16 or more small balls.
 3) On the signal, players throw balls to knock down all targets.
 4) Retrieve thrown balls and keep throwing from behind the line; the first team to knock down all targets wins.
pe-04483:
1) Place hands behind the neck to create a neck shield with elbows pointing to the sky.
 2) Sit on the wedge mat facing backwards.
 3) Bring your nose down to your knees in a tucked position.
 4) Quickly kick back, tuck and roll onto your back, and try to stand back up.
pe-04484:
1) Stand with legs wide apart, knees bent low, and head up.
 2) Move the ball in and out of your legs in a figure-of-eight pattern without dropping it.
 3) For spider bouncing, keep the ball bouncing continuously in the center between your legs.
 4) Alternate tapping the ball from the front and from behind using your fingertips.
pe-04485:
1) Place a starting hoop filled with one beanbag per player, a throwing cone ahead, and an empty target hoop for each team.
 2) The first runner runs to the starting hoop, picks up one beanbag, and sprints to the throwing cone.
 3) From the cone, the player makes an underarm throw toward the target hoop.
 4) If the beanbag lands inside, sprint back; if it misses, retrieve it and retry up to 3 times before returning to high-five the next player.
pe-04486:
1) Balance on one leg to touch your nose to a ball on a tall cone without knocking it, or walk across a foam noodle without touching the floor.
 2) Swing one leg wide left and right 4 to 5 times while balancing on the other, and balance on your bottom with legs raised while tossing a beanbag under your legs.
 3) Step over 4 to 5 cones along a bench without touching them, or scoop a soccer ball onto your foot and hold it for 3 seconds.
 4) Balance a beanbag on your head while sitting, lying down, and standing back up, or stack and unstack 5 cones while holding a push-up position.
pe-04487:
1) Divide the class into 4 to 5 teams behind cones, setting up targets (hoops, cones, spot markers, buckets) over a chest-height net.
 2) The first player runs to the throwing cone, points at the target, holds the ball near the ear, and waits for the teacher's command.
 3) On the call 'Fire!', players throw over the net to score points (hoop: 1 pt, tall cone: 2 pts, spot marker: 5 pts, bucket: 10 pts).
 4) Retrieve the ball immediately to hand off to the next teammate, varying throws (underarm, overhead, volleyball serve, punt kick) based on the equipment.
pe-04488:
1) Step forward or backward and bounce the basketball through your legs without touching your body to catch it.
 2) Dribble staying low using your fingertips, spin completely around, and continue dribbling without losing control.
 3) Sit on the ground and dribble with one hand, bouncing the ball underneath your legs to the other side, then progress to kneeling.
 4) Control dribble height from low (ankles), to medium (belly button), to high, and practice spinning the ball with both hands so it bounces in different directions.
pe-04489:
1) Form pairs where one student acts as the feeder standing at the cone and the other acts as the setter.
 2) The setter forms a diamond shape with their hands held up high in front of their forehead.
 3) When the feeder tosses the ball up high, the setter steps forward and pushes the ball upward with both hands.
 4) Push the ball high into the sky back to the partner, repeating the feed-and-set sequence to master the technique.
pe-04490:
1) Perform 10 challenges such as bouncing a tennis ball off a gym ball or basketball and catching it before it hits the ground.
 2) Balance on one leg, throw a bean bag or small ball over the head, and count how many catches behind the back in 2 minutes.
 3) Bounce two small balls simultaneously crossing them over, or bounce balls through the legs to catch.
 4) Bounce a ball high, clap three times (front, behind, front), and catch it 15 times in a row without dropping.
pe-04491:
1) Stand behind the cones set up around the outside holding a soft rubber ball or basketball.
 2) Step and bounce the ball with one hand from behind the cone trying to land it in the buckets.
 3) Score one point if the ball lands inside the bucket.
pe-04492:
1) Stand opposite a partner at designated cones.
 2) Take a step and pass the ball to your partner using the inside of your foot.
 3) Trap the incoming ball with the sole/underneath part of the shoe, then pass it back with the inside of the foot.
 4) Advance by stepping over the ball without touching it before executing the inside foot pass.
pe-04493:
1) Dribble staying low in and out of zig-zag cones, switching hands at each cone.
 2) Reach the hoop/circle placed at the end of the cones.
 3) Perform a designated skill move inside the hoop, such as wrapping the ball around the waist 5 times or putting it through legs 5 times.
 4) Dribble staying low back to the start line using fingertips with head up.
pe-04494:
1) Dribble keeping the ball close with small touches using both feet while following lines or a leader.
 2) Practice rolling the ball with the sole of the foot and trap it if it gets away.
 3) Step next to the ball and pass along the ground using the inside of the foot to a partner.
 4) Strike big kicks or shoots with shoe laces pointing toes down, and practice drop-kick-catch drills individually.
pe-04495:
1) Stand apart from a partner at cones facing each other.
 2) Get into warrior pose by pointing at the target with one hand and touching the ear with the tennis ball.
 3) Step forward and throw the ball over the head to the partner.
 4) The receiving partner repeats the same stance and throws back.
pe-04496:
1) Complete skill stations including hurdle dribbling, bench balance walking, bucket bouncing, hoop tossing onto cones, and cone catching.
 2) Dribble a ball with a stick through a cone tunnel to knock down and retrieve targets.
 3) Run a zigzag relay touching cones to collect one beanbag at a time from a hoop.
 4) Carry out basketball dribble-shoot, beanbag underarm tossing, and toss-clap-catch relay challenges.
pe-04497:
1) Scatter 15 or more cones across the area, some right-side up and some upside down.
 2) Divide the class into two teams: Team Volcanoes and Team Ice Creams.
 3) Run around for 2 to 3 minutes turning over cones to match your team's assigned orientation, one at a time.
 4) Stop when the whistle blows; the team with the most cones facing their orientation wins, then swap roles.
pe-04498:
1) Set up a zigzag of two cones for each team with a hoop at the end containing a beanbag for each player.
 2) The first runner sprints touching each cone, picks up one beanbag, and runs back.
 3) They high-five the next player, who then runs to collect the next beanbag.
 4) The team that collects all their beanbags first wins.
pe-04499:
1) Partners face each other holding the ball with two hands, elbows out, take a step and push for a chest pass.
 2) Practice two-handed or one-handed bounce passes by stepping through and bouncing to the ground.
 3) Practice a push pass holding the ball to the side and stepping to push with one hand.
 4) Practice an overhead pass with two hands above the head at various distances.
pe-04500:
1) Place four benches on their sides in a square as caves, fill gaps with cones, place a large exercise ball in the center, and scatter tennis balls around.
 2) Divide the class into four teams, each standing behind their bench.
 3) When the teacher calls "bash", players pick up tennis balls and throw them underarm to hit the boulder toward other teams' caves.
 4) A team loses one of its three lives if the boulder hits their bench, and the team with the most lives remaining wins.
pe-04501:
1) Complete an obstacle course hopping ladders, spots, hurdles, and weaving poles before sprinting back.
 2) Stand behind cone gates, step to the called side, and take the ball through the opposite gate.
 3) Weave through zigzag poles without the ball, collect the ball, and weave back dribbling to the start.
 4) Perform ladder footwork, collect the ball to weave through cones using inside/outside touches, and stop it on the spot.
pe-04502:
1) Form a flat platform by pointing both thumbs down toward the ground to push forearms close together.
 2) Move quickly behind the ball and step forward with one leg instead of swinging shoulders fast.
 3) Push through the platform toward the target to deliver accurate passes.
 4) Push shoulders forward toward the target as if holding two tennis balls between neck and shoulders to close platform gaps.
pe-04503:
1) Choose a preferred extreme sport within 10 seconds from the two options given each round.
 2) Perform the assigned movement for the selected sport for 30 seconds (e.g., ice skater hops or hopscotch).
 3) Execute water ski slalom jumps (knees together twisting hips) or wide leg balance holding one leg out.
 4) Progress through rounds performing airplane balances, surf switches, side bunny hops, or mountain climbers.
pe-04504:
1) Dribble a basketball tapping cones to the hoop, wrap the ball around the body 5 times, and dribble back.
 2) Balance a ball on a cone running to the hoop, toss and catch it in the cone 3 times, then return.
 3) Balance a tennis ball on a racket weaving cones, sit down and stand up 3 times at the hoop, then return.
 4) Jump to the hoop holding a beanbag between knees, toss and clap 3 times before catching it, then jump back.
pe-04505:
1) Set up at the tee, hold the bat between ear and shoulder, and swing while squashing the bug to hit line drives.
 2) Grip the seams with two fingers, raise arms like a scarecrow, step, and throw aiming directly at partner's chest.
 3) Field ground balls with a wide base, glove fingers pointing down, and scoop the ball softly using two hands.
 4) Run first to get under fly balls, position hands above eye level in front of the face, and catch with two hands.
pe-04506:
1) Stand with a basketball in front of a cone next to the basket.
 2) From the left side, take a step off the right leg, jump up, and shoot with the left hand aiming at the top left corner of the square.
 3) From the right side, jump off the left leg with a high right knee and shoot with the right hand.
 4) Once mastered, practice with a short run-up.
pe-04507:
1) Set up cones on opposite lines and place a tennis ball on top of the cones at one end.
 2) On the whistle, snatchers sprint toward the balls at the opposite end.
 3) The moment the ball is snatched, the runner turns back to sprint to the start line, while the chaser runs after them to tag them.
 4) Roles switch between snatcher and chaser for the next round.
pe-04508:
1) Hold the racket with a handshake grip and stand in an athletic stance behind the baseline.
 2) Use the non-hitting hand on the racket throat to pull back into a power position with the racket head pointing up.
 3) Drop the racket under the ball and swing low to high, finishing over the opposite shoulder.
 4) For backhands, use a hammer grip with two hands, turn side-on, and swing low to high.
pe-04509:
1) Place 10 tall cones numbered 1 through 10 randomly across the area and line up teams behind starting cones.
 2) The teacher calls out a division question, and the first runner of each team solves it.
 3) Runners sprint around the cone showing the correct answer and return to their line.
 4) Points are awarded based on arrival order, and the next player steps up.
pe-04510:
1) Stand close to the net facing forward.
 2) Place the dominant shooting hand underneath the ball with the elbow forming an L-shape.
 3) Bend knees and extend the elbow while flicking the wrist to create backspin on the shot.
 4) Once mastered, add the guide hand resting gently on the side of the ball.
pe-04511:
1) Balance on one foot for 3 seconds and kick the ball as far as possible using your laces.
 2) Trap the ball with the sole of your foot and roll it behind you to maintain control.
 3) Drop the ball with both hands, let it bounce once, and kick it high and far with your laces.
 4) Bounce, kick with laces, and catch the ball, then try kneeing or heading with the forehead to catch.
pe-04512:
1) Form pairs where one partner stands at the cone as the catcher and the other holds two balls out to the sides as the dropper.
 2) The dropper releases one ball unexpectedly, and the catcher quickly reacts to catch it after a single bounce.
 3) The catcher turns their back, then turns around quickly to catch the dropped ball upon hearing the call 'Catch'.
 4) The catcher starts in a push-up position and gets up immediately on the call 'Catch' to secure the ball before it bounces twice.
pe-04513:
1) Point the elbow upward and push the hand down the back to stretch the triceps for 10 to 15 seconds.
 2) Extend the arm with the palm facing up and gently pull the fingers down to stretch the biceps.
 3) Push the shoulders forward with arms extended to stretch the trapezius, and slowly move the neck up and down.
 4) Perform lunges and side lunges for hip flexors and glutes, then wide-leg reaches and kneeling hip raises for hamstrings and quadriceps.
pe-04514:
1) The first player starts on the whistle, completes the T-run (sprint, side shuffle, backpedal), and the next runner starts once the first drill is cleared.
 2) Perform 5 squat jumps, run figure-eights around cones twice, leap through hoops one foot each, and tiptoe along the skipping rope line.
 3) Leap over hurdles, jump in and out of a hoop in four directions twice, do in-and-out hops on the agility ladder, and weave backward through cones.
 4) Quarter-turn jump across spot markers, jump through poles, and run back to high-five the next teammate in line.
pe-04515:
1) [Number Calls]: Half dribble and pass; players react to numbers called by the teacher (1: weak hand, 2: along lines, 3: low dribble, 4: score layup, 5: protect ball).
 2) [Three Chances]: Four teams compete; each player takes 3 shots from the 3-point line (10 pts), outside the key (5 pts), and inside the key (2 pts) to reach 30 points.
 3) [Chaser Layups]: Front player dribbles to make a layup while a chaser starting 1 meter behind attempts to steal or block the shot.
 4) [Half-court 1v1 to 2v2]: Players sprint around halfway markers from the baseline to play 1v1 offense vs defense, progressing to 2v2 or 3v3.
pe-04516:
1) Form a basic push-up position with hands at chest level, feet together, and glutes squeezed straight.
 2) Perform push-ups touching opposite hand to foot or elbow to knee.
 3) Alternate between wide and narrow hand placements.
 4) Practice special variations such as diamond, sphinx, worm, spiderman, archer, bear walk, or balancing with a ball or beanbag.
pe-04517:
1) Set up a jail area using five tall cones, while robbers spread out across the play area.
 2) Police tag robbers as they run around trying to evade capture.
 3) Tagged robbers are taken to jail and must complete a physical challenge (e.g., 10 star jumps, 20-second one-leg balance) to re-enter the game.
 4) When the teacher blows the whistle, robbers who survived without being in jail score one point.
pe-04518:
1) Gently cushion the incoming ball using the inside of your foot to trap it.
 2) Trap the incoming ball by stepping on it using the underneath part or sole of your foot.
 3) Practice controlling the ball alternating between both left and right feet.
pe-04519:
1) Sit in a straddle position, reach toward one foot keeping legs straight for 5 seconds, then switch sides.
 2) Sit in a pike position with legs together and reach forward as far as possible without bending knees.
 3) Extend arms out to the sides and draw arm circles starting small and expanding into large shapes.
 4) Sit straight, bring your ear to your shoulder for 5 seconds, and stretch your neck looking up and down.
pe-04520:
1) Players pair up with an opponent from the other team along the center starting line.
 2) Mark out an end zone for each team about 10 to 15 meters away from the starting line.
 3) When the teacher calls a team name, that team sprints to their end zone while the other chases.
 4) Score one point by successfully tagging the opponent before the end zone or by escaping safely.
pe-04521:
1) Set up a large circle using 10 cones and have throwers stand outside with 8 or more soft balls.
 2) Place 2 or 3 selected students in the center of the circle as dodgers.
 3) Throwers roll or throw balls inside the circle to hit the dodgers below the knees.
 4) Anyone hit below the knees becomes an outside thrower, and the last surviving player wins.
pe-04522:
1) Bounce lightly off your toes with feet together staying in the center of the trampoline.
 2) Absorb bounce and regain control using a motorbike landing with arms forward and knees bent.
 3) Practice core gymnastics shapes in mid-air including pencil, straddle, star, and tuck jumps.
 4) Progress into seat drops landing on bottom and front drops bouncing off hands and knees.
pe-04523:
1) Hold the racket with one hand, toss a beanbag high, and catch it gently on the racket (flip it like a pancake once skilled).
 2) Bounce the ball on the floor, tap it up into the air, and keep the bounce-tap rhythm going.
 3) Balance the ball in the middle of the racket and walk along the lines without dropping it.
 4) Bounce the ball downward against the ground repeatedly using the racket (switch hands as well).
pe-04524:
1) Spend 10 seconds choosing a preferred travel destination between the two options shown.
 2) Perform the designated exercise for the chosen place for 30 seconds.
 3) Complete a total of 5 rounds with different destinations and exercises (wood choppers, swing kicks, side shuffles, running on the spot, etc.).
pe-04525:
1) Set up cones in pairs around in a circle to form gates.
 2) Dribble the ball with small touches using a hockey stick through the gates along the circle.
 3) Turn around to dribble the opposite way or conduct as a relay.
pe-04526:
1) Take 10 seconds to choose your preferred food between the two options.
 2) Perform the designated exercise matched with your choice for 30 seconds.
 3) Proceed through 5 rounds with different fruit and veggie choices and corresponding exercises.
pe-04527:
1) Hop forward in each square on one foot to the end, then switch feet and go back.
 2) Jump on your toes with feet together like a kangaroo across the squares.
 3) Stand straight with arms overhead and legs together to perform pencil jumps.
 4) Run from the cone, jump as far as possible, and land safely in a motorbike position.
pe-04528:
1) Straighten one arm, point your thumb down, pull it across your chest, and hold for 10 seconds.
 2) Clasp your hands behind your back, straighten your arms, and push your chest forward.
 3) Stand on one foot, bring your heel up to your bottom holding the laces, and stretch your quad.
 4) Sit on a mat, step one leg over the other, and hug your knee tightly to stretch the glute.
pe-04529:
1) Jump up and down from cone to cone with straight legs, keeping feet and knees together.
 2) Jump sideways with both feet up two squares and back one along the ladder.
 3) Support yourself on hands and knees with belly facing up and touch the opposite hand and foot.
 4) Stand in the hoop, squat to touch its sides, and jump straight up into the air.
pe-04530:
1) Run around two cones 3 to 4 meters apart in a figure-eight pattern for 10 laps facing forward.
 2) Balance on one leg and lean over to touch a ball atop a tall cone with your nose 7 times.
 3) Balance a beanbag on your foot, flick it into the air, and catch it with one hand 10 times.
 4) Balance on one foot and push a beanbag across the floor as far as possible using a foam noodle.
pe-04531:
1) Tap the inside of the foot to identify the correct contact surface.
 2) Step forward with the supporting foot and pass the ball along the ground using the inside of the foot.
 3) Switch to the other foot, stepping and passing with the inside of the foot.
pe-04532:
1) Practice close control warm-ups: inside foot taps, toe taps, stepovers, drag rolls, and V-rolls.
 2) Dribble through two cones in a figure-eight pattern with small touches, scoring a point each lap.
 3) Dribble toward a defender, perform body faints and stepovers, and accelerate through gate cones.
 4) Complete an obstacle relay: jump hurdles, run ladders, weave poles, 10 toe taps, dribble through arches, 10 stepovers, and shoot into the wall.
pe-04533:
1) Scatter 5 gym mats around the sports hall and have all students move in the open space off the mats.
 2) When the teacher calls out a number, students quickly form groups of that exact size on a mat.
 3) Groups that fail to match the exact number perform a physical challenge (e.g., 10 star jumps, 5 push-ups, 20s sprint on the spot, 7 frog jumps).
 4) Vary movement styles by hopping on one foot, skipping, or jogging backwards.
pe-04534:
1) Practice one-step crossovers by bouncing across the body, stepping wide, and catching with two hands.
 2) Perform shuttle dribbling along tall cones: dribble forward two cones, back one, touching each cone with the free hand.
 3) Stand side-on to a wall and flick the ball behind the back against the wall for 10 reps per side.
 4) Perform crossovers at each rung of an agility ladder, bounce a tennis ball with a basketball, and practice one-handed windshield wipers.
pe-04535:
1) Stand side-on pointing to the target, swing the ball back, step forward, and perform an underarm throw toward the chest.
 2) Stand in a warrior pose with ball at the ear, step forward, and throw overhand above the head.
 3) Hold the ball at the chest with elbows out like chicken wings, step forward, and push into a chest pass.
 4) Practice individual drills including self-toss with claps, spinning before catching, and catching with two hands in a fruit bowl shape.
pe-04536:
1) Lay the towel flat on the ground
 2) Flip the towel over within 1 minute
 3) Must have 2 feet on the towel when moving it
 4) Make the towel nice and flat after flipping
pe-04537:
1) Set up 4 or more cups in a row on a desk.
 2) Bounce a ping pong ball so that it lands inside a cup.
 3) Turn the cup over once the ball goes in.
 4) Team members take turns, and the first team to flip all their cups wins.
pe-04538:
1) Pair up with one person as the participant and the other as the referee.
 2) Tap your knees, clap your hands, and point in one of four directions (up, down, right, left).
 3) If the participant and referee point in the same direction, a count is recorded.
 4) If they make three mistakes, they sit down and switch roles.
pe-04539:
1) Remove one desk and chair from the group formation
 2) After the leader announces a topic, everyone chants 'Hunminjeongeum' twice
 3) Students must say a word related to the topic and grab their thumbs
 4) The last person who fails to say a word stands up, and the student without a seat becomes the next leader
pe-04540:
1) Prepare one sheet of tissue.
 2) Step 1 is to clap once and catch the tissue.
 3) Step 2 is to clap twice (once in front, once behind) and catch the tissue.
pe-04541:
1) Place desks against the wall and arrange chairs in a triangle.
 2) Divide into two teams and choose a king for the defensive team to sit on the throne.
 3) The offensive team lines up and plays rock-paper-scissors with the defensive team.
 4) If they win, they move forward one space; if they lose, they return to the start.
pe-04542:
1) Arrange chairs in a cross pattern and have the tagger team sit and wait.
 2) One tagger stands to start, and the fish team moves freely.
 3) The tagger touches a teammate with their back turned to make them cross over and catch the fish.
 4) Caught fish sit in the 'fish farm', and the team that catches all fish fastest wins.
pe-04543:
1) Turtle Run: Play rock-paper-scissors across a center line, stepping forward on a win until reaching the center.
 2) Leg Split RPS: Touch feet, play rock-paper-scissors, and move feet backward on a win or forward on a loss until unable to stretch further.
 3) Arm Wrestling: Press right feet together, hold right hands, and use strength and technique to topple the opponent.
 4) Palm Push: Face each other with palms up and close, pushing palms to make the opponent lose balance.
 5) Hip Bump: Back up against each other and push using hips.
pe-04544:
1) Divide roles into 12 citizens, 3 police officers, 7 villains, and 3 doctors by drawing cards and scatter around.
 2) Villains tag citizens and doctors, making them sit down.
 3) Doctors tag seated citizens or doctors to revive them.
 4) Police officers escort villains to jail, and the citizen team wins if they catch 6 or more villains within 5 minutes.
pe-04545:
1) Catch the ball with the glove tilted sideways showing the pocket, not upright or palm up.
 2) Extend your arm in advance before the ball arrives and welcome the ball while absorbing the shock.
 3) When catching a ground ball, cover the top of the glove with your hand to prevent the ball from bouncing.
 4) Bend down in advance and prepare to catch when a ground ball comes from a distance.
pe-04546:
1) Walk forward, lift front/back leg, and move forward.
 2) Jump at the midpoint and walk forward.
 3) Turn with hands together, walk backward, and turn with hands together.
 4) Keep eyes forward and land creatively.
pe-04547:
1) Participants record their personal numbers in the upper left corner of the sheet.
 2) Participants move around with their sheets and pencils to play Rock-Paper-Scissors with desired opponents.
 3) Winning the game allows you to get one desired letter from the opponent's name.
 4) Continue battles until you know the full name, and the person who acquires the most names wins.
pe-04548:
1) Place 20-30 bean bags and a basket for each team at an appropriate distance.
 2) Gather in front of your team's basket and hold 1 bean bag in your hand.
 3) Play rock-paper-scissors with 1 member from the opposing team while holding 1 bean bag.
 4) The loser gives their bean bag to the winner, and the winner puts the received bean bag into their team's basket and rejoins the game.
pe-04549:
1) Divide into two teams wearing team vests to prepare for the game.
 2) Pass or dribble the gym ball and shoot into the opponent's goal to score.
 3) Defenders can steal or block the ball from the opponent.
 4) Both team goalkeepers guard the goal area and block shots.
pe-04550:
1) Prepare by wrapping the body with newspaper spread on the classroom floor.
 2) Tear the newspaper wrapping the body into pieces while shouting "Three Cheers for Korean Independence" on the signal.
 3) Gather the scattered newspaper pieces and put them in a bag to clean up.
pe-04551:
1) Divide the class into two teams, choose one person to throw the ball from outside the court for each team, and send them to the outside of the opposing team.
 2) Have everyone else go inside their own area and place obstacles in the middle of the area to avoid the ball.
 3) The rules are all the same: once the dodgeball game starts, if you get hit by the ball, you go outside and throw the ball from outside the opponent's area.
pe-04552:
1) Arrange the vaulting boxes in a row
 2) Crawl on all fours like a bear over the boxes
 3) Adjust the height or direction of the boxes to change the difficulty
 4) Once comfortable, try standing and balancing on the boxes
pe-04553:
1) Four players defend while cones are set up with one extra cone making five total.
 2) Start with one empty space.
 3) One or two taggers move around trying to capture the empty cones while defenders protect them.
 4) Increase difficulty by having taggers run or increasing the number of taggers to two.
pe-04554:
1) Grab the bar horizontally, lift your feet and cross them in an X shape.
 2) Lean backward to hang from the bar and count to 5.
 3) Increase difficulty by bending your arms so your forehead or face is above the bar.
pe-04555:
1) Move forward, sideways, and backward by alternating hands and feet.
 2) Proceed in the order of hand, foot, hand, foot while raising hips high as if jumping.
pe-04556:
1) Sit under the bar, hold a stick, and swing your legs up while rolling backward
 2) Hold a towel draped over the bar and swing your legs up
 3) Use an inclined board under the bar to swing your legs up
 4) Get assistance from a partner to swing your legs up
pe-04557:
1) Check for cars and pedestrians behind you before starting
 2) Hold the brakes and mount from the left side of the bicycle at the edge of the road
 3) Check the front and back before starting
 4) Stop temporarily at intersections and check left, right, and back before starting
pe-04558:
1) Hold the ball with both hands and raise your elbow above your shoulder
 2) Point your non-throwing hand, eyes, and stepping foot toward the target
 3) Shift your weight from the back foot to the front foot while throwing
pe-04559:
1) Sit on a chair and practice hitting incoming balls with one hand.
 2) Once accustomed, catch the ball with both hands.
 3) Catch the ball while moving arms and wrists softly.
pe-04560:
1) Hold the rope with both hands to prepare.
 2) Swing the rope around your waist and jump to a steady rhythm.
 3) Jump on your toes without letting your heels touch, timing the jump and rope rotation.
 4) Keep your back straight and jump vertically.
pe-04561:
1) Hang on the bar, put your legs under the bar, and roll backward.
 2) When you get used to it, curl your body and roll backward without touching the bar.
 3) Beginners practice rotation holding hands with an instructor.
 4) Land and finish with arms spread.
pe-04562:
1) Jump high on the count of 1, 2, 3 without a rope.
 2) Clap hands twice in the air while jumping high.
 3) Keep the body straight without bending the knees when jumping high.
 4) Turn the rope quickly with small wrist circles and jump high.
pe-04563:
1) Sit on a chair with legs apart and lean upper body slightly forward.
 2) Put center of gravity on toes when standing up.
 3) Transfer weight from right to left leg while throwing the ball.
pe-04564:
1) Both teams divide into inner and outer players, aiming to hit the opponent's inner players with the ball.
 2) When a player is hit and the ball touches the ground, that player is out and moves to the outer area.
 3) If an outer player hits an inner player, the inner player can return to the inner area.
 4) The winning team is decided by the number of inner players remaining at the end.
pe-04565:
1) Divide into teams of 6 players each.
 2) Catch opponent balls securely on the chest or attack with accurate passes.
 3) Dodge or evade difficult incoming balls.
pe-04566:
1) Stand facing a partner and express rock-paper-scissors with your whole body to the start signal.
 2) Change your shape to a rock-paper-scissors move right as you land from a jump.
 3) The winner goes to find another person and continues playing.
 4) If you win 3 times in a row, come and sit where the teacher is.
pe-04567:
1) Take off powerfully from the Reuter board with both feet.
 2) Place hands as far back on the vaulting box as possible, support the body, and lift hips high.
 3) Push off the vaulting box to raise the torso.
 4) Land in a Banzai position with arms raised.
pe-04568:
1) Run up and take off from the springboard.
 2) Place hands on the front half of the vaulting box.
 3) Touch the back of the head, neck, and shoulders while swinging legs.
 4) Arch the back, push off the box with arms, and land.
pe-04569:
1) Wrap your knees and round your body.
 2) Use the momentum of falling to rock back and forth like a rocking chair.
 3) For the rocking chair leading to a forward roll, place hands by your ears and stop upon landing.
 4) For the rocking chair leading to a backward roll, increase rotation speed and touch toes beyond the head.
pe-04570:
1) Prepare by placing a mat on the floor.
 2) Sit on the floor, swing the upper body backward, and gather energy using momentum.
 3) Use the momentum energy all at once to place your head and both shoulders on the mat and rise up.
pe-04571:
1) Place the back of the neck on the mat.
 2) Look at the belly button with a rounded posture.
 3) Push off with palms placed flat on the mat.
pe-04572:
1) Hit the ball with your hand to make one bounce and send it far.
 2) Earn points based on the zone where the defense catches the ball.
 3) The defense can subtract 1 point from the opponent's score by throwing the ball into the out zone.
pe-04573:
1) Set up the tablet where the entire mat exercise movement is clearly visible.
 2) Use the time-difference mirror function to set a delay of up to 15 seconds.
 3) When multiple students take turns, use the out-camera and keep the charger connected.
 4) Review the video repeatedly to objectively check your posture and movement.
pe-04574:
1) Hit the foam ball placed on the tee with a bat.
 2) Run to 1st, 2nd, 3rd base, and home plate to score.
 3) Fielders catch the ball and tag the batter or the base ahead.
 4) Adjust tee position and batting stance to hit the ball in the desired direction.
pe-04575:
1) Engage in activities such as moving or hanging on fixed facilities like monkey bars, climbing poles, and jungle gyms.
 2) Race to ring the bell hanging at the top of the jungle gym.
pe-04577:
1) Stand behind the designated line.
 2) Make a snowball and throw it onto the snow platform.
 3) Stack the snowballs on the platform and count how many stay.
pe-04578:
1) Place the treasure (bottle) in the center and base camps at both ends.
 2) Tag runners using two hands within the defensive zone.
 3) Attackers dodge tags to enter the base camp and capture the treasure.
 4) The team that captures the treasure or enters the base first wins.
pe-04580:
1) Two players stand facing each other and play rock-paper-scissors.
 2) If you win with rock, shout 'Glico' and take three steps forward.
 3) If you win with scissors, shout 'Chocolate' and take six steps forward.
 4) If you win with paper, shout 'Pineapple' and take six steps forward to reach the goal first and win.
pe-04581:
1) March in place to the music.
 2) Follow the physical movements and stretches corresponding to the numbers.
 3) Perform various movements according to the numbers from 10 down to 0.
pe-04582:
1) Stand facing a wall with a paper ball made by crumbling three sheets of paper together.
 2) Make an underhand toss against the wall to start.
 3) Volley the ball with your hand each time it rebounds off the wall without letting it hit the floor, scoring 1 point per rebound for 3 tries to get the best score.
pe-04583:
1) Clasp your hands together and join your forearms to create a flat surface.
 2) Move quickly toward the ball to get into position.
 3) Hit the ball upward from below to send it to the opponent.
 4) Work in teams of 2-3 to pass the ball without letting it drop.
pe-04584:
1) Perform jabs, front kicks, climbing, running in place, uppercuts, and side kicks.
 2) Each movement lasts 40 seconds with a 20-second rest.
 3) Combine the learned movements at the end.
pe-04585:
1) Aerobic exercise using step boxes
 2) Riding a tricycle
 3) Passing bean bags
 4) Making stress balls by filling balloons with cornstarch
pe-04586:
1) Hold each yoga pose for 10 to 30 seconds
 2) Modify the pose to your own comfort level
 3) Record the date and time of the pose in the log
pe-04587:
1) Figure-eight dribble: Dribble the ball in a figure-eight pattern around the cones.
 2) Speed rope skipping: Skip rope.
 3) Curl-ups: Perform curl-ups.
 4) Shuttle run: Perform a shuttle run.
pe-04588:
1) Perform 5 exercises twice each with a medicine ball.
 2) Follow the order: Isometric Hold (20s), Curl to Press, Goblet Squat (10 reps), Running Hold (20s), Straight Leg Hold (15s).
 3) Maintain breathing during exercises.
 4) Use a book or backpack if a medicine ball is unavailable.
pe-04589:
1) Students perform exercises assigned by the instructor in their own space with a timer.
 2) Continue the exercise until the timer sounds or the next movement is called.
 3) Sequentially perform movements such as squats, elbow-to-knee, lunges, high knees, and front kicks.
pe-04590:
1) Inhale through the nose and exhale forcefully as if blowing out trick birthday candles 5 times.
 2) Practice scuba breathing by holding breath underwater for 10 seconds.
 3) Inhale for 4 seconds and exhale slowly for 6 seconds.
 4) Perform controlled neck rotations both ways and rotate the thoracic spine hugging the chest.
 5) Mobilize shoulders, scapula, and wrists with circles.
pe-04591:
1) Perform 6 reps of diagonal uplifts with a medicine ball on each side.
 2) Complete 8 to 10 reps of wide-leg good mornings hinging at the hips.
 3) Hold an isometric split stance holding the ball for 15 seconds per side.
 4) Execute side squats moving side to side for 5 reps each side.
 5) Perform a push-and-pull movement with the ball for 30 seconds.
 6) Rest 15-20 seconds between exercises and repeat for two rounds.
pe-04592:
1) Learn the four parts of a racket: handle, head, face, and throat.
 2) Grip the handle tightly and keep a secure hold without letting go.
 3) Practice walking down and back while bumping up an imaginary ball on the paddle.
 4) Line up with a partner on the line and practice moving down and back together.
 5) Return and place all rackets on the designated line when finished.
pe-04593:
1) Mobilize neck, thoracic spine, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, and ankles while keeping the body stable.
 2) Perform dynamic stretches in a 40 seconds on, 20 seconds off format starting with jogging in place.
 3) Perform gate swings reaching across while stepping the opposite leg back.
 4) Practice rapid punches in a squared or split stance.
 5) Execute lateral bounding or side-to-side stepping swinging arms across.
 6) Crawl forward, backward, and side-to-side using opposite arm and leg movements.
 7) Complete high knees and repeat the circuit for a second round.
pe-04594:
1) Practice stationary dribbling bending knees, using fingertips, and keeping eyes up at varied heights and speeds.
 2) Dribble zigzag through cones down and back with the right hand, then repeat with the left hand.
 3) Dribble through cones switching hands at every cone.
 4) Select two taggers (French Fries) who hold a noodle while dribbling a basketball with the other hand.
 5) All players dribble their basketballs while taggers attempt to tag them with the noodle.
 6) Tagged players sit down holding their ball in the air until a teammate performs 3 push-ups alongside them to free them.
pe-04595:
1) Practice Around the World around ankles, waist, and head for 10 seconds along with toe touches and crab catches.
 2) Complete figure-eight drills around the legs on the floor and in the air for 10 repetitions.
 3) Pair up as leader and follower to mirror locomotor movements (skip, gallop, jog) inside the volleyball court.
 4) Play the Popcorn game where each player bounces a ball once and runs to keep all balls continuously bouncing as a team.
 5) Free dribble inside defined boundary lines without colliding as the playing area shrinks.
 6) Dribble through the river avoiding obstacles and perform 10 tick-tocks or 2 around-the-worlds on command.
pe-04596:
1) At station one, walk along the jump rope and pick up spots.
 2) If you fall off, put the spots back down and start over.
 3) At station two, one volunteer is the ghost and all players must stay on the volleyball court lines.
pe-04597:
1) Start at your designated hoop.
 2) Ride the scooter with the hockey stick to the center ice area.
 3) Use the stick to hook an object and bring it all the way back into your hoop.
pe-04598:
1) Stand tall, tuck the chin, and slowly rotate the neck in both directions.
 2) Hug yourself, flex the upper back forward, and rotate the torso without moving the hips.
 3) Perform large shoulder rotations, then move to the ground or chair for hip and ankle rotations.
pe-04599:
1) Warm up the whole body with neck, spine, shoulder, hip, knee, and ankle rotations.
 2) Stand with one foot forward, guard up, and throw alternating jabs for 30 seconds.
 3) Perform uppercuts, front kicks, hooks, and sidekicks for 30 seconds each, then repeat rounds.
pe-04600:
1) Set up as center with hands on knees and snap the ball to the quarterback.
 2) React to quarterback cadence and practice blocking steps to the left and right for the running back.
 3) Wide receivers run in place and jump high to catch the pass upon the signal.
pe-04601:
1) Dribble using the inside of feet to music, and shoot at the nearest cone goal when music stops.
 2) Practice kicking towards a large goal target from three marked spots spelling C-A-T.
 3) Form groups of three (two offense, one defense) to practice passing around a defender and scoring.
pe-04602:
1) Regulate breathing for 5 minutes through belly breathing, tubular breathing, rib breathing, and 4-second box breathing.
 2) Hold a wall or chair to circle ankles, and bend the knee while rotating the foot in and out to extend.
 3) Perform a standing figure-four hip stretch, followed by arm and thoracic spine rotations.
pe-04603:
1) Practice locomotor movements such as walking in mud, tiptoe walking, scissor kicks, and giraffe walks.
 2) Hold an imaginary ball and circle it around ankles, knees, waist, and head in 'Around the World'.
 3) Place the imaginary ball between feet, squatting and alternating hands in 'Crab Catch' and Two-Hand Pounds.
pe-04604:
1) Place hula hoops and markers on the floor and set up mats as walls
 2) Move around by walking, skipping, trotting, or hopping while music plays
 3) When music stops, move to the color and item called out by the teacher
 4) One student per pad, two students per hoop, and high-five in the center upon success
pe-04605:
1) Stand gym mats up in the four corners to create clear running lanes.
 2) Split teams to opposite sidelines.
 3) The first runner from each team starts with a tag stick, runs one full lap around the outside of the mats, and hands the stick off to the next teammate.
 4) Catch someone from the other team and make a clean tag with the stick for one point.
pe-04606:
1) The tagger, Disco Stu, moves only by shuffling with scarves under their feet inside the volleyball boundary lines to tag others.
 2) When tagged, students go to the dance stage outside the boundary and perform their special dance move.
 3) Another student copies the dance move for 3 seconds, and then both high five and return to the game.
pe-04607:
1) When the music starts, students navigate their hula hoop boats around the outside of the cones.
 2) When the music stops, students race to the nearest mat and drop their hula hoops.
 3) The teacher visits each mat and students act out the jungle animal designated for that station.
pe-04608:
1) Place three mats as castle safe zones; Elsa starts in the center circle while Anna and the Snowman start on the sideline.
 2) Elsa uses a foam stick to tag runners, and tagged players freeze in creative poses while singing or humming Let It Go loudly.
 3) Anna is immune from tagging and tosses the red fireball to frozen players to unfreeze them with a clean catch.
 4) The player who catches the ball becomes the new Anna, and the Snowman can crawl under leg tunnels to unfreeze teammates.
pe-04609:
1) All players wear a flag on their waist and scatter
 2) Players try to pull off others' flags
 3) A player whose flag is pulled must go outside the boundaries, perform a task, and then reattach the flag to return
pe-04610:
1) The Mandalorian is given a pool noodle and two flag football flags.
 2) The Mandalorian loses a flag when hit by a stormtrooper's blaster.
 3) The Mandalorian does not freeze when tagged but freezes once all flags are lost.
 4) The Mandalorian frees frozen rebels.
pe-04611:
1) Adventurers explore Treasure Island and move to the beach on the 'BEACH!' signal
 2) Collect bean bags from the treasure cave and place them in the booty box
 3) If tagged by a pirate, players freeze or move to the cursed ship
 4) If the die roll is odd, players become zombies and move while inside a hula hoop
pe-04612:
1) Teams start in their hoops
 2) On the signal, dribble the ball to collect one beanbag at a time
 3) Return to the hoop with the beanbag
 4) The game ends when all beanbags are collected
pe-04613:
1) When the teacher says "On the lines", students slide on the lines.
 2) When the teacher says "Off the lines", students leap off the lines.
 3) Ghosts tag the Pack family with foam balls.
 4) Tagged students go to the mini-coach for sliding instruction.
pe-04614:
1) Stand in a circle and follow the laughter yoga movements
 2) Choose your favorite animal and laugh while imitating it
 3) Walk around the circle and perform a laughter handshake when you meet someone
 4) Lie on the floor and laugh to finish
pe-04615:
1) Students practice overhand throwing with a partner.
 2) One student performs the throw, while the other acts as a coach.
 3) The coach awards points when the thrower performs the specific movements (stand sideways, bend arm at 90 degrees, step with front foot, touch opposite thigh).
 4) The thrower earns 2 points for completing all movements.
pe-04616:
1) Set up 6 stations using playground structures.
 2) Place cards at each station with movement instructions like 'over', 'under', 'around', 'through'.
 3) Students move through the structures according to the instructions.
 4) Rotate to the next station after a set time to experience all courses.
pe-04617:
1) Students check their resting heart rate before the activity.
 2) Builders set up cones upright, while Bulldozers knock cones over.
 3) Students check their heart rate again after the activity to notice any changes.
 4) The class splits into two teams where Builders try to keep cones upright and Bulldozers try to knock them down.
pe-04618:
1) Somnus tags players, making them freeze and pretend to sleep.
 2) Cupid uses golden arrows (foam balls) to revive sleeping players.
 3) Two sleeping players with the same colored arrow form a love squad by holding hands.
 4) Cupid uses lead arrows to split large love squads in half.
pe-04619:
1) Print and cut out the reindeer cards and tracker sheet using scissors.
 2) Ask a family member to hide all nine cards around the house.
 3) Find a hidden card and perform the exercise shown on it based on the chosen bait repetitions.
 4) Flip a coin, logging the reindeer on the tracker if it lands on heads, or escaping if tails.
 5) Continue until all nine reindeer are successfully rounded up.
pe-04620:
1) Each team designs a golf hole on a schoolyard map sheet using tee-off cones and hoop targets.
 2) Set a challenging par between 2 and 5 strokes for the designed hole.
 3) Rotate through each course and throw the disc from the tee-off toward the target hoop.
 4) Keep track of throw strokes aiming for the lowest overall score.
pe-04621:
1) Every player is 'it' and tries to tag others while avoiding being tagged.
 2) When tagged, a player freezes in place with both hands held out in front.
 3) Another player must tap the frozen player's hands three times to unfreeze them.
 4) Players can use a poly spot or balance on one foot to stay safe on base for 5 seconds.
pe-04622:
1) Stand inside a hoop and practice throwing and catching the ball individually.
 2) Toss and catch the ball with a partner standing in a nearby hoop.
 3) In pairs at a cone, one player runs to a hoop with bean bags; if they catch a pass from the partner with both feet inside the hoop, they bring back a bean bag and switch roles.
 4) Place various objects into the hoops with different point values and challenge teams to collect points within a time limit.
pe-04623:
1) Divide the area into the burrow, river, and riverbank, splitting students into frogs (hopping on one foot) and toads (jumping on two feet).
 2) Students travel across the river using their assigned locomotor skill, grab one fly (beanbag), and return it to their burrow.
 3) Place colored poly spots (lily pads) in the river requiring balance on orange, air squats on blue, and stretches on green.
 4) Introduce fish taggers into the river who try to tag frogs and toads outside safe zones (burrow, lily pads, riverbank).
 5) Tagged players switch roles (frog becomes toad or vice versa), return any carried fly, and restart from their burrow.
pe-04624:
1) Set up home base and runner base 20 meters apart with a pitcher's hoop, dividing the class into batting and fielding teams.
 2) The pitcher throws underhand between shoulder and knee height; the batter strikes or misses, drops the bat inside home base, and runs to runner base.
 3) The batting team scores a point if a runner reaches runner base and returns home before the pitcher catches the relayed ball and yells Freeze.
 4) Fielders get batters out via fly ball catches, tagging runners with the ball, or if a bat is tossed outside home base, switching sides after three outs.
 5) In the final progression, fielders cannot run while holding the ball and must relay passes to tag runners or hit them below the knees with an underhand throw.
pe-04625:
1) Divide the area into two haunted houses with hoops at each end and a street in between, dividing students into ghosts and ghouls.
 2) Set up a containment unit using cones and red, yellow, and green spots, appointing Ghostbusters equipped with pool noodles.
 3) When music plays, fleeing players run across the street to the opposite house, scoring 1 focus point each time they cross safely.
 4) Tagged players reset points to zero and go to the containment unit, advancing from red to yellow to green as new players arrive before re-entering.
 5) In build 3, ghost trap spots are added to the street so Ghostbusters can herd fleeing players into stepping on traps.
pe-04626:
1) Divide the court into two halves and place a mat at the back of each team's end.
 2) Each team sends one initial catcher to stand on their respective mat.
 3) Passers advance up to the center line and attempt to pass the ball to their catcher while opponents defend and intercept.
 4) When a catcher securely catches the ball landing with both feet on the mat, the passer joins them as a catcher until all players reach the mat.
pe-04627:
1) Secretly select one student as 'Precious' while all other students put on blindfolds.
 2) Precious remains completely silent and stationary while blindfolded players move slowly.
 3) When bumping into someone, ask 'Precious?'—if they reply 'Precious', keep moving.
 4) If a player remains silent after asking three times, remove the blindfold and join Precious.
pe-04628:
1) Place a target beanbag in the middle of a square target area.
 2) Two teams take turns throwing their beanbags toward the central target bag.
 3) At the end of each round, the team with their beanbag closest to the target bag earns points.
 4) In build two, teams throw toward cones placed at 5, 10, and 15 feet away, scoring points for the closest throw before advancing.
pe-04629:
1) The teacher rotates a long jump rope (Jake) along the floor in a circle while students jump to avoid touching it.
 2) The teacher reveals a food card, calls out its name, and turns the rope; any student touched by the rope must step out, perform the card's exercise to burn calories, and return.
 3) Teams sort food cards into healthy and unhealthy piles, fill out assessment sheets, and share their findings.
pe-04630:
1) Divide the class into four teams with attackers at the start and defenders defending designated lines.
 2) Defenders must keep both feet on their line, slide sideways, and may only tag players directly in front of them.
 3) Attackers try to penetrate past the defensive lines into the end zone without getting tagged; tagged players return via sidelines.
 4) In advanced builds, attackers collect bean bags from the end zone, or defenders are allowed to pivot.
pe-04631:
1) Divide the class into 6 teams, each assigned a team color and a workshop base hoop.
 2) [Build 1] In relay fashion, search under 36 scattered cones to find and collect all builder's list cards of your team's color.
 3) [Build 2] Review the builder's list and relay to collect the required snowman equipment one item at a time.
 4) [Build 3] Relay across the playing area carrying one item at a time to assemble the complete snowman in the construction zone.
pe-04632:
1) Identify the beach outside four cones, bridges across the ocean, and hoops acting as boats.
 2) Evade two taggers wearing pennies using the beach, bridges, and boats without getting tagged.
 3) Tagged students step out to the whiteboard to reflect on chasing or fleeing tactics before returning.
 4) In the swarm tag build, taggers hold a ball and may only pivot, passing to tag runners; tagged runners put on pennies to become taggers.
pe-04633:
1) Divide the class into two teams (running and fielding) and assign each player a number from 1 to X.
 2) The first player on the running team yells 'Chuck the chicken' and throws the rubber chicken into an open space.
 3) The running team forms a circle while the runner runs laps around the team, scoring one point per lap completed.
 4) The fielding team lines up behind the first fielder to pass the chicken back using an over-under pattern until the last player yells 'Chuck the chicken' and tosses it into an open space to end the run.
pe-04634:
1) In teams of four, player 1 strikes the ball off the tee while three fielders field the ball back to the batting base.
 2) In build 2, after striking the ball, the batter runs back and forth between the batting base and running base, scoring a point each time they reach a base.
 3) The runner's turn ends when a fielder touches the running base while holding the ball, after which positions rotate.
pe-04635:
1) From 6 bases, the first player throws an energy ball using an underhand throw to knock over space towers made of a hoop, ring, and pin.
 2) In build 2, thin pins are replaced with basketballs (power stations), requiring more power to knock them out of hoops.
 3) In build 3, two teams throw energy balls to knock meteors into the opposing team's spaceship base.
pe-04636:
1) Each player defends their foamy prairie dog inside their hoop nest while sliding around in a defensive ready position.
 2) Players holding a foam ball may only pivot, throwing or rolling the ball to knock over opponents' prairie dogs.
 3) If knocked over, the player picks up their equipment and joins the thrower's team to form and grow a colony.
pe-04637:
1) Two teams form circles in their halves to establish a continuous passing pattern where every member receives the ball once.
 2) In build 2, players move to open spaces after passing and count completed passes out loud while only pivoting with the ball.
 3) In build 4, teams score points by passing to a teammate in the offensive end zone using NBA Jam progression scoring (1-4 points).
pe-04638:
1) Sit down calm and take a mindful moment noticing breathing, heartbeat, body temperature, and muscles.
 2) Choose one of two exercises shown on screen and perform it with good technique for 30 seconds.
 3) Notice four bodily changes (heavy breathing, faster heart rate, sweat, tired muscles) and record four home physical activities on a power chart.
pe-04639:
1) Divide the area into a ranch (1/
 3) and prairie (2/3); wild horses gallop in the prairie demonstrating mature galloping.
 2) On the rancher's signal, horses freeze to learn five keys of galloping and later exchange peer feedback in pairs.
 3) Selected cowboys/cowgirls with pool noodle lassos gallop to tag horses, sending tagged horses to gallop along a cone track in the ranch.
pe-04640:
1) Students answer multiple-choice questions by holding up their Plickers card with the selected answer side facing up.
 2) The teacher scans the class with the Plickers app on an iPad to instantly collect answers and assess comprehension.
 3) Students place their personalized numbered magnets on a whiteboard next to target skill elements, learning rubric levels, or Borg RPE exertion zones.
pe-04641:
1) Search and locate 15 Pokemon cards hidden by parents in various creative places around the house.
 2) When a card is found, perform the exercise corresponding to the Pokemon's type to earn flips with a Poke Ball (1), Great Ball (3), or Ultra Ball (5).
 3) Flip the coin for the earned number of chances; getting heads at least once successfully catches the Pokemon to record in the Pokedex.
pe-04642:
1) Feel your pulse at the wrist or neck for 10 seconds and multiply by 6 to determine your resting or active heart rate.
 2) Understand the 5 heart rate zones based on maximum heart rate calculated by subtracting your age from 220.
 3) Complete nine different wacky movement activities and check your 10-second heart rate immediately after each to see if you reached moderate to vigorous zones (21-28 beats per 10 seconds).
pe-04643:
1) Designate opposite end lines as Pleasant and Unpleasant; students react and run to the line matching the emotion called out by the teacher.
 2) Designate side lines as High Energy and Low Energy; students run to the appropriate side based on the emotion called.
 3) Divide the court into 4 colored zones using cones (Blue, Red, Yellow, Green) representing energy/pleasantness, where correct guesses earn a focus point.
 4) Place a 3x3 grid of poly spots in each zone to have students stand on the specific intensity level (-3 to -1 or +1 to +3).
pe-04644:
1) Practice three character poses—giants, elves, and wizards—by moving around to music and showing the designated pose when the music stops.
 2) The class splits into two teams, with each team having 10 seconds in their discussion zone to agree on which character to play before lining up facing each other.
 3) Both teams reveal their character at the same time (rock-paper-scissors dynamic), and the losing team must sprint back to their discussion zone before being tagged; tagged players switch to the opposing team.
pe-04645:
1) Two players enter each court as keeper and challenger to play a singles game to 3 points.
 2) If the challenger loses, they leave the court to re-enter a line or switch courts, while the keeper earns a win.
 3) Once a keeper reaches 3 wins, they earn a crown, leave the court to record their name on the whiteboard, and join the end of a line.
 4) The next two waiting players enter the court and play rock-paper-scissors to determine the new keeper and challenger.
pe-04646:
1) Start jumping rope on one foot.
 2) If you trip or touch the ground with both feet, you are out.
 3) The last person remaining wins.
pe-04648:
1) Perform grapevine step with 4 taps for 8 counts
 2) Perform step touch and spin for 8 counts
 3) Walk forward for 8 counts and walk backward for 6 counts with 2 jumps
 4) Swing arms for 8 counts and lift heels for 8 counts
pe-04649:
1) Sit around the parachute holding the edges.
 2) Place balls on the parachute.
 3) Shake the parachute to keep the balls from falling off.
 4) Move under a specific color of the parachute on the teacher's signal.
pe-04650:
1) Divide into two teams, Rockets and Satellites.
 2) Set up bowling pins for one team and cones with frisbees for the other.
 3) Hit the ball over the net to knock down the opponent's items.
 4) If an item is knocked down, you must catch a ball in the air to set it back up.
pe-04651:
1) Start at the red line and perform log rolls and forward rolls
 2) Cross the green hurdle to signal the next person to start
 3) Jump 10 times on the trampoline
 4) Walk across the balance beam and land with two feet at the red tape
pe-04652:
1) Practice the jump rope move shown on the station sign.
 2) Moves include rainbow jumps, rainbow swings, side swings, balancing, heart jumps, making letters, and jumping in and out of a hoop.
 3) Rest by sitting in a hula hoop if tired.
 4) Move to a different station when ready.
pe-04653:
1) Enter the long rope in order while it is turning and jump a specified number of times.
 2) Exit the rope after completing the specified number of jumps (5, 3, or 1).
 3) If someone gets tangled, switch with the next person and continue.
 4) As you succeed, reduce the number of jumps and take on the next level challenge.
pe-04654:
1) Set up stations including trampolines, hurdles, heart-shaped hula hoops, and jump ropes in the gymnasium.
 2) Students rotate through stations performing activities such as 10 trampoline jumps, hurdle clearing, heart jumps, and jump rope.
 3) Grades 3-5 complete 20-50 jumps and trick tests while grades 1-2 perform basic jumps.
pe-04655:
1) Stand tall and take deep breaths to prepare.
 2) Follow various poses like tree, waterfall, bird, wind, and windmill.
 3) Perform floor poses like table, cat, dog, and butterfly.
 4) Finish with seated poses like candle and peacock.
pe-04656:
1) Set up bowling pins as castles with one guard stationed at each pin.
 2) Challengers attempt to approach and knock down the pin without being tagged.
 3) The player who successfully knocks down the pin becomes the new guard.
 4) Any player tagged by the guard must leave and move to a different castle.
pe-04657:
1) Jog two laps around the gymnasium perimeter.
 2) Move to the exercise station in the center.
