 3) Perform 10 repetitions of designated exercises such as push-ups (or a 10-second hold), picking berries, and windmills 10 times.
 4) Jog two laps again and finish with stretching.
pe-04658:
1) Taggers holding orange balls chase and tag running students.
 2) When approached or tagged, students go to a house station along the perimeter.
 3) Roll the dice and perform the designated exercise (such as picking berries) as many times as the rolled number.
pe-04659:
1) Divide the class into two teams across the half-court line and set up mats as snow forts.
 2) Throw soft yarn balls across the line to hit opponents or defend incoming throws.
 3) Players hit by a ball sit down, and rejoin the game when a teammate brings them a ball.
 4) Catching an opponent's throw directly causes the thrower to get out and sit down.
pe-04660:
1) Designate one or two sharks while the rest of the students line up on the black line as minnows.
 2) On the go signal, minnows run across safely to the opposite black line avoiding the sharks.
 3) Minnows who are tagged, collide, fall down, step out of bounds, or touch cones become stationary seaweed on the floor.
 4) Seaweed players must stay fixed in place but can reach out their arms to tag passing minnows.
pe-04661:
1) Divide the gym into four airspaces using half-court lines and cones, setting up each team's mat spaceship.
 2) Players start each round standing inside their assigned airspace with a ball held between their feet.
 3) Throw foam and yarn balls aiming inside opponent spaceships while strictly staying within own airspace.
 4) Players may block incoming balls, and the team with the fewest balls inside their spaceship wins a point.
pe-04662:
1) Form groups of three: one riding the scooter, one standing in the hula hoop, and one holding the bucket.
 2) The scooter rider travels across the gym to collect one ball at a time and returns to the line.
 3) The rider throws the ball to the teammate in the hoop, who catches it and tosses it to be caught in the bucket.
 4) Empty the bucket once filled and rotate roles among the three team members.
pe-04663:
1) 15 to 18 students ride scooter boards on their bottoms or knees within the basketball court.
 2) Meatball taggers push two cage balls and a spaghetti tagger rides a scooter holding noodles to tag others.
 3) Tagged students get off their scooters and line up by the cone, while the next student in line takes the scooter to join.
pe-04664:
1) Every student dribbles their own soccer ball in any direction across the gym.
 2) Designated defenders try to trap other students' balls by putting their foot on top of them.
 3) If a student's ball is trapped, they freeze with the ball above their head and call for help until a teammate passes a ball through their legs.
pe-04665:
1) Students line up in teams of 3 to 4 behind their colored cones.
 2) On their turn, a runner sprints to their team's pretend house, opens the door, and says 'Trick or treat'.
 3) The runner selects one piece of candy, closes the door, and says 'Thank you'.
 4) The runner sprints back, drops the candy into the team bucket, and tags the next teammate for a 10-minute relay.
pe-04666:
1) Line up behind one of the four numbered cones.
 2) Complete the obstacle assigned to each cone (trampoline/balance beam, cone weaving, bear/crab walk, hurdle jump/hopscotch).
 3) Pick a reward item from the corner bucket after completing the obstacle.
 4) Run along the wall, place the item in the empty bucket, and move to another line.
pe-04667:
1) Divide the class into two teams with players restricted from crossing the centerline.
 2) Throw foam balls to knock down the opponent's beach balls resting on tees.
 3) When knocking off an opponent's ball, players shout "Sorry!" as in the board game.
 4) Players can immediately place their knocked-off beach ball back on the tee to keep play moving.
pe-04668:
1) Divide the class into two teams across the centerline and set up 10 ghost pins per team.
 2) Use 10 rhino skin balls to throw or roll across to knock down opponent ghosts.
 3) Defending players catch or swat balls away to protect their pins.
 4) Play rounds where pins can be stood back up, or competitive rounds where fallen pins remain down.
pe-04669:
1) Each participant stands with a jump rope.
 2) Start jumping rope on the signal, and side swings are not allowed.
 3) As soon as a participant messes up, they must sit down and be eliminated.
 4) The last person standing without making a mistake wins.
pe-04670:
1) Enter the decorated gym with disco lights and streamers, receive glow sticks, and get ready on the dance floor.
 2) Begin with 3 to 4 popular group dances such as the Cha Cha Slide and Cupid Shuffle.
 3) Enjoy freestyle dancing for the remaining time.
pe-04671:
1) Split the players into roles such as taffy and dark chocolate.
 2) Tagged players sit down and make a heart shape with their fingers.
 3) Players can get back up if someone helps them.
pe-04672:
1) Most students become turkeys starting inside the center pen while farmers hold tagging sticks.
 2) Turkeys run out to retrieve bean bags from hula hoops one at a time and put them in the center basket.
 3) If tagged by a farmer, turkeys must stand on a poly spot dinner plate.
 4) Another turkey can rescue them by linking elbows for a free walk back to the pen.
pe-04673:
1) Every student has a soccer ball and dribbles around the gym space.
 2) Two players start as pirates without a ball trying to steal someone else's ball.
 3) If a pirate steals your ball, you become the new pirate.
 4) You cannot steal the ball right back from the person who just took it from you.
pe-04674:
1) Teams divide on either side of a dividing mat wall, set up pins (ships), and throw balls to knock down opponent pins.
 2) Catching an incoming ball over the mat earns a bonus to run around to the opponent's side and throw a ball.
 3) Defenders can block and guard their team's pins.
 4) Players cannot touch the mat with their bodies, and must stay outside the black line when visiting the other side.
pe-04675:
1) Partners face each other with a bucket in between and take out the ball inside.
 2) Toss the ball over the bucket directly to your partner's hands only when they show ready hands.
 3) If dropped, pick it back up and continue, counting how many catches you make in a row.
 4) When the teacher calls switch, rotate in one direction to the next bucket station.
pe-04676:
1) Divide the class into four ships (mats) with 3 to 6 students and four bowling pins on each ship.
 2) Players start with a ball between their feet, then throw or roll balls to knock down opposing teams' bowling pins.
 3) Defenders stand to catch or deflect balls; falling off the ship with both feet sends a player to do 10 push-ups or mountain climbers.
 4) When all four pins on a ship are knocked down, the entire crew does 5 push-ups together before resetting their pins.
pe-04677:
1) Students divide into groups of 3 (batter, pitcher on the star, outfielder at the cone) or 4 (adding a catcher).
 2) The batter hits the ball off the batting tee, or older students (grades 3-5) can choose to have the pitcher pitch.
 3) The outfielder fields the hit ball and throws it to the pitcher, who resets it onto the batting tee.
 4) Low grades rotate positions every 5 minutes on teacher command, while upper grades rotate after 5 hits or 3 minutes.
pe-04678:
1) Students rotate in colored teams across six stations: beanbag toss, catching, basketball, fitness/trampoline, jump rope, and paddle balloon.
 2) At the beanbag toss, students throw underhand into buckets; sinking all three lets them step back, while a miss brings them closer.
 3) Students practice target skills at each station for 3 to 5 minutes until the music stops.
 4) When music stops, students clean up within a 10-second countdown, sit down, and rotate to the next center upon the switch call.
pe-04679:
1) Students observe pictures on cones illustrating specific skills: hurdle leaping, one-foot hopping, soccer dribbling, basketball shooting, crab walking, skipping, and scooter riding.
 2) A student performs the designated skill along the lane around the baby cone and returns.
 3) Upon return, the student taps ('beeps') the cone to signal the next person in line to go.
 4) After finishing one station, students choose another cone skill to test themselves.
pe-04680:
1) Hunters start on a dot with balls, while the turkey team is in the middle area.
 2) Turkeys must walk, and hunters throw balls at the turkeys to hit them.
 3) If a turkey is hit with a ball, they are caught.
 4) Hunters collect balls from the floor but cannot cross the white line into the turkey area, and turkeys must stay inside the white lines.
pe-04681:
1) Partners face each other to practice underhand serves.
 2) Catching the served ball earns two points.
 3) Touching the ball without catching it earns one point.
 4) Missing the ball completely earns zero points, and partners keep track of their points together.
pe-04682:
1) Squat down on toes like a frog while holding the parachute.
 2) Take one step in and lift the parachute to make an 'umbrella'.
 3) Following the student leader, take three scooches inward to form a 'mushroom'.
 4) Step back out and shake the parachute to create 'waves'.
pe-04683:
1) Most students begin on scooters, three wait behind a cone, and two taggers with tagging sticks start in the middle on scooters.
 2) Taggers scoot around the gym to safely tag players.
 3) Tagged players leave their scooters and stand in line behind the cone, while the next waiting student takes the scooter into the game.
 4) Every 2 to 3 minutes, taggers choose new taggers to switch roles.
pe-04684:
1) Students enter quietly along the black line and stand on their assigned tape-marked spots.
 2) A student leader stands in front to demonstrate and lead the 12 warm-up exercises with music.
 3) Follow each exercise, such as jogging in place and lunges, for 20 to 30 seconds for the duration of one song (about 3 minutes).
 4) Transition to the next exercise when the teacher signals with a pointer or picture clipboard.
pe-04685:
1) Stand inside a hula hoop holding it like a steering wheel to represent personal space.
 2) Move safely around the gymnasium using walking, jogging, skipping, or galloping movements.
 3) If a student bumps into or touches anyone, they must park their car by sitting down inside the hoop.
 4) Visit destination pictures posted on walls or pair two students inside one hoop as variations.
pe-04686:
1) Set up a low volleyball net dividing the gym into two team courts.
 2) Players bend down and roll dodgeballs under the net aiming at opponents' feet and legs without throwing.
 3) If hit by a rolled ball, the player must sit down and wait for the soap scooter helper.
 4) The hit player pretends to wash hands for 20 seconds or sings the ABC song before standing back up to rejoin the game.
pe-04687:
1) Start with choreographed group dances after practicing routines in prior lessons.
 2) Move on to 15 to 20 minutes of freestyle dancing to lively music.
 3) Respect personal space during freestyle dance and avoid running aimlessly, pulling, or lifting peers.
pe-04688:
1) Students divide into groups of three and line up behind a poly spot.
 2) Nine buckets containing 10 to 15 plastic hearts each are placed along the opposite wall.
 3) Students take turns running down to get one heart, run back, and place it on the poly spot.
 4) The activity can be modified by having students skip or gallop instead of running.
pe-04689:
1) Perform only the displayed locomotor movement around the gym following the teacher's cues.
 2) Practice galloping by stepping one foot forward and sliding the back foot up to meet it.
 3) Stop immediately and return to assigned spots upon hearing the whistle.
pe-04690:
1) Students stand on designated spots and throw the ball to teammates on other spots.
 2) The teammate who catches the ball brings it to the team treasure chest.
 3) Players switch roles between throwing and receiving.
 4) Earn points by spelling words with the collected letters.
pe-04691:
1) Teams travel from island to island using only a preset set of items retrieved from the shipwreck.
 2) As they travel, players must step forward and pick up the trailing equipment to advance.
 3) Reach the island and retrieve the first clue sheet to unlock the word lock box.
 4) Use equipment clues to cross to subsequent islands, solve combination and directional locks, gather the entire team into floor hoops, and open the final box.
pe-04692:
1) Dribble a ball and touch all 20 cones across the gym before the music stops playing.
 2) Progress through self-paced bounce pass challenges according to individual readiness.
 3) Track progression on the magnetic plagnets scale after passing levels 3, 6, and 8.
 4) Finish in small groups competing simultaneously in a make-it-take-it shooting contest.
pe-04693:
1) Teams use provided equipment to travel across the gymnasium from island to island without touching the floor.
 2) Solve clue papers to unlock breakout boxes in sequence.
 3) Each unlocked box provides a new piece of equipment to help navigate the journey across the gym.
 4) Unlock the final box and safely gather all team members onto the three hula hoops at the end to finish.
pe-04694:
1) Students form groups of three or four, taking roles of holder, hand opener, and noodle placer.
 2) The holder presses both hands together horizontally while teammates place noodle slices between the hands.
 3) Teammates separate the stack from the middle and add more noodle slices to increase the count.
 4) When the group feels the stack might collapse, they ask the teacher for an official count, after which no more slices can be added.
pe-04695:
1) Place a mat over six scooters to construct a team ship.
 2) Scatter colored mini cones in the center and place matching colored hoops around the gym.
 3) Teams navigate their ship to the center to retrieve one cone item at a time.
 4) Deliver the cone to the matching colored hula hoop bin to clear all trash as fast as possible.
pe-04696:
1) Set up tables with folding nets, paddles, and foam balls.
 2) Students select a personal challenge target of 5, 10, or 20 hits based on ability.
 3) Practice striking the ball with paddles to achieve the chosen repetition goal.
 4) Record individual progress on the assessment chart across differentiated levels.
pe-04697:
1) Divide the class into two teams, with one student sitting on a scooter and a partner pushing them, using yarn balls as ammunition.
 2) Depending on penny colors, knock down the opposing team's pin towers with balls.
 3) The first team to knock down all opposing pins wins the round.
 4) If a team knocks over the special cone in the center, they can reset one of their fallen pins.
pe-04698:
1) Students must figure out the correct hidden movement pattern on the grid.
 2) Students navigating cannot communicate with each other, though designated map readers are permitted to talk to them.
 3) The team begins with 12 lives represented by 12 beanbags, losing one life each time a mistake is made.
 4) If they run out of lives, they get one final chance to earn extra lives equal to the length of the longest word they can create from given letters.
pe-04699:
1) Students form a circle standing with legs apart and strike the ball along the floor using hands to pass through others' legs.
 2) If the ball passes between your legs, you receive a strike.
 3) If you hit the ball into the air and it is caught, or it flies out over someone's legs, you get a strike.
 4) After receiving three strikes, rotate to another game circle in the gym to keep playing without elimination.
pe-04700:
1) Place a gym mat on top of six lined-up scooters to build a team ship.
 2) Students position around all sides of the mat and push it cooperatively.
 3) Move out to collect resource items and bring them back to headquarters.
 4) The team that collects the most items before they run out wins.
pe-04701:
1) Partners check progressive learning challenges projected on the screen.
 2) Choose small or large hoops and preferred ball types to practice hand-striking into the hoops.
 3) Track completed challenge levels using magnetic assessment boards.
 4) Interchange hoops and balls anytime during the lesson to match comfortable challenge levels.
pe-04702:
1) Divide students into four teams of 5-6 wearing color-coded pinnies, and scatter colored hoops across the floor.
 2) Players occupy an open hoop to defend it and engage in rock-paper-scissors battles against challenging opponents.
 3) Winners take or keep possession of the hoop, while losers move to challenge open or occupied hoops elsewhere.
 4) The teacher stops the game every minute to award 1 point for any hoop and 3 points for matching team-color hoops.
pe-04703:
1) Working in pairs, one student sits on a scooter resting their feet on a noodle scooter, while the partner pushes or pulls them around.
 2) Only the seated student may grab scarves from other teams' noodles, while the pusher cannot touch any scarves.
 3) If a team loses all scarves from their noodles, they must stand up stationary until they grab a scarf from someone coming close or receive a donation.
pe-04704:
1) Set up 5 to 10 bowling pins on each side separated by center cones, with a hula hoop around each pin to keep defenders back.
 2) Players throw balls across to knock down the opposing team's bowling pins.
 3) Making a basketball shot allows a team to reset knocked-down pins, and only the player who made the basket may reset the pin.
pe-04705:
1) Students make a circle and another group of students stand inside the circle.
 2) Outside students hit the kin ball with their hands to hit students in the middle.
 3) Students who get hit go to a designated area to exercise and return to the game once completed.
 4) The game continues for two to three minutes.
pe-04706:
1) Divide into two teams with a center boundary line and upright mats forming a cookie jar.
 2) Students inside the jar throw landed balls back into the playing area.
 3) Throwing team runs to collect balls and overhand toss them into the cookie jar.
 4) Defenders on the jar side attempt to catch incoming balls to protect the jar.
pe-04707:
1) Perform bicep curls while seated on the chair for 20 seconds.
 2) Rest for 10 seconds.
 3) Hold a hover squat position slightly above the chair seat for 20 seconds.
 4) Rest for 10 seconds, then repeat the set of bicep curls and hovers one more time.
pe-04708:
1) Form a circle and slap the ball across to opponents, earning 1 point if the ball gets past a player.
 2) Increase the difficulty by using two balls simultaneously.
 3) Place one player in the center to dodge the balls; if hit, they raise their hand and switch spots with the thrower who hit them.
 4) Expand the center to three dodging players while keeping two balls in play.
pe-04709:
1) Scatter 10 to 12 hula hoops across the gymnasium floor.
 2) While music plays, students perform locomotor skills around the gym without stepping inside hoops.
 3) When the music stops, students must find a hoop and place one foot inside it.
 4) Increase difficulty by removing hoops or requiring exact group sizes inside each hoop.
pe-04710:
1) Scatter various colored hula hoops and bean bags across the entire gym floor.
 2) Each student picks up one bean bag at a time and places it into the matching color hula hoop.
 3) Bean bags placed inside hoops cannot be touched again, continuing until all bags are cleaned up.
 4) Vary movements using different locomotor skills such as hopping, sliding, or changing movement speeds.
pe-04711:
1) Two Grinches hold foam noodles for tagging, while the rest of the players start with 5 popsicle sticks each.
 2) Players run around the gym but cannot enter the center circle designated as the Grinch's cave.
 3) When tagged by a Grinch, players raise their hand, go inside the cave to deposit one popsicle stick into the bucket, and re-enter the game.
 4) If a player loses all five sticks, they visit the teacher to perform an exercise and earn sticks to rejoin.
pe-04712:
1) Runners hold the baton out, and the next person grabs the baton from them.
 2) Start with cones super close together and have students go around them.
 3) Go around the same color cone that you have.
 4) Gradually move the cones back about 5 feet as students progress.
pe-04713:
1) Players stand at the cone, step up to the throwing line on their turn, and throw the frisbee to knock down bowling pins.
 2) Pick up the frisbee and knocked-down pin, run back along the outside boundary line, hand the frisbee to the partner, and place the pin in the hoop.
 3) Round 1 is won by the team collecting the most pins, and Round 2 is won by the team collecting the most pins matching their team color.
 4) In Round 3, eliminate pins until the last remaining pin determines the winning team color.
pe-04714:
1) All students start at Corner 1, raise their hand to find a partner, and play the winter RPS game (Snowman, Bell, Candle).
 2) Winners advance to the next corner, while non-winners stay in the current corner and find a new partner.
 3) Winning at Corner 4 earns a bracelet, and the player returns to Corner 1 to start again.
 4) Check who collected the most bracelets or holds the designated magic color at the end.
pe-04715:
1) Place buckets filled with colored craft sticks or scarves along the outdoor track.
 2) Run a lap around the track and pick up one stick or scarf as a feather after each lap.
 3) Collect different colors each lap or choose freely from the buckets.
 4) When using scarves, tuck each scarf into the waistband while running.
pe-04716:
1) Each team stays in their designated area against the wall with cones set up around the gym.
 2) The first runner completes one lap on the track, retrieves one piece of equipment from the center, and returns to their team.
 3) The next person goes when their teammate returns, and teams build anything they want related to winter.
 4) If a team lacks a specific color, they may approach another team to trade equipment.
pe-04717:
1) Practice putting with two golf balls each, attempting to make a hole-in-one.
 2) Count the number of strokes taken to get the ball into the hole, applying a one-stroke penalty if it lands in a hazard.
 3) Creatively customize the putting green by adding bumps or obstacles.
 4) Rotate to another green that someone else created and putt on their obstacle course.
pe-04718:
1) Hold the wind wand in one hand and make big circles in front of the body, then reverse the direction.
 2) Switch to the other hand to make big circles, then move it overhead making large circular motions.
 3) Draw figure-8 shapes in front of the body with the wand.
 4) Hold one wand in each hand near the end, spin double circles, and take two trips around the room.
pe-04719:
1) Place target rings on the ground and determine the throwing order behind the starting line.
 2) Stand with one foot in the designated ring and roll a soft die towards the target ring.
 3) If the rolled die rests completely inside the ring, score the exact number shown on top of the die.
 4) Take turns rolling for four attempts and tally up the total points to see who scored more.
pe-04720:
1) Divide into two teams along boundaries marked by small cones behind the throwing line.
 2) Step with the opposite foot and slide/throw bean bags underhand to knock over bowling pins and cones.
 3) When all bean bags are thrown, retrieve and fill the team buckets without knocking down pins.
 4) Transition to rolling balls underhand to knock down remaining targets and compare total knockdowns.
pe-04721:
1) Perform underhand throws with swing, step, and throw.
 2) Perform overhand throws by turning sideways, making an L shape, and using step, twist, and throw.
 3) Always step with the opposite foot when throwing.
 4) Catch high balls with thumbs together and low balls with pinkies together.
pe-04722:
1) Teams line up with five bocce balls per team.
 2) The first runner rolls a ball attempting to make it stay inside the hula hoop.
 3) If the ball stays inside the hoop, the player scores and moves to the back of the line for the next runner to take the next ball.
 4) If the ball rolls out of the hoop, the player must run to retrieve it, bring it back, and hand it to the next person.
pe-04723:
1) Set up boundaries and designate two taggers holding pool noodle halves.
 2) Taggers work as a team to run and tag runners from the shoulders down before the music stops.
 3) Players become frozen if tagged, if they fall down on the ground, or if they step outside boundaries.
 4) Frozen players must stay in one place and do a fist pump side-to-side dance until taggers are switched.
pe-04724: 1) Divide into two teams, and the team that wins rock-paper-scissors serves underhand from behind the end line to start the game2) Using bare hands (fist, back of hand, palm), send the indiaca over the net into the opponent's court within 3 touches like volleyball3) Play 3 sets of 15 points each, and the first team to win 2 sets wins the match
pe-04725: 1) Divide into two teams, wear team vests, and place the ball on a saucer cone2) Two batters pair up to hold the rope bat and swing it together within 7 seconds to hit the ball3) Batters run around the near cone (1 pt) or far cone (2 pts) to touch the red base, while defenders throw to the catcher touching the blue base for an out
pe-04726: 1) Two teams line up in their respective end zones, and the losing team of rock-paper-scissors throws the disc to the attacking team to start.2) Players cannot run while holding the disc, so they must advance only through passes into the opponent's end zone to score.3) If the disc is dropped or hits the ground during a pass, turnover occurs on the spot, and a player must throw the disc within 10 seconds of catching it.4) After scoring, the scoring team throws off to the conceding team, and the team with the most points after two 10-minute halves wins.
pe-04727: 1) Decide turn order by playing rock-paper-scissors between team representatives.2) Teams take turns throwing curling stones toward the target sheet from behind the baseline.3) The team with the stone closest to the center wins the round.4) The winning team scores points equal to the number of consecutive stones closer to the center than the opponent's best stone.
pe-04728: 1) Divide into two teams, assign positions/zones, wear bibs, and start play with a center pass2) Dribbling and walking over one step are prohibited, and the ball must be passed to teammates within 3 seconds3) Defenders must keep 1 meter distance and can only intercept passes, while designated shooters score by shooting into the goal
pe-04729: 1) Place left hand on the waist, hook fingers, and turn for 8 counts.2) Repeat the turn in the opposite direction for 8 counts.3) Connect clapping with traditional talchum and hansam waving motions.4) Perform the full sequence repeatedly to the rhythm of Arirang.
pe-04730: 1) Stretch the shoulders and back muscles in a frog stretch position.2) Stand tall and alternate touching elbows to opposite knees.3) Perform lunges and kick the back leg forward when rising.4) Hold a plank position raising hips, then lie down and perform bicycle kicks.5) Perform wide squats with feet spread apart.
pe-04731: 1) Students acting as Rudolph hold their own ankles and stay crouched down.2) The Santa tries to pull and lift Rudolph players by their ankles.3) Rudolph must not kick and should hold firm to avoid getting pulled.4) Any Rudolph captured joins Santa to help pull the remaining players.
pe-04732: 1) Jump two times inside and two times outside the line on the floor.2) Turn while jumping on the beat, rotating in increments until returning to the starting position.3) Practice 8 adapted footwork movements including hopping, two-foot jumping, and running steps to the rhythm and perform them with music.
pe-04733: 1) Learn basic arm movements by waving hands left and right and turning them.2) Practice characteristic CanCan leg movements by lifting knees and kicking legs forward.3) Link the five basic movements including clapping, turning, and in-place steps to perform the dance along to the CanCan music.
pe-04734: 1) Stand comfortably and bounce smoothly to the rhythm by slightly lowering the hips without straining the knees.2) Move sideways to the rhythm, slightly lifting the heel of the trailing foot.3) Perform side walks by stepping the leading foot forward and swaying the pelvis and shoulders.4) Open both arms and step backward while leaning the shoulders back slightly, then dance to the music.
pe-04735: 1) Hold two scarves and practice throwing them diagonally in an X pattern to a set height and catching them with opposite hands.2) Practice holding one scarf with the ring and pinky fingers while holding another with thumb and index finger to throw and catch.3) Hold three scarves and practice the throwing order: 1 (right hand), 2 (left hand), and 3 (inside right hand).4) Perform the full three-scarf cascade by continuously following the throw-throw-catch rhythm.
pe-04736: 1) Sit cross-legged and rotate the upper body 10 times to each side.2) Lie on the back with knees bent and twist knees side to side.3) Place one foot on the opposite knee and pull the lower leg toward the chest.4) Lie face down and gently lift the legs or upper body to stretch.
pe-04737: 1) Blow air into a plastic bag and tie it to create a lightweight homemade volleyball.2) Practice the underhand pass by clasping hands with flat thumbs, bending the knees, and popping the bag upward.3) Practice the overhand pass by forming a triangle with thumbs and index fingers and pushing the bag upward in place.4) Practice the underhand serve by stepping forward and striking with the palm, followed by the floating serve tossed at a 45-degree angle.5) Practice spike mechanics by jumping and hitting the floating bag downward.
pe-04738: 1) Tie four strings to a rubber band so four students can pull from different directions2) Without using hands, pull the strings to expand the band and grip a cup3) Coordinate with teammates to move the cup to the side4) Stack the cups into a pyramid within the time limit
pe-04739: 1) Cross arms to stretch shoulders and rotate the waist to warm up.2) Bring elbows and fingertips completely together and raise arms straight up and down.3) Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width and alternately bend knees for lower body strength.4) Sit on the floor, slightly raise legs, and tap the floor side to side for core training.5) Stand and mimic pull-ups with arms flexed for 20 repetitions.6) Perform bicycle crunches by touching the elbow to the opposite knee while twisting the torso.7) Perform squats combined with front punches upon standing up.8) Cool down by stretching the back and reaching arms forward on the floor.
pe-04740: 1) Perform neck, shoulder, knee, and leg stretches to warm up the upper and lower body.2) Execute high knees towards thigh and chest height, followed by hip rotation stretches in place.3) Practice low kicks forward and high jumping kicks while running.4) Lift the feet using the inside and outside of the foot and shake out the legs with light steps.5) Practice imaginary inside and outside foot passes in rhythm with running steps and finish with breathing exercises.
pe-04741: 1) Learn basic diagonal footwork stepping left and right.2) Practice forehand and backhand hairpin strokes combined with footwork.3) Place an object like a remote control on the floor and practice jumping footwork.4) Practice clear, smash, and drive swings sequentially following the footwork.
pe-04742: 1) Play rock-paper-scissors and raise both arms while quickly shouting the outcome ('Won', 'Lost', 'Tied'); the first to shout wins.2) In the reverse variation, quickly call out the opposite result ('Lost' if won, 'Won' if lost, 'Tied' if tied).3) In Body Freeze RPS, mimic rock, paper, and scissors using whole-body poses, and the first to win 3 rounds wins.
pe-04743: 1) Assign different snack bar menu items (tempura, ramen, sundae, dumplings, etc.) to each horizontal row and vertical column in the classroom.2) When the caller shouts a specific menu item, students in that corresponding row or column stand up.3) The called students run along the classroom aisles following the designated horizontal or vertical direction.4) Students race around the track and the first to return and sit properly in their seat wins.
pe-04744: 1) Tie yarn between classroom desks to create a spiderweb obstacle course, allowing up to 3 strings per desk.2) Hang paper cards on the strings to detect any touch.3) Escape to the other side by crawling under or stepping over the yarn without touching the strings.
pe-04745: 1) Two players face each other, perform split-step jumps for scissors (feet front-back), rock (feet together), and paper (feet wide), and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The winner places one of their shuttlecocks onto the designated line or zone.3) The player who successfully empties and places all 3 shuttlecocks first wins.
pe-04746: 1) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.2) Each time a player loses, they lower their stance progressively: one knee down (step 1), both knees down (step 2), sitting on the floor (step 3), and prone position (step 4).3) The player who loses for the fifth time and lies completely flat on the floor loses the match.
pe-04747: 1) Perform thorough joint warm-up stretches from head to toe.2) Learn 8 key strength movements including squats, hand touches, lunges, and knee-ups.3) Perform the 8 strength exercises continuously in rhythm with fast-paced music.4) Conclude with partner shoulder taps and cool-down stretching.
pe-04748: 1) Run and complete missions with a partner using spots as safe zones.2) Touch the wall and quickly return to the starting spot.3) Complete a relay by crawling under the partner's spread legs.
pe-04749: 1) Keep elbows close to your sides and practice basic techniques including two-foot bounce, alternate-foot jump, and criss-cross using wrist rotations.2) Run to a turn-around point holding a jump rope, then run together with the next partner holding the rope in a relay.3) Two partners hold a jump rope tautly between them, place a balloon or ball on the rope, and carry it into a goal without dropping it.
pe-04750: 1) Flip the racket between forehand and backhand to bounce the shuttlecock upward alone.2) Pair up with a partner and take turns hitting the shuttlecock back and forth.3) Add a third player and maintain a continuous rally among three people.4) Set up four target areas numbered 1 through 4 and hit shuttlecocks toward them.5) Attempt 10 hits to see how many accurately land inside the designated target circles.
pe-04751: 1) Arrange six hula hoops on the floor in a pyramid layout and assign 1, 2, and 3 points by distance.2) Stand behind the throwing line and toss beanbags underhand into the hoops.3) Calculate total points based on which hula hoops the beanbags landed in after tossing all bags.
pe-04752: 1) Tossing from the front scores 1 point on the board and 3 points in the hole.2) Players can choose to throw from the back, scoring 2 points on the board and 6 points in the hole.3) Take turns throwing from both sides and calculate your score.
pe-04753: 1) Stand at a spot marker and pass the soft flying disc to a teammate.2) Run around the outside of the square to take the next spot marker.3) Continue passing and rotating until the final runner returns to the starting spot marker.
pe-04754: 1) Lie prone on the mat with the body straight, holding a bracelet.2) Roll sideways with the body extended and pass the bracelet to the next teammate.3) The next teammate rolls across to transport all bracelets to the target area.
pe-04755: 1) Team members line up in a train formation holding the back or shoulders of the person in front.2) Starting from the front, step through the hoop with feet and head without breaking the hold and pass it back.3) Pass the hoop all the way back until it lands around the cone behind the last runner.
pe-04756: 1) The first runner dribbles in a zigzag pattern.2) After passing the spot marker, pass the ball backward.3) The next runner starts upon receiving the ball, and the game ends when the ball reaches the final spot.
pe-04757: 1) Set a timer for 1 or 2 minutes and prepare one beanbag.2) Score 1 point for landing on the board and 3 points for going into the hole.3) Players rotate continuously to throw and accumulate scores.
pe-04758: 1) Toss a scarf and a ball into the air.2) Catch the ball first with your hands.3) Catch the scarf on your head or balance it on top of the caught ball.
pe-04759: 1) Form a circle and have each person bounce and catch their own ball in place.2) Bounce the ball and move one spot to the right to catch the next ball.3) Toss the ball straight up and catch it in place.4) Toss the ball up and rotate to the right to catch the next person's ball.
pe-04760: 1) Form pairs facing each other.2) One player tosses a folded team bib, and the partner catches it using a racket.3) Move sideways to the next spot if caught, or return to the starting position if missed.
pe-04761: 1) Form pairs in each team and run toward the spot markers upon the start signal.2) Toss and catch beanbags within the designated circle.3) If dropped, return to the spot and toss again; determine ranks based on collected beanbags.
pe-04762: 1) The tagger chases students dribbling soccer balls using a foam stick.2) Tagged students must freeze, raise the soccer ball above their heads, and spread their legs.3) A teammate revives them by dribbling a ball through their open legs; praise those tagged least.
pe-04763: 1) Group members bounce table tennis balls off the floor into a stacking cup.2) Whenever a ball lands in the cup, all group members perform jumping jacks twice.3) Each success allows stacking another cup and ball on top to complete a 4-6 tier tower.
pe-04764: 1) A teammate places a ball on top of another ball held by the player to form a snowman shape.2) Balance the balls and keep them from falling for as long as possible.
pe-04765: 1) Hold two cups in both hands and toss the balloon ball into the air.2) Catch the tossed balloon ball with the cups.3) In pairs, toss and catch the balloon ball to each other using the cups.
pe-04766: 1) Quickly perform 2 jumping jacks2) Bounce a table tennis ball into the egg carton3) Win by connecting three balls in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally
pe-04767: 1) Stand up from back-to-back sitting position and run around your partner2) Jump over your partner's legs3) Crawl through the body tunnel made by your partner, pass through the legs, return, and switch roles
pe-04768: 1) Tap the balloon into the air using the ball.2) Quickly pass the ball to a teammate while the balloon is floating.3) Keep hitting the balloon up with the ball to continue the rally.
pe-04769: 1) Team members stand in line holding hands.2) Pass the hoop through the body from head to toe without letting go of hands.3) The team that passes the hoop through all members around the turning point first wins.
pe-04770: 1) Two players face each other, one holding a hoop and the other holding a basketball.2) On the count of 'one, two, three', throw the hoop upward while passing the ball directly through it.3) Toss both the ball and hoop slightly higher so they do not collide in midair.
pe-04771: 1) Sit back-to-back on the floor with legs extended with a partner2) One partner stands up, circles around the partner, and leaps over their legs3) Sit back down back-to-back, switch roles, and repeat for two complete rounds
pe-04772: 1) Each player tosses their team bib into the air forward from the start line.2) If caught, drop the bib at that spot, move the spot marker there, and toss again.3) If missed, retrieve the bib and return to the marker position to try again.4) The player who reaches the designated finish line first wins.
pe-04773: 1) Pair up with a partner.2) Increase the number of claps one by one in sync with the chant and clap with your partner.3) You must clap your own hands after clapping with your partner.4) Praise the pairs that finish first.
pe-04774: 1) Pair up with a partner, jump twice, and play rock-paper-scissors.2) Make moves where scissors means one person sits, rock means both sit, and paper means both stand.3) Play against another pair without planning moves beforehand.
pe-04775: 1) Face your partner across a desk and take turns bouncing the ball.2) Challenge bounces sequentially from 1 up to 5 bounces.3) Be the first to successfully complete up to 5 bounces within the allowed failure limit.
pe-04776: 1) Start immediately on signal without rock-paper-scissors and perform one squat.2) Bounce a table tennis ball into an egg carton.3) Perform a squat before each throw even if a shot misses.4) The first player to align three balls in a row raises a hand to declare victory.
pe-04777: 1) The tagger (octopus) holds foam sticks to chase and tag runners.2) Players tagged must move around in a crab-walk posture.3) When two crab players meet and give each other a high-five, both are revived and return to the game.4) Praise students who persevered without being caught at the end of the round.
pe-04778: 1) In groups of three, two players hold the ends of a scarf and one player stands at the start.2) On signal, the runner circles around the two players holding the scarf.3) When the scarf is raised high, pass under it, and when lowered, step over it one foot at a time.4) The activity finishes once all three members take turns completing the round.
pe-04779: 1) Set up spot markers on the floor as stepping stones and stand at the starting line.2) Throw a team bib to cover a spot marker.3) Once the bib lands on the marker, jump onto it with both feet or one foot.4) Repeat the process to be the first to reach the finish line.
pe-04780: 1) Team members line up in a plank position on the floor.2) A player rolls and passes the ball under the teammates' bodies.3) After passing the ball, the player quickly moves to the front of the line to resume the plank position.4) Teams cooperate to advance to the destination.
pe-04781: 1) Form a tunnel shape by holding hands.2) Pass through the tunnel one by one.3) The person who exits immediately connects at the front to continue the tunnel.
pe-04782: 1) Pair up into groups of two and get two spot markers.2) Place the spot markers one by one and jump forward using both feet together.3) Upon reaching the destination, switch roles and return.
pe-04783: 1) Roll forward on the high jump mat.2) Run around the perimeter of the mat one and a half laps.3) Tag the next teammate's hand to take turns and measure the team time.
pe-04784: 1) Step one foot forward.2) Keep arms extended to the sides, jump while crossing feet back and forth, and cross arms up and down in front of the chest.3) Repeat the criss-cross movement to the rhythm of counting one, two, three.
pe-04785: 1) Place a cone on the back or behind the neck.2) Hold both hands behind the legs.3) Walk or run without dropping the cone.4) If the cone falls, return to the start line and begin again.
pe-04786: 1) Place a cone inside a hoop tied to a rope and pull it at a constant speed.2) Three players roll balls to hit the moving cone.3) The player who hits the cone switches roles with the puller.
pe-04787: 1) Both teams take turns tossing beanbags toward the hole on the cornhole board.2) Players who land a beanbag in the hole successfully exit the game.3) Each player must retrieve the beanbag they threw.4) The team whose members all exit first wins.
pe-04788: 1) Two players face each other, and one player tosses a balloon into the air.2) While the balloon is airborne, underhand pass the volleyball thrown by the partner back.3) Perform 5 times and switch roles.
pe-04789: 1) Walk around in the egg stage and play rock-paper-scissors with another egg.2) Win to level up to chick, lose to drop down one stage.3) Progress through chicken, whole chicken, and chicken delivery stages.4) Win at delivery to challenge the teacher boss, and winning creates branch store owners.
pe-04790: 1) Team members stand in a zigzag formation with adequate spacing.2) On the start signal, the first player hands a ring to the next teammate.3) After passing the ring, the player steps out of line.4) The team that passes the ring hand-to-hand in a zigzag to the end fastest wins.
pe-04791: 1) Inhale through a straw to pick up paper squares and alternate stacking paper cups on top.2) The first player to build a 5-tier tower performs a designated exercise (such as 5 jumping jacks).3) Pull out the paper layers so the cups nest together, then complete the exercise again to win.
pe-04792: 1) Players from both teams step on number spots from opposite sides and play rock-paper-scissors when they meet.2) The loser steps out to an adjacent spot and sits down.3) A teammate coming from behind can revive the sitting player by touching their head.4) The team that first steps on the opponent's final spot wins.
pe-04793: 1) Starting runners from Team A and Team B stand on their respective spots.2) Upon the signal, players run around the cones and whoever steps on the center spot first becomes the attacker.3) They play Cham-Cham-Cham; if the attacker wins, the attacker shoots, and if the defender wins, the defender shoots.
pe-04794: 1) The tagger dribbles a soccer ball and kicks it to hit running players.2) Hit players become taggers, get a ball, and dribble to tag others.3) Continue playing until the last surviving player remains.
pe-04795: 1) Stand facing each other about 1 to 2 meters apart.2) Hit a balloon using paper plates or newspaper sticks back and forth.3) Keep the balloon in the air to complete 20 consecutive rallies without letting it hit the ground.
pe-04796: 1) Runner 2 holds a beanbag while Runner 1 runs out on signal to step on a desired spot marker.2) Runner 2 throws the beanbag, and Runner 1 captures the spot marker if caught without stepping off.3) Bring the spot marker back, pass to the next runner, and the team with the most markers wins.
pe-04797: 1) Groups of 3 to 4 students hold a long foam stick together.2) On signal, run together toward cones placed ahead and turn around them.3) Round the turning cone and return to pass the stick to the next group.
pe-04798: 1) Face a partner and roll the ball along the floor using the scoop to catch it.2) Lightly toss and catch the ball with the scoop from a close distance.3) Move further apart or use one bounce to throw and catch while gently tilting the wrist.
pe-04799: 1) Turn the long jump rope while participants travel through it from one side to the other.2) As one runner enters and moves through, the next runner immediately follows into the rope.3) Compete as a team to achieve the highest total jumps and passes within 30 seconds.
pe-04800: 1) Enter the rotating long rope by following its rhythm as it touches the ground and moves upward.2) Enter near the rope turners where the arc is smaller rather than the center to clear the rope safely.3) In Long Rope Viking, once the runner crosses, turners immediately reverse the rope's direction for the return trip.4) Gradually increase the group size from 1 to 2, 3, and 4 runners completing continuous round trips.
pe-04801: 1) On signal, pass items overhead from the front of the line to the back.2) Only the person holding an item may move backward to the next spot marker to relay it.3) The team that transports all items without knocking over the cone castle wins.
pe-04802: 1) Set up a goal using three classroom desks.2) Pass the ball quickly between teammates when the game starts.3) Shoot the ball toward the desk goal when an opening appears.4) The team that scores more baskets during the given time wins.
pe-04803: 1) Place mats on the floor and stand facing each other on both sides.2) Set a 1-minute timer and pass the balloon back and forth.3) Keep the balloon from hitting the floor or going outside the designated mat area to achieve 30 passes (50 passes for adults) in one minute.
pe-04804: 1) Two players face each other with a dish cone placed in the middle2) The caller names body parts or other words and unexpectedly shouts "Catch!"3) The player who grabs the dish cone first (or pulls it with a foot) upon hearing "Catch!" wins the round
pe-04805: 1) Set up two bases on opposite sides and divide players into offense and defense teams.2) The offensive runner must run back and forth between the two bases for 5 laps.3) The defense passes the ball 10 times among themselves to touch or tag out the runner.4) If the runner does not move while 10 passes are completed or gets tagged out, offense and defense switch.
pe-04806: 1) Advance towards the opponent zone by running or passing the ball.2) If tagged while holding the ball, stop immediately and place it down to play as soccer.3) Pass by hand to a teammate in the scoring area for 1 point, or kick for 3 points.
pe-04807: 1) Practice assembling into squad, circle, and classroom formations based on teacher cues.2) Form a circle and perform joint warmups from ankles to neck followed by whole-body stretching.3) Use remaining time to conduct a 50-meter sprint test to assess student baseline fitness.4) Reassemble in a circle for cooldown stretching and review the lesson.
pe-04808: 1) Advance the ball using passes only without dribbling.2) Score 2 points by throwing into the center circle goal or 1 point into the four corner squares.3) If an attacker holding the ball tags a defender with it, the defender must step out, complete a physical exercise task, and return.4) If physical contact occurs, call a defensive foul and resume play immediately from the spot of the foul.
pe-04809: 1) Form pairs of one performer and one measurer.2) The performer lies on a mat with knees bent at 90 degrees and palms resting on thighs.3) The measurer places fingertips below the performer's kneecaps.4) Following the 3-second cadence beep, curl up until fingertips touch, then return to the starting position.5) The test ends when the performer fails to reach the mark twice in succession.
pe-04810: 1) Set up cone markers numbered 1 through 6 in a straight line at equal intervals from the start.2) The first runner rolls a soft dice ball and checks the number rolled.3) The runner calls out the number loudly and runs around the corresponding cone while holding the dice.4) The runner returns around their group, passes the dice to the next runner, and the first team to finish wins.
pe-04811: 1) Four students each hold one string tied to a central rubber band.2) Teammates pull strings simultaneously to stretch the band around Speed Stacks cups and stack them into a 4-3-2-1 pyramid.3) Once the pyramid is built, move the cups back one by one into a single stacked column.
pe-04812: 1) Teams line up at the start line with 3 distance lines marked using cones.2) Runner 1 carries 3 disc cones, runs to the first line, places one cone, and runs back to the start.3) Runner 1 repeats this for the second and third lines, placing cones, and then tags runner 2.4) Runner 2 runs out empty-handed and retrieves the disc cones from each line one by one.
pe-04813: 1) Students form a circle around the teacher and practice waist wraps (20 times each way), knee wraps (20 times each side), figure-eight dribble wraps through legs (20 times), and combination wraps from knees to waist, head, waist, and knees (10 times) with one ball per student.2) After practicing the basic handling skills, everyone participates in a timing-based 'sense game'.3) Students caught in the sense game must complete a designated ball-handling penalty before rejoining the game.
pe-04814: 1) Mark a rectangular court with disc cones, and all students tuck a team pinny into their waistband as a tail.2) On the teacher's whistle, players move inside the boundary trying to grab opponents' tails.3) Players whose tails are pulled are not eliminated from the court but must hop on one foot to chase other players' tails.4) If a one-legged hopper snatches someone else's tail, they revive and continue playing on both feet.
pe-04815: 1) Complete 5 laps by meeting teammates and rounding the cone in High-Five Running.2) Deliver or retrieve dish cones in Pizza Delivery.3) Pass hoops from back to front to move forward and collect beanbags in Hoop Train.
pe-04816: 1) Students form a circle, and one chosen tagger steps out of the room or waits facing backward.2) A secret leader is chosen in the circle and begins dancing or making body movements to music, which everyone copies.3) The tagger stands in the center and gets three chances to identify the hidden leader; if successful, the leader becomes the next tagger.
pe-04817: 1) Divide the class into two teams and have them sit on the floor in single files facing each other.2) Gather all slippers at each team's designated starting point.3) On the start signal, the first player grabs a slipper using only their feet and passes it to the next person.4) If a slipper is dropped during the pass, it must be returned to the starting point to begin again.5) The team that moves all their slippers to the finish line first wins, and the losing team performs 10 leg drops as a penalty workout.
pe-04818: 1) Divide into two teams, line up bowling pins equal to the number of players in each territory, and have each player hold a ball.2) On start signal, roll balls toward the opponent's territory to knock down their bowling pins.3) Players may block incoming balls with hands or feet and retrieve balls rolling past to throw again.4) The team with more standing pins when time expires (e.g., 3 minutes) wins the game.
pe-04819: 1) Set up cones at the start and turning points, organize teams of 6, and give the dice to the first runner.2) The runner rolls the dice, calls out the number, and holds hands with that number of teammates to run around the turning point.3) Hand over the dice to the next runner, who rolls it and runs around the turn holding hands with the indicated number of teammates.4) Continuously add up the numbers rolled as the relay proceeds.5) The first team to reach exactly 31 wins, but exceeding 31 invalidates the roll and requires rerolling.
pe-04820: 1) Divide into two teams for offense and defense, place spot markers in a 4-3-2-1 pyramid pattern, and mark the starting line with cones.2) The defending team stands on the spot markers, and the attacking team waits at the starting line.3) An attacker runs to each defender and plays rock-paper-scissors, advancing to the next tier upon winning.4) If the attacker loses, they must return to the starting line, step on the starting point, and try again.5) Defeating the final defender at the top earns 1 point, and the team with the most points within the time limit wins.
pe-04821: 1) Pairs stand back-to-back, pass a ball sideways 20 times, and sit down2) Pairs pass a ball alternating over the head and through the legs to reach 20 repetitions first3) The entire class forms a circle facing the same way and passes a ball backwards alternating left and right to beat the target time4) The class passes a ball alternating over and under to challenge and reduce their record time
pe-04822: 1) Stack 12 cups per team with a different colored base cup at the bottom.2) Move cups one by one from top to bottom.3) Once the colored cup returns to the bottom, pass it to the next player.4) The team where all 4 members finish first wins.
pe-04823: 1) Form a circular track using cones and set two starting points facing each other at 180 degrees.2) Divide into two teams with team vests, and pair up players within each team to set the running order.3) On start, players 1 and 2 run along the track while continuously passing the ball to each other.4) After completing one lap, they pass the ball to the next pair; the team that catches up or finishes first wins.
pe-04824: 1) Scatter soft dice balls evenly across the gym floor.2) The referee tosses the scatter ball and a representative from each team calls out the top color once it stops.3) Teammates pass the matching dice ball between all members while moving toward the scatter ball.4) The last player to receive the pass throws the dice ball to hit the scatter ball and the team sits down.
pe-04825: 1) Students sit in a large circle leaving exactly one chair empty.2) When music starts, the two students beside the empty chair hold hands, pick any classmate, and seat them in the gap.3) The students adjacent to the newly created empty chair quickly hold hands and bring another guest.4) When the song ends, the two students next to the empty seat receive a penalty.
pe-04826: 1) Place cups marked 1 to 5 points at increasing distances starting from 3 steps away.2) Throw sock balls from chosen distance markers during the 3-minute time limit.3) Tally the points of all sock balls successfully tossed into the basket.
pe-04827: 1) Team members stand in a circle formation.2) Keep the big volleyball aloft in the air without letting it bounce on the floor.3) Call out 'Mine' when approaching the ball and cooperate to achieve 20 consecutive hits.
pe-04828: 1) Runners start simultaneously from four positions (12, 3, 6, and 9 o'clock) around the perimeter.2) If tagged by the runner immediately behind you, you are out.3) Runners continue circling until the teacher gives the command.4) On the command, crawl through a hoop into the center to grab the target cone first.
pe-04829: 1) Start by gently pushing the ball with the inside of the foot and trapping it with the sole between cones.2) Push the ball with the outside of the foot, step through, and stop it using the sole.3) Prepare an odd number of soccer balls and run 1-on-1 dribbling races by group.4) Dribble through the cones, shoot the ball into the mini goal, and run back.5) The team that scores more balls wins the match.
pe-04830: 1) Each group places drawing paper on the desk and decides player order from number 1.2) At the signal, player 1 runs to the problem basket and picks a word slip.3) The player must draw the word using only illustrations, without letters, numbers, English, or speaking.4) When teammates guess correctly, the next player runs to pick a new slip and continues.
pe-04831: 1) Write expressible words on paper, fold them, and place them in a central basket2) Form groups of four in a line, and the first student draws a paper prompt from the basket3) Tap the person in front to turn them around and act out the word using only body language to pass it along the line4) If the final student guesses correctly, keep the paper slip and start a new round from the back with a new prompt
pe-04832: 1) Pick a song and choose a seeker who temporarily steps out of the classroom2) Select one 'outsider' who only lip-syncs (or an 'insider' whose dance moves everyone copies)3) When the seeker enters, the music begins and the students sing and dance together4) For the outsider game, students sing louder as the seeker gets closer to the target; for the insider game, students copy the leader's dance moves while the seeker tries to spot them before the song ends
pe-04833: 1) Write group numbers and present initial consonants on the whiteboard.2) Group members brainstorm distinct words matching the consonants equal to their team size.3) Once ready, the group lines up quickly in front of the teacher.4) Each member must say a unique word within 1 second without hesitating.5) The fastest team earns 2 points and the runner-up earns 1 point before starting a new round.
pe-04834: 1) In Round 1, sit facing each other with feet touching and hold hands to stand up together, progressing from pairs to the whole group.2) In Round 2, hold hands in a circle and pass a hula hoop across bodies without letting go of hands, completing a full round and back.3) In Round 3, link crossed hands (right hand under palm up, left hand over palm down) and untangle into a proper circle without releasing hands.
pe-04835: 1) Select the mafia bosses and mafia members, and have the bosses wear team vests.2) Play rock-paper-scissors with the teacher, and players who win or tie move forward one step.3) Students tagged by a mafia boss are eliminated and return to their seats.4) Citizens guess and accuse the mafia members who move unconditionally; incorrect guesses result in elimination while correct guesses send the mafia to jail.
pe-04836: 1) With all students head down, select about 8 to 9 mafias based on a class of 28.2) The mafias quietly look at the screen to check their secret mission (e.g., stand up and sit down 3 times).3) When day comes, mafias must complete the mission without getting caught while citizens observe actions to identify them.4) When 3 suspects are nominated, a majority vote decides who is eliminated; an eliminated mafia takes down one citizen together.5) Citizens win if 5 mafias are eliminated first, while mafias win if 10 citizens are eliminated first.
pe-04837: 1) Start from the starting line and turn around the center cone.2) Turn around point 1, pass the center cone, and sequentially turn around points 2 and 3.3) Run through the finish line at point 4.
pe-04838: 1) Move toward the leaves falling from the tree when the signal starts.2) Catch 3 falling leaves with your hands before they hit the ground.
pe-04839: 1) Divide into teams by vest color and practice basic stepping-in throwing and catching.2) The player holding the ball cannot move, while teammates continuously run into open spaces.3) Connecting three consecutive passes earns one point, followed by a high five.4) Possession turns over if the opposing team intercepts the pass or if the ball goes out of bounds.
pe-04840: 1) The pitcher rolls the ball into the strike zone, and the kicker kicks the ball and runs to first base.2) If the kicked ball clears the foul zone and lands in fair territory or outfield, it is a hit and the runner advances.3) A runner is out if a fielder catches the ball in the air, forces the base before the runner arrives, or tags the runner with the ball.4) A run is scored when a runner rounds first, second, and third base and touches home plate.
pe-04841: 1) Long jump with both feet landed together onto number spot markers according to the teacher's call (even, odd, greater/less than a number).2) When two players land on the same number, play rock-paper-scissors and the loser returns to the start.3) When playing tag, runners may only jump to tiles meeting the called number condition, while the tagger can step to any tile to catch runners, who then become taggers.
pe-04842: 1) Hold the parachute with one hand and walk counterclockwise in a circle while singing.2) Practice fundamental commands such as shaking, freezing on signal, lifting high overhead, and lowering down.3) Raise the parachute high and have students holding the called color run underneath to switch places.4) Lift the parachute quickly, step inside, and sit on the edge to create mushroom and umbrella shapes.5) Shake the parachute to bounce balls off, launch a ball into the air, and finish by lifting and releasing the parachute to fly.
pe-04843: 1) Prepare two different colored balls for boys and girls and divide into two teams.2) Boys can only eliminate boys with the boys' ball, and girls can only eliminate girls with the girls' ball.3) Players hit by the opposite gender's ball are safe and pass the ball to teammates.4) When one gender is completely eliminated, remaining players can target the other gender using their own ball.5) Pass to the outfield if no eligible thrower is in court, and win by eliminating the entire opposing team.
pe-04844: 1) Line up at the team starting point, and the first player stands on a chosen numbered spot marker2) The second player throws a beanbag from the start, and if the first player catches it while keeping a foot on the marker, they collect the spot marker3) The thrower moves to the next marker while passing the beanbag to the next player, continuing until all markers are retrieved to calculate total scores
pe-04845: 1) Form a large circle using disc cones and arrange 2 to 4 teams evenly around the perimeter.2) The first runners stand outside the circle while teammates wait inside.3) Each runner sprints one full lap holding a baton and hands it off to the next runner.4) The team whose members finish running and sit down first wins the game.
pe-04846: 1) Divide the class into two teams and place a turning point 10 to 20 meters ahead.2) The first runner sprints around the turning point and returns.3) The runner takes the next teammate by the hand, and both run around the turning point together.4) Add one player each round holding hands, and the team whose entire group returns first wins.
pe-04847: 1) Learn basic warm-up movements including toe touches and light stretches.2) Practice taking two steps sideways followed by an elbow strike and punch combination.3) Execute punches 4 times each toward high diagonal, side, and low directions.4) Combine all learned movement sequences together to upbeat music.
pe-04848: 1) Divide the class into two teams and prepare a rectangular dodgeball court.2) Have the teams face each other in lines and play rock-paper-scissors to count individual wins per team.3) Adjust the center line so the team with more wins takes two-thirds of the court, while the losing team takes one-third.4) Play dodgeball within the assigned zones; the winning team earns 1 point, and the team with the most points after several rounds wins.
pe-04849: 1) Place a disc cone on your head without holding it, run around the turning point, and place it on the next runner's head.2) If the cone drops, pick it up and place it back on your head before moving.3) Adapt the relay by holding toilet paper or newspaper against your body using air resistance, or throwing paper airplanes.
pe-04850: 1) Push desks to the sides, set up goals using 8 chairs at the front and back of the classroom, divide the class into two teams, and select one representative per team to sit in front of the goal.2) Teammates take turns sitting in available spots facing the same direction as their representative.3) The representative initiates play by hitting the balloon forward, and players hit the balloon with their hands toward the opposing goal.4) Scoring a balloon resting on a chair earns 1 point, while landing it into the chair opening earns 3 points.
pe-04851: 1) Set up an equal number of cones along both end lines and split into two teams.2) Draw a line 1-2 meters in front of the cones where attackers cannot cross.3) Pass and shoot using the inside of the foot, keeping the ball below waist level.4) Score 1 point by knocking down an opponent's cone; downed cones remain down.5) The team that knocks down the most cones within the time limit or clears all first wins.
pe-04852: 1) An opposing player stands 5 meters ahead of the start line with 3 cones aligned behind them at regular intervals.2) The runner sprints to the opposing player and plays rock-paper-scissors.3) Turn around the nearest cone if you win, the middle cone if you tie, or the farthest cone if you lose, then return.
pe-04853: 1) Form groups of 4 and sit in a circle keeping bottoms and hands firmly on the floor.2) Each member raises only one foot and gathers their soles in the center.3) Place an object provided by the teacher on top of the four soles.4) The group that balances and holds the object the longest without dropping it wins.
pe-04854: 1) Decide the turn order by playing rock-paper-scissors.2) On your turn, flick your eraser with your finger to hit the opponent's eraser.3) You score points or win by landing completely on top of the opponent's eraser.
pe-04855: 1) Divide the field into designated grid zones and assign players evenly into each zone.2) Players must stay inside their assigned zones and pass or shoot using inside kicks.3) Play a 10-minute first half, then switch positions for a 10-minute second half.
pe-04856: 1) Learn full-body exercise movements including jumping jacks, wide squats, and regular squats.2) Perform each exercise at maximum effort for 20 seconds followed by 10 seconds of rest.3) Cycle through all 8 movements sequentially for the designated rounds.
pe-04857: 1) Prepare household items such as socks, towels, and tissue papers2) Perform balance and catching missions in sequence using body parts including head, shoulders, knees, and feet3) If you fail, restart from the initial step and try to clear all steps within 20 seconds
pe-04858: 1) Students learn the fundamental steps of action cheerleading by moving arms and legs quickly to fast-paced music.2) Teams play rock-paper-scissors to draw three basic step cards, arrange them into 16-count sequences per movement, and perform them to music.3) Practice arm motions such as high-V and T in 2-count intervals, finishing with a sequence moving from half-T into a punch.4) Once team movements are synchronized, connect the basic steps and arm motions into a completed 2x8 count performance.
pe-04859: 1) Fill a plastic bottle about 1/4 full of water, cap it tightly, and tie a cord around the center groove 2-3 times to create a rescue tool.2) Hold the bottle in the throwing hand, grasp the cord with the other hand, and firmly step on the end of the line to secure it.3) Throw underhand or overhand beyond the target person, and quickly pull the line back to retrieve and re-throw if it misses.4) Each student throws twice toward target boards marked with points from 2 to 10 in the classroom, and the team with the highest score wins.
pe-04860: 1) Lower your center of gravity and step out to the right first, leading with the heel.2) Check that your foot crosses the line, then shift your weight and step out to the opposite side.3) Keep your center of gravity in the middle and quickly repeat the side-to-side steps for 50 reps across 3 sets.
pe-04861: 1) Split into two teams wearing team vests and stand at the starting line marked by cones.2) Play rock-paper-scissors with the teacher: winners take two straddle steps forward, ties take one step, and losers bend at the waist to touch the floor.3) Move to claim spot markers, challenge opponents occupying spots via rock-paper-scissors, and the team with the most spots after 15 rounds wins.
pe-04862: 1) Blow on the water in a basin to make ripples and use a straw to blow bubbles as long as possible.2) Submerge your face in the water, open your eyes, and play a game reading a number card held under the basin.3) Practice the rhythmic breathing method by exhaling through the nose underwater and inhaling through the mouth above water.
pe-04863: 1) When encountering a collapsed person, immediately check their consciousness by tapping their shoulders.2) Point to specific individuals nearby to call 119 and bring an AED.3) For cardiac arrest patients, interlock your hands and perform firm, rapid chest compressions on the center of the chest.4) For choking patients, stand behind them with one leg between theirs and thrust upward on the upper abdomen with a fist.
pe-04864: 1) Set up 5 cones on each side in symmetrical T-shapes.2) Form groups of 4 and have runners line up opposite each other.3) Sprint zigzagging around the cones on signal.4) Return to the start line and tag the next runner's hand.5) Win by finishing 8 laps first or catching up to the opposing team.
pe-04865: 1) Form teams of 6 or more players and designate offense and defense.2) The batter throws a flying disc into the field instead of hitting a ball and runs through the bases.3) An out occurs on three fouls, a fly catch, a disc tag, or when the disc arrives at the 3-meter base circle before the runner.4) The game lasts 3 innings with all players throwing each inning; throwing discs directly at runners is prohibited.
pe-04866: 1) Lie on a mat with your chest and back straight, look at the ceiling, and spread your arms comfortably.2) Practice the breathing technique of inhaling deeply, exhaling slightly about one-third, and inhaling again.3) Lie on the new-sports equipment in a floating posture while a partner slowly pulls you.
pe-04867: 1) The first runner puts on the life jacket at the starting line.2) Fasten the 3 chest buckles, pull side tightening straps, and buckle the leg crotch straps.3) Run around the turning point wearing the life jacket correctly and return to the line.4) Pass the life jacket to the next runner, while teammates observe and check for correct fitting.
pe-04868: 1) Mark first, second, third base, and home plate in a diamond shape using spot markers, then divide into batting and fielding teams.2) The batter places the ball on one hand, hits it with the other fist, and scores 1 point by safely running through first, second, third base, and home.3) A strike is added if the batter swings and misses or hits the ball out of bounds, and three strikes result in an out.4) Teams switch between offense and defense after every player has batted rather than on three outs, playing three innings to determine the winner by score.
pe-04869: 1) Form pairs in a crawling position and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The winner leaps over the partner.3) The loser crawls underneath the partner.4) Challenge how many times you can jump or crawl within the time limit.
pe-04870: 1) Set up the court, rally 4 times, and start the game on the 5th hit.2) Hit the ball after it bounces once.3) Score 1 point if the opponent fails to return the ball inside the court.
pe-04871: 1) Split into two teams at opposite ends of a balance beam, line, or tires.2) On start, the first player runs forward toward the opponent's base.3) When players meet, they play rock-paper-scissors; the loser steps off and returns to base while the next teammate starts immediately.4) The winner advances, and the team whose members all reach the opposing base wins.
pe-04872: 1) Divide into two teams with one becoming radishes and the other pullers2) Radish players link inner elbows firmly in a circle on the floor3) Pullers grab only the feet to pull them away until all are pulled and switch roles
pe-04873: 1) Roll up newspaper and tape it to make a stick.2) Stand the stick on the floor and catch it before it falls after letting go.3) Alternate catching between right and left hands.4) Practice while sitting or lying down once standing becomes easy.
pe-04874: 1) Stretch neck, shoulders, and wrists before practicing.2) Lie down and lift hips to practice pelvic lift.3) Support weight on shoulders and raise hips for shoulder stand.4) Hold frog and spider balances supporting body weight with hands.5) Face away from the wall and climb the wall with feet in tripod handstand.6) Climb the wall with feet while supporting body only with hands.7) Face the wall, place hands down, and kick up legs to hold against the wall.
pe-04875: 1) Fold the rope and rotate it in smooth circles overhead and in front like a propeller2) Form circles or triangles on the floor with the rope and jump over them cleanly3) Swing the rope slowly in front, watch it touch the ground, and step or jump over4) Perform belly pull-slide games and limbo passing under a taut rope
pe-04876: 1) Hold the rope lightly without wrapping it around hands so it slips free upon catching2) Keep knees steady, tuck elbows close to the body, and swing using wrists and elbows3) Keep a steady circular rhythm so the bottom of the rope lightly taps the floor4) Shorten or lengthen grip placement to adjust turning speed to matching skippers
pe-04877: 1) The parent lies on a mat, and the child stands on the parent's knees to balance.2) The child practices balancing on all fours with hips raised while the parent moves slightly.3) The child stands upright on the parent's knees and balances as the parent moves their body like a surfboard.
pe-04878: 1) Tie a knot at the end of a towel.2) Punch the knotted part of the towel held by a partner.3) Progress to kicking or jumping kicks.
pe-04879: 1) Partners face each other holding hands and lean back to stretch the back.2) One person holds a bridge while the partner crawls underneath.3) Transition from holding hands into a bridge position safely.
pe-04880: 1) Practice foot positions in place: Rock (feet together), Scissors (split front-back), and Paper (straddle).2) For scissors, alternate with the right foot forward then left foot forward.3) Jump rhythmically following callouts of rock, scissors, and paper.4) Increase difficulty by clapping hands between jumps.
pe-04881: 1) Clap and repeat the exact rhythms modeled by the leader.2) Mimic animal and body movements shown by the teacher.3) Place one fist on the chest and an open palm forward, then swap them on cue.4) Add a clap or head touch between hand switches to increase difficulty.5) Play fast rock-paper-scissors by matching or beating the leader's hand.6) Pair up and hold index fingers to catch or pull away on signal.
pe-04882: 1) Two partners hold the ends of a towel and place a ball on it.2) Walk to the goal without touching the ball with hands.3) Try carrying the ball using a sheet of newspaper instead of a towel.4) Carry the ball sandwiched between bellies or backs without using hands.
pe-04883: 1) Divide into two teams, with one team lying face down on the floor as fish.2) The other team turns the prone fish players over.3) If a fish is difficult to flip, teammates cooperate to turn them over.4) Once everyone is flipped, switch roles and play again.
pe-04884: 1) Place both hands on the vault while keeping both legs closed together2) Practice pulling the legs toward the chest while supporting weight on the hands3) Support body weight with hands and pass the closed legs forward over the vault to land
pe-04885: 1) Run together in a group following the designated leader.2) Listen closely to the leader's prompt (e.g., 'rolled over', 'hopped').3) Rapidly mimic and freeze into the instructed action.
pe-04886: 1) Toss a towel ball made by tying a towel twice into the air.2) While the ball is airborne, touch body parts like the head or shoulders.3) Catch the falling towel ball with both hands.
pe-04887: 1) Turners swing the long rope at a steady rhythm.2) Jumpers leap with both feet matching the turning timing of the rope.3) The turners vary the turning rhythm, and the jumper adjusts their jump timing by watching the rope.
pe-04888: 1) Create a 3x3 grid with nine squares on the floor.2) One tagger and two runners stand in the squares.3) When the tagger counts, everyone jumps into an adjacent square (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) or stays in place.4) Anyone who lands in the same square as the tagger becomes the next tagger.
pe-04889: 1) Place the rope straight on the floor and jump side-to-side moving forward.2) Jump over a waving rope 10 times in a row.3) Stand inside the turned rope and jump 10 times consecutively.4) Jump 5 times inside the rope and exit through the turner's legs.5) Enter the turning rope on timing, jump 3 times, and exit.6) Complete the 8-figure jump by having the next runner enter as the previous person makes their 3rd jump.
pe-04890: 1) Lie down on the floor facing each other or pairing up.2) Raise both legs into the air.3) Rotate legs forward in large circles as if pedaling a bicycle.4) Reverse the pedaling direction to engage abdominal and back muscles.
pe-04891: 1) Raise your right hand while simultaneously lifting your left leg.2) Raise your left hand while simultaneously lifting your right leg.3) Bend one knee backward so your heel touches your buttocks.4) Switch sides and bend the opposite heel up toward your buttocks.5) Combine lifting your hand and bringing your heel up at the same time.
