pe-04892: 1) Two players play rock-paper-scissors; the winner sits in a V-balance while the loser holds their feet to turn them in a circle or pull them back 5 steps.2) The loser holds a one-hand balance for 10 seconds while the winner gently taps their body to challenge balance.3) The winner makes a bridge or pair double-balance while the other crawls quickly under the tunnel.4) Three players form a bridge by placing their feet on each other's shoulders, and another crawls under without touching.
pe-04893: 1) Jump forward with both feet together without stepping on the ladder rungs.2) Perform in-and-out jumps spreading feet wide to loosen hip joints.3) Alternate hopscotch jumps using the right foot and left foot separately.4) Jump into and out of the ladder from the side while keeping the head centered.5) Twist hips from side to side while keeping the head and torso facing straight ahead (hip change).
pe-04894: 1) Tie a towel twice to make a round ball.2) One person balances on one foot.3) The partner throws the towel ball to hit the balancing person's body.4) Switch roles when the foot or hand touches the floor.
pe-04895: 1) Clear the surroundings to ensure safety.2) An adult holds the child by both ankles upside down.3) Spin slowly in a circle, then spin in the opposite direction.4) Vary the leg position once comfortable to stimulate body awareness.
pe-04896: 1) Walk on all fours like a bear by reaching your hands and feet as far forward as possible.2) Walk sideways like a crab with large body movements.3) Jump like a frog by placing your hands far ahead and leaping forward.4) Move quickly through different animal walks using your whole body.5) Complete all 5 animal walking movements to learn how to move your body in a large range.
pe-04897: 1) Stand tall and lift one leg backward.2) After holding balance, lift the leg forward.3) Keep your head still, maintain a steady gaze, and repeat on both legs.4) Challenge stability by controlling leg movements without wobbling.
pe-04898: 1) Sit shallowly on a chair with good posture and hold the glove slightly away from the body2) Rotate the arm widely to bring the elbow forward and relax shoulders facing wrists forward3) Keep the index finger straight and catch the ball securely with the fingers
pe-04899: 1) Drag the ball inward with the sole of one foot.2) Without dropping the foot to the ground, step over the ball from inside to outside like a scissors feint.3) Push the ball forward with the opposite foot to beat the opponent.4) Practice the movement slowly toward a plastic bottle or partner to master the distance and timing.
pe-04900: 1) Alternate tapping the ball lightly in place using the front part of the sole without letting it move.2) Rotate around the ball slowly while maintaining the taps.3) Move forward, backward, or in any direction while tapping with the sole.4) Tap the ball between the insides of both feet with equal strength so it stays between the feet.5) Practice rotating and moving in all directions while maintaining inside touches.
pe-04901: 1) Form pairs and assign one person as the driver and the other as the train.2) The driver dribbles freely in various directions across the space.3) The follower dribbles closely behind the driver without colliding or falling behind.4) Switch roles and repeat the practice.
pe-04902: 1) A partner lightly tosses a floating ball with their hands.2) Point the supporting (non-kicking) foot firmly toward the target.3) Lock the ankle and use the inside of the foot to volley the ball back as a pass.4) To practice instep volleys, extend the toes firmly, lock the ankle, and strike through the ball.5) Practice using both right and left feet.
pe-04903: 1) Set up plastic bottles (or cones) ahead as targets.2) Step forward and point the supporting foot directly at the target.3) Strike the ball with the inside of the foot aiming straight to knock down the bottle.4) Once mastered, challenge knocking them down using an instep kick.
pe-04904: 1) Trap the tossed ball with the sole of the foot right as it bounces.2) Cushion and control the falling ball using the instep by gently pulling the foot back.3) Once familiar, try trapping without a bounce or using the opposite foot.
pe-04905: 1) Sit on a mat and hold a bar with shoulder-width grip placed against your waist.2) Kick off the ground with one foot while forcefully swinging the other foot over your head in a scissor kick.3) Roll backward with a rounded back, lifting your hips high so your feet reach toward the ground behind your head.
pe-04906: 1) The performer grips the horizontal bar while the assistant stands back-to-back.2) The assistant crouches down and steps backwards to lift the performer's body.3) The performer leans back onto the assistant's back, raises both legs over the bar, and completes the roll.
pe-04907: 1) Position your pivot foot at a 90-degree angle toward the target.2) Step your stride foot straight forward toward the target.3) Shift weight smoothly from back to front foot and swing your arm broadly with relaxed shoulders.
pe-04908: 1) Juggle the soccer ball while walking, allowing bounces on the ground.2) Juggle all the way around the partner in a complete circle.3) Return to the original starting spot and pass the ball to the partner.
pe-04909: 1) Grip the handles with fingers together and thumb extended lightly.2) Swing the rope from behind to the front.3) Jump over the rope slowly one time as it comes in front.
pe-04910: 1) Start with regular forward jumps to find the rhythm.2) Cross the arms deeply when the rope swings overhead.3) Jump through the crossed loop and uncross the arms back to normal.
pe-04911: 1) Grip the seams with index and middle fingers, support underneath with the thumb joint, and lock the pinky.2) Swing and rotate the entire arm fully while keeping the shoulder relaxed.3) Set the pivot foot at 90 degrees, step the front foot straight toward the target, and throw.
pe-04912: 1) Keep the body straight, jump high off the ground, and stay airborne.2) Keep the armpits closed and rotate the rope quickly twice using the wrists.3) Jump continuously with a consistent rhythm to string multiple double unders together.
pe-04913: 1) Grip the bar and position the body directly underneath it.2) Keep the elbows bent and kick the legs powerfully up toward the ceiling.3) Keep the body close to the bar while rotating over, then straighten the arms to finish.
pe-04914: 1) Sit on a mat or flat surface, tuck knees in, and round your back2) Pull your chin tightly toward your chest and roll backward3) Roll until your feet reach over your head lifting hips toward the ceiling, repeating smoothly
pe-04915: 1) Squat down and raise hands by ears with palms facing the ceiling.2) Round the back, tuck chin towards the navel, and roll backward.3) Place palms firmly on the mat and push against the floor to rotate.4) Land on the soles of both feet rather than the knees.
pe-04916: 1) Stand straight without a rope and jump upward.2) Tap the thighs once with both hands at the peak of the jump.3) Land and repeat continuous rhythmic jumps while tapping the thighs in the air.
pe-04917: 1) Pop the soccer ball up with the right foot.2) Tap the falling ball gently with the left foot.3) Circle the right foot around the ball once and scoop it back up to continue juggling.
pe-04918: 1) Juggle the ball and pop it up slightly higher.2) Jump and let the ball bounce once off the ground between your legs.3) Hit the rebounding ball with the back of your head, let it bounce once more, and scoop it up to resume juggling.
pe-04919: 1) Place body weight and balance on the right foot while seated or standing near a chair.2) Turn your chest squarely toward the target.3) Keep the elbow steady and snap the wrist flexibly toward the partner to throw or catch.
pe-04920: 1) One student acts like a bouncing ball while the partner gently presses down on their shoulders like dribbling.2) In rhythm with the presses (1, 2, 3), the jumping student bounces off the ground keeping knees straight.3) Turn the rope using thumb guidance, jumping precisely as the rope hits the floor.
pe-04921: 1) Hold both handles of the jump rope together in one hand without jumping over it yet.2) Keep the arm close to the hip and swing the rope forward in small circles.3) Jump lightly right at the moment the rope hits the ground to master the rhythm.
pe-04922: 1) Keep your back straight, look forward, and wrap the ball around your waist.2) Move the ball behind your head and circle it around your neck.3) Connect the neck circles and waist circles to trace a figure-eight path rapidly.
pe-04923: 1) Drive toward the basket, step right-left, drive your knee upward, and jump high.2) Lay the ball smoothly into the basket as if placing it on a shelf.3) Bend knees slightly, bring the ball above head, and shoot a one-handed shot extending the elbow fully.
pe-04924: 1) Lower knees and execute a two-handed chest pass from your chest directly to your partner's chest.2) Bounce the ball firmly off the floor to pass beneath a defender's reach.3) Practice overhead passes stepping forward, one-handed push passes, and behind-the-back passes.
pe-04925: 1) Track the incoming aerial ball, exhale slightly, and cushion it with the chest before catching with hands.2) Cushion the ball using the upper-middle part of the thigh and catch it.3) Practice cushioning aerial balls with the forehead or foot to absorb momentum before catching.
pe-04926: 1) Set up an inclined board against the bar to assist rotation.2) Hold the bar and run up the inclined board to vigorously kick legs upward.3) The movement is successful when the stomach rests on the bar and the body rotates backward.4) Gradually decrease the board angle as you get used to it.
pe-04927: 1) Lay out markers in a row spaced about three shoe lengths apart.2) Take the first step close to your body rather than reaching far out.3) Keep your upper body low without standing upright until passing about the fifth marker.4) As speed builds up, raise your upper body and pump your arms rhythmically.5) Step down forcefully from above using the balls of your feet, as if stomping a can, to sprint through.
pe-04928: 1) Bend your arms to keep your body positioned under the bar.2) Stand with staggered feet and kick upward.3) The spotter supports the hips in a circular motion following the kick to place the student on the bar.4) Finish in a support pose once the hips rest on the bar.
pe-04929: 1) Keep hands at hip level and rotate the rope using the wrists instead of the entire arms.2) Cross the arms deeply so the elbows overlap when crossing the rope.3) Jump with a steady rhythm while keeping the cross wide.4) Stop the rotating rope by catching it behind the feet to finish.
pe-04930: 1) Position a goalkeeper in front of the goal and trap the passed ball.2) Extend the instep fully and swing the kicking leg straight toward the goal.3) Check the goalkeeper's position upon trapping and shoot into the open space.
pe-04931: 1) Set up water-filled plastic bottles in a line at 1-meter intervals.2) Dribble zigzag through the bottles using short inside-foot touches without hitting them.3) Progress to using outside-foot touches and alternating inside and outside touches.
pe-04932: 1) Stand in place, step over the ball from inside to outside with one foot, and push it away with the outside of the other foot.2) Fake by shifting your entire upper body dynamically to deceive the defender.3) Dribble toward a plastic bottle acting as a defender and execute the scissors feint at the right distance.
pe-04933: 1) Open feet shoulder-width, lower hips, and bounce the ball forcefully in place using five fingers.2) Raise the opposite arm forward to guard the ball from defenders.3) Move forward while dribbling, then practice V-shape single-hand dribble changes and two-handed crossovers.
pe-04934: 1) Run along a straight line pushing straight back against the ground with toes pointing forward.2) Bend elbows at 90 degrees and swing arms forward and back to drive hip rotation.3) Practice ankle hops and human-dribble partner drills to develop elastic ground reaction forces.4) Rapidly pull thighs up from the hip joints and use fast-walking drills to master the leg retraction phase.
pe-04935: 1) Place 3 plastic bottles at each goal line.2) Form two teams of 3 players each to play 3 vs 3.3) Play the game for a duration of 5 minutes.4) Dribble past opponents and shoot the ball to knock down the opponent's plastic bottles.5) The team that knocks down the most bottles within the time limit wins.
pe-04936: 1) Place 3 plastic bottles at each goal and play a 3 vs 3 match for 5 minutes.2) Apply shooting techniques to aim at and knock down the opponent's bottles.3) The team that knocks down more bottles wins; if tied, proceed to a penalty shootout.4) In the shootout, 3 players from each team take turns kicking at a plastic bottle.5) The team that knocks down more bottles in the shootout wins the match.
pe-04937: 1) A partner tosses a high floating ball with their hands.2) Cushion the ball using the chest, thigh, or head to drop it near your feet.3) Trap the bouncing ball quickly with your foot to bring it under complete control.4) Once the ball is settled, pass it back to the partner without using hands.5) Progress to controlling and passing the aerial ball using only the feet.
pe-04938: 1) Place 3 plastic bottles at each goal.2) Form two teams of 3 players each for a 3 vs 3 match.3) Play the match for 5 minutes.4) Use passing and trapping skills to create openings and knock down the opponent's bottles.5) The team that knocks down more bottles within the time limit wins.
pe-04939: 1) Get into the sparrow pose on the horizontal bar.2) Slowly lean forward like hanging a futon while looking at your navel.3) Turn your wrists, roll forward slowly, and place your feet quietly on the ground.
pe-04940: 1) Float on your back while hugging a kickboard to your chest.2) Inhale deeply and float on your back without a kickboard.3) Propel forward with backstroke flutter kicks by kicking upward with the tops of your feet.4) Practice arm stroke mechanics while standing up.5) Combine arm strokes and flutter kicks to swim the backstroke.
pe-04941: 1) Inhale through the mouth and exhale slowly through the nose underwater to learn breathing technique.2) Submerge in the water, sit on the pool floor, and push the water with hands to stay down.3) Tuck both knees toward the chest to perform the Daruma tuck float.4) Push off the wall with feet and keep arms straight behind ears for streamlining.5) Sit on the pool deck to practice flutter kicks from the thighs, then hold the wall in water and kick.
pe-04942: 1) Place hands on a kickboard, push off the wall into a streamline, and flutter kick.2) Rest one hand on a kickboard and flutter kick sideways to practice the breathing posture.3) Practice the arm pull while standing by pulling water toward the abdomen and sweeping the arm back.4) Turn the head sideways to breathe when the pulling hand reaches chest level.5) Practice catch-up freestyle by bringing both hands together in front before alternating strokes.
pe-04943: 1) Gently tap the top of the ball with the soles of your feet alternately without moving the ball.2) Tap the ball rhythmically between the inside edges of both feet.3) Drag the ball back with the sole of one foot and push it outward with the inside of the same foot in a V-shape.4) Switch feet and repeat the drag-and-push V-pattern.
pe-04944: 1) Rotate the gloved arm in a large circle and bring the elbow in front of your body.2) Turn your wrist so the palm of the glove faces forward toward your partner.3) Extend your index finger straight up inside the glove.4) Secure the incoming ball into the pocket near the base of the index and middle fingers.
pe-04945: 1) Practice jumping vertically in place without a rope like a bouncing ball.2) In pairs, one person jumps while the partner gently presses down from behind to establish rhythm like dribbling a ball.3) Jump with the balls of your feet without excessively bending the knees.4) Turn the rope from near the hips, relax in the air, and absorb rebound upon landing.
pe-04946: 1) Spread feet shoulder-width apart, lower hips, and lean slightly forward into ready stance.2) When a low rolling ball approaches, drop knees to the floor to get low.3) Avoid catching only with your hands; wrap both arms around the ball and catch with your chest.4) Practice repeatedly with a partner rolling balls safely from the front.
pe-04947: 1) Place the center of a towel against your lower back.2) Keep your stomach close to the horizontal bar and grasp the towel ends together with the bar.3) Lean your weight onto the towel, split your feet front and back, and kick up to rotate.
pe-04948: 1) Set up a 3x3 grid on the floor and designate one tagger2) Jump into adjacent squares or stay in place simultaneously matching the beat or song rhythm3) If a player lands in the same grid square as the tagger the tagger scores a point
pe-04949: 1) Perform jumps and rhythm movements 16 times to the count2) The next person starts right after 16 counts in rotation3) Clap along while waiting and continue the circuit for 3 minutes
pe-04950: 1) The infield is divided into four zones with one warrior aiming for unification2) Outfield peasants throw with their non-dominant hand and enter the infield upon hitting a warrior3) Hitting another warrior annexes their land, and knocking down the center cone swaps all warriors and peasants
pe-04951: 1) Serve underhand from behind the service line.2) When the ball enters your court, let it bounce once and return it within 3 touches.3) Return the ball without jumping spikes or blocking.4) Earn bonus points if three different players touch the ball once each before sending it over.
pe-04952: 1) Put on a blindfold and stand on the designated center line.2) March vigorously in place for 30 seconds upon the signal.3) Remove the blindfold after the signal and measure the distance drifted from the starting center.
pe-04953: 1) Arrange color boards on the gym floor and stand at the start2) Jump in 8-beat sequences performing slow steps twice and fast steps twice3) Shift foot positions diagonally forward and backward to complete the rhythm course
pe-04954: 1) Serve underhand into the diagonal service court2) Both sides must let the ball bounce once before hitting on the initial serve and return3) Players cannot step into the non-volley zone during volleys, and only the serving team scores toward 11 points
pe-04955: 1) Fold a paper popper using A3 or A4 paper2) Twist your torso and swing down to pop the paper with a sharp sound3) Swing diagonally upward and release it right when it pops so it floats like a parachute
pe-04956: 1) Five players per team enter the court while the remaining players wait on the side.2) Players throw balls at opponents; hit players leave the court and sideline players enter from the endline (hits above the neck are safe).3) A team wins by placing three hula hoops over the cone in the opponent's court.4) If hit while holding a hoop, the player must place it down on the spot, and physical contact such as grabbing an opponent is prohibited.
pe-04957: 1) Tie ropes tightly on both sides to set up a spider web.2) Move through the gaps by lowering your posture or jumping without touching the rope.3) You are out if your hair, hips, or any part of your body touches the rope.
pe-04958: 1) All participants stand on a narrow mat platform.2) Without stepping off, swap positions into the designated order (alphabetical order).3) If anyone falls off the platform, reset and restart from the beginning.4) The mission succeeds when everyone is arranged correctly without falling.
pe-04959: 1) Assign one-third of the class as police, and secretly choose one thief as the secret police.2) Thieves evade police and attempt to steal the treasure.3) Police or secret police tag a thief's shoulder or back to send them to jail.4) Free thieves can rescue jailed teammates by tagging them inside the cone boundary.5) Police win by arresting all thieves, while thieves win by stealing the treasure.
pe-04960: 1) For the straight-leg forward roll, keep knees straight and hands on the mat while a spotter lifts the pelvis with a towel.2) Practice rocking on the back with straight legs, gradually making the movement larger.3) For the backward roll, hold a towel behind the neck and tuck tightly while rolling backward.
pe-04961: 1) The fielding pitcher throws the ball and the batter hits it to start play.2) Runners attempt to run 6 round trips between nests to score 1 point.3) Fielders complete 6 catches while touching the plates or tag runners below the neck to get outs.4) Teams switch sides after 3 outs.
pe-04962: 1) Participants stand in a circle, each holding a stick upright on the floor.2) Tap the sticks to the rhythm cues (Ton-Ton-Ton Pa, Ton-Ton Pa, Ton-Pa).3) Release the stick on 'Pa' and move to catch the adjacent player's stick before it falls.4) Complete rounds while adding turns or directional changes.
pe-04964: 1) Learn the one-foot take-off and double-arm swing forward from a standstill to rhythm cues.2) Walk while counting rhythm mentally and connect the take-off step with the arm swing.3) Run a short approach, take off strongly from one foot right before the mat, and jump forward to land.
pe-04965: 1) Set up a low net on a badminton-sized court and prepare paddles and perforated pickleballs.2) Serve diagonally underhand and allow one bounce on both the serve and the return (two-bounce rule).3) Rally back and forth across the net while staying out of the non-volley zone (kitchen) to score points.
pe-04966: 1) 6 players gather in a circle with an irregularly bouncing oval Flaball.2) Let the ball bounce once on the floor and bump or hit it straight upward.3) Move and cooperate to keep the ball from bouncing twice consecutively, aiming for 10 consecutive hits.
pe-04967: 1) Face a partner, clap hands together, and rhythmically turn in a circle to return to position2) Step the right foot diagonally forward to stand back-to-back, bounce lightly, and repeat with the left foot3) Jump open (straddle), jump crossed, spin jump, and clap hands together4) Alternate between the chorus partner dance and standard stretches like knee bends and lunges.
pe-04968: 1) Freeze Tag: Tagged runners freeze until unfrozen by teammates, with the tagger team aiming to freeze everyone within 1 minute 30 seconds2) Chain Tag: Tagged runners join hands with taggers, splitting into pairs once reaching four, aiming to catch everyone within 3 minutes3) Latch-on Tag: Pairs holding hands form safe zones; when a runner grasps one hand, the opposite person is displaced and must run4) Spider Tag: Crab-walking taggers crawl face down to catch runners crawling face up within 2 minutes.
pe-04969: 1) Work in small groups to support and move through various physical formations.2) When rotating, agree on the direction, complete two full rotations, and land safely.3) Progressively challenge missions such as releasing hands or lifting one leg.
pe-04970: 1) Defenders mark opponents between the attacker and the goal without letting them break away.2) The lead player carries the ball while seeking or defending open space within the time limit.3) After each round, the player holding the ball moves to the back and roles switch.
pe-04971: 1) Stand in a circle with 4-6 players, each holding a ball.2) On cue, throw and pass the ball simultaneously to the person on the right or left and catch.3) Increase difficulty with bounce passes, skipping a player, or spinning around before catching without dropping the ball.
pe-04972: 1) Toss the ball upward and catch it after clapping in front or behind your back.2) Increase difficulty with jump actions or moving distances before catching.3) Challenge turns before catching or swapping balls with a partner facing each other.
pe-04973: 1) Follow instructions only when preceded by 'Everyone'; ignore commands without it.2) Continue with varied body movements like raising hands, lowering hands, rolling the neck, and stretching.3) Conclude by transitioning into an attentive listening posture with straight backs and hands on knees.

pe-05098: 1) Two or more players participate and designate their own bases2) On the start signal, search for branches longer than one's arm and collect them at the base3) Players can steal sticks from the opponent's base during the set time, and whoever collects more eligible sticks wins
pe-05100: 1) The tagger calls out a specific natural item (pebble, stick, pinecone, etc.).2) Runners search for the item while avoiding being tagged.3) Runners win if they place the item at the designated spot before being touched by the tagger.
pe-05101: 1) Stand in a sunny outdoor area facing an opponent and observe your shadows.2) Move swiftly like a fencer to touch the head area of the opponent's shadow.3) The player whose shadow's head is touched first loses the round.
pe-05102: 1) Three players divide into roles: one tagger, one mother (front), and one tail (back).2) The mother and tail hold onto each other in a line while the tagger attempts to touch the tail.3) The tagger tries to tag the tail within a 10-second time limit while the mother blocks.4) Switch roles when tagged or after the time limit expires.
pe-05103: 1) Step one foot forward with your whole body to tag rather than just reaching with your hand.2) Practice stepping to the right and then practice stepping to the left.3) Anticipate the opponent's approach and move your body first.
pe-05104: 1) Place the treasure in the circle while defenders protect it from outside.2) Attackers avoid tags from defenders and lift the treasure.3) Control speed or pull the treasure upward from behind after passing to keep it from falling over.
pe-05105: 1) Each player places their own stone on the ground.2) Kick the stone with your foot to send it into the designated target area.3) The player whose stone enters the area wins, and a tie occurs if both enter.
pe-05106: 1) The defender positions themselves around the marked T-circle.2) The defender moves along the outside of the circle without stepping inside while tracking the attacker.3) Practice tagging defense while moving around the circle either alone or in pairs.
pe-05107: 1) Place 4 numbered plates 1 to 4 in a 4-foot by 4-foot square on the floor.2) Start in the center balancing in tree pose on one foot.3) Move to the called number plate to perform assigned exercises (1: jumping jacks, 2: ski jumps, 3: quick feet, 4: dance) then return.
pe-05108: 1) Line up 4 pieces of paper on the floor about 2 feet apart and prepare a partially filled water bottle.2) Start behind the papers and jump over each paper, then turn around.3) Attempt one bottle flip onto the paper; if successful, stack that paper onto the next, and if missed, jump back and retry until the last paper is cleared.
pe-05109: 1) To the song 'Jump', extend the right leg sideways and jump, then repeat with the left leg and jump.2) Hold arms tight and jump, then raise arms high and jump.3) Roll arms forward repeatedly, followed by rolling arms backward.4) Extend hands to perform pancake, rollerblade, snake, and leg-shaking dance movements.5) Follow the rhythm during the chorus with wave motions and jump combinations.
pe-05110: 1) Set up 5 distance markers at 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12 feet away from the target water bottle.2) Start at the closest marker, perform a ski jump, and roll the ball stepping with the opposite foot.3) If knocked down, reset the bottle and advance to the next distance marker to ski jump and roll.4) If missed, retrieve the ball, return to the missed spot, repeat the ski jump, and try again until all 5 distances are cleared.
pe-05111: 1) Get ready and begin the exercise on the screen's 3-2-1 countdown.2) Perform the designated full-body workout at maximum effort for 20 seconds.3) Rest for 10 seconds, repeating this interval sequence until completing all 8 cycles.
pe-05113: 1) Lay out mats across the hall and have each child sit ready on their own mat.2) Experiment with point balances using feet and hands, holding each for at least 4 seconds.3) Experiment with patch balances without using hands or feet (e.g., bottom, back, tummy, knees).4) Create a performance sequence combining two patch balances and two point balances in any order.
pe-05114: 1) Set up three hoops on each side of the playing area for a 1v1 matchup with a collection of balls.2) Kick your ball aiming to stop it inside the opponent's hoop.3) Block opponent shots or utilize them, but never touch a ball once it is inside a hoop.4) The player with the most balls in hoops after 2 minutes (or who fills all three hoops first) wins.
pe-05115: 1) Scatter multiple bibs on the floor (more bibs than participants) to serve as snowballs.2) On the start signal, children move around rapidly and pick up a free snowball.3) Players holding a snowball can move around and throw it to hit others.4) Scoring one point for each successful hit, the player with the most points at the end wins.
pe-05116: 1) Pencil roll: Lie on back with arms and legs raised above waist height in a U-shape and roll over.2) Barrel roll: Start in a tabletop position and roll sideways to invert and return.3) Teddy bear roll: Sit with legs apart at 90 degrees, roll across shoulders and back, and sit back up.4) Combine balances, jumps, and two learned rolls to build and perform a continuous sequence.
pe-05117: 1) In Chain Tig, two taggers hold hands or wrists and add tagged runners to the chain until one runner remains.2) In Group Tig, tagged runners also become taggers until only one winner is left untagged.3) In Freeze Tag, taggers try to freeze everyone within 60 seconds while runners can high-ten frozen teammates to free them.4) In Shadow Tig, taggers must tag the runner's shadow on the ground rather than their body.5) In Toilet Tig, tagged runners crouch with a hand up and return to play once another runner flushes their hand.
pe-05118: 1) Set up playing areas with a hoop and a bowling pin inside, then organize a 2v2 match.2) Attackers pass the ball together to create an opportunity to throw and knock down the pin for a point.3) The second defender provides cover when the first defender is beaten, intercepting the ball or tagging opponents to win possession.4) Encourage players to try three attacks each before switching roles.5) Progress to three-pin bowling where teams defend three pins and switch roles upon knockdowns.
pe-05119: 1) Set up a playing area and nominate one student to be the tagger.2) All other students keep their legs together and jump around to steer clear of the tagger.3) If tagged, that student becomes the new tagger, and the person who just tagged is immune for that turn.
pe-05120: 1) Set out two lines to define the throwing area and place a target ball in front.2) Children enter the area holding the foam javelin tip-down, then position it at 45 degrees.3) Each student throws their javelin aiming closest to the target ball, and the closest throw scores the win.
pe-05121: 1) Place a hoop on the ground and mark out a throwing lane using two rows of cones.2) Students step into the throwing area and use the shot put technique to push the ball into the hoop.3) After throwing, students cycle to the back of the queue, and the team with the most balls in the hoop wins.
pe-05122: 1) Grab a bib in the middle and tuck it halfway into your shorts with half hanging out.2) Move around the area and attempt to snatch the bibs of other players.3) Use your arm as a shield to protect your own bib while striving to keep your bib safe.
pe-05123: 1) Arrange cones into various small shapes across the area representing puddles and rivers.2) Children move freely around the space, making one jump at a time across the cone obstacles.3) If two children arrive at an obstacle at the same time, they wait for one person to go first.
pe-05124: 1) In 'Jumping Pumpkin', pumpkins jump toward the leader when their back is turned and must restart if caught moving.2) In 'Graveyard Guard', guards protect the gravestones while the mummy tries to reach an open gravestone marked by cones.3) In 'Zombie Tig', zombies chase civilians who become zombies when tagged, with optional doctors to rescue them.4) In 'Enter the Castle', a Dracula or witch tries to invade through one of three gates guarded by two blockers.
pe-05125: 1) For the straight jump, bend your knees, swing your arms up to jump, and land with knees bent and arms out for balance.2) For the star jump, crouch with hands by ankles, extend legs explosively flaring arms out to the sides, and gather back to land.3) For the tuck jump, jump and lift knees to the chest while bringing arms forward as a counterbalance before landing.4) After practicing each jump on mats, perform a routine starting and ending with balances while including two selected jumps.
pe-05126: 1) In 'Bunny's Tail', teams invade the opponent's base to steal tail bibs and bring them home until a team runs out of spare bibs.2) In 'Protect the Egg', a tagger guards an egg in the base while stealers try to grab it, freezing when tagged until rescued by teammates.3) In 'Running Rabbits', all players hold a ball between their legs and bounce around, becoming the tagger if tagged or if the ball drops.
pe-05127: 1) Select fundamental movements that directly align with the main lesson's outcome.2) Engage in an active warm-up game like TIG or paired passing for approximately 4 minutes.3) Children do not sit out if tagged, maintaining continuous movement throughout.4) Use light sport-specific activity to increase core temperature and prepare cognitively for the main session.
pe-05128: 1) Set up a diamond, have children start at each end, and nominate one attacker and one defender.2) The defender starts two steps forward before the game begins.3) The attacker scores one point for getting to either side or three points for making it to the opponent's cone.4) The defender scores one point for tagging the attacker, and restart if tagged or reached.
pe-05129: 1) Children form small teams, and balls, bibs, and cones are placed in the middle.2) On 'go', one member runs to the middle, grabs one item, puts it in their cauldron, and high-fives the next teammate.3) Once a team collects two items, they can steal items from other teams' cauldrons.4) Teams can defend their cauldron by tagging intruders, forcing them to steal from another base.
pe-05130: 1) Children stand around a pot, which can be a hoop or container.2) Each child is armed with several gold coins (balls or bean bags) and aims to throw them into the pot.3) They score a point for each successful throw, and if a coin misses, children scramble for the loose coin to add to their score.
pe-05131: 1) Place the less dominant foot one forearm length behind the start line, and the stronger foot one forearm length behind that.2) Place fingers on the start line in an arc with shoulders directly over the line.3) On 'get set', raise the hips and explode off the floor when the starting signal sounds to sprint to the finish line.
pe-05132: 1) Lay out lines with tape or markers to divide the floor into three scoring zones (1, 2, and 3 points).2) Two players each receive three balls or rolled-up socks and take turns throwing them.3) Players score points based on the zone their ball stops in (the furthest ball scores double), but receive zero points if it falls short or goes past the third zone.
pe-05133: 1) Set out mats and learn six different turns using different parts of the body.2) Practice turning on feet, bottom, tummy, back, knees, and with one hand for 3 to 4 minutes each.3) Combine a balance, a jump, a roll, and two chosen turns into a smooth gymnastic sequence.
pe-05134: 1) Every student tucks a bib into their side and attempts to steal bibs from others to tuck into their own side during a 2-minute round.2) Having no bibs does not eliminate a player; they remain in the game to steal from others.3) Players level up by stealing bibs or surviving rounds without being tagged, accumulating higher levels.4) Unlocked levels grant special power-ups such as 10-second invincibility, mid-air safety (ninja mode), safe zone access, or throwing bibs to tag.
pe-05135: 1) One child starts in the middle guarding Dinosaur Island while tourists form a circle around them.2) Tourists creep onto Dinosaur Island or within 2 meters of the T-Rex.3) If the T-Rex sees you moving, return to your start point, but you are invisible if holding a balance.4) The first tourist to reach the island wins and becomes the next T-Rex.
pe-05136: 1) Place a target object on a table and pair up with a partner.2) Each player gets three scrunched-up pieces of paper and takes turns throwing toward the target.3) Players can tactically knock the opponent's paper further away.4) The player with two pieces of paper closer to the target wins.
pe-05137: 1) Children work within their own designated individual areas.2) Follow a given theme such as waterfalls, the jungle, pyramids, or Vikings.3) Create an original dance including high and low, fast and slow movements, as well as various moods and open/closed shapes.
pe-05138: 1) Track the ball by calculating its speed and trajectory to anticipate the landing zone.2) Adopt the W position (thumbs together, palms up) when the ball arrives above the chest.3) Adopt the M position (pinkies together, palms down) when the ball arrives below the chest.4) Stay on the balls of your feet to move quickly to the landing zone and catch while stationary.
pe-05139: 1) Rotate the ball around your waist for 15 seconds in one direction, then 15 seconds in the reverse direction.2) Weave the ball in a figure-eight pattern around your legs for 20 seconds, then reverse for 10 seconds.3) Hold the ball in a split squat stance and perform 6 reps on each leg.4) Lie on your back and perform 12 floor chest presses with the ball.5) Lie on your back and perform 10 pullovers, bringing the ball overhead and touching toward your knees.
pe-05140: 1) Practice hockey puck handling side-to-side for 20 seconds per side, followed by 5 slap shots on each side.2) Dribble and execute jump shots 5 times per arm, followed by lateral defensive guarding footwork.3) Simulate tennis serves 5 times per side, then alternate forehand and backhand swings.4) Practice baseball batting swings 5 times on each side.5) Simulate soccer kicks for 20 seconds, then perform 5 overhand throwing motions per arm with an L-arm shape.
pe-05141: 1) Learn the parts of the racket including head, grip, strings, and the sweet spot in the center.2) Follow the striking cues: eye on the ball, stiff wrist, side to target, and step with opposite foot.3) Practice ball control and striking by keeping contact within the racket sweet spot.4) Conduct peer assessments using checklists to observe form and technique cues.
pe-05142: 1) Clogged Arteries: Tagged runners enter a hula hoop (artery); once 3 runners collect, they jump 3 times chanting "I'm heart smart" to unclog it.2) Batman and Joker: The Joker tags players with a noodle causing them to jump continuously in place until Batman taps them to unfreeze.3) Football Passing Challenge: Students skip until a stop signal, find a partner without a ball, and perform overhand football throws.4) Hungry Crabs: Students crab walk to the center one at a time to retrieve one jersey (food) back to their home base.
pe-05143: 1) In a circle, practice heel-to-toe, side-to-side taps, space dribbling, drop and trap, goalie series, and thigh juggling.2) Play Dribble with Flies where 2-3 taggers wearing jerseys try to kick dribblers' balls away.3) Play Red Light Green Light incorporating freeze, toe taps, penguin taps, and dribbling forward.4) Hungry Hippos: 6-8 groups run to the center, dribble balls back into their group hula hoop one by one.5) Cone net shooting: Practice inside-foot shots into two cones 5-10 ft apart, moving back after 5 successful goals.6) Progress to keep-away (rotate center player every 30s), 1v1, 2v2 possession, and finally 3v3 mini soccer games.
pe-05144: 1) Practice the bump movement 5 times forward and to each side by bringing hands together and bending knees.2) Practice the set movement 5 times forward and to each side overhead.3) Practice the spike movement 5 times on each arm by swinging overhead and hitting down, with optional jumps.4) Practice the underhand serve 10 times and the overhead serve 5 times on each arm.
pe-05145: 1) Line up behind the cones with your team.2) Take turns advancing using the rotation order of skip, run, and jump to place your marker on the grid.3) The first team to get three in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
pe-05146: 1) Lift the parachute up with full power on signal and take one big step forward.2) Back up quickly as it begins to come down.3) Squeeze objects into the bucket with your hands or sit on it as directed.
pe-05147: 1) Look at the two summer options on the screen and choose your favorite.2) Check the exercise or dance movement assigned to your chosen option.3) Follow and perform the movement along with the on-screen character during the countdown.
pe-05148: 1) Watch the on-screen demonstrator performing football-themed movements closely.2) Follow and match the moves either with a partner or individually.3) Grade your performance from 1 to 5 stars, requiring 4 stars or more to advance to the next round.
pe-05149: 1) Taggers holding pool noodles attempt to tag other students below the shoulders.2) Students who are tagged, fall down, or step outside the boundary lines are frozen and must wave hands side to side.3) A student with a soccer ball is invincible from taggers, dribbles around, and passes the ball to a frozen teammate; when trapped with the foot, the player is unfrozen and takes the ball.
pe-05150: 1) One player from each team becomes Sonic, starting on the far mat holding a hula hoop, while teammates line up behind their cone holding a ring (or bean bag).2) When music starts, Sonic runs over, places the hula hoop around a teammate's torso, and escorts them safely back to the opposite mat.3) The rescued player drops the ring onto the cone and sits down on the team's mat.4) Sonic runs back to get the next teammate, and the first team with all rings delivered and all teammates seated wins.
pe-05151: 1) Station 1 (Parachute Launch): Students use a mini parachute together to launch a bouncy ball into the basketball hoop.2) Station 2 (Hockey Squeeze): Players shoot a puck with a hockey stick between pool noodles into the goal.3) Station 3 (Backwards Free Throw): Players turn away from the hoop and shoot backwards free throws.4) Station 4 (Ping Pong Bounce): Students bounce ping pong balls off the floor into cups against the wall.5) Station 5: Putt-putt golf into the hole or bean bag toss into buckets.6) Station 6: Shuffleboard slide puck onto floor bullseye or Frisbee toss to knock cups off a stand.7) Groups rotate every 5 minutes after resetting the station.
pe-05152: 1) Players occupy four designated squares (Big Bear, 1, 2, and 3).2) The Big Bear announces "Around the World" and serves to square 1, moving the ball in a circular rotation.3) When the Big Bear declares "War", direct one-on-one play occurs against the challenged square.
pe-05153: 1) Form a flat platform with hands together and use leg power to execute the forearm pass (bump).2) Create a triangle window above the forehead to set the ball cleanly using the fingertips.3) Step with the opposite foot and strike with a firm fist to complete an underhand serve.
pe-05154: 1) Place five gym mats as floating logs in the river while runners line up on one end line.2) Students matching the called description (e.g., yellow shirt) run across to the other side.3) Players hit by rolled or thrown dodgeballs are out and become throwers for the next round.
pe-05155: 1) The teacher marches like a robot holding pool noodle tag sticks in both hands and tags students to the gummy bear song.2) Tagged students become gummy bears and grab two tag sticks from the bucket.3) Tagged students also march around like robots and tag other students.
pe-05156: 1) Students choose a court based on skill level: Purple Moon (competition), Yellow Sun (fun), or Rainbow (learning).2) The server in the Big Bear square must keep feet on or behind the line and say 'Are you ready?' before serving or they are out.3) Instead of slamming the ball down, the server lets it drop from head height and scoops it underhand into play.
pe-05157: 1) Read the trivia question displayed on screen and choose an answer among options A, B, C, or D.2) Check the specific exercise demonstrated for the chosen option.3) Perform the designated exercise during the countdown to stay active.
pe-05158: 1) Prepare one shoe2) Place the shoe on your foot while balancing on your back3) Slowly roll your body completely over while keeping the shoe balanced without dropping it
pe-05159: 1) In groups of 3-4, flip a nutrition card and determine whether it is healthy, unhealthy, or hard to sort.2) Perform the exercises listed on the card to celebrate healthy foods or burn calories from unhealthy choices.3) Read and discuss the questions on the cards with group members regarding nutrition.
pe-05160: 1) Build 1: Players race from team zones to spot lines, shake hands, play rock-paper-scissors, the winner takes a beanbag back to their zone, both do 5 jumping jacks, and repeat until beanbags are gone.2) Build 2 (Battle Spots): Two teams line up facing a center line of spots; the first runners meet at the center spot to play rock-paper-scissors, the winner advances to the next spot to face the next opponent until the final spot is conquered.3) Build 3 (Tug-O-War): Without spots, runners sprint toward each other, play rock-paper-scissors, and the winner continues sprinting into the opponent's zone while a new opponent races out to meet them, continuing until one team breaches the opponent's home zone.
pe-05161: 1) Set up two main zones and two end zones, and divide the class into two teams.2) Cross through the opponent zone to reach their end zone while avoiding being tagged.3) Tagged players freeze and must be rescued by a teammate holding hands and escorting them back (immune while being saved).4) The first team to get all their players into the end zone wins the game.
pe-05162: 1) Students start at the Forest Edge while the teacher (Mr Wolf) stands across the area.2) Students call out "What time is it Mr Wolf?" and take that number of large steps forward based on the announced time.3) When Mr Wolf yells "Lunchtime!", students run back to the Forest Edge to avoid being tagged.4) Tagged players either join Mr Wolf or become sleepy wolves who freeze in place until the next lunchtime.
pe-05163: 1) Divide the entire school into six planet teams representing Mercury, Neptune, Jupiter, Saturn, Venus, and Mars with team colors.2) Students compete within their respective grade levels in designated field day events like boot toss.3) Organizers take only the single best result from each planet per event and rank the planets from best to worst.4) Points are awarded equal to rank (1st place gets 1 point), and the planet team with the lowest total score wins the cup.
pe-05164: 1) One player without a spot becomes the fleeing player with a rubber chicken, while the other becomes the chaser with a shortened pool noodle.2) When tagged, players switch roles and objects, and the new chaser waits 5 seconds before pursuing.3) Tired runners can hand off their item to stationary players waiting on spots to switch roles.
pe-05165: 1) Each student places a pin inside a hoop to defend while attacking others' pins with a ball.2) If your pin is knocked down, join that player's team to defend together and attack remaining pins.3) Progress the game by allowing three steps or restricting movement to passing only to encourage teamwork.
pe-05166: 1) The batter hits the pitched ball and runs toward first or second base.2) The fielding team stops points or gets outs by fielding the ball to the base before the runner arrives.3) Teams switch roles upon three outs, a fly ball catch, a double play, or after the entire batting lineup finishes.
pe-05167: 1) Bowl a ball from behind the 10-foot foul line toward designated 6-pin formations.2) If the lead bowler knocks down the formation on the challenge card in one roll, the opponent gets three attempts to match it.3) An opponent who fails in three tries receives a letter, and the first to complete B-O-W-L loses.
pe-05168: 1) Two taggers holding turkey tagging sticks chase and tag the fleeing runners.2) Tagged players must perform 5 turkey jumping jacks with bent arms before re-entering the game.3) Standing on a poly spot safe circle provides up to 10 seconds of safety, and taggers may not camp there.
pe-05169: 1) Students run to the poly spots placed in front of baskets near the gym wall.2) Complete 10 designated exercises (jumping jacks, push-ups, etc.) on the spot to earn 1 gold coin.3) Run across to drop the gold coin into their team's bucket and repeat continuously.
pe-05170: 1) One student acts as the tow truck pulling from the front.2) The partner acts as the broken car sitting on the scooter board.3) Safely move along the designated line to the matching color cone.
pe-05171: 1) Two players hold the rope while one player stands in the middle.2) The jumper performs straddle jumps while spelling out a name.3) After spelling the name, jump in and then out.
pe-05172: 1) Taggers hold tagging sticks (pieces of noodles).2) Tagged players go over to the out-of-bounds box and get a ball.3) Dribble the ball down and back.
pe-05174: 1) Run toward the black line upon starting.2) Touch the line with hands and run back to the team.3) Beep the cone to signal the next person to run.4) Do jumping jacks while waiting in line for your turn.
pe-05175: 1) Spread out to secure personal space.2) Toss the balloon above your head.3) Hit the balloon once with your hand.4) Let the balloon fall slightly and kick it with your foot.5) Continue keeping the balloon up by alternating between hand and foot.
pe-05176: 1) Students pretend to be cars, jog around the gym, and choose one of the four lanes to go down.2) Each lane has a different skill (galloping with a hurdle, skipping with a red hurdle, hopping with a blue hurdle, and bear walk with a yellow hurdle) ending with leaping over a hurdle.3) Going through the red hoop tunnel incurs a 5-push-up penalty if knocked down.4) Tired students cannot stop and walk on the highway but must exit to designated spots to stretch, do crunches, or do push-ups for a one-minute break.
pe-05177: 1) Practice running and leaping over the green hurdle.2) Practice activities at the hula hoop station.3) Toss bean bags into buckets.4) Keep balloons up in the air.5) Step and kick the ball to knock down the bowling pin.
pe-05179: 1) Ride scooters with a partner while keeping hands on partner's back with fingers pointed down.2) Go down and collect a Christmas card from the bowl.3) Return and take turns riding the scooter.
pe-05180: 1) Students stand in a circle holding the edges of the parachute.2) On the call 'Umbrella', lift the parachute up high and take one step inside.3) Lower the parachute and squat down in ready position.4) On the call 'Mushroom', inflate it upwards, step inside to form a dome, then come out to make waves.
pe-05181: 1) Lay the jump rope on the floor to jump over it, or make a circle to jump inside and out.2) Practice twirling the rope with both hands and jumping continuously.3) Rotate between jumping sticks, balloons, and hula hoop activity centers.
pe-05182: 1) Jump continuously in place using basic jump rope rhythm.2) Practice crossing arms in front of the body on alternate jumps (criss cross).3) Experiment with advanced trick jumps such as side swings and pretzel jumps.
pe-05183: 1) Run toward the cones set up along the wall upon signal.2) Lift one cone to find a heart (white, pink, red) hidden underneath.3) Take the heart, cover the cone back up, and run to place it into the designated color bucket.
pe-05184: 1) Check your assigned parachute color and sit around it.2) Switch places when your color is called.3) Take three scooches to reset before continuing.
pe-05187: 1) Pull a large truck tire or squat and flip it forward.2) Run around the bowling pin, then crawl through the tunnel or walk over the balance beam.3) Army crawl on the belly through designated obstacles.4) Jump 10 times on the trampoline, roll on the mat, and duck under the bars.
pe-05188: 1) Enter the gym, greet the teacher at the door, and stand on assigned rainbow spots.2) Follow the teacher's cards doing 12 exercises (Daily Dozen) for 15-30 seconds each to music.3) Finish the routine with deep breathing and sit down on the spot.4) In the Train Game, run on the black track line or walk on the white track line.5) Switch between running and walking using connecting gray lines without passing or crashing.
pe-05189: 1) Divide students into two teams across the half-court line, placing bowling pins (rockets) and cones topped with frisbees (satellites) in each territory.2) Throw or roll balls (or perform underhand volleyball serves) toward the opposing team's targets without crossing the center line.3) If a player catches an incoming ball, that player may stand up one knocked-down target for their team.4) Guard your targets while attempting to knock down all targets on the opposing side.
pe-05190: 1) The Satellites team sets up frisbees on cones, while the Rockets team sets up bowling pins behind them.2) Players use volleyball skills such as overhand serve, underhand serve, and bumps (or throw/roll under the net) to knock down the other team's targets across the net.3) If a player catches an incoming ball, they get to fix and reset one of their team's fallen targets.
pe-05191: 1) Jump 10 times in the middle of the trampoline, landing securely on feet.2) Leap over hurdles, round the bowling pin, press the pretend buzzer atop the stop cone, and signal the next person.3) Perform an army crawl around the bowling pin and crawl back through.4) Walk across blue square steps and the balance beam pretending water is underneath; falling off means going to the back of the line or another course.5) Move in a push-up position matching handprints on a flat mat, round the pin, leap the hurdle, and hit the buzzer.6) Complete the flexed-arm hang and monkey bar ladder for fitness testing and forearm strength.
pe-05192: 1) Two teams face each other throwing or rolling dodgeballs, aiming to hit opponents below the waist.2) Hit players enter the team jail marked by cones inside the basketball key area.3) Prisoners can escape through any one of three ways: catching a ball thrown by a teammate, scoring a basket into the hoop, or a "jailbreak" where a teammate hits the backboard or sinks a half-court shot to free everyone in jail at once.
pe-05193: 1) Students wait in line and take turns riding a scooter board around a turnaround cone.2) Riders can choose from three main postures: sitting on their bottom, lying on their belly, or kneeling.3) Bottom riders grip handles and push with feet; belly riders lift legs and paddle with arms or feet; kneeling riders center themselves and push with arms.4) For turbo speed, hold the handles, run a few running steps to gain momentum, hop on, glide around the cone, and stop safely before crashing into the cone to park it for the next rider.
pe-05194: 1) Teams line up behind numbered cones 1 through 5.2) Relay 1 is standard running down and back, finishing by sitting down quietly in line.3) Relay 2 (Money Relay) has players run to buckets to retrieve one fake bill at a time.4) Relay 3 (Beanbag Balance) involves balancing a beanbag on a mini hockey stick while walking/running.5) Relay 4 (Hurdles) has runners leaping over one hurdle per lane.6) Relay 5 (Chicken Walk) requires holding a rubber chicken between knees and walking around the cone and back.
pe-05195: 1) Move around avoiding taggers using the assigned locomotion (Round 1 walking, Round 2 skipping/galloping, Round 3 jogging).2) When tagged, step out to the sideline receiver station.3) Catch a pass thrown by the quarterback and throw it back (or after 3 tries) to rejoin the game.4) Rotate taggers and quarterbacks every 2 to 3 minutes.
pe-05196: 1) Walk across the balance beam.2) Touch the top of the cone as instructed by the sign.3) Crawl through the tunnel.4) Go through the ring of fire.5) Weave through the bowling pins.6) Leap over the hurdle and touch the cone.7) Leap over the purple hurdle and then the blue hurdle.8) Jump with two feet into the tires making two jumps.9) Finish by touching the top of the cone like a ninja warrior stop button.

pe-05304: 1) Bend a pool noodle with tape into a candy cane shape, enter the court, and tag opponents below the waist.2) A tagger is out if they tag above the waist, fall down, get tagged below the waist, or exceed the movement speed limit.3) If out, raise the noodle above your head, walk over, and pass it to your partner to switch turns.
pe-05305: 1) Study the spring-themed picture shown on screen for 10 seconds.2) Read the question about the details of the picture.3) Perform the exercise shown below your chosen answer (lunges, squats, jumping jacks, etc.).4) Check the answer reveal screen to verify if your choice was correct.
pe-05306: 1) Students form teams of three, assign roles (Snowman, Polar Bear, Penguin), and line up on the boundary line facing the center.2) The teacher scatters fewer cones than the number of teams (e.g., 6-7 cones for 10 teams) in the center area.3) When the teacher calls a character name, that player runs one full lap around the outside of the court.4) The remaining two teammates form a bridge tunnel by standing and holding hands.5) After completing the lap, the runner must bear crawl or crawl on knees through the teammates' tunnel to grab one cone.6) The round ends when cones are gone; the team with the most cones or the designated magic color cone wins.
pe-05307: 1) Study the St. Patrick's Day picture on screen for 10 seconds.2) Check the quiz question about the quantity or color of items in the picture.3) Perform the exercise shown below your chosen answer (side bends, jump rope, jogging in place, floss dance, dab, etc.).4) Check the answer reveal screen to verify if your choice was correct.
pe-05308: 1) Players are split into puck-less pirates, puck carriers, and waiting players standing in a single line.2) Pirates move inside the designated boundary to steal a puck from players using their hockey sticks.3) The player who loses their puck hands their stick to the first person in line and goes to the back.4) The new player entering the floor becomes a pirate and hunts for someone else's puck.
pe-05309: 1) Practice waving, alternating tossing and catching, and single-hand catches with one scarf2) Perform tricks such as tossing then spinning, tossing under legs, and clapping before catching3) Blow the scarf into the air and catch it with knees or feet4) Progress to using two scarves to toss across the body and juggle with one hand.
pe-05310: 1) Follow the Warrior 1 pose shown on screen.2) Transition into Warrior 2 and squat poses.3) Balance on one leg and then switch to the other leg.4) Perform Triangle pose and Lord of Dance pose.5) Lift the right leg, switch to the left leg lift, and complete with left and right side planks.
pe-05311: 1) Perform exercise at high intensity for 20 seconds following the on-screen cue.2) Rest for 10 seconds following the 3, 2, 1 countdown.3) Repeat the sequence to complete all 8 cycles.
pe-05312: 1) In round 1, choose between toss and catch sitting crisscross or on your knees.2) In round 2, choose between toss and catch standing on two feet or on one foot.3) In round 3, choose between toss and catch on knees or bounce under leg and catch.4) In round 4, choose between toss with one hand and catch with two or bounce and catch on knees.5) In round 5, choose between toss touch shoulders and catch or toss clap and catch.6) In round 6, choose between drop kick and catch or bounce and catch.7) In round 7, choose between toss under leg and catch or toss spin and catch.8) In round 8, create your own challenge to practice.
pe-05313: 1) Pick one favorite pumpkin shape from the two choices.2) Perform the exercise corresponding to your choice for 30 seconds.3) Pick up your pencil and draw the pumpkin outline for 30 seconds.4) For eyes, nose, mouth, and stem, choose a design, do the 30-second exercise, and then draw that feature to finish the pumpkin.
pe-05314: 1) Form teams of 4 to 5 students and line up behind team cones.2) Run down one at a time to retrieve hoops and construct a hut using all 6 hula hoops.3) Complete team challenges including the silent build (building 3 times without talking), tunnel crawl, move and squat (carry hut and do 5 squats), and cone collector (cover dome cones and do 5 jumping jacks).4) Practice build and blast by throwing a ball from a distance to knock down and rebuild the hut.5) In the Hula Hut Throwdown game, each side builds 3 huts; defenders guard, catch, or block balls (no kicking) and rebuild fallen huts, while attackers throw rainbow tosses or roll balls to knock down all 3 opposing huts.
pe-05315: 1) Divide students into teams of 3 to 4 with a hula hoop containing their equipment on the end line.2) Each challenge lasts for 1 minute (2 minutes for K-2), starting after a quick teacher demonstration.3) Cookie Bake: Underhand toss a beanbag off a paddle for a partner standing in a hoop to catch with a lid/sheet.4) Ring the Tree: Toss a hula hoop to ring around a cone.5) Snowball Balance: Carry snowballs on a paddle around a cone, adding one more each turn.6) Stuff the Stocking: Toss a beanbag underhand into a handheld cone.7) Snowball Fight: Throw a ball to knock down a bowling pin.8) Reindeer Stables: Use scoopers to collect foam noodle bits from the center.
pe-05316: 1) Create a coordinate grid by placing letters and numbers (or sports balls, character shapes, and stars) on opposite gym walls.2) Mark individual 6-7 inch home spots on the floor aligned with the coordinates using vinyl stickers, spots, or marks.3) Match colors for younger grades, such as yellow floor spots corresponding to a yellow star on the wall.4) Use home spots for attendance, warm-up exercises in personal space, wrap-up discussions, health tips, and emergency fire drills.
pe-05317: 1) Students are assigned a station number and color cone, rotating through each station for 3 minutes.2) They participate in various activities such as Feed the Monster, Float the Ghost, Witches Stew, and Moving Targets.3) They complete the Bone Relay on scooters, Seated Eyeball Volleyball, and the Haunted House scooter tunnel.4) When 3 minutes are up, students clean up, sit down, and rotate together to their designated color station.
pe-05318: 1) Lay two hand towels in a straight line at least 5 to 6 feet apart from each other.2) Dribble the soccer ball using the inside and outside of your foot.3) Trap the ball on the towel.4) Dribble back to the other towel, trap the ball again, and repeat for 1 minute to get as many traps as possible.
pe-05319: 1) Two physical activity options using a deck ring appear on the screen.2) Each student chooses one preferred challenge (e.g., toss and catch with one hand vs. two hands, toss-clap-catch).3) Perform the chosen challenge continuously for 30 seconds during the countdown timer.4) Progress through new challenge pairs each round and create your own challenge at the final round.
pe-05320: 1) A Valentine's Day pun pops up on the screen.2) Students rest and reset during the 5-second break while the coach reads the pun aloud.3) Perform the specific exercise associated with the pun (frog jumps, bell jumps, push-ups, squats, superman, etc.) for 30 seconds.4) Repeat the cycle for each new pun until all exercises are completed.
pe-05321: 1) Set up a net dividing the court and scatter balls evenly on both sides.2) Players continuously throw balls (trash) over the net into the opposing yard while the timer runs.3) When time is called, players freeze, and the team with the fewer balls remaining on their side wins.4) In Falling Stars, players catch incoming balls from over the net and place them into their team basket to score points.
pe-05322: 1) Station 1 (Drop and Catch): Place a beanbag on top of a ball, drop the ball, and partner catches the bouncing beanbag.2) Station 2 (Bozo Bowling): Throw a ball from behind the cone to knock down the pin on the red spot; if knocked down, advance the pin to the next colored spot (retrieve and carry the ball back, never throw it back).3) Station 3 (Build and Blast): Build a tower, throw the ball to knock it down, and rebuild together if completely knocked over.4) Station 4 (Toss and Catch Challenge): Stand on stars facing each other, toss an item underhand, and successfully catch it 3 times before trading for a new item.5) Station 5 (Bucket Toss): Take turns tossing 3 yarn balls underhand into buckets, then collect and return them to the hoop.
pe-05323: 1) Warm up paddle control by balancing and bouncing the ball on the paddle.2) Stand across the net, toss the ball high underhand, let it bounce, and hit it back with forehand or backhand for 5 turns before switching.3) Move to diagonal positions and practice diagonal tossing and hitting for 5 turns.4) Practice serving diagonally 5 times (drop and hit or bounce and hit), with the receiver catching after one bounce.5) Join as a group of four to rally back and forth collaboratively following the bounce rules.
pe-05324: 1) Station 1 (Memory): Run to flip two face-down frisbees to find matching Star Wars character pairs and collect them into a hoop.2) Station 2 (Lightsaber Tag): Speed walk to avoid taggers with foam noodles; tag below the waist, and if tagged, pass the noodle to the next person or do 10 repetitions outside the line.3) Station 3 (Space Invaders): Throw frisbees from the line to knock down target frisbees placed on cones.4) Station 4 (Roll and Run): Roll a die, race your partner to touch the corresponding numbered cone, and run back to grab the lightsaber first (sliding or falling results in disqualification).5) Station 5 (Speed Stacks): Follow along with the Phys Ed Review video to perform cup stacking challenges.
pe-05325: 1) When music starts playing, dance along with the screen characters or freestyle with your own dance moves.2) As soon as the music stops and the freeze cue appears, instantly freeze in place.3) Resume dancing when the music plays again across multiple rounds.
pe-05326: 1) In the first half, complete 1-minute individual fitness challenges (Tabata, plank, wall sit, running, one-leg balance) at home spots.2) In the second half, students work in teams of three with all equipment placed in a hoop to complete 2-minute challenges.3) Teams rotate through diverse challenges including Balancing Act, Pancake Flipper, Cone Catcher, Hoop It Up, Bucket Head, Bottle Caps, and Spinner Winner.
pe-05327: 1) Rotate through multiple stacking stations set up around the gymnasium in small groups.2) In the relay station, run to up-stack cups/buckets at cones and down-stack on the way back.3) Participate in diverse stations: stack mat timing, Tiny Towers of 12, Minecraft team build, Race to 55 pyramid, and Cups & Cardio follow-along.4) Conclude the event with a 5-minute creative cup design coloring challenge.
pe-05328: 1) Grab one hula hoop per student and stand in a safe personal space.2) Choose one of two hula hoop challenges shown on screen for each round.3) Practice the chosen challenge for 30 seconds following the timer.4) Progress through various rounds and create your own hula hoop trick in the final round.
pe-05329: 1) A new exercise is added for each consecutive day of the Christmas song.2) Perform the movements cumulatively from day 1 up to day 12 speed bounces.
pe-05330: 1) Place 4 sheets of paper on the floor as targets.2) While standing on one leg, bend down and place one sock onto each sheet of paper without throwing or dropping.3) Without putting your raised foot down, collect each sock one by one.4) Keep your balance until the whole exercise is completed.
pe-05332: 1) Pair up with each person standing by a cone2) Hold the ball with both hands and stick your elbows out to the side like chicken wings3) Take a big step forward and push the ball directly to your partner's chest.
pe-05333: 1) The teacher lays out 6 or 7 hoops in a small zigzag line.2) Practice pencil jumps with strong straight arms up and legs together.3) Keep the jumps short and quick through the hoops.
pe-05334: 1) Step onto the balance beam to prepare2) Spread both arms wide like airplane wings to maintain balance and keep your head up3) Step forward along the beam while scooping large scoops of ice cream with each stride, then perform a safety dismount at the end.
pe-05335: 1) Set the bar at shoulder height and grip it shoulder-width apart using a kangaroo grip with thumbs over the bar.2) Jump up into a front support with strong straight arms and straight legs.3) Hold the front support position firmly for three seconds (counting 3, 2, 1).4) Cast off on three swings and land safely in a motorbike landing position.
pe-05336: 1) Run up toward the trampoline starting from the cone.2) Jump off the ground with one foot onto the trampoline with two feet.3) Spread arms and legs wide into a star shape in the air and land in a motorbike position on the mat.
pe-05337: 1) Start on one foot at one cone (spot marker).2) Hop over to the other side and balance on the other foot.3) Continue hopping back and forth from left to right on one foot.
pe-05338: 1) Hang a shield screen on the net to block the view of opponents on the other side.2) Prepare for the ball using sound cues since the opponents are completely hidden.3) Receive the ball off the bounce or pass it to return it over the net.
pe-05339: 1) Stand with a partner by one of the footprint markers placed on the floor.2) On signal, shoot a ball toward any hoop or the designated target hoop among various heights and sizes.3) Retrieve the ball, pass it to the next partner, and rotate to the next footprint marker to shoot at different rims.
pe-05340: 1) The strongest player in the team holds the bottom bucket using only hands without touching their body.2) Ball tossers throw balls into the bucket from a designated distance.3) When a ball lands in the bucket, the placer adds another bucket on top, stacking them as high as possible without falling.
pe-05341: 1) Each student stands on an unstable stepping stone and maintains core balance.2) The player with the ball calls a classmate's name and throws the ball, while the receiver catches it without falling off.3) Following the teacher's cues, students hold the ball overhead or to the side while lifting one foot or tucking down.
pe-05342: 1) Throwers bounce colored balls behind the line into matching colored buckets.2) Fielders quickly gather and roll balls back to throwers.3) If a ball enters the wrong colored bucket, all balls inside that bucket are cleared.4) Teams aim to score higher points by targeting further buckets within 90 seconds.
pe-05343: 1) Roll a die to collect all numbers from 1 to 6.2) Roll to collect only odd numbers (1, 3, 5).3) Roll and add numbers together until reaching a sum of 20.4) Run around cones to stack six dice into towers and pyramids in relay format.5) Roll dice and write down numbers to reach a cumulative total of 50 as a team.
pe-05344: 1) Toss one ball up to the height of the opposite hand with an open palm without spinning it and cushion the catch.2) Toss one ball back and forth between hands from underneath at an even height.3) Hold two balls and practice the throw-throw-catch-catch pattern.4) Hold three balls, start with the hand holding two, and continue with a steady throw-and-throw cadence.
pe-05345: 1) Roll a die repeatedly until rolling the target number (such as 2 or5) and jump to signal success.2) Roll two dice until matching pairs (doubles) appear.3) Roll three dice until all three show the same number (triples).4) Roll two dice to make a total sum of 7.5) Roll dice to obtain three consecutive numbers (e.g., 1-2-3).6) Flip toy pizzas so the cheese side faces up within 60 seconds.
pe-05346: 1) Step inside the potato sack, hold the sides, and explore continuous jumping.2) Practice side-to-side ski jumps, forward-and-back jumps, and star jumps.3) Complete as many jumps as possible within a 10-second limit.4) Race by jumping forward to the designated line, turning around, and jumping back.5) Sit on the sack to perform spins, or place feet on the sack in a push-up position to do knee tucks and lateral slides.
pe-05347: 1) Split into two teams of two.2) One player serves the ball and the partner volleys toward the can.3) Hitting the can on serve scores 1 point, partner hitting the can scores 2 points, and partner spiking it inside scores 3 points.4) A serve going directly into the can results in a wipeout, resetting the opposing team's points to zero.
pe-05348: 1) Form teams of three at the starting line.2) Bring out one bucket at a time to build pyramids.3) Return the buckets touching only one at a time, or build designated structures (stacks of 2, 6, or 10).4) All three members run out together to stack a tower as high as possible.
pe-05349: 1) Keep the mini Airlite cube and cylinder up in the air without dropping them.2) Keep the Airlite inside the circle while keeping it up.3) Move the cube to the end with the mat and bring it back while keeping it in the air.4) Take turns touching it in numerical order from one to five to keep it up.
pe-05350: 1) Move forward placing one foot in each rung of the ladder.2) Pass through taking double steps (two steps in each rung).3) Jump forward into every rung using single bunny hops.4) Move down the ladder performing squat jumps into every single rung.5) Crawl on hands and feet hitting every rung with hands and feet.6) Crawl like Spider-Man bringing each knee up to the corresponding elbow.
pe-05351: 1) Four players take roles as shooter, receiver, and stealer to play the game.2) A throw landing directly into the mesh net scores three points for the team.3) If the ball bounces off the ramp and the teammate receiver catches it before touching the ground, the team scores one point.4) If an opposing stealer catches the ball off the ramp before it hits the ground, their team earns extra shots.5) The first team to reach 21 points wins the game.
pe-05352: 1) Start with two buckets on the ground, then stack three, four, and more on top in an inverted tree shape.2) Each team is provided with exactly two feet of tape to use as they wish.3) Stack as many layers as possible without toppling within a 2-minute time limit.
pe-05353: 1) Walk quickly or slide-hop around the outer play track and freeze on command.2) Enter the inner play area, mingle, and pair up toe-to-toe into groups of three.3) Two students hold two scarves taut while the third person goes over, under, around, and through.4) Tuck a scarf into your pocket and try to pull scarves from others in Dragon Tail.5) If your scarf is pulled, go to the exterior area, perform ten jumping jacks while naming fruits, and re-enter.
pe-05354: 1) Wear two flags on a belt and walk inside the circle trying to take others' flags and drop them outside2) A ball carrier tries to reach the blue line while three walking defenders attempt to pull their flags3) In a 2 vs 2 matchup, use passes and running to score a touchdown without getting your flag pulled
pe-05355: 1) Two players face each other and hold the handles of the sliding rope unit with both hands.2) Repeatedly open and close arms quickly to send the sliding runner back and forth without letting it touch the ground.3) Progress to walking forward, reversing grips, or having four players collaborate simultaneously using four hands.
pe-05356: 1) Form groups of three where one student is the designated catcher and two students hold noodle bits from a bucket.2) Launchers pinch and pop noodle slices into the air using their thumb and fingers.3) The catcher catches flying pieces without picking up dropped ones, progressing to catching behind the back into a bucket.
pe-05357: 1) Step inside the giant inflatable BBOP ball and stand up.2) Try body movements such as laying down and getting up, rolling sideways, and curling completely inside to roll.3) Follow verbal commands to walk in slow motion, hide inside like a turtle, or crawl on all fours like a bear.
pe-05358: 1) Everyone holds the handles and shakes the parachute together.2) Place scarves on the parachute and have two students go onto it to catch them while others shake it.3) Place balls on the parachute, call a student's name to catch a ball, and have them return to their handle.4) Lift the parachute high, step underneath, and sit on the handles to make a tent.
pe-05359: 1) Sit on the scooter board and travel backwards from cone to cone, or push with both legs in a rowing motion.2) Lie on your stomach and propel forward using freestyle swimming arm strokes or simultaneous arm pulls.3) Pair up side-by-side, hook inside elbows together, and coordinate remaining arms and legs to navigate around cones.4) Have one partner pull the other through a zigzag cone course without knocking over cones.5) Keep legs extended forward to scoop up a cone between feet, bring it back to the base, and switch roles.
pe-05360: 1) Each team is assigned a color and lines up behind the line2) A player jogs out and flips over a cone3) If it matches the team color, take the bean bag and place the cone on its side; if not, cover it back up and tag the next person4) The first team to collect all 4 bean bags and sit down wins.
pe-05361: 1) Toss bola sets underhand toward the ladder rung target.2) Earn 1 point for the top rung, 2 points for the middle rung, and 3 points for the bottom rung.3) Balls landing on the same rung by opposing players cancel each other out.4) The first player or team to reach 15 points wins the game.
pe-05362: 1) Insert a ball about halfway into the launcher tube and aim toward your partner.2) Stomp on the launch pad to shoot the ball and have the partner catch it.3) Switch roles after catching and continue taking turns.4) Launch beanbags instead of balls, or perform a heel blast by facing backward and stomping with the heel.
pe-05363: 1) Each team receives a set of tangled ropes and stands outside the river boundary line.2) In round one, players must stay on their spot without moving feet, passing fishing poles to neighbors to untangle lines.3) In round two, players hold their own pole and move their bodies over and under lines to untangle without passing poles.4) The team that untangles all fishing lines first wins the challenge.
pe-05364: 1) Form two teams of 4 and aim to score into the opponent's net2) Throwing the ball into the net scores 1 point, while kicking it in scores 2 points3) If a pass is dropped to the floor, players cannot pick it up with hands and must use feet4) To get the ball back into hands, a player must flick or kick it up to a teammate.
pe-05365: 1) Hold the stick with separated hands, bend knees, keep back straight, and practice side-to-side stick handling.2) Scoop and shovel under the ball to practice flipping it against the wall or over teammates' heads.3) Trap and control the ball before passing toward the target or taking a slap shot on net.4) Divide into 3-on-3 teams and play a broomball game using active communication, passing, and shooting.
