pe-05366: 1) Build a tower with 3 pins on bottom, 2 in middle, and a disc on top, then run relay with high-fives.2) Stack pins as high as possible and place a disc on top, giving the opposing team 10 seconds to beat the height.3) Compete in an attack-defense game where one team knocks pins down and the other sets them back up.4) Work together to roll coated foam balls and knock down all standing pins as fast as possible.5) Insert thumb and two fingers into the foam bowling ball, roll toward the pins, and count how many fall.
pe-05367: 1) Assume the ready position holding the stick and run shuttles between the lines.2) Practice stickhandling in place, walking, and running with knees bent and heads up.3) Runners skate towards the net, receive a pass from the passer, shoot on goal, and rotate positions.
pe-05368: 1) Place both hands together near the middle of the grip and swing back and forth like a pendulum.2) Practice putting from both ends of the mat towards the center hole.3) Putt through various obstacles such as the castle, bridge, and maze into the hole.4) Putt through the loop-the-loop obstacle so the ball travels around and into the hole.5) Creatively combine curved pieces to design diverse custom courses and putt in turn.
pe-05369: 1) Position the stilts behind your arms and tuck them in tight.2) Lean against a wall, place one foot on the step then the other, and establish balance.3) Walk forward slowly away from the wall and practice turning around.4) Once comfortable, try walking backward or adjusting the stilts to higher levels.
pe-05370: 1) Form a group of four, with each player holding one strap, and place a ball on the center net.2) Walk around or speed-walk keeping the ball balanced on the net.3) Crouch down together on a count, pop the ball up into the air, and catch it back on the net.4) Catch balls tossed by the instructor using the group balance net.5) Two groups face each other and toss the ball back and forth from net to net.
pe-05371: 1) Step over the food spots on the floor, name each food, and share if you have eaten it.2) Walk with a partner and talk about each food you pass by or what you ate today.3) Turn the spots face down, and the first partner flips two spots over to find a match.4) If they match, bring them back to the team; if not, turn them face down again.5) Take turns with your partner to find and collect as many matching pairs as possible.
pe-05372: 1) 9 Square in the Air: Push the ball up and over to another square without letting it land in yours; if it lands, go to the back of the line.2) Pickleball: Warm up by bouncing against a wall or rallying with a partner in the air or off the bounce.3) Reaction Balls: Throw the unpredictable ball against the wall and catch it after it bounces.4) Noodle Bits: Pinch half-circle pool noodle pieces to pop them high into the air to catch or tag.5) Scarf Juggling: Start with one scarf and progress to two and three scarves to practice cross-brain coordination.
pe-05373: 1) Divide into two teams and select four players per team to stand outside a hula hoop.2) Place a bowling pin inside each hoop for players to protect.3) The opposing team rolls or throws underhand to knock down the pins; overhand throws do not count.4) If your pin is knocked down, pick it up, pass it to the next teammate in line, and move to the back of the line.
pe-05374: 1) Team members hold the ends of the spider lift ropes and maintain balance.2) Transport the penguin fuel cell from the start to the blue cone safety zone without dropping it.3) Cooperatively tilt the marble maze board up and down to roll the marble to the top without hitting holes.4) If the marble falls into a hole, block it with a peg and continue the maze challenge.
pe-05375: 1) Rest the flower stick on handsticks and tap side to side using the tick-tock motion.2) Progress to rolling the stick down the arms or tossing and catching it in the air.3) Start juggling with one ball crossing ear-to-ear, then progress to two and three balls.4) Step onto the Spooner board while bracing against the wall and rock back and forth for balance.5) Spin the plate on the stick using wrist circles, settle it in the center, and try transferring it to a finger.
pe-05376: 1) Mark a court approximately 15 by 25-30 feet with team cubbs on baseline edges and the King in the center.2) Throw batons end-over-end without crossing the front boundary stakes.3) Knock down all opponent cubb blocks on their side before taking a shot at the King.4) The team that knocks down all opposing cubbs and then knocks down the center King wins the game.5) Under advanced rules, knocked cubbs are tossed across and must be cleared first, or the opponent moves forward to throw.
pe-05377: 1) Traverse sideways along the wall using velcro hand patches and floor foot blocks.2) On the return path, traverse using only specified colors like yellow and green.3) Alternate gripping between big and small patches while keeping at least one hand on the wall at all times.4) Match your foot placement so your foot lands on the same color block as the patch your hand is gripping.5) Have two climbers start from opposite ends and crisscross past each other without falling off.
pe-05378: 1) Crawl across the mat in a push-up or modified knee plank position placing hands on hand prints.2) Match right hands to right handprints and left hands to left handprints along the mat.3) Choose a single color (e.g., blue or red) and traverse the mat touching only that color.4) Each time you move a hand, lift and wave that hand to the camera before placing it down.5) Have all team members fit onto the mat simultaneously, each holding a valid right and left handprint.
pe-05379: 1) Pull the Trapp Ball handles apart to launch the ball upward and snap it shut to catch it.2) Practice alternating between underhand and overhead launches and catches.3) Shoot the ball against a wall and catch the rebound either in the air or off one bounce.4) Pair up with a partner to toss and catch the ball back and forth.5) Play an alternating wall tennis-style match where each team must catch the rebound off the wall to score points.
pe-05380: 1) Flip the foam pizza in the air and catch it switching from right hand to left hand.2) Hold one pizza in each hand and flip and catch both simultaneously.3) Stand facing a partner and flip pizzas to each other at the same time.4) Take turns picking target numbered cones and throw the pizza frisbee-style; the closest throw scores 1 point.5) Set up standing cones in the center and throw pizzas from both sides to knock all cones down.
pe-05381: 1) In groups of three, step up and down on plyo boxes for 10 seconds, switching positions twice.2) On count, jump up onto the platform using arms, land softly in a slight squat, and step down carefully.3) Jump across the platform leapfrog-style and immediately transition from two-foot landing into an explosive sprint.
pe-05382: 1) Each student grabs a balloon, finds personal space, and prepares for challenges.2) Perform 12 sequential challenges as prompted (tapping with hands, fingertips, head, feet, clapping before catching, spinning, controlling while lying down, etc.).3) Freeze immediately whenever the cue sound plays and get ready for the next challenge.
pe-05383: 1) Scorers throw balls from behind the midline into the trash can (2 hoops), side goal (4 hoops), or big goal (6 hoops) to earn hula hoops.2) Builders construct hula huts in designated zones while protectors defend them from balls.3) Destroyers throw balls from behind the midline to knock down enemy huts and return hoops to cones, while gatherers retrieve loose balls across the line.4) The team with the most standing hula huts when time expires wins the game.
pe-05384: 1) Each team starts with 13 rings in a bucket and players choose one of three roles: thrower, catcher, or blocker.2) Throwers stay behind the centerline to throw overhand to catchers standing on the opposing bench while blockers attempt to deflect the ball outside the restricted zone.3) If a catcher catches the ball with both feet on the bench, they yell 'Boom' and steal one ring to their bucket; the team with the most rings when the music stops wins.
pe-05385: 1) Hold the ball out in front and perform strong slaps on top of the ball while music plays.2) Tap the ball back and forth above the head using finger pads as quickly as possible.3) Wrap the ball around the waist, head, and knees without looking directly at the ball.4) Practice flips and flops by bouncing the ball and catching it behind the back.5) When the music stops, place the ball between your feet; if the ball rolls away, let it roll and do not chase it.
pe-05386: 1) Teams of 5 to 6 use 6 hula hoops each to build a hula hut on the middle line.2) Complete specific challenges for each level, such as crawling through, going through with belly buttons facing up while singing, or guiding a blindfolded teammate with verbal cues.3) If the hut falls, return to the start line to rebuild, and finish by sitting on the opposite line and clapping.
pe-05387: 1) Step the right leg to the side and jump, step the left leg to the side and jump, cross arms tight and jump, and wave arms high and jump, repeating twice.2) Roll arms like hitting a speed bag while walking 4 steps forward, then do the same 4 steps backward.3) Perform the pancake, rollerblade, snake, shake, and wave movements 4 times each, always starting to the right.
pe-05388: 1) Set up a trap by propping a laundry basket on top of an empty water bottle.2) Roll a tennis ball (or small ball) from 8 to 10 feet away aiming at the water bottle.3) Score 3 points if both the ball and bottle are trapped inside, 2 points for the bottle only, and 1 point for the ball only.4) Roll continuously for 60 seconds and calculate the total score achieved.
pe-05389: 1) Players occupy the King, Queen, Jack, and 10 squares, while waiting players line up outside.2) The King serves the ball underhand after bouncing it once, keeping one foot behind the service line.3) When the ball bounces once in a player's square, they must strike it underhand into another square; mistakes lead to elimination and rotation.
pe-05390: 1) The first player runs up to their team's first cone.2) The player holds the top of the cone and attempts one flip to land it upright.3) If it lands upright, the next player advances to the next cone; if it fails, leave it and tag the next teammate.
pe-05391: 1) Position hands on the line with one knee down to save energy before the test begins.2) Lower the body until the chest touches the cone and push back up to the rhythm of the cadence.3) The partner counts repetitions and halts the test after two form errors to record the final score.
pe-05392: 1) Throw a marker such as a beanbag into the numbered hopscotch grid starting from 1 to 9.2) Hop through the grid on one foot for single squares and both feet for double squares while skipping the square with the marker.3) Turn around at the end, pick up the marker on the way back without stepping on lines or losing balance, and return.4) The player who successfully completes all squares up to 9 wins.
pe-05393: 1) Form two teams of three players and stand outside the goal line.2) An attacker dribbles the ball, makes three passes with teammates, and throws the ball at the goal.3) If a defender catches the rebounded ball from the net or the ball misses the goal and goes out, attack and defense switch.4) If the defenders fail to catch the rebound off the goal, the attacking team scores 1 point.5) The team with the most points during the set time wins.
pe-05394: 1) Form a group of four, wear team vests, and decide the turn order.2) Set up 6 bowling pins and take turns rolling the ball once by extending your arm forward.3) Score 10 points for knocking all down at once, 5 points for clearing the remaining pins, or points equal to the number of fallen pins, then sum the scores.
pe-05395: 1) Line up in teams behind the starting line.2) On signal, the first runner sprints to stack Jumbo Stacks cups in a 3-6-3 structure.3) Round the turnaround cone, collapse the cups into a single column, sprint back, and tag the next runner.
pe-05396: 1) Divide students into runners and defenders, placing runners at the start line and defenders in designated zones2) On signal, runners sprint sequentially through each zone toward the finish line while dodging defenders3) The team with the greatest number of runners successfully reaching the finish line within the time limit wins.
pe-05397: 1) Set up a cone 10m away from the starting line for each team.2) On signal, the first runner runs around the cone, returns, holds hands with the second runner, and they run together.3) After rounding the cone, they link hands with the third runner and run together.4) The team whose runners all hold hands and cross the finish line first wins.
pe-05398: 1) Divide the class into two teams, select two pullers per team, and position the remaining members at both ends of the playing area2) A rider sits on the parachute pulling it taut, while the pullers drag the parachute forward3) After crossing the opposite finish line, switch only the rider with the next teammate to continue the relay4) The team whose final member crosses the finish line first wins
pe-05399: 1) Divide players into kicking and fielding teams.2) The kicker kicks a rolling ball and runs around the cones back to home.3) Fielders catch and throw the ball to knock down the hoop tower, then return to their home holding the ball.4) Kickers earn points for each cone circled before the fielders return; switch sides after all kick.
pe-05400: 1) Divide into two groups, and one group ties a tail ribbon around their waist.2) The group with tails stands 2m ahead of the starting line, while the chasing group stands at the start line.3) On signal, both groups sprint simultaneously; chasers try to grab the tail ribbons before crossing the finish line.4) Switch roles and the team that collects the most tails wins.
pe-05401: 1) Four students form a group in a line at arm's-length distance.2) At the signal, pass the ball to the next teammate using calisthenics movements.3) The last teammate receives the ball and places it into the basket behind them.4) The group that places the most balls into the basket within the time limit wins.
pe-05402: 1) Form groups of 4 and line up in order.2) Each player gets 3 balls and takes turns pushing a ball forward with the stick.3) Earn points corresponding to the action hoop when a ball stops inside it.4) The group with the highest total score wins.
pe-05403: 1) Form a team of 4 in a straight line, with only the front player wearing a team vest.2) Place a spot marker in the center of the area with a bowling pin on it.3) On signal, the player in the vest passes the ball backward overhead/bending and moves to the back of the line.4) Continue passing the ball backward until the player in the vest receives it again and dashes to the center.5) Knock down the center bowling pin for 2 points, or step on the spot marker for 1 point (only one score per turn).6) The team with the highest total score after 2 rounds wins.
pe-05404: 1) Form two teams of four students each and take turns sliding floor curling stones toward the target center.2) After all deliveries, the team with the stone closest to the center scores points.3) Play two ends in total, and the team with the highest combined score wins.
pe-05405: 1) Form two teams and stand in designated areas.2) The serving team hits the ball into the opponent area.3) The receiving team hits the ball back before it touches the ground; failing to return gives 1 point to the opponent.4) If the ball goes out of bounds, the receiving team scores 1 point.5) The scoring team hits the ball next to continue the game.6) The team with the most points within the time limit wins.
pe-05406: 1) Pull out one sheet of tissue paper.2) Toss the tissue upward without touching it with hands and blow air.3) Keep blowing to prevent it from touching the body and count successful blows in 1 minute.
pe-05407: 1) Pair up with a friend or family member.2) Jump together facing each other or side by side.3) Complete the jumps as fast as possible within the given time to record the score.
pe-05408: 1) Place hands shoulder-width apart angled outward and look at knees2) Sit holding knees and rock back and forth like a tumbling doll3) Push off with feet and roll forward keeping the body rounded so back of head touches first
pe-05409: 1) Participants start by crouching or sitting on the floor.2) Beginning from number 1, players take turns standing up and calling out consecutive numbers without overlapping with others.3) If two players stand and call out the same number simultaneously, or if someone is left last, they fail the mission as they aim to continue numbers as long as possible.
pe-05410: 1) Set the rule forbidding speaking, whispering, or eye-contact signals.2) On count, all team members simultaneously show their rock-paper-scissors hand.3) Determine victory when team members match hands or follow game rules.
pe-05411: 1) Two players face each other with hands close together, one acting as the mouse and the other as the cat.2) When the leader calls 'Mouse', the mouse claps to tag while the cat pulls hands back to dodge.3) When the leader calls 'Cat', the cat claps to tag while the mouse dodges.
pe-05412: 1) Prepare with all players, including the tagger, in a space with grid squares marked on the floor.2) On the count of "one, two, three," everyone jumps simultaneously into any square, landing with both feet inside the box.3) Players on the same row or column as the tagger are eliminated, while those diagonal to the tagger survive.
pe-05413: 1) One player acts as the hypnotist, circling hands in front of a partner's eyes to cast hypnosis.2) The hypnotist moves their hand while maintaining a distance of 15 to 20 cm from the partner's face.3) The hypnotized player follows the movement of the hand, keeping the exact facial distance.
pe-05414: 1) In Activity 1, two partners bounce the ball once on the floor and pass it through the hoop to each other.2) Partners can move together while holding the hoop or set a target number of successful passes.3) In Activity 2, one player bounces the ball through the hoop while the other player bounces the ball over the hoop.
pe-05415: 1) Place a disc cone on the floor and balance a ball on top of it.2) Place another disc cone dome-side up over the ball and balance a second ball on top.3) Stack alternately up to 2 or 3 layers to use as a target or mini goal in target games.
pe-05416: 1) Three participants stand in a circle and place their arms over each other's shoulders.2) Each of the three players takes turns jumping between the legs in sequence.3) Completing the jump for all three players counts as one full round, competing to reach a set number of rounds first.
pe-05417: 1) Partners face each other in pairs, each holding a cone in hand.2) One player kicks a fistball to pass it along the floor.3) The receiving partner traps and catches the ball using only the cone, not their hands or feet.
pe-05418: 1) Students take turns by student number coming to the front to play Rock-Paper-Scissors against the whole class.2) Students who lose do 3 squats, those who tie do 2, and those who win do 1 squat.3) The leader earns points equal to the number of students who lost, and the student with the most points becomes champion.
pe-05419: 1) Enter the center of the ropes to avoid tripping near the turners.2) Jump on the spot marker and check the turning direction of the ropes.3) Exit in the opposite direction of the turning rope as it comes down.
pe-05420: 1) Stand back-to-back with a partner.2) Reach around with the outer hand to grasp the partner's hand.3) Pull on signal to lift the opponent's foot off the floor to win.4) Switch hands between rounds to keep the contest fair.
pe-05421: 1) Three players play rock-paper-scissors to assign roles: 1st place is the hen, 2nd is the chick, and 3rd is the wolf.2) The chick tucks a tail belt behind and holds the hen's waist from behind, while the wolf stands facing the hen.3) If the wolf avoids the hen's defense and snatches the chick's tail, roles are switched.
pe-05422: 1) Two players on each team pair up to play a doubles match.2) After hitting or throwing, the player moves behind the mat while the teammate receives the ball, taking turns.3) The losing side serves first, and the team that reaches 10 points first wins.
pe-05423: 1) Players sit across a desk and attempt to flip their stacking cups.2) Each time a cup flip succeeds, the player advances the marker toward the opponent's goal.3) The player who successfully advances into the goal twice in a row wins the game.
pe-05424: 1) The tagger wearing a blue vest tries to tag the runners.2) Players tagged become frozen as ice and stay in place.3) When an angel spins the frozen player in a full circle, they are unfrozen and rejoin the game.
pe-05425: 1) Perform 10 jumping jacks.2) Perform 10 skier jumps hopping side to side.3) Perform 10 front-to-back cross hops.4) Perform 10 mountain climbers in a plank position.5) Perform 10 push-ups (or knee push-ups).6) Hold the V-sit pose for 10 seconds.
pe-05426: 1) Get into a plank position and place toilet paper rolls on both sides.2) On start, alternate hands to stack the rolls into a tower one by one.3) Once stacked, return them one by one back to their original position.
pe-05427: 1) Designate two Zombie Kings who roll a large ball inside the area to hit running players.2) Players hit by the ball exit, kneel down, and become crawling zombies.3) The crawling zombies move on the floor and tag the legs of runners to get them out.
pe-05428: 1) Two runners run between lying teammates toward the turning point.2) Lying teammates form a continuous line for the runners to pass through.3) The entire team cooperates to maintain the formation and finish the relay.
pe-05429: 1) The first runner of each team takes one numbered cone and runs to the fun sticks at the turning point.2) Insert the cone into the fun stick to set up a standing pillar, then run back and tag the next runner.3) Subsequent runners repeat the task, and the team that sets up all 10 pillars first and returns wins.
pe-05430: 1) Flip a water bottle so that it lands upright on the palm of the hand.2) Landing counts as success as long as fingers do not grab the bottle, even if the palm is not fully flat.3) Press the LED buzzer once the bottle successfully lands on the palm.4) The player who lights up 3 bulbs first wins, and each failure requires 1 squat.
pe-05431: 1) Toss and flip a water bottle so that it lands upright on the back of the hand.2) Once the bottle balances upright on the back of the hand, press the LED buzzer to turn on a light.3) The player who successfully turns on all 3 lights first wins.
pe-05432: 1) Group members line up one behind another.2) Put hands on the shoulder in front while the person behind grabs the front teammate's ankle.3) The front runner does not have their ankle held and leads the group.4) Hop together on one foot across a set distance (about 15 meters) without releasing any ankles.5) The team whose entire line crosses the finish line with ankles intact wins.
pe-05433: 1) Two players pair up and face each other.2) Tap the paper ball back and forth in the air with hands while moving forward.3) Go around the turning cone and return to the starting line.4) Stay composed and pass the ball steadily to the next pair without rushing.
pe-05434: 1) Start by placing the same-side arm and leg forward in a running stance.2) Switch feet forward and backward four times to the count while simultaneously pumping arms.3) Raise the arm high on the fourth count to complete one full rep.4) Shout a loud cue and repeat for 10 to 20 reps as a warm-up.
pe-05435: 1) Arrange cones with increasing distances from number 1 to 6.2) Throw rings from behind the start line to hoop and knock down cones in order.3) The player who knocks down all 6 cones first wins the game.
pe-05436: 1) Hold colored gonggi pieces hidden in hand and meet a partner.2) Play foot rock-paper-scissors to determine who takes the lead.3) The winner guesses the opponent's color by saying "Surely it's not (color)?".4) If correct, take the piece, and whoever collects the most pieces within the time limit wins.
pe-05437: 1) Squat all the way down on the signal, curling your body as small as possible.2) Explode upward jumping into the air while stretching both arms overhead like a rocket.3) Repeat jumping to the teacher's whistle or count.
pe-05438: 1) Two players each wear a cone on one arm to resemble Captain Hook's hook.2) Take turns tossing a ring while the partner catches it onto their arm cone.3) The team that scores the most points in the set time or reaches the target score first wins.
pe-05439: 1) Flip a toilet paper roll in the air so it completes a rotation and lands upright.2) After succeeding, flip a second toilet paper roll onto the first to build tier two.3) Flip a third roll on top of the second to complete a 3-tier tower.
pe-05440: 1) When tagged by the tagger, freeze into a designated pose such as skiing, ballet, or weightlifting.2) A teammate can unfreeze the tagged player by matching and holding the exact same pose.3) The freed player resumes running, and the game continues for the designated time.
pe-05441: 1) Face your partner, put on the new-glove mitts, and prepare two balls.2) One player rolls ground balls along the floor while the other catches with the mitt and returns them.3) Toss high fly balls into the air for the partner to catch.4) Use spot markers as bases to practice catching while stepping on the base.
pe-05442: 1) Three players play rock-paper-scissors to designate one director and two runners.2) When the director points a hand in a direction, runners run around the cone located in that direction.3) The runner who returns and touches the director's hand first wins, and they take turns rotating roles.
pe-05443: 1) Place newspaper sticks and cups on the desk and face each other.2) Play rock-paper-scissors; the winner attacks the opponent's cup with the stick while the loser defends their cup.3) The player who executes attack or defense correctly and faster wins.
pe-05444: 1) Place two high jump mats together and set up a table tennis fence across the middle as a net.2) Two teams (two players each) hit a gym ball over the barrier onto the opponent's mat.3) If a team fails to return the ball or hits it out of bounds, they lose a point.
pe-05445: 1) Choose two angel taggers through rock-paper-scissors.2) Angels cannot be tagged or eliminated.3) Players tagged by an angel must freeze with their legs spread wide.4) A teammate can rescue a frozen player by circling around their legs three times to sharpen the pencil.
pe-05446: 1) Prepare a 16-space (4x4) bingo card.2) Roll the dice to check the rolled number.3) Perform an assigned exercise before marking the corresponding square.4) Mark the square with a circle after completing the exercise, and win by completing an X-shaped bingo line.
pe-05447: 1) Prepare a roll of toilet paper.2) Practice continuous volleyball underhand tosses by bumping the toilet paper upward into the air.3) Finish the volley by hitting a strong spike.
pe-05448: 1) Instead of passing in stationary pairs, pass the ball and immediately run to the back of the opposite line.2) Continuously sprint across even if the number of players on each side differs.3) Rotate repeatedly upon reaching the end of the line to practice passing with various peers.
pe-05449: 1) Choose a hunter tagger while the other players run and evade.2) Players tagged by the hunter must kneel down on the floor to become turtles.3) An animal protector player places a large scarf over the turtle's back to rescue them.4) Rescued players take over the role of animal protector to rescue other captured turtles.
pe-05450: 1) Determine attacking and defending teams through rock-paper-scissors.2) The attacking team writes numbers consecutively from 1 toward 100 on the board.3) The defending team rolls the dice dodgeball, and if a 2 or 6 appears, calls out 'Fighter' to stop the attack.4) Teams switch roles, and the first team to complete numbers up to 100 and shout 'Finished' wins.
pe-05451: 1) Listen carefully to the teacher's verbal cues (Sea, Island, River, Mountain).2) Jump forward on 'Sea', and jump back to the original spot on 'Island'.3) Jump backward on 'River', and jump straight up in place on 'Mountain'.4) If a player makes a mistake, they give up a wristband while continuing to participate until the end.
pe-05452: 1) Place the ball behind the service line and flick it with your finger into the opponent's court.2) The opposing team must return the ball within three hits using finger flicks.3) An attack that lands in the spike zone results in a point for the attacking team.4) On the opponent's third hit, the defending team may place a blocking lid on the net, scoring a point if the ball contacts the lid.
pe-05453: 1) Cross and squeeze your forearms together like a pair of scissors.2) Trap a ping-pong ball between your arms without using your hands to carry it.3) Drop the ping-pong balls into your team's egg carton to see who transfers the most.
pe-05454: 1) Players prepare at the starting line holding a long balloon stick.2) On signal, release and throw the balloon forward as far as possible.3) Measure the distance flown, and the player whose balloon travels furthest wins.
pe-05455: 1) Two partners stand side-by-side and place a fun stick across the insteps of their inside feet.2) Balance with outside legs, hold inside hands, and walk forward in sync.3) If the foam stick falls off, place it back on the feet immediately at that spot before resuming toward the turning point.
pe-05456: 1) Randomly shuffle numbered cones (numbers 1 to 6 in 6 colors) with your partner and swap them.2) Keep both hands on your head without looking at the numbers on the cones while waiting for the start signal.3) On the signal, the player who arranges the cones with number 1 at the bottom and number 6 at the top first wins.
pe-05457: 1) Pair up with someone and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The loser cheers the winner's name three times and gives a high five.3) Move on to meet new partners and be the first to reach the goal of having your name cheered to high-five the teacher.
pe-05458: 1) Place tokens such as 'One More', 'Bomb', '+2 Points', and '+3 Points' (about 2 each) into egg carton slots.2) Decide turn order by rock-paper-scissors and take turns clockwise bouncing a ping-pong ball into the egg carton.3) Check the token where the ball lands to earn points; bombs give 0 points, and 'One More' awards 1 point plus an extra throw.4) If the ball lands in an empty slot without a token, leave the ball there to count as 1 point, then sum all points to determine the winner.
pe-05459: 1) Stack one speed stacking cup on top of an upside-down cup and divide into the Yolk team and White team.2) Place the cup on the desk and flip it using wrist rotation to land it upside down.3) Once successful, move to the next teammate's desk and take turns flipping and transferring the cup.4) If the cup falls to the floor, retry from that spot; the team that finishes first wins.
pe-05460: 1) Two players face each other or the entire class forms a circle.2) Place one open palm facing up under the partner's thumb, and place your other thumb upright on the other person's palm.3) The leader chants and calls "Catch!" at which point the open hand tries to grab the thumb while the thumb tries to pull away and escape.4) If a player grabs or dodges on false words like "Japchae" or "Japdongsan", they lose a point.
pe-05461: 1) Face a partner and hold both hands2) Lift the leg on the same side and step through with the opposite leg while rotating the body3) Relax your arms and turn smoothly to stand up together
pe-05462: 1) Stand back-to-back with a partner with feet close together2) Lean against each other's backs and gradually walk feet forward to form the shape of the character 'In' (人)
pe-05463: 1) Two partners hold hands and rotate facing each other in place2) One person stays at the center while the other orbits around like a planet3) Repeat for two to three rotations and switch directions
pe-05464: 1) Students form a circle in a round formation2) Each student lifts their right foot backward, and the person behind catches their ankle to connect the chain3) Following the leader's count, everyone hops forward on their left foot to complete a full lap while maintaining the circle
pe-05465: 1) Hold the paper plate racket and tap the balloon continuously using one hand.2) Switch hands or alternate hands while keeping the balloon in the air.3) Alternate between forehand and backhand sides of the racket, or complete missions like turning a full circle or touching the floor before tapping again.
pe-05466: 1) Move around the space and high-five classmates when meeting them.2) Practice locomotor movements starting with walking and jogging.3) Learn hopping on one foot and jumping with two feet in sequence.
pe-05467: 1) The runner from each team runs toward the opposing team's captain.2) Guess whether the number of Gonggi stones held in the captain's hand is odd or even.3) If correct, run back to tag the next runner; if wrong, say "I'm sorry" and "It's okay" before retrying or tagging.
pe-05468: 1) Two players face each other with 12 stacking cups.2) On the start signal, players take turns stacking the cups one by one in an agreed order.3) Once all cups are upstacked, the partners high-five.4) They take turns downstacking the cups back to the original position, high-five again, and raise their hands to finish.
pe-05469: 1) Practice with one ball for 2 to 3 minutes by scooping it up to head height and catching it with the opposite hand.2) For two balls, throw the second ball upward from the inside when the first ball reaches its peak.3) Keep your hands below to catch the first ball and then the second ball without circling them.4) Chant 'one, two, three, four' out loud to maintain proper throwing rhythm and catches.
pe-05470: 1) Players stand at spot markers positioned in a square layout.2) Pass the ball to a teammate and sprint along the outside to fill the next marker position.3) Continue passing and running until all players return to their original spots.
pe-05471: 1) Set up cones inside a hula hoop and stand at a designated distance.2) Kick the ball with feet instead of rolling by hand to hit the cones inside the hoop.3) Count points based on the knocked-down cones.
pe-05472: 1) Two players face each other and extend both hands simultaneously in the shape of pistols.2) The player who correctly calls out the sum of the fingers first wins.3) The player who calls out an incorrect answer first loses and must do jumping jacks before raising a hand to find a new partner.
pe-05473: 1) Set up five bowling pins on each side and face each other in two teams.2) On signal, both teams simultaneously roll balls to knock down the opponent's pins.3) Players must retrieve their own rolled balls, and the team that knocks down all five opponent pins first wins.
pe-05474: 1) Assign positions from 1st to 5th by rock-paper-scissors: batter, catcher, pitcher, infielder, and outfielder.2) The batter hits the ball and runs bases to score points without any outs.3) Fielders must pass the ball through every player to the catcher, and everyone rotates positions after each hit.
pe-05475: 1) In pairs on offense, one teammate tosses the ball up and the batter hits it with a fist or palm.2) Both players run around designated 1-point or 2-point cones and score points if both return safely.3) A caught fly ball or being tagged out before returning counts as an out, and teams switch roles after 3 outs.
pe-05476: 1) Place a hula hoop on your head like a crown and stand at the start line.2) Walk to the cone without using hands and bend down to place the hoop over the cone.3) If the hoop lands successfully on the cone, claim the cone; the first to collect 3 cones wins.
pe-05477: 1) Two players face each other holding a plank posture.2) Set up cones on each side to create small goal areas with a ball in the middle.3) Support the body with one hand and tap the ball into the opponent's goal.4) Score 1 point whenever the ball passes between the opponent's cones.
pe-05478: 1) Team members line up at the starting line.2) Runner 1 holds a ring, runs around the turning point, and returns.3) Runner 1 connects rings with runner 2 and they run together around the turn.4) Add one runner each lap until the final runner finishes the run.
pe-05479: 1) Prepare an egg carton and table tennis balls, and line up in groups.2) The runner moves or bounces the table tennis balls across the egg carton cups.3) Advance balls across two or three rows at once.4) Reach the end of the carton and hand over the turn to the next runner.
pe-05480: 1) Chant "Papaya, Papaya" and match movements with a partner.2) Play rock-paper-scissors against each other.3) If you win, evolve to the next stage (egg, frog, fish, ballerina/ballerino); if you lose, return to stage 1.
pe-05481: 1) Place rolls of tissue on the floor in four directions: front, back, left, and right.2) Stand in the center and lift one leg to balance.3) Pick up each roll of tissue one by one and stack them on the palm without letting the lifted foot touch the floor.
pe-05482: 1) Place two rolls of toilet paper on either side and stand in the middle.2) Pick up one toilet paper roll, perform a full turn, and place it back on the floor.3) Move to the other roll, pick it up, turn, place it down, and repeat the movement back and forth within the time limit.
pe-05483: 1) Place a scarf on top of your head and get ready.2) On the signal, jump up in place to launch the scarf off your head into the air.3) Catch the falling scarf with your hands and count the total number of successful catches.
pe-05484: 1) Start by launching two balloons into the air simultaneously.2) Keep hitting the balloons with any part of your body to prevent them from touching the floor.3) The player whose balloon touches the ground first loses, and the person who keeps them airborne longest wins.
pe-05485: 1) Form groups and have two players throw the balls simultaneously.2) Catching a standard ball gives 1 point, but dropping or missing a catch results in a 2-point penalty.3) Catching a red ball adds 4 points, while catching a yellow ball is essential to keep the team score low.4) After several rounds of throwing and catching, the team with the lowest total score wins the game.
pe-05486: 1) Divide into teams or groups and determine the starting order through rock-paper-scissors.2) Jump twice in place and show rock, paper, or scissors along with a cute gesture.3) Only the person who loses performs the cute rock-paper-scissors action, scoring points.4) Players compete in turn, and the team with the higher score wins.
pe-05487: 1) Three students form a team and rest their left ankles on each other's thighs to make a triangle.2) Jump in place together while supporting one another.3) Rotate clockwise for 8 beats to music and release legs simultaneously.
pe-05488: 1) Two teams line up outside a square formation.2) On signal, both teams start passing the ball simultaneously along the square perimeter.3) The team that passes continuously to overtake the other team's runner or completes all passes first wins.
pe-05489: 1) Place two spot markers about 1 meter apart facing your partner.2) If the partner catches the thrown ball, move the front spot marker backward within reach and switch spots.3) If the ball is dropped, switch spots without moving the spot marker and retry at the same distance.
pe-05490: 1) Each player takes two speed hoops and starts standing inside one hoop.2) Move forward by alternating and connecting the two hoops step by step.3) Pick up the mini spot markers (treasure) placed in the center and return home, and the player with the most treasure wins.
pe-05491: 1) Face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The loser must run to touch the wall (or endline) and return.3) If there is a tie, both players must immediately run to touch their respective walls (lines) and return.
pe-05492: 1) The tagger must move only by jumping and try to tag other players.2) Players touched by the playstick or tagger's body must leave the court.3) Tagged players step on spot markers 4 times in the recharge area outside before returning to the game.
pe-05493: 1) Teams face each other across a net and strike a balloon ball with their hands to hit it over2) Players can hit the ball directly in the air or let it bounce once before striking3) Teams pass the ball up to three times among teammates before sending it back to the opponent's court
pe-05494: 1) Follow the rock-paper-scissors dynamic where Tiger beats Hunter, Hunter beats Nobleman, and Nobleman beats Tiger2) Each team secretly discusses and agrees on one motion among Tiger (Roar), Hunter (Bang), or Nobleman (Ahem)3) On cue, both teams show their chosen gesture simultaneously, and the winning gesture takes the round
pe-05495: 1) Select one tagger while other players dribble their own soccer balls.2) Players must dodge both the tagger and the ball kicked by the tagger while dribbling.3) If hit by the tagger's ball/body or stepping out of bounds, go to the sideline, perform 3 toe taps on the ball, and re-enter.
pe-05496: 1) Form an elephant trunk with your arm and spin around 3 to 5 times.2) Run forward toward the cone and place the dice on top of it.3) The player who successfully places the dice on the cone first without it falling wins.
pe-05497: 1) Stand in a circle and pass the ball to a teammate.2) The passer immediately moves and runs behind an adjacent teammate.3) Receive the next pass while continuously moving through the spaces between teammates.
pe-05498: 1) Sit on the floor in a crab walk position.2) Kick the balloon with feet and drive it toward the designated location.3) Transport all designated number of balloons (3) to the target.
pe-05499: 1) Arrange 5 hoops on the floor in the shape of Olympic rings.2) Take turns rolling a ball from a designated distance.3) If the ball stops inside a hoop, the player claims that hoop.4) The player who collects 3 out of 5 hoops first wins.
pe-05500: 1) Pair up and face each other.2) Move around the space while protecting your own knees and trying to touch your partner's knees.3) When the teacher calls 'Hands Up', raise both hands above the head and lower them on cue to resume tagging.
pe-05501: 1) Two players face each other and perform the Kongji Patji movement where one player piggybacks the other.2) The rider rotates their body 180 degrees while supported on the back and turns over.3) Alternate carrying and turning over while advancing forward to the designated target point.
pe-05502: 1) Slide 10 beanbags across the floor to hit the feet of the opposing team.2) Players holding a beanbag cannot travel and may only pivot on the spot.3) When hit, perform 3 jumping jacks, awarding the thrower's team 1 point; catching a sliding beanbag counts as being hit.
pe-05503: 1) Place and set an upside-down cup on the desk.2) Blow air with your mouth to make the cup stay on the desk as long as possible.3) The person who keeps it on the desk longer wins.
pe-05504: 1) Lay out hula hoops in a straight line on the ground to form a hopping path.2) The hopper jumps with both feet inside each hoop progressing forward.3) The partner quickly picks up the cleared rear hoops and places them consecutively in front.4) Advance to the turning point, then switch roles or complete the team relay.
pe-05505: 1) Wiggle the index finger and follow the earthworm rhythm and movements led by the teacher.2) Increase the scale by undulating the hands and wrists into snake movements.3) Expand further by waving both entire arms dynamically like an imugi serpent.4) Conclude with maximum body movement, jumping and shaking like an ascending dragon.
pe-05506: 1) Secretly conceal either a soccer-patterned or volleyball-patterned beanbag behind your back.2) Roam around to meet a partner and play foot rock-paper-scissors.3) The winner guesses which sports beanbag the loser is hiding in their hands.4) If guessed correctly, claim the beanbag; the loser restocks or switches beanbags to continue.
pe-05507: 1) Form pairs facing each other with one partner bending over to form an obstacle.2) The active partner runs one full loop around their teammate.3) Leap vault over the partner's bent back (Over).4) Crawl through underneath the partner's spread legs to complete the pass (Under).
pe-05508: 1) Each team sets their hand marker at the starting rocket line and prepares for a rock-paper-scissors duel.2) Players play rock-paper-scissors one-on-one against the opposing team.3) The winner moves the hand marker forward one step, while the loser completes two jumping jacks and steps back; the first team to reach the moon wins.
pe-05509: 1) Two turners stand slightly wider than shoulder-width apart holding two long ropes taut.2) One person starts turning the two ropes inward with a half-turn interval, and the other partner catches the rhythm to turn together.3) Keep the upper arm still and use the forearms and wrists to turn ropes so they strike the floor without crossing the body's midline.
pe-05510: 1) Two or more players gather, raise one hand, and get ready to jump.2) Lightly jump in place while chanting "Mandu, Mandu, Mandu, Mandu".3) Shout out a target number on the final beat while displaying fingers to see if the sum matches.
pe-05511: 1) The teacher claps and calls out rock-paper-scissors prompts such as "Rock, Rock, Clap, Clap".2) Students observe the teacher's hand gesture and respond one beat later with the winning move accompanied by claps.3) When the teacher varies the pattern or speed, students concentrate and respond accordingly.
pe-05512: 1) Team members line up and the first runner steps on number spots (1 to 10) in sequential order.2) The following teammates step on the numbered spots sequentially without overtaking the runner ahead.3) The timer stops when the final runner stamps the 10th spot to establish the team time record.
pe-05513: 1) Designate one or more players to be the mosquito taggers.2) Tagged players must freeze and scratch the body part where they were bitten.3) Another player can revive them by mimicking spraying medicine with hand gestures.
pe-05514: 1) Each player spreads out 4 colored numbered cones on the floor.2) On the teacher's cue, players pick up the cones in the designated sequence.3) The fastest player to stack them properly from bottom to top wins.
pe-05515: 1) Each student picks a favorite ice cream name.2) Walk around the classroom and tell classmates the chosen ice cream name.3) Exchange names with a classmate and continue moving around with the new name.4) Continue trading names with as many peers as possible within the time limit.
pe-05516: 1) Place dome cones upside down on the floor like dishes2) Dribble a basketball to bounce directly onto the dome cone to flip it over3) Collect the successfully flipped dome cone and pass the ball to the next player
pe-05517: 1) Team members stand in a circle and hold hands together2) Pass the hula hoop along the circle by slipping bodies through it without letting go of hands3) Cooperate to complete the target number of rotations around the circle within the time limit
pe-05518: 1) At the start signal, run around the cone placed behind.2) Bounce a table tennis ball into the egg carton grid.3) Run around the cone again to repeat the bounce until completing a tic-tac-toe line.
pe-05519: 1) Each team starts from a different designated starting line.2) Runners must turn around the outside of a second bowling pin placed outward to avoid colliding with waiting runners.3) Pass the baton to the next runner and rank teams by finish order.
pe-05520: 1) Prepare two rolls of toilet paper and hold one roll in one hand.2) Throw the other roll with the dominant hand to make it flip in the air.3) Land and stack it on top of the held roll to build a 2-tier or 3-tier tower.
pe-05521: 1) The thrower tosses the ring toward the partner.2) The catcher moves to catch or hook the ring.3) Score 10 points for each catch, switching roles to compete within a set time.
pe-05522: 1) Two partners hold foam sticks facing each other and spin around three times.2) On the countdown signal, they simultaneously reach out to touch the ends of their foam sticks together.3) A point is scored if the stick tips meet accurately within the given time.
pe-05523: 1) The first player of the group stands at the throwing line2) Fling a mini spot marker toward a chair or desk placed at a distance3) Score points if the marker lands securely on the chair, then tag the next teammate to take turns
pe-05524: 1) Arrange 10 numbered cups in a bowling pin formation from 1 to 10.2) Bounce table tennis balls to land them inside the cups.3) When a ball lands in a cup, remove or flip that cup over.4) The player who flips or removes all 10 cups first wins.
pe-05525: 1) Mark the starting line with two paper cups, and place cups representing difficulty stages next to the plastic bottle target.2) Kick the sock ball with the inside of the foot from the start line to hit the target bottle.3) Upon success, move back to the next stage marker and shoot from an increased distance.4) Try to knock down the target through all 4 stages within the time limit.
pe-05526: 1) Two teams face each other with cones arranged in mismatched color orders.2) On signal, run forward to observe the opponent's cone color arrangement.3) Place a matching colored beanbag on top of the corresponding cone.4) Knock down the matched cones to mark completion, and the team that matches all cones first wins.
pe-05527: 1) One team member holds a hula hoop upright.2) The other two teammates hit a balloon to pass it through the hula hoop.3) After the balloon passes through, both teammates move their bodies through the hoop as well.4) Continue keeping the balloon in the air, repeating passes to score the highest points within the time limit.
pe-05528: 1) Select taggers and provide each tagger with a large die.2) The tagger chases other students to tag them.3) The tagged student rolls the die on the spot and performs the physical exercise (burpees) equal to the number rolled.4) The student who finishes the exercise becomes the new tagger, and the person holding the die when the teacher calls stop receives a penalty.
pe-05529: 1) Teams face each other across a net holding a stacking cup in each hand.2) Do not hit the ball directly; catch the ball completely with the cups as it falls from above.3) After catching, throw the ball to attack, allowing up to two passes among teammates.
pe-05530: 1) Fold paper to make a returning boomerang paper airplane.2) Throw the airplane so that it curves and circles back to you.3) Challenge yourself to catch the returning airplane with your opposite hand.
pe-05531: 1) Crumple an A4 paper and unfold it, then place it on your head.2) Move close to your opponent and blow your breath to knock down their paper.3) If your paper falls off your head, you are eliminated or must sit down.4) Teammates can place the paper back on each other or designate a queen bee for team play.
pe-05532: 1) Choose an exercise movement, such as squats, to target a specific muscle group.2) Spin a hula hoop on the floor like a top.3) Perform the chosen exercise as many times as possible until the hoop completely stops.4) The person who completes the highest number of repetitions wins.
pe-05534: 1) Inhale through a straw to hold a table tennis ball by suction without dropping it.2) Release both hands and the player who maintains suction longer wins.
pe-05536: 1) The witch rides a foam stick broomstick and chases players to tag them with a foam stick.2) Tagged players take two foam sticks from the hula hoop, become zombies, and join the chase.3) Runners must dodge both the witch and zombies to survive.
pe-05537: 1) Arrange hula hoops in a 3x3 bingo grid on the floor.2) Hit a yarn ball with a badminton racket into a hoop, leaving the ball where it lands.3) Run a loop and hand the racket to the next player; the team that completes a 3-in-a-row bingo first wins.
pe-05538: 1) Stand side by side with a partner, using only outer hands while keeping inner hands inactive.2) Coordinate timing together to throw and catch juggling balls on the count of '1, 2, 3, 4'.3) Increase the distance slightly and practice tossing gently with staggered timing so the ball lands smoothly in the partner's hand.
pe-05539: 1) Two players face each other doing sit-ups, passing a ball back and forth each time they rise.2) Players rise simultaneously during sit-ups to play rock-paper-scissors, with the loser completing extra movements.3) In a push-up position, players face each other to high-five or play rock-paper-scissors with one hand.
pe-05540: 1) Throw the tail ball up into the air and try to catch the falling ribbon tail.2) Award differential points depending on where you catch it, from 1 point near the ball up to 4 points near the ribbon tip.3) Face a partner and throw the tail ball so the partner can practice catching the tail section.
pe-05541: 1) Roll two dice simultaneously: one for color and one for movement numbers.2) The color die determines which colored track to advance, and the number die determines advancing 1 to 2 spaces.3) Upon landing on the designated space, perform the assigned fitness task (such as squats) for the required repetitions.
pe-05542: 1) The team leader stands on the opposite side hiding a beanbag in one hand.2) A runner sprints forward and guesses which hand holds the beanbag.3) If correct, the runner rounds the leader and returns to sit down; if wrong, the runner does a penalty with the leader before returning.
pe-05543: 1) Hit the ball with a palm or fist.2) The opposing player catches the ball while stepping on a spot marker to earn it.3) Switch turns after each hit, and calculate rankings by adding up the numbers on collected spot markers.
pe-05544: 1) Stand in gymnastics formation and jump forward on 12 o'clock, backward on 6, right on 3 (Sun), and left on 9 (Moon).2) Make a 360-degree turn on Star and a 180-degree turn on About-Face.3) Because Sun and Moon represent absolute directions, players must jump toward the original direction even after turning around.
pe-05545: 1) Kings and vassals pair up, roam the area, and compete in rock-paper-scissors when kings meet.2) Players must let go of each other's hands when playing rock-paper-scissors.3) Two players from the losing team switch places to become the new king and vassal of the opposing team.
pe-05546: 1) At the start signal, dash forward, bow, and drop rings onto the first two cones.2) Approach the end King Cone, lower your posture, shout 'Your Majesty!', and place the ring over it.3) The player who correctly shows respect and crowns the King Cone first wins the round.
pe-05547: 1) Face a partner and have one player bounce the ball underhand in an arcing trajectory.2) The opposing player judges the landing spot and jumps at the right moment so the ball passes between their legs without catching it.3) Catch the rebounded ball and pass it back to continue the drill.
pe-05548: 1) The leader of the group designated by the teacher raises their right hand and shouts 'Standard', and the others echo.2) On the double-arm distance signal, spread out quickly without touching adjacent peers, then assemble swiftly.3) On the single-arm distance signal, raise one arm to align spacing with the shoulders of peers in front and aside.4) Form a wide circle or a tighter circle with touching elbows according to the teacher's whistle signals.
pe-05549: 1) Fill a basket on the teacher's desk with small stones.2) Move around the classroom to meet peers one-on-one and play rock-paper-scissors followed by Muk-Jji-Bba.3) The winner of each Muk-Jji-Bba match goes to the teacher's desk to take one stone.4) The player who collects the most stones within the given time limit wins the game.
pe-05550: 1) Hold 2 beanbags in one hand and 1 in the other, then toss them alternately in an arc in order 1, 2, and 3.2) Count numbers aloud while practicing catching the tossed beanbags stably without dropping them.3) Face a partner and practice exchanging beanbags using inside hands while keeping outside hands ready to sustain a 3-bag pattern.
pe-05551: 1) Pair up and play rock-paper-scissors; the winner becomes the King and the loser becomes the Servant.2) The Servant holds the King's hand respectfully and escorts the King to find another King.3) When two Kings meet, they face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.4) The losing King either becomes a servant to the winner or switches roles to continue playing.
pe-05552: 1) Place treasure such as candies on a mat and set up spot markers at a distance.2) Move forward by stepping on the spot markers one by one upon the signal.3) The team that reaches and claims the treasure on the mat first wins it.
pe-05553: 1) Play rock-paper-scissors with a partner.2) The winner decides who hides the piece in which hand.3) Move around while guessing which hand holds the piece.
pe-05554: 1) The teacher demonstrates a movement first.2) Students follow that movement one beat behind.3) Continue connecting the movements in time with the counts.
pe-05555: 1) Players stand on opposite sides of a net holding a gym ball.2) Use the held gym ball as if it were a foot to hit the ball after it bounces.3) Return the ball directly or pass and send it over the net within 3 hits.
pe-05556: 1) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.2) In the standard version, players immediately call out 'I won' or 'I lost' and show the sign with their hands.3) In the reverse version, the winner shouts 'I lost' and the loser shouts 'I won' while displaying the sign.4) The player who reacts slower or makes an incorrect call loses the round.
pe-05557: 1) Players learn three actions: a bear gesture, a salmon wiggling action, and a mosquito buzzing motion.2) Follow the triangular hierarchy: Bear beats Salmon, Salmon beats Mosquito, and Mosquito beats Bear.3) On the count of three, players simultaneously strike one of the three animal poses.4) The player who wins according to the match-up hierarchy scores a point, playing best 2 out of 3.
pe-05558: 1) Set up a net in the classroom and scatter spot markers across the floors of both sides.2) When the game starts, pick up spot markers from your own team area and toss them over the net.3) Players must pick up and toss only one spot marker at a time.4) The team with fewer markers remaining on their side when time expires wins the game.
pe-05559: 1) Players stand on floor markers, and the tagger calls out one of eight basic steps followed by 'Change Room'.2) All players must move using the announced step to claim a spot, while the tagger also tries to occupy one.3) The player left without a spot does two jumping jacks and becomes the new tagger for the next round.4) If players step on a spot at the same time, they resolve it with rock-paper-scissors.
pe-05560: 1) Set up 10 paper cups in a line on a desk.2) Blow air into a balloon for 10 seconds after the start signal.3) Release the balloon opening to knock down the paper cups sequentially using the released air.4) The next teammate takes a turn, and the team that knocks down the most cups wins.
pe-05561: 1) When about to be tagged by the chaser, freeze in either a 'Sky' or 'Earth' pose.2) A player in the 'Sky' pose is freed when a teammate jumps or climbs over them.3) A player in the 'Earth' pose is freed when a teammate crawls underneath them.4) When the teacher calls stop, count how many players remained untagged to see if the group met the goal.
pe-05562: 1) For the forehand throw, grip the front edge of the disc with your fingers and snap your wrist forward.2) The receiver catches the disc using a two-handed sandwich catch.3) For the overhook throw, hold the disc vertically and launch it upward into the air.
pe-05563: 1) The tagger chases after runners and gently tags them.2) Once tagged, players sit down and position their arms together to imitate a hot dog.3) Another runner can rescue them by pretending to squeeze ketchup over them and shouting 'ketchup', after which the rescued player says 'thank you' and rejoins the game.
pe-05564: 1) The tagger chases runners and tags them to freeze them in place like mannequins.2) Two free runners must run over and encircle the frozen player by holding hands around them.3) Once encircled by the two players, the frozen player is freed and can run again.
pe-05565: 1) The tagger walks around holding a soccer ball and tries to touch runners with the ball or head it toward them.2) Players who are hit by the ball are out and must leave the playing area.3) Eliminated players must perform three consecutive heading catches outside the court before returning to the game.
pe-05566: 1) Two players face each other, play rock-paper-scissors, and the winner plays Cham-Cham-Cham (left and right directions only).2) The player who succeeds in Cham-Cham-Cham takes one colored gonggi stone of their choice from the floor.3) Players take turns playing, and whoever is first to collect a rainbow set of five different colors wins.
pe-05567: 1) One referee holds a team pinnie in the middle, and cones are placed on both sides.2) Two players start at the cones and choose to either snatch the bib or chase and tag the opponent.3) A player scores by grabbing the bib and escaping or by tagging the opponent before they escape.4) The game is played in a best-of-three format; the winner becomes the referee and the loser plays against the next person.
pe-05568: 1) Turn a cone upside down and place a soft foam ball on top to represent a torch.2) Hold the middle or bottom of the cone and run around the turning point.3) Hand over the cone and ball to the next runner upon returning.4) The team whose runners all finish and return first wins.
pe-05569: 1) Balance a roll of toilet paper directly on top of your head.2) Slowly sit down with your hips touching the floor without dropping the paper roll.3) Lean back at roughly a 45-degree angle, then sit back up while maintaining balance.4) Slowly stand back up without jolting your head.5) For a greater challenge, place a roll on each hand as well and perform the challenge without using hands on the floor.
pe-05570: 1) Stand back-to-back with a partner, then separate about 3 to 4 meters apart facing opposite directions.2) On start, turn around and toss your balls simultaneously toward each other.3) Catch the partner's incoming ball smoothly without dropping it.4) Once mastered, clap twice immediately after tossing before catching the partner's ball.5) Gradually increase the challenge by clapping 3 times or 4 times before catching.
pe-05571: 1) Place a hula hoop on the floor and put table tennis balls for each team inside.2) Stand behind spot markers and take turns throwing or rolling balls toward the opponent's balls.3) The team that knocks all of the opponent's balls out of the hoop first wins.
pe-05572: 1) Each team member takes turns trying the bottle flip mission.2) When successful, throw the flying disc at the target bottle.3) The team that knocks down the bottle wins.
pe-05573: 1) Four players each place 7 beanbags at their base.2) On signal, run to retrieve beanbags of different colors.3) The first player to collect three differently colored beanbags wins.
pe-05574: 1) Two players face each other across an agility ladder and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The winner becomes Tom (tagger) and the loser becomes Jerry (runner).3) Jerry flees toward the classroom door while Tom tries to tag Jerry before escaping.
pe-05575: 1) Pair up with each player holding a paper or stacking cup.2) One player bounces a table tennis ball on the floor toward the partner.3) The partner catches the bouncing ball inside their cup to sustain rallies.
pe-05576: 1) Place a sheet of newspaper against your chest and run with arms spread wide so it does not fall.2) Release your hands upon starting and run around the cone to hand it off to the next runner.3) Players must not hold onto the paper with hands while running.
pe-05577: 1) When the teacher calls "Kung Fu", students turn around shouting "Panda" with a designated pose.2) Snake is scissors (strike forward), Master is rock (fist wrapped in palm), and Crane is paper (spread arms wide).3) Follow standard rock-paper-scissors rules; in a tie, the player with the cooler martial arts pose wins.
pe-05578: 1) Two teams of three players use volleyball overhead passes to shoot toward a basketball hoop2) If the shot misses, shoot again with an overhead pass directly from where the ball landed3) A score is awarded if the ball goes in or hits the rim or the square on the backboard
pe-05579: 1) The first runner stays at the starting line and lies face down on the floor2) The next runner steps out and lies down while holding the ankles of the person in front3) Once connected, the rear runner gets up and runs to the front to extend the chain across the finish line
pe-05580: 1) Move around kicking or stepping on beanbags on the floor.2) Kick a beanbag to hit another player's foot; players who get hit must step outside the court.3) Players outside can rejoin the game after completing a designated exercise like squats or jumping jacks.
pe-05581: 1) Set up scoring zones marked with points such as 2, 3, and 5 points on the floor.2) Take turns throwing the tail ball as far as possible toward the target zones.3) Check where the tail ball lands to score points; the player with the furthest throw or highest points wins.
pe-05582: 1) Stand on one leg with a partner.2) Play rock-paper-scissors.3) The loser lowers their stance noticeably from their current position.4) The person who loses balance first loses the game.
pe-05583: 1) Take a ready stance in front of the mat.2) Perform a forward roll across the mat.3) Pick up one beanbag from the target area and carry it back to the start.4) Be the first to move all 10 beanbags or complete the goal.
pe-05584: 1) Place a cup slightly hanging over the edge of the desk.2) Flick the bottom of the cup with a finger to flip and land it upright.3) Play as a competition, a class relay, or an individual attempt challenge.
pe-05585: 1) Thread a paper cup with a hole through a string and tie both ends to posts or desks.2) On the start signal, blow air with your mouth to push the cup along the string.3) The first player to push the paper cup to the opposite end wins.
pe-05586: 1) Assemble a cake by placing a saucer cone on a gym ball and a ball on top of the cone.2) On the start signal, carry the assembled cake and run around the turning cone.3) Relay back while keeping the cake from collapsing and pass it to the next runner.
pe-05587: 1) Set up two tables and get ready at the starting line holding a ball.2) On the start signal, sprint back to step on the spot marker and return.3) Roll the ball after returning, and the player who puts it into the table hole first scores 1 point.
pe-05588: 1) Inflate the paper ball by mouth and move forward while striking and bouncing it with your hands.2) Go around the turning point marker or standing person and return to the starting line.3) Keep hitting the ball without dropping it to the floor and hand off to the next runner.
pe-05589: 1) Team members stand in a line and reach their right hands back through their legs to grasp the next person's hand.2) Without letting go, players lie down starting from the back to pass over and shed the skin.3) After everyone lies down, get back up in sequence from the front to return to the original position.
pe-05590: 1) Play rock-paper-scissors with a partner; the winner becomes the attacker.2) Both players jump twice and choose to either sit or stay standing.3) The attacker calls out a number: zero, one, or two.4) If the count of sitting players matches the called number, the attacker scores.5) If defended, turns switch; first to reach 3 points wins and finds a new partner.
pe-05591: 1) Face each other and clap knees then hands to the rhythm of the song.2) Play rock-paper-scissors at the end of each phrase.3) The winner fires a two-handed air blast.4) The loser jumps backward as if blown away, and both take a defensive stance during a tie.
pe-05592: 1) Teammates stand in a straight line with legs apart forming a tunnel.2) The first runner runs around the turning point and crawls through the legs of teammates.3) Once through, the runner joins the end and the next runner proceeds.4) The team whose members all complete the relay first wins.
pe-05593: 1) Form a group of three where one person tosses the balloon and the other two hold soft flying discs2) The player with the balloon tosses it up from the spot marker and steps aside3) The two players rush forward and throw their discs, and whoever hits the balloon first before it lands scores 1 point
pe-05594: 1) Play rock-paper-scissors facing each other.2) The winner chases to tag the loser with a foam stick, while the loser flees to safety zones.3) When the teacher blows the whistle, their roles suddenly switch.
pe-05595: 1) Stand up when the teacher says 'Up', and sit down when 'Down'.2) Run in place when the teacher says 'Go', and freeze when 'Stop'.3) When accustomed, perform opposite actions or replace standing/sitting with raising/lowering hands.
pe-05596: 1) Face your partner and bounce a well-bouncing ball onto the spot marker on the floor.2) Catch your partner's bounced ball instead of your own.3) If the ball strays, adjust and bounce it in place again.
pe-05597: 1) Team members enter the turning long rope one by one until 4 members are jumping together.2) Once all four are inside, the first person starts taking off their vest while jumping.3) The timer stops when the fourth person finishes taking off their vest, setting the team record.
pe-05598: 1) Toss a scarf high in the air, clap hands, and catch it.2) Toss the scarf up and touch body parts like head, shoulders, or knees before catching it.3) Perform various action missions such as touching the floor or reacting with body parts.
pe-05599: 1) When the teacher calls "McDonald's Ready!", rotate hands, move feet, and shout "Ya!".2) At the chant "McDonald's!", freeze in either the hamburger pose or the cola pose.3) Students turn their backs to the teacher to ensure fair and simultaneous action.4) Turn around to check, and any student matching the teacher's pose performs squats before rejoining.
pe-05600: 1) Participants form a circle while holding hands or resting hands on each other's shoulders.2) Everyone jumps together matching or inverting the leader's directional calls of in, out, right, and left.3) Jump forward for Apple, backward for Banana, and spin around for Orange according to continuous vocal cues.
pe-05601: 1) The first runner takes the elephant trunk posture and spins around in place for the designated number of turns.2) After spinning, maintain balance and walk forward toward the target marker on the floor.3) Accurately touch and press the target number with the tip of the elephant trunk fingers.
pe-05602: 1) Put on a tap-ball headband with the ball suspended by an elastic cord.2) Move forward without using hands, swinging the head and torso left and right to build momentum.3) Knock down the line of bowling pins using the swinging ball, then return to high-five the next runner.
pe-05603: 1) Middle grades carry the ball to a marker, dribble 3 times with each hand (6 total), pass the ball, and bring the marker back.2) Upper grades dribble from the start line, complete 10 dribbles per hand on the marker, pass, and retrieve the marker.
pe-05604: 1) Hide hands behind head and play rock-paper-scissors with the teacher.2) Students who tie do 1 squat.3) Students who win or lose do 2 squats, and those with the fewest squats at the end are praised.
pe-05605: 1) Play rock-paper-scissors in pairs with a best-of-three rule.2) The winner strikes a pose, and the loser gets behind the winner and chants the winner's name.3) Winners pair up for another best-of-three match to expand their cheering squad.
pe-05606: 1) Dribble the ball from the starting line around the cone.2) From the spot marker, bounce the ball attempting to land it on the chair seat.3) Switch roles after one attempt, and the team that successfully lands 3 balls first wins.
pe-05607: 1) The teacher and all students chant and play rock-paper-scissors together.2) Based on the result, losers do 3 squats, ties do 2 squats, and winners do 1 squat.3) Compliment and encourage students who reach a total of 10 exercises first.
pe-05608: 1) Form groups of three and take positions as batter, pitcher, and catcher.2) The batter lightly hits the ball and moves to the fielder/pitcher position.3) The pitcher fields the ball, throws it to the catcher, and moves back while the catcher becomes the next batter.
pe-05609: 1) Place a balloon between your legs and get ready.2) Juggle another balloon consecutively using your head (forehead).3) You lose if the balloon hits the floor or the balloon between your legs falls out.
pe-05610: 1) Face your partner and assign one person to throw the vest.2) Move forward while catching the thrown team vest and placing spot markers.3) Continue tossing and catching the vest without dropping it to reach the target area.
pe-05611: 1) Three players form a group and one holds a hoop acting as the remote control2) The other two players move freely in the space and pass the ball through the hoop area indicated by the holder3) When the signal sounds, players rotate the person holding and moving the hoop in the middle
pe-05612: 1) Set up cup towers on a desk using colored team cups and a black cup.2) Take turns bouncing a ping-pong ball into the cups.3) Remove your own colored cup if a ball lands in it, but return one removed cup if it lands in the opponent's cup.4) The team that removes more cups within 3 minutes or removes the final black cup first wins.
pe-05613: 1) Lay a towel (or newspaper) on the floor and set up a basket in front.2) Perform 4 consecutive side-to-side ski jumps over the towel.3) Immediately after the jumps, shoot the ball into the basket.4) Repeat for 1 minute along with music to score as many baskets as possible.
pe-05614: 1) Mark the playing area with cones; the tagger wears a blindfold and holds a fun stick.2) Runners evade the tagger while carefully balancing a ping-pong ball.3) If hit by the fun stick, stepping out of bounds, or dropping the ball, perform 2 squats before returning.4) A commentator announces the tagger's position; the last player keeping the ball safe wins.
pe-05615: 1) Prepare cones numbered 1 to 6 at the starting point2) Run one by one to stack the cones in numerical order at the target spot3) Once all 6 cones are stacked, throw a flying disc from the baseline to knock down the castle
pe-05616: 1) Tie a string to a plastic bottle, place it far away, and hold the end of the string2) Lie down on the floor and pedal your legs continuously like riding a bicycle3) Reel in the string using your hands while pedaling, and win by bringing the standing bottle all the way without knocking it over
pe-05617: 1) Hold a handmade racket created by taping an ice cream stick to a paper plate2) Toss a balloon into the air3) Hit the balloon back and forth using the paper plate racket without letting it touch the floor
pe-05618: 1) Start at Level 1 imitating a bear and play Rock-Paper-Scissors with another Level 1 peer.2) If you win, advance through Level 2 Crab, Level 3 Bat, Level 4 Fish, and Level 5 Ballerina/Ballerino.3) Losing at any stage immediately drops you back to Level 1 Bear.
pe-05619: 1) Run from the starting line and attempt a bottle flip on the spot marker.2) If the flip fails, return to the start and try again.3) Once successful, move to the chair, take off an indoor shoe, and throw it at the opponent's shoe.4) The player who successfully flips the bottle and knocks down the opponent's shoe first wins.
pe-05620: 1) Spread 4 different colored cones on the floor.2) Listen carefully to the sequence of colors called out by the teacher.3) Quickly stack the cones in the exact order announced; the fastest player wins.
pe-05621: 1) Place a beanbag on permitted body parts such as the head, shoulders, or elbows.2) Play rock-paper-scissors with opponents and place an additional beanbag on your body when you win.3) The player with the most beanbags balanced on their body when time is up wins.
pe-05622: 1) Place a balloon on top of a stacking cup and start walking or running.2) Move across without dropping it and place the balloon into the activity cup.3) If the balloon falls on the way or while placing it, return to the start and try again.
pe-05623: 1) The receiver cannot run and must pass within 3 seconds, or possession turns over2) Defenders must keep a distance of at least 3 meters (three steps)3) Scoring 1 point requires completing 3 consecutive passes among teammates (give-and-go between two players only counts up to 2 passes)4) If opposing players catch the disc simultaneously, possession remains with the throwing team
pe-05624: 1) Fill in a bingo sheet using numbers from 1 to 6 found on a dice dodgeball.2) Roll the dice dodgeball to see the resulting number.3) Mark matching numbers on the bingo sheet and perform physical exercises (such as jumping jacks) corresponding to that number.4) The first student to complete two bingo lines wins.
pe-05625: 1) Place an egg carton in the center and stand in four directions with ping pong balls.2) On the start signal, bounce the ping pong balls off the floor into the egg carton pockets.3) The first player to successfully align three balls in a row wins the game.
pe-05626: 1) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The winner runs forward and places a ring onto the opponent's cone to remove it.3) The first player to place rings on all three of the opponent's cones wins.
pe-05627: 1) Overlap sheets of flyer paper and tape them into flying rings.2) Stand in front of targets arranged on chairs of varying heights.3) Toss paper rings onto each chair target within a 1-minute time limit.
pe-05628: 1) The winning team of rock-paper-scissors chooses odd or even and rolls the dice first.2) The team matching the rolled number catches the ball and shouts 'Freeze', making the opponents stop.3) The ball-carrying team can pass or take up to three steps to throw and hit opponents to win wristbands.
pe-05629: 1) Rock-paper-scissors decides who chooses odd or even numbers and takes the first dice roll.2) The player matching the rolled number grabs the ball and calls 'Freeze', halting the other player.3) The thrower can take up to three steps to aim and throw; hitting awards an opponent's bracelet, but if the opponent catches the ball, the thrower gives up a bracelet instead.
pe-05630: 1) Place a marker at the start line in the middle of the ladder diagram and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The winner rolls the exercise die first.3) Perform the exercise shown on the die, advance the marker by that count, and win by reaching the goal first or pushing the marker further into the opponent's side when time is called.
pe-05631: 1) Face a partner while one person rolls the hula hoop along the floor.2) The partner jumps into the rolling hoop, landing with both feet inside.3) Earn points for successful landings and compete to see who gets the most within the time limit.
