pe-05632: 1) Pass the ball between teammates as a runner moves across to the center.2) Upon reaching the spot, attach a ribbon tail to clothing and run back.3) Attach the tail onto the next teammate, pass the ball, and the team that collects and attaches 5 tails first wins.
pe-05633: 1) Take off indoor shoes and place them neatly on the floor.2) Form an elephant trunk with arms and spin around three times.3) Extend one foot backward to hook into and put the shoe on; if successful, you pass, but if you fail, spin three more times and retry.
pe-05634: 1) Designate 2 taggers while the rest of the players flee within a designated confined area.2) Any player tagged by a tagger must sit down on the spot and raise both hands in the air.3) An untagged teammate rescues the seated player by taking their hand, allowing them to re-enter the game.
pe-05635: 1) Divide into two teams, with each team captain standing in front of the opposing team's starting line.2) On the start signal, runners dash to the opposing team's captain and play rock-paper-scissors.3) If they lose, they run back to tag the next runner in line.4) If they win, they put on a team vest and line up behind the captain; the first team where all members put on vests wins.
pe-05636: 1) Place one hula hoop on the floor, interlock two hoops on each side, and place one on top to build a hoop castle.2) Crawl carefully through the center of the hoop castle without collapsing it.3) Place jump ropes underneath, and have 2 to 4 students grab the ropes together to lift the castle.4) Cooperate to carry and transport the hoop castle safely to the designated destination without letting it fall apart.
pe-05637: 1) Arrange 6 to 8 classroom desks together in a line to form a ping-pong table.2) Place a divider or book/board in the center as a net and divide into teams.3) Use table tennis rackets and a soft ball to hit the ball back and forth across the desks.4) Take turns hitting the ball after it bounces to compete for points.
pe-05638: 1) Arrange number spot markers (0-9) and math symbol markers (+, -, =) on the floor.2) When the teacher calls out an addition or subtraction problem, the student jumps onto the corresponding numbers and symbols in order.3) After jumping on the equals sign (=), the student jumps to the answer marker or speaks the answer.
pe-05639: 1) Place three hula hoops in a line and throw a ball from behind the throwing line into the hoops.2) A point is awarded if the thrown ball lands inside the hoop or hits the hoop rim and stays in.3) After throwing, retrieve the ball and pass it to the next player while accumulating scores.
pe-05640: 1) Place three hula hoops in front of each team at varying distances, designated as 20, 50, and 100 points.2) Players throw flying discs from the starting line aiming to land them inside the target hoops.3) When a disc successfully lands in a hoop, the player retrieves both the disc and that hoop back to their team.4) The team with the highest accumulated hoop score at the end wins.
pe-05641: 1) Arrange numbered saucer cones (or colored cones with assigned points) on the table or floor.2) Bounce a ping-pong ball off the surface from a set distance aiming to land it into a cone hole.3) Players score the points written on the cone when the ball comes to rest inside it.4) Take turns tossing, and the player or team with the highest total score wins.
pe-05642: 1) Two runners form a pair and run forward together from the starting line.2) Both runners must dive and slide forward onto the Dofit landing mat simultaneously.3) After sliding to a stop, stand up and run back to the starting line.4) Tag the next pair of runners to continue the relay.
pe-05643: 1) Set up cones with different score values.2) Throw hoop rings and hook them onto the cones to score points.3) Sum up the points to determine the winner.
pe-05644: 1) Jump and cross over the designated obstacles.2) Throw a baseball overhand to hit the paper plates.3) After hitting the plates 3 times, throw to hit the balloons on both sides.
pe-05645: 1) Roll the dice to see the resulting number.2) Run to the matching numbered hoop and bring a beanbag back home.3) If an already cleared number is rolled, tag the hoop with a foot and return, competing to collect all beanbags first.
pe-05646: 1) Two players stand facing each other and throw the ball back and forth.2) Score a point whenever catching the thrown ball cleanly with one hand/hand catch without dropping it.3) Count points loudly and sum them up during the given time to compete.
pe-05647: 1) Set up balls placed on top of cones as targets.2) Stand behind the throwing line and throw or roll balls to knock off the targets.3) The team that knocks off all opposing target balls first wins.
pe-05648: 1) Assign two helpers per team to assist with putting on large/extra-large team pinnies.2) The runner sprints to the station where the helpers are positioned.3) Helpers dress the runner in the oversized pinny, after which the runner completes the sprint and passes to the next runner.
pe-05649: 1) Pairs take turns stacking their hands on top of each other alternately.2) Move hands continuously from bottom to top, turning hands in sequence.3) On the start signal, the pair that completes 10 hand-stacks first (or 20 for groups of4) and sits down wins.
pe-05650: 1) Stand facing a partner with each person standing on a numbered spot marker.2) Hold hands with each other and jump simultaneously to swap places onto each other's marker.3) Land with both feet firmly on the target spot marker and continue jumping continuously.
pe-05651: 1) Groups of three throw flying discs aiming to land as close as possible to the target line.2) The player whose disc lands farthest from the target line becomes the loser.3) The player with the farthest disc performs a fitness penalty such as two squats.
pe-05652: 1) Place two different colored markers face down at the turning point.2) Before the runner flips a marker, teammates waiting behind shout a color question (e.g., 'Not yellow, right?').3) If the revealed marker matches the shouted color, the runner must rerun; if it avoids that color, the runner succeeds and returns to sit.
pe-05653: 1) Prepare a flying disc in a high-ceiling gymnasium or outdoors.2) Throw the flying disc upward at an angle of about 70 to 90 degrees.3) Catch the disc yourself as it floats back down without having to run forward.
pe-05654: 1) Two partners face each other, press palms together, and push while resisting to see who moves farther back.2) Sit back-to-back on the floor and lock arms together.3) Bend knees and push against each other's backs to stand up at the same time.
pe-05655: 1) Two players play rock-paper-scissors, and the winner flees using the designated step, starting with walking.2) The loser performs two jumping jacks before chasing and tagging the runner.3) When tagged, roles reverse immediately, and players switch movement styles to skipping or jumping on the caller's cue.
pe-05656: 1) Players first attempt a bottle flip using a plastic bottle filled 1/3 with water to land it upright.2) Once the bottle flip succeeds, the player earns the chance to throw a soft flying disc.3) The player throws the soft flying disc to knock down the bottle, and the first to strike it down wins.
pe-05657: 1) Each participant holds a blue and a red fun stick (or colored paper/pencils) in each hand.2) Follow the caller's instructions (e.g., 'Blue up, red down, don't lower blue') by raising or lowering the matching stick.3) Hesitating or moving the wrong color leads to elimination.
pe-05658: 1) Pair up without holding hands, sing the 'Pongdang' song while patting knees and clapping, then play rock-paper-scissors.2) The winner turns around once with hands raised above the head, while the loser sits down in place.3) If there is a tie, both players spin around in place once.
pe-05659: 1) Three players play rock-paper-scissors to select the solo runner.2) The runner retrieves a foam ball and runs back through the designated lane between spot markers.3) The other two players throw two dodgeballs to tag the running player.4) The throwers get 1 point if they hit the runner, while the runner scores if they reach home safely.
pe-05660: 1) Set up numbered cones at a set distance.2) From the start line, kick or slide the ring across the floor with the foot to knock down the cones.3) Add up the scores displayed on the knocked-down cones.4) The first player or team to reach the target score (e.g., 100 points) wins.
pe-05661: 1) Place cups in divided stacks of six and gather them together using both hands.2) Rapidly alternate hands to merge the cups into stacks while timing with a stopwatch.3) Record individual completion times and challenge yourself to break personal records.4) Combine cup separating and cup gathering into a continuous speed challenge.
pe-05662: 1) Place ribbons or team vests around a central hoop like flower petals.2) One player from each team steps forward to play rock-paper-scissors in the center.3) The winner hops on one foot to retrieve a scarf, places it in their goal, and hops back on the other foot.4) The loser performs 5 bodyweight squats on the spot before returning to line.5) The team that collects more petals within the time limit wins.
pe-05663: 1) The teacher becomes the first zombie tagger and chases the students.2) The first tagged student contracts the zombie virus and takes on the hero role to rescue others.3) Other tagged students must walk over and sit down on designated spot markers.4) The rescuer student can revive sitting classmates by tagging up to 5 of them.5) The round ends when a few surviving students remain, praising their effort.
pe-05664: 1) Two players face each other with feet in line and touch their front toes together2) Play rock-paper-scissors, and the winner moves their front foot back behind their rear heel3) The opponent slides their front foot forward to touch toes again4) Repeat the process to widen the stance back and forth; the player maintaining balance wins
pe-05665: 1) Players hold ping pong balls and stand before an egg carton target.2) Spin the tornado tool with the wrist to launch ping pong balls into the carton pockets.3) The first player to align 3 balls in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
pe-05666: 1) The fielder stands behind an area of saucer cones, and the thrower rolls a ball along the ground.2) When the ball hits a cone and bounces irregularly, the fielder catches the bouncing ball.3) The thrower rolls 5 balls, and the fielder scores points equal to the number of successful catches before switching roles.
pe-05667: 1) Roll the dice to decide which body part to hold, such as hands, elbows, ears, head, or waist.2) Four team members hold each other's chosen body parts and enter the long jump rope together.3) Once everyone is holding the designated body part, jump the rope, and count the total jumps within the time limit.
pe-05668: 1) Stand facing each other individually or in teams.2) Blow air without using hands to push the scarf toward the opponent or keep it from falling.3) Compete only using breath without running away according to the rules.
pe-05669: 1) The first runner runs one lap and places one jumbo stack.2) When the runner returns, the next person starts and places a jumbo stack adjusting the distance.3) Once the stepping stones are set, the team that crosses them first and takes the highest jumbo stack wins.
pe-05670: 1) Wear a blindfold and spin 3 to 4 turns in place or do elephant nose spins.2) After spinning, touch the opponent's body first with the play stick to win.
pe-05671: 1) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The loser becomes a human basketball, and the winner moves while gently pressing the loser's head to dribble them.3) In the two-player team version, both players on the losing team become basketballs.
pe-05672: 1) Players place a stacking cup on their palm, walk around the turning point, and return.2) They hand the cup to the next runner, increasing to two cups as they progress.3) Increase difficulty by placing cups upside down or changing the arrangement while serving.
pe-05673: 1) Pair up in twos and take two spot markers per pair.2) As student A steps forward, student B places a marker in front.3) Student A moves forward by stepping only on the markers without touching the floor.4) Continue placing and stepping on markers alternatively toward the finish line.
pe-05674: 1) The tagger chases participants with long foam noodles to tag them.2) Participants run away to avoid being tagged.3) Tagged players must get down into a crab position.4) Players can rejoin the game by crossing hands to touch their toes twice in the crab position.
pe-05675: 1) Partners stand facing each other and exchange passes simultaneously on cue.2) One person performs a bounce pass while the partner simultaneously throws a chest pass.3) Switch passing roles after a set number of repetitions.4) Next, have one partner throw a chest pass while the other throws an overhead lob pass simultaneously.
pe-05676: 1) Two students hold opposite ends of a long jump rope.2) The rope turners sit low on the floor holding the rope down.3) Group members jump over the rope as it is positioned for them.4) The rope holders swing the rope over their heads to the front and repeat until the whole team reaches the destination.
pe-05677: 1) Team members stand in a line holding cups.2) The first runner bounces the table tennis ball into the cup to pass it backward.3) When the last runner receives it, they run around the turning point and return to place.4) If team numbers are uneven, one player goes once more.
pe-05678: 1) Players hold a hoop (UFO) and run away from the tagger.2) If tagged, the player stops and freezes in place.3) If another player touches their hoop to the tagged player's hoop, they are freed.4) Rotate taggers regularly to prevent exhaustion.
pe-05679: 1) Each player prepares one ring at their seat.2) Toss the ring upward above head height.3) Alternate catching the falling ring on the right arm and left arm.4) Count the number of successful catches within the set time to compete.
pe-05680: 1) Place toilet paper on the floor so it passes under the body.2) Move forward in a crab crawl posture.3) Return crawling in a lizard posture.4) Measure the time taken to complete the round trip.
pe-05681: 1) Practice throwing and catching a ball with a partner using scoops.2) Students struggling to catch with a scoop use a cone instead.3) Position the opening of the cone to catch the incoming ball.4) Practice catching both airborne and bouncing balls to develop ball skills.
pe-05682: 1) Set up targets using cones and hula hoops.2) Score 1 point if the beanbag lands inside the hoop, and 3 points if it goes inside the cone.3) Throw in rotation within the time limit while a teammate behind stops the beanbag with their foot to tally the score.
pe-05683: 1) Drop a roll of toilet paper from your hands.2) Kick it upward with the top of your foot.3) Catch it with your hands.4) Successfully repeat this sequence 5 times in a row.5) If you drop the roll, reset to zero and start over.
pe-05684: 1) Two players face each other, each holding a padminton racket.2) Place a beanbag on the racket face.3) Toss the beanbag toward your partner using the racket.4) The partner catches the incoming beanbag on their racket face.
pe-05685: 1) Run one lap around the circular track upon the starting signal.2) Bounce the ball off the floor into the jumbo stack cup placed in the center.3) If the ball lands inside the cup, it is a success.4) If you miss, retrieve the ball and bounce it again until it goes in.5) Award points based on the order of successful finishes while avoiding knocking down the cup.
pe-05686: 1) Stand at the starting line with a spot marker.2) Toss a team bib high forward into the air.3) Run forward and catch the bib before it hits the ground.4) Place a spot marker at the exact location where the catch was made.5) Use that marker as the new starting spot and repeat to advance as far as possible.
pe-05687: 1) Face each other across a gym mat boundary.2) Launch the Koosh ball toward the opponent's mat area using a stacking cup.3) Score points when the opponent fails to catch the ball and it lands on their mat.
pe-05688: 1) Hold both corners of a giant scarf so it flutters like a Superman cape.2) Sprint toward the turning point, letting the scarf fly in the wind as you run.3) Loop around the turning marker and pass the scarf to the next runner in the relay.
pe-05689: 1) Assign points to each colored handle (Yellow 0, Blue 1, Orange 2, Green 3, Red 4).2) The thrower calls out a specific color while tossing the catch ball.3) The catcher must grab the designated color handle to score the corresponding points.
pe-05690: 1) Wear the tap ball headband securely on your head.2) Strike the tethered ball continuously using open palms.3) Advance to using closed fists to punch the ball once accustomed.4) Challenge to achieve the highest number of consecutive hits within the time limit.
pe-05691: 1) Set up stations for pancake flipping with spot markers, racket rallying with yarn balls/shuttlecocks/balloons/dochi balls, and hand-striking indiada.2) Students freely move around stations to practice striking skills.3) Complete 5 rallies or flips at each station.4) Receive a reward such as a rubber band or stone after finishing each station challenge.
pe-05692: 1) Learn 6 movement commands (Go/Stop, Down/Jump, Punch/Kick) and follow them correctly first.2) Once familiar, switch to the reverse challenge by performing the exact opposite movement.3) Students start with 5 loop bracelets and remove one each time a mistake is made.4) The student with the most bracelets remaining at the end wins.
pe-05693: 1) Stand facing a partner with a fun stick placed between both players.2) Play rock-paper-scissors; the winner quickly strikes with the fun stick while the loser blocks.3) Full-body expressive rock-paper-scissors can also be used as a fun variation.
pe-05694: 1) Place an egg carton on a desk and stand facing each other.2) Bounce ping-pong balls on the table to land them into the egg carton slots.3) If a bounce misses, pick up the ball immediately and keep trying to fill your row.4) The player who successfully completes a row (or two rows) first scores a point.
pe-05695: 1) Set numerical values as Rock = 0, Scissors = 2, and Paper = 5.2) Two players face each other and shout 'Add up!' while revealing their hands simultaneously.3) The first player to correctly shout the sum of both players' fingers wins the round.4) The winner of a best-of-three match performs 5 jumping jacks, raises their hand, and finds another player with a raised hand to play.
pe-05696: 1) Spin a hula hoop with your hand and perform jumping jacks until the hoop comes to a complete stop.2) Toss a team vest forward and run to catch it before it hits the ground, placing it down at that spot.3) If you fail to catch the vest, you must return to the start and try again.4) Perform 5 jumping jacks each time a task is completed, and the first students to complete 15 jumping jacks in total succeed.
pe-05697: 1) The teacher announces a target number (e.g., 30, 15).2) Players shoot free throws, earning points/numbers each time a basket is made.3) Players freely combine their scored numbers using arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division).4) The first team to create an equation that exactly equals the target number wins.
pe-05698: 1) Form groups of four in the classroom and set up desks facing each other as targets.2) Score 1 point if the thrown disc directly hits the front face of the desk.3) Score 2 points if a teammate deflects the disc onto the desk, or 3 points if it passes underneath the desk.4) Score 5 points if the deflected disc rests on top of the desk, and instantly win with 21 points if it enters through the slot.
pe-05699: 1) Pairs line up at the start line, each holding a foam stick.2) On the starting signal, the pair runs forward to pinch and lift a cone using only their two foam sticks.3) Carry the cone securely without dropping it around the turning point back to the team.
pe-05700: 1) Designate one tagger within a defined playing boundary to start the game.2) When tagged, a player must place one hand over the tagged spot like a band-aid and become an additional tagger.3) The taggers multiply to 2, 4, and more until only the last few survivors remain.4) Stepping outside the designated boundary automatically turns a runner into a tagger.
pe-05701: 1) Divide into two teams and use the entire court without boundary lines.2) Throw giant dodgebees to hit opponents or pass to score points.3) A player holding the dodgebee cannot move.4) If a thrown dodgebee hits a player but is caught, it does not count as an out.
pe-05702: 1) Each player stands on their spot marker.2) Gently toss the beanbag into the upright cones without sliding it along the floor.3) When the beanbag lands inside a cone, the player claims and removes that cone.4) The player who is first to claim and remove all 6 cones wins.
pe-05703: 1) Two players form a pair and follow the leader's count.2) In 'Look the Same Way', both turn their heads 90 degrees on count, scoring 1 point if they look in the same direction.3) In 'Tom and Jerry', players play rock-paper-scissors to assign roles of Tom (cat) and Jerry (mouse).4) Both turn their heads on count; Tom scores 1 point if they look in the same direction, and Jerry scores 1 point if they look in different directions.
pe-05704: 1) Sit facing each other with toes touching, knees bent, and hands joined together.2) When the leader calls 'Everybody', participants shout 'Up' and pull each other to stand up simultaneously.3) Start with 2 players and gradually increase to 4, 8, and 16 players, figuring out different handholds to stand up together.
pe-05705: 1) Perform tuck jumps 3-5 times and exchange signatures with a partner.2) Perform standing long jumps over placed spot markers.3) Do side steps followed by high fives and touch line spot markers for designated repetitions.4) Hold tree pose and play foot rock-paper-scissors.5) Divide and achieve target jump rope counts together with a partner.6) Bounce/toss and catch balls with a partner to succeed and exchange signatures.
pe-05706: 1) Balance speed stacks cups filled with candy on the back of both hands2) Attackers throw sock balls from behind the line to knock down the cups3) Defenders swing foam noodles to block incoming balls and protect the crowns4) Attackers score when both cups on the defender's hands are knocked off
pe-05707: 1) Hit the ball toward the tchoukball net to rebound it2) Direct the rebounded ball into the opponent area within boundaries3) The ball must be sent back to the opponents within three touches4) A point is scored if the ball lands outside or the opponent fails to return it
pe-05708: 1) Insert a cone into the playstick to create a sword with a handguard2) Cross the stick tips together and assume a ready stance3) Touch the opponent's body first when the start signal is given4) The player touched first calls Touché to acknowledge the point
pe-05709: 1) Bounce and throw ping-pong balls toward the 3x3 grid markers on the floor2) Bounce the ball multiple times if needed to land inside the targets3) Place or move a marker on the board when a bounce successfully lands4) The team that aligns three markers in a row wins the game
pe-05710: 1) Place 10 number beanbags and 10 exercise prompt beanbags face down on the floor.2) A runner flips one beanbag from each side simultaneously to check and show them to teammates.3) If a matching pair is found, bring them back and perform the specified exercise for the indicated number of repetitions.4) The team that finds the target number of pairs and completes the exercises first wins.
pe-05711: 1) One player from each side runs around the corner cone2) The player who steps on the spot marker first attacks in Cham-Cham-Cham3) Shoot the flying disc toward the goal while the opponent tries to block it to score points
pe-05712: 1) Prepare two rolls of toilet paper per person and place them upright on the desk.2) Lightly toss the rolls and catch them together by hand forming a heart shape (Level 1).3) Place the heart to one side, toss and slide the rolls to switch sides and catch them together in the center (Level 2).
pe-05713: 1) Place 8 (or6) cups in front of each player on a desk at an equal distance.2) Determine player order by rock-paper-scissors and bounce a ping-pong ball toward the cups.3) When the ball bounces into one of your cups, remove that cup, and the first player to remove all cups wins.
pe-05714: 1) Two players face each other and stack their hands alternately on top of each other.2) When 'Up' is called, move the bottom hand to the top; when 'Down' is called, move the top hand to the bottom.3) When 'Dome' is called, the bottom hand quickly covers the top hand; when 'Dish' is called, the top hand covers from below to score 1 point.
pe-05715: 1) Place a beanbag on a designated body part such as the elbow, head, shoulder, or foot.2) Run away to avoid the tagger known as the toy destroyer.3) If a beanbag falls, other players help put it back on.4) The tagger cannot knock down the beanbag of a player who is helping someone.5) The tagger wins if all toys are broken, and the player who helped the most friends is praised.
pe-05716: 1) Team members slide beanbags along the floor to land them on the moving spot marker.2) If successful, perform the designated exercise (2 lunges, 2 jump spins, 2 push-ups) together with the waiting teammate.3) If unsuccessful, players switch turns without performing the exercise.4) The team that successfully lands 3 beanbags first wins.
pe-05717: 1) Teams A and B line up facing each other and run toward the center simultaneously.2) Play rock-paper-scissors with the partner facing you.3) The winner does 5 jumping jacks, and the loser does 5 squats before returning.4) The front person in one line moves to the back so everyone faces a new partner.5) Continue until everyone meets or work to beat the whole-class record.
pe-05718: 1) Four players each hold a cone with a ball placed in the center.2) Attempt cone flipping on the start signal.3) The player who flips and lands the cone first gets 2 points and can throw the ball for an additional 1 point, while other players get 1 point if all escape successfully.
pe-05719: 1) The first runner places a foot on the start line and stretches their legs as wide as possible.2) The second runner circles around the first runner and stretches their legs connected to the first runner.3) Subsequent runners also circle around previous runners and connect their feet, and the team whose final runner finishes and stands up first wins.
pe-05720: 1) Team members stand in a line.2) A runner weaves in a zigzag through or around team members.3) Roll the ball through the body tunnel formed by teammates.

pe-05830: 1) In 'Danger Zone', set up two gates where blue and red teams cross to opposite sides while changing speed and direction to avoid collisions.2) Run Danger Zone across eight 45-second rounds, calling out different movement patterns such as running, hopping, or sidesteps.3) In 'Follow the Leader', pairs move around as the follower attentively mimics the leader's basic movements and sudden direction changes.4) In 'Tig', play short 45-second rounds where taggers switch each round and students experiment with movements like skipping or hopping.
pe-05831: 1) Players are safe in their own half and use speed and direction changes to invade the opponent's end zone without being tagged.2) In 'Battlefield', students play 1v1 simultaneously, using other pairs as shields to sneak through before switching attack/defense roles.3) In 'Cats and Mice', multiple attackers cross against multiple defenders, with tagged attackers joining the defense next round.4) Progress by letting children carry their favorite sports equipment (football, basketball, rugby ball) while penetrating the territory.
pe-05832: 1) Pair up with a partner where one stands inside a hoop with a ball and the other stands three steps outside.2) The player inside dribbles 9 times and delivers a bounce or chest pass to the partner outside.3) The receiving partner dribbles 9 times around the hoop with their dominant hand, places the ball back, and rotates to the next hoop.
pe-05833: 1) Divide players into 3v3 or 2v2 teams.2) A team scores 1 point for every successful pass completed between teammates.3) The defending team scores 1 point if they intercept or steal the ball.4) Play within the designated coned area without hitting or touching opponents.
pe-05834: 1) Divide students onto two opposite sides (or four sides) of the court with a large inflatable beach volleyball placed in the center.2) Players throw their balls to hit and move the inflatable beach volleyball.3) A team scores a point when the beach volleyball crosses the opposing team's line.4) The instructor stops and restarts the game whenever a point is scored or if the ball goes out of bounds.
pe-05835: 1) Participants stand in a circle.2) The starting person holds the end of the yarn and says something they like.3) Anyone who likes it too calls out "Me too," catches the yarn, and holds the string before tossing it to the next person.4) Once the web is formed, balance a ball in the middle and bounce it 10 times without losing it to succeed.
pe-05836: 1) Divide into two teams of 5 players on a basketball court.2) One team starts with the ball on their baseline.3) The player holding the ball cannot move and must pass toward the opposite baseline.4) If the ball is dropped, possession transfers to the other team.
pe-05837: 1) Stand around the parachute and lift it up high together.2) Shake or lower the parachute following the cues.3) Stretch and extend body parts according to the instructions.
pe-05838: 1) Pair up with a partner and get one basketball per pair.2) The player with the ball wraps it around their waist 20 times.3) The player without the ball performs jumping jacks until the partner finishes, then switch roles.
pe-05839: 1) Each student lays out a jump rope on the floor in a curved 'S' shape.2) Run forward along the snake rope, circle around the end, and return to the start.3) Try different movements such as hopping on one foot and returning around the end.4) Modify by connecting four jump ropes in small groups or lining them up across the whole class.
pe-05840: 1) Form two teams of 5 and dribble soccer balls inside the designated cone zone2) Kick the opponents' balls outside the boundary line to send them to jail3) On the freeze signal, stop and pass the ball to knock down target pins for points
pe-05841: 1) Pretend you are on a soccer field jogging in place or moving your arms while seated to simulate dribbling.2) Open your foot like a golf club to pass, practice throw-ins behind a line, and reach out to make goalie saves.3) Switch to basketball to push-dribble with both hands and perform shooting form with elbows at a 90-degree angle.4) Put arms up moving side to side for defense and complete the one-leg clapping movements.
pe-05842: 1) Stand behind the ball, swing the hockey stick back, and follow through to strike the ball to the opposing team.2) Play Clean Up Your Backyard by striking balls over to the other side without crossing the center line.3) When the stop cue is called, the team with the fewest balls remaining on their side wins the game.
pe-05843: 1) Scoot around cones and grab one piece of food from the hoop.2) Tag and switch with the next teammate with a high-five.3) Draw the food on the board and determine if it is healthy or unhealthy.
pe-05844: 1) Pair up and designate one coach and one all-star player.2) The coach grabs the rope and drags the hula hoop across the floor.3) The all-star player tries to dribble the ball inside the moving hula hoop.4) The coach moves zigzags or curves, and switch roles every minute.
pe-05846: 1) Two magicians with wands start in the middle of the volleyball court as taggers.2) Players tagged by a magician are not out but turn into frogs.3) Frogs spread their legs and do five frog jumps to rejoin the game.4) On a freeze signal, magicians hand their wands to the closest frog to switch roles.
pe-05847: 1) Spread your arms to secure personal space and stand inside the coned area in the gym.2) When the teacher calls out 'Daytime', crouch down like a frog and jump.3) When 'Nighttime' is called, curl up into a ball on the floor and pretend to sleep.4) In subsequent rounds, vary the movements by making frog sounds or jumping as fast or as high as possible during daytime.
pe-05848: 1) Place 10 or more cones on a table and hide balls of two different colors underneath them.2) On signal, players lift cones with their dominant hand to search for their assigned color ball.3) Once found, balance the ball on top of that cone; the player who balances all their balls first wins.
pe-05849: 1) The teacher becomes the alligator and students are frogs, standing in small groups of 3-4 behind markers.2) On the command "Go," the first player in each group dribbles the basketball through and around the safe zones (mats and hula hoops).3) When the teacher calls "Lunchtime," students quickly run into the nearest safe zone before getting tagged.4) Caught students must complete 10 jumping jacks to return to the game, and on the switch command, they dribble back and pass the ball to the next player.
pe-05850: 1) Jump over the sticks on the floor without losing balance2) Jump forward, backward, or sideways with both feet together3) Jump over the moving sticks with one foot or both feet according to direction
pe-05851: 1) Divide students into teams and place markers in front of each team.2) All players have a ball except the first player, and start throwing to the first player standing behind the first marker.3) If caught, the ball is placed on the marker and the player moves to the next marker; if missed, the player cannot advance while throwers rotate.4) After finishing the second-to-last marker, the catcher runs around the last marker, and the team finishing first wins.
pe-05852: 1) Divide students into two teams: one with balls around the circle and the other inside.2) Inside players catch and throw with as many outside players as possible within a time limit.3) Switch roles after the allotted time.4) In the variation, inside players catch a ball, run, pass to another outside player, and repeat.
pe-05853: 1) Divide students into Teams A and B, lay out 9 hula hoops in a 3x3 grid between them, and give each team 3 markers.2) The first player from each team dribbles toward a basketball hoop and shoots.3) If the shot is made, the player passes the ball back to the next teammate and runs to place a marker inside one of the hoops.4) If the shot is missed, the player cannot place a marker and must pass the ball back to the next teammate and rejoin the line.5) The first team to align all 3 markers horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
pe-05854: 1) Place colored papers beside the left/right feet and at waist height on both sides, designating distinct color targets.2) A feeder tosses a soft paper/sock ball while calling out a color.3) The reactor slaps the ball toward the commanded color paper as quickly as possible.4) In a variation, the feeder tosses without speaking and the player must react to the color of the tossed ball itself.
pe-05855: 1) The first player in line throws the cloth from the first cone onto the second cone.2) If the cloth lands on the cone, the next player throws from that cone to the next, but if they miss, players keep throwing from the same cone until successful.3) After throwing, the player runs back to the end of the line and the next player runs to pick up the cloth to throw.4) Teams move through the cones until the last cone and return the same way, and the first team to reach the first cone wins.
pe-05856: 1) Scatter paper fish across the floor area.2) Hold a small board with both hands and fan behind the fish.3) Propel the paper fish forward with air gusts to reach the opposite side as quickly as possible.
pe-05857: 1) Form teams behind their station, each holding a cone, with small balls scattered across the field.2) On the 'Go' signal, the first runner runs to a ball and places the cone with the hollow side facing the ball.3) Use your foot to roll the ball into the cone, then pick up the ball, place it into the team's hula hoop, and hand the cone to the next runner.4) The team that gathers the most balls wins the game.
pe-05858: 1) Players start in the center area playing rock-paper-scissors, where winners move to corner box 1 while non-winners stay and play until they win2) Winners in box 1 advance to box 2 and continue progressing all the way through corner box 43) After winning in corner 4, the player returns to the center to collect points, playing with an available opponent or waiting if no one is there
pe-05859: 1) Team members stand in a straight line.2) Starting from the front player, pass the ball backward alternately over the head and between the legs (under and over).3) The last player catches the ball and sprints to the front of the line.4) Continue the sequence until the whole team crosses the target area.
pe-05860: 1) Place one hula hoop in front of each team and another several meters opposite containing small balls.2) On the signal, the first runner picks up the pool noodle and attaches the stringed cup to the end.3) Using only the noodle without touching the hoops, cover a ball with the cup, bring it back to the team hoop, and the team with the most balls wins.
pe-05861: 1) Players run with a cone toward another cone placed at the end line.2) Upon reaching the end line cone, they drop their cone from instructed heights such as waist, chest, or forehead level.3) If the cone lands right over the cone on the ground, the player earns a point.4) If the player misses, they perform 10 jumping jacks.
pe-05862: 1) Defenders wait on both sidelines holding hula hoops or balls.2) Runners dash across the central corridor towards the opposite side on signal.3) Defenders roll hoops or throw balls at the runners to hit them.4) Runners dodge the incoming equipment by changing speed and direction.
pe-05863: 1) Line up cones for each team and give the first runner a spot marker.2) On go, the first runner places the marker on top of the first cone and returns to tag the next player.3) Subsequent players run out and transfer the marker to the next cone in sequence down the line.4) The team that brings the marker from the last cone back to the green home cone first wins.
pe-05864: 1) Roll a pair of socks into a round ball.2) Hold the sock in one hand, toss it to a comfortable height, catch it with the same hand for one minute, and then switch hands.3) Practice various juggling patterns such as alternating diagonal tosses, underarm tosses, double sock tosses, and cross-arm catches for one minute each.
pe-05865: 1) Place flat markers double the number of players in a straight line at equal distances in front of each team, and place a hoop or circular marker a few meters past the last marker.2) On the signal 'Go', the last player of each team runs around the last marker, zigzags back, and stands on the first marker in front of the front player.3) All players follow the same procedure advancing one marker forward each time, and the team whose player reaches the hoop first wins.
pe-05866: 1) Place several cones with slight gaps in the center area, and position both teams opposite each other a few meters away.2) On the command 'go', the first player from each team rolls a hoop toward the cones.3) Points are scored if the rolled hoop successfully lands over a cone without being thrown.4) Once all players have taken their turns, calculate the points to determine the winning team.
pe-05867: 1) Divide into two equal teams, spread markers on the floor, and wait for the start signal.2) On go, run toward the markers, fish as many as possible using a stick, and carry them back to the hoop.3) The team with the most markers wins, followed by counting or sorting the markers by color.
pe-05868: 1) In version 1, hands go up when feet go out; in version 2, hands go down when feet go out.2) Level 1: perform 2 jumps of version 1, switch to 2 jumps of version 2, and complete 5 continuous switches without stopping.3) Level 2: perform 1 jump of each type alternately and complete 5 continuous switches without stopping.
pe-05869: 1) Place a roll of toilet paper on an open palm.2) Perform a forward shoulder roll while keeping the roll balanced without gripping it with fingers.3) Continue by performing a backward roll without dropping the toilet paper roll.
pe-05870: 1) Observe the Happy Feet movement alternating heels and toes.2) Watch the slow-motion demonstration carefully to check exact footwork.3) Practice and try to complete the movement on your own.
pe-05871: 1) Perform a 360-degree jump.2) Kick out with the right leg halfway through the turn and touch it.3) Land in a squat.4) To practice, lift the right knee and touch it instead of kicking with a straight leg, then land in a squat.
pe-05872: 1) On count 1, squat down low and place both hands firmly on the ground.2) On count 2, rotate your body 360 degrees while sweeping one straight leg across the floor.3) Once comfortable with both steps, increase the speed to execute a full smooth backsweep.
pe-05873: 1) Make a fist.2) Hit the tennis ball against the wall so it strikes the outside of your fingers.3) Keep hitting the ball repeatedly before it touches the ground.
pe-05874: 1) Fold a piece of paper and set it upright on the floor.2) Balance on one foot so no other body parts touch the floor.3) Pick up the paper using only your mouth.4) In level 2, fold the paper lower the other way and challenge again.
pe-05875: 1) Raise both arms overhead and rotate them in opposite directions simultaneously.2) In level 2, switch and reverse the rotation directions midway through.3) In level 3, add a 360-degree spin while continuing the arm rotations.
pe-05876: 1) Hold a stick with both hands.2) Solve the puzzle by reaching the other posture without changing your grip on the stick.3) Use shoulder and hip mobility to complete the movement.
pe-05877: 1) For level one, place your hands on the ground and move forward with large leg swings.2) Once mastered, advance to level two and move across the floor pumping arms and legs in the same rhythm.
pe-05878: 1) In Level 1, place a toilet paper roll on your head, sit down on the floor, and stand back up.2) In Level 2, perform the same movement without using your hands to push off the floor.3) In Level 3, hold a second roll on your open palm while sitting down, and switch the roll to the other hand without dropping it as you stand back up.
pe-05879: 1) Place your hands on the ground and position your knees on your elbows2) Slowly lean forward until you find the sweet spot that keeps you balanced3) Lift your feet off the floor and hold the balance using your arms
pe-05880: 1) Jump up using your right leg2) Perform a front kick with your right leg in mid-air3) Land on your right leg before your left leg touches the ground
pe-05881: 1) Place both hands on the floor in a quadruped or crawl position2) Rotate the hips vigorously while lifting both legs high on each turn3) Stabilize arms and legs together to coordinate the movement smoothly
pe-05882: 1) The defending team stands on walls made of mats (max 4 players per mat) while the attacking team starts at the home base.2) Attackers run through the walls without getting tagged to gather items from different zones (Zone 1 rings for 1 pt, Zone 2 yellow balls for 3 pts, Zone 3 medicine balls for 5-15 pts) and return them.3) Defenders can only tag while staying on their mats; tagged attackers must return items, touch their home wall, and restart.4) Play 6 rounds of 2 minutes each, swapping roles each round to calculate total points.
pe-05883: 1) Identify the various cone stations set up across the gym (scooter sled, paper plate ice skating, polar bear walk, reindeer hurdle run, snowman ball rolling, basketball dribble and shoot).2) Move freely to any cone in any order, taking turns to complete each movement challenge.3) Visit every cone station to complete all the winter-themed activities.
pe-05884: 1) Bear walk all the way to the cone.2) Turn around the cone and run down the side.3) Perform a crab walk on the other side and run again.
pe-05885: 1) Practice level 1 basic tricks starting with side swings and a 4-jump 4-side-swing pattern.2) Perform backward jumping and single foot hopping.3) Execute scissors, jumping jack feet, and 360-degree turning jumps.4) Advance to levels 2-4 with criss-cross, continuous criss-cross, pretzel, double unders, and partner trick handle switching.
pe-05886: 1) Choose the game you like the most from the three options on the screen.2) When the timer starts, perform the exercise shown behind your choice.3) In each round, pick a new game and follow the corresponding workout movement.
pe-05887: 1) Individual players ride scooters with a scarf tucked inside a pool noodle behind them and try to capture scarves from opponents.2) Players who lose their scarf pick up their scooter and wait behind their team zone (hoop or cone).3) Teammates carrying up to two captured scarves can bring them back to revive waiting players.4) Each team has a flagship made of connected scooters and a mat carrying four seated defenders; the game ends when a team captures both flags from the opposing flagship.
pe-05888: 1) Place two-sided taped mini cones across the gym floor with different colors on each end.2) On the start signal, players run around the area flipping cones so their designated team color faces upward.3) Players cannot touch the same cone twice in a row, cannot follow the same person for more than two cones, and may only flip one cone at a time.4) When time is called, all players raise their hands immediately, and the team with the most cones showing their color wins.
pe-05889: 1) Scatter various creature-shaped beanbags (frogs, turtles) across the gymnasium floor.2) In each group, one student sits on a scooter while a partner pushes them to collect as many beanbags as they can carry back to their team hoop.3) If tagged by Team Rocket (students riding a connected mat) or the teacher-controlled robotic tagger, players must drop all held beanbags and touch their home hoop before continuing.4) When time is up, the group that has collected the most beanbags at their base wins.
pe-05890: 1) Place three buckets in the middle.2) Choose an object to roll and battle back and forth with opponents.3) Earn 1 point for the closest bucket, 2 points for the middle bucket, and 3 points for the third bucket, playing up to 21 points.
pe-05891: 1) Round 1: Balance the balloon on your paddle for 30 seconds.2) Round 2: Balance the balloon while moving it high, medium, and low following the coach.3) Round 3: Tap the balloon once with the paddle and catch it.4) Round 4: Tap the balloon twice with the paddle and catch it.5) Round 5: See how many consecutive taps you can get in a row.6) Round 6 (Flip Flops): Tap the balloon with one side of the paddle and flip it over to tap with the other.7) Round 7: Practice hitting forehands against the wall.8) Round 8: Practice hitting backhands against the wall.9) Round 9: Design your own trick and practice it.
pe-05892: 1) Place start cones on both sides and lay 6-8 (recommended7) dual-colored topple tubes in a center line.2) One side is blue and the other is yellow; on the coach's "Ready set go", the first runner sprints out.3) The runner finds a topple tube and stands it up with their team's color face up, or flips an opponent's tube to their own color.4) The runner must return to the line and high-five their teammate before the next person can go.5) The first team to get all tubes facing their color up, or the team with the most of their color when time expires, wins.
pe-05893: 1) Scatter various sizes of pool noodles (short, medium, long) across the gym and line up behind team start cones.2) The first runner sprints down, grabs one noodle, and returns to hand it to the next teammate.3) The next runner carries that noodle, grabs one more noodle (total of 2), and hands them to the following teammate.4) Continue the relay with each runner carrying all accumulated noodles plus one newly picked noodle.5) When noodles run out or the coach calls "freeze", players stop in place and gather with their team.6) Line up all collected noodles from tallest to shortest, then calculate the total score using on-screen points (short: 1pt, medium: 5pts, long: 10pts).
pe-05894: 1) Tape 4ft by 4ft courts on the floor with a center tape as the net, and have students sit on pockets or knees.2) For K-1, one partner without a paddle rolls a tennis ball on the floor, and the paddle holder rolls it back with forehand or backhand before switching.3) For grades 2-4, practice drop-and-hit serves with tennis balls while the receiver keeps their paddle behind their back, then switch.4) Once serving is mastered, both players hold paddles, start with a serve, and rally back and forth as many times as possible.5) Stop play and alternate serves if the ball lands out of bounds, bounces twice on one side, or hits the net line.6) Older grades keep score during timed matches; when time is called, tiebreakers use rock-paper-scissors or winners advance to new courts.
pe-05895: 1) Dribble the ball toward the cone with short touches.2) As you reach the cone, step one way with one foot to fake moving in that direction.3) Touch the ball to accelerate past the cone in the opposite direction.
pe-05896: 1) Each team lines up with a basketball behind a row of cones leading to the hoop.2) Dribble in and out through the line of cones.3) Stop at the end cone and take two shots at the hoop (score 1 point for each basket made).4) Dribble back to the start line, hand the ball to the next player, and keep track of the team's total score.
pe-05897: 1) Set up cones in a zig-zag line.2) Dribble to each cone, feint with the body to one side, and dribble out to the opposite side.3) On the way back, step over the ball at each cone and accelerate in the opposite direction back to start.
pe-05898: 1) Place one large cone in the middle and four small cones around the outside.2) Start from an outside cone, dribble around the middle cone, and go to the next outside cone.3) Return around the middle cone to the next outside cone and repeat this pattern.4) Dribble back to the starting cone to complete the drill.
pe-05899: 1) Set up a goal at each end, divide players into two teams, and have the first player from each team run onto the field when the coach calls "go."2) The coach kicks in a ball, and the players compete to score in the opponent's goal.3) If nothing happens after about 30 seconds or the ball goes out of play, the round ends, players return the ball to the coach and join the back of the line.4) Progress the drill by sending two players per team (2v2) with rules such as requiring at least three passes before shooting.
pe-05900: 1) Form pairs where one student acts as the feeder and the other acts as the passer.2) The feeder stands by a cone and underarm throws the ball to bounce once in front of the passer.3) The passer kicks the ball back while it is in the air after the bounce, using the inside of the foot or the laces.4) Catching the returned pass awards 1 point for each successful attempt.5) Practice using both the left and right feet alternately.
pe-05901: 1) Each team has a stick, a ball, a tunnel of cones, and targets.2) Dribble the ball to the end of the cone tunnel and stop it.3) Hit the ball to knock down a target.4) If you hit a target, bring it back for one point, and the first team to knock down all targets wins.
pe-05902: 1) Each student prepares a tennis ball and a large cone.2) Throw the ball up into the air.3) Move underneath the ball and catch it inside the cone.4) Earn one point each time you catch it easily, and try catching with one hand.
pe-05903: 1) Divide players into teams behind markers, each team with one soccer ball.2) On the whistle, the first player dribbles through the scattered mine markers without touching them.3) If they navigate through cleanly, shoot into the goal to earn a point and dribble back.
pe-05904: 1) Stand in a warrior pose with the non-hitting hand pointing forward and the hitting hand pulled back.2) Perform a big jump toward the incoming ball.3) Strike the ball at the highest point of reach over the net using an open hand like a high-five without making a fist.
pe-05905: 1) Drag the ball back using the underside of your foot.2) Touch the ball with your other foot to change direction and keep dribbling.3) Drag the ball back, tap it behind your other leg, and continue running and dribbling.
pe-05906: 1) Practice stepping over a stationary ball alternately with both feet without touching it.2) Start at the beginning of a zigzag course laid out with cones.3) At each cone, step over the ball and then dribble to the next cone.4) Dribble back to the start with small touches without touching any cones.
pe-05907: 1) Make a fruit bowl shape with both hands ready to catch2) Keep knees slightly bent and arms out when your partner throws3) Catch the ball nice and gently before it hits the ground.
pe-05908: 1) Place both hands inside the hoop pointing to the side2) Jump over to the other side keeping hands firmly inside the hoop3) Land with both feet together facing the other way and repeat.
pe-05909: 1) Dribble through the zigzag cones by rolling the ball with the sole of both feet alternately.2) Stop at the end cone circle and perform 10 toe taps on the ball.3) Return to the start by rolling the ball back through the cones while staying low.
pe-05910: 1) Stand side-on in a T position pointing one hand toward the target and holding the racket low behind you.2) Have a partner bounce and toss the ball gently with an underarm throw.3) Step forward and swing the racket from low to high; if the partner catches the ball, earn one point.
pe-05911: 1) Divide players into 3-4 equal teams at one end of the court behind a cone, each team with a basketball.2) On the whistle, the first player dribbles out, picks up a cone from the floor, and dribbles back.3) Drop off the cone, pass the ball to the next player, and the team with the most cones once all are collected wins.
pe-05912: 1) Place tall cones across a bench at intervals.2) Walk across the bench carefully stepping over cones without touching or stepping on them, using arms to balance.3) Earn one point each time you reach the end without touching the cones.4) Walk back and try crossing in a different way, such as walking sideways, on the next attempt.
pe-05913: 1) Side Pogos: Jump out sideways then back in, jump straight up, then back out to the other side.2) Icky Shuffle: Step in and out of each square moving forward in a zigzag line, then repeat backwards.3) Power Steps: Take small steps next to the ladder and quickly plant the closest foot in and out of the square on both sides.4) Explosive Hops: Hop sideways on one foot then quickly hop in and back out of the square.5) Two In Two Out: Step into the square one foot at a time, then back out one foot at a time.6) Explosive Side Steps: Jump forwards and at each square quickly step in and out with the closest foot.7) Hold and Push Off: Balance on the outside leg and push off to step through to the other side in a zigzag pattern.
pe-05914: 1) Dribble the ball without looking or with eyes closed by feeling the ball.2) Hop on one foot while bouncing the ball with the opposite hand, then switch hands and feet.3) Bounce the ball high, quickly spin around, and catch it with two hands or one hand.4) Dribble along the gym floor lines staying low and using fingertips.
pe-05915: 1) Mark four corners with four different colored cones and have each student dribble a soccer ball in the middle area2) When the coach calls out a color, quickly dribble to that colored section and trap the ball3) Reset back to the middle area after trapping the ball and repeat
pe-05916: 1) Teams line up behind a row of five cones spaced about one meter apart.2) The first player dribbles a soccer ball weaving in and out of the cones.3) Upon reaching the end, dribble back through the cones or shoot into a goal.4) Pass the ball to the next player, and the first team to finish wins.
pe-05917: 1) Keep the ball between your feet.2) Use small touches with the inside parts of both feet.3) Stay on your toes, move left to right to the cone, and return.
pe-05918: 1) Each student takes one soccer ball and works independently in their own space.2) Drop the ball, let it bounce once, kick it upward using the laces of your foot, and catch it with both hands.3) Score one point each time you catch the ball successfully, practicing with both left and right feet.4) For an advanced challenge, kick and catch the ball before it touches the ground without bouncing.
pe-05919: 1) Split into four teams lined up in the four corners of the court, with one basketball per team.2) On the whistle, the first player of each team sprints to the far hoop and scores a layup.3) They retrieve their ball, dribble to the opposite hoop to score another layup, and return the ball to their team to earn a point.
pe-05920: 1) Face your partner standing at their cone.2) Point to the target with your non-throwing hand.3) Take one step forward, swing your arm all the way back, and step and throw.
pe-05921: 1) Set up cones in a zigzag pattern with a small circle at the end.2) Dribble through the cones keeping the ball close using small touches with inside, outside, and under the foot.3) Stop the ball at each cone before dribbling to the next one.4) Upon reaching the end circle, stop the ball, perform 10 step-overs without touching it, and dribble back to the start.
pe-05922: 1) Divide into two teams lining up on either side of the goal facing a tall cone 10-15 meters away.2) On the whistle, the first player from each team sprints out around the cone at the same time.3) Race to reach the ball kicked in by the coach, dribble toward the goal, and score.4) When progressing to 2v2 or 3v3, players must complete a required number of passes before shooting.
pe-05923: 1) Bounce the ball, kick it up, spin around in a circle, and catch it.2) Gently kick the ball forward, chase after it, and sit on it or trap it with your knee before it stops.3) Toss the ball up with two hands, volley it with your laces before it hits the ground, and catch it.
pe-05924: 1) Lift the parachute high to walk underneath or step inside to create a tent.2) Race around the perimeter when a color is called before it lands.3) Keep balls or balloons rolling or bouncing on top through coordinated shaking.
pe-05925: 1) Stuck in the Mud: Taggers use noodles below shoulders while runners hold balls under armpits; tagged players trap the ball between feet until rescued by a tossed catch2) Gopher Tag: Gophers hide behind mats and tag crossing runners below shoulders, turning tagged players into new gophers3) Yoshi: Teams race to reach the opponent's mat; players tagged on the opposing side sit down and are rescued when a teammate pulls them by hand back to safety
pe-05926: 1) Place a hand on top of the hoop and spin it on the ground for a spinning contest.2) Roll the hoop to a partner with a hand on top, or push two hoops at the same time.3) Jump with two feet into each hoop along the path.4) Move around and stop with both feet in the same hoop or across two different colored hoops on command.
pe-05927: 1) Place spots 1-30 on the floor and step over each number with only the right foot without stepping on them.2) Walk and step over only odd numbers, then switch to stepping over only even numbers.3) Step over consecutive numbers in order from 1 to 30 or count down in reverse.4) Advance by stepping over numbers that are higher, lower, or alternating higher and lower than the previous one.5) Run a relay where each runner finds and retrieves the next number in sequence, brings it to the cone, and high-fives the next teammate.
pe-05928: 1) Assemble an obstacle course of over, under, around, and through stations using blocks, poles, rings, and clips.2) Step and climb through the blue upright rings.3) Crawl under low horizontal bars that have open space underneath.4) Step over horizontal bars that have obstacles placed below them.5) Start running when tapped on the head, with student helpers assisting peers through difficult obstacles.
pe-05929: 1) Grab a paddle and a balloon, holding the paddle nice and flat.2) Strike the balloon continuously into the air with the paddle while counting each hit.3) If the balloon touches the ground or you step outside the black boundary lines, start over and aim for 50 consecutive hits.
pe-05930: 1) Place the ball on the matching color dot and hold the putter.2) Square your feet and face your side toward the target hole on the wall.3) Hit a bit firmer on the first stroke and putt softly thereafter.4) Wait until the ball stops completely before striking it again.5) Try to get the ball into the hole in fewer than six hits until the music stops.
pe-05931: 1) Face your partner while one player randomly throws either a high pop fly or a low grounder.2) The receiver catches high balls with hands up and thumbs together, or low balls with hands down and pinkies together.3) After successfully catching five balls, high-five or fist bump, jog one lap together around the gym, and return to open space to see how many total catches you can make in three minutes.
pe-05932: 1) Practice footwork without the rope first, mastering skips (one-two steps) and straddles (out-together).2) Try advanced variations such as straddle-cross or forward-and-back straddle steps.3) Once footwork is mastered, pick up the jump rope and execute the moves using single or double bounces.
pe-05933: 1) Prepare one hula hoop.2) Spin the hula hoop around 5 different body parts continuously without stopping.3) Move sequentially through hands, neck, waist, knees, and feet to complete the challenge.
pe-05934: 1) Level 1: Start on one mat, swing using the rope, and land safely on the opposite mat.2) Level 2: Start on a mat, swing over the floor without touching the red mat, and land with control on the opposite floor.3) Level 3: Start from the floor, swing completely across, and land on the floor on the other side.
pe-05935: 1) Shoot the ball into the goal from one of the designated spots on the court2) If you make the shot, pick up that spot and take it back to your team3) Each collected spot is worth one point for the team
pe-05936: 1) Form a castle perimeter with long foam bars where players act as guards holding the wall.2) When the giant attacks a section with a hammer toy, guards must hold firmly so the wall is not taken.3) If the giant moves to attack another section, other guards can rush over to help hold that wall.
pe-05937: 1) Run changing directions in forward-backward, zigzag, S-curve, and square pathways using dish cones.2) Practice jumping variations including single-leg hops, two-foot jumps forward and sideways, jumping jacks, jumping with arms stretched, and hands-down jumps.3) Perform rolls by rolling with arms down, arms up, hugging knees, holding ankles, and over one shoulder.
pe-05938: 1) Practice throwing balls upward and forward, and catching flying, bouncing, or rolling balls.2) Roll various sized balls on the floor, and strike balls with fists, palms, and paddles.3) Kick balls with the instep, bounce balls with hands/paddles/cloth, and dribble balls with hands, feet, and sticks.
pe-05939: 1) Run or walk with upright posture, adjusting breathing by walking when tired.2) Perform push-ups (desk, floor, or knees) and curl-ups progressively individually or with partners.3) Complete shuttle runs around cones (15m straight and 3m zigzag), followed by individual and partner stretches.
pe-05940: 1) Place hands on waist and rotate the neck in both directions.2) Hold the head with the opposite hand and gently stretch the neck and shoulder.3) Rotate shoulders using elbows and raise one elbow supported by the other fist.4) Stretch arms by pulling the palm and the back of the hand forward.5) Spread legs to stretch hamstrings, then hold one ankle to stretch the front thigh.
pe-05941: 1) Set nests 5 to 8 meters apart, scatter eggs, and choose sides by rock-paper-scissors.2) Hold balloons and pick up eggs while bouncing the balloon on referee's signal.3) The game ends when the balloon touches the floor, and the final count of collected eggs determines the winner.
pe-05942: 1) Set up 2 balls and 2 goals facing each other about 10 meters apart, and both players bow to each other.2) On signal, each player runs around a small circle once, runs to their own goal, and loops around it once.3) The player who arrives first shoots their ball, while the slower player acts as a goalkeeper.4) If saved, the defender quickly runs to shoot their own ball; each player shoots only once per turn, and the first to score 3 points wins.
pe-05943: 1) Team members run in a single-file line through three zones: ladder challenge, hurdle jumps, and zigzag dome cones.2) One lap is counted when the last runner carrying the ring baton returns to the start line, adding 0.5 laps if past the second zone at the whistle.3) Knocking down a hurdle or cone reduces the remaining team time by one second each.
pe-05944: 1) Arrange 6 cones numbered 1 through 6 in a star shape on the floor2) Decide the running order within the team and have the first runner stand at the starting line3) Run and touch cones 1 through 6 in sequential order, then return to the start line to tag the next runner4) Time the team from start to finish to see which team completes the relay fastest
pe-05945: 1) Perform a plank by resting forearms on the floor, lifting hips to make a straight line, and bracing core muscles.2) Perform lunges by stepping one foot forward, bending knees downward, and stepping back alternating legs.3) Spread feet shoulder-width apart, stretch arms forward, lower into a horse-riding stance, and hold for 10 seconds.4) Perform burpees by placing hands down, kicking feet back, jumping feet in, and jumping straight up.
pe-05946: 1) Students wait outside the classroom in the hallway.2) The teacher hides sticky note clues with words around the classroom.3) Students enter wearing paper mole cones covering their faces.4) With restricted vision, students search the classroom to spot and read hidden words.5) Successfully identifying the written word rewards the student with a gift.
pe-05947: 1) In arm wrestling, place elbows on the surface, grip hands, support with the other hand, and pull toward yourself on start.2) In hand wrestling, face each other, grip hands, and pull or push to make the opponent fall.3) In leg hook ssireum, hook legs together and disrupt balance to take down the opponent.
pe-05948: 1) Arrange six hula hoops in a line and divide students into teams.2) Roll a die and strike the ball with hands or rackets to land inside the hoop corresponding to the rolled number.3) Successfully hit hoops are removed, and the team that clears all six hoops first wins.
pe-05949: 1) Each player chooses and wears 3 colored wristbands on their wrist from 6 available colors.2) Players hold hands to make a circle, and after one player rolls the colored die, the circle follows it while holding hands.3) When the die stops, players with different colors run away, while the player matching the die's color picks it up and shouts 'Stop!'.4) The thrower throws the die to hit a runner and takes 1 wristband, but if a runner catches the die, the thrower loses 1 wristband.5) Players who lose all wristbands are out, and the player with the most wristbands at the end wins.
pe-05950: 1) Set the starting and finishing points and place markers at the destination.2) Form teams by drawing shuttlecocks with matching marks.3) Transport the shuttlecock by balancing it on the palm in level 1, back of the hand in level 2, elbow in level 3, and head in the final level to hit the cone.4) If dropped or missed, return and retry until cleared.5) Record the number of failures per level, and the team with fewer total failures wins.
pe-05951: 1) All participants sit in a circle with their eyes tightly closed.2) The lead player silently gets up and walks slowly around the seated members.3) Before completing a full loop from their starting point, the leader touches another person to attach them as the next train car.4) Each newly selected player selects the next person to extend the train, and the last remaining person must sense their turn and open their eyes to succeed.
pe-05952: 1) When the leader calls 'Cut', the extra player without a partner chops between a pair's hands to take a spot, and the displaced person finds a new partner.2) When 'Mix' is called with a specific rule (e.g. groups of 3), players reorganize into new matching groups.3) When 'Dash' is called, players quickly run to touch the nearest wall and return to high-five hands with a partner.
pe-05953: 1) Each student holds a die and moves around to meet a partner.2) Count '1, 2, 3' together and reveal dice numbers simultaneously without manipulation.3) The player who correctly shouts the sum of both dice first wins (rock-paper-scissors on tie).4) The loser holds the winner's back to form a train, continuing until the whole class forms one train.5) [Variation] Multiply numbers instead of adding, or shout 'Ping' to explode the train when identical numbers appear.
pe-05954: 1) Imagine becoming a caterpillar and walk following the teacher's cues alternating right and left foot.2) Lift feet to step over puddles or pits, and hide under leaves when it rains.3) Walk on tiptoes carefully when crossing water pools.4) Lower the body to hide when birds fly near, pretend to find and eat food, and return home.
pe-05955: 1) In Losing Rock-Paper-Scissors, students play against the teacher and only those who lose stay in the game.2) In Double Pistol One-Out, show different hand signs with both hands and remove one on the call.3) You can play either without changing the remaining hand or allowing a late change.
pe-05956: 1) Step on the center of the rope with one foot and pull the handles up to check the length.2) Beginners adjust the stopper so the handles reach near the chest or armpits.3) Turn the rope using wrist rotation rather than whole arms, keep elbows close to the body, and jump lightly 1 to 1.5 cm.
pe-05957: 1) Place inverted cones on desks to form bowling pins.2) Teams of three throw soft flying discs from a set distance.3) Knocking down a cone earns 10 points, while knocking it off the desk earns 20 points.4) The thrower rotates to reset the pins, and the first team to reach 100 points wins.
pe-05958: 1) Students jump in place and turn toward the commanded direction.2) 'Sun' means turning 90 degrees right; 'Moon' means turning 90 degrees left.3) 'Turn' means a 180-degree half rotation, and 'Star' means a 360-degree full rotation.4) Players jumping in the wrong direction receive penalty points or are eliminated.
pe-05959: 1) Place spot markers of five different colors on the floor as scoring targets.2) From the starting line, kick off an indoor slipper toward the targets.3) Score points based on where the slipper lands (e.g., 3 points inside a target) and sum up the scores for the group.
pe-05960: 1) Set up a square boundary using 4 markers and place a team vest in the middle.2) One player from each team circles the boundary looking for a chance to snatch the vest.3) If the defender tags the stealer the defending team scores 1 point, and if the runner safely escapes with the vest their team scores 1 point.
pe-05961: 1) Teams line up and the first runner skips forward rotating an ankle jump ball rope toward the turning point.2) Upon reaching the station, the runner tosses a dolphin ring to hook it onto the target pole.3) After successfully hooking the ring, return and hand off the ankle rope to the next teammate.
pe-05962: 1) Place 24 cups in four colors on the floor and assign each player a color.2) Bounce table tennis balls from the designated throwing area into the cups.3) When a ball lands in a cup of the player's assigned color, that player removes and claims the cup.4) The player who retrieves all 6 cups of their assigned color first wins the game.
pe-05963: 1) On the start signal, runners carry a kelp flag from the starting marker toward the jump rope line.2) Hang the flag onto the jump rope to dry and run back to tag the next teammate.3) Once all 5 kelp flags are hung, two runners advance together to hold both ends of the rope.4) The two runners pass the rope under all teammates' legs and then over their heads before returning to finish.
pe-05964: 1) Face a partner and jump landing on either one foot or two feet to the chant "Odd or Even Jump!".2) Landing on one foot counts as 1 (odd) and two feet as 2 (even); add both players' numbers to determine whether the sum is odd or even.3) The winner completes a designated exercise such as squats, takes one marker from the partner, and moves to find a new opponent.
pe-05965: 1) In groups of three, one person holds a team vest in the middle while two players circle around.2) One player snatches the vest and sprints toward their spot marker.3) The other player immediately chases and tags them before they cross their marker to score.
pe-05966: 1) Spread two-sided mini spot markers across the play area2) Each team runs around flipping the markers to show their assigned team color3) Rock-paper-scissors can be added so only the winner is allowed to flip a marker upon meeting.
pe-05967: 1) Fold an A4 sheet vertically in half and stand it on the floor2) Stand on one leg and lower the body3) Pick up the paper with the mouth without touching the floor with hands to succeed4) If successful, fold the paper horizontally to challenge a lower height
pe-05968: 1) Each student holds a numbered disc cone and checks their own number2) The teacher calls out a target sum or group size3) Students ask each other their numbers to find partners that make the target sum4) The group that completes the sum and reports to the teacher first wins
pe-05969: 1) Connect 1-2 desks and form a group of 3 divided into 2 on one side and 1 on the other2) A player from the side with 2 serves by rolling the ball across the table and runs to the opposite side3) The ball may bounce multiple times on the table but only once on the floor4) If a player fails to return the ball or it bounces twice on the floor, the opponent scores
pe-05970: 1) Divide courts with a center line, place cones in zones, and set baulk-line cones outside.2) The raider must cross the baulk line, tag opponents, and safely return across the center line within 10 seconds.3) Tagged defenders are out and raiders score points equal to the number of defenders tagged upon returning safely.4) If the raider exceeds 10 seconds or is tackled, the raider is out and previously tagged defenders are revived.
pe-05971: 1) Every student wears two tags (bands) around their waist and dribbles their own soccer ball.2) While keeping control of their ball, players try to kick opponents' balls out of the area.3) If a player's ball is kicked out, they surrender one tag; the player with the most tags remaining wins.
pe-05972: 1) Fold a heart-shaped sheet of paper slightly in half and place it on your head.2) Tilt or shake your head to make the paper fall off.3) Catch the falling paper with your hands and count how many times you succeed in one minute.
pe-05973: 1) Two players face each other and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The winner of each round stacks one cone onto the tower.3) Cones can be stacked upside down or upright, and whoever knocks down the tower loses.
pe-05974: 1) Prepare 12 stacking cups, holding 6 in the right hand, 5 in the left hand, and leaving 1 cup aside.2) Alternate hands to line up 6 cups on the bottom row and 5 cups on the top row without gaps.3) Use the remaining cup to slide and push from the end, collapsing all cups together in one motion.
pe-05975: 1) Select one tagger, blindfold them, and place them in the center of the area.2) Other players make noises or move silently to one of the four corners within a 10-second countdown.3) The blindfolded tagger points to one corner based on sound, and players in that area are eliminated.
pe-05976: 1) The tagger stands in front and the runner places their hand on the tagger's shoulder as both walk forward.2) After at least ten steps, the runner releases their hand at any time and sprints back to the safe zone.3) The tagger turns around immediately upon feeling the hand leave their shoulder and tries to tag the runner.
pe-05977: 1) Catch a ball rolled down a desk angled at 45 degrees toward a paper plate target attached to a water bottle.2) Throw the ball underhand to hit the target.3) Measure the time taken to hit the target a set number of times (3 to 5 hits) to break the record.
pe-05978: 1) Group members line up and keep a ping-pong ball bouncing on paddles while moving around a turn marker.2) Attempt to complete the course without dropping the ball, either via one bounce or continuous direct hits, timed for speed.3) If a student struggles and misses three times, a teammate may assist or take over.
pe-05979: 1) Practice one-ball juggling drills such as tossing and catching after clapping, touching the floor, turning around, or tapping head, shoulders, and knees.2) Practice scooping a single ball upward within the body frame to the opposite hand for at least 5 minutes.3) For two-ball juggling, toss the second ball from underneath just as the first ball reaches its peak, chanting "1, 2, 3, 4" rhythmically.
pe-05980: 1) Lie down on your back and clamp a toilet paper roll between both feet.2) Raise your legs using core abdominal strength to drop the roll into a basket placed above your head.3) Attempt to score target rolls (10 rolls) within a 1-minute time limit.
pe-05981: 1) Runner 1 dashes forward and constructs a hoop castle structure using 6 hula hoops.2) Once built, Runner 2 throws balls attempting to land them inside the hoop castle.3) If it collapses, rebuild it, and the team that successfully sinks 3 balls first wins.
pe-05982: 1) Crumple paper and place it inside a sock to make a sock ball2) Hit the ball against the wall continuously with your hands3) Count the consecutive hits before dropping it, attempting twice for the better record
pe-05983: 1) Push 4 classroom desks together to form a center hole (black hole) and place numbered spots at varying distances.2) Take turns throwing fun sticks toward the black hole from a chosen spot.3) If the fun stick lands in the black hole, collect the score of that spot.4) If missed, the thrower (or entire team) must perform 2 jumping jacks.5) When all sticks are thrown or time expires, add up the scores to determine the winner.
pe-05984: 1) Bounce a dodgeball off the floor to land it on a desk or chair.2) Perform the exercise shown on the landed side for the designated repetitions.3) Rotate turns so all teammates can participate.
