pe-05985: 1) Two players face each other, play rock-paper-scissors, and the loser throws a beanbag toward the opponent's hoop first.2) If the beanbag misses, the thrower must run one full circle around their own hoop.3) The winner acts as defender and throws a beanbag while the challenger runs around the hoop.4) The player who successfully lands two beanbags into the hoop wins.
pe-05986: 1) Throw balls into an inverted cone.2) The player who successfully lands 6 balls first wins.3) The game can be modified by throwing directly or bouncing the ball into the cone.
pe-05987: 1) Lay out six colors of spot markers in rows on the floor and stand at the starting line.2) Roll the dice (or scooter board) and move the spot marker of the rolled color forward by one space.3) The team or student whose assigned color reaches the finish line first wins.
pe-05988: 1) Inflate balloons to fit into classroom lockers and place one in each open locker cubby.2) Stand behind the throwing line and throw dart pins (or sharpened pencils) to hit and pop the balloons.3) The team that pops all their assigned locker balloons first wins the game.
pe-05989: 1) Spike Dodgeball: Players must only spike the ball with their hands to hit opponents; bounce balls do not result in outs2) Hand Jokgu: Teams hit the ball over the spot-marker center line within one bounce using only hands3) Rugby Football: Score 1 point by catching a throw or 3 points by kicking into the scoring zone to a teammate outside the circle
pe-05990: 1) Each student receives 2 Ttakji paper tiles and places one on a desk or chair2) Strike your tile against the target tile to flip it over (tiles falling off to the floor do not count)3) The first student to flip the tile a set number of times (e.g. 4 times) sits down to record ranking, optionally doing jumping jacks per flip
pe-05991: 1) Lay out ten numbered disc cones from 1 to 10 randomly across a table or floor.2) Students stand facing backwards waiting for the start signal.3) On signal, turn around quickly and stack the disc cones in numerical order from 1 to 10.4) The student who finishes stacking all 10 cones correctly first wins.
pe-05992: 1) One player stands in each of the four numbered squares and hits the ball into another square after one bounce.2) A player who makes a fault moves down to square 1 while others rotate up.3) Only the player in square 4 scores points, and the game can also be played as Floor Square by placing a mini goal in the center.
pe-05993: 1) Watch the teacher or screen closely to learn the basic dance steps.2) Step in place and turn side to side to the beat of exciting music.3) Connect hand gestures and turns smoothly according to the musical rhythm to express movement.
pe-05994: 1) Stack 12 cups together in a single pile2) Divide the stack into two piles of 6 cups alternating both hands3) Stop the timer to record the total elapsed time
pe-05995: 1) Start from the designated starting line on signal2) Throw balls to knock down targets in order starting from the closest one3) After knocking down all targets, run to blow the whistle first
pe-05996: 1) Divide into Dome team and Dish team with cones placed across the area.2) At the signal, players attempt a cone flip challenge from their spots.3) Only players who successfully flip and land a cone may run out and turn a cone to their team's side.4) When time is called (about 1 minute), the team with the most cones facing their side wins.
pe-05997: 1) Pull the balloon to fire the air cannon.2) A teammate catches the ball with a cup.3) The shooter and catcher switch roles.4) The team with more balls in the set time wins.
pe-05998: 1) Run from the start line and attempt a bottle flip.2) If successful, move to the next colored paper line.3) If you fail, perform jumping jacks and try again.4) Succeed four times in total.
pe-05999: 1) Roll the dice and advance markers by the number rolled.2) Perform the fitness task shown on the spot for the specified repetitions.3) Complete the task to get another turn to roll the dice.4) The first team to reach the finish spot wins.
pe-06000: 1) Run one full lap around the outside of the circular markers on signal.2) Enter the center to grab a bowling pin or throw a ball to knock it down.3) Score points by being the first to grab or knock down a pin.
pe-06001: 1) Set up a tower target with tiered points: 50 points for the bottom, 100 points for the middle, and 300 points for the top.2) Take turns throwing balls to hit each target tier.3) Earn the corresponding level's points each time a target is hit to compete for total scores.
pe-06002: 1) Each team finds and collects cards 2, 12, and 9 from playing cards.2) Roll two dice on your turn.3) If the sum of the dice is any number other than 2, 12, or 9, perform 2 jumping jacks.
pe-06003: 1) Place an equipment basket lightly on top of a traffic cone.2) Play rock-paper-scissors and take turns throwing beanbags.3) Knock down the basket and earn points based on the number of beanbags landed inside.4) Adjust difficulty by turning the basket vertically or rolling balls instead of throwing.
pe-06005: 1) Place the Koosh ball on the back of the hand and bounce it gently with one or both hands to maintain balance2) Alternate between palms and the back of hands, bounce while turning, or lightly kick it up like jegichagi3) Bounce the ball and step onto spot markers to score points in fun extension games
pe-06006: 1) Teams line up at the starting line with numbered cones gathered in the center.2) One runner at a time runs out to find the number their team needs in order from 1.3) Observe the numbers lifted by other teams and retrieve them when needed.4) The next runner starts only after the previous runner arrives, and the team that completes up to 10 first wins.
pe-06007: 1) Set up 4 pins and stand at a distance.2) Roll the ball to knock down all 4 pins in a single throw for a strike.3) If not knocked down in one try, roll a second ball to hit the remaining pins.
pe-06008: 1) The kicker kicks the ball and runs around the outer bases heading back toward home.2) The fielding team retrieves the ball and passes it successively around the inner circle/bases toward home.3) If the runner reaches home before the ball arrives, they score; if the ball arrives first, the runner is out.
pe-06009: 1) Students stand at their desks and play Rock-Paper-Scissors against the teacher.2) In the Master game, students who win or tie stay standing while those who lose sit down until the final champions remain.3) In the Telepathy game, only students who show the exact same gesture as the teacher match and stay in the game.
pe-06010: 1) Roll the dice from the starting line on signal.2) Move to the spot marker that matches the rolled number or color.3) Students whose number did not appear run to touch the gym wall and return.
pe-06011: 1) Hang team bibs between chairs to make an obstacle and place an inverted umbrella behind it.2) Throw a ball from behind the line over the bibs obstacle into the umbrella.3) Compete for points within a set time (1 to 2 minutes) using a timer.
pe-06012: 1) One player steps on the placard sled while three teammates pull it across the floor.2) Turn around the turning point and return to the start line.3) The rider switches to pulling, rotating roles among the 4 members in a relay.
pe-06013: 1) Form teams of four players each.2) The teacher draws one card from number cards 1 through 12 without looking.3) The team with the jump count closest to the card number gets 1 point, and accurately matching the number earns 2 points.
pe-06014: 1) The leader stands in front and passes the volleyball to the team member facing them.2) The receiver passes the ball back to the leader and moves to the back or side of the formation.3) When the last member receives and passes the ball, the group splits and that member moves up to become the new leader.
pe-06015: 1) Select four students to place numbered saucer cones from 1 to 10 on their heads without looking at duplicate numbers2) Runners run out and whisper a number from 1 to 10 to each cone-holder to guess their hidden number3) After identifying all four numbers, runners calculate the sum and whisper the final answer to the teacher
pe-06016: 1) Teams search for cards in reverse order from 10 to 1, using a total of 32 cards including freeze and chance cards.2) When a freeze card is drawn and 'Freeze' is called, other teams must stop moving and cards can be taken.3) When a chance card is drawn, the player can keep revealing cards undisturbed until they find what they need.
pe-06017: 1) Stand the opponent's block and challenge through 7 stages: Foot, Knees, Hand, Belly, Shoulder, Head, and Blind2) Carry the block on each body part, walk over, and drop it to knock down the opponent's block3) If you fail, the turn passes and you resume from the failed stage on your next turn4) In the final blind stage, throw your block, close your eyes, walk forward, and kick to knock it down
pe-06018: 1) Set up colored spot markers on the floor and two players stand facing each other.2) Place the called hand or foot onto the designated colored spot marker according to the leader's call.3) Maintain balance while twisting, and the player whose body touches the floor first loses.
pe-06019: 1) Set up 20 spot markers (5x4) on the floor, with the teacher predetermining a hidden path of 8 steps (moving forward, horizontally, or diagonally).2) The first runner steps on spot markers one by one to find the correct path.3) The teacher calls 'correct' or 'wrong'; on a wrong call, the runner returns and the next player tries using the memorized path.
pe-06020: 1) Place two cups upside down along the edge of the desk leaving a gap.2) Slide another cup with your hand from the opposite side toward the gap between the two cups.3) Control the push so the cup slides precisely between them and scores inside.
pe-06021: 1) Set up six corners numbered 1 through 6.2) Players compete at each corner, and only the winner advances to the next corner.3) Players complete missions such as rock-paper-scissors and spinning three times before kicking and catching a shoe to clear all 6 corners first.
pe-06022: 1) The first runners from each team run toward each other holding a ball.2) They play rock-paper-scissors where they meet; the loser steps aside and returns to their line.3) The winner keeps advancing while the next runner from the opposing team dashes out to block them.4) The team that steps on the opponent's end spot marker first or touches it more times wins.
pe-06023: 1) A leader tosses two balloons into the air simultaneously from an elevated spot.2) The thrower launches three flying discs one by one toward the falling balloons.3) Points are scored whenever a thrown flying disc hits a descending balloon before it lands.
pe-06024: 1) Every participant steps into a hula hoop around their ankles and moves with legs spread wide.2) The designated tagger also keeps the hoop around the ankles and chases other players.3) When tagged, both players give each other a high-five three times and swap roles immediately.
pe-06025: 1) Arrange multiple dish cones on a table and assign different score values to each zone.2) Bounce a table tennis ball onto the floor or table surface toward the targets.3) If the ball lands inside or grazes cones along its path, score the sum of all cones it touched.
pe-06026: 1) Team runners sprint to the turnaround mark to check number cards (stacking cups).2) The 1st and 2nd runners bring cards back visibly, while the 3rd runner keeps theirs concealed.3) If the sum of all three cards matches the teacher's magic number (e.g., 20), the team succeeds.4) If the total is incorrect, subsequent runners return 1 card and swap it for a different number.
pe-06027: 1) The champion and challenger play rock-paper-scissors, and the loser challenges first.2) The challenger throws a beanbag into the opponent's hula hoop.3) If the beanbag lands inside, the opponent must perform a designated exercise such as burpees.
pe-06028: 1) Bounce a ping pong ball once off the surface aiming into a row of lined-up cups.2) Advance to the next cup once the ball successfully lands in the first cup.3) Continue bouncing the ball into the cups step by step through each subsequent level.4) The player who successfully lands the ball into the final designated target cup first wins.
pe-06029: 1) The commander of each team sits at the base holding 10 ddakji tiles while runners wait.2) On the signal, a runner takes one tile from their commander and sprints to the distant battlefield.3) If the runner flips an opponent's tile, they take both tiles back to their commander.4) If they fail to flip it, they leave their tile on the battlefield and return to their commander for a new tile.5) Teams that run out of tiles visit the head commander (teacher) to complete physical exercise missions and receive more tiles.
pe-06030: 1) Toss a fleece ball into the air and catch it with both hands or one hand.2) Toss the ball upward and catch it after clapping multiple times or touching the floor.3) Balance the ball on the back of hands or feet, or toss and catch it using stacking cups held in both hands.
pe-06031: 1) Play with moving goals where two students hold fun sticks and move toward the rolling ball to form a goal.2) Play with elastic goals where the goal width expands by one cone space after each score to increase defensive challenge.3) Play with tiered scoring where passing between wide cones earns 1 point, hitting a cone scores 2 points, and passing through the narrow middle scores 3 points.
pe-06032: 1) Place a cone upside down on top of your head.2) Bounce a small ball (table tennis ball) firmly onto the floor.3) Move your head and body to catch the bouncing ball inside the cone on your head.
pe-06033: 1) Set up traffic cones and line up at the starting line.2) Place a ring on a designated body part such as the palm, back of the hand, elbow, head, or foot.3) Walk without dropping the ring, hook it onto the cone, and return.
pe-06034: 1) Place a roll of toilet paper on your foot and flick it up into the air.2) Juggle the roll three consecutive times using your feet.3) After three juggles, kick it with a volley shot before it hits the ground.
pe-06035: 1) Students pair up and cones, markers, or wall spots are placed around the gym.2) One student hides a small item in one hand and pairs play rock-paper-scissors.3) The loser must run around another pair's cone or designated wall before returning to guess the hand.
pe-06036: 1) Place hula hoops in the back of each team's court with bowling pins inside them.2) Players throw balls from their own territory to knock down the opponent's pins while blocking incoming balls.3) The team that knocks down all of the opponent's pins first wins the game.
pe-06037: 1) Set up stacking cups with different point values (1, 2, 3 points) at designated spots.2) Throw the ball directly into the cup or bounce it off the floor into the cup from behind the line.3) Take a set number of throws (e.g., 3 to 4 turns) and total the scores based on the cups landed.
pe-06038: 1) Take 2 cups with your left hand and slide them across.2) Stack 3 on the right and 3 on the left to build a 6-cup pyramid.3) Build another 6-cup pyramid on the other side.4) Downstack both sides by separating the cups into a 3-3 structure to finish.
pe-06039: 1) Place six numbered cones (1 to6) upside down like domes.2) Roll a die and run to the cone matching the rolled number to flip it right side up into a dish shape.3) Perform the agreed physical task (e.g., two jumping jacks) each turn until all cones are successfully turned into dishes.
pe-06040: 1) Set up an obstacle or net using desks, and have players line up on one side.2) The first runner taps the balloon over the net and quickly moves to the other side.3) Players continuously keep the balloon in the air until the entire team finishes moving back and forth, timing the run.
pe-06041: 1) Choose a tagger holding a disc cone while other students move freely within the area.2) The tagger freezes players by tapping their backs with a finger.3) Moving players can attempt to call out and identify the tagger within a set number of steps (e.g., 5 steps) to catch them.
pe-06042: 1) Two players play rock-paper-scissors with their feet2) The winner calls out a sport before revealing a beanbag (e.g., Don't tell me it's baseball?)3) If the revealed beanbag does not match the guess, the player takes it; otherwise, they leave it
pe-06043: 1) Toss a beanbag up and catch it 20 times.2) Toss a beanbag up, clap, and catch it.3) Toss a beanbag up, touch the floor, and catch it.4) Toss a beanbag up, spin around in place, and catch it.5) Toss a beanbag up, touch body parts (head, head-shoulders, head-shoulders-knees, head-shoulders-knees-feet), and catch it.
pe-06044: 1) Spread multiple numbered saucer cones across the floor.2) Determine the turn order using rock-paper-scissors.3) Kick your saucer cone to hit a cone on the opposite side.4) Take the cone you hit, and the successful player continues kicking.
pe-06045: 1) Set up diamond stations representing home, 1st, 2nd, and 3rd bases.2) Players run from each side along the base path and play rock-paper-scissors when they meet.3) The winner continues running toward the next base.4) The player who completes the designated number of laps (e.g., 2 laps) around the bases wins.
pe-06046: 1) The first runner carries a ball around the turning point and returns.2) Upon returning, the runner rolls or tosses the ball into the jumbo stack cup.3) Once the ball successfully enters the jumbo cup, retrieve the ball and pass it to the next teammate.4) The next teammate repeats the same running and shooting process.
pe-06047: 1) Place 16 jumbo stack cups in the center with numbered cones and beanbags placed together.2) On the start signal, players run to the center to check the colors of the cone and the item underneath.3) Players can only take the set back to their team base if both items match in color.4) If the colors do not match, the items must be left in their exact original place.5) The team that collects the most matching color pairs within the time limit wins.
pe-06048: 1) Two teams stand facing each other and designate offense and defense roles.2) A defender may step only one foot back or aside to dodge the attacker's tag attempt.3) An attacker steps forward with one foot and tries to tag the opposing player.4) A defender who fails to dodge and gets tagged is either eliminated or joins the opposing team.5) The team with the most players remaining at the end of the time limit wins.
pe-06049: 1) The leader calls out the rhythmic chant "Tick-tock, tick-tock, what time is it?".2) The leader and students simultaneously show a clock time using arm positions (both hands up for 12, horizontal for 9 or 3, down for 6).3) Students who show the exact same time as the leader match successfully.4) In pair mode, partners stand back-to-back and turn around on the final count to reveal their arm positions.5) If both partners show the same clock time, they give each other a high-five to celebrate.
pe-06050: 1) Hold the cup by its side with one hand and toss a ping-pong ball upward with the other hand.2) Bounce the ball off the side of the cup and catch it inside the cup opening.3) Earn 1 point for bouncing once and catching, and 2 points for bouncing twice.4) Increase the bounces for higher points and challenge for the highest score in 1 minute.
pe-06051: 1) Runner 1 throws a flying disc to knock down bowling pins.2) Runner 1 passes the disc to the next teammate and runs forward to reset any fallen pins.3) After resetting the pins, the runner rushes back to the line.4) Continue this relay for 3 to 5 minutes to record the highest total pin score.
pe-06052: 1) Pack bags and hang them on chairs before starting.2) Move while the tagger chants, and if caught moving, return to the chair and start over from putting the bag on.3) The first student to step out through the classroom door wins and leaves for home first.
pe-06053: 1) Stand on a spot marker and play rock-paper-scissors with another person.2) The winner stays in place while the loser hops on one foot to find another opponent.3) Accumulate wins and sit down once the target score is reached.
pe-06054: 1) On start, alternate foot taps twice and jump forward toward the sock balls.2) Dribble the sock ball back from side to side with your feet.3) Grip the sock ball between both feet and jump to toss it into the basket within 1 minute.
pe-06055: 1) Four players stand on their central spot markers and get ready.2) On start, collect scattered numbered disc cones one by one in numerical order from 1 to 10.3) The player who collects all 10 disc cones sequentially onto their central marker first wins.
pe-06056: 1) Face your partner and get ready.2) For two-hand RPS, form and present the same sign with both hands simultaneously.3) For foot RPS, jump twice in place and form the chosen shape with your feet upon landing (scissor, paper, rock).
pe-06057: 1) Three students form a group, with the middle student holding a hoop.2) The other two pass the ball to each other through the hoop (hitting the hoop doesn't count).3) Rotate roles, and in the next step, pass around the hoop while the defender moves it to block.
pe-06058: 1) Place a Jumbo Stack cup on a desk and throw mini spot markers from a distance.2) Score 10 points if the marker enters the cup directly.3) Score 50 points if the partner student redirects the flying marker into the cup.
pe-06059: 1) Scatter various balls across the floor.2) Roll a hoop from the starting line and let it roll until it stops.3) Collect the balls or items that end up inside the stopped hoop.
pe-06060: 1) Hide treasure and blank slips under 2 of the 20 spot markers placed on the floor.2) The seeker team's leader looks away while teammates run in place faster as the leader gets closer to the treasure.3) The leader follows the running cues to flip spot markers and find the treasure within limited attempts.
pe-06061: 1) Build a hoop castle by placing one hula hoop flat on the floor and leaning two hoops inside it.2) Once player 1 finishes assembling the castle, player 2 throws a ball to knock it down.3) Players rotate positions after throwing, and the previous builder returns to the line.4) The team that successfully knocks down the hoop castle 3 times (or 2 times) first wins.
pe-06062: 1) Run to the turning point, grab a cone, and attempt a cone flip at the starting area.2) If the cone flip is successful, roll two dice and add the sum to your total score.3) Repeat running and flipping until a player or team reaches a cumulative score of 100 first.
pe-06063: 1) Place cones numbered 1 through 6 in order.2) A runner rolls a die and runs toward the cone matching the rolled number.3) The runner turns around that numbered cone and returns to the starting line.4) Pass the turn to the next runner until the entire team finishes.
pe-06064: 1) A player tagged by the tagger lies down on the floor to become the meat patty.2) Two other teammates lie down on either side to act as buns and complete a hamburger.3) Once the hamburger is made, the rescued player comes back to life and rejoins the game.4) The tagger cannot tag players who are actively helping a teammate.
pe-06065: 1) Tie a jump rope to a hoop, toss it, and pull it back to catch targets in a fishing game.2) Step inside a moving hoop pulled by a partner and walk forward without touching the hoop.3) Dribble a basketball inside the moving hoop as a partner gently pulls it forward.
pe-06066: 1) A player tagged by the tagger freezes in place with their legs spread wide apart.2) Another player thaws them by crawling through their legs from back to front.3) The unfrozen player can move and run away again.4) The tagger cannot touch players while they are actively freeing a frozen teammate.
pe-06067: 1) Place a cup on the floor and stand upright in front of it.2) Hold a cup under your eye while keeping your back completely straight.3) Drop the cup from eye level to try to land it inside the cup on the floor.
pe-06068: 1) Position one or two players on each mat on opposite sides of a net.2) Hit the balloon with your hand over the net toward the opponent's mat.3) Two consecutive hits by the same player are not allowed, so return it immediately.4) Score a point when the balloon lands on the opponent's mat, while hitting out of bounds gives a point to the opponent.
pe-06069: 1) Form lines by group facing the turning cone.2) Squeeze a soccer ball between ankles and hop forward on both feet.3) Jump around the turning point and return to the starting line.4) Hand off the ball to the next runner by popping it up using ankles rather than simply picking it up with hands.
pe-06070: 1) Spread out mini spot markers on classroom desks.2) Run from the starting line on cue and cover a mini spot marker on the desk using your own large spot marker.3) Return to tag the next teammate's hand to take turns.4) The team that covers and claims the most markers wins.
pe-06071: 1) One team sits on chairs in the middle of the court while the opposing team rolls a gym ball to hit them.2) Hit players are eliminated, move behind the court, complete a assigned physical activity, and wait.3) Defending players receive 2-3 revival bands so that each time they are eliminated, they can submit a band to re-enter play.
pe-06072: 1) Three players play rock-paper-scissors together.2) A solo winner or solo loser stacks 2 cups.3) If all three tie, each player stacks 1 cup.4) If the cups collapse, start over.5) The player with the most stacked cups within the time limit wins.
pe-06073: 1) Build a basic tower of stacking cups about 5 layers high in advance.2) Determine the order by playing rock-paper-scissors, and the winner stacks cups upwards.3) Initially, overlap cups within their rim thickness, then gradually offset them more to increase difficulty.4) The player who knocks down the tower loses and performs an exercise penalty.
pe-06074: 1) Place a single shoe as a target at a designated distance from the starting point.2) Alternate feet touching the top of the sock ball with toe touches three times.3) Kick the sock ball using the inside of the foot to hit the shoe target.4) Score one point for each successful hit and challenge for the highest score within given turns.
pe-06075: 1) Teams take turns throwing a flying disc from the starting line at three bowling pin targets.2) If a throw misses the target, the thrower or the whole team must run back and forth four times around the designated spot.3) If a target is hit, retrieve the disc safely, hand it to the next thrower, and continue.4) The team that knocks down all three bowling pins first wins the game.
pe-06076: 1) Line up 9 cups horizontally as a base track.2) Place a set of 3 stacked cups at the starting position on top.3) Move the cups along the track using alternate hands like a train on a rail.4) Measure the time taken to reach the end.
pe-06077: 1) Hold a cup tied with string like a fishing rod on the desk.2) Use the suspended cup to fish up paper cups from the floor.3) Stack the 6 fished cups one by one into another cup on the desk.4) The player who finishes catching all 6 cups fastest wins.
pe-06078: 1) Roll a dice dodgeball and earn points corresponding to traditional yut moves based on the rolled number.2) After rolling, decide whether to roll again ('Go') to accumulate points or keep the points ('Stop').3) If you roll a 1, all accumulated points for that turn reset to 0, and the turn passes to the opposing team.4) Teams take turns, and the first team to reach the target score (e.g., 30 points) wins.
pe-06079: 1) Place numbered dome cones face down and assign a sequence mission such as odd numbers then even numbers (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10).2) A runner dashes forward, lifts one cone, and shows the number to their teammates.3) Teammates remember the numbers and locate all the cones in the designated mission order.
pe-06080: 1) Place a target ball in the center and give players balls to throw.2) Throw balls to hit the target ball into the opposing team's goal to score 2 points.3) Hitting an opposing player directly with a thrown ball earns 1 point, and players quickly retrieve nearby balls to continue shooting.
pe-06081: 1) Set up holes 1 to 3 using hula hoops and mark each tee area with a mini spot marker.2) Rest the foam stick on the back of your hand like a pool cue and strike the ball into each hula hoop.3) Count the total number of strokes taken to complete holes 1 through 3; the player with fewer strokes wins.
pe-06082: 1) Two players face each other and agree to cross to their left side.2) On signal, both toss scarves high and move to catch the partner's scarf.3) Step back one pace after each success to increase the tossing distance.4) In a circle formation, toss scarves simultaneously and catch the scarf of the person to the right or skip one person.
pe-06083: 1) Prepare one balloon and numbered cups from 1 to 12.2) Keep tapping the balloon in the air so it does not fall.3) While keeping the balloon up, stack cups 1 through 12 in order with cup 1 at the bottom and cup 12 at the top.4) If the balloon drops, spread the cups out and start over.
pe-06084: 1) Attach a rope to a scooter board and place targets on top.2) One person pulls the rope slowly to move the scooter board.3) The shooter aims at and hits the moving targets on the scooter board.
pe-06085: 1) Hold the handle near the back end with the thumb securing the grip correctly.2) Keep elbows close to the body and rotate the rope using wrist action rather than swinging the whole arms.3) Keep heels slightly lifted and bounce lightly on the balls of the feet about 1 to 1.5 cm off the floor.
pe-06086: 1) Learn 8 locomotor skills (walking, running, skipping, galloping, hopping, jumping, side-stepping, leaping) displayed on 4 cones.2) Play rock-paper-scissors against the teacher, and only the winners take off.3) Complete the first lap movements, flip the task card on the cone, and complete the second lap.
pe-06087: 1) Students tagged or eliminated in games move to the fitness recharge station.2) Perform assigned physical exercises (jumping jacks, squats, burpees, planks, etc.) for the designated repetitions or duration.3) Return to the ongoing game immediately upon completing the task.
pe-06088: 1) Wait at the starting line and run to the beanbag area upon the start signal.2) Flip over two beanbags to reveal their colors or symbols.3) Take both beanbags if they match; if they do not match, turn them face down again and return to tag the next player.
pe-06089: 1) Run from the starting point to the designated spot marker.2) Bounce a ping-pong ball off the floor into a target cup.3) Once a ball lands in a cup, flip the cup over and return to tag the next teammate.4) The first team to flip all 10 cups wins.
pe-06090: 1) Lay number cards from 1 to 10 face down and have each team line up at the starting line.2) On the signal, one runner dashes forward, checks a card, and takes it back to the team only if it is the next number in sequence starting from 1.3) If the card is not the correct number, place it face down again and run back.4) When the final card number 10 is reached, all team members run out together to retrieve it and cross the finish line.
pe-06091: 1) Prepare 10 stacking cups numbered 1 through 10.2) Look at the displayed card pattern and cup arrangements.3) On start, build the cup castle matching the card's exact number layout, and raise a hand upon completion.
pe-06092: 1) Place a cup slightly off the desk edge and flip it with fingers to land upright.2) Perform 5 squats upon each successful cup landing.3) Place your team's marker on a 3x3 spot-marker board to complete 3-in-a-row or claim more spots to win.
pe-06093: 1) When tagged, freeze as a urinal (arms spread) or a sitting toilet (crouched with an arm lever extended).2) A free teammate pushes the arm down or presses the lever with a flushing sound to rescue them.3) In an alternate rule, frozen players pose as showers and get rescued by pretending to shower after pressing the lever.
pe-06094: 1) Start the 1-minute timer and run to the first shooting station2) Load the dart blaster in a prone position and shoot at the targets3) Navigate and hurdle over obstacle equipment4) Move to the second station and shoot at the targets from a prone position again5) Cross the balance beam obstacles and stop the timer within 1 minute while scoring points based on targets hit.
pe-06095: 1) One player places both feet inside a hula hoop and holds a plank position.2) The tagger positions themselves near the planking player's head.3) The tagger circles around to tag the planking player's foot.4) Alternatively, the tagger can use a cut foam noodle instead of hands to tag the foot.
pe-06096: 1) Crumple 2 sheets of paper to make one small and one large paper ball.2) Perform a squat and throw then catch the large paper ball upon standing up.3) Count the number of successful squat catches performed with proper form in 1 minute.
pe-06097: 1) Divide players into standing 'Up' team and seated 'Down' team.2) Up team and Down team members face each other in rock-paper-scissors.3) The winner stands up (Up team) and the loser sits down (Down team) to change sides.
pe-06098: 1) The batter gets three consecutive chances to throw a ping pong ball from a cup.2) If the ball goes into the defender's cup below, the batter is out.3) Points are scored based on the number of bounces outside the cup, with a maximum cap such as 15 points.
pe-06099: 1) Both teams sit facing each other and decide the serving order.2) Players serve the ball toward the saucer cones placed on the floor.3) Hitting a saucer cone allows the player to claim it, and the team with the most cones wins.
pe-06100: 1) Desks are arranged in a row, and the first runner rushes toward the desk.2) The player throws gonggi stones and attempts the catching phase on the back of the hand.3) The player shouts out the points scored, runs back to tag the next teammate's back, and the team reaching the goal first wins.
pe-06101: 1) Determine ranks by rock-paper-scissors and position players in zones 4 through 1.2) Perform assigned individual missions such as bottle flips or jumping jacks.3) Rotate and advance positions upon success to reach and maintain zone 4.
pe-06102: 1) Throw a small ball into a stacking cup hoop secured with a rubber band.2) Check the score, retrieve the ball, pass it to the next player, and move to the back of the line.3) Rotate continuously while upbeat music plays to accumulate points.
pe-06103: 1) Roll an A4 sheet of paper and wrap tape around the top, middle, and bottom to form a paper stick, and prepare a pair of rolled socks.2) Perform a preparatory exercise such as ski jumps (side-to-side hops) or a squat before tossing the socks.3) Toss the socks into the air and catch them using the paper stick, counting total catches completed in one minute.
pe-06104: 1) Use a double-sided marker and designate one side as Head and the other side as Tail.2) Students pick either Head or Tail, and the teacher flips the marker into the air.3) Students who guessed correctly perform a set exercise (such as 5 or 15 squats) and receive praise upon completion.
pe-06105: 1) Place numbered target markers on the floor, positioning higher scores further away from the throwing line.2) Players stand at the throwing line and throw beanbags with one hand aiming to land them directly on the markers.3) Points are scored only when the beanbag lands on top of a marker, and scores are totaled after rounds.
pe-06106: 1) Learn the three set poses for Giant, Wolf, and Wizard.2) Follow the rule where Giant beats Wolf, Wolf beats Wizard, and Wizard beats Giant.3) Show a pose simultaneously on cue to determine the winner.
pe-06107: 1) Stack 3 or 4 cups together to start.2) Repeatedly move the top cup to the bottom one by one.3) Continue cycling until the starting colored cup returns to its original position.
pe-06108: 1) All students play Rock-Paper-Scissors together with the teacher on count.2) In 'Tie or Lose', only students who tie or lose survive, and winners are eliminated.3) In 'Sit or Stand', players choose to sit or stand during Rock-Paper-Scissors, and only the minority survives.
pe-06109: 1) Set up 6 cones in a grid at each goal and pyramid-stack 10 activity cups in the center.2) Divide students into teams to play soccer using a foam ball.3) Kicking the ball to knock down opponent cones or cups scores points equal to the number toppled; knocking down own cones while clearing counts as an own goal.
pe-06110: 1) Walk around freely, greet partners you encounter, and play rock-paper-scissors.2) The loser marks a single dot with a pen on the winner's back of the hand.3) The player with the most dots when time is up wins.
pe-06111: 1) The batter hits the ball with a fist and sprints around two cones back to the home spot marker.2) Defending players must pass the caught ball so that every teammate touches it once.3) The last defender steps on the central loop to force an out; if the batter touches home first, they score.
pe-06112: 1) The first runners from each team hold a ball and jump over numbered cones forward.2) When runners meet in the middle, they stop and play rock-paper-scissors.3) The loser runs back to hand the ball to the next runner, while the winner continues forward.
pe-06114: 1) In pairs, one person tosses the ball and the partner hits it with a fist.2) Both players run around designated 1-point or 2-point zones to score.3) If defense secures the ball first, runners are out.
pe-06115: 1) Place a stacking cup upside down, slightly hanging over the edge of the desk.2) Flick the bottom rim of the cup upward with fingers to make it flip in the air.3) Land the cup upright on the desk surface.4) Repeat until successfully landing the target number of times (e.g., 3 or 5 times).5) Upon completing the flips, perform 10 jumping jacks and sit down.
pe-06116: 1) Teams line up at assigned stations along the perimeter of a large circle.2) On the signal, the runner dashes to complete the 3-3-3 stacking and down-stacking pattern.3) The runner sprints around the outside track of the circle.4) Tag the next teammate, and returning runners stack/nest the cups into a single column.5) The first team to have all runners complete the cycle and nest the cups wins.
pe-06117: 1) Hold the horse stick with one hand and control the ring using only the other hand.2) Pass the ring to hit the target area to score.3) Limit possession time to maximum 2 seconds per person to keep the pace fast.
pe-06118: 1) Lie or sit on the floor and stack a 3-tier cup pyramid (3-2-1) using only your feet.2) Once your feet leave the floor, they must not touch the ground until completion.3) Stack the cups in any order using only your feet.4) Challenge yourself to finish within a time limit such as a 1-minute challenge.
pe-06119: 1) Teams pass the ball and shoot at the rebounder frame to score.2) A team may make up to three consecutive passes before taking a shot.3) Defending players cannot intercept passes or engage in physical contact.4) Catching the rebounded ball transfers possession to start the next attack.
pe-06120: 1) Spin the hoop on the floor like a spinning top.2) Perform a designated number of jumping jacks in place.3) Move to catch a partner's or another player's hoop before it falls.
pe-06121: 1) Mark scoring areas with tape on the badminton court.2) Divide into two teams of four and set the serving order.3) Serve diagonally from the service box using forehand or backhand.4) A shuttlecock landing in the target area scores 1 point; each player serves 3 times before rotating.
pe-06122: 1) Divide the activity space into stations: throwing/catching, bouncing, rolling, dribbling, striking with hands, striking with implements, and kicking.2) Practice the specific manipulative movements in pairs or individually using assigned balls and equipment.3) At the batting station, hit a ball off a tee with a bat, and at the kicking station, kick balls using various foot surfaces.
pe-06123: 1) Form groups of 4 and assign roles: #1 Server, #2 Receiver, #3 Setter, #4 Spiker2) #1 serves the ball and #2 receives and passes it to setter #3 at the net3) Setter #3 sets the ball to #4 who hits or spikes it over the net4) Rotate roles after completing 3 repetitions
pe-06124: 1) Form pairs and play against another group by serving diagonally across the court.2) Serve from the right court on zero or even points and from the left on odd points; after scoring, swap sides and serve again.3) Concede 1 point on missed shots, net faults, out-of-bounds, crossing the net, or hitting consecutively; play 3 sets to 15 points.
pe-06125: 1) Divide into two teams, set batting orders and defensive positions on a field with 14m base distances.2) Set runners for each inning (1st on 1st, 2nd on 2nd, 3rd on 2nd/3rd, 4th loaded) and hit the ball off the tee.3) Defense gets outs by catching fly balls or throwing to bases first; score 1 point when reaching home safely, switch after 3 outs, and play 4 innings.
pe-06126: 1) Place one spot marker in the center and four markers 6m away in four directions with 5 players.2) Player 2 passes to center Player 1, who traps the ball and passes it to Player 3.3) Pass counterclockwise like a pinwheel for three full rotations, then switch the center player.
pe-06127: 1) Create physical expression movements and formations matching chosen song lyrics.2) Compose point choreography utilizing both upper and lower body.3) Perform movements sequentially while changing formations such as a vertical line.4) Complete and present the routine conveying the mood and lyrics.
pe-06128: 1) Runners from both teams sprint around the cones toward the ball on signal.2) The one who reaches the ball first dribbles to the shooting spot while the other defends the goal.3) Score 1 point by shooting into the goal from the designated spot.4) The team with the most points within the time limit wins.
pe-06129: 1) Form four 2m radius cone circles in four directions, and have players tuck two tail tags into their waistbands.2) The offense begins by snapping or rolling the rugby ball backward between their legs.3) Offensive players catch passes inside circles to claim them, scoring 1 point upon claiming three out of four circles.4) Getting tagged or losing the ball costs one of five offense attempts, resuming play from that spot.
pe-06130: 1) Two partners face each other 3 to 5 meters apart, placing a target box near the receiver.2) The thrower pitches a soft dice ball slightly past the target box toward the receiver.3) The receiver taps the ball into the box with their hand or body for 1 point, while a direct throw into the box without a tap scores 2 points.
pe-06131: 1) Dribble the floorball ball with a stick zigzagging through cones spaced 2 meters apart in a straight or W-shaped line.2) After clearing the last cone, dribble straight back to the starting line.3) Run as a team relay where the next runner departs once the previous runner turns around the final cone.
pe-06132: 1) Form a team of 5 players (kicker, pitcher, infielder, outfielder, catcher) and place a cone 10m from home base.2) The pitcher rolls the ball, the kicker kicks it, and then runs around the 10m cone and back to home.3) The fielding team must field the ball and pass it through every fielder's hands before throwing to the catcher.4) The kicker scores 1 run if they return before the ball reaches the catcher; otherwise, they are out.5) After each kick, players rotate positions: kicker to pitcher, pitcher to infielder, infielder to outfielder, outfielder to catcher, and catcher to kicker.
pe-06133: 1) Decide an order within the group and take turns placing one foam dice ball at a time to build a tower.2) The player who knocks down the tower on their turn performs three frog jumps as a physical penalty task.3) Play by switching orders via rock-paper-scissors each turn, stacking together on teacher signals, or stacking as high as possible within 30 seconds.
pe-06134: 1) Set up cones 10m to the left and right of home plate, and fielding bases 4m above and below it.2) Batter throws the foam ball in any direction and runs around a cone back to home base.3) Fielders catch and complete at least 3 passes before returning the ball to the fielding base.4) Batter scores 1 point for circling one cone before defense finishes, or 2 points for circling both.5) Teams switch roles after all members bat, playing 2 rounds to determine the winner.
pe-06135: 1) Scatter soft dice balls across the gym and gather all participants inside the area.2) The referee throws the scatter ball up, and players wait until it comes to a complete stop.3) Players quickly identify the top color facing up and race to find a matching colored soft dice ball.4) Players throw their ball at the scatter ball; hitting and moving it qualifies them as safe.5) The round ends when the first 1/3 of players hit the target; remaining players perform fitness tasks.
pe-06136: 1) Hand Jaegi: Strike a soft dice ball with your dominant hand for 1 minute to keep it up (only hits reaching chin height count).2) Challenge hand jaegi across three categories: dominant hand, non-dominant hand, and alternating hands.3) Hand-Foot Jaegi: Kick the ball like jaegi, using your hands to keep it in play if it is about to drop.4) Only kicks count toward the score in hand-foot jaegi across dominant foot, non-dominant foot, and alternating feet.
pe-06137: 1) Four students in each group form a circle in the gymnasium.2) A player bounces the ball once on the floor and kicks it to a teammate.3) Keep the ball moving using hands, feet, or head (direct or after one bounce); sending with feet or head earns 1 point, while hands score 0 points, aiming for the highest score within the time limit.
pe-06138: 1) Divide into four groups and place ball baskets at the corners of a square court.2) Mark a cross-shaped no-movement line inside the court.3) On the start signal, run to an opposing basket and dribble the ball to the no-movement line.4) Pass the ball to a teammate across the no-movement line without dribbling across.5) The receiver dribbles to their own basket to deposit the ball, and the team with the most balls wins.
pe-06139: 1) Pair up so each player has a spot marker and the pair shares one ball.2) Stand facing each other five steps apart and place the spot markers on the ground.3) Successfully catch and throw four times to move the spot markers one step backward.4) If the ball is dropped, restart the count from the beginning and compete to see who reaches the farthest distance within the time limit.
pe-06140: 1) Set up a net on a badminton court, place 6 spot markers on each side, and divide into two teams of 6.2) Serve from the service area to start, allowing the ball to bounce once or be hit directly, passing up to 5 times among teammates before returning over the net.3) Score 1 point if the opposing team fails to return within 5 hits, bounces the ball twice or more, or hits out of bounds.4) Rotate positions clockwise every time the opposing team scores, playing best of 3 sets to 15 points.
pe-06141: 1) Divide into two groups and pair up by twos within each group to determine turns.2) Pair 1 stands facing each other across the net and rallies the shuttlecock.3) Score 1 point each time the shuttlecock is successfully hit across the net.4) If the shuttlecock fails to cross the net, switch with the next pair.5) Play timed rounds per court where the group with the highest rally score wins.
pe-06142: 1) Divide into two teams, decide offense and defense by rock-paper-scissors, and start with the offense passing from the safe zone.2) The player holding the disc may only pivot on one foot and cannot run while holding it.3) Hitting the opponent's goal earns 1 point and getting it inside scores 2 points, with possession switching upon incomplete passes or interceptions.
pe-06143: 1) Divide into 2 teams of 4 players each, assigning 2 field players, 1 hoop holder, and 1 final defender per team.2) Field players cannot cross the half line, can take up to two steps, and are limited to 1 pass between each other.3) Pass the disc through the hoop held by the teammate who moves along the endline using side steps.4) A point is scored if the passed disc stays within the OK line and is not caught by the opposing final defender, and players rotate counterclockwise every 2 points.
pe-06144: 1) Divide into two teams, tuck two team vests into both sides of each player's waist, and line up at the starting lines.2) The attacking team starts by passing the rugby ball backward between their legs.3) Defenders attempt to pull vests or take the ball once the attacker moves; if tagged, restart from that spot with a backward pass.4) Turnover occurs after 5 stops, and touching the ball down in the opponent's end zone scores 1 point.
pe-06145: 1) Pour water into a paper cup and nest another paper cup inside so it floats.2) Place three target paper cups and one goal cup across the playing space.3) Run to touch a designated spot, return, and perform one squat.4) Blow air between the nested paper cups to launch the top cup into a target cup.5) Repeat the shuttle run, squat, and blowing sequence until 3 cups are scored.
pe-06146: 1) Place action spot markers on the floor to visually indicate the starting point and jumping direction for long rope jumping2) Arrange directional markers in a figure-eight path around turners to guide students in figure-eight running long rope3) Create a course with arrow markers where students complete a mission and move cones in a relay format4) Set up bases like baseball and have students play rock-paper-scissors to advance along the arrow markers toward home base
pe-06147: 1) Tuck the end of the toilet paper inside or tape it so it does not unravel.2) Toss the roll upward, clap hands as many times as possible, and catch it while counting claps.3) Toss the roll and clap alternating front and behind the body before catching it.4) Juggle the roll with feet continuously without letting it touch the floor and count the kicks.
pe-06148: 1) Tape two paper cups to the edge of the table.2) Use a single spoon to scoop and place two table tennis balls into each cup.3) Start on a flat surface in level 1, then tilt the table steeper in levels 2 and 3.
pe-06149: 1) Set up 6 paper cups at both starting and finish tables and place chopsticks across pairs of cups like bridges2) Place a chopstick on the back of your hand and walk to the finish table without dropping it to build the bridge3) Measure the total time taken to move all 3 chopsticks4) Increase difficulty by placing the chopsticks on the top of your foot and balancing while moving toward the target
pe-06150: 1) Bend knees and join arms together from elbows to wrists to create a flat passing platform.2) Keep arms parallel to the ground and use knee bounce to bump the ball straight up.3) Practice with a balloon, dodgeball, and volleyball in progressive order.4) Move between cones while maintaining forearm passes without letting the ball drop.
pe-06151: 1) Mark a path on the desk and place 3 paper cups at the starting point.2) Move the paper cups to the finish line across three stages: blowing with mouth, fanning with a hand fan, and releasing air from a balloon.3) If a cup falls off the desk, perform 2 jumping jacks before placing it back to continue.
pe-06152: 1) Form a triangle with your thumbs and index fingers and practice the hand shape to cushion and push the ball up.2) Use knee flexion and extension to gently catch and push a balloon overhead.3) Progress to dodgeballs and volleyballs, bouncing the ball off the fingertips without catching it.4) Set up cones for start and return points to practice overhead passing while moving forward.
pe-06153: 1) Hold a roll of toilet paper and get ready.2) Toss it up and kick it continuously with feet or legs without letting it touch the ground.
pe-06154: 1) Complete 10 jumping jacks as quickly as possible.2) Perform 10 quick jump rope skips.3) Flip 2 milk-carton ttakji tiles over by striking them once each.4) Successfully flip and land a water bottle upright.5) Step back 3 paces and swing the jump rope with the right hand to hit the water bottle.6) Pass the jump rope around legs, in a figure eight, and waist.7) Spin around 5 times with an elephant trunk pose and catch the thrown jump rope.8) Kick and trap the bottle cap twice with feet.9) Place a ttakji tile on the instep, flick it into the air, and catch it by hand.
pe-06155: 1) Set up 3 target cones at a suitable distance and prepare a volleyball.2) Use forearm (underhand) passes to hit and knock down all 3 cones, measuring the time taken.3) Use overhead passes to hit and knock down all 3 cones, measuring the time taken.
pe-06156: 1) Runners sprint from the hoop to the cone grid upon the start signal (horizontal or vertical).2) Swap only two directly adjacent cones horizontally or vertically once, with no diagonal or skip moves allowed.3) Return to the start hoop, place both feet inside, and tag the next runner.4) The next runner repeats the process to complete 3 lines of matching colored cones in the designated direction.
pe-06157: 1) Fielders position themselves behind the restraining line marked with pinnies or saucer cones.2) The kicker kicks the ball and runs.3) If a fielder catches the fly ball directly, the kicker is out.
pe-06158: 1) Set up marker cones in a circle and divide students into 2 teams wearing pinnies.2) Players stand at cones, pass the ball low and fast in the same direction, and rotate one cone at a time.3) Continue passing and running around the circle to overtake the opposing team's ball to win.
pe-06159: 1) At the signal, pick up a disc from the basket and run around the cone.2) Reach the area beside the opposing goal and throw the disc into the goal.3) Scoring first awards 2 points (1 point for goal plus 1 bonus point), scoring second awards 1 point, and if both miss, the next runners go immediately.
pe-06160: 1) Navigate the obstacle course maintaining balance without feet touching the floor.2) Traverse Bosu balls, spot markers, zigzag lines, balance beam, and laser ropes in order.3) The next student starts when the runner ahead reaches the third zigzag obstacle.4) Complete the course twice and sit at the start line.
pe-06161: 1) Group members bounce the ball upward at chest level or dribble basketballs toward the floor.2) Keep bouncing without dropping the ball upon the signal and count repetitions.3) When the stop cue is given, compare bouncing counts with group peers.4) Return the ball to its original place and rotate to the next station.
pe-06162: 1) Hold the racket up in a ready position.2) Hit with a backhand when the shuttlecock comes to the side opposite the racket hand.3) Raise the arm after hitting to form a triangle.4) Pass the shuttlecock to teammates and rotate one spot to the right to practice with the next partner.
pe-06163: 1) Take a ready stance and hold the ball with both hands.2) Bring the ball up to shoulder height on the first cue.3) Step forward with the front foot and throw the ball with one hand on the second cue.4) Throw to your partner and gradually increase the distance between each other.
pe-06164: 1) Number 1 of each group brings the textbook from the desk and opens page 48.2) Sit in a circle for about 2 minutes to study how to run faster by observing body tilt, body height, stride, and limbs.3) After finishing the study, return the textbook and autonomously test and practice zigzag or cross running.
pe-06165: 1) Dance and run along with the music, then freeze immediately when signaled.2) Cooperate with teammates to form Korean alphabet letters using whole bodies.3) After shaping the letter either lying down or standing up, shout out the letter name together.
pe-06166: 1) Students hold hoops and jump ropes at various heights to create a zigzag obstacle path.2) On the 'freeze' signal, students holding the obstacles must stay still.3) Runners take turns navigating through the course without touching the obstacles.4) If you touch an obstacle, honestly judge yourself and return to the back of the line to try again.
pe-06167: 1) Circle around the team spot marker holding hands while music plays, and freeze when told to stop.2) The student whose number is called retrieves a movement card from the basket and places it on the marker.3) All team members imitate the balance posture shown on the card and hold it calmly for 3 seconds until verified.
pe-06168: 1) Two teams attempt the obstacle course while one team serves as referees.2) Referees check if feet touch the floor and reset displaced equipment.3) Eliminated players who touch the floor restart from the beginning.4) The next player departs when the person ahead reaches the third obstacle.5) Successful participants provide feedback to their teammates.6) Teams rotate referee and player roles.
pe-06169: 1) Split into groups where one group practices ball bouncing while the other observes and gives feedback2) Push down to bounce the basketball in a low stance, and keep arms straight at chest height for the balloon volleyball3) Switch roles upon signal and rotate through designated colored floor markers
pe-06170: 1) Gather in groups and discuss positive cooperative behaviors and unhelpful ones.2) Move toward the turning point by placing hula hoops consecutively and stepping inside them without stepping out.3) Once everyone arrives, hold a team meeting to scout and bring over one player from the other team.4) Run around the cone holding the hoop together as a pair, return to the goal line, and sit down in a line.
pe-06171: 1) Stand behind the throw line holding a soccer corner pole over the shoulder in throwing stance.2) Move sideways using a crossover crab-step approach while keeping the throwing arm raised high.3) Throw the pole forward aiming for high distance on the whistle.4) Mark the landing spot with a disc cone and move the cone farther on future attempts.
pe-06172: 1) Pairs place a ball between their bodies and hold hands or place hands on shoulders.2) Move forward together without dropping the ball to reach the goal and form a train.3) If the ball drops or someone feels uncomfortable, ask to stop and the partner stops.4) Points are awarded in order of arrival from first place to last place.
pe-06173: 1) Waiting students sit in numerical order behind the line while the bowler steps up to the spot marker.2) Bend at the waist behind the cone marker line and roll the ball at moderate speed to knock down pins.3) Move knocked-down pins behind the lane, pick up the ball, and exit to the side rather than walking down the lane.4) Set up one pin per person on the green floor stickers before sitting down for the next round.
pe-06174: 1) Call out the partner's name before passing accurately with the inside of the foot.2) If the pass fails, run one lap around the area before rejoining.3) In designated zones, push rather than kick the ball while changing directions toward 2, 6, and 10 o'clock.
pe-06175: 1) Teams pass the ball in sequence using assigned forms such as chest, shoulder, or overhead passes.2) If the ball is dropped, resume strictly from the spot where it fell.3) Any team that commits a violation or finishes last twice runs one lap around the field.
pe-06176: 1) Divide into two teams and pass the ball to successfully reach your team's captain.2) Move quickly into open spaces where defenders are not present to receive the pass.3) Restart play and pass from behind designated court boundary lines, rotating roles systematically.
pe-06177: 1) Stand at a slight angle and lower your stance and ball height2) Check the target in front, then keep your eyes solely on the ball when striking3) Hit the underside of the ball from a stationary position without throwing or dropping it4) If the ball crosses the net, step back to the next floor marker to serve from further away
pe-06178: 1) Divide into teams across the net and rotate positions accordingly.2) When the ball arrives, let it bounce once and set it high toward a teammate.3) The second or third player spikes/hits the ball over the net to score.
pe-06179: 1) Team members stand in a line holding hands, with a hula hoop placed on each end and beanbags inside one hoop.2) On the signal, moving together without breaking hands, transfer the beanbags one by one gently into the opposite hoop without throwing.3) Once all beanbags are completely transferred, the entire team sits down quickly to finish.
pe-06180: 1) Kick the ball through the cones to narrow the distance between them by one step.2) Do not kick from a standstill; run up from behind, check your plant foot, and kick with the inside of the foot.3) In the second game, kicking with the instep to directly hit the distant target wins immediately.
pe-06181: 1) Learn the origin, rules, and winning conditions of ssireum through slides and videos.2) Conduct palm pushing and hand wrestling matches in teams to select team representatives.3) The representative students compete in semifinals, finals, or challenge matches.
pe-06182: 1) Select student peer teachers who demonstrate forward rolls and shoulder rolls well2) Set up mat stations divided into forward roll and shoulder roll areas3) Practice rolls while receiving demonstration and peer feedback from selected leaders4) Correct movements such as hand placement, tucking the chin, and pushing off with feet
pe-06183: 1) Divide into Team A and Team B and practice kicking focusing on the plant foot position2) Place the non-kicking foot beside the ball on the left, watch the ball, and kick firmly3) Retrieve the ball and pass it to the next person to rotate practice turns4) Play a match where batters kick into open areas without defenders and run bases to score
pe-06184: 1) Students sit nicely in classroom teams waiting for their turns2) The teacher announces math problems or specific cue words (scale notes, words)3) Roll the ball to hit bowling pins only when the designated condition (e.g., odd numbers, specific words) occurs4) Bonus points are awarded for sitting properly, and scores are tallied from fallen pins
pe-06185: 1) Install separate bases for offense and defense at 1st, 2nd, and 3rd base to prevent collisions2) Mark the pitcher's spot, home strike zone, and foul lines with cones3) The waiting batting team sits in order in the stands maintaining distance4) Out players hold cones to indicate outs visually while the kickball game progresses
pe-06186: 1) Teams determine their running order and strategy before running along the track.2) Runners maintain their pace and attempt to overtake the team ahead.3) Runners overtaken by an opposing team are eliminated and rest inside the designated circle.4) The last remaining team that avoids being overtaken wins.
pe-06187: 1) The attacking team passes the ball to add successful catches while the defense blocks receivers.2) Each successful catch increases the count by one.3) If the ball is dropped, the count resets to zero.4) Scoring one point requires five consecutive catches.
pe-06188: 1) Pass the ball to teammates moving into open spaces.2) Score points by completing passes into the scoring zone.3) Players cannot walk while holding the ball.4) Out players return to the court when their team attacks next.
pe-06189: 1) Divide into offense and defense teams.2) The offensive runner changes directions to avoid the defender and reach the goal.3) The defender attempts to tag the runner within the time limit.4) Switch offensive and defensive roles.
pe-06190: 1) The batting team decides the batting order and waits seated in order.2) The batter measures distance by extending arms to touch the tee with the bat end, holds the bat upright, loads back on signal, and swings.3) After hitting, the batter runs to base; accumulating 3 fouls or being fielded out results in an out.4) The teams switch sides upon three outs, and players record their own scores when crossing home plate safely.
pe-06191: 1) Divide into two teams and take turns sliding bottle caps or kicking rings toward a target line on the floor.2) The player closer to the line draws a line connecting dots on the board.3) Completing a square captures that territory, and the team with the most squares wins.
pe-06192: 1) Determine the jumping order via rock-paper-scissors and take turns.2) Jump and land on spot markers numbered 1 through 12 arranged in a circle.3) Earn points based on the landed spot and rotation direction, adding to the team score.
pe-06193: 1) Divide into teams wearing vests and play a soccer match.2) Kick and pass the ball, spreading out across the field rather than crowding together.3) The scoring team must gather and high-five for the goal to count.4) The conceding team also gathers to cheer and encourage each other.
pe-06194: 1) Start the game from the center line.2) A player holding the ball cannot walk or run and must pass the ball within 7 seconds.3) A team scores when a player inside the opponent's goal area catches a pass directly with the scoop.4) The ball held inside a scoop cannot be stripped, but players can intercept balls in flight or cover loose balls on the ground to gain possession.
pe-06195: 1) Divide the area into 4 stations (Station 1: Taegeuk 1 Jang, Station 2: Jump rope, Station 3: Taegeuk 1 Jang, Station 4: Front kick).2) Student instructors at each station guide participants in practicing the designated movements.3) Spend 5 minutes at each station and rotate to the next station upon signal.4) After rotating through all stations, perform Taegeuk 1 Jang together as a whole group.
pe-06196: 1) The pitcher rolls the ball without bouncing it.2) The batter kicks the ball and runs, and going outside the line is a foul.3) Up to three fouls apply, and four balls award one run after circling around and a chance to kick again.
pe-06197: 1) Divide into Yellow and Green teams and determine attacking directions.2) Pass the ground ball to open teammates to advance.3) Score by successfully connecting passes to the designated teammate or space.
pe-06198: 1) Review manipulative skills learned in previous classes including throwing, catching, rolling, bouncing, dribbling, and riding.2) Check key posture cues for each skill such as stepping, trunk rotation, and balance.3) Identify which skills will be applied in today's upcoming game.
pe-06199: 1) Set up tiered landing target zones on the field using action loops, lines, or cones.2) Divide students into 4 groups of about 5 members each.3) Students choose a target color or zone and perform standing long jumps.4) Rotate through zones and challenge missions such as reaching the goal within a designated number of jumps.
pe-06200: 1) Teams pass the ball to teammates moving into open spaces across the court.2) Score a point when a pass reaches the captain waiting outside the line and is caught successfully.3) Restart with the opponent's ball after a goal or out of bounds, and only players without the ball move.
pe-06201: 1) Control the ring puck using both hands on the hockey stick and pass to teammates.2) Attackers must shoot from outside the goalkeeper's crease; shots taken inside do not count.3) Goalkeepers can stop the ring with feet or hands to pass out, and the scorer rotates to become the next goalkeeper.
pe-06202: 1) Thread a jump rope through a hula hoop to make a dog leash.2) The owner pulls the teammate inside the hula hoop around the turning point.3) When returning, the owner moves to the back of the line and the previous dog becomes the new owner.4) The pair must fully cross inside the line before switching.
pe-06203: 1) Using only one ball without throwing or kicking, lower your body, bend your knees, look at the target, step forward with one foot, and roll the ball.2) When the rolled ball enters or passes the target hoop, score points, retrieve the ball, and hand it to the next player without throwing.3) Points are awarded by distance: 1 point for the close red hoop, 2 points for the yellow hoop, 3 points for the blue hoop, and an instant win if it lands in the farthest neon hoop.
pe-06204: 1) Practice proper walking by having the heels touch the ground first, tucking the chin, and bending the arms to swing back and forth.2) Play rock-paper-scissors with the teacher: move two steps for scissors, three for rock, five for paper, and one step for a tie to reach the destination.3) Play Red Light, Green Light individually and in teams, freezing when the tagger turns and having caught players step forward.
pe-06205: 1) Set up the goals facing opposite directions at both ends of the field rather than facing each other.2) The orange team scores by shooting into their designated goal, while the lime team scores in the opposite goal.3) Rather than having one skilled player dribble continuously, players advance the ball by passing to teammates.
pe-06206: 1) Run up as fast as possible during the approach run.2) At take-off, tilt the body slightly rather than standing straight up to spring upward off the board.3) In mid-air, push the stomach forward and throw both arms back in a high-reach position to gain propulsion.4) Before landing, swing both arms forward, extend the legs as far forward as possible, and fold the body to land.
pe-06207: 1) The player with the ball must run or pass to a teammate within 5 seconds to avoid being tagged.2) When tagged while holding the ball, play temporarily stops (dead ball) and possession turns over to the opposing team.3) After scoring, tagging, fouls (exceeding 5 seconds or unsportsmanlike conduct), or out-of-bounds, play restarts with an uncontested free pass.4) Intercepting a flying or rolling ball in mid-play immediately switches offense and defense without pausing the game.
pe-06208: 1) Both players stand beside the ball and await the start signal.2) Upon the signal, players avoid kicking immediately and instead dribble and dodge to attempt a shot.3) The defender blocks the attack while the attacker tries to score a goal.4) When a goal is scored or play ends, both players retrieve the ball together and return it to the center.5) Exchange handshakes, update the scoreboard, and rotate to the next pair.
pe-06209: 1) Separate offense and defense with bibs, placing safety double bases at each base about 16m apart.2) Offensive players must sit in batting order and receive an out if they wander around.3) The on-deck batter waits in the designated safety area behind the batter with a bat and ball.4) Batters check distance with extended arms and are called out immediately if they fling the bat.
pe-06210: 1) Team members connect in a line to form a caterpillar.2) Run around the cones without touching them and return to the starting line.3) The entire team, including the last runner at the tail, must completely cross the finish line to complete the race.
pe-06211: 1) Perform the ABC check (Air, Brakes, Chain) before riding.2) Mount from the right side and check left, right, and rear clearance before departure.3) Use hand signals to indicate right and left turns while riding.4) Dismount at crosswalks and push the bicycle on the right side.
pe-06212: 1) Place spot markers numbered 1 through 6 on the floor.2) The server stands at spot 1 and calls out the receiver's name before serving.3) The server strikes a stationary ball, and the receiver must catch it directly or after one bounce while keeping one foot on the spot marker.4) Scoring corresponds to the marker number, and teams alternate after all members attempt.
pe-06213: 1) Two teams stand facing each other holding hands in straight lines.2) On signal, runners at the end run around the opposing team's line.3) The first runner to return adds a point, then joins the line end as the next runner departs.
pe-06214: 1) Divide teams into designated areas and prepare airballs.2) Keep the airball afloat in the air by continuously tapping it without letting it touch the ground.3) Instead of hitting in only one direction, surround the ball from all sides and take turns tapping it.
pe-06215: 1) Line up by team and dribble the ball zigzag through obstacles using sticks.2) If touching an obstacle, return to the start of that obstacle and restart.3) Turn around and tag the next runner; the team that finishes first wins.
pe-06216: 1) Practice passing low and fast imagining a pole is a person2) Practice throwing high over the goalpost to reach far distances3) Throw small balls accurately aiming for target numbers
pe-06217: 1) For underhand hits, strike the ball with the folded part of your forearm rather than your fist.2) Use overhand hits to send the ball high as needed.3) Move toward the ball instead of waiting, sending it gently and accurately to your teammate.
pe-06218: 1) Bend your waist and knees, and step forward with one foot while rolling the ball.2) Control your force to roll it gently into the target.3) When using a stick, place one foot forward, hold the lower part of the stick with one hand, and sweep-push without lifting the stick.
pe-06219: 1) Players from both teams lie down or roll forward across the mats upon the start signal.2) Place the beanbag accurately inside the hoop.3) After the round, shake hands with the opponent, tidy up the equipment, and update the score.
pe-06220: 1) Search around school playground structures, poles, and slides to find hidden treasure notes.2) Bring a found note to the teacher and locate the matching coordinate on the treasure map yourself.3) Complete the assigned mission to receive a reward.
pe-06221: 1) A student throws a ball or shot put as far as possible.2) The next student brings a saucer cone to mark the spot where the throw first landed.3) Retrieve the ball, rotate turns, and check rankings after round 1.4) For shot put, practice fundamental form: hold against neck/chin, turn, and bend before throwing.

pe-06226: 1) Hold the shuttlecock facing yourself and practice backhand serves in place without dropping it.2) Grip the racket like holding an ice cream cone and practice forehand serves by dropping the shuttlecock from waist height.3) Hold the shuttlecock facing yourself and practice standard padminton forehand serves without dropping the bird.4) Face a partner across the court and take turns serving while the partner catches the shuttlecock by hand.
