pe-06230: 1) When a defender touches an opponent, that player is out and automatically returns once their team regains possession.2) A player holding the ball cannot run and must pass the ball within 7 seconds.3) A team scores when a player catches a pass directly inside the rectangular penalty area.4) After scoring, play restarts from the center.
pe-06231: 1) Divide the class into two teams and set two cones at home base as the pitch target area.2) A pitcher from the batting team rolls the ball, and the kicker kicks it into the field.3) The runner rounds designated scoring cones (1 pt for near, 3 pts for far) and steps on the scoring base.4) Fielders field the ball and step on the defensive base for an out, alternating sides after full rotation or 3 outs.
pe-06232: 1) Place cones at different angles and distances beneath the basketball hoop numbered 1 through 5.2) Shoot from spot 1, and upon making the shot, move sequentially to spot 2 and continue.3) If a shot is missed, pass the turn to the next player, resuming from that missed spot on the next turn.4) Successfully making shots through spot 5 earns 1st rank, then restart from spot 1 to reach a target score.
pe-06233: 1) Bounce a jokgu or volleyball on the floor once and kick it upward with your foot.2) Before the ball rolls away or bounces twice, kick it up into the air again.3) In a group activity, a player who kicked the bounced ball cannot kick it consecutively, and another teammate must kick it next to continue the count.
pe-06234: 1) Divide students into boys 5v5 and girls 5v5 teams and determine offense and defense.2) The offensive team must ensure that every single teammate receives at least one pass.3) After all teammates have completed a pass, the player receiving near the hoop shoots to score.4) The match consists of four 7-minute quarters in total, with boys playing two quarters and girls playing two quarters.
pe-06235: 1) In pairs, players face each other and pass using an overhand pass above the forehead with fingers spread wide.2) In pairs facing a wall, one student tosses the ball and the partner practices spiking against the wall.3) In a 4-player team catch-volleyball game, sending the ball over to the opponent's side must only be done via spike.
pe-06236: 1) Form pairs; student 1 places one foot on a spot marker as a pivot foot and must not lift it.2) Student 1 dribbles and rotates 360 degrees with the other foot to protect the basketball.3) Student 2 attempts to steal or knock the ball away when it leaves the hand, and players switch roles upon success.
pe-06237: 1) Pair up to practice inside passing by stopping then passing, advancing to non-stop passes to reach 30 consecutive passes.2) In groups of 5, 4 players pass along a square attempting 10 consecutive passes while 1 defender tries to intercept; roles switch upon turnover (or 3 attackers try to knock down a center cone guarded by a keeper).3) Place 5 tall cones inside a circle marked by disc cones where no one can enter, then play a soccer match where teams pass and shoot from outside the circle to knock down cones for points.
pe-06238: 1) Four students form a group and stand in a circle.2) Players keep the ball alive using underhand passes with one bounce or no bounce allowed.3) The round ends if one player touches the ball consecutively or if it bounces twice, and the group counts total successful hits.
pe-06239: 1) Face a partner and practice rolling the ball along the floor without bouncing.2) Divide into two lines to take turns rolling and kicking the ball, returning to the back.3) Roll the ball from a distance to hit cones of different point values.
pe-06240: 1) Set up only home base and first base, then divide into kicking and fielding teams.2) The kicker kicks the ball, runs to touch first base, and returns to touch home base to score 1 point.3) If a fielder catches the kicked ball in the air, the kicker is out; if the fielding team retrieves the ball and steps on home base before the runner arrives, the out is made.4) Teams switch roles after all members of the kicking team have kicked.
pe-06241: 1) Lower center of gravity in place and practice pushing the ball smoothly with both hands and each hand.2) Practice walking and jogging dribble relays by dribbling across to deliver the ball to a teammate.3) Start from the corners of a square area, dribble to numbered spot markers, and bounce the ball the indicated number of times to score points (Bound 100).
pe-06242: 1) Set up Home, 1st, and 2nd bases; the pitcher rolls the ball and the kicker kicks it.2) Catching the kicked ball in the air is a flyout, and 3 fouls result in an out.3) The kicker can only advance to 1st base, while an existing runner on 1st can advance up to 2nd base, rotating offense/defense after all kickers finish.
pe-06243: 1) Spread feet wider than shoulder-width, extend arms forward, wrap with left hand, and align thumbs to form the underhand stance.2) Bend knees halfway, slightly lift heels, stay low, and bump the ball upward.3) Divide into teams across the net and play the volleyball match according to the rules.
pe-06244: 1) Place a towel on the floor and perform Stepping 48 movements in order to the signal sound.2) Prepare within 15 seconds and perform Plank 10 by moving a towel onto the back and catching it with hands.3) Prepare within 15 seconds and perform Speed Jump Rope 30 times alternating feet.4) Measure the total time taken to complete all tasks.
pe-06245: 1) Set two cones and a basket at the starting line, placing 20 mixed leaf cards face down 5 meters away.2) On the teacher's call, the first runner runs to the cards.3) Flip only one card; keep it if it matches the called leaf, or put it back if incorrect.4) High-five the next runner to switch; the first team to collect 5 target cards wins.
pe-06246: 1) Divide into two teams and advance exclusively through no-bounce passing without dribbling.2) The player with the ball cannot move except for pivoting, while off-ball players move freely.3) Defenders cannot strip the ball from a handler's hands and may only intercept passes.4) Play two 10-minute halves, and the team scoring the most baskets wins.
pe-06247: 1) Prepare a stable chair without wheels and stand with heels together.2) Learn the basic ballet movements: plie (bending knees) and releve (lifting heels).3) Practice the passe (bent leg at the knee) and arabesque (extending leg backwards).4) Place one leg on the chair for stretches, then hold the chair while performing plie, releve, passe, and arabesque in sequence.
pe-06248: 1) Select upbeat background music and set up an audio speaker.2) Combine basic soccer movements to match the rhythm and beats of the music.3) Practice synchronized soccer actions individually or in pairs.4) For advanced levels, add aerial ball juggling or direct passing to complete the routine.
pe-06249: 1) Set up target objects like paper cups and plastic bottles on the table tennis table.2) In the individual mode, each player serves 10 consecutive balls at the targets.3) In team play, one player receives a serve from a teammate and shoots toward targets with 10 chances.4) The player or team that hits the most targets wins the game.
pe-06250: 1) Set up four safety cones as holes and designate par 3, 4, or 5 targets.2) Assign different body parts as clubs, such as inside of the foot (club 1), outside (club 2), instep (club 3), heel (club 4), thigh (club 5), and heading (club 6).3) For thigh or heading shots, toss the ball with your hands into the air, and always take the next shot from where the ball landed.4) Record the number of kicks and body parts used, and the player who hits the final cone in the fewest total strokes wins.
pe-06251: 1) Practice direction changes using inside, outside, and behind turns with a low center of gravity while controlling the ball with the sole2) Dribble through the marked cone sequence (3-2-4-3) and shoot toward the mini goal3) Dribble to the first cone, trap a pass from the opposite player, navigate the center cone, and pass to the next teammate4) Each player protects their own ball while trying to kick opponents' balls out; tagged players perform a physical activity before returning
pe-06252: 1) Played 2v2 or 3v3 using badminton rackets and shuttlecocks over a net.2) Teams must pass the shuttlecock internally according to player count (twice for 2v2, three times for 3v3) before sending it over.3) Powerful smashes are not allowed; players must aim for open spaces on the opponent's court.4) In the 'Two-Touch' variation, each player hits the shuttlecock twice consecutively before sending it over.
pe-06253: 1) Form two teams of three, take about 15 bottle caps and one disc cone per team, hold one cap each, and place the rest in the cone at the start line.2) Run to the finish zone 5m away and play rock-paper-scissors against opponents.3) If you win, take an opponent's cap and run back to store it in your cone; if you lose, give up your cap, run back to get a new one from your cone, and return to play again.4) Repeat within the time limit, and the team with the most bottle caps wins.
pe-06254: 1) Set up cones 10m apart and practice approaching quickly, slowing down, and lowering the stance to defend.2) Practice intercepting passes made around the cones and blocking incoming balls.3) In a 10m by 10m area with mini goals, play a 2v2 game where driving the ball through the goal scores a point.
pe-06255: 1) Two players face each other for rock-paper-scissors; the loser holds palms behind while the winner taps them and sprints to the end line.2) The loser turns immediately upon being tapped to touch the winner's shoulder before the finish line.3) In the group version, cones are placed in a circle and players defend open cones by tapping them before the center challenger does.
pe-06256: 1) Divide into two teams on a half court to alternate offense and defense.2) Play 1v1 three times, 2v2 twice, and 3v3 once so every player participates in at least one game.3) Start each 3-minute game from the center circle with a bounce pass by the offensive team.4) Switch possession immediately after any shot attempt regardless of whether it scores, deciding the winner by total score.
pe-06257: 1) Play rock-paper-scissors to assign the roles of rabbit (winner) and tiger (loser).2) The rabbit runs away within the designated area while the tiger chases using galloping or hopping movements.3) Stop on the signal after 15 seconds; the tiger wins if they can reach and touch the rabbit, and players then switch roles or try to match actions on the right side.
pe-06258: 1) Sit with legs straight on a mat, perform flex and point ankle movements, and rotate ankles inward and outward.2) Lean forward to hold feet, then bring soles together in butterfly pose and bounce knees up and down.3) Extend one leg at a time to stretch the torso, then spread both legs and bend forward.4) Lie on your stomach, lift the upper body, bend knees, grasp the ankles, and pull upwards toward the ceiling.
pe-06259: 1) The tagger faces the wall.2) Players only move when the tagger repeats a summer-related word three times.3) Players must freeze if a non-summer word is called or when the tagger turns around.4) Tag the tagger's back and run to the start line without being caught.
pe-06260: 1) Players pair up and line up at the start line.2) Partners alternate hitting a balloon back and forth around the turning point.3) Upon returning, pass the balloon to the next pair with both hands.4) The team whose three pairs finish first wins.
pe-06261: 1) The tagger faces the wall and players line up 10m away.2) While the tagger calls out a plant/animal name, players move up to two steps imitating it.3) Players tag the tagger's back and run back to the start line without getting tagged.4) A tagged player becomes the next tagger.
pe-06262: 1) Set up 6 hula hoops on the floor as targets for Do, Gae, Geol, Yut, Mo, and Back-Do.2) On your turn, hit the shuttlecock with a badminton racket into a target hoop.3) If the shuttlecock misses all targets, the shot is invalid and turns pass to the opponent.
pe-06263: 1) Players 1 and 2 move toward the opposite marker while passing the ball.2) One player steps on the marker and catches the ball.3) They pass the ball back to the starting line and hand it to the next pair.
pe-06264: 1) Stage 1: Field a batted ball and make 3 successful throws into the designated target area.2) Stage 2: Catch 3 fly balls.3) Stage 3: Move to the mound and throw 3 pitches through the strike zone.4) Stage 4: Hit 3 successful base hits.5) Stage 5: Base run from home plate to third base, competing for the fastest completion time.
pe-06265: 1) Spread your legs and jump while bending knees backwards.2) Clap hands overhead while performing the basic step.3) Move sideways with basic steps, placing hands on head and extending forward.4) Thrust hands sideways, spread outward, and repeat the sequence to music.
pe-06266: 1) Inside a 5m x 5m area, 6 players (3 pairs) hold hands forming a circle.2) Both players in a pair must lift the ball (one bounce or no bounce) before passing it to the next pair (Pair 1-2-3).3) Count the total successful pair-lifting rounds within 1 minute without letting go of hands.
pe-06267: 1) In Freeze Badminton, two teams of three play against each other with both feet fixed to the ground during serves and hits, and lifting a foot results in a foul.2) Teammates rotate serves, switch positions after each rally, and the first team to reach 5 points wins.3) In Toss Badminton, teams of two must use two touches to return the shuttlecock, where one player sets it high and the partner spikes it, while returning it in a single hit is a foul.
pe-06268: 1) Two partners sit facing each other with knees bent and feet touching, hold hands, and stand up simultaneously on cue.2) Expand the group to 4 to 6 students, cross arms in an X shape, hold hands, touch feet, and stand up together.3) Form a circle of 3 to 4 students holding hands, then pull or push to make others step into the marked puddle area; anyone who falls in performs 5 jumping jacks.
pe-06269: 1) Players stand in a line holding hands with the treasure at one end and the tagger at the other end.2) The tagger attempts to tag the treasure, while the guardians and treasure move together to prevent the tag.3) When the tagger touches the treasure, roles rotate so the guardian becomes tagger, tagger becomes treasure, and treasure becomes guardian.
pe-06270: 1) Stretch your feet, wrists, and ankles thoroughly, and adjust the jump rope length so handles reach chest height when stepping on the middle.2) Jump alternately starting with the left foot, counting one rep every time the right foot clears the rope.3) Do alternate-foot jumping for 30 seconds to compete or break your personal record.
pe-06271: 1) Place cones at the starting line and hoops, whiteboards, and markers at the finish line about 12m away.2) Form two teams of three students each and determine the running order.3) The first runner runs to the finish line with a die and rolls it inside the hoop.4) Record the rolled number on the whiteboard and run back around the outside of the cone to hand the die to the next runner.5) The team with the higher total score within the time limit wins.
pe-06272: 1) Each player rolls the dice, and the player with the lowest number becomes the first tagger.2) Inside the boundary marked by 4 cones, the tagger holds the dice and tries to tag other runners.3) When tagged, players step outside the boundary, roll the dice, and perform exercises like push-ups or burpees equal to the rolled number.4) Upon finishing the exercises, the player becomes the new tagger and enters the game.
pe-06273: 1) Place start and finish baskets 25m apart with 4 spot markers placed every 5m for 4 runners.2) Place 5 songpyeon (fluffy balls) in the starting basket.3) On signal, runner 1 carries a ball to runner 2 and runs back to their original spot.4) The ball is relayed from runner 2 to 3, and 3 to 4 in the same manner.5) Runner 4 places the ball into the finish basket; the first team to deliver all 5 balls wins.
pe-06274: 1) Set up cones at court corners, install a central net, and divide students into two teams.2) Players catch and throw the ball with both hands, and every teammate must pass the ball at least once before attacking.3) The last teammate to receive the pass throws the ball over the net into the opponent's empty space.4) A team concedes a point if the ball bounces twice, touches the net, lands out of bounds, or if a player touches the net; first to 15 points wins.
pe-06275: 1) Groups of 3 to 4 students hold a long rope together and stand at the starting line.2) When the teacher announces a locomotor movement (walking, running, jumping, skipping, galloping, hopping) and says to depart, the group moves using that skill.3) After looping around the cone and returning to the start, the front student moves to the back of the rope, repeating with different movements.
pe-06276: 1) Group members decide on the country's folk dance, music, costumes, and formations.2) Practice basic movements according to the plan and exchange feedback.3) Present the completed folk dance performance by groups.4) Watch other groups' performances with good audience etiquette and share thoughts.
pe-06277: 1) Set up targets of various sizes such as hula hoops, hurdles, or soccer goals about 5 steps away.2) Take turns throwing the flying disc from a set distance to pass it through the targets.3) Throw the disc 3 times each, record the number of successful passes, and rotate to targets set up by other groups.
pe-06278: 1) Place the jump band on the floor, stand inside, jump twice with feet together inside, and twice with legs apart outside2) Lift the right foot and jump twice on the left foot inside, then jump twice with legs apart on both feet outside3) Jump twice on the right foot inside, jump outside, alternate feet, and complete the dance to the music
pe-06279: 1) Assign rooster for scissors, turtle for rock, and stork for paper, and lay spot markers in rows of 3 bronze, 2 silver, and 1 gold.2) Play body rock-paper-scissors with another team at the start line and advance to the bronze spot while mimicking the winning animal.3) Play again at each medal spot to advance to silver and gold; each win at the gold spot earns a gold medal point.
pe-06280: 1) Hold a balloon and tap it into the air for a designated number of repetitions using hands, head, or feet according to signals.2) Tap the balloon continuously without dropping it by alternating between two or more body parts.3) Form teams of 4 to run a relay, tapping the balloon with one or both hands around the cone turning point.
pe-06281: 1) Prepare a 2-person jump rope (approx. 3m) or individual ropes with your partner.2) Choose either side-by-side jumping (holding the handles with outer hands) or front-and-back jumping (facing each other while one turns the rope).3) Jump in sync aiming to complete ten successful turns.
pe-06282: 1) Walk freely around the designated area to the music.2) When the music stops, the Frost player holding a blue balloon stick shouts, and students freeze into statue poses based on the prompt.3) The Sun player holding a red balloon stick unfreezes statues by tagging them, while the Frost player can freeze them again.
pe-06283: 1) Taggers stand between cones at designated cave gate checkpoints while runners line up at start.2) On signal, runners sprint dodging taggers across checkpoints to reach the end zone.3) Tagged runners must exit the court and restart from the beginning, while successful runners take 1 beanbag from the goal basket back to start.
pe-06284: 1) Crumple a scarf in one hand, toss it high on the teacher's cue, and catch it with the opposite hand until successful 5 times.2) Try catching the scarf using different body parts such as the head, shoulder, chest, thigh, or foot, or toss it forward and run to catch it.3) Progress by adding turns, clapping before catching, partnering up, or shifting clockwise in a circle to catch a peer's scarf.
pe-06285: 1) Two players stand facing each other across the net.2) At the signal, player one tosses and passes the ball, and counting begins from the partner's return pass.3) Count the total number of underhand or overhead passes completed over the net without dropping the ball for 1 minute.
pe-06286: 1) Divide into 4 teams, and 2 players from each team pair up and head to the center.2) Pick up a ball from the center and pass it back and forth to carry it back to your team's hoop base.3) Players holding the ball cannot move, and if the ball is dropped, both must return to where they picked it up.
pe-06287: 1) Set up the measurement area by placing line tape 5 meters away from the wall.2) Measure the number of successful catches with a glove within 1 minute after throwing the ball against the wall.3) The thrown ball must hit the wall without bouncing and bounce at least twice off the ground before being caught cleanly in the glove.4) The player must stand behind the 5m line; stepping on or crossing the line while throwing or catching does not count toward the score.
pe-06288: 1) Pairs receive one foam ball and one country activity sheet.2) On the whistle, one student dribbles the ball while the partner marks visited countries on the sheet.3) The dribbler taps the cone by hand, calls out the country name, and dribbles to the next cone.4) The partner tracks visited countries and guides the next destination.5) The first pair to visit all cones wins, and players switch roles to play again.
pe-06289: 1) Form groups of 4, split into pairs, and decide the playing order.2) Set up bowling pins in a line 50cm apart from the start line.3) The first pair rolls a soft ball zigzagging between the pins back and forth.4) Pass the ball to the next pair; the team that finishes the relay first wins.
pe-06290: 1) Tightrope: Two players at each end move to shake the imaginary tightrope, and the center walker tries to stay on for 10 seconds.2) Eagle Eye: The eagle counts to 30 while mice hide, and the mouse who gets closest to the eagle over three rounds without being spotted wins.3) Table Football: Guards move sideways to block gates, and runners must pass through open gates on both defense lines within 30 seconds.
pe-06291: 1) Kings and Queens: Peasants move around the circle following royal commands and change directions quickly.2) Snap: Players call out a number from 1 to 4 on countdown, competing in a set movement if numbers match.3) Base Rush: Move around and quickly run to designated bases or colored cones when the music stops or a cue is called.4) Rock Paper Scissors Tag: Challenge nearby players to RPS; losers freeze in a crouch or balance until the player who beat them loses.
pe-06292: 1) Two players stand about 4 meters apart to create a portal.2) Runners move safely around the area and accelerate through open portals to score points.3) If a blocker stands in the gap to destroy the portal, runners cannot use it and must scout for a new one.
pe-06293: 1) Dragons and Knights: Secretly pick a dragon and knight, moving continuously so the knight stays between you and the dragon.2) Laser Tag: While a guesser turns away, a secret laser winks to eliminate players, and the guesser gets three attempts to find the laser.3) Shadows: Pair up, mimic your partner's movement, and add a new move to expand the sequence from memory.4) Pirates: Follow the pirate leader's commands (climb the rope, walk the plank, cannonball) by performing coordinated body balances.
pe-06294: 1) Nominate one child to be the witch, who stands to guard the cauldron.2) The rest of the class aims to run in and touch the cauldron without getting tagged by the witch.3) If the players collectively manage to touch the cauldron 10 times, they win the game.4) Anyone tagged by the witch turns into a stone statue and must freeze on the spot.5) Teammates can free a frozen statue by taking the risk to run over and tag them, but get frozen if caught.6) If the witch turns everyone into stone, the witch wins the game.
pe-06295: 1) Jedi Battle: When two players make eye contact and swap places, the center Jedi tries to claim the vacant spot.2) Pyramid Tag: A 3-player pyramid tags runners into mummies, who can be revived when teammates show immortality.3) Galaxies: Groups of three act as Sun, Earth, and Moon to balance and orbit, swapping roles on signal.4) Hopscotch Remix: Students use chalk to design and adapt their own hopscotch courts, scoring, and rules.
pe-06296: 1) Rotate through obstacle courses including crawling under nets, jumping hurdles, and balancing on benches.2) Cross to the opposite side of a mat in pairs without colliding, or balance a beanbag on the head while moving slowly.3) Play a balance push game facing a partner to force their feet to move, and practice skipping ropes.
pe-06297: 1) Hold the ball by the ear with one hand like making a phone call, and point at the target with the other hand.2) Push the throwing arm forward as if casting a rod, swapping the positions of both arms.3) Transfer body weight from the back foot to the front foot while rotating the hips and torso to release the ball.
pe-06298: 1) Warm up with stretches including lying deep breaths, knee hugs, down dog, and tree pose.2) Practice kicking with the inside of the foot and following through.3) Practice trapping the incoming ball to freeze and control it.4) Place the ball on the white line and shoot toward the goal net.
pe-06299: 1) Place the ball between the feet on Freeze, and dribble forward and backward tapping the ball side to side on Go.2) Stop and trap the ball with the sole on Stop, do toe taps on Scissors, and waddle with the ball between the feet on Penguin.3) Practice drop-and-trap, goalkeeper coordination movements, and play the World Cup call-out game executing assigned moves for each country (USA, Canada, Brazil, Germany, France, Morocco, Congo).
pe-06300: 1) Start with the Name Game where each person shares their name and favorite sport while others mimic the motion.2) Measure endurance with the Pacer test, followed by Freeze Dance and the parachute game Sharks and Minnows.3) Practice soccer/basketball fundamentals and adapted fitness movements including push-ups, sit-ups, and squats.4) Conduct the Nutrition Relay where runners retrieve food bean bags one by one into a grocery bag, followed by Nutrition Pictionary on a whiteboard.5) Wind down with relaxation breathing in Savasana yoga.
pe-06301: 1) Dribble a soccer ball freely within the designated court area.2) Change speeds between fast dribbling and walking according to country call-outs while keeping ball control.3) Pair up and practice accurate passing between cones with a partner.4) Step back up to a maximum of five steps to increase passing distance after successful passes.
pe-06302: 1) Work cooperatively to jump into hoops or place cones inside the hoops2) Hold both ends of the foam noodle with two hands like a hockey stick to touch targets or move objects3) Avoid running into obstacles like spaceships while completing the mission
pe-06303: 1) Perform stretching exercises on mats by extending legs and touching toes for mobility.2) Raise hands to protect the face while practicing stepping and kicking combinations.3) Roll or throw small balls to hit bowling pin targets set up in front.
pe-06304: 1) Engage in fitness activities using modified pull-ups, resistance bands, battle ropes, dumbbells, and mats at the fitness station.2) Ride scooters around cones to sort nutrition beanbags into hoops and solve nutrition games at the nutrition station.3) Practice sports skills including bowling, soccer, baseball, and football target throws at the sports station.4) Perform locomotor movements through hurdles, agility ladders, hula hoops, and jump ropes at the locomotor station.
pe-06305: 1) Practice two-foot and one-foot takeoff and landing over a rope.2) In pairs, one shakes the rope like a snake on the floor while the other jumps over it three times before switching.3) Progress to the swinging bridge challenge, jumping over a swinging rope for 20 seconds.
pe-06306: 1) Joystick: Follow the leader's directions to step forward, back, left, or right, focusing on weight transfer and agility.2) Knockout: Protect your ball inside the square while knocking other players' balls out of bounds.3) Disc Relay: Throw a disc into a hula hoop 5 feet away; if successful, push the hoop farther forward to test accuracy.4) Ball in the Middle: Run to the center, dribble balls back to your group base, and strategically steal balls from other teams.
pe-06307: 1) Dribble and control the ball in and out through a line of cones.2) Hold the ball overhead and count from 1 to 20 for control and balance.3) Pass the ball to teammates and advance toward the opponent's goal.4) Shoot toward the goal or perform a two-handed overhead throw-in when the ball goes out.
pe-06308: 1) Follow the leader to perform flying superhero poses lying on the floor.2) Place hands down, extend legs back, and move up and down.3) Sit down, stretch legs outward, and hold single-leg stretches for 10 seconds on each side.
pe-06309: 1) Flip over the floor pads so the protective measure side faces up instead of the virus side2) Step only on the side showing virus protections while maintaining balance to move forward3) Once you lift a foot, do not touch the floor and move across to the other side
pe-06310: 1) Juggle a balloon keeping it in the air using the palm of the right hand2) Alternate by using the left hand palm, both hands, and fingertips to keep the balloon aloft3) Challenge yourself to use knees, head, or spin around before striking the balloon again
pe-06311: 1) Keep juggling the balloon with your palm and touch it quickly with the body part called by the teacher.2) Perform wall passes gently against the wall using the right hand, left hand, and back of the hand.3) Juggle the balloon toward a box to basket it, or hold it between the knees while jumping.
pe-06312: 1) Wait at the starting cone and run upon the signal.2) Place a hula hoop over a cone using your feet without hands.3) The team that first completes three in a row vertically, horizontally, or diagonally wins.
pe-06313: 1) Two players stand facing each other at a chosen distance with sock balls and targets of various sizes.2) One partner presents a target and assigns a point value (e.g., 10 or 20 points).3) If the thrower hits the target with the sock ball, they earn the points; if they miss, the presenter gets the points.
pe-06314: 1) Follow animal actions like stomping, penguin waddle, kangaroo hop, and swimming, then freeze on command.2) Toss a handkerchief (or tissue) in the air and catch it before it lands, practicing both stationary and jumping for one minute.3) Place paper balls (or socks) five steps away, run to retrieve them one by one for one minute, and count the total.
pe-06315: 1) Two players face each other and pass a ball gently.2) Keep the balloon floating in the air while exchanging passes.3) Whoever drops either the balloon or the ball most loses a point.
pe-06316: 1) Mark the playing area into 8 lanes with a semicircle at the end, dividing lanes 4 and 8 into two halves.2) Toss a marker starting into lane 1, skip the lane containing the marker, and hop forward on one leg.3) Rest with both feet on lanes 4 and 8, turn around, and return to the start line by picking up the marker or pushing it with toes while balancing on one leg.
pe-06317: 1) The coach holds color-coded balloons while the child stands ready next to them.2) The coach releases the balloon and simultaneously calls out a color.3) The child quickly catches the corresponding color balloon or string before it flies away.4) Progress by releasing two balloons at once, starting facing the opposite direction, or catching balloons released through the legs.
pe-06318: 1) Prepare the playing area marked with various shapes such as circles, squares, triangles, rectangles, and a starting line.2) On the whistle, the first student dribbles a basketball around the shapes continuously for 30 to 40 seconds.3) On the second whistle, they dribble back to the line and pass the ball to the next player until everyone gets a turn.
pe-06319: 1) Place an equal number of different colored balls inside the circle for each player.2) Decide who goes first by coin toss or rock-paper-scissors, then strike your own colored ball using the spare ball.3) If your ball is knocked out of the circle, keep striking; otherwise, turn passes to the other player.4) The player who knocks all of their colored balls out of the circle first wins the game.
pe-06320: 1) Four players play simultaneously, rolling a ball down a slanted cloth into a box one at a time.2) The player with the highest score at the end wins.3) Fold the cloth to make it narrower or lengthen it to increase the difficulty.4) Alternatively, use flat markers instead of balls to roll into the box.
pe-06321: 1) Set up 3 different color gates on each side and place 3 beanbags between them.2) The player with beanbags becomes the kicker and the other becomes the keeper.3) The kicker attacks while the keeper tracks movement to save goals, switching roles after 3 attempts.

pe-06427: 1) Choose one of two jungle animals displayed on screen within 10 seconds for each round.2) Round 1 (30s): Perform sprint steps for sloth or frog jumps for tree frog, then rest.3) Complete Round 2 (anaconda calf raises / tarsier pencil jumps) and Round 3 (orangutan touch hop squats / gorilla monkey hand walks).4) Complete Round 4 (chameleon side bunny hops / toucan donkey kicks) and Round 5 (black jaguar shoulder taps / Bengal tiger toe taps).
pe-06428: 1) Perform arm circles with hands on shoulders forward and backward, followed by straight-arm flaps up and down.2) Do shoulder crossovers by bending elbows at 90 degrees and extending/crossing arms upward.3) Execute back supports and dips by supporting yourself with hands behind and dipping your hips down and up.4) Perform shoulder taps from a push-up position, touching alternating hands to opposite shoulders.5) Do crawling push-ups by walking hands out to a push-up, pressing down and up, and crawling back.6) Perform frog kicks with straight arms, kicking both legs up with bent knees.7) Finish with pike push-ups in an inverted V-shape, lowering and pushing back up through the shoulders.
pe-06429: 1) Practice drag backs with both feet by using the sole of the foot to pull the ball back and change direction.2) Practice step overs by stepping over the ball without touching it, both stationary and while moving.3) Practice the 360 spin turn by putting a foot on the moving ball, turning, switching feet, and continuing forward.4) Practice body feints by stepping one way to throw off the defender and pushing the ball the other way.5) Practice ball control by tossing the ball up and controlling it close with both feet.
pe-06430: 1) Each player holds a Spot It card and meets in the center area.2) Introduce yourself and flip cards on three.3) The first to call out the matching symbol wins, jogs a victory lap, and trades cards.
pe-06431: 1) Players pair up or form groups of three and take turns shooting from spot 1 through 12.2) If a shot is made, the player advances to the next spot and continues shooting.3) If a shot is missed, the player can either stay at the spot or call 'Chance' for an extra shot; missing the chance shot sends them back to spot 1.4) The player who reaches the farthest spot or completes spot 12 wins the game.
pe-06432: 1) The first player of each team places a pancake (spot marker) from the bucket onto their frying pan using hands.2) The player holding the pancake must keep one foot frozen and slide it onto the next teammate's frying pan.3) The passer moves to the end of the line, repeating the slide pass until the pancake reaches the team's hula hoop without touching hands or the floor.
pe-06433: 1) Hold the parachute in a circle and have one half raise and lower it quickly on cue to send a wave to the other side.2) Switch sides and let the other group raise and lower the parachute to return the wave.3) Lift the parachute high, bring it down, and press knees onto the edges to trap air and create a mountain.
pe-06434: 1) View animated GIF jump rope skills displayed on the screen categorized by level (basic for 1st grade, intermediate for 2nd-3rd, advanced for 4th-5th).2) Follow the 30-second countdown timer for each trick on screen as a warm-up activity.3) Practice four alternating tricks continuously with the 5-minute repeating GIF loop slide.4) Partner up with a classmate to peer-assess whether each trick can be performed five consecutive times using a checklist.
pe-06435: 1) Line up behind the line with each team assigned a target frisbee goal.2) Throw your frisbee into the assigned goal from behind the throwing line.3) If you score, leave it and go to the back; if you miss, retrieve your frisbee and hand it to the next person.
pe-06436: 1) The player without the balloon stands waiting on the spot marker.2) The server starts by hitting the balloon twice, ensuring the second hit goes high above their head.3) Once the balloon is hit over the head, the partner leaves the dot to hit it twice, and the first player runs to stand on the dot.4) By directing the balloon away from the dot so the partner cannot reach it before it drops, a player scores 1 point and earns the next serve.5) The first player to reach 3 or 5 points wins the game.
pe-06437: 1) Place different colored mats around the area while players gather in the center.2) The tagger rolls a colored die.3) Players quickly run onto the mat matching the rolled color to stay safe from being tagged.
pe-06438: 1) The tagger hides behind a rainbow parachute playing the giant.2) When the giant comes out from behind the cloth, students throw balls from the basket to hit the giant's head or body.3) When the giant hides back behind the cloth, stop throwing and collect balls to prepare.
pe-06439: 1) Run away as the tagger acting as a virus grows and chases2) If tagged and infected, move to the designated area3) When teammates come and touch you, get rescued and return to play
pe-06440: 1) Hold hands to form a circle.2) Raise arms up and slowly turn in place following the count.3) Rotate shoulders and massage the knees.4) Step forward together clapping hands to the count and then step back.
pe-06441: 1) The tagger holds a net while students crawl on the floor like snakes, lizards, or lions.2) The tagger approaches and casts the net over players to catch them.3) Uncaught classmates crawl over to rescue the trapped student.
pe-06442: 1) The tagger holds a long noodle while students hold short noodles.2) When the tagger swings low, students jump over or block it with their noodle.3) Touching the noodle results in elimination, and only strikes to the legs are permitted.
pe-06443: 1) Carry foam blocks from one side and put them into a basket on the other side one by one.2) The tagger rolls or tosses a big gym ball to hit passing participants.3) If hit by the ball, drop the block and return to the starting position.4) Successfully transfer all blocks to the basket while dodging the ball to complete the mission.
pe-06444:
1) Rotate arms in circles like a crane to warm up shoulder joints
 2) Squat and lift arms mimicking a forklift mechanism according to an 8-beat count
 3) Step forward pushing hands like a bulldozer scoop alternating legs
 4) Perform ladder climbing steps and dump truck loading rotations consecutively
pe-06445:
1) Start in a basic ready stance and perform side-step footwork moving forward, backward, left, and right.
 2) Move rapidly with side-steps and execute a simulated header using knee flexion.
 3) Shift with side-steps and execute a setter-style toss motion making a triangle shape with the hands.
 4) Practice inside-foot kicking and approach-step driving motions after a simulated bounce.
pe-06446:
1) Warm up with stretches and hip twists, then practice ready footwork moving forward, backward, and sideways
 2) Inflate and tie a plastic bag to practice low and high inside-foot serves
 3) Practice instep kicks and turning kicks, then train receiving drops using the inside foot and headers
pe-06447:
1) Perform joint warm-ups for the wrists, shoulders, neck, waist, and knees.
 2) March in place with high knees and arm swings, followed by light jogging.
 3) Squat down to pick up litter with proper form for two sets of 10 reps.
 4) Lunge forward on alternating legs to collect items, then use side steps to simulate sorting recyclables.
pe-06448:
1) Pretend to be a speed skater by stomping one foot, lifting the other, and swinging arms inward.
 2) Perform lateral jump-skates alternating explosively from side to side.
 3) Bend low like a farmer planting seeds and step forward, sideways, and backward.
 4) Act like a baseball pitcher by winding up, holding balance on one leg, and throwing.
 5) Pretend to be a shooting athlete by stabilizing the lower body and turning to aim and fire.
 6) Perform swimming arm strokes and diver flutter kicks to finish the full-body workout.
pe-06449:
1) Stand and bend knees to alternately touch the soles of your feet.
 2) Tap a balloon or plastic bag into the air using hands and knees.
 3) Bounce it off knees or feet like soccer trapping, then hit it with your head or catch it.
 4) Perform lunges in place while shifting your center of gravity.
pe-06450:
1) Hold the stick and dribble the ball side to side, looking forward when signaled instead of only looking down.
 2) Balance a ball or rolled socks on the stick blade while moving without dropping it.
 3) Grip the stick with both hands and pass accurately by sweeping the ball along the floor.
 4) Move quickly to shield the ball with your body and safely block the opponent's stick.
 5) Lower your center of gravity and sweep-push the ball accurately toward the goal to shoot.
pe-06451:
1) Reach both hands upward and stretch the whole body to warm up.
 2) Lift feet inward like kicking a shuttlecock and pull knees to stretch ankles and legs.
 3) Lift each knee and clap hands underneath the thigh.
 4) Lightly bounce and jog in place.
 5) Lift the knee and touch it with the opposite elbow, twisting the torso.
 6) Bend knees and hold an invisible chair squat position.
 7) Extend both arms to the sides and tilt the torso side to side, squeezing the obliques.
pe-06452:
1) Perform basic conditioning exercises including jumping jacks and side-to-side directional sprints.
 2) Practice overhead and pancake catches by throwing a towel or scarf into the air.
 3) Practice catching while jumping or spinning 180 degrees.
 4) Throw and catch the scarf, immediately transitioning into backhand, forehand, and hammer throwing stances.
pe-06453:
1) Perform march-in-place exercises for 5 sets following the 8-beat count.
 2) Rest for 10 seconds, then jog in place at a faster tempo for 8 sets.
 3) Rest, then perform high-knee marches for 6 sets.
 4) Take a short break, then complete jump rope-in-place movements for 12 sets to build endurance.
pe-06454:
1) Divide into offensive and defensive teams, with the offensive team forming an outer circle and the defensive team inside.
 2) The offensive team must roll the ball along the floor to hit the defensive team.
 3) If the ball is thrown in the air or goes out from a pass mistake, a previously out defensive player returns.
 4) A silence rule can be applied where talking results in being out.
pe-06455:
1) Lie down on the floor with knees bent and feet slightly wider than hip-width apart.
 2) Place the pilates ring between the inner knees and rest both hands on the floor beside the hips.
 3) Exhale and squeeze the ring with the inner thighs while slowly lifting the hips into a bridge position.
 4) Lower the hips back down and repeat the lift and hold for 10 repetitions.
pe-06456:
1) Warm up your body using the movements learned in the previous lesson.
 2) Sit on the floor with legs spread and stretch while keeping toes and knees pointing toward the ceiling.
 3) Learn and practice new cheerleading choreography step by step to the counts and music.
 4) Connect the entire routine from beginning to end according to the counts.
pe-06457:
1) Form a butterfly pose and gently bend forward for 8 counts to loosen hips, followed by neck stretches.
 2) Extend one leg sideways from the butterfly pose, flexing and pointing feet while performing side stretches on both sides.
 3) Sit with legs straight and hands behind the head, alternating point and flex movements 4 times.
 4) Lie down and raise one leg at a time to meet in the air, then flex ankles and lower legs quietly to the floor.
pe-06458:
1) Assume a low basketball stance with legs wider than shoulder-width, knees bent, and back straight.
 2) Hold the ball at chest height and practice chest passing back and forth with a partner.
 3) Practice passing slightly ahead of your moving partner so they can receive it in motion.
 4) Practice stationary dribbling with one hand using fingertips to push the ball down softly.
 5) Alternate hands for cross dribbles and advance to zigzag movement dribbling while looking forward.
pe-06459:
1) Warm up with a full-body stretch, then practice lifting by bouncing the soccer ball with knees and feet and catching it.
 2) Face a partner and practice passing slowly, alternating between trapping before passing and direct one-touch passes.
 3) Practice ball touches by tapping the ball front-to-back and side-to-side.
 4) Practice dribbling forward and returning backward using the instep and the sole of the foot.
 5) Finish with a full-body cool-down stretch.
pe-06460:
1) Insert hands or feet into the outer loops of the Spoband to stretch shoulders and hold.
 2) Place hands in the middle loops and pull apart to engage the chest and shoulder muscles.
 3) Hook the band onto the feet and perform leg and core strengthening exercises for 10 repetitions while keeping the back straight.
 4) Perform combined movements stretching the band with opposite arms and legs to develop full-body balance.
pe-06461:
1) From table pose, bring the right knee between hands, lift the torso, and raise both arms into low lunge.
 2) Bend arms into a W-shape up and down, then shift hips back to extend the front leg into half monkey pose.
 3) Flow through high lunge, warrior 2, and triangle poses while maintaining breath.
 4) Lie on the back and lift legs into shoulder stand and plow pose, then finish with savasana.
pe-06462:
1) Lie face down and alternate flexing toes upward and pointing feet downward.
 2) Prop up on elbows in a prone position and lift one leg up to a 45-degree angle.
 3) Stand holding a ballet barre or chair and practice 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, and 4th foot positions with music.
pe-06463:
1) Toss one ball up with one hand and catch it with the same hand for 10 reps.
 2) Practice tossing one ball back and forth between both hands 10 times.
 3) Hold two balls in each hand and toss them up simultaneously to catch them.
 4) Practice crossing two balls from one hand to the other in an arc.
 5) Hold three balls and practice continuous crossing tosses.
pe-06464:
1) Learn the ready stance by spreading feet shoulder-width apart, crouching, and catching the ball with the glove in front of the chest.
 2) Face the target direction, raise the leg to 90 degrees, extend the arm, and snap the wrist to throw.
 3) Practice light catchball in pairs facing each other.
pe-06465:
1) Perform a thorough warm-up by stretching the neck, shoulders, hips, wrists, and ankles.
 2) Learn the first section of choreography step-by-step: covering the face, tilting the head, chest pops, placing hands on the head with side steps, and hip rolls.
 3) Learn the second section: tapping forward twice, rotating arms and chest 4 times, touching shoulders, and body wave down.
 4) Practice connecting all learned dance movements together from the beginning to counts and music.
pe-06466:
1) Stretch neck, shoulders, pelvis, wrists, and ankles before dancing.
 2) Learn the first part by shaping hands into 'L', stepping out with the left leg, and moving hands up.
 3) Learn the second part by bouncing the pelvis with hands on the head and extending limbs.
 4) Connect movements to counts and perform the full routine to music.
pe-06467:
1) Lie on the mat with knees bent and curl up your upper abdomen so your palms reach your knees
 2) Place hands behind the head and perform bicycle crunches by touching opposite knees and elbows
 3) Hold a plank position on elbows keeping the lower back flat
 4) Support on one elbow with crossed legs and lift hips for a side plank
 5) Place palms on the floor and rapidly alternate driving knees to chest in a mountain climber
pe-06468:
1) Perform elbow-to-knee touches alternating legs 10 times.
 2) Do back lunges alternating legs 5 times.
 3) Do side back lunges stepping diagonally inward 5 times.
 4) Do jump squats 10 times.
 5) Do slow burpees stepping feet back and returning 5 times.
pe-06469:
1) Fold fingers together with thumbs aligned to create a flat contact surface on the forearms for the underhand pass
 2) Use knee rebound with straight elbows to lift the ball without swinging arms above horizontal
 3) Form a triangular shape with thumbs and index fingers above the forehead for the overhead set
 4) Track the ball and push upward using knee flexion and wrist extension without catching the ball.
pe-06470:
1) Throw a flying disc to hit the targets (Do, Gae, Geol, Yut, Mo) placed on the floor.
 2) Move team pieces according to the target hit.
 3) If you catch an opponent's piece, earn an extra turn.
pe-06471:
1) Stack 12 sport stacking cups into a single column on the desk.
 2) Place 1 cup on each side, stack 2 on each side, then stack 3 on each side to create a 6-cup tower.
 3) Gather all cups with both hands back into the original single 12-cup column and stop the timer to check the time.
pe-06472:
1) Place both hands on the floor in front of you.
 2) Step one foot back at a time to form a flat plank position.
 3) Step one foot forward at a time into a squat stance, then stand up.
pe-06473:
1) Upstack the cups from left to right in sets of 3, 6, and 3.
 2) For the 3-stack, pick up 1 cup with each hand; for the 6-stack, take 3 in the right hand and 2 in the left, stacking alternately.
 3) Downstack the cups starting back from the first 3-stack on the left toward the right.
pe-06474:
1) Gently tap the ball with your right palm to head height and bounce it 20 times without dropping it.
 2) Switch hands and bounce the ball 20 times with your left palm without dropping it.
 3) Alternate between your right and left hands to bounce the ball 20 times with a steady rhythm.
 4) Bounce the ball 20 times using only your right index finger.
 5) Bounce the ball 20 times using only your left index finger.
 6) Move around the room in circles while tapping the ball with your palm or finger.
pe-06475:
1) Set a target pace of about 8 minutes per km for a running course of roughly 1.2 km.
 2) Inhale through the nose and exhale through the mouth using a 2-2 breathing pattern matched to foot strikes.
 3) Keep elbows bent at 90 degrees while swinging arms naturally, and lean the torso forward about 15 degrees.
 4) Land on the midfoot (center of the foot) rather than heel-striking during comfortable continuous running.
pe-06476:
1) Place a hula hoop at home base and six vertices in a hexagon, connecting them with chalk lines.
 2) The batter hits the ball and runs to bases while fielders field and throw to the infield.
 3) Teams switch on two outs, runners advance until the ball reaches the infield, there are no fouls, and two innings are played.
pe-06477:
1) Dribble the ball low using fingertips while seated or standing.
 2) Practice moving dribbles around the room after stationary dribbling.
 3) Push the ball with two hands against a wall to practice basketball chest passes.
 4) Lightly tap the ball with the instep for soccer dribbling.
 5) Practice inside kicks and instep shots against the wall.
 6) Complete ball liftings and inner-foot hacky sack kicks.
pe-06478:
1) Sit facing a partner to do high-five sit-ups, or lie down and transfer indoor shoes using feet onto a chair.
 2) Do push-ups over Speed Stacks cups with high-fives, or jump over a partner in plank position.
 3) Perform chasing relays with toy hammers, windmill cone relays, or place three cones and balls like pizza toppings.
 4) Play rock-paper-scissors leg splits or occupy spot markers to stretch forward.
pe-06479:
1) Practice serving against a wall 10 times by hitting the ball with the bottom of the fist.
 2) Practice underhand bumping until achieving 10 consecutive hits on the wrists while bending knees.
 3) Practice wall underhand passes consecutively.
 4) Sit on the floor, form a triangle with hands, and perform overhead sets against the wall.
 5) Practice seated overhead sets in place up to 20 reps without the wall.
 6) Practice spiking by tossing the ball and hitting it toward the floor and wall.
pe-06480:
1) Explore a safe running course around home or the school track avoiding traffic, and post it on Padlet.
 2) Open the Nike Run Club app and practice running on the school field to get familiar with the app.
 3) Participate in a monthly team running challenge (e.g., 50 km) by combining running distances within each group.
 4) Apply the STAD model after the first measurement to reward the group that shows the highest combined improvement.
pe-06481:
1) Explore the motion-tracking HomeCourt app in pairs to experience agility and basketball drills.
 2) Form four teams of 4-5 students and assign the cross-training activity involving jumps, planks, and squats.
 3) Conduct an internal team rank match and record individual scores.
 4) Share movement tips and strategies within teams during secondary practice.
 5) Compete against peers of equal rank from other teams using the TGT model and sum up team points.
pe-06482:
1) Start play next to the goal post and utilize the entire gymnasium space without boundary lines.
 2) Advance the ball into opponent territory using passes only without running with the ball.
 3) Defenders must stay at least 1 meter away from the ball carrier without making physical contact.
 4) Score points by throwing the ball to hit and knock down the target ball sitting on top of the opponent goal post.
pe-06483:
1) Arrange 9 cups in a 3x3 grid and fill each cup completely to the brim with water.
 2) Bounce table tennis balls off the table or floor to land inside the cups.
 3) For solo play, challenge yourself to see how fast you can fill 5 or more cups out of 9.
 4) For two-player competition, alternate turns using different colored balls to complete three in a row (tic-tac-toe).
pe-06484:
1) Run across from the starting line and exchange hand touches 10 times with approaching classmates to pass the warm-up.
 2) Pick a team vest from four colors (blue, red, yellow, green) from the box and move to the assigned station.
 3) At the green station, kick the ball from the saucer cone to knock down 10 bowling pins for points.
 4) At the yellow station, choose a cone from levels 1 to 3 and shoot into the soccer goal.
 5) Practice straight dribbling around a cone at the blue station and zigzag dribbling through cones at the red station.
pe-06485:
1) Point at the shuttlecock with the non-racket hand, rotate the torso, and face the racket face toward the bird.
 2) Hit the shuttlecock firmly when it reaches the highest point directly above the head or hitting arm.
 3) Aim and hit the shuttlecock across the net into targets like hula hoops, buckets, or jumbo cups.
pe-06486:
1) Each player takes four red or blue beanbags and stands at the throwing mark.
 2) Alternate tossing beanbags underhand towards the cornhole board to slide into the hole.
 3) Score 3 points if the beanbag falls into the hole, and 1 point if it rests on the board.
pe-06487:
1) Divide into 4 teams where 3 players hold the Kin-Ball and 1 player hits or pushes to serve.
 2) The receiving team pushes the Kin-Ball to another court before it touches the ground.
 3) Players actively practice empathetic and encouraging communication during gameplay.
pe-06488:
1) Set the throwing order within each team and stand behind the release line.
 2) Player 1 rolls the ball toward 10 bowling pins set approximately 11 steps away for the first shot.
 3) The last player of the team serves as an assistant to clear knocked-down pins and return the ball.
 4) Player 1 attempts a second shot for a spare.
 5) Check the score to record on the scoresheet, reset the pins, and have the previous bowler act as the next helper in turns.
pe-06489:
1) Freely practice rolling techniques such as forward, pencil, and log rolls on mats to discover safe and fast methods.
 2) Understand the relay course consisting of a single-leg hopping section, mat rolling section, and turning point.
 3) On the signal, each runner hops and rolls across the mats, tags the next teammate, and the whole team boards the final mat raft.
pe-06490:
1) Rotate through 8 target activity stations such as beanbag toss, disc throw, ball throwing, and shoe tossing.
 2) Try throwing or kicking the equipment to hit the target at each station.
 3) Clean up the equipment so the next student can use it before rotating.
pe-06491:
1) Students approach while the teacher calls out 'Red light, green light'
 2) Leap over the elastic high jump band set at a certain height at the arrival spot
 3) Students who clear the band without getting caught pass the challenge
pe-06492:
1) Set up scoring zones at both ends of the field and start from the center with a pass.
 2) The player with the disc cannot run, may only pivot, and must pass within 7 seconds.
 3) If a defender touches the disc-carrier, they are out to the sideline until possession flips.
 4) Catching the disc cleanly inside the end zone scores a point; a dropped disc switches possession.
pe-06493:
1) Divide into two teams and pass a small ball by hand within the designated area.
 2) Players holding the ball cannot run and may only pivot on the spot.
 3) Touching the ball holder or hitting the ball out of their hands is a foul resulting in an out.
 4) The team earns 1 point by successfully completing 7 consecutive passes without losing the ball.
 5) Intercepting a pass or picking up a loose ball on the ground turns over possession.
pe-06494:
1) Assess basic standing long jump mechanics on mats in the diagnosis zone and appoint student coaches.
 2) Practice jumping over action ropes and mini hurdles in the practice zone while focusing on swinging arms back upon landing.
 3) Measure distances with a tape measure in the challenge zone and record progress on record sheets.
pe-06495:
1) Right-handed players insert middle finger, ring finger, and thumb into the bowling ball holes.
 2) Take a 4-step approach (right-left-right-left), gradually lowering the body posture.
 3) Push the ball away forward, follow through with a downswing, and roll the ball smoothly.
 4) Each player rolls twice per turn; after rolling, roll the ball to the next player and reset the pins.
pe-06496:
1) Toss a balloon overhead and practice keeping it airborne using head, shoulders, thighs, insteps, and fingers.
 2) Practice underhand passes and downward spikes by clasping hands and keeping arms straight.
 3) Play balloon fencing by keeping your own balloon floating while tapping opponents' balloons down.
 4) Players whose balloons touch the floor sit down, and the team with the most surviving balloons wins.
pe-06497:
1) Two teams line up facing each other on opposite sides of a circular track.
 2) The first runners hold foam fun sticks and sprint in the same direction around the circle.
 3) Runners complete one lap, pass the stick to the next peer, and score by tagging the opponent ahead.
pe-06498:
1) Offense and defense line up at their respective starting spots waiting for the signal.
 2) On the signal, both runners sprint around the outer side of the cones to meet in the middle.
 3) The runner attempts to dodge the defender and enter one of two goal gaps within 10 seconds.
 4) If tagged before entering, the runner is out without points and goes to the back of the line.
 5) Successfully entering allows the runner to take one dish cone and stack it onto their team cone.
 6) Once all teammates finish running, the teams switch offensive and defensive roles.
pe-06499:
1) Defending players pull up their masks to cover their eyes and act as zombies.
 2) Attackers dribble the ball around zombies toward the penalty area.
 3) When the teacher shouts 'Open your eyes', the attacker shoots one-on-one against the goalkeeper.
 4) If a zombie touches the attacker or the ball, the attacker is out.
 5) Roles switch after five players attempt.
pe-06500:
1) Arrange desks in a square leaving a center hole and seat four teams on each side.
 2) The first player of each team sits properly on their chair facing forward.
 3) Roll the bouncy ball toward the center hole only when the teacher calls out a specific target word or number.
 4) The team whose ball enters the center hole first scores one point.
 5) Rotate to the next student in line and repeat the game with different prompt words.
pe-06501:
1) Learn the grip and address posture after warming up.
 2) Practice swinging at foam golf balls with iron clubs in pairs.
 3) Practice putting towards the hole cup using putters in the designated area.
pe-06502:
1) Divide each class into two teams wearing distinct colored vests and seat waiting teams orderly in the stands.
 2) Kickers kick the ball and run bases while fielders catch the ball and touch the base ahead of runners to make outs.
 3) Teams switch sides after three outs or when three strikes and fouls are accumulated.
 4) The game is played for five innings and the class with the higher score wins.
pe-06503:
1) Students jump over the vaulting box upon starting and roll a table tennis ball into a fan cover hole.
 2) Walk across the balance beam, perform a forward roll on the gym mat, and strike through a newspaper sheet.
 3) Dribble a soccer ball to the designated line, shoot into the goal, and tag the next runner.
pe-06504:
1) Warm up with tiered running speeds from level 1 to level 3
 2) Run zigzag around cones at the signal and stack cups at the designated station
 3) Turn around and sprint back at level 3 speed to tag the next teammate's hand
 4) Gather in teams to discuss mistake-free strategies, scout a player, rearrange running order, and compete again
pe-06505:
1) Set the jump band low on stands and explore various body jumping techniques
 2) Approach the teacher playing 'Red Light Green Light' while leaping over elastic bands
 3) Form groups of four to negotiate jumping thigh-height bands and escape the chasing zombie
 4) Partner up to clear waist-height bands, allowing successful students to mentor peers
pe-06506:
1) Move arms, legs, and body freely without being self-conscious to practice personal dance moves across 4 rounds.
 2) All students form a circle and sway to the music in rhythm.
 3) When called by name, the student steps into the center of the circle to showcase their dance.
 4) All other students around the circle enthusiastically mimic and dance along with the center student's moves.
pe-06507:
1) The teacher and a student helper hold each end of a 10-meter rope.
 2) Swing the rope side to side while changing its height and speed to simulate an electric wire.
 3) Students dodge and jump over the rope, and anyone caught moves to their spot to jump rope.
pe-06508:
1) The kicker kicks a stationary ball, runs a set number of laps around their team, and sprints to the home base.
 2) If the defense catches the ball in the air, they throw it directly home; if grounded, they line up and roll it between their legs to the last person, who then passes it home.
 3) Defenders holding the ball cannot walk or run and must only pass.
 4) Three foul balls out of the sideline result in an out, and teams switch after three outs.
pe-06509:
1) Four players support the Kin-Ball, shout Omnikin and an opposing color, and strike the ball.
 2) The called team concedes a point if the ball hits the floor before they catch it.
 3) Teams gather during breaks to respectfully discuss strategies and feedback.
pe-06510:
1) Place a ball on the sword, take the ready stance, and start from the center of the court.
 2) Only thrust without swinging to knock off the opponent's ball.
 3) Do not press the ball against your body or step out of bounds, and the team whose ball drops later wins.
pe-06511:
1) On signal, runners from both teams dash from their lines to the center cone for rock-paper-scissors and Cham Cham Cham.
 2) The winner becomes the kicker while the loser becomes the goalkeeper for a quick goal attempt.
 3) Regardless of whether a goal is scored, players comfort each other and high-five to earn points.
pe-06512:
1) Practice individual ball handling missions such as bouncing and catching, clapping before catching, and turning around.
 2) Form circles of 6-7 students with legs spread wide, using open palms to strike the ball through opponents' legs.
 3) If the ball passes through a player's legs, they receive 1 penalty point; the lowest score wins, and play restarts from that player.
pe-06513:
1) Mark distances with flat cones and practice throwing and catching a soft ball facing each other.
 2) Batters hit the soft ball with their fist instead of a bat and run around bases to score points.
 3) Fielders touch the base with the ball to get runners out, and play can be upgraded to tee-ball using a tee and bat.
pe-06514:
1) Form pairs and practice chest passes, bounce passes, and overhead passes while maintaining distance.
 2) Divide into two teams standing in their respective end zones, and start play by throwing the basketball to the opposing team's area.
 3) The ball can only be moved via passing within 5 seconds without traveling or dribbling.
 4) A team scores when a player catches a pass in the opposing team's end zone, after which the teams switch ends.
 5) A turnover occurs if a pass hits the ground or is intercepted by a defender.
pe-06515:
1) Pairs practice catching skills in various ways (solo, lying down, chest level, ground ball, fly ball).
 2) In groups of three, Player 1 passes to Player 2, and Player 2 passes to Player 3.
 3) Player 3 throws the ball into the goal, then runs to the back of the line to rotate.
pe-06516:
1) Form six teams of four students and assign three teams per court where two teams play and one team referees
 2) Decide service by rock paper scissors and throw the ball underhand in an arching rainbow trajectory
 3) Players may move before catching but cannot move after catching and must pass to all teammates before throwing across the net
pe-06517:
1) Protect the Boss: A boss and 2 bodyguards hold a hoop; the tagger circles behind bodyguards to tag the boss.
 2) Protect Our Base: Four corner bases hold 10 beanbags each; teams sprint to take 1 beanbag at a time back to their base.
 3) Hula Hoop Bingo: Place 9 (or 25) hoops in a grid; runners sprint to place or move team vests to complete a straight bingo line.
 4) Hula Hoop Basketball: Pass the ball without entering the goal zone and score by throwing into the hoop held by 2 goal keepers to reach 3 points.
pe-06518:
1) Run up from the start line and jump to touch three objects hung at different heights on a wall or horizontal bar.
 2) Stand on three spot markers placed in front of and on both sides of the hoop and shoot at the basket.
 3) Dribble from the start line to the marker at a lower hoop, take a shot, and advance to higher hoops upon making the basket.
pe-06519:
1) For light ball throwing, spread feet shoulder-width, step the left foot forward, draw the throwing arm back, and throw over the shoulder.
 2) For modified shot put, spread feet front-to-back, lower the body away from the throwing direction, and take a large step back.
 3) Rotate toward the throw direction while keeping the shot next to the neck, push it outward like pushing a wall, and switch feet.
pe-06520:
1) Place five table tennis paddles in a straight line within a 1-meter area with rubber facing up.
 2) Stand 20-40 cm away and toss a ping-pong ball to bounce across the paddles to score points.
 3) If the ball hits the floor, subsequent bounces do not count; each player throws three times to sum team points.
 4) In Touchdown, students stand in a circle and pass the ball from paddle to paddle without dropping it, aiming to place it in a target box for 1 point.
pe-06521:
1) Form a circle five to ten paces in diameter and select one student to stand in the center via rock-paper-scissors.
 2) The students on the perimeter pass the ball to the center player.
 3) The center player must redirect the ball to another perimeter player on a direct first touch without stopping it.
 4) Players continuously exchange one-touch passes between the center and perimeter.
 5) If an outside player fails a pass, they switch places with the center player; if the center player makes an error, they perform a fitness task.
pe-06522:
1) Mark free throw lines at 1-meter intervals from a target and form two players or two teams
 2) Take turns throwing the flying disc at the target without defense
 3) Upon hitting the target advance to the next distance station and the team completing the most stations wins
pe-06523:
1) Each team fills out a challenge card combining dribbling, passing, and shooting tasks.
 2) Set up obstacle cones on the basketball court to design the challenge course.
 3) Team members run a relay completing the assigned basketball skills, and the first team to finish earns points.
pe-06524:
1) Hold the disc with a backhand grip and practice continuous catching at chest level.
 2) Form pairs at 5m apart to practice shuttle passing and throwing through a hula hoop.
 3) Step back incrementally to throw discs and hit basket targets set at various distances.
pe-06525:
1) Divide into teams and set up cones at various distances as targets.
 2) Kick the soccer ball to hit and knock down the target cones.
 3) Compete for points within set attempts or play time-attack until all targets are hit.
pe-06526:
1) Draw a word or sports star's name randomly from a lottery box.
 2) Create expressive body movements representing the letters or theme.
 3) Connect each member's dance movements in a continuous relay performance.
pe-06527:
1) Put the ankle jump rope on one ankle and complete at least 20 jumps in 30 seconds
 2) Move forward along a straight rope line while continuously spinning the ankle jump rope
 3) In teams of four each runner completes 30 ankle rope jumps and tags the next teammate to finish the relay
pe-06528:
1) The batter punches a tee-ball with a closed fist without a bat and runs toward the base.
 2) The runner does not stay on base but rounds the cone back to home, scoring points equal to each completed lap.
 3) The defense must relay the caught ball through at least one infielder to the base, and if the ball arrives before the runner, it is an out.
pe-06529:
1) Form a 3-player team and assign roles: runner (A), kicker (B), and header (C).
 2) Place two different-sized cones 20m ahead; on the signal, runner A sprints to pick a cone, with the first arriver choosing first.
 3) Player B kicks a one-bounce ball from 2m ahead of the start line, player C headers it toward player A standing in the circle, and player A catches the ball inside the cone to win.
pe-06530:
1) In pairs, one student stands while the other sits to practice underhand and overhead passes to build control.
 2) Both students sit on the floor to practice underhand passing, overhead passing, spiking, and blocking.
 3) Play following standard volleyball rules while remaining seated, starting with a one-handed serve.
pe-06531:
1) Divide players into two teams, set one batter, place one fielder at 1st base, and line up the rest at 2nd base.
 2) The batter rolls a ground ball to 2nd base, the fielder catches it, steps on 2nd base, and throws to 1st base.
 3) The thrower runs to 1st base to catch the next throw, and the catcher moves to 2nd base to wait.
 4) The team with the most successful plays in 3 minutes wins.
pe-06532:
1) Form 4 teams wearing different colored vests, scatter 30-40 cones in the center, and place a hula hoop at each corner.
 2) The first runner side-steps to the center, grabs only one cone, side-steps back, and high-fives the next runner.
 3) Once center cones are gone, runners may sprint to steal one cone at a time from other teams' hoops.
 4) The team with the most cones when time expires wins.
pe-06533:
1) Draw a circle about 3 to 4 steps across on the floor and mark a target square in the center.
 2) Three to five students stand around the circle, determine their order via rock-paper-scissors, and the first player starts by throwing the ball into the center target.
 3) The next player steps in to receive the ball before it bounces twice, controls it with foot lifting, and must step outside the circle to return the ball into the central target.
 4) Players rotate in order to continue the rally, and if a ball misses the target, that player performs a penalty such as 3 jumping jacks.
pe-06534:
1) Form a circle within groups and prepare a flying disc.
 2) Pass the disc clockwise and counterclockwise for one lap as fast as possible.
 3) Attempt the blind relay by closing eyes and relying solely on sound and touch.
 4) Play the bomb game where students pass the disc within 2 seconds, and the one holding it when the timer rings is eliminated.
pe-06535:
1) All team members take turns placing one floorball ball at a time.
 2) Hands may be used, but must be removed once the ball is placed.
 3) Once placed, the position cannot be changed, and if it collapses, restart from the beginning.
 4) The team that builds the highest within the 3-minute time limit wins.
pe-06536:
1) In step 1, hold the feathers with three fingers, throw the shuttlecock vertically over 1 meter using a wrist snap, and catch it in a stacking cup with your right hand as the cork faces down.
 2) In step 2, stand 2 meters away from a partner and throw the shuttlecock high diagonally.
 3) The partner catches it with a stacking cup, takes it out, and throws it back to complete 2 round trips.
pe-06537:
1) Face your partner and touch hands using fist and palm shapes.
 2) While jive music plays, continuously alternate between fist and palm to the count.
 3) Stop immediately when the stop call is made, and the player ending with the palm shape wins.
 4) The player with the fist bows down, and the winner gently pats their back.
pe-06538:
1) Form a group of 5, consisting of 1 tagger and 4 passers.
 2) Passers remain in their spots without moving and pass the ball to evade the tagger.
 3) The tagger attempts to block, swat, or intercept the thrown ball.
 4) If 10 consecutive passes are completed, the tagger gets a penalty; if the tagger intercepts or blocks the ball, they switch roles with the failed passer.
pe-06539:
1) Clap hands three times to the left and three times to the right, repeating twice.
 2) Tap the left heel and toe alternately twice, then perform three galloping steps to the side.
 3) Repeat the heel-toe taps and three galloping steps on the right side.
 4) Walk eight counts in a circle to the left facing a new direction, and repeat the sequence to the music.
pe-06540:
1) Set up a field approximately 30 by 20 paces with cones as goals at each end and divide into two teams.
 2) Dribble and pass using feet only, aiming to kick the soccer ball between the opponent cones to score.
 3) When a team scores, move their own goal cones one step wider to make their own goal larger.
 4) Restart out-of-bounds balls with an indirect kick-in, continuing until a team expands their goal to maximum capacity.
pe-06541:
1) Practice barehand drops by throwing shuttlecocks from mid-court in an arc into a hoop near the net.
 2) Rally across the net alternating between an underhand toss and a drop shot for 5 consecutive exchanges.
 3) Hit drop shots from the long service line toward cones (1 pt) and hoops (2 pts) across the net to reach 21 points first.
 4) Form teams of 4 where 1 feeder lifts underhand clears from inside a hoop and 3 players take turns hitting drop shots for 60 seconds.
pe-06542:
1) Practice cup isolation movements by drawing circles with one hand while tapping the desk with the other, switching on signal.
 2) Perform foundational 1-cup rhythm patterns (claps, taps, and movements) 4 times without mistakes.
 3) Play off-beat rhythms with 2 cups and design 8-beat or 16-beat rhythm scorecards to master routines.
 4) Exchange cups with a partner or rotate clockwise around desks in sync with the beat, culminating in a group cheer performance.
pe-06543:
1) Evade balls thrown from four directions using backsteps and jumps in clockwise and random sequences.
 2) Complete catching drills 5 times each: kneeling at 3m, running 5m, backpedaling, and weaving through markers.
 3) Play 1-on-1 dodgeball duels across 5 meters, catching and counter-attacking to reach 5 points first.
 4) Compete in a 2 vs 2 mini-game where 2 attackers pass over 10m to strike and 2 defenders dodge or catch for 1 minute per half.
pe-06544:
1) Warm up with a 3-person relay where 2 form an arm-hurdle and 1 leaps over, taking turns.
 2) Transform basic 8-beat bounces into a signature move by varying tempo (0.5x-2x), scale/direction, and music styles.
 3) Choreograph a 32-beat dance routine following the 4-bar recipe: intro, build-up, killing part, and ending pose.
 4) Showcase the signature moves in a relay busking session and perform the completed 32-beat routine by crews.
pe-06545:
1) Warm up with a tunnel crawl activity where members crawl beneath a teammate holding a plank tunnel.
 2) Pair up for the Core Duo and partner handstand drills, holding balance firmly for at least 5 seconds.
 3) Form teams of 4 to practice the 8-count basic pom dance and add over 10 seconds of original creative choreography.
 4) Combine pom dance routines with partner cartwheels and leg-driven lifts to showcase a group routine.
pe-06546:
1) Four players enter a 3-meter circle or split into two teams.
 2) Hit the ball only with the feet and head, allowing only one bounce inside the circle before hitting.
 3) If the ball bounces more than once or lands outside, players are out or concede points, and the first to 10 points wins.
pe-06547:
1) One person sits on a team vest on the floor and extends both hands forward to the partner.
 2) The partner stands in front, grasps both hands, and pulls while walking backward using lower body power.
 3) The seated person maintains core balance while being pulled along the floor.
 4) After completing a round trip over the set distance, switch roles and repeat.
pe-06548:
1) The first runner holds a T-balance stance for 5 seconds at the start line, then sprints and tags the second runner.
 2) The second runner places a disc cone on their head, balances it across the zone, and tags the third runner.
 3) The third runner spins 5 times around an elephant trunk turn, regains balance, and tags the fourth runner.
 4) The fourth runner places a traffic cone on the back of the hand and balances it to cross the finish line first.
pe-06549:
1) Challenge six table tennis ball lifting missions sequentially around an official table tennis table.
 2) In survival mode, 6 players compete and any player who fails a mission is eliminated until one winner remains.
 3) In team mode, 6 players form a team and pass the paddle and ball like a baton to complete each stage in a relay.
