 2) Airplane Twists: Stand straight with arms wide, kick one leg straight up, touch opposite hand to foot, and switch sides.
 3) Hoop Switches: Place one foot inside the hoop and one outside, stay on your toes, and jump to switch feet.
 4) Calf Jumps: Hold a soccer ball under each arm, balance on one leg, push explosively off the toes into a jump, land softly on the same foot, and switch.
 5) Ball Push-Ups: Perform a push-up with one hand on a basketball, roll the ball over to the other hand, and push up again.
 6) Step Ups: Step onto a bench with one foot, drive the opposite knee up to touch the opposite elbow, step down, and switch legs.
pe-06971:
1) Spin and Jump: Spin a hula hoop upright and jump inside with both feet without touching it before it hits the ground.
 2) Noodle Skips: Bend a pool noodle into a U-shape and skip over it forward and backward without touching it.
 3) Bouncing Under Legs: Balance on your bottom with feet elevated and bounce a high-bounce ball from one hand to the other under your legs.
 4) North South East and West: Place a spot marker down and quickly jump forward, center, right, center, back, center, left, and center keeping feet together.
 5) Flick Ups: Place a bean bag between both feet, jump to flick it up behind you, and catch it before it hits the ground.
 6) Four Steps In and Out: Step into each ladder square left-right (1-2) and out left-right (3-4) while moving along the agility ladder.
 7) Hand Walkouts: Balance on an exercise ball on your belly and walk your hands forward to a push-up position, then walk back without letting your feet touch the ground.
pe-06972:
1) Two teams take each side of the centerline, and end zones (jail) are marked with 5 cones at each end.
 2) Players slide beanbags across the floor without crossing the centerline to hit opponents' feet.
 3) Players hit on the foot by a beanbag must go to the jail behind the opposing side.
 4) A teammate throws a soft rubber ball to the jail; catching it safely releases the prisoner, and the team that jails all opponents wins.
pe-06973:
1) Stand facing sideways to the wall and place one hand on the wall
 2) Put one leg straight out in front
 3) Bend the other leg and stand back up
pe-06974:
1) Rotate through 10 water stations including sponge squeeze, bottle fill, and water hose jump rope.
 2) Complete solo or partner challenges such as balancing cups of water and target spraying.
 3) Play sponge tag where players must tag each other directly using a wet sponge without throwing it.
pe-06975:
1) All students ride scooter boards, with 4 taggers holding red foam noodles and 6 emergency rescuers holding red balls.
 2) Students ride around the gym avoiding the taggers representing accidents.
 3) When tagged, a player must flip their scooter board over, sit on it, and call out '9-1-1 help'.
 4) An emergency rescuer tosses or hands them a red ball (band-aid) to heal them so they can flip the scooter back and rejoin the game.
pe-06976:
1) Perform an arm exercise (push-up, knee push-up, or plank shoulder taps) for 1 minute and count reps
 2) Perform a core exercise (full sit-up, crunch, or crab kicks) for 1 minute
 3) Perform a leg exercise (wall sit hold, rocket blast jumps, or burpees) for 1 minute
pe-06977:
1) Prepare a pair of rolled-up socks and place a laundry basket 5 to 10 feet away.
 2) Choice one: drop the rolled-up sock from your hand onto the ground and kick it into the basket.
 3) Choice two: place the sock on the ground, get your toes underneath it, lift, and kick it into the basket.
 4) Take 1 minute to kick and see how many goals you can score inside the laundry basket.
pe-06978:
1) Step on the middle of the rope with both feet to adjust the handles to armpit height.
 2) Practice the single jump where the rope passes under once per jump.
 3) Progress through double jump, easy rocker, jogger, and double unders.
pe-06979:
1) Move to each station including the turkey feather obstacle course.
 2) Creatively complete assigned tasks such as forming a leaf circle, stretching, and throwing.
 3) Cooperate with teammates while practicing relaxation.
pe-06980:
1) Assign a virtual mountain from the Seven Summits (e.g., Everest, Kilimanjaro) to each year group.
 2) Take a brisk walk along the designated school grounds trekking course at least once a week led by teachers.
 3) Add one kilometer to each child's virtual climbing journey for every completed lap.
 4) Mountain monitors record progress by scanning student names at the check-in table.
 5) Utilize indoor mountain training sessions when outdoor walking is prevented by rain.
pe-06981:
1) Kneel on one knee with a partner, toss the ball off the wall, and demonstrate control by continuously bumping or setting to yourself
 2) Divide court sides using rubber dome markers and play a modified volleyball game without a net, allowing bounces
 3) Transition to playing live over a real volleyball net using lighter trainer balls
pe-06982:
1) The entire team must cross the crocodile-infested river to the other side by building a sturdy raft using scooters and mats.
 2) One team member paddles across on a scooter to tie a rope to the tree and safely return.
 3) The remaining members design and build a raft large enough to fit the entire team.
 4) All teammates sit on the raft and pull themselves across safely using the secured rope.
pe-06983:
1) Create a running channel using cones and place presents (bean bags) inside a hula hoop at the far end.
 2) The Grinch team stands on the outside holding dodgeballs.
 3) Santa runners take turns sprinting down the lane to collect a present and deliver it back to their team.
 4) If a runner gets hit on the way up, they must turn back to the end of the line and the next Santa goes.
 5) If a runner gets hit while carrying a present back, they must drop the present right there and rejoin the back of the line for the next runner to retrieve.
 6) Rotate team roles once time expires or all presents are collected.
pe-06984:
1) Set up a central running track with four teams stationed on the outside and one thrower team in the middle.
 2) One runner from each team runs around the track in one direction to retrieve a bean bag of their color and score a point.
 3) If hit by a dodgeball while running, the runner drops the bean bag, walks back outside the playing area, and high-fives the next teammate.
 4) Play against the clock and count how many bean bags each team collects within the time limit.
pe-06985:
1) Set up a central no-go zone and place an exercise ball (poison ball) right in the middle.
 2) Two teams stand on opposite sides, each holding dodgeballs.
 3) On go, everyone throws dodgeballs at the poison ball to push it across the opponent's boundary line to win the round.
pe-06986:
1) Arrange hula hoops into a snake shape on the floor with start and finish ends, placing each team's colored cone at the start, and line up opposite the hoops.
 2) One defender/rebounder from each team stands under the opponent's hoop while the first shooter takes a shot.
 3) If the shot scores, the shooter advances their cone one hoop forward or pushes the opponent's back; if missed and the defender gets the rebound before the attacker, the defender moves their cone forward or opponent's back, and the team reaching the finish first wins.
pe-06987:
1) Set up a baseball diamond with three different colored home bases, three matching colored hoops in the middle of the field, and three different balls or striking implements.
 2) Three batters step up to the three home bases at the same time and, on the teacher's signal, simultaneously hit or kick their balls into the field and run around the bases.
 3) The fielding team waits outside the bases, collects all three balls, and places each ball into its matching colored hoop.
 4) If at least two of the three batters pass second base before all balls are in the hoops, the batting team scores half a point, and if two make it back to home base, they score 1 full point.
pe-06988:
1) Spread out in the playing area where everyone acts as a tagger at the same time.
 2) If tagged, sit or crouch down and watch the person who tagged you.
 3) If two players tag each other simultaneously, play rock-paper-scissors to decide who sits down.
 4) Seated players pop back up and rejoin the game when their tagger gets tagged or when the teacher shouts "Popcorn".
pe-06989:
1) Set up a jail area on one side of the playing area, place freedom cones or spot markers, and scatter dodgeballs on the floor.
 2) Assign a couple of taggers wearing bibs while all other players run around avoiding them.
 3) Players tagged by a tagger must make their way into the jail.
 4) To save someone, an active player collects a ball from the floor, goes to a freedom cone, and throws the ball to a person in jail.
 5) If the jailed player catches it without a bounce, they are back in the game; if unsuccessful, they stay in jail.
pe-06990:
1) Form a circle with cones, and players stand between the cones defending their own goals.
 2) Roll the ball across the floor to score between players' cones on the opposite side of the circle, without scoring on adjacent players.
 3) Progress through levels by adding a second ball or having dodgers in the center who swap places when tagged by the ball.
pe-06991:
1) Place a bucket in the center and arrange a line of spot markers in front of each team line.
 2) The first player chooses any spot marker, stands on it, and attempts an underarm throw into the bucket.
 3) If successful, they collect both the spot marker and the bean bag to store at the back of the line, whereas if they miss, they only retrieve the bean bag for the next player, with the first team collecting all markers winning.
pe-06992:
1) Form pairs on the sideline with one hula hoop per pair, assigning one student as the hooper and the other as the jumper.
 2) The hooper places the hoop flat on the floor in front, and the jumper jumps inside with both feet together.
 3) The hooper picks up the hoop and lays it down ahead, adjusting the jumping distance for their partner toward the opposite black line.
 4) If the hoop is placed too far and the jumper misses landing inside, the pair must return to the start and begin again.
 5) Upon reaching the opposite line, partners switch roles and return, aiming to complete the round trip within the 2-minute limit.
pe-06993:
1) Toss one ball from waist level above your head and catch it 5 times in a row.
 2) Move to the next progression: toss from waist level, clap, and catch at waist level 5 times consecutively.
 3) Add a second ball and toss one at a time starting from your dominant hand in a 'toss, toss, catch, catch' pattern.
 4) Keep your hands down at waist level and aim to complete the two-ball pattern 5 times in a row.
pe-06994:
1) Teams sit around the hula hoop that matches their team color without touching the blocks beforehand.
 2) On 'go', team members work together to build the tallest tower possible inside the hoop.
 3) When the whistle blows and 'hands up' is called, everyone raises their hands and steps away from the hoop.
 4) The tower must stand by itself without collapsing, and the tallest tower measured by the stick wins.
pe-06995:
1) The first player dribbles the ball to a spot or cone
 2) Take one shot standing on the dot (1 point) or behind the small cone (2 points) or large cone (3 points)
 3) If made, collect the equipment, rebound the ball, dribble back, hand or bounce pass to the next player, and tally team points at the end
pe-06996:
1) Prepare a ball, rolled-up sock ball, or paper ball to develop hand-eye coordination.
 2) Warm up by tossing the ball up with two hands and catching it with two hands.
 3) Progress to clapping once or twice before catching the ball.
 4) Practice catching strictly above the head (thumbs together) and below the waist (pinkies together).
 5) Perform single-hand toss and catch, single-hand toss with a clap, and alternating hand-to-hand catches.
 6) Practice the toss-strike-catch drill and conclude with a 1-minute record challenge to count total catches.
pe-06997:
1) Crawl under the tunnel and hit the Go button to signal the next participant to start.
 2) Move through the agility ladder and complete the over-under-over obstacles.
 3) Perform a gymnastics challenge by choosing either a forward roll or crawling down the wedge mat.
 4) Complete the balance beam challenge and hopscotch patterns using dots and hoops.
 5) Pull yourself on a scooter board using a rope, navigate the scooter trail, and step across mountain tops to reach the finish line.
pe-06998:
1) Place a target basket in the middle and arrange nine balls (foam, sock, or paper balls) in three lines of three.
 2) Perform five jumping jacks before shooting from each ball location.
 3) Shoot at the basket using the BEEF technique (Balance, Eyes, Elbow, Follow-through).
 4) If made, move to the next spot with five jumping jacks; if missed, retrieve the ball and retry shooting without repeating jumping jacks until all nine are scored.
pe-06999:
1) Start from the baseline and dribble in a complete circle around the first obstacle
 2) Dribble over and complete a full circle around the second obstacle
 3) Dribble toward the goal and shoot to score 1 point, repeating within the time limit
pe-07000:
1) Crawl under the hula hoop tunnel and wait for the front person to pass the go sign before starting.
 2) Hop from dot to dot and crawl under the obstacle bars.
 3) Crawl up Magic Mountain (mat incline) and carefully come down.
 4) Walk slowly across the balance beam bridge, then hop through the hula hoop forest.
 5) Go under the exit, cross the final balance beam slowly, and return to the start.
pe-07001:
1) Learn the exercises for the 100th Day of School Fitness Challenge, where each exercise is performed for 10 repetitions to reach 100 total repetitions.
 2) Begin standing with 10 Jumping Jacks, 10 Lunges alternating legs while staying tall, and 10 Cross Crawls touching your elbow to the opposite knee.
 3) Move down into a push-up position to complete 10 Shoulder Taps touching opposite shoulders, then stand up with feet together and swing your arms for 10 Skier Jumps side to side.
 4) Drop back into a push-up position for 10 Mountain Climbers switching feet, then stand to finish with 10 Feet Crosses jumping and crisscrossing feet, 10 Arm Crosses alternating over and under, 10 alternating Up Punches overhead, and 10 counts of Fast Feet moving your feet up and down as fast as possible.
pe-07002:
1) Lay five sheets of paper on the floor and clear them using two-foot hops, single-leg hops, zigzag shuffles, and plank walks.
 2) Ball up four sheets of paper and fold the fifth sheet in half to mark the starting line.
 3) Toss the paper balls from behind the line into a basket or hat target within one minute to score points.
pe-07003:
1) Place 5 buckets, each containing a die, around the gym.
 2) When the music plays, students jog in random patterns around the gym.
 3) When the music stops, they meet at a bucket, spin the die, and check the screen for the matching locomotor skill.
 4) When the music starts again, they move around using that specific skill.
pe-07004:
1) Separate a deck of cards into suits and mix up the pile for the suit you choose to collect.
 2) Hold a tall plank position with straight arms and a flat back.
 3) Within 60 seconds, alternate hands to flip one card at a time and collect as many cards of your chosen suit as possible.
pe-07005:
1) Collect 4 different household items with 4 of each (16 items total) and arrange them mixed up in a 4x4 grid.
 2) Run from the starting line up to the playing area.
 3) Switch the positions of two adjacent items either horizontally or vertically one time per turn, then run back.
 4) When all 4 identical items are aligned in the bottom row, collect them and continue with the next row.
pe-07006:
1) Choose a spot on the floor to serve as home base
 2) When an arrow appears on screen perform a two-foot jump in the direction of the arrow (forward, backward, left, right)
 3) When the home base symbol appears jump back to home base
 4) Keep up as the game advances through levels and gets progressively faster.
pe-07007:
1) Divide the class into equal teams of 2 to 4 players behind the gym end line, and give each team a matching colored bucket.
 2) Spread 50 to 75 poly spots in a path across the gym floor (the lava river) and place a bucket filled with plastic gold coins on the opposite end line.
 3) On the start signal, the first player in each line leaps from spot to spot across the river; touching the floor once is allowed, but touching the floor twice requires starting over from the beginning.
 4) Once across, the player grabs one coin, runs back along the far outside edge of the gym to drop it into their team's bucket, and tags the next teammate until all coins are gone; the team with the most coins wins.
pe-07008:
1) The fielding team spreads out across the gym and the kicking team lines up near home plate.
 2) The pitcher rolls the ball, the kicker kicks it, and runs through all bases to home without stopping.
 3) The fielding team gets outs by catching the ball in the air or scoring a basket at any hoop before the runner reaches home.
 4) Teams switch sides after 3 outs, and the team with the most runs wins.
pe-07009:
1) Scatter a deck of cards face down in the center of the gym and divide students into 2 to 4 teams with assigned hoops and buckets.
 2) The first shooter in line dribbles toward their hoop and takes one shot from any chosen spot.
 3) If made, the shooter runs to the center, grabs one card for their team bucket; if missed, they rebound and pass to the next teammate.
 4) When all cards are gone, teams count pairs of card matches, and the team with the most matches wins.
pe-07010:
1) Divide into two teams at opposite ends of the gym, with a trail of hula hoops and poly spots leading to bean bags spread in the center.
 2) On the signal, the first player holds a pool noodle and hops, jumps, or leaps through the trail to the center.
 3) Grab one bean bag, hop back through the trail to place it in the team bucket, and hand the pool noodle to the next teammate until all bean bags are collected.
pe-07011:
1) Set up 11 winter sports stations including snowboarding, figure skating, curling, bobsled, and hockey.
 2) Rotate through stations in groups and practice designated movements using corresponding props.
 3) Perform each activity such as scooter bobsled racing or cone sliding according to teacher signals.
pe-07012:
1) Divide the class into 2 to 4 relay teams (4-6 players each) and arrange 8 to 10 hula hoops end-to-end in a line per team.
 2) The first thrower uses an underhand throw to land the bean bag into the first hoop.
 3) If successful, advance the rubber chicken into that hoop and pass the bean bag; if missed, retrieve it and hand it off to the next teammate until a chicken reaches the top.
pe-07013:
1) 3-4 hunters stand in the center with balls, while the rest are turkeys on the perimeter.
 2) Hunters roll balls from the center to hit turkeys below the knees.
 3) Hit turkeys grab a rubber turkey from a basket and drop it in the center.
pe-07014:
1) Divide the class into 4 teams, place 4 colored hula hoops in the center of the gym with 1 basketball and 6 matching bean bags inside each hoop, and have teams line up next to their hoop.
 2) The first student in each line dribbles the basketball to any basket in the gym and takes 1 shot.
 3) If they miss the shot, they get the rebound, dribble back, and pass the ball using a chest or bounce pass to the next teammate in line.
 4) If they make the shot, they swipe 1 bean bag from any of the other three teams' hoops, add it to their own hoop, and the team with the most bean bags at the end wins.
pe-07015:
1) Choose 3 to 4 ice cream taggers depending on class size to stand in the middle of the gym with one pool noodle each, while all other students take 3 plastic gold coins, 1 small cone, and 1 small ball to place on top as an ice cream scoop.
 2) When the game begins, students with cones run around balancing the ball on their cones without holding it with their other hand, while taggers work together to knock the balls off the cones using their pool noodles.
 3) If a student's ball is knocked off their cone by a tagger, they give 1 coin to the tagger, who runs the coin over to the collecting hula hoop before heading out to knock off another scoop.
 4) At the end of the round, taggers count the total coins collected together, then switch taggers and restart with 3 coins each for as many rounds as needed so everyone gets a turn as tagger.
pe-07016:
1) Designate half of a basketball court as the playing area, and one tagger starts with a red sash and a soccer ball.
 2) The remaining players spread out across the playing field.
 3) The tagger dribbles the ball around and passes or kicks it to hit a runner below the waist.
 4) Tagged players go to the sideline, grab a red sash and a soccer ball, and join as taggers.
 5) Once 10 players are tagged and 10 balls are in play, taggers work as a team and pass the ball among themselves.
 6) The last player remaining untagged wins the game.
pe-07017:
1) Set up goals using four cones.
 2) Place one Swiss ball or beach ball in the center of the court.
 3) All players must move around the field like a crab on hands and feet facing upward.
 4) Use feet as the primary contact to kick the large ball into the opponent goal like soccer.
pe-07018:
1) Scatter around 50 cones across a basketball court, placing approximately 40 activity cards underneath them.
 2) Divide the class into four even teams lined up along one side of the court.
 3) On the teacher's signal, one runner from each team races out to lift up a cone.
 4) If an activity card is found, the runner brings it back to the team and all members complete the assigned cardio task.
 5) After completing the task, the runner tags the next teammate, and the team with the most cards at the end of the time limit wins.
pe-07019:
1) Set up a field about the size of a netball third with the fielding team spread inside and the batting team in pairs outside.
 2) One pair steps up at a time with one player as the dodger holding the ball and the other as the runner.
 3) The dodger throws the ball into the field, steps inside, and avoids being hit by the fielding team.
 4) Fielders cannot run with the ball and must pass it around to hit the dodger below the shoulders.
 5) Meanwhile, the runner runs laps around the outside of the field scoring a point for each corner cone rounded until the dodger is hit.
 6) After all pairs have a turn, teams switch roles, and partners swap dodger and runner roles in the second innings.
pe-07020:
1) Set up a spot marker as the kitty and give each player two bean bags.
 2) In teams of three (two pushers and one rider), push the teammate on the scooter board as close to the spot marker as possible.
 3) The rider stands up, places a bean bag where they stop, rotates roles, and after everyone takes two turns, scores points based on bean bags closest to the spot.
pe-07021:
1) Place three cones in a line at 5m, 7m, and 9m from a solid wall, placing a volleyball on the cone closest to the wall.
 2) Teams of 3 or 4 throw a tennis ball against the wall from behind the furthest cone, aiming to rebound and knock the volleyball off the cone.
 3) When hit, stack the knocked-off cone onto the next cone, place the volleyball on top, and repeat until all three are knocked off to win.
pe-07022:
1) Set up 4 teams of about 5 players each, placing 2 spot markers 4 to 5 meters apart for each team.
 2) The leader stands on the first spot marker with a ball, and the remaining players line up in a single file with the first person standing on the other spot marker.
 3) On the start signal, the leader passes to the first person in line who passes it back and bobs down, repeating this with the second and third players in line.
 4) When the last person in line receives the pass, they run with the ball to the leader's spot marker to become the new leader while the previous leader moves to the front of the receiver's line, continuing until everyone has had a turn as leader and the first team to finish wins.
pe-07023:
1) Students pair up with one acting as the cop and the other as the robber, separated by 15 to 20 meters.
 2) The cop stands near the bean bag (gold) with their back turned, while the robber sneaks forward whenever the cop faces away.
 3) When the cop turns around, the robber must freeze immediately on the spot.
 4) The robber grabs the bean bag and sprints toward the safety line before being tagged by the cop.
pe-07024:
1) Divide the court into two halves for England and Wales, placing a bank (hula hoop with bean bags) and a jail (empty hoop) on each side, with all players wearing tags behind their pants
 2) Players cross into enemy territory to steal one gold bar (bean bag) at a time without getting tagged and return it to their bank
 3) If a player gets their tag snatched in enemy territory, they go to jail until freed by a teammate
pe-07025:
1) Stand side-on to the target so that shoulders and feet line up with the pitcher.
 2) Grip the bat with the preferred hand above the non-preferred hand and hold it behind the shoulder.
 3) Take a small 5 to 10 cm step forward with the foot opposite the preferred hand toward the target.
 4) Rotate hips before shoulders, make contact opposite the front foot with straight arms, and follow through around the body.
pe-07026:
1) Mark a 1-meter takeoff square with spot markers and provide a short run-up.
 2) Run up to the takeoff square and leap as far as possible taking off from one foot.
 3) In the flight phase straighten legs with opposite arm and leg movements before landing on the other foot.
 4) Maintain forward movement out of the landing without stopping abruptly.
pe-07027:
1) Set up targets by placing volleyballs on top of cones in front of a solid wall.
 2) Teams stand 3 to 4 meters behind the targets.
 3) Throw tennis balls against the wall so the rebound knocks off the opposing team's target volleyballs, and the first team to knock them all down wins.
pe-07028:
1) Form lines on both sides of the court with a bucket of balls next to the waiting line, and set up targets (cones or cones with balls on top) on the opposite side.
 2) When it's your turn, take a ball from the bucket and hit a tennis serve to knock over the targets.
 3) After serving, run to the opposite court, pick up a ball, and join the end of the line on the adjacent court.
 4) Scoring a hit earns 1 point for the team. The team that knocks over all targets first or has the most points wins.
pe-07029:
1) Mark the playing area using four cones and have players spread out within the boundaries.
 2) Designate one player as the tagger, who begins chasing and tagging opposing players when the teacher signals.
 3) Tagged players link arms or hold hands with the tagger to form a chain and chase the remaining players together.
 4) When the chain reaches four players, split them into two separate pairs of taggers to continue the game.
 5) The last remaining player who has not been tagged wins the game.
pe-07030:
1) Hide Monopoly cash under spot markers around the gym and form groups of three consisting of a shooter, rebounder, and feeder.
 2) If a player makes a basket from a spot marker, they lift the marker and collect the cash underneath.
 3) Each player can only shoot up to 5 consecutive times and must rotate to a different basket after making 2 shots, with the team holding the most cash winning.
pe-07031:
1) Two players start at the Royal end (King and Queen) and challengers line up at the other end.
 2) The challenger plays a single point against the King; the winner stays at or moves to the Royal end.
 3) The next challenger plays the Queen, and Royals can serve immediately without waiting for challengers.
pe-07032:
1) Pair up as cats and mice, with cats facing away towards the stage.
 2) Mice quietly sneak up behind the cats using various movements like hopping, skipping, or jumping.
 3) When the teacher calls out 'the mice are here', cats turn around to chase only their mouse partner before the mouse crosses the line.
pe-07033:
1) Two players sit facing each other and lace their feet together to hold each other in place.
 2) One player holds a rolled-up sock, rolls back until their shoulders touch the ground, and sits back up.
 3) At the top, the player throws the sock to the partner, who then rolls back and repeats the movement.
 4) Continue for one minute or count together up to a set target number.
pe-07034:
1) Two players stand back-to-back like cowboys.
 2) Agree on a specific number of steps and walk away from each other while counting together.
 3) When 'turn and shoot' is called, turn around and throw socks at each other.
 4) When dodging the incoming sock, do not run away; take at most one step to avoid it.
pe-07035:
1) Keep eyes focused forward throughout the bounce.
 2) Contact the ball with the fingers of one hand at about hip height.
 3) Bend and straighten wrist and elbows to push the ball down.
 4) Keep hips and knees slightly flexed during the bounce.
 5) Bounce the ball in front of and to the side of the body.
pe-07036:
1) Prepare 3 balloons and get ready to keep them in the air.
 2) Start the 1-minute timer on the signal and release the balloons.
 3) Use any body part such as feet, arms, shoulders, or head to keep the balloons from touching the floor for 1 minute.
pe-07037:
1) Hold a laundry basket with both hands and prepare a tennis ball.
 2) Keep the ball continuously bouncing either inside the basket or on top of the inverted basket.
 3) Challenge yourself by flipping the basket over while the ball is bouncing in the air.
pe-07038:
1) Clear the area of obstacles to ensure plenty of safe space.
 2) Have a partner throw the ball, focus on the ball throughout, and keep elbows bent in a ready position.
 3) Move to meet the ball, position hands correctly, catch with hands only, and bend elbows to absorb force.
pe-07039:
1) Set up cups in a line to form a running ladder.
 2) The first partner begins running the cup ladder course.
 3) The second partner continuously performs squats with feet wider than shoulder-width, dropping their bottom to knee height and standing straight up.
 4) Switch roles when the runner returns and continue the routine for 3 minutes.
pe-07040:
1) Two players take the roles of Rat and Rabbit and stand between two target spots.
 2) When the caller shouts 'Rat', the Rat sprints toward their base (chair) while the Rabbit tries to tag them.
 3) When the caller shouts 'Rabbit', the Rabbit sprints toward their base (ball) while the Rat pursues.
pe-07041:
1) Keep eyes focused on the ball throughout the kick
 2) Step forward with the non-kicking foot next to the ball
 3) Bend the knee of the kicking leg during the backswing
 4) Strike the ball with the instep of your foot
 5) Swing the arm opposite the kicking leg forward and sideways
 6) Follow through with the kicking leg towards the target after contact
pe-07042:
1) Stand opposite each other with an object like a water bottle in the middle.
 2) Take turns throwing a ball to hit the object.
 3) Step back each time you hit it to increase difficulty, or race with individual balls where the first to knock it over wins.
pe-07043:
1) Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, reach high, and fold forward at the hips.
 2) Place hands on shins to lengthen the back, then plant hands on the floor and lower your chest slowly.
 3) Push hips high and step one foot forward between your hands to perform full-body stretches.
 4) Breathe and make a relaxing sound to keep your body loose throughout the movements.
pe-07044:
1) Grip the ball with fingers rather than the palm
 2) Step forward with the opposite foot and stand side-on to the target
 3) Rotate your hips and release the ball smoothly at the correct point while keeping balance
pe-07045:
1) In Level 1, walk when the leader says 'walk' and stop when they say 'stop'.
 2) In Level 2, reverse the meanings so 'walk' means stop and 'stop' means walk.
 3) In Levels 3 and 4, add 'clap' and calling out your 'name', then swap their meanings as well.
 4) In Levels 5 and 6, add 'jump' and 'dance' on the spot, then swap those two commands too.
pe-07047:
1) Stand on a spot marker and toss a beanbag hand-to-hand like a rainbow while tracking it with eyes.
 2) Practice challenges: toss-clap-catch, toss-turn-catch, and toss-touch the ground-catch.
 3) Place beanbag on foot and scoop-kick gently to catch with hands or on back.
 4) Partner up and practice underhand toss-catch, then do double switches on the count of three.
 5) One partner tosses both beanbags consecutively for the other to catch gently.
pe-07048:
1) Stand tall at your designated section and make big slow waves followed by small fast waves
 2) Hold the parachute with your left hand facing counterclockwise, walk and shake, then reverse directions on the whistle
 3) Freeze to stretch hamstrings with straight legs, then slide sideways with two hands shaking the parachute
pe-07049:
1) Sprint on the spot for 20 seconds maintaining an upright posture and knee drive.
 2) Perform a standing long jump off two feet using arm swings to gain forward momentum.
 3) Throw a ball (or paper airplane/rolled socks) from a side-on stance utilizing core rotation.
 4) Record your time or distance for each event to complete the challenge.
pe-07050:
1) Set up hoops or poly spots in a line and place 5 to 10 bean bags in the starting hoop.
 2) In a plank position, move the bean bags from one end to the other and back to see who finishes first.
 3) For a team relay variation, once the first player moves all the bean bags to the opposite end, their waiting partner switches in and moves the bean bags back.
 4) The first team to get all the bean bags back to the starting spot wins.
pe-07051:
1) Each child tucks a pinnie or flag into their pocket or waistband so it is visible as a squirrel tail.
 2) Children run and dodge each other while trying to grab tails from one another.
 3) If a child loses their tail, they stay in the game and try to grab a tail to start their collection again.
 4) When the leader stops the game, children count their tails and the one with the most tails wins.
pe-07052:
1) The children line up at home plate, the pitcher rolls the ball, and one child kicks it.
 2) The entire group runs around the bases to get all the way home without getting hit.
 3) The pitcher gets the kicked ball and tries to hit the runners as they circle the bases.
 4) Any runners hit become fielders and try to hit the runners the next time around.
pe-07053:
1) Line up five hoops, buckets, or targets, and have players stand behind a line.
 2) Two players receive 10-12 beanbags of different colors each and take turns throwing them into each hoop.
 3) Retrieve beanbags that missed the hoops, return to the line, and keep throwing until someone has a beanbag in every hoop.
pe-07054:
1) Divide children into two teams on opposite sides and place several beanbags in a line in the middle.
 2) On the go signal, children run to pick up one beanbag at a time and bring it to their team's hula hoop.
 3) Continue until all beanbags in the middle are gone, then count the beanbags.
pe-07055:
1) Give each child one beanbag.
 2) Players tag each other by sliding beanbags on the gym floor to hit another person's foot.
 3) If hit in the foot, a player crouches down and places the beanbag on their head.
 4) A player is rescued when someone removes the beanbag from their head and places it in their hand.
 5) Older children can play in teams where each team has a specific beanbag color and only rescues same-color teammates.
pe-07056:
1) Place hands and head on the mat to form a triangle shape where fingers are visible.
 2) Walk feet in without letting knees touch the floor until knees reach the tummy and hips are high.
 3) Lift one foot at a time toward the bottom to find control then extend both legs upward straight.
 4) Come down with control one knee at a time without knees hitting the floor and stretch up tall.
pe-07057:
1) Start with hands on the beam and feet on the floor, pushing up into a bridge with straight arms and belly lifted high.
 2) Practice the bridge with feet on the beam and hands on the floor.
 3) Once confident, place both hands and feet on the beam and press legs straight into a solid bridge.
pe-07058:
1) For front support, start on hands and knees with shoulders above hands, then step feet back one at a time to form a straight line from shoulders to heels.
 2) Tighten the tummy and bottom while keeping the head aligned with the back.
 3) For back support, sit with legs extended, point fingers toward toes, and lift hips high until aligned with shoulders and feet.
pe-07059:
1) Jump over the beam from side to side and from front to back.
 2) Stand sideways on the beam and jump feet on and off with feet apart and together.
 3) Perform arm circles and wide-leg stretches on the beam for 5 to 10 minutes.
 4) Touch your elbow and nose to the beam, then balance on your bottom and tummy.
 5) Lie flat on your back on the beam to form a dish shape with pointed toes.
 6) Stand up and touch the beam with toes, heels, and tap the sides of the beam with your feet.
pe-07060:
1) Start by squatting onto the balance beam
 2) Walk forward into a front support position
 3) Transition into a side support with one hand on the hip and hold for 3 seconds
 4) Jump into a crouch position and stand up tall
 5) Present an artistic pose toward the camera
 6) Walk to the end of the beam and perform a pivot turn
 7) Run to the end and dismount with feet together to finish
pe-07061:
1) Stretch arms up by ears and take a big step forward into a lunge position.
 2) Bend the front knee slightly and place hands down onto the floor.
 3) Kick legs up while pointing toes and stretching knees to make a straight body line.
 4) Start small so you do not tip all the way over, then build up to bigger kicks.
 5) Step back down the exact same way and stretch up tall.
 6) Tuck bottom under, push through shoulders, and hold the handstand for longer.
pe-07062:
1) Set up five spots with a cylinder pin on the center spot and place a pair of students on each sideline.
 2) Pairs take turns rolling the ball toward the pin.
 3) If a student knocks the pin down, they move it one spot forward into the other team's zone.
 4) If the other team knocks it down, they move it back toward the center.
 5) If a team knocks it all the way to the other team's sideline, they score a point and reset to the center.
pe-07063:
1) Collect recyclable containers such as cereal boxes and oatmeal canisters.
 2) Work individually or with a partner to stack materials and build the tallest tower possible.
 3) Count the total number of material levels high.
 4) Measure the total height from base to top using a tape measure in inches.
 5) Calculate the final score by adding the number of levels to the total height.
pe-07064:
1) Divide the court with a midline and place orange balls (pumpkins) on top of cones and overturned baskets (vines) on both sides.
 2) Take the green and yellow balls (gourds) from the midline and throw them across the midline at the other team's pumpkins.
 3) If you knock a pumpkin off its vine, place that pumpkin underneath the basket.
 4) If a player catches a gourd thrown by the other team, they may take one pumpkin from under a basket and put it back on the vine, and the first team to knock all the opponent's pumpkins off wins.
pe-07065:
1) Place an empty box in the center of a mat or target area.
 2) Walk back five paces and mark the rolling spot with tape or a towel.
 3) Roll the sock ball and knock over the box as many times as possible in one minute.
pe-07066:
1) Set up recyclable materials that can stand up as targets at a chosen distance.
 2) In the 1-person version, kick with the inside of your foot for 30 seconds to knock over targets, scoring 1 point per object.
 3) In the 2-person version, move further back, kick with laces, and switch places between kicker and receiver for 1 minute.
pe-07067:
1) Set up a line in the middle with each team placing 9 to 10 cylinders or bowling pins on their side.
 2) On the start signal, strike the ball off the ground or out of the hand using a foam paddle to knock over the opposing team's pins.
 3) If you knock over an opponent's pin, take it back to your side and set it up on your line.
pe-07068:
1) Place 8 to 10 items on the ground and work with a partner to stand one item up using only feet.
 2) Once an item is stood up, one partner runs it to a laundry basket on the other side while the other partner does push-ups.
 3) Repeat the process, alternating who runs and who performs push-ups.
 4) Work for 1 minute to see how many items can be placed in the basket.
pe-07069:
1) Prepare a sock ball, a bath mat, and a cereal box as a target.
 2) Roll the sock ball; score 1 point if it stays on the mat, or 2 points if it knocks over the cereal box and leaves the mat.
 3) Earn 3 points if it knocks over the box and stays on the mat, aiming to reach 11 points competitively or cooperatively.
pe-07070:
1) Place one full cup and one empty cup at one end, and another empty cup 15-25 paces away.
 2) Carry the full cup to the other side and pour it into the empty cup.
 3) Earn one point each time you pour the cup, repeating for one minute.
pe-07071:
1) Set up two laundry baskets (or buckets/boxes) 5 paces apart (or further for advanced players) with partners facing each other.
 2) One player tosses a ball or frisbee and the partner deflects it toward the basket using an open hand.
 3) Score 1 point for deflecting into the side, 2 points for deflecting inside, 3 points for a direct hit to the bucket, and 4 points for a direct throw into the basket until reaching 21 points.
pe-07072:
1) Place a laundry basket 10 paces away from the starting line.
 2) Use a wooden spoon to hit the balloon forward and drop it into the basket.
 3) Pick up the balloon, run back to the start, and repeat for 1 minute.
 4) If the balloon hits the ground, simply pick it up and continue.
pe-07073:
1) Outline two zones at each end of the gym and place all pucks or balls in the center.
 2) Divide into 2 to 4 teams, with every player holding a hockey stick.
 3) One player at a time runs to the center, stick-handles a puck back into their zone, and returns to line.
 4) Once center pucks are gone, a 2-minute period begins where players can steal pucks from opponents' zones.
 5) When time expires, the team with the most pucks or balls wins.
pe-07074:
1) Half of each four-player team lines up on one side facing the other half.
 2) Hit the birdie across to teammates, then run to the opposite end of the gym to touch the wall or do an exercise before returning to the line.
 3) A player who makes a mistake is eliminated, and the last team standing wins.
pe-07075:
1) Divide players into two teams on each side of the net with birdies spread across the floor.
 2) On go, players grab a birdie or catch a served one and move to the serving line.
 3) Players serve the birdie over the net using forehand or backhand.
 4) The team with the least amount of birdies on their side at the end of the time limit wins.
pe-07076:
1) Divide the court into four numbered squares from 1 to 4 (king/queen's court) with one player with a racket in each square.
 2) The king or queen in square 4 serves over the net to start the rally.
 3) A player is eliminated if the birdie lands in their square or if they hit the birdie out of bounds.
 4) When a player ahead is eliminated, players advance one step toward the king/queen's court, and a new player joins court 1.
pe-07077:
1) Yellow, blue, red, and green teams ride scooter boards and try to score in their own colored goals using only their feet.
 2) If you touch the ball with your hands, perform a scooter exercise 5 times before rejoining the game.
 3) Once a goal is scored, another team can take the ball and score in their own goal.
pe-07078:
1) Divide students into groups of three and give each group five colored exercise cards, moving pieces, and a die.
 2) Roll to determine turn order with the highest number going first, then take turns rolling the die and moving tokens.
 3) Check the exercise card matching the color of the landed space and perform that exercise 10 times, aiming to reach the finish line first.
pe-07079:
1) Divide the class into two teams; half of each team plays on scooter boards while the other half lines the sidelines.
 2) Players on scooters use only their feet to move and kick a 48-inch Omnikin ball toward the goal.
 3) Sideline players use hands or feet to keep the big ball in play.
 4) Every 2 minutes when the timer sounds, players and sideline members swap roles.
 5) After a goal, the ball is placed back in the center to continue.
pe-07080:
1) Choose two or three taggers and have everyone else spread out in the playing area.
 2) Taggers run around and tag as many people as they can.
 3) A tagged person puts both arms in the air and finds another tagged person with arms up.
 4) Two tagged players move together, hold hands, and link arms to form a bridge.
 5) Someone runs through their bridge to rescue them, allowing them to run and play again.
pe-07081:
1) Split into two equal teams at each end of the pitch and give each player a number.
 2) The teacher kicks a ball into the middle area and calls out a number.
 3) Players with that number run into the middle to compete for the ball.
 4) Kick the ball across the other teams goal line to score a point.
 5) Players whose numbers are not called act as goalkeepers behind their line to save the ball.
 6) Reset after a goal or when the ball goes out of play.
pe-07082:
1) Set up 4 cones and place 4 slightly filled water bottles as targets opposite them.
 2) Start at the first cone, run through the cones in a zigzag pattern, and return to the starting cone.
 3) Pick up a softball, step with the opposite foot, roll the ball, and try to knock down the water bottles within one minute.
pe-07083:
1) Choose 3-4 taggers (farmers), give them pool noodles, and send them to the corners
 2) Other students (animals) gather in the center circle and escape when music starts
 3) Tagged animals freeze where they are and are gently corralled back to the barn with the pool noodle
 4) Caught animals do five jumping jacks in the barn and rejoin the game
pe-07084:
1) Set up a doubles game using the service boxes of the tennis court.
 2) The server starts play by executing a self-drop serve over the net.
 3) Teammates must take turns hitting alternating shots like table tennis doubles.
 4) The ball must bounce before being hit; volleys are not allowed.
pe-07085:
1) A leader stands in front with a ball and teammates line up behind spot markers.
 2) On go, the leader passes to the first player who passes back and shifts to the next spot marker.
 3) The pattern repeats until the last player receives the ball, dribbles up to replace the leader, and the leader moves into the line.
 4) The first team where all players complete the leadership position wins.
pe-07086:
1) Set up a square area of about 10x10 for each team using four cones.
 2) Wait for the teacher's signal and kick the ball toward the opposing team's area.
 3) The opposing team tries to catch (mark) the incoming football before it touches the ground.
 4) If the ball lands inside their trench, the team receives a penalty point; the team with the lowest score wins.
pe-07087:
1) Set up a river area using witches hats or the width of a basketball court, and place three teams on one side of the river.
 2) Give each team 2 gym mats, 2 spot markers, 1 piece of rope, and 1 scooter board (for 3 teams: 6 mats, 6 spot markers, 3 ropes, 3 scooter boards in total).
 3) Without touching the river floor at any stage, teams communicate and use the equipment to cross, such as moving mats and spot markers forward or pulling teammates on a scooter board with the rope.
 4) The first team to get all of their players across to the other side of the river wins.
pe-07088:
1) Set up two sets of stumps 10-15m apart within a cone square, with a batter, bowler, keeper, and two fielders.
 2) The bowler delivers the ball, and the batter must block the ball defensively and run around the outside cone back to the stumps.
 3) If the stumps are hit or the ball is caught, the batter is out, and players rotate roles.
pe-07089:
1) Most players line up at the baseline at one end of the basketball court, and two taggers stand in the middle.
 2) On the start signal, players try to run to the other end of the court without being tagged.
 3) Players who are tagged become seaweed at that exact spot, either keeping one foot on a spot marker or sitting on their backside to tag others.
 4) Continue running end to end until the last player untagged wins the game.
pe-07090:
1) Spread cones evenly across the playing area and hide tennis balls under some of them.
 2) One player from each team runs out at a time to lift one cone and search for hidden treasure.
 3) If empty, place the cone back and tag a teammate; if treasure is found, collect the tennis ball, replace the cone, and return to the team.
pe-07091:
1) Set up four hula hoops in a diamond formation and place two cones to mark a throwing line behind home base.
 2) Players on the throwing team each receive a ball and line up behind the throwing line.
 3) On the teacher's 'Go' signal, all throwers throw their balls into the field, and one designated runner starts running around the outside of the bases.
 4) The fielding team works together to gather and return all balls to the matching color-coded hula hoops.
 5) Once all balls are placed inside the hoops, the teacher calls 'Stop', and the runner must stop running.
 6) Continue until each player on the throwing team has had a turn to run, then switch roles.
pe-07092:
1) Each player stands on a spot marker and dribbles a basketball on the spot.
 2) The first runner places their tennis ball on the ground, dribbles around the front marker, and moves past teammates.
 3) While dribbling, the runner throws and catches the tennis ball back and forth with each teammate using their free hand.
 4) After passing everyone, the runner returns to the start and the next player goes; the first team to finish wins.
pe-07093:
1) Players spread out evenly within a half-court or full-court basketball area.
 2) Two taggers start with a sash and one ball and are not allowed to run with the ball.
 3) Taggers pass the ball to hit others below shoulder height and tagged players become it.
 4) The teacher can periodically add extra balls as fewer runners remain.
pe-07094:
1) Set up a baseball diamond where the kicker kicks the football and the runner circles bases continuously.
 2) The fielding team retrieves the ball and passes it by kicking to first, second, and third base, where third base kicks at the goal posts.
 3) The runner runs until the teacher yells stop upon a successful goal or point, scoring points for bases rounded minus goal points.
pe-07095:
1) Under one basketball ring, the passing team forms a circle with one leader in the middle, while the dribbling team lines up at a cone near the sideline.
 2) On the signal, the center leader passes the ball to each person in the circle and gets it back in order, then the last person replaces the center leader until everyone has had a turn in the center.
 3) Meanwhile, the dribbling team players take turns dribbling around the outside of the circle and shooting a layup for 2 points (or 1 bonus point for hitting the ring), with the next player rebounding to continue.
 4) When everyone on the passing team has been in the center, the round ends, teams switch roles, and the team with the most points wins.
pe-07096:
1) Each player sets up their cone upside down in the playing area.
 2) Kick a soccer ball to knock down an opponent's cone to eliminate them.
 3) An eliminated player picks up their cone and moves to the sideline.
 4) Players on the sideline can control balls and kick them at cones still in play.
 5) Protect your cone to stay in the game as long as you can.
pe-07097:
1) Divide the class into two teams and each team huddles up to choose rock, paper, or scissors.
 2) On the count of three by the teacher, both teams show their chosen shape.
 3) The winning team chases and tags the fleeing members of the losing team.
 4) Any tagged player switches to the opposing team.
 5) Return to the starting position and repeat to capture all opposing players.
pe-07098:
1) Form pairs and join another pair to stand in a diamond formation facing each other
 2) On the teacher's command, both pairs handball their balls simultaneously aiming to collide them in the air
 3) Score 1 point if the balls collide, or 2 points if a player catches a colliding ball before it hits the ground
pe-07099:
1) Set up two spot markers per team across the width of a basketball court, with 4-5 players spaced 3-4 meters apart between them.
 2) The first runner starts from the end marker, weaves through teammates and around the far marker, then weaves back.
 3) Tag the next runner upon return, continuing until all teammates have taken a turn.
pe-07100:
1) Players pair up and link arms, leaving one chaser and one runner on their own.
 2) The chaser pursues the runner, who can find safety by linking onto an existing pair to make a group of three.
 3) The player at the opposite end of the group of three must immediately break away and become the new runner.
 4) If tagged, roles reverse and the tagged player becomes the new chaser.
pe-07101:
1) Place hoops or spot markers on the floor and each participant stands on their own spot
2) One tagger stands in the center hoop and everyone moves according to whistle signals
3) One whistle blow means move one spot clockwise; two blows mean move one spot counterclockwise
4) Three whistle blows mean sprint to any vacant spot except the adjacent ones, and the person left without a spot becomes the next tagger
pe-07102:
1) Sit comfortably at desks simulating a roller coaster ride.
2) React instantly to callouts like raising hands, leaning left, right, or ducking.
3) Maintain posture and body control until the coaster arrives at the stop.
pe-07103:
1) In the Crougar, lift one leg, pass the hand under the calf to jump, then transition into a cross (X) or pull it straight out into an open (O).
2) In the Inverse, lift one leg and insert the same-side hand under the leg first, followed by the opposite hand before jumping.
3) In the Elephant, lift one leg and insert both hands deeply under the leg to form a loop and jump over the rope.
4) For A.S and C.L, bend the knees to lower your posture and pass your hands under the legs or behind the waist before jumping.
pe-07104:
1) Place cones equidistant from the center line, face your partner, and play rock-paper-scissors.
2) The player who loses runs around their own cone and returns; the first to win 5 rounds wins.
3) In 'Catch the Cone', sprint to grab your rear cone upon the cue word and return to grab the center cone first.
pe-07105:
1) Linear: Pairs hold a newspaper together, bouncing a balloon along the line to the end and back without moving feet.
2) Circle: Pairs form a circle holding newspapers and bounce the balloon to pass it around as many times as possible within the time limit.
3) Feet must remain planted on the ground while bouncing.
4) If the balloon drops, resume play from the drop point.
pe-07106:
1) Divide into two teams and set up an equal number of cones in each team's designated zone.
2) When signaled, run to knock down opponents' cones while standing up your own team's cones within the time limit.
3) The team with more standing cones at the end of the time wins.
4) For cone capture, arrange colored cones in a circle, move to music, and grab the called color when music stops.
pe-07107:
1) Divide students into two teams, placing one tagger from each team at the front and others at the back.
2) On the signal, everyone takes one step forward; taggers touch nearby opponents to turn them into jellyfish.
3) Caught players become stationary jellyfish waving one arm to tag nearby opponents until one team is eliminated.
pe-07108:
1) Face your partner and throw playsticks to each other on count; step back one pace if successful, or move forward if failed.
2) Hold playsticks upright facing each other, release them on count, swap places to catch each other's stick, stepping back when successful or returning to start when failed.
3) Face each other with feet aligned in a line, moving only forward and backward to tag the partner's instep with the stick to reach 3 points first in a fencing drill.
4) Sit facing each other with legs extended and a playstick in between, play rock-paper-scissors, and have the winner chase with the stick while the loser dashes across a designated cone line.
pe-07109:
1) Draw an intersection pathway (defense area) and 4 attack rooms inside a square court.
2) Split into two teams to decide offense and defense by rock-paper-scissors, placing attackers in room 1 with a stick and defenders in the intersection.
3) Attackers pass the stick counterclockwise through each room, and when all attackers leave and return to room 1, they gain one life to revive an eliminated teammate.
4) Attackers can evade defenders by crossing the intersection directly or hopping four times on both feet, but get eliminated if tagged by a defender.
5) Teams switch offense and defense once all attackers are eliminated.
pe-07110:
1) Form a circle standing together.
2) Cross arms in an X-shape and hold the hands of adjacent peers.
3) Place a ball on the starter's hands and pass it counter-clockwise without dropping.
4) If dropped, restart by placing the ball on the hands of the next person.
5) Work as a whole class to pass the ball 3 rounds and reduce the record time.
pe-07111:
1) Set up two cones about 12 paces apart, place spot markers behind each cone equal to team size minus two, and set 2 saucer cones on each spot marker.
2) Place 1 defender at each spot marker and 2 attackers at the team cone.
3) When the game starts, attackers run to an opposing defender and play rock-paper-scissors, needing consecutive wins equal to the number of saucer cones behind the defender to take them.
4) If an attacker fails to win consecutively, they must loop around their own cone before trying again, and defenders who lose their cones become attackers.
5) Use acquired saucer cones to upgrade team stacks up to 4 cones or place them on empty spots to switch to a defender role; the team that captures all opponent cones or collects the most cones after 5-8 minutes wins.
pe-07112:
1) Divide into offense and defense; the offense enters the head area (A) and defense enters the body area (B).
2) The game begins when the offense leaves area A; players must hop on one foot outside designated zones.
3) Offense players who cross the bridge (F) earn the right to walk on both feet.
4) Players may only cross between inside and outside through the tail circle (B); failing to do so causes an out.
5) A hopping player touching the ground with both feet or stepping on lines is eliminated.
6) If defense eliminates all offense players, roles switch; if an offense player enters through the tail and steps on zone C, offense wins.
pe-07113:
1) Arrange desks into a plus (+) shape with a center hole and seat four teams at the ends of each lane.
2) On signal, each player simultaneously rolls a ball along the desk.
3) The team whose ball enters the center hole first scores a point.
pe-07114:
1) Set up mats safely and prepare cards with body parts written on them.
2) Players take turns drawing a card one by one.
3) Balance on the mat with only the designated body part touching the mat for 3 seconds.
pe-07115:
1) Review four fundamental gymnastic skills: forward roll, backward roll, cartwheel, and handstand.
2) Practice crossing feet upon landing a forward roll to rise smoothly into the subsequent movement.
3) Combine movements such as handstand into forward roll or backward roll into handstand to present a sequence.
pe-07116:
1) Practice taking off from the spring board and placing both hands at the two-thirds point of the vaulting box.
2) Avoid placing hands too close to the front edge to ensure smooth momentum without getting stuck.
3) Explore creative jumping techniques such as side vaults or turning vaults beyond basic straddle vaults.
pe-07117:
1) Place hoops or draw circles on the floor and place multiple balls in the center area.
2) On the starting signal, players sprint to pick up one ball at a time and return it into their team hoop.
3) The team that collects more balls within the target area or time limit wins the challenge.
pe-07118:
1) The tagger jumps forward from the baseline by a set number of steps (e.g., one step, two steps)
2) The next player jumps the same step count trying to touch the tagger or jump further past
3) Failing the landing or being touched results in becoming the tagger or receiving a penalty
pe-07119:
1) Draw a card indicating the specific object to throw (weighted ball, light ball, flying disc, etc.)
2) Analyze the physical properties of the object (pushing, rotating) at the starting line
3) Throw the object past the foul line to see who can achieve the farthest distance
pe-07120:
1) Start the match with a kickoff from the center mark and advance the ball toward the opponent's goal to score.
2) Restart play with a corner kick or goal kick when the ball crosses the goal line, and with a two-handed throw-in when crossing the touchline.
3) Direct free kicks are awarded for handball or physical fouls such as kicking, tripping, or pushing opponents.
4) Indirect free kicks are awarded for dangerous play like high kicking, impeding progress, or offside offenses.
5) Referees penalize unsporting conduct or severe infractions using yellow cards (caution) or red cards (sending-off).
pe-07121:
1) Place a towel on the top of one foot in ready position.
2) Kick the towel up and catch it with the opposite foot.
3) Alternate feet without using hands and aim for 5 consecutive successes.
pe-07122:
1) Pairs face each other and perform quick reaction movements based on caller cues or rock-paper-scissors
2) Choose between two prompted menu options called out by the leader
3) The winning player turns and sprints toward the safety line while the other chases to tag them
pe-07123:
1) Inflate a balloon for 10 seconds and release it to see whose travels furthest (Balloon Missile).
2) Keep balloons airborne using only designated body parts such as head, shoulders, knees, or feet.
3) Hold hands in a circle and cooperatively keep the balloon floating without breaking the grip (Bounce Together).
pe-07124:
1) Learn how to fold physical education clothes neatly in the classroom.
2) Practice lining up in 1 or 2 rows making sure heads align behind one another.
3) Touch a designated facility (e.g. horizontal bar) and quickly form the line in front of the teacher.
pe-07125:
1) Cat and Mouse: Pairs face each other; the called role chases and tags the runner before safety line.
2) Ball Roll Relay: The first runner rolls a ball across a line, runs to retrieve it, and tags the next runner.
3) Flip Resistance: One player lies face down while partner attempts to flip them over within time limit.
pe-07126:
1) Set up two cone goals spaced about 10 meters apart and form 3v3 teams.
2) Teams can attack either goal freely, scoring 1 point by dribbling through the cones or passing through them to a teammate.
3) Immediately turning around to dribble back through the goal scores an additional point.
4) The first team to reach 4 or 5 points wins, after which teams quickly rotate and shuffle players.
pe-07127:
1) Lie face down and place cones within hand reach to set up goals.
2) Support your body using only your elbows, palms, and toes in a plank position.
3) Roll the ball through the opponent's cones without breaking posture.
pe-07128:
1) Two players face each other with two cones placed on their left and right sides.
2) Set a signal rule beforehand (e.g., winner runs to the right cone, loser runs to the left cone).
3) Play rock-paper-scissors with hands or jump feet, and immediately sprint to touch the designated cone first to win.
4) Reverse the reaction rules (win goes left, lose goes right) or use feet jump rock-paper-scissors to test agility.
pe-07129:
1) All participants start by squatting down in a circle.
2) Players take turns calling out a number on a rhythmic signal as participants choose whether to stand.
3) If the called number exactly matches the number of people who stood up, the caller wins.
pe-07130:
1) Master 20 consecutive forward jumps as the fundamental step.
2) Call out counts to synchronize hand rotation with jumping timing.
3) Practice one-legged hopping alternately before advancing to the running skipping motion.
pe-07131:
1) Practice getting onto the bar with legs straddled, either by jumping or stepping on one leg at a time.
2) Practice swinging and jumping forward from hanging to master the forward dismount.
3) From straddling the bar, swing hips through underneath to create centrifugal force and fly forward to land.
pe-07132:
1) Stand about 1 meter away from basket pole
2) Aim at rim edge of basket
3) Bend knees and throw ball straight upward with both hands
4) Hold 2 to 3 balls vertically and throw together
5) Divide team into throwers and ball collectors
pe-07133:
1) Jump forward along cones performing jumping jacks with hands and feet opening and closing simultaneously.
2) Increase difficulty by switching so hands open when feet close and hands close when feet open.
3) Switch hand-foot coordination pattern immediately upon reaching center cone of the line.
pe-07134:
1) The tagger protects the soccer ball inside the marked area while trying to tag other runners.
2) Outside players avoid being tagged by staying outside markers (safe zones) and look for a chance to steal the ball.
3) Stealing the ball and completing 5 consecutive passes scores 1 point, while being tagged makes you the new tagger.
pe-07135:
1) Swing legs from support, keep back straight, and turn head far and fast.
2) Keep hands loose until passing under the bar, then regrip firmly.
3) Tuck chin and bend elbows slightly after crossing bar to rotate compactly.
4) Keep belly close to bar and return to support position.
pe-07136:
1) The teacher (lion) stands inside the center, and the children hold hands tightly in a circle to form a cage.
2) When the lion tries to escape underneath, children squat down; when the lion tries to climb over, they raise their arms up high.
3) If the children maintain their hold and keep the lion inside the cage, the children team wins.
4) If the lion escapes through the cage, children must quickly sprint to their safe home mat without getting caught.
pe-07137:
1) Form pairs to practice supporting body weight on floor and resistance pushing games.
2) Use towels or partner hands to push/pull against each other, contracting and relaxing muscles.
3) Run keeping 5m spacing, instantly mirroring poses, circling partner, or crawling under on cue.
pe-07138:
1) Pairs hold hands, lean back against each other's pull, and maintain balance.
2) Pairs stand back-to-back without linking arms, support each other's weight to stand up, and jump together.
3) One partner dribbles while seated and the other tries to steal the ball or runs around them.
4) Practice timed jumping with ball bounces and passing or rolling the ball over a partner's back.
pe-07139:
1) Stand feet shoulder-width apart, rest shot on base of middle finger tucked under neck.
2) Support shot with non-throwing hand and lift throwing elbow high and parallel to target line.
3) Thrust shot straight toward ground and flick wrist outward upon release.
pe-07140:
1) Stand facing throw direction without discus, stepping non-pivot foot forward.
2) Turn hip of pivot leg toward throw direction to create torso twist.
3) Fold and swing non-pivot leg 180 degrees into power position.
4) Practice with discus once footwork feels natural and release.
pe-07141:
1) Two teams play against each other on the court while one or two other teams wait on the side.
2) The winning team stays on the court.
3) The losing team steps off to the side, and a waiting team fills in for the next game.
pe-07142:
1) Place four mats in gym corners away from the walls and divide students into four even teams.
2) Give one team pennies to be the catchers, while other teams become puppies.
3) On the signal, puppies run away and any tagged puppy must return to their starting mat cage.
4) Once all puppies are caught, pass pennies to the next team and repeat.
pe-07143:
1) The crows team and cranes team stand back-to-back along the gym center line.
2) Each team faces outward toward their respective end lines.
3) The leader calls out either 'crows' or 'cranes'.
4) The called team chases the opposing team toward their end line, and any tagged player switches teams.
5) Players reset in the middle and continue until one entire team is caught.
pe-07144:
1) Place two skipping ropes 1-2 feet apart on the ground to represent a river.
2) Players take turns running and jumping across the river.
3) If they clear it, they advance to the other side; if they land in the river, they are out and sit out.
4) Once all remaining jumpers cross, widen the distance by about half a foot and jump back.
5) Continue until only one final jumper remains.
pe-07145:
1) Divide the court into thirds with teams occupying the end zones and sharing the middle third, placing eliminated zones along the opponent sidelines.
2) Start the 10-minute game with two dodgeballs, adding a third ball at 7 minutes and a fourth ball at 9 minutes.
3) Players hit from the shoulders down are out and move to the sideline outside the court opposite their side, continuing play from the perimeter.
4) Throwers are called out if they hit an opponent in the head or throw unnecessarily hard from close range.
5) A team holding the ball for longer than 5 seconds must roll possession over to the other team under the ball-in rule.
pe-07146:
1) Place two mats at opposite ends of the basketball court as bases, designating a fielding team and a kicking team.
2) The pitcher rolls a foam soccer ball to the kicker, who kicks the ball and runs toward the base mat.
3) Kicking runners reaching base can stay safe or run back home to score a point, with unlimited runners allowed on base.
4) Returning runners can continue running back and forth between mats to score multiple points until hit by a thrown ball.
5) A batter or runner is out when a pop fly is caught or when touched by a thrown ball while off base.
pe-07147:
1) Divide the playing area into four quadrants and place a hula hoop with a cone topped by a tennis ball in each corner.
2) Split into four teams with each team staying entirely within their own quadrant, starting with one foot in the hula hoop.
3) On the whistle, players sprint to retrieve foam balls from the center and immediately throw them to knock tennis balls off opponents' cones.
4) Players must remain inside their designated team quadrant at all times throughout the game.
5) Once a tennis ball is knocked off a cone, it remains down for the duration of the match.
pe-07148:
1) Choose a starting side between side 1 (feet cannot touch floor) and side 2 (free movement) divided by the center line
2) Cross to the opposite end avoiding the tagger in the middle, switching sides once if desired
3) Players who get tagged join the tagger's team in the next round
pe-07149:
1) Players line up behind their team's cones
2) On the whistle, the first runner dashes to the mat and performs the designated exercise (such as 10 push-ups)
3) The runner sprints back and high-fives the next player who then takes their turn
pe-07150:
1) Teams work together to construct castles using 6 hula hoops (1 base, 4 sides, 1 top)
2) Throw dodgeballs to knock down the opposing team's castles to score points
3) Knocked-down castles can be rebuilt, and players cannot throw balls at a castle while it is being rebuilt
pe-07151:
1) Place treasure like beanbags, tennis balls, and frisbees in the center circle of the gym guarded by keepers
2) Teams from four corner bases attempt to steal equipment and return it to their base without getting tagged
3) If tagged, a player must return any stolen item to the center and touch their team hula hoop before rejoining the game
pe-07152:
1) Students line up along one wall while two designated throwers hold dodgeballs facing them
2) Throwers time it to throw dodgeballs simultaneously against the wall above the runners and catch the rebound
3) As the ball hits the wall runners sprint to the opposite side while throwers try to hit them with the rebounded balls
4) Hit players must sit down where they were hit and can tag passing runners in subsequent rounds
pe-07153:
1) Place beanbags inside end zones at both sides of the gym and divide students into two opposing teams
2) Players cross into enemy territory without getting tagged to reach the safe end zone and grab a beanbag
3) Once a beanbag is placed on their head they become immune to tags and must walk back balancing it without dropping
4) If tagged before reaching the zone or if the beanbag falls, the player must sit down until tagged and rescued by a teammate
pe-07154:
1) Two teams play dodgeball on opposite sides divided by a center line.
2) The first player hit from each team moves to the hula hoop zone on the opponent's side to become a thrower.
3) Subsequent players hit walk down the bench (plank) and jump onto the mat while trying to catch a ball thrown by their thrower.
4) If the catch is successful, the thrower who was there longest returns to their team, and the catcher becomes the new thrower.
5) If they miss the catch, they must go to the back of the plank to try again, and the round ends when all players on a team are hit.
pe-07155:
1) Students lie on their backs on the floor in team lines, positioned head to toe.
2) Place hula hoops at both ends of each line and fill the starting hoop with various equipment items.
3) Players pass each item down the line to the next person using only their feet while using hands solely for balance.
4) If an item drops, players must pick it up using only their feet and continue until it reaches the end hoop.
pe-07156:
1) Students start by sitting down in pairs across the playing area.
2) One pair is split into a chaser (tagger) and a fleer (runner) to start the tag game.
3) The fleer escapes and sits down beside any seated pair, which bumps the opposite partner out to become the new fleer.
4) If the chaser tags the fleer at any point, they immediately switch roles.
pe-07157:
1) All students stand along a single gym line representing ants on a log.
2) Without stepping off the line, students shuffle past each other to reverse their order.
3) Alternatively, two teams race to switch spots or reverse their orders first.
pe-07158:
1) Players scatter across the playing area and the first person to grab the loose foam ball becomes the thrower.
2) The thrower can take up to three steps before attempting to hit a player.
3) Hit players become mushrooms by crouching down, and they can tag passing players to swap roles.
4) If mushrooms complete passes among all grounded mushrooms without interception, they all stand back up.
pe-07159:
1) Place hula hoops with a plastic pin inside each around the area to serve as home bases.
2) Base players protect their pin while waiting players stand along the perimeter.
3) Players throw dodgeballs to knock down opponents' pins; when a pin falls, that player is replaced by a waiting player.
pe-07160:
1) Partners face three cones that have tennis balls balanced on top.
2) Partners take turns kicking a soccer ball toward the cones to knock off the tennis balls within a 2-minute time limit.
3) After kicking, retrieve the ball via dribbling or passing back to the partner for their turn.
4) If all tennis balls are knocked off, move the cones farther away to increase the challenge.
pe-07161:
1) Students line up on one side of the gym and one student is chosen as the tagger.
2) Students chant to the tagger who then calls out a specific color.
3) Students wearing that color try to run across without getting tagged.
4) Tagged players join the tagger for the next round.
pe-07162:
1) Set up obstacles across the playing area using hockey sticks, benches, mats, and cones.
2) Students pair up and one partner wears a blindfold.
3) The seeing partner verbally guides the blindfolded partner safely through the minefield.
4) If an obstacle is hit, restart or perform penalty exercises at the end, then switch roles.
pe-07163:
1) Place two nets with mat crease areas on opposite gym sides and split into two teams.
2) Assign a goalie for each team and restrict players to their own side.
3) Green dodgeballs are thrown into the opposing net to score points.
4) Purple dodgeballs are thrown at opposing players to temporarily eliminate them.
5) Hit players go to the side to complete a quick exercise before returning.
pe-07164:
1) Divide the playing area into four quadrants using cones or lines, placing one tagger (dog) with a foam ball or scarf in each quadrant.
2) The remaining runners start in one corner and are free to run across all quadrants and fences.
3) Dogs must stay inside their own backyard and tag runners, and anyone tagged becomes the new dog by taking the ball or scarf.
pe-07165:
1) Set up safe zones for blue and red teams at opposite ends of the gym and place cones in corners as team jails.
2) Staying in the safe zone resets a player's timer to fresh, and only a fresher player who left their base later can tag an opponent who left earlier.
3) Tagged players go to the opposing jail, where they can link hands to stretch out the line toward their own team.
4) A teammate can rescue one prisoner at a time by reaching the jail safely, granting both players a free walk back.
5) A team wins the round by capturing all opposing players into their jail.
pe-07166:
1) Place mats in the gym corners as sailor ships and one mat in the center as the pirate ship jail.
2) Three pirates holding pool noodles chase and gently tag sailors running between ships.
3) Sailors are safe on ship mats but are only allowed to stay for a maximum of 3 seconds before moving.
4) Tagged sailors go to the pirate ship prison and can be freed if an active sailor reaches them and escorts them safely back to a sailor ship by holding hands.
pe-07167:
1) Students pair up, with one player placing a hula hoop on the floor and the other holding a basketball or soccer ball.
2) On the start signal, players with balls dribble around the area.
3) Players in the hoops try to knock away the balls from the dribblers while keeping at least one foot inside the hoop.
4) A player who loses the ball retrieves it to continue dribbling, and players switch roles after a few minutes.
pe-07168:
1) Students form pairs at their team cone, each pair holding two skipping ropes.
2) On the signal, pairs run to a hula hoop and scoop it up by sliding the skipping ropes underneath without using hands or feet.
3) They transport the hoop together without dropping it and bring it to their cone to score points.
4) If a hoop falls, they must stop and lift it again using only the ropes, and the round ends when all hoops are collected.
pe-07169:
1) Set up four cones in a square and place a hula hoop in the middle with two footballs, with teams lined up at the cones.
