2) On the signal, the first player in line runs to the hoop and picks up a football.
3) The second player runs around the cone to catch a lead pass.
4) The ball is returned to the hula hoop, and players go to the back of the line for the next turn.
pe-07170:
1) Set up a plant zone and an animal zone using cones, giving one tagger a green noodle and the other an orange noodle.
2) On the signal, runners tagged by the green noodle enter the plant zone, while those tagged by orange enter the animal zone.
3) When all runners are caught, the zone with more players wins and chooses an exercise penalty for the losing team.
pe-07171:
1) Students spread out in the gym, each holding a tennis ball or bean bag.
2) Walk around in any direction while throwing the ball up and catching it.
3) If a student drops the catch, they must lie on their back and complete one throw and catch to rejoin the group.
pe-07172:
1) Form groups of 3 to 7 players with one volleyball per group and place a deck of cards in the center.
2) One player from each group runs to grab a card and brings it back to their circle.
3) Complete volleyball passes equal to the card number (J=11, Q=12, K=13) to keep it; if failed, return it under the deck and take a new one.
pe-07173:
1) Split the gym into two halves, create end zones with poly spots or cones, and divide students into two teams.
2) Slide a bean bag across the floor to hit an opposing player on the foot, sending them to the end zone jail.
3) Trapped players are freed and return when a teammate throws a football and they successfully catch it inside the end zone.
4) If too many players are trapped, call a jailbreak to release everyone.
pe-07174:
1) Form a circle of 4 to 10 players with feet touching the adjacent players' feet to create an opening between the legs.
2) Hunch over slightly and strike the ball back and forth using hands.
3) When the ball goes between a player's legs, the person who struck it scores a point.
4) The player who was scored on retrieves the ball and brings it back to continue play.
pe-07175:
1) Assign each scattered student an animal role ensuring at least two students per animal.
2) On signal students move like their animal while making animal sounds.
3) Once matching pairs find each other they stay put until everyone finishes.
pe-07176:
1) Set up mini nets using cones about two soccer balls wide.
2) Divide into two teams and introduce one or two soccer balls.
3) Score a point by successfully passing the ball through the cones without goalies.
pe-07177:
1) Divide into two teams spread across the floor and determine who starts.
2) Complete five consecutive passes without dropping the ball or being intercepted.
3) Players cannot pass back and forth between two people and must pass to someone else.
4) On the fifth pass, place or slam the ball on the ground to score a point, then the other team starts with possession.
5) If intercepted or knocked to the ground by an opponent, possession turns over.
pe-07178:
1) Set up pylons around the gym and hide beanbags under about half of them out of sight.
2) Form teams in lines; on the signal, the first player runs out and checks under a pylon.
3) If a beanbag is found, they bring it back to their group; if not, the team performs five jumping jacks before the next runner goes.
4) Continue in relay order, and the team that scavenges the most beanbags wins.
pe-07179:
1) Divide into a kicking team and a fielding team, and split the kicking team into small groups of 3 to 6 players.
2) Set up mats on the floor; two pitchers roll balls simultaneously, and two kickers from the active group kick them.
3) Once kicked, all runners in the group must sprint to the far mat and directly back without stopping.
4) Fielders retrieve the balls and throw at runners below the shoulders to score points; a fielder cannot throw twice in a row and cannot tag runners with the ball.
5) The fielding team scores one point for each runner hit, and teams swap roles once all kicking groups have finished.
pe-07180:
1) Divide students into four lines facing each other without any equipment.
2) The first runner from all four lines starts running at the same time, following paths that intersect in an hourglass shape.
3) Each runner high-fives the first person in their target line and moves to the back of that line.
4) The runner who received the high-five immediately takes off, maintaining a continuous, non-competitive running flow.
pe-07181:
1) Place numbered poly spots randomly along the baseline for each runner to stand on.
2) Taggers or the teacher call out three numbers, and those called players attempt to run across to the other side.
3) Tagged players go to the side jail, while successful runners score points for the runners against the taggers.
pe-07182:
1) Partners pair up; one partner takes a skipping rope and the other places 5 poly spots in a pattern on the floor.
2) Set a clock for 1 minute; one player counts completed skips while the other counts finished movement sequences across the spots.
3) After 1 minute, partners switch roles and repeat the activity.
pe-07183:
1) Set up nets on the four sides of the gym and divide students into even teams.
2) Teams guard their own net while trying to score in any of the other nets.
3) Start with one soccer ball and gradually add more balls as the game progresses.
pe-07184:
1) Set up goal areas (about 3x3 feet) along the gym sides for each team to guard.
2) Players pass frisbees to teammates who earn points by catching a pass inside a goal area.
3) Players cannot run with the frisbee, and only one defender at arm's length may guard.
pe-07185:
1) Layup Wheel: Six teams shoot layups at designated hoops, pass the ball to the next runner, and rotate baskets after a set time.
2) Pirates: Most students dribble while 2-3 pirates try to steal a ball; a player who loses the ball becomes a pirate.
3) Hot Shots: Players shoot from spot markers and collect each marker into their team hoop upon making a shot.
pe-07186:
1) Students move freely around the area by running, walking, or jumping.
2) When music stops or the signal sounds, each player freezes in one of four postures: sit, stand, kneel, or lie down.
3) The leader closes eyes and calls out one posture; players in that posture are eliminated and do perimeter exercises.
pe-07187:
1) Divide into kicking and fielding teams, and a kicker kicks the ball rolled by the teacher.
2) Upon the kick, all kicking team runners run to the opposite sideline and back.
3) Each round trip scores a point until the fielding team records three outs or passes the ball back to the pitcher.
pe-07188:
1) Scatter multiple hula hoops across the playing area and set up cones for each team of at least three players.
2) On start, the first player runs into a hula hoop and the next teammate tosses them the ball.
3) If caught with both feet inside the hoop, the player retrieves the hoop to score a point for their team.
pe-07189:
1) Place four hoops in the corners as safe zones and one in the center as the skunk home.
2) Two taggers start in the center and chase other players on signal.
3) Tagged players go to the center hoop, yell "new skunk", and switch roles with the previous tagger.
4) Players can stay in a safe zone for up to 10 seconds, but must leave if another player enters.
pe-07190:
1) Set up hula hoops on the floor and have noodle taggers chase runners.
2) Players inside hoops are safe, but must leave when another player arrives and says the secret password.
3) Tagged players become bad guys who help taggers by walking only.
4) In higher levels, bad guys must link hands to form blobs of 2, 3, 4, and 5, with 5-player blobs able to tag players inside hoops.
pe-07191:
1) Players occupy four squares numbered 1 through 4 (King) while remaining players line up outside.
2) The King serves lightly to start the rally using volleyball skills like bumping or setting into other squares.
3) A player who makes a mistake (hits out or drops the ball) is eliminated and goes to the end of the waiting line.
4) Remaining players rotate up to fill vacant higher squares and the next waiting player enters square 1.
pe-07192:
1) Imagine the floor is lava, stepping across two books as stepping stones to reach the goal.
2) Challenge moving by balancing on one foot per book or hopping on one foot to the targets.
3) Imagine the floor is dirty ice, standing on two wet wipes to slide, spin, and wipe the floor without losing contact.
pe-07193:
1) Match movements while chanting the traditional song back and forth between tagger and players.
2) Move according to the chant lyric 'come here and live, go away and die'.
3) The tagger hops on one foot toward the target and tags them with both hands.
pe-07194:
1) The batter hits a dodgeball placed on a tee aiming for a base hit.
2) The batter runs around the bases toward 1st, 2nd, and 3rd base.
3) Fielders get outs by hitting runners with the dodgeball or throwing to bases, switching sides at 3 outs.
pe-07195:
1) The tagger chases runners with a soft hammer tag tool.
2) Caught runners are given either the Up or Down command.
3) Up players jump with raised hands and feet together, while Down players lie on the floor.
4) High-five a partner in the same state (Up with Up, Down with Down) to revive.
pe-07196:
1) Walk around the classroom freely to the music.
2) When the music stops, face the nearest friend and play rock-paper-scissors.
3) If it ends in a tie, the two players hold hands and form a pair.
4) Move together to the music and play again with others when it stops, linking hands if you tie.
pe-07197:
1) Write a Korean word on a sticky note and stick it to your back.
2) Line up along one classroom wall.
3) On the start signal, hop on one foot toward the opposite wall.
4) Spot the word on another player's back and shout it out to eliminate them.
pe-07198:
1) Place the target balloon on the floor and start from each corner baseline.
2) When playing with feet, kick the balloon on the floor toward the target balloon.
3) If it hits the target balloon, score 1 point and gain another turn; if it misses, turn passes to the opponent.
4) When playing with hands, toss the balloon up and hit it around eye level toward the target balloon.
pe-07199:
1) Practice swing open and swing cross while jumping.
2) Perform left EB swing, right swing, and insert the EB movement again.
3) Connect EB toad and swing toad skills in rhythm.
4) From toad, wrap the rope around the leg, untangle it, and finish with a cross jump.
pe-07200:
1) Move desks and chairs to one side of the classroom to clear an open activity area.
2) Listen to the teacher's condition (e.g., shoe size, height, arm length in silence) and line up in order.
3) Use gestures, silent body language, or rock-paper-scissors to settle the order if values are identical.
4) Once lined up, make a heart with both arms above the head, shout "Finished!", and complete follow-up missions like walking around the room.
pe-07201:
1) Each player prepares a balloon inside their own marked area
2) Bounce the balloon up in the air to the music using any body part
3) When the music stops, balance the balloon on the body part called out by the teacher (back of hand, instep, etc.)
4) Hold the balance for 3 seconds without letting the balloon drop to pass
5) Stay within personal boundaries without invading other players' spaces
pe-07202:
1) Start the game by serving from the restricted serve area in a clockwise rotation.
2) The ball can be played directly or after a maximum of one bounce; two or more bounces result in a lost point.
3) Return the ball to the opponent's court within a maximum of three passes using only the head and parts below the knees.
4) Touching the ball twice consecutively, contacting the net with body parts, or crossing over to the opposing court results in a fault.
pe-07203:
1) Divide into two equal coed teams; the batting team sits in alternating order, and the fielding team spreads behind the fielding line.
2) Place team vests on third-base cones for 1, 2, and 3 points, with separate bases for runner and fielders at home.
3) The kicker kicks the ball, runs to pick up a chosen vest for points, and steps on home base before the fielding team to score.
4) Fielders cross the fielding line after the kick and step on the defensive base with the ball to record an out.
5) Teams switch sides after all kickers take a turn, and the team with the most points wins.
pe-07204:
1) In step 1, learn characteristics of baseball-type games and sending the ball to open spaces via circular kickball.
2) In step 2, practice fundamental skills like target hitting, cone running, diamond relay, and passing to score.
3) In step 3, learn defensive positioning strategies using spot markers.
4) In step 4, play actual games like kickball, punchball, and tee-ball.
5) In step 5, play varied baseball-type games such as up-and-down kickball, kickball running, and hexagonal baseball.
pe-07205:
1) Students place a school supply item (ruler, eraser, pencil case, sticky note) on body parts like head, arm, or shoulder, excluding palms and backs of hands.
2) While balancing the item, students run and dodge the tagger around the classroom.
3) If the tagger knocks the item off or it falls, the student freezes and cannot move.
4) A classmate must avoid the tagger and place the item back on the frozen student to revive them.
pe-07206:
1) Form a group of 4 to 6 players and assign numbers to each member.
2) Player 1 stands at the center of the fan while the others form the arc.
3) When player 1 tosses the ball, the next player returns it accurately using an underhand or overhand toss.
4) Once everyone receives and returns the ball, rotate the center player and repeat.
pe-07207:
1) Players use their feet or head to shoot the ball into the opponent's goal.
2) Field players except the goalkeeper must not touch the ball with their hands or arms.
3) When the ball crosses the sideline, play restarts with a two-handed throw-in.
4) If the ball goes over the end line off a defender, a corner kick is awarded, while fouls lead to free kicks or penalty kicks depending on location.
pe-07208:
1) Use an uppercut swing from low to high to hit fly balls and advance runners
2) Use a chop down swing on the top of the ball to create ground balls
3) Fake a directional hit before swinging toward the opposite gap to confuse defenders
pe-07209:
1) Designate one player per team who can use both hands and feet, then start a 2-on-2 match
2) Designated players may use hands and feet while other players use only feet and head
3) A maximum of one bounce is allowed per side and the ball must be returned within 3 touches
4) Players must only use feet or head when returning the ball over the net
5) The first team to score 5 points wins with a 2-point lead required in deuce at 4-4
pe-07210:
1) Set up a rectangular play area, divide into two teams of 6 players each, and have each student prepare one soccer ball.
2) Dribble your own ball while trying to kick the opponent team's balls out of bounds.
3) If your ball goes out of the area, keep moving to receive a pass from a teammate or kick the opponents' balls out.
4) When the set time ends, the team with more balls inside the area wins.
pe-07211:
1) Place a hoop, determine the order with rock-paper-scissors, and line up in front of the hoop.
2) 'Jal-pi-hae' involves stepping into the hoop with one foot while saying 'Jal', and hopping out landing on both feet saying 'Pi-hae'.
3) 'Pi-hae' involves jumping past without stepping inside the hoop, landing on both feet while shouting 'Pi-hae'.
4) Followers must match the technique used by the leader ('Jal-pi-hae' or 'Pi-hae').
5) Attack opponents' feet by tapping from the side during landing; attacked players are eliminated until one winner remains.
pe-07212:
1) Form a group of 5 students and stand in a pentagon formation.
2) Throw and catch the ball in a star pattern at various heights including chest height, overhead, and rolling on the ground.
3) Count how many successful catches are made in 3 minutes, and the group with the highest score wins.
pe-07213:
1) Mark Blue and Red team zones with cones where opposing players cannot enter.
2) Players start from their zone wearing two tails on their belts, representing two lives.
3) Players pull opponents' tails; losing both tails requires returning to one's own zone.
4) Acquired tails can be given (1 or
2) to eliminated teammates to revive them, or attached to one's own belt/held in hand if no one needs revival.
5) The team that collects more tails within the time limit wins.
pe-07214:
1) Step 1: Alternate grouping index-middle fingers and ring-pinky fingers together 10 times
2) Step 2: Face palms to chest, pointing index on one hand and thumb-pinky on the other, alternating 10 times
3) Step 3: Start with rock-scissors and alternate rock, scissors, and paper asynchronously with both hands 10 times
pe-07215:
1) Each team receives 6 attacks per round, scoring by spiking into the opponent's court
2) Defenders earn 1 point if they cleanly catch the attacked ball
3) In caring volleyball, touching the ball among all players within assigned touches (team count + 1) awards 1 point regardless of attack outcome
pe-07216:
1) Set up high-jump mats as targets and place a partner behind the mat as a referee and ball retriever.
2) The thrower takes 6 balls and throws them overhand from behind the throwing line.
3) Score 1 point for each hit on the mat, and switch roles with your partner after throwing all 6 balls.
pe-07217:
1) Draw concentric circles and place one student inside the inner circle to act as the basket.
2) Attackers score 2 points by passing the ball past defenders directly to the goal student.
3) Attackers cannot dribble after receiving the ball and must pass or shoot from where they stand.
4) Roles switch if the ball or player goes out of bounds, a pass is intercepted, or a goal is scored.
pe-07218:
1) Taggers use tag sticks to touch and eliminate running players.
2) Tagged players raise their hands to signal and move to the out zone.
3) When an active player kicks the ball in the can zone, all eliminated players are revived.
4) Taggers cannot tag anyone until the ball is returned to its base.
pe-07219:
1) Place a stacking cup hanging over the edge of the desk.
2) Flip it with a finger to rotate in the air and land upright on the desk.
3) If the cup lands upright, place it on the bingo board.
4) The player who completes a bingo line first wins.
pe-07220:
1) Draw a starting line and line up behind it starting with the players who lost rock-paper-scissors.
2) The first player shouts each syllable of 'Heo-su-a-bi' while taking one hop per syllable for four total hops on one foot and stops.
3) Subsequent players also hop four steps, but get eliminated if they touch another player or lose balance and fall.
4) Once everyone finishes moving forward, players take turns returning to the starting line within four steps without failing.
pe-07221:
1) Practice the movement without a rope by jogging in place, lightly lifting each knee alternately.
2) Keep the lifted foot extended downwards so that the toes point to the floor and the sole faces backward.
3) Once the footwork is comfortable, use a jump rope and slowly skip rope by alternating feet.
pe-07222:
1) Perform a 10-throw catch routine with a partner focusing on ball rotation.
2) Bend knees with the front foot forward to field 5 grounders in front of the body and throw back at chest level.
3) Practice batting by driving through the ball with open palms or light swings while keeping the core axis steady.
pe-07223:
1) Start at the center cone line and play rock-paper-scissors with anyone in the same cone zone.
2) If you win, advance one cone forward; if you lose, return to the starting cone.
3) Winning three times in a row to pass the final cone and reach the goal scores 1 point, and the most points in 1 minute wins.
pe-07224:
1) Mount the horizontal bar and securely hook both legs over the bar.
2) Grip the bar wrapping the thumb around and never release your hands.
3) Look towards your thighs (diagonally down) and curl up tightly to swing all the way around forward (Heaven) or backward (Hell).
pe-07225:
1) Start in the front support position on the bar and swing legs back and forth to gain momentum.
2) Practice tucking on the floor first to get used to the rounded body shape.
3) Hook the backs of the knees over the bar, hold the backs of the knees firmly with the hands, and boldly lean the arms and upper body forward to roll.
pe-07226:
1) Master regular backward double unders and backward criss-cross jumps before trying this skill.
2) Set the jump rope slightly longer than usual.
3) Bend knees slightly to stay compact and jump quickly.
4) Look diagonally downward to maintain a slight forward lean while executing the backward cross.
pe-07227:
1) The teacher demonstrates slow running and fast in-place dashing while students mirror the rhythm and tempo.
2) While running in place, students instantly step one foot in the direction indicated by the teacher's hand signals (right/left).
3) Once accustomed, add 'up' (jump) and 'down' (touch the ground and resume) commands to challenge reaction speed.
pe-07228:
1) Roll and rotate the ball closely around your torso to familiarize your body with the ball feel.
2) Stand with legs apart and pass the ball in a figure-eight pattern through your legs to understand body-ball positioning.
3) Toss the ball upward and clap your hands exactly when the ball reaches its peak height before catching it.
pe-07229:
1) Imagine holding a big ball in front of the stomach and place hands slightly farther forward than usual.
2) Keep the elbows extended, support body weight with arms, extend the knees, and kick off the ground to roll.
3) Tuck the body tightly at the final moment feet hit the ground to generate speed and stand up.
pe-07230:
1) Stand in front of a low bar and grip the horizontal bar with both hands in an overhand grip (palms facing down).
2) Support your weight with both arms and jump over the bar to get the feel of the movement.
3) Position your body between both arms and practice shifting your body sideways over the bar.
4) Swing your legs back and forth to generate momentum, lifting your hips high to vault over the bar and dismount.
pe-07231:
1) Practice rotating the rope with one hand without jumping to learn the fast rhythm transition from single bounce to Hayabusa.
2) Practice the rotation timing while jumping in place with both hands separately.
3) Perform a double under and immediately connect into a Hayabusa while keeping the hip position high upon landing.
4) Transition smoothly from the Hayabusa into continuous side-cross rotations.
5) Connect the side-cross double under back into a standard double under to complete the combination.
pe-07232:
1) Set up with two attackers and one defender
2) Attackers score 1 point each time they touch the central cone
3) The defender scores 1 point by tagging either attacker before they touch the cone
pe-07233:
1) Four players stand facing each other marked by cones.
2) After making a pass, the passer must move in the opposite direction of the pass.
3) Moving even a single step toward the passed direction results in an out.
4) Successfully complete 20 consecutive passes to clear the challenge.
pe-07234:
1) The instructor rolls hula hoops across the floor from the center or opposite side.
2) Children run across from one side to the other without letting the rolling hoops touch them.
3) In later rounds, the instructor adds variations such as spinning or curving the hoops.
4) Children observe the path of the hoops and choose whether to dash, wait, or change direction.
pe-07235:
1) Practice basic cartwheels on the mat keeping both arms completely straight.
2) Practice jumping off the springboard with both feet to lift the hips high.
3) Place hands diagonally on the vaulting box, twist the body, and clear to the landing mat.
pe-07236:
1) Hold both handles in one hand and turn the rope backward at the side of the body to learn rotation.
2) Place the rope in front and swing it over backward so it rests behind the heels.
3) Time the rope swing over the head and jump backward smoothly as it lands near the feet.
pe-07237:
1) Place both hands spread wide on a low vault box or mat and keep elbows straight.
2) Keep your eyes looking slightly forward, jump with both feet, and clear across to the opposite side.
3) As you improve, lift your hips higher to increase flight time in the air, and progress to flat mats.
pe-07238:
1) Hold the jump rope handles with index fingers pointing forward along the handle.
2) Swing the rope while placing one arm behind the back and the other in front of the body to form the cross.
3) Practice swinging the rope in this cross position without jumping first.
4) Practice catching the rope under the toes as it swings forward to get the proper loop size.
5) Once comfortable, jump over the swinging rope once, then progress to continuous jumping.
pe-07239:
1) Place both palms flat and wide on the mat, keeping elbows and knees straight.
2) Raise the hips high to form a ramp-like four-legged stance (horse walk).
3) Walk forward slowly on hands and feet without attempting to roll yet.
4) While maintaining the high hip position, look down at the navel to round the spine and roll forward naturally.
pe-07240:
1) Walk or jump over ropes and equipment placed on the floor while maintaining balance.
2) Crawl under low obstacles using the whole body without touching the boundaries.
3) Cooperate with a partner to pull and push mats toward the designated target area.
pe-07241:
1) One volunteer tagger chases the runners to tag them
2) When tagged, a participant must place one hand directly on the tagged spot like a band-aid and continue running
3) If tagged a second time, they must place their other hand on the second tagged spot and keep moving
4) If tagged a third time with both hands attached, they must sit down until another runner removes both band-aids to re-enter
pe-07242:
1) Children form a straight line and gently hold the shoulders of the person ahead.
2) One child outside the line tries to tag the person at the very back.
3) Children in line move together to protect the back person.
4) Once tagged, switch roles between the tagger and the back person.
pe-07243:
1) All participants stand in a circle holding hands.
2) Place a hula hoop at one spot in the circle.
3) Each person passes through the hula hoop to the next person without letting go of hands.
4) Continue until the hula hoop travels all the way around the circle.
pe-07244:
1) One or more children are chosen to be the taggers.
2) When tagged, a child becomes a banana, stops, and raises both arms above their head.
3) Another player rescues them by peeling both arms down, allowing them to rejoin the game.
pe-07245:
1) A portion of the children become goalies and protect their cone or block.
2) The other players have balls and attempt to kick them at the target to knock it down.
3) If a player hits the block or cone, they become the new goalie, while the previous goalie switches to becoming a regular player.
pe-07246:
1) Divide students into pairs.
2) Players try to tap their partner's knees while protecting their own from being touched.
3) Each successful tap earns one point, playing up to five points or the highest score within a time limit.
pe-07247:
1) Select three taggers (Sanderson sisters) with noodle brooms to wait in the center circle.
2) When music plays, outside students throw balls across the gym while taggers try to steal them into baskets.
3) To retrieve a ball, a student goes to a mat, completes 10 jumping jacks, and takes one ball from the basket.
4) Each round lasts two minutes, after which current taggers choose new students who have not had a turn yet.
pe-07248:
1) Start on your feet with legs wide outside a semicircle rope.
2) Place hands down in sequence of foot-foot-hand-hand-foot-foot and jump across to the other side of the rope.
3) Gradually widen the semicircle, swing arms over head like a rainbow, and finish tall with legs apart.
4) Straighten or remove the rope and practice with toes pointed and good posture.
pe-07249:
1) Teams line up at the baseline and run to the center to get a ball on the start signal.
2) Toss a ball into the pool to earn 1 tier or into the laundry baskets to earn 2 tiers, or catch an opponent's throw before it hits the ground to earn 1 tier.
3) Run to the side basket to get earned tiers and build 3-tier pillars on your team's poly spots.
4) Guard your pillars from being knocked over by opponents' throws, and win by completing six 3-tier pillars first or having more complete pillars at the end of the round.
pe-07250:
1) Prepare a spoon and a balloon, and mark the starting lines on the floor using tape.
2) Players navigate through a set indoor course through three rooms while balancing and guiding the balloon with the spoon.
3) The first person to complete the course and guide the balloon into the basket wins the round.
pe-07251:
1) Players divide into two teams, with each player holding a scoop.
2) Teammates pass and catch the ball to one another using their scoops.
3) The ball is allowed to bounce once, and successfully completing 3 consecutive catches scores 1 point before possession turns over to the other team.
pe-07252:
1) Students sit on scooter boards and paddle using foam noodles.
2) If tagged, a student moves directly to the designated exercise zone.
3) The tagged student performs three knee tucks in the exercise zone and returns to the game.
pe-07253:
1) Two teams throw balls to knock the opponent's pumpkins off the cones.
2) If a pumpkin is knocked off, place it under the cone.
3) Catching a thrown ball allows a team to place one fallen pumpkin back onto its cone.
pe-07254:
1) Line up behind the starting cone in front of the hula hoop grid
2) The first student jumps into a hoop and the teacher signals thumbs up for correct or thumbs down for incorrect
3) Correct jumps allow another move to an adjacent hoop, while an incorrect jump sends the player to the back for the next student to try
pe-07255:
1) Each student starts in the center of the gym with one balloon and one pool noodle.
2) When music plays, students keep the balloon in the air by tapping or balancing it with their noodle while moving around.
3) Score points by hitting the balloon through hula hoops hanging from basketball hoops.
pe-07256:
1) Gather in a large circle for instructions, then disperse when the music starts.
2) Perform partner communication and movement challenges such as High Five Bank Account, Righty Lefty, Me You You Me, Three Things introduction, and Head Shoulders Knees and Toes match.
3) Complete the challenge with a high five or handshake and find a new partner.
pe-07257:
1) Line up behind your team's cone, flip the scooter wheels down when it is your turn, and place a bowling pin on top.
2) Move toward the center circle by pushing or pulling the scooter without touching the bowling pin once it is placed.
3) Pick up one piece of treasure from the center and return to your team's hula hoop without letting the pin fall.
4) If your pin is knocked over by a ball or falls on its own, return the treasure and go to the back of the line.
5) When the game ends, the team with the most treasure in their hula hoop wins.
pe-07258:
1) [Folding] Throw a rubber football from the cone to knock down 6 pins, then reset the pins after one turn.
2) [Flag Tag] Pull other players' flags inside the boundary; if pulled, reset outside the line before re-entering.
3) [Running Back] Tuck the ball securely, weave through the cones, touch the line, and hand off to a partner.
4) [Partner Passing] Stand on spots to throw and catch, or have receivers catch while running routes.
5) [Kickoff & Jackpot] Kick off from a tee on the whistle, or take turns catching long throws in Jackpot.
pe-07259:
1) Step on stepping rocks to cross from one island to the next without touching the water.
2) In the traffic jam version, two teams line up facing each other with one empty stepping stone between them.
3) Move forward one empty stone or step around one facing classmate without turning around.
pe-07260:
1) Form pairs where one partner is blindfolded as a robot and the other acts as the coder.
2) The robot holds a hula hoop and starts at the baseline wall.
3) The coder gives directional programming commands such as step count and turn angles.
4) When the robot successfully drops the hoop over a numbered cone, the team collects that cone to earn points.
pe-07261:
1) Retrieve scattered balls and bounce them into a bucket while staying outside the rope circle.
2) Crossing or reaching over the rope boundary results in a foul.
3) Players cannot run while holding a ball, so they must pass or roll it to reach the target count within 2 minutes.
pe-07262:
1) Travel in a counterclockwise circle around the parachute without touching it.
2) When the music stops, find a spot and sit at one of the colors (1-2 students per color).
3) Perform the assigned 30-second fitness exercise for your color (e.g., burpees, planks, sit-up punches, jumping jacks).
pe-07263:
1) Groups rotate through 8 Christmas-themed stations set up around the gymnasium.
2) Students complete the specific WoW Challenge designated at each station.
3) When the music stops, students clean up the equipment and move to the next numbered station.
pe-07264:
1) Scatter alphabet letter papers across the floor.
2) Students move around to find the letters that spell their names.
3) Once all letters are found they finish, with variations such as performing jumping jacks at each letter or playing as a team relay.
pe-07265:
1) Divide the area into three sections (Peasants, Knights, Ultimate Warriors) and play three dodgeball games simultaneously.
2) When a player is hit, they move down one rank to the lower section.
3) The thrower who hit a player advances up one rank, and whoever is in the Ultimate Warriors section when time is called wins.
pe-07266:
1) Divide the area in half, set up cones to form zones, and assign players as builders, blockers, and launchers
2) Launchers throw foam balls to knock down castles, blockers defend, and builders rebuild castles
3) Play 5-minute rounds where each knockdown earns 1 point and knocking down all 3 at once results in an automatic win
pe-07267:
1) Split into two teams and take turns throwing a monster foam frisbee from behind the throw line
2) Score 5 points for an individual catch and 3 points for a team catch, playing first to 50 points
3) Deduct 1 point for a dropped catch, failing to cross the center line, or throwing below 2 feet at the center line
pe-07268:
1) Students sit around the parachute while one mouse crawls underneath and one cat goes on top
2) Students shake the parachute to obscure vision while the cat crawls around trying to find the mouse
3) Once the mouse is caught, both leave the parachute and two new students are selected
pe-07269:
1) Each student takes one balloon and stands behind, in front, or jogs around it.
2) Follow teacher commands to jump over it, gallop, skip, or perform animal walks.
3) Pick up the balloon and keep it in the air using hands, knees, head, or feet.
pe-07270:
1) Students hold the parachute and spin slowly in one direction, then change directions.
2) On command, let go of the parachute and perform a specified fitness task such as 10 jumping jacks.
3) Return to the parachute, hold it again to spin faster, and complete the next command.
pe-07271:
1) Students stand around the parachute holding the edges.
2) They start waving slowly and gradually shake it faster as it gets hotter.
3) Balls are tossed onto the parachute and bounced vigorously like popcorn.
4) Two dedicated fetchers collect balls that fly off and throw them back on.
pe-07272:
1) Line up in relay teams behind a cone or starting line with one large exercise ball per team.
2) On the go signal, the first runner pushes and rolls the ball across the floor and back using their hands.
3) Hand the ball off to the next player, and the first team to have all members finish and sit down wins.
pe-07273:
1) Place a hula hoop in the home area for each individual or partner to serve as their collection zone.
2) Check the list of nature items provided by the teacher and search for them one at a time.
3) Bring the retrieved item back and place it inside the hoop before heading out to find the next item.
4) Complete the scavenger hunt by finding and collecting all the items on the checklist.
pe-07274:
1) Players determine an shooting order, and the first shooter shoots from the free-throw line, earning 2 points per make and continuing to shoot.
2) On a miss, the next player must rebound and immediately shoot from where the ball lands, earning 1 point if made.
3) After making a 1-point rebound shot, that player moves to the free-throw line for 2-point shots, playing until someone reaches exactly 21 points.
pe-07275:
1) One catcher starts inside the middle circle while all other players line up along the starting line.
2) When the teacher calls the school team name and a condition such as a clothing color, matching students run toward the finish line.
3) Any runner tagged by the catcher joins the middle to help tag on subsequent calls.
pe-07276:
1) Place cones in corners to create nests and set benches in the playing area to act as the cage.
2) Doves attempt to travel from their home nest across the open flying area into the safe target nest while avoiding the hawks.
3) Any dove tagged by a hawk must stand on the bench cage until a teammate tags them to set them free.
pe-07277:
1) The teacher calls out commands representing buttons on a video camera
2) Walk on Play, go backwards on Rewind, run on Fast Forward, and move slowly on Slow Motion
3) Jump on Pause, freeze movement on Stop, and lie flat on Delete
pe-07278:
1) Place four colors of hula hoops around the gym for each student and have everyone start inside a hoop.
2) The teacher rolls a die where numbers 1-4 assign that color hoop players as taggers with pool noodles, 5 is jumping jacks, and 6 is teacher is it.
3) Taggers chase and tag other players, and tagged players must stand inside a hula hoop until everyone is caught.
pe-07279:
1) Students form a circle with a few players standing inside the circle.
2) Outside players safely roll or push an exercise ball to hit the players in the middle.
3) When hit, the player must correctly spell a PE-related word given by the teacher to swap spots with the roller.
pe-07280:
1) Teams line up behind the cones.
2) The teacher selects an animal, and the first runner acts like that animal while running to the cone and back.
3) The runner high-fives the next teammate to take their turn.
4) Continue until everyone finishes, then switch to a new animal.
pe-07281:
1) Set up a racetrack using court boundary lines or cones, and students hold a hula hoop around themselves as their race car.
2) On signal, students move around the track while avoiding crashing into each other's personal space.
3) If players bump into someone, they must go to the pit stop in the center to exchange their hula hoop for a new car.
4) Once replaced, they return to the track and continue racing.
pe-07282:
1) Students spread around the gym and one or two taggers are chosen.
2) Tagged players must crouch down like a frog.
3) A free player leapfrogs over the crouched player to return them to the game.
pe-07283:
1) Place hula hoops as podiums inside the court and choose two taggers with pool noodles.
2) Players avoid taggers when the music starts; tagged players enter a hoop and perform dance moves.
3) A free player frees the trapped player by performing the predetermined secret dance move.
pe-07284:
1) Dribble through the course passing between the cones and gates.
2) In the first round, dribble only with the right hand while keeping your head up.
3) In the second round, dribble only with the left hand and change directions.
pe-07285:
1) Slalom around cones and jump with both feet or on one leg over obstacles.
2) Move with side steps and shoot the ball into the goal.
3) Run back as fast as possible and high-five the next runner to switch.
pe-07286:
1) Run, bounce off the springboard/trampoline, and stick a solid two-foot landing on the mat.
2) Perform rabbit hops with hands and feet, then balance walk along the beam.
3) Perform half-turn jumps off the rebounder or vault onto the box using hands and feet.
pe-07287:
1) Jog lightly for 5 to 10 minutes for general warm-up.
2) Perform butt kicks while focusing on arm coordination and looking forward.
3) Repeat butt kicks while rotating arms backward.
4) Perform high knees keeping shoulders from leaning back and driving arms.
5) Do high knees while rotating arms forward like the crawl stroke.
6) Run with straight legs keeping toes pointed up without letting heels touch the ground.
7) Finish with progressive acceleration driving knees high and staying off heels.
pe-07288:
1) Crawl or walk across a 10cm-wide raised balance beam.
2) Move across designated spots coordinating hand and foot placements.
3) Roll the body on a gym mat to overcome fear of losing visual orientation.
4) Link consecutive actions by running, jumping, and rolling in sequence.
pe-07289:
1) Run freely around the gym, switching to single-leg hops or two-feet jumps on signal.
2) Walk on tiptoes with straight legs, then switch to walking on heels.
3) Move across the floor mimicking animals such as rabbits, frogs, elephants, spiders, and ducks.
4) Finish by making small circles with the head to warm up the neck.
pe-07290:
1) Run freely around the room, freeze on command, and quickly run to touch the announced color.
2) Switch locomotor movements to running backward, high knees, and butt kicks.
3) Imitate various animal movements in sequence, including elephant walks, frog jumps, rabbit hops, kangaroo hops, snake crawls, and spider walks.
pe-07291:
1) Pupils work in pairs or small groups to explore counter-tension and counter-balance shapes on gym mats
2) Hold each balance shape for 3 to 5 seconds
3) Create a three-part sequence using the explored shapes
4) Join another group to present sequences and provide two stars and a wish feedback to improve performance
pe-07292:
1) The running team throws the ball into the field and runs along the obstacle course through mats.
2) The fielding team passes the ball to land it into the box in the middle.
3) When the ball hits the box, all runners not on a mat are burned out.
pe-07293:
1) Divide the area into three zones with one catching team in the center and two teams at the ends.
2) End teams run across the center zone to steal balls from the opposing team's box.
3) Players score by returning to their zone untagged, and teams rotate roles after set time.
pe-07294:
1) Place cones 30-50m away; the first runner circles the cone and returns to bring the second runner along.
2) Once all group members run together, runners drop out in reverse order until the last runner finishes solo.
3) The team that finishes first and sits down wins the challenge.
pe-07295:
1) Participants stand in a circle before the activity and memorize who is standing to their left and right
2) When the leader shouts "Action," everyone has 3 to 5 seconds to reform the exact original circle
3) If the group succeeds in silence within time they earn a point, otherwise the leader gets the point
pe-07296:
1) Arrange chairs in a circle with one fewer chair than the total number of players and have everyone sit
2) One person stands in the center and makes a statement that applies to them
3) All players to whom the statement applies must stand up and find a new seat that is not directly next to them
4) The center player also tries to find a seat, and the remaining person becomes the new leader in the center
pe-07297:
1) Divide the court into two team territories with a center line, placing a flag base (10 cones) and a jail in each territory
2) Cross into the opponent territory to steal cones from their base and bring them back safely to score
3) Players can only be tagged in the opponent territory and must go to jail if tagged, while safe zones protect from tagging
4) Jailed players are freed when a teammate runs in, takes their hand, and both make it back untagged
pe-07298:
1) Mark an endline at each end of the court with cones or court markings and divide into two teams
2) Teammates pass the ball to each other and score by placing the ball on the floor behind the opponent endline from inside the court
3) A player holding the ball cannot move and must stay in place, while players without the ball can move freely
4) If the ball drops to the floor, turnover occurs or whichever team picks it up first gains possession
pe-07299:
1) Soccer Tic-Tac-Toe: Dribble a ball with the foot, knock down cones, and place that number of cones on the grid to complete three-in-a-row first.
2) Direction & Color Cone Grab: Stand in pairs following rotational commands (left/right), then quickly grab the cone of the called color.
3) Circle Cone Tag: Runners touch an occupied cone in a circle to switch roles with that student, who becomes the new runner.
4) Squat Cone Reaction: Hold a squat position and be the first in the pair to grab the cone of the called color.
pe-07300:
1) RPS Ball Tag: The winner of rock-paper-scissors grabs the ball to hit the partner for a point.
2) Pass & Chase: Partners pass the ball, and on signal the player without the ball chases the partner dribbling to the goal line.
3) Noodle Tag: The RPS winner grabs the foam noodle and tags the partner before they reach the goal.
4) Finger Math Sprint: Add the fingers shown by both players and race to touch the corresponding numbered cone.
5) 1v1 Goal Line Run: Touch a cone on either side and sprint across the opponent's goal line without getting tagged.
6) Color Cone Stick: Grab the called color cone and be the first to place it on the center pole.
pe-07301:
1) Played on a futsal court where the end lines and corner lines define the goal zones.
2) Tag any part of an opponent's body to stop their advance.
3) A tagged player must return to their own defending goal line before re-entering play.
4) A player scores 1 point by crossing the opponent's goal line, and the team with the most points when time expires wins.
pe-07302:
1) Face each other in pairs.
2) Dribble a basketball with one hand while holding a stick with the other hand.
3) Switch hands or execute drills such as dribbling under the stick according to the teacher's call.
4) Keep continuous control of the dribble to score points against opponent mistakes.
pe-07303:
1) Continuously perform the body percussion rhythms or assigned movements set by the teacher.
2) Maintain the movement rhythm while listening carefully for the start command.
3) Quickly snatch the cone placed in the middle as soon as the signal is called.
4) The student who grabs the cone first scores 1 point.
pe-07304:
1) The first runner of each team runs around the turning cone holding a hoop.
2) Upon returning to the line, all waiting teammates step through the hoop.
3) The next runner joins and repeats the course.
4) The team that gets all members through and completes the round trip first wins.
pe-07305:
1) Two teams stand behind their end lines with a medicine ball or rugby ball placed in the center.
2) Teams throw 7-8 balls at the center ball to push it into the opponent's territory.
3) At the teacher's stop signal, the team that moved the ball into the opponent's court wins, using only balls in their area.
pe-07306:
1) Each student enters a predefined court with their own ball.
2) Players protect their ball while trying to push opponents' balls out of the court.
3) As players are eliminated, the court size can be narrowed down.
pe-07307:
1) Create a 9m x 9m square area; one team stands inside while the other spreads along the outer perimeter.
2) Outer players throw one or more balls at the inside opponents.
3) Hit inside players leave the court; teams switch roles and the team that eliminates all opponents in less time wins.
pe-07308:
1) Students form groups of three running lightly in a line maintaining a 3-4m distance.
2) The central player passes the ball to a side runner who receives it.
3) The receiver turns and passes to the opposite side, taking 2-3 steps towards the ball upon receiving.
pe-07309:
1) Two paired students face each other across a mini volleyball net.
2) They move using lateral gallop steps while passing the ball over the net to each other.
3) They continue the rally back and forth while travelling along the net without dropping the ball.
pe-07310:
1) Run at full speed holding a marker cone, turn around the turning cone, and place the marker cone inside the hoop.
2) Return and tag the next runner, repeating until all group members have run.
3) Once everyone has finished, line up behind the cone and pass the ball down the line one by one without dropping it.
4) Squat down immediately after passing the ball, and the first team to finish scores a point.
pe-07311:
1) Assign numbers from 1 to 6 to students on two teams standing on opposite sides.
2) The teacher stands in the middle holding a handkerchief high and calls out a number.
3) The called players race to grab the handkerchief.
4) If the player who grabs it returns to their team without being tagged, their team scores 1 point; if tagged, the opposing team scores 1 point.
pe-07312:
1) Set up hoops and cones for safe zones with 4 flags (vests) each, and place hoop jails on each side.
2) Infiltrate the opponent territory to retrieve a flag and bring it back safely to score.
3) If tagged in opponent territory, go to jail; a teammate can rescue a jailed player by touching/leading them back.
4) Players cannot be tagged inside the safe zone, and the team wins by capturing all 4 opponent flags to hold 8 in total.
pe-07313:
1) Place mats in opposite corners for students (animals) to stand on, while a group of guardians stands in the middle.
2) The teacher announces that guardians finished work and calls out an animal (e.g., monkeys).
3) Students imitating that animal must mimic its movements while running across to the opposite mat.
4) Anyone tagged by a guardian while crossing must wait outside or become a guardian.
pe-07314:
1) Place benches in four corners of the court with teams lined up behind each bench.
2) Place a soccer ball in the center and assign numbers to players on each team.
3) When the teacher calls a number, the designated players sprint to contest the ball.
4) The player who takes the ball shoots towards any of the other three teams' benches to score a goal upon hitting it.
pe-07315:
1) Students pair up standing back-to-back 1 meter apart, with end zones marked on both sides.
2) One partner is designated as 'Pepe' and the other as 'Pepa'.
3) When the teacher calls 'Pepe', Pepa sprints toward their end line while Pepe chases to tag them.
4) If the runner crosses the line safely they score 1 point; if tagged first, the chaser scores 1 point.
pe-07316:
1) In Around the World, players shoot from nine spots in order to complete the circuit.
2) In Knockout, if the first shooter misses and the second scores first, the first is eliminated.
3) In 3v3, teams check the ball to the opponent before attacking the basket.
4) In 21, players score from free throws (2 pts) and rebounds (1 pt) to reach exactly 21 points.
pe-07317:
1) On signal, one runner from each team dashes to the center circle to dribble a ball back to their hoop.
2) Once the center is empty, players can steal balls from other teams' hoops.
3) Teams strategize by assigning attackers and defenders to gather the most balls.
pe-07318:
1) One player is chosen as the bomber and given a foam ball, while the remaining players pair up and hold a hoop parallel to the ground with both hands.
2) One player in each pair closes their eyes and is guided by their partner.
3) On the instructor's signal, the bomber throws the ball into the hoops to sink them; sunken pairs leave their hoop and latch onto surviving hoops to form bigger shuttles.
pe-07319:
1) A tagger is chosen inside a designated area, and the other players keep possession of the ball using their hands (or feet).
2) Players pass to keep the ball away so the tagger without the ball cannot touch it.
3) The tagger must win the ball from a teammate to switch roles, and anyone who takes the ball out of bounds automatically becomes the tagger.
pe-07320:
1) One player is chosen as the hunter, while all other players stand at the starting line.
2) At the starting signal, all runners must cross the entire playing court without being tagged by the hunter.
3) Anyone tagged joins the hunter to catch the remaining players, and the last remaining player wins to become the next sparrowhawk.
pe-07321:
1) Form a large circle marked by cones and divide players into 3 or 4 teams lined up at equidistant points outside the circle.
2) On the start signal, runners number one dash in the same direction and complete one full lap.
3) Pass the baton to runner number two, and the team that completes the designated number of laps first wins.
pe-07322:
1) Draw a large circle in the center of the play area and set up targets (the castle) in the middle.
2) The defending team positions itself inside the circle while the attacking team stands outside.
3) The attacking team passes the ball with their hands to hit the targets, the defending team protects the castle, and after a set time roles switch with the highest scoring team winning.
pe-07323:
1) Set up 4 cones spaced 1 to 1.5 meters apart for each team, with a hoop at the end.
2) The first runner places a ball on the first cone and runs back.
3) The second runner slaloms past the first cone, picks up the ball, places it on the second cone, and returns.
4) The following runners repeat this until the first team places the ball in the hoop to score.
pe-07324:
1) Four pairs of students form teams and assign numbers 1 and 2 to each player.
2) When a number is called, that player runs to grab another team's scarf and bring it back.
3) The uncalled partner defends their own scarf by tagging opposing runners.
4) Tagged runners must return the scarf to its spot, while successfully retrieved scarves score 1 point.
pe-07325:
1) The batting team takes turns hitting a tennis ball into the field using a baseball bat or tennis racket.
2) The batter runs around the bases marked by cones to cross the finish line and score a point.
3) Fielders retrieve the ball and pass it to the captain positioned between yellow cones.
4) If the captain catches the ball while a batter is between bases, or if the ball is caught on the fly, the runner is out.
pe-07326:
1) Each team's captain stands inside an end zone and must remain within that designated area.
2) Players cannot walk or run with the ball in hand and must pass to advance toward their captain.
3) A minimum of two passes must be completed before passing the ball to the captain.
4) A point is scored when the captain catches the ball inside the zone without letting it touch the floor.
pe-07327:
1) Four teams line up at their respective base cones around the perimeter.
2) On start, the first runner runs around the outside of all opponent cones.
3) After completing the lap, the runner picks up one scarf from the center and brings it to their base.
4) The next runner repeats the process, and the team with the most scarves when all are collected wins.
pe-07328:
1) Assign specific body movements to each card color in advance (e.g., Red=kangaroo jump, Green=high knees, Blue=swimming arms, Yellow=side steps).
2) Distribute one UNO card to each child.
3) Children move around performing the movement matching their card color.
4) On the leader's signal, players swap cards and immediately perform the new movement.
pe-07329:
1) Divide players into three teams (Chicken, Fox, Viper) with designated home zones.
2) Chickens tag Vipers, Vipers tag Foxes, and Foxes tag Chickens.
3) On start, players chase their target team while escaping from their predator team.
4) Tagged players are imprisoned in the tagger's base, and the first team to capture all opposing target players wins.
pe-07330:
1) Set up a semi-circle path using 10 hoops (or cones) with starting lines at both ends for two teams.
2) On start, the first player from each team hops forward through the hoops.
3) When meeting face-to-face, players stop and play Rock-Paper-Scissors.
4) The winner continues forward while the loser returns home; the next teammate immediately departs to block the opponent.
5) Reaching the opponent's starting line scores 1 point, and the first team to reach 5 points wins.
pe-07331:
1) Set up a circular zone with 14 cones and assign numbers to each player on two teams.
2) When a number is called, that player runs to the center and grabs the ball.
3) Teammates run in and position themselves around the center player at each cone.
4) The center player passes the ball to each teammate one by one and receives it back until everyone has passed.
5) The first team to complete all passes and return to their base scores 1 point.
pe-07332:
1) One team starts with the ball at center court and passes to a teammate.
2) Players cannot take more than three steps without dribbling and must dribble if holding the ball for longer than three seconds.
3) Once the ball is held after dribbling, a player cannot dribble again or it is a double dribble.
4) When shooting, the ball must be released outside the opposition goal area.
5) Defenders cannot use contact to win the ball and must rely on interceptions.
6) Defenders entering their own goal area concede a seven-meter penalty.
7) Making contact while attacking is penalized as charging.
pe-07333:
1) Teams play with six or seven aside starting from the halfway line.
2) The objective is to place the ball into the opponent's try zone without being tagged.
3) To restart after a tag, roll the ball back with a foot to the dummy half who must pass it.
4) The attacking team has five attempts to score and loses one attempt per tag.
5) Five tags, forward passes, knock-ons, or running out of bounds result in a turnover.
6) Defenders must retreat five meters after a tag or concede an offside penalty that resets all five tags.
pe-07334:
1) Place hoops with two-meter gaps and have students walk around the open space.
2) Progress to jumping with two feet into hoops and jogging between them.
3) Add fundamental movement skills such as one-foot jumps, skipping, and stepping.
4) Incorporate individual balls for passing and movement drills without exchanging equipment.
pe-07335:
1) Set up a row of cones, and pairs of students stand facing each other across each cone.
2) Listen to the caller's commands and touch the designated body parts or colors.
3) As soon as the caller shouts 'Cone', whoever grabs the cone first wins.
pe-07336:
1) Divide into teams of 3v3 or 4v4 and pass the ball to create attacking opportunities.
2) Move past the centerline and shoot the ball at the rebound frame to score.
3) If the ball bounces off the frame and hits the floor untouched, a point is scored; if the defense catches it, no point is awarded.
pe-07337:
1) On the start signal, players run towards one of the stations featuring balls (1 pt), clips (2 pts), cups (3 pts), or a special ball at the far back (instant win).
2) Players pick up one item and sprint back, but the last person to return must take their item back to its station.
3) Those who are not last keep their items to accumulate points, and the first person to reach 10 points wins.
pe-07338:
1) Two players face each other, each setting up a water bottle filled with water in front of them.
2) Players take turns throwing a ball to knock down the opponent's bottle.
3) When your bottle is knocked down, you must first retrieve the loose ball before standing your bottle back up.
pe-07339:
1) Teams of 4–6 line up at the start line, with number cards (1–
6) placed face down at the far end.
2) On the signal, the first runner hops through hula hoops with both feet together and slaloms around cones to reach the cards.
3) The runner flips one card; if it matches the required sequence (from 6 down to 1), they bring it back, otherwise they flip it back over and tag the next teammate.
pe-07340:
1) Each student holds a number card and moves freely inside the area while music plays.
2) When the music stops, students freeze and quickly find a partner whose card adds up to (or subtracts to) the target number (10 or 15).
3) Pairs that find each other run to one of the hula hoop goal zones outside the boundary to verify their answer.
pe-07341:
1) Put vests on children and mark structures with corresponding colored scarves.
2) Children move to their team color structure and hang.
3) On the teacher's signal children hang, and on the second signal they freeze.
4) Add cats who try to tag the mice when the bell rings while mice avoid by hanging.
pe-07342:
1) All children are ghosts, and four starters (ghost hunters) with balls try to tag the ghosts.
2) A tagged ghost becomes the new ghost hunter but cannot immediately tag back the player who caught them.
3) Ghosts can jump over benches (walls) but only once per bench before finding another, while ghost hunters must run around the benches.
pe-07343:
1) Players split into Blue and Yellow teams on their respective courts and use two balls to hit opponents.
2) Hit players walk around the outside of the court to stand on the opposite bench.
3) If a hit player catches a pass from a teammate, they place the ball down and return around the court into their field to be rescued.
4) The team that eliminates all opposing players onto their bench wins.
pe-07344:
1) Players play inside the boundary with three red balls and try to hit each other.
2) A player holding a ball can take up to two steps and must then throw the ball.
3) Hit players must go behind the white line, perform five jumping jacks, and re-enter the game.
4) If a player catches a ball thrown at them, they are not out and can keep playing immediately.
pe-07345:
1) Two teams play against each other by hitting balls under three benches placed on vaulting boxes.
2) The blue and yellow teams use only flat hands on their respective sides to stop, dribble, and hit the balls.
3) Hitting the ball through the opponent's goal marked by colored cones scores one point.
4) Multiple balls are played simultaneously, and teams keep track of their scores.
pe-07346:
1) Extend both arms straight and roll the ball across the chest using wrist flick.
2) To roll the ball across the back, hold it behind the arm, push upward, and extend both arms into a T position.
pe-07347:
1) All players hold hands and form a circle.
2) One tagger steps outside the circle, and one player inside is chosen as the target to be caught.
3) Players in the circle prevent the target from being caught, while the tagger may slip through but not break through the circle.
pe-07348:
1) Benches are numbered, and students move to the called benches when the teacher calls out two-digit numbers.
2) Perform running coordination, direction changes, balancing, and sliding using long benches.
3) Disperse across 6 benches to perform strength exercises for a set time, rotating to the next bench on signal.
pe-07349:
1) All students except two sit on the floor at least two meters apart.
2) The tagger chases the runner; if the runner sits behind a seated classmate, that classmate becomes the new hunter.
3) The original hunter immediately becomes the hunted runner as play continues.
pe-07350:
1) La-Ola Wave: Students form a lane and raise hands at the last second as a runner passes through
2) Magnetic: Pairs keep palms together while one leads the movement
3) Human Memory: Two seekers touch pairs who reveal set movements to find matching pairs
4) Black and White: Two opposing rows chase their direct partner in a straight line when their color is called
5) Friedrich: Tag game through 3 zones where runners aim to reach 50 points
pe-07351:
1) Practice the entry arm lock position so arms do not pull apart
2) Kneel on kickboards with heels against hips while a partner holds the boards to practice diving forward
3) Lean forward into the water from a scale position supported by the teacher
4) Perform the headfirst dive with a one-leg jump and approach run
pe-07352:
1) Run and sidestep across zigzag benches to practice directional changes
2) Step and leap over benches with a set running rhythm to feel takeoff and lead legs
3) Increase the bench distance to encourage greater jumping effort
4) Rearrange benches for arm-support strength exercises and sliding drills using carpet tiles
pe-07353:
1) Form a stable stance with toes gripping the edge, knees bent, upper body tilted, and arms at 45 degrees
2) Perform a forward roll into the surface of the water
3) Tuck tightly by grabbing the shins with both hands
4) Swing arms and torso downward forcefully at takeoff into a quick tuck to gain rotational momentum
pe-07354:
1) Set up mats as islands according to class size and divide students equally onto the islands
2) Throw balls to hit and eliminate any opposing players outside your own team
3) Hit players must retreat to their team's island mat
4) Players on the mat can return to the court by hitting an opponent in the court or on another mat
pe-07355:
1) Adjust the rings to the proper height and practice basic turn exercises forward and backward
2) Swing forward or backward into an inverted hang (sturzhang)
3) Perform dismounts from knee hang via handstand or execute the window drop (Fenstersturz)
pe-07356:
1) Form relay groups and place six hoops in a line in front of each group
2) Roll the foam dice and run to place a tennis ball into the hoop matching the rolled number
3) If the rolled hoop already has a ball, touch it and run back, winning once all six hoops are filled
pe-07357:
1) Place gymnastic mats across the gym floor with even spacing
2) The tagger and runners must run only in the gaps between mats without jumping over them
3) Anyone tagged by the tagger must complete a bonus task such as climbing wall bars before rejoining
pe-07358:
1) The chaser holds a black ball representing the virus and tags other players
2) Tagged players must freeze in place and hold their hands up in the air
3) The healer holding a green ball touches frozen players to cure and free them
pe-07359:
1) Divide into two teams and move the ball down the court by passing
2) Players cannot dribble or take steps while holding the ball
3) Score by throwing the ball against the backboard and having a teammate catch the rebound in the air
pe-07360:
1) Divide into two teams and set up cones in a line.
2) The first player of each team picks up the ball and moves it to the next cone ahead.
3) Run back as fast as possible to high-five the next player, who then moves the ball one cone further.
pe-07361:
1) Draw houses (markers) on the floor for each player, each person starts at a house, and one child stands in the middle.
2) On the leader's signal or countdown, everyone must move to a different house.
3) The child in the middle tries to claim an empty house, and whoever is left without a house becomes the new middle player.
pe-07362:
1) Players set up their own spots with equipment and prepare to play.
2) Players run to other players' bases to steal items without getting tagged.
3) The first person to collect 4 identical items wins the game.
pe-07363:
1) Set up two different colored lines (markers) 8 to 10 meters apart.
2) Children line up in a single file between the two lines while the leader stands in the middle.
3) When the leader calls out a command (e.g., run to yellow or blue), players sprint to that line as fast as possible.
pe-07364:
1) Split the class into two teams behind their respective starting points.
2) On the signal, the first runner from each team runs into the course.
3) When runners meet, they must stop and play Rock-Paper-Scissors.
4) The loser signals their team so the next runner can sprint into the course to intercept the opponent.
5) The winner continues running forward until meeting the next opposing runner.
6) Crossing the designated mark on the opponent's side scores 1 point, and the game continues immediately without a new signal.
pe-07365:
1) Divide the class into four equal groups at one end of the hall.
2) Set up a throwing station opposite each team, consisting of a vaulting box and throwing objects.
3) On the starting signal, the first runner runs into the biathlon course to their throwing station.
4) The runner attempts to throw the first object into the vaulting box.
5) If it hits, the runner immediately returns to high-five the next teammate.
6) If it misses, the runner must retrieve the object and run a penalty lap before tagging the next runner.
7) The team with the most objects in the box after a set time, or the first to sink all objects, wins.
pe-07366:
1) Divide the class into two teams: hares and hunters, placing two cones in the field.
2) Hunters spread out in the field while hares line up at the start/finish line in pairs.
3) Two hares start simultaneously, choosing their own running path to circle a cone and return.
4) Hunters try to hit the hares by throwing the ball; running while holding the ball or blocking hares' paths is forbidden.
5) Hares earn 1 point per circled cone upon safely returning without getting hit, choosing to circle 1 or 2 cones.
6) The next pair of hares may only leave once both current runners have returned, even if hit.
7) After about 5 minutes, teams swap roles and tally points.
pe-07367:
1) Set up two teams in a volleyball-sized court with a bridge of 10 gym mats connecting both sides, plus benches and basketball hoops.
2) Teams play dodgeball using 4-6 softballs to eliminate opponents.
3) Players can advance deep into opponent territory along the center mat bridge, where they can throw or be hit.
4) Hit players sit in order on the bench located at the edge of the court.
5) Hitting the opponent's basketball backboard from the mat bridge frees the teammate waiting longest on the bench.
6) Scoring a direct basket from the mat bridge immediately frees all eliminated teammates from the bench.
pe-07368:
1) A player with the ball throws the Kin-Ball to hit others.
2) Players hit by the ball are eliminated.
3) If a player catches or dodges the incoming ball, they gain possession.
4) The last remaining player who survives wins the game.
pe-07369:
1) Grip the flying disc like a forehand grip extending thumb, index, and middle fingers while folding the others.
2) Face the target direction, place feet shoulder-width apart, and put the opposite foot slightly forward.
3) Raise the disc overhead and tilt it slightly toward the opposite side of your head.
4) Throw the disc forward and overhead with force.
5) Release the disc using wrist snap.
pe-07370:
1) Put 30 table tennis balls into an empty tissue box.
2) Fasten the tissue box filled with balls to your hips using an elastic band.
3) Shake your hips to lively music to make the balls fall out of the box.
4) The person who shakes out all table tennis balls first wins.
pe-07371:
1) Each student prepares one sheet of tissue and lines up behind the starting floor line.
2) Without crossing the line, players hold one corner of the tissue with one hand and launch it forward.
3) Landing inside the designated target area scores 10 points; otherwise, points (8, 6, 4,
2) are awarded based on distance.
4) Teams take turns by roster order, and the group accumulating the highest total score wins.
pe-07372:
1) Set a target cone and decide the kicking order among players.
2) Take turns kicking the ball, wait until it stops completely, and move to that spot for the next kick.
3) To ensure accuracy, place the ball on a marker cone at each spot before kicking.
4) Repeat kicking in order until hitting the target cone; the player with fewer total kicks wins.
pe-07373:
1) Steps 1-2: Perform double bounce twice and repeat left and right.
2) Steps 3-4: Perform double bounce twice followed by inside and outside skips.
3) Steps 5-10: Match various step combinations and rhythms together with a partner.
pe-07374:
1) Perform jumping jacks following the count of one, two, three.
2) On the third count, form scissors (arms up at 45 degrees, palms up), rock (hands forming a circle above head), or paper (arms spread sideways).
3) Determine winners according to the rock-paper-scissors outcome.
pe-07375:
1) Divide into two teams, wear team vests, and stand by the desks.
2) Take turns attempting to flip and land a water bottle upright on the desk.
3) Upon landing the bottle, run to the chalkboard and mark the team's symbol (O or X) on the bingo grid.
4) Once the teammate returns, the next player takes a turn, and the team that completes a bingo line first wins.
pe-07376:
1) Each team selects one chaser holding a foam stick and one captain wearing a team vest.
2) Team members hold hands to form a circle around a cone, while the chaser stands in front of the opposing circle.
3) As the game begins, teammates rotate around the cone to protect their captain from being tagged.
4) A team wins if their chaser tags the opposing captain first, or if the opposing circle breaks or drifts away from the cone.
pe-07377:
1) Run one full lap around the designated circular track upon the start signal.
2) Move to the outside of the track to the throwing station and throw a ball at the target.
3) If you miss the target, run another lap around the circle and retry the target throw.
4) Repeat the sequence of running and target throwing until the winners are determined.
pe-07378:
1) Make a funnel on top of the batting tee using a damaged disc cone and place a large dodgeball on it.
2) Hold the bat and swing with quick confidence to hit the ball.
3) Practice swings repeatedly with confidence to increase swing speed.
pe-07379:
1) For short distances, throw lightly underhand to your partner's chest level using wrist snap.
2) Back up behind first base so other fielders can cover missed throws.
3) When an outfielder cannot throw all the way home, use a relay throw through an infielder by taking steps.
4) Use call plays where teammates loudly shout instructions when a fielder is focused solely on the ball.
pe-07380:
1) Select a personal story or theme such as a school trip.
2) Create 8-count body movements (stretching, bending, twisting) that depict specific actions like waking up, walking, or riding attractions.
3) Connect 3 to 4 sequential movement scenes into a complete 2 to 3 minute routine that stretches the whole body.
pe-07381:
1) When fielding a slow roller, do not wait; charge forward, stay low, and scoop the ball with the glove.
2) Stand up smoothly after fielding to transition directly into a throwing motion.
3) For outfield fly balls, keep an upright stance with feet staggered diagonally to react to deep or short hits.
4) When a ball goes over the head, track it while moving backward or backing up teammates with proper coverage.
pe-07382:
1) Set offense and defense roles, with the offensive player stationed further from the basket.
2) Pass the ball once between each other to confirm defensive readiness before starting play.
3) The offensive player drives and shoots, rebounding missed shots to continue attacking for points.
pe-07383:
1) Choose an emotion or topic such as going to school.
2) Express the situation using movement by adjusting size and speed rather than staying still.
3) Play as a speed quiz guessing the topic without using spoken words.
pe-07384:
1) Grip the floorball stick with both hands, lower your center of gravity, and push the ball forward from behind your body to pass.
2) To receive a pass, cushion the impact by pulling the stick back slightly as the ball arrives.
3) Pivot and shield the ball with your body or back when an opponent approaches, then change directions.
4) Move quickly into open space immediately after passing to become available for the next return pass.
pe-07385:
1) Perform thorough stretches for wrists, ankles, knees, and hips to warm up the body.
2) Perform fast side-steps and quick footwork agility drills between cones.
3) Dribble through the cones with light touches using both feet while keeping your head up.
4) Sprint into open space around the cones after passing to prepare for receiving the next ball.
pe-07386:
1) Take a defensive ready stance for drive returns against opponent smashes.
2) Extend the racket forward to secure space and hold the grip loosely.
3) Move feet without retreating and return the shuttlecock with drives to regain attacking initiative.
pe-07387:
1) Each player stands on a spot marker on the floor.
2) Jump to a nearby spot marker with feet together on a single whistle blow.
3) Freeze on the spot marker when the whistle blows twice.
4) A player is eliminated if two players occupy the same marker, touch hands to the floor, react late, or move during two whistle blows.
pe-07388:
1) Students receive stamp sheets, defending students sit in row desks, and the last student in each row holds a stamp.
2) Attackers run to any chosen row and challenge sitting defenders to rock-paper-scissors in order.
3) If the attacker wins, they advance to the next desk; if they lose, they must restart from the very front student or try another row.
4) The mission is accomplished by defeating the final student and collecting all stamps within the 10-minute limit.
pe-07389:
1) Place 7 beanbags in the center hoop and assign a personal hoop to each runner's start line.
2) On the signal, sprint to the center, take 1 beanbag, and return it to your hoop.
3) Once the center is empty, take beanbags from opponents' hoops until one player collects 3 beanbags.
pe-07390:
1) Form pairs and select a tagger pair equipped with a toy hammer.
2) Runners hold hands with their partner, and if about to be tagged, yell "Freeze" and raise their clasped hands overhead to form an igloo.
3) Once an igloo is formed, the taggers cannot touch them, but they cannot move until another pair crawls through the igloo to unfreeze them.
4) If tagged, that pair becomes the new taggers; if everyone becomes an igloo, players do a simple physical activity and taggers pick the next taggers.
pe-07391:
1) Move quickly in the same direction as instructed or demonstrated on screen
2) Level up by adding jumps or dropping to the floor when reacting
3) Quickly move in the opposite direction of the verbal command
4) Drop chest to floor or crouch on 'down' and jump vertically on 'up'
pe-07392:
1) Separate a 2-ply facial tissue into a single thin sheet.
2) One person drops the tissue from above while the other attempts to catch it with one or both hands.
3) Challenge variations by catching it while seated, using feet, or changing body positions.
4) Stand about 2 meters apart, and have the partner sprint forward to catch the tissue upon release.
pe-07393:
1) Perform full-body marionette jumps by alternating and coordinating hand and foot positions.
2) Conduct line jumps forward, backward, and sideways while keeping the head level and stable.
3) Stretch while seated with legs extended, exhaling smoothly for 10 seconds to touch toes.
4) Rotate the upper torso by passing a rolled towel ball behind the back and through an 8-figure path with a partner.
5) Lie on your back, clamp the towel ball between feet, lift legs upward, and catch it with hands.
pe-07394:
1) In Changing Tag, the tagger switches immediately upon touching another player.
2) In Tail-Snatching Tag, the tagger must steal another player's tail to switch roles.
3) In Bye-Bye Tag, players inside a ring are safe, but each ring holds only one person; when a new player enters saying "Bye-bye," the previous player must leave.
pe-07395:
