1) Four players stand in a square at cones each with a soccer ball
2) The leader passes to player 1 who passes to player 2 who passes to player 3 who passes back to the leader in sequence
3) Successfully complete 10 consecutive passes without making a mistake
pe-07396:
1) Pairs face each other or stand together and place a ball between assigned body parts
2) Hold the ball using parts such as backs of hands, cheeks, waist, knees, hips, foreheads, or soles of feet
3) Move together without dropping the ball to complete the relay
pe-07397:
1) Players are distributed into four corners (A, B, C, D) of the area.
2) On start, players play rock-paper-scissors with an opponent at their corner.
3) The winner performs a designated movement mission and advances to the next corner.
4) The loser runs around a center cone and back to the same corner to challenge someone again, repeating until time runs out.
pe-07398:
1) All participants take off one shoe and place it in the middle of the playing area.
2) Form teams and line up one behind the other.
3) On the go signal, the first runner hops on the shoed foot to the shoe pile.
4) Find your shoe, put it on and tie it, then run back to tag the next teammate.
5) Once all members finish and sit down, repeat with the other shoe.
pe-07399:
1) Practice forearm passes with a partner for a few minutes where one tosses and the other passes back under control.
2) Repeat the drill with setting passes, followed by a one-minute continuous rally attempt.
3) Form circles of six by combining three pairs to practice rallying, then practice underhand and overhand serves facing the wall.
4) Split the court to serve from behind the 10-foot line and play Falling Stars where teams serve balls over to the other side until freeze.
5) Move to full-court lead-up games over the net with rotating servers and positional switching.
pe-07400:
1) Players form teams of six in positions 1 to 6 and start gameplay with a serve from position 1 over the net.
2) Teams are allowed up to three contacts to return the ball, and the ball is allowed to bounce once within the court between contacts.
3) A player cannot contact the ball twice in a row, and the point ends if the ball bounces out of the court lines.
4) Whenever a team wins the serve back, players rotate one spot clockwise, and a server can only score up to three consecutive points.
5) Sets are played up to 25 points, and a team must win by two points.
pe-07401:
1) Set up a large circle using eight cones or markers.
2) Place two to three dodgers inside the circle while the remaining students line up outside.
3) Outside players kick one to three gym balls toward the dodgers to hit them.
4) Any dodger hit by a ball moves outside to become a kicker.
5) Continue playing until a single winner remains inside the circle.
pe-07402:
1) Stand behind the marker cones with one hoop each.
2) Toss the hoop like a frisbee aiming to land it over a tall cone target.
3) Score 1 point if the hoop lands over a cone, check that the area is safe, retrieve the hoop, and return.
pe-07403:
1) The feeder passes the soccer ball to one side of the cone to the partner.
2) The partner controls the ball, passes it back with the inside of the foot, and moves around to the other side of the cone.
3) The feeder passes again to the other side and the partner returns it, continuing the lateral movement.
pe-07404:
1) Defenders stand outside their hula hoop to protect the treasure (scarf) placed inside.
2) Attackers try to approach and reach in to steal the treasure without getting tagged.
3) If a defender tags an attacker before they touch the scarf, the attacker must move to another hoop.
4) If an attacker successfully grabs the treasure, they swap roles with the defender.
pe-07405:
1) Players stand with both feet behind the green line marked by a jump rope on the playground.
2) When the caller shouts 'Ready, Set, Throw,' throw the javelin as far as possible without crossing the line.
3) After everyone throws once, the round winners go to the black line to prepare for the championship round.
4) The winner of the final championship throw earns the title of ultimate javelin throw champion.
pe-07406:
1) Each team's captain stands inside an assigned end zone.
2) Players advance the ball solely through passing without walking or dribbling.
3) Successfully passing the ball into the hands of the designated captain scores a point.
pe-07407:
1) Run around the hoop and jump with feet together
2) Slalom through cones without touching them
3) Shoot into the goal at the finish
pe-07408:
1) One player steps outside while a secret conductor is chosen
2) All players mimic the movements and sounds made by the conductor
3) The seeker returns and gets three guesses to identify the conductor
pe-07409:
1) Crawl on all fours in various directions
2) Crawl flat on the stomach
3) Move with side steps like a snake
4) Move mimicking rabbit hops, duck walks, and frog jumps
pe-07410:
1) Extend both arms horizontally out to the sides.
2) Keep the legs straight and toes fully pointed.
3) Face the instructor and travel sideways in a continuous chassé step rhythm.
pe-07411:
1) Navigate through the cone course, dribbling with the right hand when moving right and the left hand when moving left.
2) Keep the head up and look forward in the direction of movement.
3) When changing hands in front of a cone, keep the ball low beneath the knees and cross over to the other hand.
pe-07412:
1) Pairs hold hands and run to the turning point and back to the starting line without releasing hands.
2) Run forward to the turning point, then run backward to return to the starting line.
3) Jump with legs spread wide back and forth.
4) Move together in a deep squat position with hips touching heels without touching the floor with hands.
pe-07413:
1) For forward rolls, tuck the chin to look at the belly button, place hands forward, and roll on the back of the neck
2) Complete the forward roll by extending legs and toes, standing up without using hands on the mat
3) For backward rolls, start tucked with both hands placed flat next to the ears and tuck the head
4) Push firmly off the mat with both hands simultaneously to roll backward smoothly and land on the feet.
pe-07414:
1) Players dribble freely inside a designated marked square, each with their own soccer ball
2) On the coach's call, dribble exclusively using the inside of the right foot
3) On the next call, switch to using only the inside of the left foot
4) Switch to alternating inside touches between both feet or rolling the ball with the sole of the foot.
pe-07415:
1) Mark both boundary lines and the center area with cones, placing one tagger (the Hawk) in the middle
2) At the signal, players sprint across the field toward the opposite safety line
3) The Hawk tries to tag passing players; any player tagged must immediately freeze in place as a statue
4) Surviving players cross again on the next signal until all players are caught or extra taggers are added.
pe-07416:
1) Children sit on their chosen color section (red, blue, yellow, green) of the parachute to identify colors
2) Grip the handles and shake gently for small waves, then shake vigorously when the wind blows hard
3) On the count of three, lift the parachute high overhead and duck underneath to hide inside
4) Place soft toys or beanbags on top of the parachute and bounce them continuously without touching them by hand.
pe-07417:
1) Players stand in a circle and select one player to be in the middle.
2) The middle player walks around and calls a player's name.
3) The called player ducks down, and the two neighbors on each side quickly shoot at each other by calling the other's name.
4) The slower player is eliminated and sits down.
5) When two players remain, they stand back-to-back, taking a step forward when a fruit is called and turning to shoot when a vegetable is called.
pe-07418:
1) Set up 4 stations with 3 players starting at each station marker.
2) Station 1 involves stepping right in the blue hoop and left in the red hoop, pausing briefly between hoops.
3) Station 2 practices lateral steps with a stable stop at each point.
4) Station 3 requires two quick steps per rung on the agility ladder.
5) Station 4 consists of jumping across slats spaced further apart.
pe-07419:
1) Jog around the gymnasium utilizing the open space without touching others.
2) At the whistle, freeze in place and perform high knees as high and fast as possible.
3) Resume jogging, then freeze on signal to do butt kicks touching heels to glutes.
4) Move using side gallops/shuffle steps, stepping over mats and ducking under bars or beams.
5) Stand in place to rotate the head, make large arm circles with shoulders, and extend elbows 5-6 times each.
pe-07420:
1) Each student takes one basketball and gathers inside the center circle.
2) Jog around the court while continuously dribbling the ball.
3) Learn court markings (red boundaries, paint/key area, 3-point line, center line) and move to designated areas on call.
4) Stop dribbling on signal and hold the ball between the legs.
pe-07421:
1) Step one foot in each ladder rung with throwing arm raised.
2) Slalom quickly through the cones.
3) Pass the ball to the passer upon reaching the green cone.
4) Run around the red cone and receive the ball back from the passer.
5) Take three steps (one, two, three) and shoot at the goal.
pe-07422:
1) Identify lines 1 through 5 marked on the floor.
2) Place both feet inside the hoop to get ready.
3) Move quickly in the exact code combination: line 1, line 2, line 1, line 4, and line 1.
4) Complete the exact code sequence to unlock the magic chest.
pe-07423:
1) Dribble the ball only inside the court boundaries; dribbling outside is not allowed.
2) Double dribble is not permitted once the dribble is stopped.
3) The tallest players from each team jump in the center circle to tip the ball.
4) Other players must wait behind the line outside the circle and must tip rather than catch the ball.
pe-07424:
1) Both teams greet each other before the game starts.
2) After the signal, players run toward the three balls placed in the center.
3) Players hit by a thrown ball raise their hand and leave the court.
4) Players must not cross or step over the center line.
pe-07425:
1) Draw a target court on the floor divided into four squares numbered 1 through 4.
2) Each player throws markers up to 3 times to accumulate points.
3) Landing inside a square scores the written points, while landing on a line scores 0.5 points.
4) A player can choose to stop throwing at any time before exceeding 7.5 points.
5) Exceeding 7.5 points results in a loss or disadvantage, and the player closest to or hitting 7.5 points wins.
pe-07426:
1) Divide the court into two halves using an elastic cord or tied plastic bags as a net.
2) Catch the comet ball by its head and throw it back into the opponent's court using the same hand.
3) Snap your wrist to align the tail and aim to land the ball on the opponent's court floor to score.
4) In a two-ball variation, countdown 3-2-1 and throw both balls simultaneously into each other's courts.
pe-07427:
1) Throw the ball against the rebounder so your partner can catch the rebounding ball.
2) Play fronton-style by continuously alternating throws against the rebounder to keep a rally going.
3) Throw the ball against the rebounder with controlled power so the rebounding ball passes right between your legs.
4) Place the rebounder flat on a table or chairs and play like table tennis by bouncing the ball alternately.
pe-07428:
1) Draw foot-sized squares on the floor for each player at least 60 cm apart.
2) Design rhythmic step patterns with hops and turns, practicing slowly for 1 minute.
3) Keep group tempo while incorporating position swaps and body percussion.
pe-07429:
1) Mark a designated central zone across the court and place the initial tagger inside it.
2) All other runners line up on one side of the playing area.
3) Runners attempt to cross through the middle zone to the opposite side without getting tagged.
4) Anyone tagged inside the zone becomes a tagger and joins the wall in the middle.
5) Rounds continue with an increasing wall of taggers until all players are caught.
pe-07430:
1) [Memory Run] Sprint to the card zone, flip matching pairs or target colors, tag the teammate to finish.
2) [Tic-Tac-Toe] Relay race placing 3 colored cones/vests onto a 3x3 grid; relocate pieces once placed to get 3-in-a-row.
3) [RPS Sprint] Face off at 1-2m; loser immediately sprints to the endzone while the winner chases and tags.
4) [Black and White] Two teams face each other; when the teacher mentions their assigned color in a story, that team flees to safety.
5) [Number Call Race] Opponents sit numbered 1-4; called numbers race around perimeter cones to sit back down first.
pe-07431:
1) Set up a 3x3 grid using 9 cones or hoops on the floor.
2) Two teams line up at the baseline, each receiving 3 cones of their assigned team color.
3) On the start signal, the first runners dash forward to place one cone onto the grid and sprint back to tag the next runner.
4) If all three cones are placed without a win, subsequent runners must relocate one of their own cones already on the grid.
5) The first team to align three cones horizontally, vertically, or diagonally scores a point.
pe-07432:
1) Introduce softballs into the area; players move freely across the entire boundary.
2) Players holding a ball can take a maximum of 3 steps; balls hitting the floor first do not count as a hit.
3) Players hit by a direct throw sit at the sideline and must remember who eliminated them.
4) When the thrower who eliminated them gets hit by someone else, the waiting player can re-enter the game.
5) [Active Variation] No eliminations; players count their own hits and the first to reach 10 points shouts "Stop" to win.
pe-07433:
1) Balance a tennis ball on the back of the hand while walking steadily.
2) Toss the ball upward and catch it, alternating between the right and left hand.
3) Bounce the ball firmly onto the ground while walking and catch it alternately with both hands.
4) Throw the ball high into the air, perform a 180 or 360-degree spin, and catch it cleanly.
5) Perform complex tasks such as throwing behind the back to catch in front, or standing up/sitting down while tossing.
pe-07434:
1) Balance-walk across inverted benches or jump from bench to bench.
2) Climb the wall bars and jump onto mats, absorbing impact by bending knees or connecting into a roll.
3) Vault over progressively higher boxes, cross a wobbling bench, crawl through box frames, and overcome parallel bars.
pe-07435:
1) Arrange teams in return relays around cones or shuttle relays divided across opposite sides.
2) Runners take turns tagging hands to alternate, or gather teammates lap by lap to run together.
3) The team that finishes navigating distances or obstacles first wins the challenge.
pe-07436:
1) Mark target zones with small cones on each side and place a large cone on a box inside.
2) Players holding the softball cannot take steps and must advance by passing to throw and hit the target cone.
3) Successfully knocking the cone down scores one point, and possession transfers to the other team.
pe-07437:
1) Place three hoops at increasing distances for each team and fill them with cones or balls worth 1, 2, and 3 points.
2) On signal, sprint to retrieve one item from a chosen hoop within a strict time limit (e.g., 8 seconds).
3) Return across the starting line in time to secure the points; otherwise return the item with zero points awarded.
pe-07438:
1) Run along the outer track and enter the throwing station set up inside the area.
2) Throw balls to knock down cones placed on boxes or throw a medicine ball into a target box.
3) Run penalty laps around the small inner track for each missed target before returning to tag the next runner.
pe-07439:
1) Each team places a mat somewhere in the hall to serve as their island.
2) Players throw softballs to hit opponents moving freely across the hall.
3) Hit players go to their own island, and they can free themselves by hitting an opponent from the island.
pe-07440:
1) Place one hula hoop in each of the four corners of the playing area.
2) The player holding the ball cannot move and may only pass from their spot.
3) Pass among teammates and successfully place the ball inside a corner hoop to score a point.
pe-07441:
1) The teacher throws a ball into the field, and both teams race to get it first.
2) The team that gets the ball lines up and passes it backward through their legs, then the last player throws it far away.
3) The other team quickly forms a circle while one runner sprints around it counting completed laps.
pe-07442:
1) Set up a pathway and fortress of gym mats connecting the two halves of the court.
2) Hit opponents with softballs, crossing into the opponent half only while on the mats.
3) Hitting the basketball backboard revives one eliminated player, while scoring a basket revives all eliminated teammates.
pe-07443:
1) Divide the court into two halves and assign matching numbers to students in each team.
2) When a number is called, that player from each team sprints into the opposing half.
3) The player who tags an opponent first earns a point for their team and both return.
pe-07444:
1) Balance and walk forward across an inverted gymnastics bench.
2) Next, walk sideways and then backwards across the bench.
3) Increase difficulty by touching the wall, closing eyes, or tossing and bouncing a tennis ball while walking.
4) Progress by having a partner throw a ball to catch while balancing across.
pe-07445:
1) Assign a unique number to every participant.
2) Move around the play area, and whenever meeting another player, call out your number and swap numbers with them.
3) When the game is paused on signal, all players gather together.
4) Check the numbers in order to see if any number is missing or duplicated.
pe-07446:
1) Pair gym mats end-to-end around the gym, and designate taggers (hunters) with pinnies or bands.
2) Runners (rabbits) escape by jumping over the mats without touching them, while taggers must run around the mats.
3) Tagged runners complete a side jump station/course before re-entering, or take the pinny to become the new tagger.
4) In an alternate variation, allow taggers to jump over mats to cut corners while runners must run around.
pe-07447:
1) Place a hula hoop at each end of the field containing 3 identical items (frisbee, football, softball).
2) Start with a softball thrown into play; a team that completes 5 or 10 consecutive passes places the ball into their hoop.
3) The opposing team then picks a new piece of equipment from their hoop to initiate their own 5 or 10 passes.
4) Turnovers occur whenever an item touches the floor or is intercepted; the team collecting the most items in their hoop wins.
pe-07448:
1) Taggers hold softballs while other players hold hoops around their waists as ships moving freely around the gym.
2) Taggers throw softballs through the players' hoops to sink the ships.
3) A player whose ship is sunk places their hoop on the floor and freezes.
4) Rescues occur either when another player pulls their hoop over the frozen player or integrates them into the same hoop.
pe-07449:
1) Two teams line up along opposite gym walls.
2) The teacher calls out a number of players and throws a selected sports equipment (basketball, soccer ball, frisbee, or softball) onto the court.
3) The called players from each team enter the court and attempt to score according to that sport's rules.
4) When a point is scored or the teacher calls stop, players return to the back of their lines and the next round begins.
pe-07450:
1) Divide the court into two halves; each team starts with only one player inside their half while the rest start outside on the opponent's side.
2) Outside players throw the ball at opponents inside the court, and hit opponents allow the thrower to enter their own court half.
3) Once inside your own half, you cannot be eliminated; if hit, an outside opponent gets to enter their court instead.
4) The team that successfully gets all of its players inside its court half first wins.
pe-07451:
1) On a mat, hold partner's shoulders to pin them down, or in all-fours position pull partner's arm to turn them onto their back.
2) Place a tennis ball on a cone behind each player and compete to knock the opponent's ball off first.
3) Along a line, compete by holding hands to pull the partner across, or pushing shoulder-to-shoulder or back-to-back across the line.
pe-07452:
1) Place multiple mats at appropriate distances across the gym floor to serve as islands, and choose 1–2 taggers.
2) All players must move only on the mats, jumping from mat to mat without stepping on the floor.
3) Tagged players either complete a separate jumping obstacle course before returning, or take the tagger's sash/vest to become the new tagger.
pe-07453:
1) Divide players into sharks, dragons, and humans, setting up mats as islands.
2) Dragons move only on the mats while sharks move only on the floor around the mats to tag humans.
3) Tagged humans go to prison, and another human can rescue them by holding hands and running safely to an island.
pe-07454:
1) Players form a circle with eyes closed and hands behind their backs, and the teacher hands softballs to secret catchers.
2) On cue, catchers hold the softball to touch other players' torsos without throwing the ball.
3) Tagged players freeze into a designated pose (tree, stone, etc.) and can be unfrozen when a teammate crawls under or jumps over them.
pe-07455:
1) Divide into two teams and mark a target goal line at each end of the playing area with cones or lines.
2) Pass the ball among teammates without walking while holding the ball, aiming to place it onto the opposing line.
3) The ball must be placed onto the goal line directly from inside the playing area to score.
pe-07456:
1) Divide into two teams, distribute character cards with ranks, spies, and flags, and set up a jail in each territory.
2) Move through the area tagging opponents to compare ranks; the player with the lower rank is taken to the opponent's jail.
3) Friendly spies can rescue captured teammates by high-fiving them at the jail, and tagging the enemy flag wins the game.
pe-07457:
1) Form 3-player teams lined up at a designated distance from the tic-tac-toe grid.
2) Each team receives three marker cones of their team color.
3) On the signal, players run relay-style to place one cone into an empty square and return.
4) If all three cones are placed without a 3-in-a-row, subsequent runners move one of their existing cones to an empty space until a team wins.
pe-07458:
1) Set up five activity stations around the gym with small groups of 4-5 students assigned to each.
2) Each station lasts 4 minutes, where students must first pay an entry fee by performing a required strength exercise (burpees, planks, or squats).
3) After completing the strength exercise, students attempt the target challenge (free throws, medicine ball precision throws, or tennis ball ring throws).
4) Each success awards points that students log to track and improve their personal bests over a multi-week program.
pe-07459:
1) Students spread out across the play area, and two students are selected as the starting chasers.
2) The two chasers hold hands and run together to tag other players.
3) Tagged players join hands with the chasers, progressively lengthening the chain.
4) Tags are only valid when the chain is fully connected; tags made while hands are detached do not count.
pe-07460:
1) Hoop Cone Transfer Relay: Match group size to the number of hoops, individual runners carry a cone through hoops and tag the next runner, first team to finish scores a point.
2) Memory Relay: Divide the class into groups of 5, the first runner observes the teacher's object layout, runs back to place an object in the same position, continuing until the arrangement matches.
3) Stick Cone Relay: The first runner places a cone onto a stick (or broomstick), grabs the next cone to hand it to the waiting teammate, repeating until all cones are placed.
pe-07461:
1) Two teams of 6 court players including a goalkeeper (up to 15 players per roster) compete on a futsal/handball court using a foam or volleyball.
2) The ball can be played with both feet and hands without bouncing; airborne balls can be caught by hand or foot, but once grounded, the ball cannot be picked up with hands.
3) If an opponent touches (tocado) a ball carrier holding the ball in hand, a foul is called and possession transfers, so players must drop the ball to their feet before being touched.
4) Scoring into the goal with either hand or foot awards 1 point for field goals, fouls, and penalties, played across four 15-minute quarters.
pe-07462:
1) In pairs, hold a wheelbarrow position and collect as many cones as possible in one minute, switching roles midway.
2) Hold a plank or push-up position, move beanbags from hoop to hoop, and pass the relay to the next teammate.
3) In a plank posture, compete to place balls onto cones and remove them as quickly as possible.
4) Touch body parts called out by the teacher, and grab the target object in the center first when it is named to score.
pe-07463:
1) Chain Tag: When tagged, hold the ends of a short rope together to link and catch remaining runners.
2) Black and White: Two teams face off; when a color is called, that team sprints to their safe line while opponents chase.
3) Hares and Hunters: Dogs hold hands to herd the hares toward the hunter, who tags the hares.
4) Crab Football: Move on all fours with chest facing up, lifting hips off the floor to kick the ball.
5) Circle Jump: Jump over a rope swung horizontally in a circle near the floor without touching it.
pe-07464:
1) Three teams of four players (pink, gray, black) enter the court.
2) All four attacking players must touch the ball before shouting a designated defending team's color and serving.
3) The called defending team must prevent the giant ball from touching the floor using any part of their body.
4) If successfully received, that team immediately sets up their own serve; if they fail, the other two teams each earn a point.
pe-07465:
1) Students are divided into crewmates and impostors; crewmates complete 6 fitness tasks while impostors secretly eliminate others.
2) Tasks include 4 zigzag ball dribbles, 2 track laps, 5 hurdle jumps, 4 hoop carries with feet, 2 goal post kicks, and 5 sprints.
3) If an impostor triggers a sabotage with the teacher, crewmates must fix it within 30 seconds.
4) Finding an eliminated player triggers an emergency whistle meeting to vote out suspects or skip.
pe-07466:
1) Approach the high jump bar along an angled approach from the designated side.
2) Take off powerfully from the plant foot, kicking the lead leg up and over the bar.
3) Rotate your belly and torso over the bar to clear the crossbar without dislodging it.
4) Land safely onto the high crash mat rolling through the impact.
pe-07467:
1) Jump with feet together inside hoops while rotating 180 degrees.
2) Jump onto a 40cm step box, turn, jump down, and perform a backward roll on a mat.
3) Side gallop between cones, skip rope, balance on a fitball, and hold a wall handstand.
pe-07468:
1) Teams line up behind the starting line with numbers marked ahead using cones or chalk.
2) The teacher calls out a math problem and each runner sprints to the result number and returns.
3) The runner who correctly identifies the answer and returns first earns a point before going to the back of the line.
pe-07469:
1) Students pair up and position back-to-back 1 meter apart.
2) One side is named Pepe and the other side is Pepa.
3) When the teacher calls a name, that person chases to tag the partner before the partner reaches the finish line.
pe-07470:
1) Divide the court into 4 zones with a central corridor using cones and place a team in each zone.
2) Distribute foam balls to each team to play dodgeball by throwing balls at opponents.
3) Hit players must run through the central corridor from end to end and back before returning to their game zone.
pe-07471:
1) A group of students join hands to form a circle.
2) The remaining students move in and out of the circle.
3) When the music stops, anyone trapped inside the circle joins hands with the circle team.
pe-07472:
1) Set up five cones diagonally on the court with a target cone placed directly in the center, dividing students into two teams.
2) Players roll basketballs across the floor to teammates attempting to topple the center target cone, rotating to the back after each turn.
3) The team that knocks over the cone rushes to the basket to shoot, while the other team performs and loudly counts 20 chest passes.
4) The shooting team attempts to score as many baskets as possible before the defending team completes their 20 passes.
pe-07473:
1) Place runners inside a designated half-court zone while remaining students wait in a line outside supervised by the teacher.
2) The first runner from the line enters the zone as the chaser and has exactly 10 seconds to tag as many players as possible.
3) Tagged players must immediately leave the area and wait at the back of the line, while the chaser keeps tagging until time expires.
4) Chasers who successfully tagged someone get to remain inside as runners, and the next student in line enters as the new tagger.
pe-07474:
1) Distribute students across the court boundaries, each controlling their own soccer ball or basketball.
2) Players dribble their own ball to protect it while attempting to knock opponents' balls out of the boundary lines.
3) Anyone whose ball goes out of bounds must move to the boundary sidelines.
4) Eliminated players on the sideline remain active in the game and are allowed to tackle or swipe balls away from inside players.
pe-07475:
1) Divide the class into multiple teams and provide each team with a set of hula hoops.
2) Each team designates one student as the "frog" while the remaining teammates act as hoop movers.
3) The frog hops forward inside the hoops placed sequentially along the floor toward the finish.
4) Teammates pick up the rear hoops that have been cleared and place them in front so the frog can keep jumping to the end line.
pe-07476:
1) Set up goals on each side of the pitch and divide the class into two teams.
2) Play soccer using three balls simultaneously: a soccer ball, a foam ball, and a soft/deflated ball.
3) Teams attempt to score in the opposing goal with any of the three balls.
4) Optionally, a player who scores can switch teams with an opposing player.
pe-07477:
1) Mark four squares (1 through
4) on the floor, designating square 4 as the King square.
2) Four students occupy the squares while the remaining students wait in line outside.
3) The player in the King square serves the volleyball to begin the rally.
4) The player who faults moves to the back of the line, remaining players rotate counter-clockwise, and the next waiting player enters square 1.
pe-07478:
1) Place various equipment like cones, frisbees, and balls inside a center circle, with one or more guardians outside the circle.
2) Place hula hoops at each corner to serve as team bases, with teams positioned at each corner.
3) Players run to the center circle to collect items (one item per person at a time) and bring them back to their base.
4) If tagged by a guardian, a player must return any retrieved item to the center, run back to touch their base hoop, and then resume playing.
pe-07479:
1) Divide students into two teams and place each team at opposite ends of the court.
2) On the signal, students run across while dodging each other to reach the opposite side.
3) The team whose entire members reach the opposite side first earns a point.
pe-07480:
1) Place four mats as bases and divide into a kicking team and a fielding team.
2) The pitcher rolls the ball along the ground, the kicker kicks it, and runs toward the next base.
3) Batters are out if caught in the air, forced out at base, or tagged between bases, and teams switch after 3 outs or when the batting order ends.
4) A runner scores 1 point upon successfully rounding all four bases.
pe-07481:
1) All students line up on one side of the court, and one student is placed in the center as the 'Man from Mars'.
2) Students call out asking to be taken to the stars, and the Martian responds with a condition such as 'Only if you are wearing green'.
3) Students wearing that color must run across to the other side without getting tagged.
4) Tagged students join the Martian in the middle to become taggers in subsequent rounds.
pe-07482:
1) Divide the court into 4 zones, place a hula hoop in each zone, set a cone inside it, and balance a tennis ball on top of each cone.
2) Divide students into 4 teams in each zone and distribute foam balls.
3) Teams throw foam balls to knock down the tennis balls on opponents' cones to score 1 point.
4) Players may defend their targets but cannot step inside the hula hoop, and the ball is reset after being knocked down.
pe-07483:
1) Students divide into two teams at opposite sides of the field and are assigned numbers from 1 to 6.
2) The teacher stands in the middle holding a handkerchief up high and calls a number.
3) The called players race to grab the handkerchief and return to their side; returning uncaught scores a point, while being tagged awards the point to the opponent.
pe-07484:
1) Place four mats near the corners of the court and place a group of students on each mat.
2) Select a team of hunting dogs wearing vests, and on the teacher's signal, they chase and tag students from other groups.
3) Tagged students must return to their mats, and the game ends when everyone is caught, after which roles rotate.
pe-07485:
1) Teams line up behind cones, and the first player of each team stands inside a hula hoop placed ahead.
2) The next teammate in line passes the ball to the player inside the hoop.
3) If the player catches the ball while staying inside the hoop, they take that hoop back to their team.
4) If the pass is missed, the player inside retrieves the ball, returns to the back of the line, and the next player continues.
pe-07486:
1) Scatter multiple hula hoops across the play area and distribute the students.
2) When music plays, students run and move freely around the area.
3) When the music stops, students must quickly step inside any hula hoop regardless of how many players fit in.
4) The teacher removes a few hoops at random each round, restarts the music, and repeats until very few hoops remain.
pe-07487:
1) Place 6 cones in the corners and center along the court boundary lines.
2) Teams line up behind each of the 6 cones.
3) On the teacher's whistle, the first runner of each team sprints clockwise around the entire perimeter back to their team.
4) Upon returning, the runner gives a high-five to the next teammate, who then departs clockwise.
pe-07488:
1) Students line up along a line designated as 'Land', with the front area as 'Sea' and the rear area as 'Air'.
2) If the teacher calls "Sea", students jump forward to the sea and jump back to land.
3) If the teacher calls "Air", students jump backward to the air and jump back to land.
4) If the teacher calls "Land", students jump in place; anyone who jumps in the wrong direction goes to the end of the line.
pe-07489:
1) Divide the class into teams where students lie on their backs in a straight line.
2) Place a hula hoop at each end of the line, with various objects placed inside one of the hoops.
3) Using only their feet without hands, students grab an object from the hoop.
4) Students pass the object from feet to feet down the line until it reaches the hoop at the opposite end.
5) If an object falls to the floor, students must pick it up again using only their feet and continue passing.
pe-07490:
1) Mark two boundaries across the court with lines or cones, place one chaser (spider) in the center zone, and line up the rest on one side.
2) When the teacher signals, players run to cross to the opposite side of the court.
3) The central spider tries to tag runners without stepping out of the designated middle area.
4) Any player tagged or stepping out of bounds becomes a spider in the middle.
5) Repeat each round upon signal, optionally having spiders link hands as their numbers grow.
pe-07491:
1) Divide the gym into four zones using cones, assign students into four teams, and distribute foam balls.
2) Throw foam balls from your own zone to hit players in other zones.
3) Anyone hit by a ball immediately joins the team of the player who threw it.
4) When an entire team is eliminated and their zone is empty, remove the cones to expand that team's area.
5) Continue throwing and absorbing players into teams until the game concludes.
pe-07492:
1) Divide students into groups of four: three hold each other's shoulders to form a triangle, and one stands outside as the tagger.
2) The tagger's goal is to tag one designated target player inside the triangle.
3) The three triangle players rotate clockwise or counterclockwise to protect the target player.
4) The tagger moves around the group in either direction trying to reach the target.
5) Rotate roles so every student gets a turn to be the tagger.
pe-07493:
1) One tagger (the wolf) faces the wall while the other students line up at the opposite starting line.
2) Students call out "What time is it, Mr. Wolf?" and the wolf responds with a time (e.g., 6 o'clock).
3) Students take that specific number of steps forward toward the wolf.
4) When the wolf senses the students are close, the wolf turns around and shouts "Lunch time!".
5) Students must run back to their starting line while the wolf chases and tries to tag them.
pe-07494:
1) Place two mats in two court corners, place throwers and foam balls in the center circle, and line remaining students around the perimeter.
2) Outside students walk or run around the circle in a clockwise direction.
3) Center throwers throw foam balls to hit players circling on the outside.
4) Anyone hit by a ball moves into the center circle and joins the throwers.
5) A player standing on a mat is safe from being hit, but can only stay for 5 to 10 seconds.
pe-07495:
1) Teams are made of more than 5 players and play 3-4 minute periods.
2) Dribbling with two hands is allowed, and players can stop and resume dribbling.
3) Touching the rim scores 1 point, making the basket scores 3 points, and drawing a foul gives 1 point and ball possession.
pe-07496:
1) All participants (foxes) except one hunter attach a handkerchief to the back of their waist as a tail.
2) The hunter chases the foxes and captures them by grabbing their tails.
3) Captured foxes become hunters and help catch the remaining foxes.
pe-07497:
1) Set up 10 cones in the play area, placing 5 upright as volcanoes and 5 upside-down as glaciers.
2) Split into two teams: Volcanoes turn inverted cones upright, while Glaciers flip upright cones upside down for 4 to 5 minutes.
3) When time is called, the team with the most cones facing their target position wins.
pe-07498:
1) At least 5 players enter the court; the ball holder may take up to 3 steps and must throw within 5 seconds.
2) A hit player moves to the prison area outside the court and watches the specific player who eliminated them.
3) When that specific eliminator gets hit, the waiting prisoner rejoins the match; the last player standing wins.
pe-07499:
1) Place all participants' shoes in a pile at the far end of the area and divide players into two relay lines.
2) On the starting signal, the first runner sprints to the pile to locate and put on their own shoes.
3) After crossing the starting line, the next runner goes; the first team to have all members retrieve shoes and return wins.
pe-07500:
1) Form a circle with cones to create a cave, place a ball in the center as the jewel, and select one player as the dragon.
2) Teams take turns entering the cave to dodge the dragon and retrieve the jewel out of the circle.
3) If the dragon tags any player, that team is eliminated; safely carrying the jewel out scores 1 point.
pe-07501:
1) Two zombies chase humans while passing the ball to each other.
2) Zombies must tag players holding the ball without throwing it and cannot move while holding the ball.
3) Tagged humans become zombies, and the last remaining untagged player wins.
pe-07502:
1) Kickers kick the ball as far as possible into the field from behind the red cones.
2) The kicker runs around the bases marked by red cones and crosses the finish line to score a point.
3) If the ball reaches the fielding captain between the yellow cones while a kicker is between bases, that kicker is eliminated.
pe-07503:
1) Each team's master sets a secret color combination while runners line up at the start.
2) On signal, runners relay one by one to place a dish cone into the designated color zone and return.
3) Once all cones are placed, the master checks the combination; runners take turns adjusting the positions until correctly guessed, earning a point.
pe-07504:
1) Two players hold hands to become a blob and start chasing others.
2) They must tag others without releasing their hands, and tagged players join hands with the blob.
3) Once a blob reaches 4 players, it splits into two separate blobs of 2 to continue chasing until 10 minutes pass or all are caught.
pe-07505:
1) Divide into a batting team and a receiving team.
2) Each batter hits the ball as far as possible into the field using a baseball bat or tennis racket.
3) The batter runs around red cone bases to reach the finish line for 1 point, or stops at a base to avoid elimination, earning 3 points if completing the circuit without stopping.
4) Receivers retrieve the ball and throw it to their stationary captain between yellow cones; if the ball reaches the captain's feet before the batter reaches a base, the batter is out.
5) Roles switch after all batters have taken a turn, and the team with the most points after two innings wins.
pe-07506:
1) Create a circle with 6 flat markers and place 5 cones inside representing fish.
2) The defending team stands inside the circle to protect the cones while the fishing team uses 2 balls from outside to knock the cones down.
3) Defenders intercept the balls to prevent them from hitting the cones.
4) After 10 minutes, the defenders score 1 point if no cones are knocked down, while the throwing team scores 1 point if they knock cones down, after which roles are swapped.
pe-07507:
1) Divide into two teams with a colored cone in front of each team and set up a total of 6 cones.
2) On the starting signal, the first runner of each team runs and circles around the opponent's cone.
3) Each runner finishes by lifting their own team's colored cone to score 1 point, and both teams get 1 point if lifted simultaneously.
4) The first team to accumulate 10 points wins the match.
pe-07508:
1) Divide into two teams using colored pinnies and throw a ball into the playing area to start.
2) The team that gains possession must complete 10 consecutive passes without the ball being intercepted to score 1 point.
3) Walking while holding the ball is forbidden, while intercepting in the air and non-contact defending are allowed.
4) If a player sends the ball out of bounds, possession goes to the opposing team.
pe-07509:
1) Set up the play area using cones or flat markers in four different colors.
2) Children move around in the center of the area and sprint as fast as possible to the announced color zone when called.
3) In elimination mode, the last child to reach the designated color zone is eliminated, and the last remaining player wins.
4) When multiple colors are called in sequence, players must pass through each color and stop in the final zone.
pe-07510:
1) Divide the area into a drawing zone and a sentence zone, and split each team into two groups.
2) On start, a runner reads the sentence, runs to the center, and orally describes it to a teammate.
3) The teammate runs to the blank paper to draw what they heard, while subsequent runners pass the next clues.
4) The team that best reproduces the drawing scores a point.
pe-07511:
1) Designate one cat and one mouse, while the other players stand still in pairs in the center.
2) On start, the cat chases the mouse to tag it, and the mouse flees.
3) If tagged, the mouse becomes the cat and the cat becomes the mouse.
4) The mouse can link arms with a standing pair for safety, and the cat cannot tag standing pairs.
5) When a mouse links to a pair, the player on the opposite end must detach and become the new mouse.
pe-07512:
1) Designate 2 monkeys and 1 super banana; all other players are regular bananas.
2) On start, the monkeys chase and tag the bananas.
3) Tagged bananas must freeze in place with both arms raised in the air.
4) The super banana unfreezes frozen bananas by peeling them (lowering one arm, then the other).
5) The super banana can also be tagged but only freezes for 10 seconds before freeing itself.
6) Monkeys win if they catch all regular bananas within the time limit; bananas win if they survive.
pe-07513:
1) Set up cones across the field and divide players into adventurers and defenders.
2) On signal, 2 adventurers kick or launch 2 balls as far as possible into the field.
3) Once hit, adventurers run through the jungle to retrieve treasures while defenders retrieve the balls to tag them by throwing.
4) If an adventurer carrying a treasure is hit, they must drop the treasure on that spot and return to camp.
5) Each treasure safely brought back to camp scores 1 point.
6) Switch roles after a round; the team with the most points wins.
pe-07514:
1) Divide players into two teams (Camels and Chamois) standing back-to-back in pairs.
2) The teacher tells a story; when the word "Chamois" is called, the Chamois sprint toward the finish line.
3) At the same time, the Camels quickly turn around and try to tag their partner before they cross the line.
4) A point is awarded for crossing the line safely, or for tagging the opponent before the line.
5) The first player to reach the target score wins the round.
pe-07515:
1) Place multiple hoops on the field to represent planets, and have both teams line up behind their starting lines with a ball each.
2) At the signal, the first player from each team runs to a hoop planet and takes position inside.
3) The next player remaining at the base throws the ball to the player stationed on the planet.
4) If caught, the player brings both the hoop and the ball back to base; if missed, they return with only the ball.
5) Subsequent pairs repeat the run and throw, and the team that captures the most hoops wins.
pe-07516:
1) Each team prepares two mats and two cones, working cooperatively to advance the mats toward the treasure.
2) At the start signal, players must advance solely on the mats without falling onto the floor.
3) Players step onto the forward mat and work together to bring the rear mat forward to progress.
4) The first team to reach and touch the treasure earns a point.
pe-07517:
1) Scatter hoops representing ice floes randomly across the play area, matching the number of players.
2) Children act as polar bears and wander freely around the area.
3) At the adult's signal, polar bears quickly step inside an ice floe hoop to avoid the giant wave.
4) Once all bears are safe, they wander again while the adult removes one hoop to simulate melting ice.
5) As floes decrease, players cooperate to squeeze into the remaining spaces until all stand on the final single hoop without falling.
pe-07518:
1) Divide each team into an adult captain along with designated attackers and defenders.
2) The captain sets ship coordinates on a grid and writes an attack target on a piece of paper for the attacker.
3) The attacker must run to the opponent's base without getting tagged by defenders to deliver the attack order.
4) The opposing captain indicates if a ship was hit, and the attacker returns to report the result to their captain.
5) If tagged by a defender while crossing, the attacker's paper is torn and they must return to base for a new slip.
6) The team that sinks all opposing ships first wins the game.
pe-07519:
1) Divide into two teams, set up a 3x3 grid using 9 hoops, and place cones at each team starting point.
2) At the start signal, the first player from each team runs to a hoop and places a scarf of their team color.
3) The player runs back to tag the next teammate, and the team that first aligns three matching colors horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
pe-07520:
1) Divide the court into two zones and assign one player from each team as a spy placed in the opponent territory.
2) Play begins with the spy who must pass the ball across to teammates in their own half.
3) Any teammate who catches the spy's pass with two hands without it touching the ground crosses into the opponent zone as a new spy, and the team that brings all players across wins.
pe-07521:
1) Players form a circle wearing blindfolds, while two players stand in the center as a statue and a speaker.
2) The statue takes any posture, and the speaker describes the exact posture verbally to the circle.
3) The blindfolded players listen carefully and reproduce the statue pose; once described, blindfolds are removed and the closest player becomes the next statue.
pe-07522:
1) Students form pairs where one acts as the guide and the other is blindfolded.
2) The guide stands behind cones without crossing them and gives directions using only their voice.
3) The blindfolded partner navigates the space guided solely by voice commands to locate and retrieve a scarf back to the start.
pe-07523:
1) Place 10 cones in a circle at the center to represent the sun, and assign numbers to players on both teams.
2) When a number is called, players with that number sprint to the center to seize the ball.
3) Teammates of the player with the ball join in a circle around the cones, complete a return pass with the center player each, and sprint back to their camp to score a point.
pe-07524:
1) Divide into six teams and line up behind each team's hoop.
2) On signal, the first runner sprints to the opposite side and turns over one face-down card.
3) If the card matches their team hoop's color, take it back; if not, place it face down again and run back.
4) Tag the next runner's foot instead of giving a high five, and the next runner takes off.
pe-07525:
1) Divide into two teams: an infield team and an outfield team.
2) Infield pairs pass the ball, run back to touch a cone behind them, return, and continue until they complete 30 passes.
3) Outfield runners race along the outer track stepping through hoops, slaloming around boxes, and clearing lateral hoops while counting their completed laps.
4) When the infield team finishes 30 passes and calls stop, the outfield runners immediately halt.
pe-07526:
1) Perform bear crawls in all directions to warm up and build supporting strength in arms and shoulders.
2) Set up progressive stations increasing gradually in height and difficulty using mats and foam blocks.
3) Place foam blocks beside the box so students can practice straddling safely without fear.
4) Increase the height step by step at individual learning paces until mastering the straddle vault.
pe-07527:
1) Two seekers leave the gymnasium briefly before the game begins.
2) Remaining students pair up, invent a unique body movement, and show it to the teacher to prevent duplicates.
3) Students scatter across the gym, and the two seekers take turns touching students.
4) Touched students perform their secret movement, and seekers earn points when finding matching pairs.
pe-07528:
1) Hook long gym benches onto Swedish wall bars at varying angles to create inclined climbing and sliding stations.
2) Slide down belly-first while clamping hands or feet against the bench to control sliding speed.
3) Practice walking down the inclined benches, maintaining coordination as the steep incline transitions to flat ground.
4) Perform advanced climbing by hanging underneath the bench beam and pulling upward along the incline.
pe-07529:
1) Students sit in a circle, and one secret 'conductor' is designated while a seeker steps outside.
2) The conductor changes various physical movements, and all other students inconspicuously copy the actions.
3) The seeker stands inside or outside the circle and tries to identify who the conductor is.
4) Difficulty can be increased by making movements subtle or having students move around the gym.
pe-07530:
1) Move a parallel bar against a wall and detach the inner bar rail so only the outer rail remains.
2) Position the standing leg under the rail with slightly bent arms, then swing the free leg up forcefully.
3) Walk the feet up the wall while pulling the legs over the rail, keeping eyes fixed on the feet throughout the turn.
4) Continue rotating the body until reaching a front support position on top of the bar.
pe-07531:
1) Attach two ropes to the front of the parallel bars and stretch them forward in parallel.
2) Support your weight on the end of the bars and swing your legs back and forth.
3) Swing over to execute a turn dismount over the ropes and land safely on the mat.
4) If legs contact the ropes, the ropes are easily released to prevent injury.
pe-07532:
1) Arrange hula hoops on the floor in a grid pattern to create the playing board.
2) Divide into two teams, with each team holding sashes/ribbons of their own color.
3) On the signal, runners sprint one by one to place their ribbon inside an empty hoop.
4) Tag the next runner; the team that successfully connects four in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins.
pe-07533:
1) Place a large soft crash mat with additional safety floor mats around it.
2) Several students start on the mat in a low or kneeling wrestling posture.
3) Push or pull opponents to force them off the mat area.
4) A player is eliminated once touching the outside floor, and the last remaining student wins.
pe-07534:
1) Students distribute evenly across six benches
2) Perform the designated strength exercise at each bench for a set duration
3) Rotate to the next bench station when time is up
pe-07535:
1) Students stand in two facing lines with outstretched arms to form an alleyway
2) A runner sprints through the alleyway at their chosen pace
3) Students raise their hands at the very last second to allow the runner to pass through safely
4) The runner joins the end of the line upon completing the run
pe-07536:
1) In basic forward roll, look at hands, tuck chin to chest, and place the back of the head on the mat
2) Catch a ball thrown immediately after rolling to practice standing up without hands
3) Use an inclined mat to gain rolling momentum easily
4) Practice rolling on a bench from kneeling to reinforce head placement, or roll holding a ball between knees
pe-07537:
1) Every player holds a cone in their hands throughout the game
2) The ball is kicked with the feet but must always be caught inside the cone
3) Players holding the ball inside their cone have limited mobility and can score an additional point by tagging an opponent
4) Score goals by kicking the ball into the opponent's goal
pe-07538:
1) Run under the horizontal bar keeping arms straight to finish in an extended arched body position
2) Widen hands slightly on the bar and pass through the gap with a small hop
3) Swing one leg actively upward and forward
4) Use a gymnastics stick held at half bar height as a visual target, gradually progressing to a single-leg takeoff
pe-07539:
1) Develop supporting arm strength using animal walks and bunny hops.
2) Place both hands on a low vaulting box and hop both feet up close to the hands.
3) Gradually increase the box height, roll forward smoothly across the box, and land safely on the mat.
pe-07540:
1) [1-2-3 Hoops] Run between hoops on the floor and perform tasks on command (1: step through hoop, 2: stand in empty hoop, 3: twirl hoop).
2) [Tip & Hop] Stand inside hoops arranged in a circle and jump left or right simultaneously to achieve 10 consecutive rounds.
3) [Battleship] Move around holding a hoop at waist level; 3 to 5 throwers try to throw a ball through the hoops to sink them.
pe-07541:
1) Mark the curved approach path and takeoff point using spot markers.
2) Take off with the left foot when running from the right, and with the right foot when running from the left.
3) Clear the low bar/elastic cord and land safely in the center of the mat.
pe-07542:
1) Students form a circle and cross their arms.
2) Grasp the hands of two different classmates with each hand.
3) Untangle the knot without ever releasing hands until a single open circle is formed.
pe-07543:
1) Place two thick soft mats inside the court and divide students into two teams.
2) Pass the ball to teammates without dribbling to advance toward the mat.
3) Score by having a teammate on the mat catch a ball that has bounced at least once.
pe-07544:
1) Perform warm-up drills to build body tension and arm support strength.
2) Run up and swing through a handstand onto stacked mats keeping the entire body straight.
3) Utilize a mini-trampoline, vaulting box, and landing mats to complete the full handspring.
pe-07545:
1) A runner throws a softball into the field and sprints toward the mat mountain stacked on the opposite side of the hall.
2) The fielding team catches the ball and tries to hit running players with the softballs to get them out.
3) The runner climbs the mat mountain (safe base) and must successfully return to their team to score a point (a maximum of 3 runners can be on the mountain simultaneously).
pe-07546:
1) Two teams face each other divided by a centerline, with a large gym mat standing upright in each half.
2) Players play standard dodgeball rules by throwing softballs to eliminate opponents.
3) If a team's standing gym mat falls over, that team immediately loses the game.
pe-07547:
1) A runner throws a softball into the field, and a team of 4 runners carrying a gym mat starts running the course.
2) The fielders pass the ball among themselves (without running while holding it) to put it into the target vaulting box as quickly as possible.
3) Before the ball enters the box, all 4 runners must drop the mat and stand on it as a safe base, scoring points when crossing the finish line.
pe-07548:
1) One team positions inside the court as fielders, while the runner team waits outside in pairs.
2) The first runner throws a softball into the court and immediately runs in after the ball.
3) The fielding team cannot run with the ball and must pass to hit and tag the first runner out.
4) Simultaneously, the second runner navigates the base course of gym mats earning 1 point per base until the partner inside is hit.
pe-07549:
1) Roll the dice at the designated dice station.
2) Locate the corresponding fitness exercise card matching the rolled number.
3) Complete the assigned workout task at a predesignated area.
4) Return to the dice station after finishing the exercise to roll again for the next task.
pe-07550:
1) Set up a 16-spot grid using spot markers, and assign 4 players per team as human pieces lined up on opposite sides.
2) Determine player order via rock-paper-scissors and take turns moving one space along the lines.
3) Capture an opponent piece by sandwiching it horizontally, vertically, or in a corner, and win when the opponent has only 1 piece left.
pe-07551:
1) Hold one cup upside down and place another cup on top of it.
2) Toss the top cup upward and flip the bottom cup held in your hand.
3) If the tossed cup lands directly inside the flipped cup, it counts as a success, and add up all team members' scores.
pe-07552:
1) Make a 3x3 grid on a desk and prepare 5 cups of different colors for each player.
2) Place a cup slightly over the table edge and flick it upward from the bottom to flip it.
3) Once successfully flipped upright, place it onto one space of the 3x3 grid.
4) The player or team that makes a line of three or controls more spaces wins.
pe-07553:
1) Make a web shape by attaching tape across a hula hoop.
2) Stand the completed web up or have someone hold it.
3) Crumple tissue or newspaper into a prey ball and throw it to stick onto the web.
pe-07554:
1) Hold the balloon firmly by the tied knot.
2) Spin around three times in place.
3) Immediately after three spins, release and throw the balloon as far as possible in the target direction.
pe-07555:
1) Flick a table tennis ball with fingers on the table to knock paper cups off.
2) Retrieve fallen cups, place the ball in the center, and try to knock down as many cups as possible within 1 minute.
3) In match play, dropping the ball to the floor hands the turn to the opponent, and the player who stacks more knocked cups wins.
pe-07556:
1) The batter places one foot on home base and hits a balloon using a paper towel roll.
2) If the batter reaches 1st base and returns home before the defense tags the base with the balloon, they score 1 point; 2nd base awards 2 points, and 3rd base awards 3 points.
3) In an alternative version without fielders, the play area is divided into scoring zones (1, 2, 3 points), with cups placed to add bonus points or penalties when knocked down.
pe-07557:
1) Hold the playstick noodle and take your spot.
2) Hit the incoming ball or balloon using only the stick.
3) Stay in your designated spot without moving your feet.
pe-07558:
1) Perform one ball-handling control by bumping or setting the ball and catching it.
2) Execute an underhand or overhand serve over the chair toward the target area.
3) Earn 1 point for clearing the chair, 2 points for hitting the box, and 5 points if the ball lands inside the basket box.
4) Score a total of 10 or more points within 1 minute to complete the challenge.
pe-07559:
1) The batter kicks a stationary foam ball on the ground and runs counterclockwise to touch cones for points (1 point per cone touch, up to 4 points).
2) The fielding team immediately gets the batter out if they catch a fly ball.
3) If the ball lands or rolls, the fielders pass the ball 3 times among themselves and then throw it from outside the circle to knock down the target cone placed in the center.
4) The batter scores points based on how many cones were touched before the target cone is knocked over.
pe-07560:
1) Set up goals using vaulting boxes and bands at both ends, using a gym ball as the game ball.
2) Roll the ball backward and exchange greetings to begin play.
3) Ball possession for an individual is limited to a maximum of 5 seconds before passing.
4) Kicking and lifting are fouls; players must use hand actions (handling) only to roll/pass into the goal.
pe-07561:
1) Set up goals for both teams with 2 cones spaced 8 steps apart and select one goalkeeper per team.
2) Play soccer where goalkeepers cannot catch the ball but can only block with feet, body, or deflections.
3) When a team scores, widen their goal cones by one step; when conceded, narrow them by one step.
4) Only goals entering below the goalkeeper's waist count, and the team with more goals wins.
pe-07562:
1) Set up spot markers ahead of the throw line and have each team line up in order.
2) Player 1 stands on a chosen spot marker, and Player 2 throws the flying disc to Player 1.
3) If caught successfully on the marker, bring back the marker and disc; if missed, retrieve only the disc, and the team with the most markers wins.
pe-07563:
1) Set a 20m by 10m field divided in half into two defense zones with 2 defenders in each zone.
2) Four attackers line up at the start and advance by running with the ball or passing it to teammates.
3) Attackers earn 1 point and switch sides upon successfully carrying the ball across the end line.
4) If an attacker is tagged or a pass is intercepted, roll the ball backward at that spot to restart.
5) Attackers switch roles after 3 failed attempts, and the team with the most points wins.
pe-07564:
1) Set up a target and stand at a designated distance behind the starting line.
2) Roll smaller balls with one hand and larger balls with both hands using controlled force toward the target.
3) When using feet, stop the ball and gently push it with the inside of the foot toward the target.
pe-07565:
1) Slowly loosen joints from the wrists and ankles, moving from small movements to larger ones.
2) Stretch smoothly without bouncing until a mild pulling sensation is felt.
3) Lie on the mat, roll sideways, or balance on one foot to get accustomed to the mat.
pe-07566:
1) Select one tagger and all players step inside the circle.
2) On the teacher's whistle, everyone simultaneously jumps high with both feet toward a spot where the tagger cannot reach.
3) After jumping once, the tagger reaches out their arms to tag players while other players must not move.
4) Tagged students go outside the designated area and sit down.
pe-07567:
1) Divide the court into six zones across the net and form two teams of six players each.
2) Serve by hitting or throwing the ball from outside the court; teams may let the ball bounce once and must pass it to return it within three hits.
3) If a team fails to return the ball within three hits or hits it out of bounds, the opponent scores one point, and players rotate clockwise upon scoring.
4) The first team to reach 15 points wins.
pe-07568:
1) Set up 2 home bases for offense, 1 home base for defense, and 1st through 3rd bases, placing a cone and ball between offensive bases.
2) Form two teams of 6 players each to play offense and defense.
3) Two offensive players stand at home, and the right player kicks the ball placed on the cone.
4) The kicker runs toward 1st base and the partner toward 3rd base, meeting near 2nd base to high-five before heading home.
5) If defense fields the ball and steps on the defensive home base first, it is an out; if both offensive runners touch home first, they score 2 points (1 point if only one touches).
6) Teams switch sides after all players kick, playing 2 innings to determine the winner by score.
pe-07569:
1) Set up a 2m net in the center and divide into two teams of 6 players.
2) Place hoops where the ball is expected to land and serve the ball from outside the court.
3) Each player hits the ball twice to rotate, and players pass within 3 touches to clear over the net avoiding the hoops.
4) Score 1 point if the ball lands over the net without touching any hoops; the team with the most points wins.
pe-07570:
1) The teacher explains the order of hamburger ingredients (e.g., bun, lettuce, patty, bun).
2) Each student receives four ingredient cards.
3) Students move around the classroom to find peers with the required ingredients and link up in order using one card each to form a four-person train.
4) The completed train submits their cards in order to the teacher, and students who use up all cards return to their seats.
5) If fewer than four students remain at the end, they may combine multiple cards to complete the hamburger.
pe-07571:
1) Choose 1 or 2 seekers who wear blindfolds and hold fun sticks.
2) The remaining players hide throughout the classroom for 10 seconds.
3) Players must freeze completely once the 10 seconds are up.
4) The seekers search for the hiding players.
5) Players tagged by the fun stick are eliminated and sit quietly in a designated area.
pe-07572:
1) Throw the flying disc toward opponents within 5 seconds.
2) Avoid or catch incoming flying discs.
3) Players hit by the disc are eliminated to the outside, but catching the disc revives an outside teammate.
pe-07573:
1) The batter throws the ball underhand into the white court area and runs the bases.
2) Circling the orange bases and stepping on home base scores 1 point.
3) The defense gets an out by catching the ball in the scoop or throwing it through the bases to beat the runner.
4) Teams switch sides after 3 outs.
pe-07574:
1) Each participant rolls a die, and the turn order is determined starting from the highest number.
2) Players take turns rolling the die and advancing their magnet piece by the number shown.
3) The player performs the designated fitness exercise written on the landing space.
4) If landing on a Golden Key space, draw a mission card and follow its instructions.
5) Repeat turns until all players have completed one full round around the board.
pe-07575:
1) Teams of 3-4 sit in lines forming a rectangle, and the leftmost player holds a beanbag.
2) A player performs the called locomotor movement (gallop, side slide) to touch a cone and returns.
3) The player sits down and passes the beanbag under the teammates' legs to the next person.
4) Teams count how many full cycles they complete within 2 minutes.
pe-07576:
1) Serve by bouncing the ball on the floor and hitting it, with one teammate allowed to assist if needed.
2) Teams have unlimited hits on their side, but no player may hit the ball twice in a row.
3) Players may hit the ball directly in the air or after exactly one bounce on the floor.
4) Play rally games from 2-on-2 up to 6-on-6 according to group size.
pe-07577:
1) Players line up behind one another in a file, and only the last person in line keeps their eyes open while everyone else closes their eyes.
2) The person at the back guides the line toward an opposing team.
3) When the leader shouts "disparo" (fire), the front player moves forward to tag an opponent, eliminating anyone touched.
4) The team that eliminates all opposing players wins.
pe-07578:
1) The narrator plays background music and tells an engaging adventure story.
2) Participants act as silent performers, expressing the story entirely through their body movements without speaking.
3) Players physically act out scenes such as boarding the spaceship, launching, floating in space, exploring an unknown planet, hiding, and returning against strong winds.
pe-07579:
1) The seeker stands in the middle with arms spread and eyes closed, counting up to 30 as 'Pi 1, Pi 2...'.
2) During the 30 seconds, players run up to the seeker, call out 'Pi [Name]', and quickly go hide.
3) Once the count finishes, the seeker takes around 10 steps to spot hiding players and calls out their names to eliminate them.
4) If no one is caught, the time decreases to 25 seconds, then 20 seconds, continuing until all players are found.
pe-07580:
1) Players stand in a circle while the guide sits in the center with eyes closed.
2) Players pass a ball quickly to the right around the circle.
3) The center person counts mentally to 50, performing set arm gestures at 10, 20, 30, and 40.
4) At 50, the guide claps and shouts bomb, and the player holding the ball must sit down with legs extended forward.
5) Standing players must step over the legs of seated players to continue passing until only one winner remains.
pe-07581:
1) Players form a circle, and the person with the ball stands in the center.
2) The center player declares war by calling someone's name and throws the ball up.
3) The called player catches the ball and shouts to stop feet, freezing everyone.
4) The thrower takes three steps and throws the ball at the nearest player to eliminate them.
pe-07582:
1) Place cards with item names on a central chair, and set up 4 designated recycling chairs (glass, containers, paper, organic) around it.
2) On the signal, players run to the center and grab a card.
3) Players quickly run to the matching recycling chair, but anyone who picks an item that belongs to none of the four must sit on the floor in the center.
pe-07583:
1) Divide into two equal teams facing each other about 8 meters apart.
2) Each team captain secretly assigns numbers to their teammates.
3) On signal, find the person from the opposite team with the same number to hug and stay together.
4) Add non-verbal restrictions such as no talking or gesturing in each subsequent round.
pe-07584:
1) Line up at the starting line.
2) When the whistle blows, move as slowly as possible toward the finish line.
3) You must keep moving forward without stopping, and the last person to cross the line wins.
pe-07585:
1) Two players hold hands facing each other to form a house, and a third player stands inside as a tenant.
2) When the tagger calls 'House', the pairs forming houses must find a new tenant without letting go of their hands.
3) When 'Tenant' is called, tenants find another house, and when 'Earthquake' is called, all groups disband and form new trios.
pe-07586:
1) Divide participants into an exhibition team and a tourist team.
2) The exhibition team poses silently as statues representing monuments, paintings, or figures.
3) The tourists tour the museum and then return to the start to guess what each statue represents.
pe-07587:
1) Imagine a pretend ball that has various properties such as being extremely heavy, hot, dirty, spiky, or slippery.
2) Follow the leader's prompt and exaggerate facial expressions and physical gestures matching each condition.
3) Pass the pretend ball to peers while vividly acting out its sensation and weight through mime.
pe-07588:
1) One player covers their eyes with a blindfold to become the bat.
2) Other players walk freely around the bat, choosing to stay quiet or touch the bat to confuse them.
3) The bat catches someone using only touch and guesses their name by touching their face.
4) If the guess is correct, the captured player becomes the next bat; otherwise, the current bat continues.
pe-07589:
1) Players form a line with front players blindfolded, while the last player acts as the guide.
2) Pressing both shoulders starts movement, right shoulder turns right, left turns left, and a tap on the back stops.
3) The team navigates around the cones and touches the wall to complete the course.
pe-07590:
1) The entire team aims to reach the facilitator and gently touch their head as quickly as possible.
2) When the facilitator calls out a number of feet, teammates gather to coordinate how to make only that exact number of feet touch the ground.
3) At the signal, all team members move together toward the facilitator while maintaining the designated number of feet on the ground.
pe-07591:
1) One tagger faces the wall while the other participants stand behind the starting line.
2) While the tagger faces the wall and calls out '1, 2, 3, Wall', participants advance and pass a handkerchief among themselves without being seen.
3) Any participant seen moving or caught passing the handkerchief when the tagger turns around must return to the starting line.
4) The handkerchief must be passed to another teammate before touching the wall; touching the wall while holding the handkerchief is invalid.
pe-07592:
1) Players split into two teams in lines facing colored cardstock sheets.
2) The leader calls out a color order and racers run out to rearrange them accordingly.
3) The first team to correctly arrange the colors scores a point and the highest score wins.
pe-07593:
1) Guardians stand behind chairs and prisoners sit down, leaving one guardian with an empty chair.
2) The guardian with the empty chair winks at one of the seated prisoners.
3) The winked prisoner tries to escape to the empty chair, while their guardian attempts to tag them.
4) If the prisoner escapes, the former guardian now manages the empty chair and winks next.
pe-07594:
1) Players stand in a circle and pass a ball to the right without handing it directly, completing a full circle without dropping it.
2) A player in the center throws a second orange ball to someone in the circle and receives it back.
3) The center player tries to cause either ball to drop, and whoever drops a ball moves to the center.
pe-07595:
1) In pairs, one person closes their eyes while the partner shapes them into a human statue
2) Avoid postures that defy gravity such as lifting both feet off the ground
3) Switch roles so the other partner closes their eyes and becomes the statue
pe-07596:
1) Each participant is assigned a secret animal that others do not know
2) Participants express their assigned animal using only mime gestures without making sounds
3) Observe each other's gestures and line up in alphabetical order of the animal names
pe-07597:
1) Form two teams of four, holding each other's waists to make a dragon with a head and a tail.
2) Attach a tail to the last player and move to grab the other team's tail upon signal.
3) The team that grabs the opponent's tail wins, and if the line breaks, reform before continuing.
pe-07598:
1) All participants stand in a circle holding hands.
2) Place a hula hoop over one player's arm before starting.
3) Pass the hoop along the circle to the next person using body movements without letting go of hands.
4) Complete the challenge when the hoop travels through everyone and returns to the start.
pe-07599:
1) Set up 4 cones at the four corners of a handball court.
2) Run continuously for a designated time (3, 6, or 9 minutes).
3) Earn 3 points for running diagonals, 2 points for jogging lengthwise, and 1 point for walking widthwise.
4) A resting partner observes and records each lap's points on a score sheet.
5) The teacher announces remaining time every 30 seconds, and partners switch roles afterwards.
pe-07600:
1) Designate 1 or 2 catchers (witches) within the judo mat area.
2) Stepping onto the red boundary mat or being tagged turns a player into a stone.
3) When turned into a stone, curl up into a ball on the mat.
4) A teammate rescues a frozen stone by hugging their arms and rolling them over to free them.
5) Players dodge the witches while rescuing frozen teammates before everyone gets caught.
pe-07601:
1) Run along the course set on the 400m running track.
2) Touch every single cone on the course with your hand as fast as possible without missing any.
3) Return to your column upon finishing so the next runner can start.
pe-07602:
1) Divide players equally into thieves and smugglers (defenders/police).
2) Thieves hide bills on their body and try to transport them across to the other side.
3) When caught by a defender, thieves are searched for 5 seconds; carry as many bills as possible.
pe-07603:
1) Two partners face each other and choose ingredients needed for baking a cake.
2) The first player calls out an ingredient like "flour" and tosses a single ball to the partner.
3) The receiver catches the ball, calls out "milk," and tosses it back, continuing with ingredients like "eggs" and "butter."
4) If a player drops the ball, the cake is considered burnt and the round restarts from the beginning.
5) Progress to under-the-leg throws or bouncing the ball off body parts like thighs or elbows.
pe-07604:
1) Scatter chairs across the area leaving one chair empty, while the tagger stands opposite the empty chair.
2) The tagger can only walk toward empty chairs, while seated players may run to sit in empty chairs to block the tagger.
3) Players move to cover new empty seats created, under the rule that only one player stands at a time and cannot return to their previous seat.
pe-07605:
1) Teams line up in rows and the first runner advances toward the basketball hoop with the ball.
2) Each player gets only one shot attempt to score at the basket.
3) After shooting, the player retrieves the ball, places it in the center, runs back to elbow-tap the next runner to start, and combines score and finish points.
pe-07606:
1) Stand balanced with feet shoulder-width apart, holding hands steady as if resting on a table.
2) Gently toss the ball upward with one hand and catch it with cupped hands like a bowl.
3) Progress to tossing hand-to-hand, circling hands around the ball, and practicing cat-paw catches with both hands.
pe-07607:
1) Mice run around the boundary marked with cones while the tagged cat wearing a bib prepares outside.
2) Mice run continuously to avoid the cat and can step into floor spots as safe zones.
