3) Players can only remain inside the safe zone for a maximum of 3 seconds before they must exit and run again.
pe-07608:
1) Form mixed-gender teams and set up target cubes in an indoor or outdoor court.
2) Move the large ball across the court solely through teammate passes.
3) A player holding the ball cannot run and must not walk more than three steps before passing or shooting.
4) Defenders cannot make physical contact or strip the ball from the ball holder.
5) Attack from any chosen side and knock down the target cube to score a set.
6) The first team to win three sets wins the match.
pe-07609:
1) Set an elastic cord at 1 meter height across the court to divide the playing areas.
2) Players throw or roll the ball by hand under the 1-meter elastic cord to hit the opponent back wall to score.
3) Defenders can block using feet or hands, but attacking shots must be thrown by hand.
pe-07610:
1) React and start upon hearing the audio signal (count or whistle).
2) Move through the cones, executing left-right directional shifts.
3) Turn around the cones, complete the staggered slalom section, and accelerate at the final stretch to return to teammates.
pe-07611:
1) One hunter (tagger) stands in the middle without a ball, while all runners hold a basketball at the baseline.
2) On the starting cue, runners must dribble across to the opposite designated line using legal one-handed dribbling.
3) The hunter attempts to swipe only the ball without hitting hands; anyone who stops dribbling or loses the ball hands it to the teacher and joins the hunters.
pe-07612:
1) Divide into red and blue teams, lining up behind their designated team cones.
2) On start, players race as fast as possible to the yellow shooting box holding the ball (or dribbling with feet).
3) Shoot into the team goal from within the shooting box, retrieve the ball, and run back to hand it to the next teammate; the first team to score 10 goals wins.
pe-07613:
1) Run back and forth across a set distance in time with recorded audio beeps.
2) Reach and touch the opposite line before the signal sounds and pivot back.
3) Continue pacing back and forth as speed stages increase until exhaustion.
pe-07614:
1) Move through the cones tossing the ball from hand to hand and return to hand it to a partner.
2) Toss the ball upward and catch it or catch it off a bounce.
3) Bounce the ball downward with one hand without slapping it.
4) Step onto the bench with one foot, aim with the other hand, and throw to the partner.
pe-07615:
1) Designate the field as a farm and place students assigned as animals (pigs, cows, sheep) on one end.
2) Position farmers as taggers in the middle of the field.
3) When the farmers call out an animal, students representing that animal must run to the other end without being tagged.
4) Students who are tagged by the farmers must run one lap around the perimeter of the farm before rejoining the group.
5) The farmers return to the center and call out another animal to continue the game.
pe-07616:
1) Mark a central roadway on the court, placing runners at one end and throwers behind the sidelines.
2) Distribute soft foam balls to the throwers on both sides.
3) Runners must dash forward through the central lane while throwers throw foam balls to hit them.
4) Runners who are hit by a ball must sit down immediately where they were struck.
5) In subsequent rounds, seated players remain still but can reach out to tag passing runners.
6) The game continues until all runners have been hit.
pe-07617:
1) Pair up students facing each other in the center of the court, giving one ball to each pair.
2) One player throws the pass to their partner.
3) If the partner catches the ball, that partner takes one step backward.
4) If the partner fails to catch the ball, they must take one step forward.
5) Continue taking steps back or forth based on catches to practice throwing and receiving.
pe-07618:
1) Divide students into teams standing in single-file lines very close together behind the starting line.
2) Set up a finish line at a distance ahead of the starting line.
3) The last person in line crawls forward under the legs of all teammates to the front of the line.
4) The new last person then crawls through everyone's legs to the front, repeating continuously.
5) The line keeps moving forward, and the first team whose front crosses the finish line wins.
pe-07619:
1) Place a row of cones in each goal area and divide players into two teams.
2) Play soccer using a foam ball, aiming kicks at the opponent's cones.
3) When a player knocks down an opponent's cone, they retrieve it and place it in their own area.
4) The team that captures all of the opposing team's cones first wins.
pe-07620:
1) Students spread out across the play area and must remain rooted in their spots.
2) Pass the ball to one another in complete silence.
3) If a student drops the ball, throws a bad pass, or speaks, they must perform a penalty such as stretches, 5 push-ups, or 5 sit-ups.
pe-07621:
1) Set up pins in the center of the court, surrounded by goalkeepers wearing yellow pinnies defending them.
2) Throwers in green pinnies toss foam balls through the air and rollers roll balls along the floor to knock down the pins.
3) Teams count how many pins are knocked down during 3 minutes, then switch roles.
pe-07622:
1) Place cones in the middle of the field and set a volleyball on top of each cone.
2) Divide the class into two teams facing each other on opposite sides, giving each student 1 tennis ball.
3) On signal, players throw tennis balls to knock the volleyballs off the cones, and the team that knocks all volleyballs down first wins.
pe-07623:
1) Place four goals around the edges of the court, divide the class into four teams, and assign each team to defend one goal.
2) Play with a soccer ball, allowing players to score in any goal except their own.
3) Whenever any team scores a goal, all four teams rotate and change the goals they defend.
pe-07624:
1) Disperse all students across the court, with each player dribbling a basketball.
2) Designate 3 students without balls as pirates whose objective is to steal balls from dribblers.
3) A player whose ball is stolen must immediately pursue and steal a ball from another player.
pe-07625:
1) Divide the class into two teams lined up in single files, assigning each student a number (e.g., 1 to 6).
2) When the teacher calls out a number, that student runs around the back and front of their own line and returns to their starting spot.
3) The team whose runner returns to their original spot first scores 1 point.
pe-07626:
1) Students hold the edge of the parachute representing a pot and shake it gently up and down to warm up.
2) On cue, shake it faster and toss popcorn (balls) onto the parachute.
3) Vigorously shake the parachute until all the popcorn (balls) are popped out of the pot.
pe-07627:
1) Place hoops as trees around the yard and place one falcon (student) inside each hoop.
2) Students call names or signal to each other to switch to different hoops (trees).
3) Once familiar with the flow, remove two hoops so two falcons are left without trees to act as chasers.
4) Falcons left without a hoop become the new chasers and try to claim an open hoop when others switch.
pe-07628:
1) Designate one tagger while all other players scatter across the playing area.
2) The tagger chooses one specific target player and chases only that person.
3) If another runner crosses between the tagger and the target, the 'thread is cut.'
4) The tagger must stop chasing the original target and pursue the runner who crossed through; tagged players become taggers.
pe-07629:
1) The teacher stands at one end of the field while students line up at the opposite end.
2) When the teacher calls 'Green Light,' students move forward; on 'Red Light,' they must freeze immediately.
3) Students can vary locomotor movements such as running, fast walking, skipping, or lateral movement.
4) Any student caught moving after 'Red Light' must return to the starting line and begin again.
pe-07630:
1) Place four cones at each corner of the play area to form a rectangle.
2) Assign a specific locomotor exercise to each side of the rectangle between the cones.
3) Students move around the perimeter performing the assigned movement for each side (e.g., jogging, crab walk, galloping, jumping).
pe-07631:
1) Place 1-2 chefs (taggers) in the middle while all other students wear colored pinnies (red, blue, green, yellow) at one end line.
2) Assign a food group to each bib color (green=fruits/vegetables, red=meat, blue=dairy, yellow=grains).
3) When the chef calls out a food item, runners matching that food group sprint across the field without getting tagged.
4) Players tagged while crossing are eliminated to the side; the chef may tag multiple runners in one run.
5) Once everyone safely reaches the other side, repeat the process in reverse.
pe-07632:
1) Two taggers (sharks) stand in the middle, and the remaining students (swimmers) stand at one end.
2) On signal, swimmers run to the opposite side without getting tagged by sharks.
3) Tagged swimmers must sit down on the floor where they were caught.
4) Passing swimmers can free sitting students by giving them a high-five.
pe-07633:
1) Students stand in a circle with legs apart and feet touching neighbors' feet.
2) Strike the ball with open palms to pass it between another player's legs.
3) A player scores 1 point when successfully passing the ball between another's legs.
4) If the ball goes outside, retrieve it and restart play.
pe-07634:
1) One tagger (octopus) stands in the center and the other students line up at one side.
2) After singing the designated song, students run toward the other side.
3) Students tagged by the octopus must sit down where they were caught.
4) Seated students cannot move from their spot but can tag passing runners within arm's reach.
pe-07635:
1) Form 6 teams of 3 students and line up behind each cone.
2) On signal, run to the mat and perform the predetermined exercise (e.g., 10 push-ups).
3) Return to the team and give a high-five to tag the next runner.
4) In competition mode, runners sit at the back after finishing, and the first team entirely seated wins.
pe-07636:
1) Divide the class into Red and Yellow teams and distribute balls.
2) Throw balls to hit players on the opposing team.
3) A player who gets hit moves to the opponent's side, touches the endline, and joins that team.
4) Start a new round when all players from one team are converted and eliminated.
pe-07637:
1) One team lines up in a zigzag across the court to exchange passes while the other lines up outside at the start line.
2) The running team completes a relay around the court one by one as the passing team exchanges as many passes as possible.
3) Passes are counted out loud and the round ends when the final relay runner crosses the finish line.
4) Teams switch roles and the team with more completed passes wins.
pe-07638:
1) One tagger starts in the center of the court and chases runners to tag them.
2) Runners can protect themselves from being tagged by holding hands with another classmate to form a pair.
3) The paired runners must count out loud to 3 seconds and then immediately separate.
4) The runner who gets tagged becomes the new tagger.
pe-07639:
1) Divide players into two teams on opposite court halves, each selecting 3 outfields to stand behind the opponent's two sidelines and baseline.
2) The teacher throws the ball, and players can only touch it after it bounces 3 times.
3) Outfielders throw the ball from behind the lines to eliminate opponents and score a point.
4) An eliminated player takes the ball to position 1, shifting outfielder 1 to 2, 2 to 3, and outfielder 3 returns inside the court.
5) The round resumes from outfielder 1, and the team with the most points when time runs out wins.
pe-07640:
1) Mark shooting zones and starting direction, place one player under the basket, and align other players at designated spots
2) Take turns shooting; if made, advance one zone to the side and shoot again, while missing passes turn to the next player
3) If the player under the basket catches a rebound off the board directly and scores, they switch places with the shooter
4) The player who successfully scores from the final shooting zone wins and becomes the King
pe-07641:
1) Divide students into two teams (Sparrows and Crows) facing each other across the center line
2) The team whose name is called by the teacher chases straight ahead while the other team sprints toward their baseline
3) Tagging a runner before the baseline scores a point for chasers; escaping safely scores a point for runners
4) The team with the highest total points after several rounds wins
pe-07642:
1) Players form a large circle holding hands to create the cage.
2) Players acting as mice run freely inside and outside the circle.
3) On signal, the cage players squat or lower arms to trap mice inside.
pe-07643:
1) Players advance the ball only with passes without dribbling
2) Score by throwing the ball through a hoop held by a teammate
3) The opposing team restarts play from behind the endline after a score or failed attempt
pe-07644:
1) The tagger starts at the center of the court while others flee
2) Any tagged player forms a bridge by holding a push-up support position
3) A tagged player is freed when another player crawls underneath them
pe-07645:
1) Divide the field into two team zones, setting up a flag area and a prison in each zone.
2) Players are safe in their own territory but can be tagged in the opponent's territory, sending them to the opponent's prison.
3) A captured player can return to the game by running back to their own side without being tagged.
4) A player reaching the opponent's flag area becomes safe, and successfully bringing the flag back scores a point.
pe-07646:
1) Arrange hula hoops in a large circle; some students stand outside next to them, while those without a hoop stand inside.
2) Outside students run in a designated direction while inside students move freely or perform warm-up exercises.
3) On a signal, every student tries to find and occupy a hula hoop.
4) Students left without a hoop go inside the circle, and in elimination rounds, remove one hoop each time to keep one less hoop than players.
pe-07647:
1) Students sit in a circle and one person is chosen to start outside the group.
2) That person walks around touching others' backs while saying 'Fly' or 'Mosquito'.
3) When 'Mosquito' is called that participant must stand up quickly and chase the runner.
4) Both players run and chase in the same direction.
5) If the runner circles around and sits in the chaser's spot they switch roles.
6) If the chaser catches the runner before sitting down roles do not switch and the runner goes again.
pe-07648:
1) Two teams play while seated on their bottoms on the court.
2) The foam ball is tossed into the playing area at the start signal.
3) Players may only move by sliding on their bottoms when they do not have the ball; traveling with the ball is prohibited.
4) Teammates pass the ball to each other and attempt to shoot and score into the opponent's goal.
5) Defenders can regain possession by intercepting passes in midair.
pe-07649:
1) Set up four different colored zones; players (customers) scatter randomly across the zones.
2) Two taggers (waiters) start in the middle of the court.
3) When the leader calls out a specific color (e.g., Red), customers in that zone must run to a different colored zone without getting tagged.
4) Any customer tagged by a waiter becomes a waiter too.
5) The game ends when only one customer remains.
pe-07650:
1) Two hunters position themselves on the sidelines with balls, while 10 rabbits line up at the starting line.
2) On the starting signal, the rabbits dash across to the finish line while dodging balls thrown by the hunters.
3) Once safely across, the rabbits must run back to the starting line dodging balls again.
4) Any rabbit struck by a ball between the shoulders and feet becomes a hunter.
5) Play continues until only one rabbit remains in the game.
pe-07651:
1) Mark out the bank, thieves' camp, and prison with cones, and divide players into sheriffs and thieves.
2) Sheriffs defend the bank and prison, tagging any thieves to send them directly to prison.
3) Thieves attempt to steal items (cones or scarves representing money) from the bank and bring them back to their camp without being tagged.
4) Captured thieves in prison can be freed if another active thief runs in and tags them.
5) Thieves win by stealing all items from the bank, while sheriffs win by jailing all thieves.
pe-07652:
1) Divide into two teams, and upon the signal, the first runner (kangaroo) of each team jumps from hoop to hoop placed in front.
2) Teammates pick up the hoops behind the runner and place them ahead to continue the path.
3) If the runner steps outside a hoop onto the floor, they must return to the start and try again.
4) The first team whose runner reaches the finish line scores a point, repeating until all members take a turn.
pe-07653:
1) Designate two predators (taggers), and the remaining players scatter across the area as ants.
2) On signal, predators chase and try to tag the running ants.
3) A tagged ant must lie on their back with arms and legs raised in the air.
4) Two free ants must touch the immobilized ant's arms and legs simultaneously to rescue them.
5) The ants win if at least one ant survives after 5 minutes; the predators win if they tag everyone.
pe-07654:
1) Mark the river area with cones and place one crocodile (tagger) in the center of the river.
2) Other players line up on one bank waiting for the start signal.
3) On the signal, players dash across the river trying to reach the opposite bank without being tagged.
4) Tagged players become baby crocodiles and must crawl on all fours to help tag remaining runners.
5) The last untagged player wins the game and becomes the crocodile for the next round.
pe-07655:
1) Players line up in a single file behind each other to form a train.
2) All players except the front leader (locomotive) wear blindfolds.
3) On signal, the train moves forward guided by the verbal instructions of the locomotive.
4) The locomotive guides the team to safely navigate through all obstacles on the course.
pe-07656:
1) Divide into 4 teams, with each player in a team assigned a vegetable name such as carrot, salad, cabbage, or radish.
2) When the leader calls out a vegetable name, all players assigned to that vegetable run simultaneously.
3) The runners slalom around their teammates and race back to their original spots.
4) The fastest runner to return earns a point for their team, and the team with the most points after all vegetables are called wins.
pe-07657:
1) Set up four distance scoring zones marked by cones: white (1 pt), green (2 pts), blue (3 pts), and red (4 pts).
2) The thrower stands behind the line and throws an object as far as possible on signal.
3) Each player gets three attempts, and only the single best throw is counted.
4) The player or team with the highest score at the end wins the competition.
pe-07658:
1) Teammates sit on the floor in a line behind cones, with all 10 hoops placed on the front cone.
2) On the start signal, the first player takes a hoop, passes it overhead, rolls back, and places it over the cone behind them.
3) The next player picks up the hoop and transfers it backward in the same way down the line.
4) Once passed, players can immediately take the next hoop, and the first team to move all hoops to the final cone wins.
pe-07659:
1) Divide into two teams, with each team's first jumper lining up at the starting line.
2) On the signal, jump forward as far as possible with both feet together using knee flexion and extension.
3) The instructor places a cone to mark the landing spot.
4) The next player jumps forward with both feet together directly from that marked cone.
5) After all players have jumped, the team with the greatest total distance earns 4 points, while the losing team earns 1 point.
pe-07660:
1) Line up hoops (10 total, 5 per team) and place a cone at the turning point.
2) On the starting signal, the first runner hops with feet together through each hoop.
3) Turn around the cone after the last hoop and run back to the team.
4) Once crossing the starting line, the next runner repeats the course.
5) The first team whose members complete 3 full rounds earns 1 point.
pe-07661:
1) Divide the field into two zones and assign 2 defenders and 3 attackers per team.
2) Defenders protect their flag and tag invading attackers, but cannot stand inside the designated flag zone.
3) Attackers must capture the opponent's flag without being tagged and carry it back to their own side.
4) If an attacker is tagged, they must return to their own side before attacking again.
5) The first team to bring the opponent's flag back to their territory scores 1 point; defenders rotate every 3 minutes.
pe-07662:
1) Place gold bars (scarves/cones) at the center and divide into 3 teams to play across 2 rounds.
2) In round 1, one runner from each team runs to grab one gold bar at a time; the team with the most items when the center is empty wins 1 point.
3) In round 2, one player per team becomes a police officer, and all players play simultaneously.
4) Players must dump their team's gold bars into opponents' camps as fast as possible, while police tag players carrying gold to return the item.
5) The team with the fewest or no gold bars left in their camp at the end of round 2 scores 1 point.
pe-07663:
1) Place cones numbered 1 through 6 in the center of the playing area and divide players into two teams.
2) When the instructor calls out a math problem, the first runner from each team races toward the cone with the correct answer.
3) The first runner to touch the correct cone and return to their home camp scores 1 point for the team.
4) The game continues with the next runners answering new math problems.
pe-07664:
1) Place memory cards face down on the ground at the far end of the playing area and divide players into two teams.
2) Each team forms pairs, and on the start signal, the first pair from each team runs to the memory zone.
3) Each partner flips over one card, and if the two cards match, the pair brings the pair of cards back to their camp.
4) If the cards do not match, players return them to their original spots and run back to camp; the team with the most pairs wins.
pe-07665:
1) Divide players into a Ghost team wearing colored pinnies and a Pac-Man team.
2) At the starting signal, all children run strictly along the court lines without stepping off them.
3) When tagged by a Ghost, a Pac-Man goes to the prison inside the center circle and can be freed if tagged by another teammate.
4) Ghosts win if they tag all Pac-Men within the 10-minute time limit; if at least one Pac-Man survives, Pac-Men win.
pe-07666:
1) Two teams line up facing an obstacle course set with cones, mats (river), and hula hoops.
2) At the start signal, the first runner races around the cone and leaps over the mat without stepping on it.
3) The runner lands with both feet together inside the hoop, pulls the hoop up over the head, places it back down, and sprints back to camp.
4) Once the runner crosses the starting line, the next runner goes; the first team whose runners complete the course three times earns 1 point.
pe-07667:
1) Two teams are stationed across 6 designated zones marked by cones as defenders or attackers.
2) At kickoff, the ball is thrown into the center, and players are strictly forbidden from leaving their designated zone.
3) A player who receives the ball cannot move while holding/controlling it and may pass forward, backward, to zone teammates, or shoot on goal.
4) If a ball touched by a player goes out of bounds, possession goes to the opposing team; the first team to reach 10 goals wins.
pe-07668:
1) Write your name on paper and crumble it into a ball.
2) Throw paper balls at each other during 20-30 seconds of music.
3) Stop on signal, open balls to find your own name, sit down once found, and check elapsed time.
4) In round two, cooperate by delivering found name balls directly to classmates and compare times.
pe-07669:
1) Freeze like a statue when the tambourine rhythm stops.
2) Approach the lying crocodile, step on the line, and sprint back without getting tagged.
3) Play Spider tag by crossing the court and Chain tag linking hands or holding hoops.
4) Play Rock Paper Scissors hopping through hoops and giant Tic-Tac-Toe relay using 9 hoops and cones.
pe-07670:
1) In Octopus Race, 4 players link arms back-to-back and move in sync to the finish line without breaking formation.
2) If the formation breaks, the team must stop, reorganize, and resume from that spot.
3) In Space Rescue, teams of 2-3 carry a homemade ball on a sheet of paper holding its corners back to the base without dropping it.
4) Roles rotate each time a resource is successfully delivered.
5) In Survival Island, teams complete cooperative challenges across marked islands (balance, bowling pin target, transport).
pe-07671:
1) Line up along the red line in the gym.
2) When music plays, move along the line skipping or galloping.
3) When music stops, halt on the line and toss a green beanbag into any hula hoop to score a point.
pe-07672:
1) Form groups of four, where three players hold hands in a circle and one player becomes 'it'.
2) The tagger and one designated target player in the circle face each other.
3) On go, the tagger has 10 seconds to tag the target while the other two rotate the circle to protect them.
pe-07673:
1) Students dribble a soccer ball within the grid while trying to evade the tagger (Mr. Freeze).
2) When tagged or if the ball goes out of bounds, freeze by holding the ball overhead with legs spread apart.
3) An unfrozen teammate can unfreeze a player by crawling under their legs or passing a soccer ball between them.
pe-07674:
1) Two taggers move around by hopping like bunnies.
2) The rest of the players dribble soccer balls while evading the bunny taggers.
3) Tagged players leave their balls and also become hopping bunny taggers.
4) The game continues until only the last dribblers remain.
pe-07675:
1) The tagger (Cookie Monster) lies down on a gym mat pretending to sleep.
2) Students sneak up towards the tagger chanting "Cookie Monster, Cookie Monster, are you sleeping?".
3) If the monster answers "Yes, I'm sleeping", players continue sneaking forward.
4) If the monster shouts "No, I'm not sleeping!", students must dash back behind the starting line.
5) Players tagged with a foam noodle become Cookie Monsters for the next round.
pe-07676:
1) Each student dribbles a soccer ball within the field.
2) The tagger walks around the center without a ball.
3) On cue, students pass the ball using the inside of the foot to hit the tagger.
4) After hitting once, challenge from further away or use left foot only.
pe-07677:
1) Form 2 offense and 1 defense players with no dribbling allowed.
2) Offense players move to open lanes to exchange passes and take a shot.
3) The shooter transitions to defense on the next round.
4) Defense levels progress through Cold (pylon-like), Warm (intercept allowed), and Hot (full pressure).
pe-07678:
1) All players dribble their soccer balls under tight control at speed.
2) When tag is called, players reach to tag opponents' front knees while keeping control of their ball.
3) Touching behind the knees is strictly prohibited.
4) Count individual successful tags and challenge to beat previous personal records.
pe-07679:
1) Students line up at the starting line and follow the leader while performing locomotor movements like walking, jumping, skipping, jogging, sliding, or galloping.
2) When the teacher shouts "Bang!", students must immediately run back to the starting line.
3) The teacher tries to tag the students, who aim to reach the line safely.
pe-07680:
1) Students lie on the floor in a straight line with each person's feet next to the next person's head.
2) The first person holds an object (e.g., a pool noodle) between their feet and passes it to the next person's feet on "Go."
3) Once a student passes the object, they get up, run to the end of the line, and lie down again to advance toward the wall and back.
pe-07681:
1) Two players face each other across a line with a soccer ball between them, keeping both feet on the ground behind the line.
2) Both feet must remain on the ground and behind the line before the command.
3) When the coach says "Go," players race to drag the ball back with their foot, scoring a point in a best-of-three matchup.
pe-07682:
1) Pair up with a partner and face each other.
2) Touch the specified body parts and directions called by the teacher with your partner.
3) When the teacher calls 'People to People', quickly find a new partner and stand back-to-back.
pe-07683:
1) Designate the gym floor as the ocean and place 4 sharks wearing yellow jerseys in the center.
2) Five students on each side line up with scooters ready to cross.
3) On the signal, students ride scooters across the gym without getting tagged by sharks.
4) If tagged, stand up, walk the scooter to hand it to the next team, and walk back along the sideline safe zone.
pe-07684:
1) Pair up and hold hands, then try to tap the partner's knee first on the signal.
2) Next, try to tap the partner's toes with your foot without getting yours tapped.
3) Plant both feet and interlock fingers, trying to make the opponent move their feet first.
4) The winner of each round becomes number 1 and the other becomes number 2 to divide teams.
pe-07685:
1) Set up various cones across the area and divide students into builders and bulldozers.
2) Every student constantly dribbles a ball using one hand while moving.
3) Bulldozers knock down the equipment while maintaining their dribble.
4) Builders set up knocked-down equipment while continuing to dribble.
5) No one can touch another person's ball, and students must move throughout the entire area.
pe-07686:
1) Run or move freely around the designated area using the directed movement style.
2) When the caller shouts a word like archer, table, flower, winner, stork, earthworm, windmill, or queen, immediately freeze and pose like that statue.
3) Stay completely still until the next movement call is given.
pe-07687:
1) Divide the court into three equal zones: Underworld, Earth, and Olympus.
2) All players start on Earth.
3) If you hit another player, you move up one zone (Underworld to Earth, or Earth to Olympus); if hit, you move down one zone (Olympus to Earth, or Earth to Underworld).
4) Players hit in the Underworld must run a full lap around the court and restart on Earth.
pe-07688:
1) Divide into teams and set hoops around the court.
2) Players cannot run with the ball in hand and must pass to advance.
3) Throwing the ball into a hoop does not count; the ball must be placed down inside a hoop to score.
4) Once a point is scored, the opposing team takes possession and play continues immediately.
5) Defenders can block hoops by placing one foot inside them.
pe-07689:
1) Steal ribbons from the center hoop avoiding the guard.
2) Place ribbons in a hoop grid to get four in a row like Connect Four.
3) Roll a die and place tennis balls into the matching numbered hoop to fill all six first.
4) Collect matching cards or replicate a Lego structure as a relay team.
pe-07690:
1) Set up six benches in a straight line with varying distances.
2) Round 1: Cross over the benches freely to adapt to the equipment.
3) Round 2: Step on every bench with the left foot while crossing.
4) Round 3 and beyond: Regulate floor contacts between benches (e.g., exactly three or two steps).
pe-07691:
1) The team with the ball passes to move and target opposing players.
2) Players cannot run while holding the ball; teammates without the ball must position close to opponents.
3) Touching an opponent directly with the ball held in hand scores a point (throwing is not allowed).
4) If the ball is thrown, dropped to the floor, or intercepted, possession immediately switches to the other team.
pe-07692:
1) Both teams play without a goalkeeper
2) Use a volleyball and only roll it along the floor using the palm of the hand
3) Players must not enter the small black semi-circle around the mini goal
pe-07693:
1) The tagger holds a ball under an arm while others dribble, and whoever is tagged becomes the next tagger
2) Partners hold one hand while dribbling with the other and try to pull each other past
3) One dribbles two balls simultaneously or alternately while the partner runs 5 laps around the volleyball court
4) One juggles two balls in the center while the partner runs laps for conditioning
5) Stand between two balls on a line using a pivot foot and touch the balls before the partner touches you
6) A player holds two balls and unexpectedly drops one, and the partner tries to catch it before it hits the floor
7) The ball handler uses pivot steps to shield and protect the ball from the defender
pe-07694:
1) Open elbows outward and form a triangle cup shape above the forehead with thumbs and index fingers
2) Toss the ball upward, align the forehead under the ball, and contact it with the finger pads rather than the palm
3) Work in pairs or trios to receive and set the ball descending from above
4) Utilize a gym balcony or wall to practice setting the rebounding ball
pe-07695:
1) The player holding the ball cannot be tagged or touched
2) Players cannot run or walk while holding the ball
3) The ball can only be played in two ways: hitting from below or smashing from above
4) Teams aim to score by hitting the ball into the opponent's goal
pe-07696:
1) Two teams lie down facing each other on opposite sides of a large landing mat
2) On signal, both teams push against the mat simultaneously to slide it past a designated line
pe-07697:
1) Divide the class into two groups assigned to individual rope and long rope stations.
2) The individual rope group practices designated skills such as one-foot jumps, running steps, backward skipping, and side swings.
3) The long rope group practices running through the turning rope or timing jumps inside it.
pe-07698:
1) Divide the team so half are blindfolded and the other half are not allowed to speak.
2) The mute participants guide the blindfolded teammates across using only non-verbal communication.
3) The team travels the length of the gym using only two soft mats without touching the floor.
pe-07699:
1) Pair up into Black and White teams standing face to face in two lines.
2) The teacher calls out either Black or White.
3) The called team chases and tags their direct partner, who sprints straight back behind a designated boundary.
pe-07700:
1) Greet partners with an elbow tap while dribbling with the non-dominant hand.
2) Dribble with eyes closed, or transition between standing, sitting, prone, and supine without losing the bounce.
3) Dribble between the legs, dribble two balls simultaneously, and practice 1-on-1 ball-stealing defense.
pe-07701:
1) Stand in two facing lines, firmly gripping gymnastics poles horizontally with partners using both hands.
2) Place a gym bench at both the start and end of the lane to facilitate stepping up and down.
3) One student climbs onto the benches and crosses along the poles while leaning on peers' shoulders.
pe-07702:
1) Divide the class into two teams, placing Team 1 inside a bench-enclosed square and Team 2 outside.
2) On command, Team 1 throws as many balls out of the square as possible while Team 2 brings them back in.
3) Play for 2 minutes, count the balls, and then switch roles.
4) The team with fewer balls left inside the square after 2 minutes wins.
pe-07703:
1) Construct a spider web with nine openings using three horizontal bars and two ropes.
2) The team must pass exactly one student through each designated web opening to get everyone to the other side.
3) Each opening of the spider web can only be passed through once.
4) The mission is accomplished when all students have safely crossed over to the other side.
pe-07704:
1) Divide the class into 2 teams (Red/Black) or 4 teams according to card suits (Hearts, Spades, Diamonds, Clubs).
2) Players run in a relay format toward face-down cards on the floor and flip one card over.
3) If it matches their team's color or suit, they take it back; if not, they must place it face-down again, and the team that collects all cards first wins.
pe-07705:
1) Stack two thick mats in the center with two normal mats behind them to create a bridge zone extending the court.
2) Players can cross over the mats toward the opponent's area to throw, but touching the opponent's floor or being hit on the bridge causes elimination.
3) Hit players line up outside in order of elimination and can be revived in order when a teammate hits the basketball backboard with a ball.
pe-07706:
1) Place a vaulting box in the center as a net and place large landing mats on both sides.
2) Hit a gymnastics ball over the vaulting box so it lands on the opposite mat.
3) Cooperate to achieve the maximum number of error-free contacts without letting the ball get caught on the box (progress to direct returns without catching).
pe-07707:
1) Two teams of five players compete against each other using a 55 cm large ball.
2) Players cooperate through passing to knock down one of the two target cubes with the ball.
3) If defenders guard one target, the opposing team can easily move to attack the other target.
4) Players cannot touch the ball when it is in another player's hands, and no one may enter the forbidden zone around the cubes.
pe-07708:
1) When not pressured by defenders, lift your eyes from the ball to assess the field and find passing opportunities for teammates.
2) Use varied dribbling techniques to maintain possession when facing defensive pressure.
3) Use a one-handed grip for fast running and switch to a two-handed grip for shielding the ball, passing, or shooting in tight spaces.
pe-07709:
1) Students lie on the floor along the gym wall and raise their legs against the wall
2) Pass the gym ball to the next person using only feet without touching it with hands
3) Transport the ball as far as possible along the perimeter of the gym without dropping it
pe-07710:
1) Students form a circle in a designated posture such as lying prone or squatting
2) The first runner stands up and sprints a full lap around the outside of the circle
3) As the runner returns to the original spot, the next student immediately takes off to run around the circle
pe-07711:
1) The teacher tells a story of the sea and gives visual gestures to indicate the movement of waves.
2) Students sit and lean their bodies left and right to express waves according to the signals.
3) When a whirlpool signal is given, students make a spinning motion, and the tempo gradually speeds up.
pe-07712:
1) Three players kneel in a triangle formation to hold the ball up with hands beneath it.
2) A player shouts 'Omnikin' and the designated defending team color, then strikes the ball.
3) The ball must fly at least 3 meters and cannot be struck downward toward the floor.
4) The called team must catch the ball before it touches the ground, while defenders maintain a square shape 3 to 4 meters away.
pe-07713:
1) Two captains hold straps and pull the gym mat boat.
2) Teammates wait at the starting pier on the benches.
3) The captains pull a passenger on the mat across the floor to the designated marker line.
4) Once reached, players grab the mat, run back together, and transport the next passenger.
pe-07714:
1) The tagger (octopus) chases runners using tentacles made of foam noodles attached to a hoop.
2) Anyone touched by the tentacle or falling to the floor turns into a crab.
3) Crabs must move on all fours on the ground with their bellies facing upward.
4) When two crabs crawl toward each other and give a high-five, both are freed and rejoin the game.
pe-07715:
1) Students line up in groups behind cones on four sides facing the center.
2) When signaled, the groups pointed to by the teacher run straight across to the opposite side.
3) Groups blocked by the teacher's lowered arm gate must stop and wait for the next call.
4) When given the cross signal, all teams from all sides run across the center intersection simultaneously.
pe-07716:
1) Jump over a low scarf held by teammates.
2) Crawl under the next scarf.
3) Run through, turn around the starting point, tag the next runner, and the first team with all 3 seated wins.
pe-07717:
1) Pair up with one partner assuming a bridge or kneeling tunnel posture on the floor.
2) The active partner leaps over their partner to the other side.
3) Next, they crawl under the kneeling partner.
4) Finally, they run around the partner, then switch roles and count completions in 2 minutes.
pe-07718:
1) Line up in teams waiting for the start signal.
2) Crawl on all fours while rolling the ball towards the turning point.
3) Support weight with one hand while rolling the ball with the other hand.
4) Use crab walk positions holding the ball between thighs and chest to move around the cone.
5) Return to the start line and pass the ball to the next teammate.
pe-07719:
1) [Number Pass] Each player is assigned a number (1-10) and moves freely in the area.
2) Players call out numbers and pass sequentially (1 to 2, 2 to
3) or in reverse (10 down to 1).
3) [Pin Pass] Player 1 stands at the front spot with the ball, while teammates line up behind.
4) On signal, Player 1 passes to Player 2, who returns the pass and squats down immediately.
5) This continues to the last player, who then dribbles to Player 1's spot to rotate positions.
pe-07720:
1) Both teams start from their goal line and sprint to secure the ball placed at center court upon the whistle
2) Players can take up to 3 steps with the ball and must advance only by passing without dribbling
3) A team scores by safely placing the ball with hands onto the opponent end line while staying within bounds
4) Teams play 7-minute periods, switch ends, and restart from the foul spot if steps or boundary violations occur.
pe-07721:
1) When the teacher calls out a number, students run around and then gather the specified number of balls to build a snowman.
2) The game proceeds with varying conditions, such as gathering by the same vest color or collecting 8 balls.
pe-07722:
1) Move in one direction around a circle
2) Throw your scarf up into the air on the whistle
3) Move to your classmate's spot and catch their falling scarf
4) Switch directions or expand the circle to vary difficulty
pe-07723:
1) Teams sit in rows on chairs facing each other.
2) On start, the first player grasps the balloon with both feet and passes it to the next player.
3) If dropped, restart from the student who dropped it, and the first team to reach the last player wins.
pe-07724:
1) Place scrap paper on the floor and balance without stepping off while folding it in half each round
2) One partner drops the paper from above and the sitting partner catches it with two hands
3) Tear stacked sheets of paper all at once
4) Crumple scrap paper into a ball and tap it with hands as many times as possible to compete with a partner
pe-07725:
1) Receive a paper slip with an animal, instrument, or occupation from the teacher and wait
2) In round 1, mimic the target using words and motions to find the matching partner
3) Go to the teacher to check the answer together and hold hands to form a circle once approved
4) Play round 2 using only sounds and round 3 using only silent actions
pe-07726:
1) Lie down and use feet or hands to transfer sock balls into a basket above the head.
2) Balance a sock on the head in attention stance while lifting one leg forward, backward, in a T-shape, or sideways for 15 seconds.
3) Sit on the floor and perform bicycle kicks while passing a sock between legs for 30 seconds.
4) Hold a sock between both feet, raise arms and legs into a V-sit, and hold for 15 seconds.
pe-07727:
1) Divide the classroom into four sections and post paper signs with location names.
2) Choose one seeker who turns away and sings a designated song.
3) While the song plays, other students move around and choose one of the four areas.
4) When the song ends, the seeker calls out one location, and students there sit down; last survivors win.
pe-07728:
1) Divide into two teams and assign numbers to each player.
2) In numerical order, each player rolls two dice: place the first body part on the starting point (wall or previous teammate) and extend the second body part as far as possible as the end point.
3) The next teammate rolls the dice twice to connect their starting body part to the previous teammate's end point.
4) The team that stretches the farthest from the wall to the final player's body part wins.
pe-07729:
1) Each student receives one paper with a word written on it.
2) Students mingle and combine their words to form action sentences.
3) They succeed by physically performing the action described in the formed sentence together.
4) Upon successful action, they turn in their papers, take new ones, and repeat the process.
5) The whole class checks how many sentences they can complete within a 1-minute time limit.
pe-07730:
1) Start from the line and move forward while passing the ball against the wall 5 times using hands or feet.
2) After completing the passes and reaching the end, dribble the ball back to the starting line.
3) Compete to see whether using hands or feet completes the course faster.
pe-07731:
1) Attackers outside the lines throw a jaegi to hit defenders inside the court.
2) Defenders avoid or catch the jaegi; if a defender catches a thrown jaegi cleanly, they shout 'Stop', allowing them to take up to three steps toward an attacker to throw and hit them.
3) If an attacker cleanly catches a jaegi thrown outside by a defender, that defender is out.
pe-07732:
1) Hit the ball over the net into the opponent's court using only below the ankles or the head.
2) The ball may bounce once before being hit, and a single player cannot hit the ball twice consecutively.
3) Score points when the opponent fails to return the ball; beginners can practice Catch Jokgu by catching the bounced ball with hands before kicking.
pe-07733:
1) Place the dodgeball on your palm without pinching it.
2) Wrap your wrist around the ball to throw it.
3) If your hands are small, use your wrist to throw it sideways.
pe-07734:
1) Tee up the ball and hit it over the volleyball net to clear Stage 1.
2) Cross the hazard area, pass the red spot marker (Stage 2), and proceed toward the green marker (Stage 3).
3) Hole out at the final goal cup using the fewest strokes possible.
pe-07735:
1) Move through five cones using side steps to strengthen lower body muscles.
2) Jump in place upon hearing a ball bounce and quickly move toward the ball.
3) Practice bumping a tossed ball back to your partner using an underhand receive stance.
pe-07736:
1) Place goals at each end and mark designated defense zones using cones or lines.
2) Divide players into attackers, defenders, and a goalkeeper; defenders cannot leave their designated zone.
3) Attackers move in the center zone and may cross through the defensive zone to score, but cannot remain inside it.
pe-07737:
1) Face each other across the volleyball net.
2) Hit the ball over the net to the opponent without letting it touch the floor.
3) You concede a point if the ball does not clear the net or hits the floor.
pe-07738:
1) With only home and first base, the batter hits the ball and runs to first base and back to home.
2) The fielder catches the ball without a glove and puts it into the mini soccer goal.
3) The batter scores points by running back and forth before the ball enters the goal, and the player with more points after 5 minutes wins.
pe-07739:
1) Two players prepare a basketball and a hoop.
2) If the shot goes in, the shooter retrieves the ball; if missed, the other player shoots from where the ball rebounds.
3) Players switch positions around the court to practice shooting from various spots.
4) If the ball goes out of bounds, restart from the designated starting area.
pe-07740:
1) Two players hold the ball close to the chest to minimize contact area.
2) The striker steps forward with the opposite foot and pushes the center of the ball with both hands.
3) The holders release their grip smoothly at the moment of the push.
pe-07741:
1) Four players stand in a line and track the falling ball.
2) The player nearest to the ball establishes position while teammates quickly adjust.
3) Bend knees and coordinate to safely catch the ball before it touches the floor.
pe-07742:
1) Move holding the Kin-Ball in a relay format.
2) Prepare for a hit after moving and hit the Kin-Ball according to the signal or order.
3) Send the ball toward other groups or peers and cooperate to continue the play under considerate rules.
pe-07743:
1) Draw ladder grids (e.g., 7, 9, 11, or 13 spaces) on the floor and place a water bottle in the center space.
2) Players from each team take turns flipping their own water bottle up to 3 times before rotating to the next teammate.
3) Successfully landing the bottle upright moves the center bottle one space toward the player's side.
4) The team that moves the center bottle past the final line on their side wins.
pe-07744:
1) The tagger stands in the center and tosses a sheet of tissue upward.
2) The tagger calls out the name of another participant.
3) The called participant quickly runs in and catches the tissue with the designated body part (hands, head, etc.) before it touches the ground.
pe-07745:
1) Attach numbered notes to the wall or floor.
2) Touch the numbers in order starting from 1 within a 15-second time limit.
3) Challenge yourself to see how many numbers you can reach in time.
pe-07746:
1) Players stay on the mat to avoid being pulled into the sea.
2) The Umibozu tries to pull the players by their legs off the mat.
3) Players dragged off the mat are eliminated or switch roles.
pe-07747:
1) Run away from the tagger, and make a chestnut shape over your head while shouting 'Kuri!' if about to be tagged.
2) Once frozen as a chestnut, you cannot move.
3) Another player must tap you to split the chestnut and free you.
pe-07748:
1) Designate one tagger while the remaining players stand on individual mats holding balls.
2) Players on the mats pass the balls among themselves to prevent the tagger from stepping onto an open mat without a ball.
3) As an advanced variation, players may step off their mats and move around while continuing to circulate passes.
pe-07749:
1) Each player stands inside a hula hoop while one player is designated as the tagger.
2) Players move to an empty hoop without getting tagged by the tagger.
3) A tagged player becomes the next tagger, and the player with the most successful moves within the time limit wins.
pe-07750:
1) Set a start and finish line, and have teammates lie face down in a straight line with spacing.
2) The last player crawls on all fours over or around the teammates to reach the front.
3) Alternate by crawling under teammates on hands and knees or jumping over them toward the finish line.
pe-07751:
1) Lie on your back and dodge or catch two newspaper balls dropped from above to train dynamic vision.
2) Set up multiple plastic bags and throw newspaper balls to knock them down.
pe-07752:
1) Each player places a ball on the ground inside the designated area.
2) Using only feet, players protect their own ball while trying to kick opponents' balls out of bounds.
3) The last player remaining with their ball inside the area wins.
pe-07753:
1) Swing forward vigorously while holding the horizontal bar.
2) Bend your knees and bring your legs close to your chest in one swift motion.
3) Look downward and push down on the bar with your hands to raise your upper body above the bar.
pe-07754:
1) Choose a horizontal bar around chest height.
2) Kick off the ground to jump up.
3) Push heels to the far side of the bar and use heel weight to pull the body up onto the bar.
pe-07755:
1) Practice basic two-foot jumps to learn the timing of turning the rope and jumping.
2) Hop on one foot in place without a rope while counting numbers to build balance.
3) Combine the movements by turning the rope and hopping over it on one foot.
pe-07756:
1) Support your body with both hands on the floor and hold for about 10 seconds.
2) Drop to your knees in a seal-like position, lower your belly to the floor, and push up by bending and straightening your arms.
3) Lift your knees, lower your whole body until your belly touches the floor, and push back up.
4) Once strength is built, perform standard push-ups by lowering yourself just above the floor before pushing up.
pe-07757:
1) Set up one cone as the goal and start a 2-on-2 match.
2) Play man-to-man defense without a goalkeeper.
3) Pass the ball with teammates to hit the cone and score.
pe-07758:
1) Lean your upper body slightly backward as the airborne ball approaches.
2) Cushion the ball with the upper chest, not the stomach.
3) Control the dropped ball so it stays close to your feet and make a pass.
pe-07759:
1) Leave the coop, pick up an egg (ball), and pass through three gates without being tagged by the fox.
2) Stand on the bench and pass the ball to the rooster using one hand (or two hands for younger kids).
3) If tagged by the fox, perform three two-footed jumps in place to get freed.
pe-07760:
1) Players position themselves inside a very restricted area marked by cones.
2) Pass the ball back and forth quickly with teammates while keeping it inside the marked zone.
3) Use all surfaces of the foot to maintain ball control and pass at a fast pace.
pe-07761:
1) Move freely within the designated space using boxing dynamic steps without running.
2) Maintain intermediate guard (cheeks), high guard (temples), or low guard (below shoulders) as instructed.
3) Quickly move to the designated color using boxing steps when the coach calls out a color.
pe-07762:
1) Divide into two teams, with the first runner of each team dribbling a soccer ball from their starting point.
2) Navigate around the cones using only feet, then exchange passes with a partner while moving along the lane.
3) Once all team members complete the drill, they hold hands, move using chassé steps, and retrieve their team sash.
pe-07763:
1) Wait behind the starting line for the signal.
2) On signal, run across the field to the opposite line as fast as possible without colliding.
3) In the next progression, touch the designated object (cone) and jump over the marked puddle with both feet before returning home quickly.
pe-07764:
1) The offensive player accelerates forward, calls for the ball, and catches a pass.
2) Upon a quick jump stop, the attacker drives either right or left toward the hoop.
3) The defender must not enter the restricted semi-circle marked with blue cones.
4) The attacker maneuvers past the defender and finishes with a running layup.
pe-07765:
1) Choose two players as wolves while the other runners spread across the field.
2) When tagged the first time by a wolf, the player loses one leg and must hop on one foot.
3) If tagged a second time while hopping, the player must freeze in place with legs spread wide.
4) Other active runners can unfreeze a teammate by crawling through their spread legs.
pe-07766:
1) All players start within a defined boundary wearing two flags on their belts.
2) Players try to pull one opponent's flag at a time without touching clothing or making physical body contact.
3) Players who lose all their flags must leave the area, and the last survivor or the player with the most flags wins.
pe-07767:
1) Divide into two teams (Monster and Dragon), tuck a scarf into the back of your pants, and kneel on the ground.
2) When the teacher calls a team name, players from that team carry the ball toward the opponent's area to score a try.
3) The opposing players try to grab the runner's scarf to prevent them from scoring.
pe-07768:
1) In pairs, move forward together passing the ball back and forth without dropping it on the ground.
2) Stop when reaching the designated first marker cone.
3) Aim and throw the ball into the zoned goal delimited by cones to score points (1, 2, or 3 points).
pe-07769:
1) Set up a running course with cones and run aiming for the target time announced by the teacher (e.g., 30s, 25s, 23s, 21s).
2) Check the stopwatch time after running to see if the group met the rule of running faster in subsequent rounds.
3) Run continuously and sit down on the floor at the exact moment you estimate the target time (e.g., 60 seconds) has elapsed; the closest student earns points.
pe-07770:
1) Draw a center circle on the court where all student groups gather, and give each group one basketball.
2) The first runner dribbles to their assigned peripheral hoop and attempts a layup shot.
3) The player retrieves the rebound, returns to their center group, and passes the ball to the next teammate.
4) Once everyone in the group finishes, all groups rotate clockwise to challenge the next basket.
pe-07771:
1) Set up colored cone bases around the court and assign students into themed teams.
2) When the teacher calls out a specific team, all members of that team become taggers and chase the other players.
3) Tagged players must go to that tagger team's designated base and complete an exercise task such as jogging or skipping.
4) Once the exercise task is completed, players return to the court, and the teacher switches the chasing team periodically.
pe-07772:
1) Distribute mats across the corners and center of the gymnasium to serve as islands, and choose 2 taggers.
2) All other students start standing on the mats, with no limit on how many students can stand on each mat.
3) When taggers in the center shout "Find a new land!", all players must run across the open space to any different mat.
4) Anyone tagged before reaching a mat becomes an additional tagger in the center until everyone is caught.
pe-07773:
1) Select two taggers and scatter all other participants freely across the play area.
2) Players tagged by a chaser must lie on their backs with arms and legs raised like a dead ant.
3) When four teammates come together and lift the tagged player upright, that player is revived and rejoins the game.
pe-07774:
1) Place foam balls around the court and designate two participants as personal trainers wearing vests.
2) The trainers retrieve balls and throw them to hit other players moving around the court.
3) Hit players must step out of the play area and complete assigned exercises like 10 push-ups or 10 squats.
4) Once their fitness reps are completed, players can re-enter the game immediately.
pe-07775:
1) Divide the class into multiple teams (e.g., yellow, blue, green, purple) each wearing team vests.
2) Distribute one foam ball to every individual participant.
3) Players move to tag opponents from different teams using the held ball without throwing it.
4) Tagged players sit frozen on the floor until a same-team member touches them with a ball to revive them.
pe-07776:
1) Disperse students across the field (or half field divided by cones) and select a tagger.
2) The tagger chases and tags other students.
3) Tagged students must run to the opposite wall, touch it, and perform an assigned exercise (e.g., 5 push-ups, squats).
4) Once the exercise is completed, they can return to the game and keep playing.
pe-07777:
1) Students become robots with a beanbag placed on their head acting as a battery.
2) Two designated students become robot mechanics who repair fallen robots.
3) As robots move around the yard, any robot whose battery falls must freeze in place.
4) A robot mechanic runs over, picks up the fallen beanbag, and places it back on the head to reactivate the robot.
pe-07778:
1) Set up four mats (or cones) as bases, then divide the class into a batting team and a fielding team.
2) The pitcher throws the ball, the batter hits it with a baseball bat, and runs around the bases.
3) If the runner completes the circuit through all bases, the batting team scores 1 point.
4) The fielding team attempts to complete 5 consecutive passes to get the runner out; if they fail before the runner reaches home, a point is scored.
pe-07779:
1) Distribute cones across the entire area and divide the class into two teams.
2) On start, one team turns cones upside down while the other team stands them upright.
3) Move around during the game to continuously flip or reset the cones.
pe-07780:
1) Students run freely across the whole area.
2) When the teacher calls out a number, students immediately form groups of that size.
3) Once groups of the desired size are formed, transition directly into the next activity.
pe-07781:
1) Place goals with goalkeepers on each side, divide students into two teams, and distribute foam balls.
2) Throw balls to hit opponents; players hit by the ball must go outside the court.
3) Out players can only return to the game when their own team scores a goal in the opponent's goal.
pe-07782:
1) Two teams stand facing each other on opposite sides of the field, and one team holds the frisbee.
2) Throw the frisbee towards the other side, where receiving team members tap it in the air before catching it.
3) Earn points equal to the number of airborne touches, but get zero points if caught directly without touches or dropped.
pe-07783:
1) Divide the class into two teams and have each team build a castle using hoops before starting.
2) Distribute foam balls to both teams and have them throw balls at the opposing team's hoop castle.
3) Score 1 point by knocking down the castle, and opponents cannot throw at it while it is being rebuilt.
pe-07784:
1) Set up a volleyball net and divide the class into two teams on opposite courts.
2) Distribute foam balls and beanbags (rice bags) evenly to each side.
3) Throw foam balls over the net and slide beanbags under the net one by one.
4) When the teacher stops the music, the team with the fewest items on their court wins.
pe-07785:
1) Set 16 cones in four corners as landing zones and place taggers with foam noodles in the center.
2) Remaining students wait inside their respective colored landing zones.
3) When the teacher calls a command (e.g., green flies to orange), students run to that target zone.
4) Anyone tagged by a foam noodle must return to their starting landing zone.
pe-07786:
1) Divide into two teams behind end lines and assign each player a number (e.g., 1 to 7).
2) Place multiple beach balls in the center of the court.
3) When the teacher calls numbers, called players crawl out crab-style on hands and feet.
4) Crabs hit the beach balls into the opponent's end zone while defending lobsters try to block them.
pe-07787:
1) Students form a circle holding the edge of the parachute with both hands.
2) Slowly walk and spin in one direction, then change direction and spin.
3) Release the parachute, step back 5 to 10 paces, and perform the teacher's exercise challenge (e.g., 10 jumping jacks).
4) Grab the parachute again, spin faster, and complete the next high-intensity challenge (e.g., 5 tuck jumps).
pe-07788:
1) Divide the class into two equal teams on opposite sides of a volleyball net.
2) Distribute volleyballs to the players, who serve the balls simultaneously aiming to land as many balls as possible inside the opposing court boundaries.
3) The team with the highest number of balls landing inside the opponent's court wins, practicing both underhand and overhead serves.
pe-07789:
1) Place one mat (swamp) in each team's zone, divide the class into two teams, and supply soft foam dodgeballs.
2) Throw balls at opponents; any player hit directly without a bounce must go to the mat located in the opposing team's court.
3) Trapped players on the mat are rescued if they catch a pass thrown by a teammate directly out of the air, winning when all opponents are trapped.
pe-07790:
1) Arrange 16 beanbags in 4 distinct colors neatly on the floor and conceal each beanbag completely under a frisbee or bowl.
2) Divide players into 4 color teams, having the first runner of each team dash out to flip open one frisbee.
3) If the beanbag matches their team's color, they take it back to their base; if not, they recover it and tag the next runner.
pe-07791:
1) Place a bucket in the center of a circle surrounded by bouncers, while rollers are spread across the field.
2) Rollers pick up scattered tennis balls and roll them across the ground from stationary positions to bouncers.
3) Bouncers catch the rolled balls, bounce them once on the floor, and sink them into the bucket.
4) Once all tennis balls are placed in the bucket, switch roles between rollers and bouncers.
pe-07792:
1) Form a square with cones, place a hoop in the center, and put rugby balls inside the hoop.
2) Divide into two teams, with each team lining up behind opposite cones of the square.
3) The front runner runs to the center hoop to grab a rugby ball, while the next runner in line runs forward to their front cone to receive a pass.
4) The passer moves to the back of the line, while the receiver carries the ball to the center hoop, deposits it, and joins the line, continuing until everyone completes the cycle.
pe-07793:
1) Place hoops in each corner of the play area as safe zones and one hoop in the center as the skunk den.
2) Place designated skunks (taggers) inside the center den while other students scatter across the field.
3) Skunks leave their den to chase and tag other players; any player tagged becomes the new skunk.
4) The new skunk must run to the central den and shout out 'New skunk!' before coming out to chase others.
5) Running players can take refuge in the corner safe-zone hoops for a maximum of 10 seconds, but must leave if another player enters the hoop.
pe-07794:
1) Pairs face each other with a bowling pin placed in the center between several marked lines.
2) Players take turns rolling a foam ball along the floor attempting to knock down the bowling pin.
3) The player who successfully knocks down the pin moves it one line closer to their side until reaching the final line.
pe-07795:
1) White-vest players run and pass foam balls by hand while avoiding the bandits.
2) Purple-vest bandits attempt to intercept passes or steal balls and throw them out of bounds.
3) The game continues until all balls on the court are eliminated by the bandits.
pe-07796:
1) In pairs, one student takes a jump rope and the other lines up in front of an array of hoops.
2) For one minute, the rope jumper counts rope jumps while the partner counts jumps made with both feet together through the hoops.
3) After one minute, players compare total jump counts to see who achieved more jumps.
pe-07797:
1) Scatter all students across the play area and designate one tagger.
2) When tagged by the chaser, a player must crouch down into a frog position.
3) To be rescued, another player must jump or leap over the crouching frog so they can rejoin the game.
pe-07798:
1) Set up throwing cones and target hoop cones at various distances across the field as golf holes.
2) Form student groups at the starting cones and distribute one frisbee to each group.
3) Players take turns throwing the frisbee into the target hole in the fewest throws possible.
4) If a throw misses, the player throws again until it goes in, then retrieves the disc and passes it to the next player.
pe-07799:
1) Place a bench at each end of the court and divide the class into two teams.
2) One player from each team begins by standing on the bench in the opposing team's area.
3) Players pass the ball across to their teammate standing on the opposite bench.
4) When the bench player catches the pass, the thrower joins them on the bench.
5) The first team to have five players standing on their bench wins the game.
pe-07800:
1) Students move freely across the area by running, walking backwards, skipping, or hopping.
2) The teacher calls out a letter of the alphabet (e.g., "L").
3) Students quickly partner up and form the shape of the letter together, either standing up or lying on the floor.
pe-07801:
1) Mark four team zones at the court sides; each team defends its zone with 3 frisbees in play.
2) Pass the frisbee to a teammate inside an opposing team's zone to score 1 point.
3) Players cannot run with the frisbee or strip it from an opponent's hands.
pe-07802:
1) Players and sandbags are scattered across the play area.
2) Players pick up a sandbag and slide it along the floor to hit others' feet.
3) Hit players must sit down where they were tagged, but can pick up nearby bags to slide and hit others.
pe-07803:
1) Place large fitness balls along the center line and divide players into two teams on opposite sides.
2) On signal, throw balls to hit the fitness balls and roll them across the opponent's goal line.
3) Pushing a fitness ball across the opponent's line scores 1 point; the first team to reach 10 points wins.
pe-07804:
1) Set up starting and turning cones, dividing the class into teams lined up behind each start cone.
2) When the teacher calls out an animal, the first runner mimics its movements to the cone and back.
3) High-five the next teammate in line, who then imitates the same animal until all finish.
pe-07805:
1) Divide the court in half, place mats at both ends, and divide players into two teams with bibs.
2) Invade the opponent's area to reach their mat; if tagged along the way, freeze on the spot.
3) Frozen players are freed when a teammate takes their hand back to their side; shouting 'Yoshi' triggers an all-out rush.
pe-07806:
1) Position players along the court lines and permit movement only along these lines.
2) Assign hunters wearing red bibs and liberators wearing green bibs.
3) When a hunter tags a player, that player must sit down on the floor at that spot.
4) A liberator can tag the seated player to free them to resume running along the lines.
pe-07807:
1) Place mats and benches across the playing area as barricades and split the class into two teams.
2) Distribute foam balls to both teams, having players throw and hit opponents.
3) Hit players must leave the court and go outside.
4) If the opponent who hit a player is subsequently hit and eliminated, the sidelined player may return to the court.
pe-07808:
1) Disperse students across the area, assigning half as bridges and half as rivers.
2) While music plays, all students move freely around the space.
3) When the music stops and bridges is called, bridges form an arch with hands and feet on the ground and hips raised while rivers crawl under as many bridges as possible.
4) When the music stops and rivers is called, rivers lie down flat on the ground while bridges jump over as many rivers as possible.
pe-07809:
1) Bad robots (taggers) hold foam balls without throwing them and try to tag good robots.
2) Good robots can seek refuge in a center safe area of three hoops for up to 10 seconds while counting aloud.
3) Tagged robots must go to the cone-marked repair shop and count out loud to 30 before re-entering the game.
pe-07810:
1) Place one mat in the center as the pirate ship (prison) and mats in each corner as the sailors' ships.
2) Tagged players acting as pirates carry pool noodles to chase sailors scattered across the playing area.
3) When tagged by a pirate, the sailor must go directly to the central pirate ship prison.
4) Free sailors can rescue captured teammates from the central prison and lead them to a corner ship.
5) Players inside a corner ship cannot be tagged, but they may only stay inside for a maximum of 3 seconds.
pe-07811:
1) Place 1 hula hoop on the ground and 2 cones separated to form a triangle between the hoop and cones.
2) The kicker stands next to the hoop, while the remaining 3 fielders position themselves in the play area.
3) The kicker kicks all 3 balls consecutively into the field, then immediately runs laps around the triangle (each completed lap scores 1 point).
4) The fielders retrieve the 3 balls and place them inside the hula hoop.
5) As soon as all 3 balls are placed inside the hoop, the kicker must stop running, and the completed laps are counted as points.
pe-07812:
1) Designate one tagger and scatter all other students across the area.
2) The tagger calls out a letter of the alphabet and tries to tag others.
3) A tagged student must sit down and can only rejoin the game after saying a word that starts with that designated letter.
pe-07813:
1) Divide into two teams with goals placed at each end of the field and position teams on their respective sides.
2) All players assume a crab posture with hands and feet on the ground facing upwards.
3) Starting with a beach ball placed in the center, players move in the crab position and use hands, feet, or any body part to score into the opponent's goal.
pe-07814:
1) Distribute stilts to all students and scatter them across the gymnasium.
2) Designate 2 taggers wearing team bibs to distinguish them.
3) When a tagger tags a student, the tagged student must spin around three times in place before continuing to flee.
pe-07815:
1) The teacher scatters chips across the entire gymnasium floor.
2) Divide students into groups or set it up as an individual activity.
3) For a limited time (e.g., 3 to 5 minutes), students collect as many chips as possible, and the group with the most chips wins.
pe-07816:
1) All students scatter freely across the playground.
2) Designate two students, giving a blue foam ball to one and a red foam ball to the other.
3) When the student with the blue ball tags someone, that tagged student freezes completely and cannot move.
4) The student with the red ball must run to frozen classmates and melt them so they can move again.
pe-07817:
1) Set up mats on their sides in a square shape to leave an opening in the center as a goal.
2) Divide the class into two teams (green and white), providing one beach ball to each team.
3) Following football rules, players kick the beach ball using only their feet or body parts, excluding hands.
4) Score 1 point by kicking the beach ball into the open space inside the opposing team's mat square.
pe-07818:
1) Face the wall of the gym or playground.
2) Before starting, each student is assigned a number that designates the hitting order.
3) The first player hits a tennis ball against the wall using the palm of their hand.
4) The next player hits the rebound either in the air or after a single bounce using the palm of their hand.
5) If a player misses the ball or lets it bounce more than once, they receive a point; the player with the fewest points wins.
pe-07819:
1) Select one student as the queen bee and pair up all other students.
2) The queen bee gives instructions such as back to back or face to face, and pairs form the pose.
3) When the queen bee calls out change, all students must find a new partner.
4) The student left without a partner becomes the next queen bee.
pe-07820:
1) Distribute scarves or vests to all students to wear as tails before starting.
2) Protect your own tail while trying to steal as many tails as possible from other players.
3) Players who lose their tail are not eliminated and can continue stealing tails from others.
4) The round ends when all tails are stolen, and the player with the most tails wins.
pe-07821:
1) Set up a net on a volleyball court, divide the class into two teams, and place a hoop at the back of each side.
2) Distribute foam balls to both teams and throw them into the opposing team's court.
3) If a player catches an incoming ball before it hits the floor, they place it into their back hoop.
4) The team that collects more foam balls inside their hoop at the end wins.
pe-07822:
1) Spread all students across the playground and place foam balls around the floor.
2) The teacher acting as the tagger picks up balls and throws them aiming below students' knees.
3) Students hit below the knees must perform designated exercises such as 10 sit-ups, push-ups, or squats.
4) After completing the exercise, students re-enter the game, which continues until the teacher gets tired.
pe-07823:
1) Students stand along a floor line representing a log, and each is assigned a number.
2) When the teacher calls two numbers, those two students exchange spots without stepping off the line.
3) The game can also be played in two teams cooperating or competing to see who swaps positions faster.
pe-07824:
1) Everyone is a tagger, trying to tag others while avoiding being tagged.
2) Tagged players must sit down on the floor immediately.
3) If the person who tagged you gets tagged by someone else, you stand up and rejoin the game.
pe-07825:
1) Set up mats vertically in the center, surround them with color spots, and place foam balls on each spot.
2) Position one player in the center mat zone while other students scatter around the outside.
3) Outer students grab foam balls and throw them into the mat area while the center player clears them out.
pe-07826:
1) Place color spot markers (or hoops) across the area and divide the class into 4 teams.
2) The teacher calls out a specific color sequence pattern.
3) Students sprint to touch the spots following the designated color sequence and return to their teams.
pe-07827:
1) Selected students become astronauts and tie a balloon (oxygen tank) to their ankle with a cord.
2) The remaining students become Martians and try to step on and pop the astronauts' balloons.
3) Astronauts whose balloons are popped become Martians; the game ends when all astronauts are converted.
pe-07828:
1) Teams line up behind the starting cones.
2) Give one rice bean bag to each group.
3) Carry the bag to the turning cone and back by holding it in hand, on the shoulder, head, or tossing and catching it.
4) Pass it to the next runner, and the first group where everyone sits down wins.
pe-07829:
1) Distribute colored spots across the court and place math problem papers (addition/subtraction) underneath.
2) Place students on each spot and keep some students outside the spots.
3) The teacher announces an exercise (e.g., jumping jacks) and calls out two colors.
4) Students on those colors and outside students switch to claim spots.
5) Students on spots check the math problem and perform the announced exercise according to the result.
pe-07830:
1) Set cones for each group, distribute scooter boards, and divide the class into five teams.
2) The first student sits on the scooter board, moves to the opposite cone, and returns.
3) Pass the scooter board to the next teammate to continue the relay.
4) The first group where all members finish and sit down wins.
pe-07831:
1) Distribute students across the area and assign an animal for each to imitate.
2) Blindfold each student with a handkerchief or have them close their eyes.
3) Students make their assigned animal sounds to find the partner making the identical sound.
4) Once partners find each other, they stand still until everyone else finds theirs.
pe-07832:
1) Position all students along the court perimeter or around the center circle.
2) One student stands in the center to lead the warm-up routine.
3) The center student performs any movement such as stretches, dances, jumps, or push-ups for 20 seconds.
4) All other students copy the exact movement for 20 seconds, after which a new student takes the center.
pe-07833:
1) Divide students into groups and line them up in a single file.
2) Hand one ball to the student at the front of each line.
3) The leader runs in a designated direction while teammates follow maintaining the line.
4) As they run, the ball is passed backwards from player to player down the line.
5) When the last student receives the ball, they sprint to the front to lead the line and repeat the sequence.
pe-07834:
1) Two teams sit down on opposite sides of the volleyball court.
