2) One player from each team stands in the opposite court serving area.
3) The standing servers hit volleyball serves toward their seated teammates.
4) When a serve reaches a seated teammate, that student stands up and joins the serving area.
5) The serving team continues serving until a fault occurs, and the team with all members standing wins.
pe-07835:
1) Draw two lines across the gym for hunters and place the rest of the class at one end of the gym.
2) Hunters can only move side-to-side along their line and give the signal by shouting "The bears are coming!"
3) Upon the signal, students must run to the other side of the gym, and anyone tagged joins the hunters along the line.
pe-07836:
1) Set up nets on each court, assign 4 students per court, and distribute 1 racket per student and 2 shuttlecocks per court.
2) Students practice a specific badminton skill instructed by the teacher for 1 minute.
3) When the teacher signals to stop, all students rotate to the next court clockwise and practice the next activity for 1 minute.
pe-07837:
1) Scatter paper alphabet letters on the ground or draw them across the schoolyard.
2) On the starting signal, all students run out simultaneously from one side of the area.
3) Students run around to find the individual letters that spell out their own name in order.
pe-07838:
1) Place mats on one side of the gym and have each team sit or lie on a mat.
2) Move forward by pulling the mat across to the other side without letting any body part touch the floor.
3) The first team to reach the opposite side of the gym wins.
pe-07839:
1) Students form a circle, and the largest object (e.g., basketball) is placed in the center.
2) Students attempt to reach and touch the central object without touching one another.
3) If successful without physical contact, switch to smaller objects sequentially (tennis ball, coin, etc.).
4) If any students touch each other while attempting to reach the object, they must restart from the beginning.
pe-07840:
1) Scatter paper sheets with alphabet letters randomly across the playing area.
2) At the starting signal, the first runner of each team runs, picks up one letter, and brings it back to their team base.
3) The next runners take turns repeating this process until no letters remain in the playing area.
4) Once all letters are collected, teams have 5 minutes to form as many words as possible, earning 1 point for each formed word.
pe-07841:
1) Mark a rectangle with four cones; one red attacker throws the ball and enters the rectangle to dodge the blue team's throws.
2) The blue team retrieves the ball and tries to hit the red runner inside the rectangle.
3) Meanwhile, a red teammate outside runs around the perimeter cones; each cone base crossed earns 1 point for the red team.
4) When the inside runner is hit by the ball, running stops, two other players take over, and roles switch after predetermined rounds.
pe-07842:
1) Divide the court with elastic bands at hip height and form teams of 2 to 4 players.
2) Serve from the baseline after a bounce, and no handball is allowed.
3) The ball may bounce once after each body contact, and touches per team can be adjusted.
4) Handball, out of bounds, two consecutive bounces, or touching the elastic band results in a fault, and the scoring team serves next.
pe-07843:
1) Divide the players into a throwing team and a running team.
2) A thrower launches the howler into the field and runs around their teammates to score points.
3) The running team retrieves the howler, passes it between their legs, and then back over their heads.
4) Once passed through, a runner carries the howler back to the throwing team to stop scoring, and teams switch roles after everyone throws.
pe-07844:
1) Both teams receive identical materials, have 5 minutes to build an anthill, and assign a queen marked with ribbons.
2) Players throw balls without crossing the centerline; hit players stand in hoops and can only be freed by their queen.
3) Players collect food (tennis balls) from the centerline one at a time and bring them to their anthill.
4) A team wins if all opponent hoops are filled, the opponent queen is eliminated, or all food is cleared and they have collected more food.
pe-07845:
1) Place safety mats beneath the parallel bars.
2) Students navigate through the parallel bars following the shape of a lying figure-8.
3) Students can choose to begin maneuvering from above or below the bars.
pe-07846:
1) Warm up wrists and shoulders, followed by throwing imitation drills.
2) Practice throwing the vortex from a kneeling position with the opposite leg forward.
3) Practice throwing while transitioning from kneeling to standing up.
4) Take a single forward step with the opposite leg before initiating the throw.
5) Perform a full approach run using side steps or cross steps before releasing the vortex.
pe-07847:
1) Mark end zones at both ends with 4 cones and divide teams using sashes or pennies.
2) Players cannot run while holding the ball and can advance only via passes.
3) Catching the ball inside the opponent's end zone scores one point.
4) If a pass is incomplete, the defending team gains possession.
5) Physical contact between players is strictly prohibited.
pe-07848:
1) Warm up by holding the left foot with the right hand and swimming a full length.
2) Practice head-first sculling without kicking legs or lifting arms out of the water.
3) Practice feet-first sculling in the opposite direction.
4) Practice eggbeater water-treading, keeping both hands fully out of the water without sinking.
pe-07849:
1) Students line up facing each other to form a lane.
2) Students pass balls back and forth according to the teacher's instructions.
3) Pair students with similar skill levels to effectively differentiate the exercise difficulty.
pe-07850:
1) Place a large mat for the sea monster in the center and mats in four corners for each animal group (sharks, dolphins, whales, rays).
2) Students jog loosely around the mats until the teacher calls out a specific animal name.
3) When an animal is called, the sea monster chases them before they reach their safe mat, and tagged students turn into sea monsters.
pe-07851:
1) Two partners face each other in a push-up position and play rock-paper-scissors.
2) Maintain the push-up position while greeting each other with a creative, prolonged handshake.
3) Practice finger tapping/dodging and single-leg release holds while maintaining firm body tension.
pe-07852:
1) Set up an elastic line at a height of 140 to 160 cm on volleyball posts and define the court with cones.
2) The ball must bounce once after each contact with the body, preferably using the arm or fist.
3) Pass the ball with fists over to the opponent court, losing points if the ball bounces twice or goes under the elastic line.
pe-07853:
1) Place a tape measure alongside two long landing mats.
2) Students jump forward from a standing position as far as possible and land on both feet.
3) Align a gymnastics bar with the tape measure to measure the exact jumping distance.
pe-07854:
1) Place landing mats around the vaulting box.
2) Group members hold and balance each other so that at least five students can board the vaulting box.
3) With teammates assisting, all participants maintain balance atop the box without falling off.
pe-07855:
1) Line up at the end line (start cone) of the court.
2) On the signal, sprint forward to touch the attack line and return to the start cone.
3) Continue shuttling back and forth successively to the center line and opposite attack lines.
pe-07856:
1) Each student places a gym club or cone on the gym floor to mark their post.
2) Players kick the ball to knock down opponents' pins while guarding their own.
3) A player whose pin is knocked over is eliminated, and the last remaining player wins.
pe-07857:
1) Walk in a circle in the shallow pool making crawl arm motions to feel water flow.
2) Practice crawl flutter kicks while keeping toes pointed and legs straight.
3) Practice arm strokes on the back first, then transition to prone crawl with side breathing.
pe-07858:
1) Fasten the elastic band around chairs or vaulting boxes.
2) Practice the designated sequence of basic jumping footwork.
3) Once familiar, try jumping synchronously in pairs, groups of 4, or groups of 8 in time with the rhythm.
pe-07859:
1) Practice a headstand leaning against the wall bars on top of safety mats.
2) Practice lifting hands off the floor to grasp a bar on the wall bars.
3) From a kneeling position, grip the same horizontal bar with both hands and lift legs into an inverted hang.
4) Once mastered, attempt kicking up directly from a standing position into an inverted hang.
pe-07860:
1) Bounce a volleyball onto the landing mat in the opponent's area to score.
2) Players cannot run with the ball in hand and must advance using passes.
3) Defenders can leap onto the landing mat to prevent the ball from touching down.
4) Scoring a bounce onto the mat awards 3 points, while catching a pass while standing on the mat awards 1 point.
pe-07861:
1) Divide the class into equal-sized teams.
2) The teacher designates specific body parts and exact numbers that are immune to lava.
3) Teams discuss and position themselves so only the permitted body parts contact the floor.
4) The entire group crosses the imaginary lava river maintaining the exact designated body contacts.
pe-07862:
1) Set up four bases with cones or hoops around the field and designate a catching zone for defenders.
2) The first thrower throws a tennis ball into the field and runs around the bases.
3) Defenders field the ball and throw it to the catching zone; runners must reach a base before the ball arrives.
4) Runners caught between bases when the ball reaches the zone are burned out; teams switch after 8 minutes.
pe-07863:
1) Students get a point if they complete the obstacle course without being hit.
2) Throwers are only allowed to throw while standing on the benches.
3) Teams switch roles after a set time (e.g., 5 minutes), and the group with more points wins.
pe-07864:
1) In the first game, players must touch their opponent's shoulder without holding them.
2) In the second game, players try to touch the opponent's thigh while preventing head collisions.
3) In the third game (Witches' Dance), players hold hands and try to step on the opponent's toes.
pe-07865:
1) Each team receives a sheet with blank fields, while the completed reference sheet lies under a cone.
2) Students run to the cone, memorize the content, and return to copy it onto their team's sheet as accurately as possible.
3) The team that accurately completes the sheet through teamwork and communication wins.
pe-07866:
1) The tagger wears a ribbon sash across the shoulder to prepare
2) All participants must move only by walking and are not allowed to run
3) The tagger walks to catch and touch fleeing players
pe-07867:
1) Pair up with a partner facing each other
2) Begin once palms touch each other as if drawn by magnetic force
3) One player takes the lead and the second partner must continuously follow the movements
pe-07868:
1) Warm up together with regular squats, partner push-ups, and leg stretch resistance
2) The base partner on all fours tightens their body to maintain a firm, solid support
3) The top partner climbs onto the base slowly without putting pressure on the middle of the back
4) Dismantle the pyramid in a slow and strictly controlled manner just like the setup
pe-07869:
1) Divide into teams and assign consecutive secret numbers to each team member
2) Players must hit opponents strictly in ascending order of their assigned numbers
3) Teammates who are not currently targeted can stand in front to shield the targeted player
4) The last assigned number is given to the backcourt player and teams aim to eliminate opponents in sequence
pe-07870:
1) Warm up with a tag game on the volleyball court, followed by wall-bar exercises, trampoline bounces, and core conditioning.
2) Practice vertical takeoffs on a mini-trampoline set against a wall bar.
3) Run through a track set with alternating mini-trampolines and vaulting boxes, jumping onto or over each box.
4) Start cautiously with squat thrust vaults and progress toward more fluid and powerful continuous jumps.
pe-07871:
1) Run up and step onto the mini-trampoline in an upright body position.
2) Raise both arms straight above the head at the moment of rebound.
3) Initiate forward rotation immediately with the trampoline push.
4) Tuck tightly by grabbing the shins with both hands to accelerate rotational speed.
5) Complete the turn and land securely on the safety mat.
pe-07872:
1) Squat down, tuck chin and knees to chest, and rock backward and forward along the rounded spine.
2) As you roll back, place hands next to the head with fingers pointing toward shoulders, and actively push off the floor to stand up.
3) Practice backward rolls down an inclined mat setup created with a springboard and mat.
4) Gradually remove the incline and perform the backward roll on a flat gymnastics mat using arm push strength.
5) Advanced students can finish the roll in a push-up plank or progress to a backward roll to temporary handstand.
pe-07873:
1) Teammates pass the ball to each other 10 times consecutively without letting it touch the floor.
2) If a team completes 10 passes, they score a point and possession turns over.
3) The opposing team tries to intercept or force the ball to drop, resetting the count back to 1.
pe-07874:
1) Overcome the fold-out wall bars.
2) Pass the horizontal bar, crawl through the tunnel, and clear the vaulting box.
3) Navigate parallel bars, leap over hurdles, cross remaining boxes and bars to finish.
pe-07875:
1) Create a bridge using 3 gymnastic poles across the mat (river) without touching the ground.
2) Teammates firmly hold the poles from both sides to support the crossing student.
3) Transport a total of 5 students across to the other side safely one by one.
pe-07876:
1) Students lie on the mat in an alternating layout with heads close together.
2) Students on the floor extend both hands upwards to form a conveyor belt.
3) The student being transported keeps their body rigid while at least 8 students continuously move them forward.
pe-07877:
1) Place a soft mat on the vaulting box, aligning the mat edge precisely with the box rim.
2) Roll backward across the box, pushing firmly against the mat with extended arms as legs go over the head.
3) Once mastered, remove the soft landing mat to increase the challenge.
pe-07878:
1) One initial tagger chases the runners.
2) When a runner is caught, they hold hands with the tagger to form a chain and continue chasing together.
3) Upon catching a fourth person, the chain splits into two pairs of taggers, or continues growing into one long unbroken chain.
pe-07879:
1) Walk across a tilting seesaw bench without stepping off.
2) Balance across an inverted narrow bench, progressing to walking backward or with closed eyes.
3) Carefully traverse a bench placed on evenly spaced rolling gymnastic bars buffered by mats.
pe-07880:
1) Players use 3 to 5 softballs to hit other opponents across the court.
2) A player who gets hit sits on the bench as a zombie and remembers who threw the ball.
3) When the person who hit them is eliminated, the zombie revives and returns to the game.
pe-07881:
1) Kneel on top of the vaulting box.
2) Swing arms vigorously forward and leap off the box.
3) Land safely on the floor and gradually increase the height of the box as confidence builds.
pe-07882:
1) Suspend a cord across the center of the court and place teams on opposite sides.
2) On cue, roll balls underneath the cord trying to cross the opponent's baseline.
3) The opposing team tries to block the balls, with variations including knocking down cones.
pe-07883:
1) Hang a thick rope from the wall bars and place two soft mats with a medicine ball (treasure) in the middle.
2) Students must retrieve the medicine ball using the rope without ever stepping on the soft mats.
3) The group plans and collaborates to bring the treasure safely outside the forbidden zone.
pe-07884:
1) Jump through hoops while turning the body toward the direction indicated by the cones.
2) Use a gymnastic stick to guide a flat cone through large cones in a relay.
3) Arrange cones so that each row has the same color, and touch the called color cone while holding a plank position.
pe-07885:
1) Practice receiving the ball with straight arms as a partner tosses it from bottom to top.
2) Bend the knees, bring the forearms close together to create a flat contact surface, and push the shoulders forward to hit the ball.
3) Practice bumping the ball after a bounce from a partner's toss or rebounding it off a wall.
pe-07886:
1) Hold the pool ladder in a crouch and practice entering the water backwards head-first.
2) Hold the instructor's hands to get used to falling backwards, then practice letting go.
3) Advance to the pool edge or springboard, extending arms to perform a backwards head-first dive.
pe-07887:
1) In a designated area, throwers use a volleyball to hit other players.
2) Throw the ball from above the head to tag running opponents.
3) Tagged players complete a movement task such as climbing up and down the wall bars before returning to the game.
pe-07888:
1) Students distribute evenly under the large soft mat and lift it up simultaneously.
2) Walk together without running while carrying the mat, and lower it simultaneously on command.
3) Perform cooperative variations such as crawling under the mat or lifting and flipping the mat 180 degrees using only feet.
pe-07889:
1) Divide students into groups of 2-3 and set up various stations.
2) While students at the shooting station make 10 baskets, other groups perform tasks at their stations including slalom dribbling, bench dribbling, parallel bar holds, chest passes, and vault box jumps.
3) Rotate stations once the 10 baskets are scored.
pe-07890:
1) Four students race across aligned benches and back, determining ranks 1 through 4.
2) Students with identical rankings race against each other for homogeneous competitions.
3) In the tag game, two runners sprint on benches in single file, where the rear runner tries to tag the front runner once the front runner's hand leaves the bench.
pe-07891:
1) Pairs transport a flat cone to a box using only gymsticks without dropping it.
2) Pairs carry a small ball and subsequently a tennis ball using gymsticks to the box.
3) Groups creatively invent and execute their own cooperative tasks such as walking-free ball transport or tossing and catching a ball with sticks.
pe-07892:
1) Four teams dribble basketballs or soccer balls to the center to retrieve cones back to their base.
2) When all central cones are collected, teams count their gathered cones to determine the winner.
3) In the second game, dribblers place tennis balls atop cones or collect them back in a relay format.
pe-07893:
1) Sled Dog Race: One student sits on a carpet tile while two pull them around a cone and back for 5 minutes.
2) Mini Biathlon: Runners throw tennis balls from a hoop into an open vault box until all 6 are scored.
3) Ice Hockey Slalom: Dribble a ball through a cone slalom course.
4) Winter Puzzle Run: Match a 6-piece puzzle by checking correct border colors.
5) Ice Floe Crossing: Cross the gym using carpet tiles numbering one more than team members.
pe-07894:
1) Practice hip extension exercises on a vaulting buck to build rotational power
2) Climb the wall bars and place both hands aligned vertically on the side rungs
3) Keep your eyes on the landing mat at all times while swinging your hips over and down to dismount
pe-07895:
1) Divide into two teams, with each team assigning two players wearing sashes to be 'living goals'
2) Play under standard handball passing rules to advance the soft ball
3) Score a point by successfully hitting an opponent's living goal player with the ball
4) When their own team has possession, living goals can actively run and participate like regular players
pe-07896:
1) Form a triangle with your head and hands, placing hands shoulder-width apart on the mat.
2) Push off with the standing leg, swing the other leg upward, and bring both legs together vertically.
3) Firmly press hands into the mat to distribute weight across three points and relieve neck strain.
pe-07897:
1) Divide the class into four teams, giving each team a die and a designated base.
2) A player rolls the die and moves forward to the hoop matching the rolled number.
3) Meanwhile, a teammate runs around a cone and back; upon return, the next player rolls and the board player advances.
4) Landing on an opponent's hoop knocks them out, sending them to a mat to perform 10 tuck/stretch jumps before re-entering.
5) The first team whose all players complete a full lap wins.
pe-07898:
1) Divide into two teams standing behind or on benches facing each other.
2) Throw frisbees at 3 to 4 cones placed atop vaulting boxes in the center of the gym.
3) Knock cones into the opponent's court; count cones in each court when time runs out to determine the winner.
pe-07899:
1) Pair up where one student closes their eyes and the partner guides them around the gymnasium.
2) When the teacher calls 'Stop', pause while keeping eyes strictly closed.
3) Walk back blindly to the original starting spot while the partner guards against collisions.
pe-07900:
1) Students move freely across the gym until the teacher calls out a number to form groups.
2) Each group completes the body challenge announced by the teacher, such as keeping only a set number of hands and feet on the floor.
3) Once all groups succeed, movement resumes until the next instruction is given.
pe-07901:
1) Place a vaulting box 30 cm from a thick mat and practice vaulting legs past the mat.
2) Gradually move the box closer to make the vault steeper with one hand placed on the mat.
3) Remove the box, tilt the mat, and use both hands against the mat to complete the spin.
pe-07902:
1) Two taggers are designated and marked with ribbons.
2) All players must move strictly along the floor lines and cannot jump between lines.
3) Players can switch paths at any intersection while taggers pursue and tag runners along the lines.
pe-07903:
1) Form a team and line up in front of a basketball hoop.
2) Within a 3-minute time limit, take turns shooting to hit the backboard and catching the rebound.
3) Record the total number of hits within the time limit or count consecutive hits until an error occurs.
pe-07904:
1) Divide into two teams and place one to three mats in the opponent court.
2) Hit players move to a mat in the opponent court.
3) Hitting an opponent from the mat allows returning to your own court.
4) The team that eliminates all opponents wins.
pe-07905:
1) At station one, pass through the wall bars without touching the suspended ropes.
2) At station two, climb the wall bars using a rope.
3) At station three, step along gym balls while holding ropes.
4) At station four, climb through hoops inserted diagonally into the wall bars.
pe-07906:
1) Set cones around a volleyball court and form pairs.
2) One student runs around the court (60m per lap) for 8 minutes while the partner counts laps.
3) Multiply completed laps by 60 at the end of 8 minutes.
4) Add 10 meters for each cone or center line passed on the final incomplete lap.
pe-07907:
1) Swing across the mat gorge using ropes and land safely inside hoops.
2) Transport a medicine ball treasure across the gorge without throwing it.
3) Complete the mission when all students stand inside hoops with the treasure safe.
pe-07908:
1) Jump while spreading feet forward and backward or in a cross pattern (front, back, left, right).
2) Practice rock-paper-scissors jumps, jog jumps, high knee jumps, and leg swing jumps in sequence.
3) For double unders, stay airborne longer and quickly rotate the wrists twice per single jump.
pe-07909:
1) Lightly hit the tab ball in place and while moving left, right, forward, and backward.
2) Strike the tab ball while rotating in place or circling around the ball.
3) Repeat sitting and standing while hitting, or turn your body to dodge and hit the ball.
4) Hold the headband and kick the ball with your instep 10 times consecutively.
pe-07910:
1) For 1 turn 2 jumps, jump twice per one rope turn using wrists and arms together to widen rotation radius.
2) For the reverse turn, swing the rope backward so the left or right hand moves behind the waist and untangle it back to place.
3) For backward jumping, place hands at pelvis height and turn the rope using only wrists.
pe-07911:
1) Stand in a circle around the person swinging the rope.
2) Jump over the rope every two beats matching the timing of the swing.
3) The rope swings 3 times along the floor and 3 times high in repeating cycles.
4) Jump to avoid the rope when it is low and sit down to duck under it when it is high.
5) Anyone who touches the rope is eliminated or receives a penalty.
6) Increase difficulty by reducing repetitions as students succeed.
pe-07912:
1) The match consists of two 15-minute halves for elementary divisions.
2) Each set within a half lasts for 3 minutes.
3) Winning a set awards 2 points, while a draw awards 1 point.
4) The team with the higher total points at the end of both halves wins.
pe-07913:
1) Move forward galloping with slightly bent knees and swinging bent arms rhythmically.
2) Gallop in a zigzag pattern between cones placed at 1.5m intervals.
3) Move galloping to pick up beanbags placed at 2m intervals and carry them sequentially to the target spots.
pe-07914:
1) Perform forward side steps on the mat by lowering your center of gravity and moving forward and sideways.
2) Perform cross steps rapidly across the mat using side steps.
3) Run back and forth quickly between cones set 8 meters apart.
4) Leap over 6 hurdles spaced 50 cm apart alternating feet.
5) Jump in a zigzag through 10 hoops spaced 70 cm apart taking off and landing on both feet simultaneously.
6) Hop through 14 spot markers spaced at 50 cm and 70 cm intervals.
pe-07915:
1) Place markers on the floor at varying intervals or in L-shape, U-shape, or straight-line patterns.
2) Move forward using skipping while lifting knees high and adjusting arm swing according to the target markers.
3) Control the leaping distance to land at the center of each target marker sequentially.
pe-07916:
1) Move using forward and side steps.
2) Advance forward while performing burpee squats.
3) Touch alternating feet in a push-up position.
4) Raise the upper body and touch balls in sequence.
5) Roll the ball with both hands to touch targets in order and jump onto the jump box.
pe-07917:
1) Step diagonally forward while pushing elbows out to the sides
2) Jump twice while raising both arms up, then quickly close and spread feet
3) Connect the learned movements quickly to music
pe-07918:
1) Practice the 4-step sequence (feet together, feet apart, feet together, stand up) without the rope for push-ups.
2) Transition to a 3-step sequence once comfortable, then perform the push-up over the rope.
3) For the frog skill, place hands down, extend legs into a handstand, bring feet together, and land smoothly before trying with the rope.
pe-07919:
1) Attach direction markers to 10 cones, and have team members turn around while a representative arranges them.
2) On the start signal, the first runner completes each cone mission, rounds the turning point, and tags the next runner's back.
3) In the second game, runners switch the positions of 10 cones placed on spot markers from left to right around the turning point before tagging the next runner.
pe-07920:
1) [Around Town] Set up 4 corners; students play rock-paper-scissors at corner 1, winners advance to the next corner, and losers play someone else.
2) Each time a student completes a full lap and reaches corner 1, they take 1 wristband; once 3 bands are collected, they sit down in order.
3) [Band Stealing] In 4 teams, each player wears 1 wristband and places the remaining 2 in their team bucket.
4) Players move around playing foot rock-paper-scissors against other teams; winners take the loser's band to put in their team bucket, while losers go back to their bucket to put on a new band.
5) When time is up, the team with the most wristbands in their bucket wins.
pe-07921:
1) Students divide into 4 teams and stand at starting points of a circular track.
2) On signal, run one lap around the track.
3) Complete the assigned mission upon return, such as moving beanbags, knocking down bowling pins, or throwing flying discs.
4) The first student or team to finish the mission wins.
pe-07922:
1) Stand at an appropriate distance from the vault box.
2) Lower your stance in place and jump high off both feet while forcefully swinging your arms upward.
3) When landing atop the vault box, bend your knees slightly and extend your arms to maintain balance before stepping down safely.
pe-07923:
1) Hook the rope under foot in a V-shape, bring one foot around, wrap it back, release the foot, and reform a V-shape
2) Follow trick 1 and loop the rope over using the stepping hand, repeat on the other side, step out, and raise hands to release
3) Keep handles pointing down by your side to make the rope pop up, then poke the handle through
4) Insert one hand, toss and catch the rope, then pull the rear handle forward
pe-07924:
1) Set cones at the start and finish points, and place spot markers in a zigzag layout corresponding to the number of students.
2) Each student stands on a spot marker holding a stick and cannot step outside the marker.
3) On the start signal, pass the ball with the stick from the first player to the last player sequentially.
4) If a player fails to receive the ball, the passer retrieves and passes it again, and the team that delivers the ball to the finish line first wins.
pe-07925:
1) Place cones in a circle matching group members and stand by each cone with assigned numbers.
2) Player 1 balances a beanbag on the chest to player 2, and players sequentially carry it on hand, head, and shoulder.
3) Once relay finishes, toss the beanbag into the center of the circle on signal.
pe-07926:
1) Place hula hoops on the schoolyard.
2) Listen carefully to the rule announced by the teacher.
3) Students matching the condition step inside the hula hoops.
4) Students who cannot enter move to the rest area.
5) Continue the game with new rules.
pe-07927:
1) Set up cones along the finish line and attach country name tags onto each cone.
2) Select one tagger while the remaining students line up at equal intervals along the starting line.
3) The tagger calls out a country name to visit and stands in front of that cone, then plays rock-paper-scissors with the students.
4) Students take two steps forward if they win, one step if they tie, and do one squat in place if they lose.
5) Successfully passing the cone marked with the called country name counts as an arrival.
pe-07928:
1) Pair up students, provide two disc markers per pair, and assign roles as helper and explorer.
2) The helper places the first disc, and the explorer jumps onto it with both feet together.
3) The helper places the second disc ahead, the explorer hops onto it, and the helper moves the rear disc forward.
4) Navigate around the turning cone back to the start line and switch roles.
pe-07929:
1) Designate one squirrel and one hunter, while remaining students act as the forest holding hands in an outward circle.
2) The hunter chases the squirrel who weaves in and out of the forest circle.
3) The forest students block the hunter by lowering arms while letting the squirrel pass, swapping roles upon tag.
pe-07930:
1) Designate a tagger team and mark them by wearing vests or bands.
2) When the game begins, taggers chase the other players to step on their shadows.
3) Any player whose shadow is stepped on must squat down on the spot.
4) If a non-tagger player steps on a squatted player's shadow, that player can stand up and run away again.
5) When the game time ends, count the squatted players to score the tagger team.
6) After every team takes a turn being the taggers, the team with the highest score wins.
pe-07931:
1) Choose one student to be the king, and that student wears a team vest.
2) Other students pair up, face each other, and hold hands high to form archway doors.
3) On the start signal, the king ducks low and quickly passes through the doors.
4) The pair of students through whose door the king has passed runs to the back of the line to form a new door.
5) The king passes through all the doors, circles around the turning point, and returns to the starting line.
pe-07932:
1) Two groups stand at the starting line ready to run.
2) Dash quickly toward the target area upon the start signal.
3) The group that grabs more plastic bottles (one fewer than the total runners) wins the game.
pe-07933:
1) Two to three teams line up at the starting line.
2) The first runner butt-kicks, the second claps under legs, and the third walks with bent knees around the cone.
3) On the signal, the first runner navigates around the cone and returns.
4) The team whose final runner finishes first wins.
pe-07934:
1) When the signal sounds, run to a classmate and challenge them to a duel.
2) Play rock-paper-scissors; the winner selects the jump rope technique from previously learned styles.
3) Start the duel: the first person to trip gets 1 point, and the longer jumper gets 2 points.
4) You cannot rematch someone you already faced; score as many points as possible within the time limit.
pe-07935:
1) Lay out spot markers or A4 paper in a grid on the floor.
2) In groups, design a secret 10-step safe path connected straight or diagonally on paper.
3) Players hop one step at a time, balancing on one foot on each marker for at least 2 seconds.
4) If a player steps on a mine and hears the referee call 'Bang', they exit and the next teammate starts from the beginning.
pe-07936:
1) Squat down with feet flat and knees together, then place your hands behind your back to maintain balance.
2) Stand facing a wall leaving an index finger space between the wall and your toes.
3) Squat all the way down and stand up while keeping both your chin and hands pressed against the wall.
pe-07937:
1) For shuttle runs, 1 to 6 players run simultaneously to touch the screen up to 5 times.
2) In relay mode, each runner touches the screen and tags the next teammate.
3) In speed alignment rotation mode, players run and touch tiles to rotate and assemble the image.
4) In position swap mode, players touch two tiles per turn to swap positions until completed.
pe-07938:
1) Practice the drop step without a ball by bending the knees and spreading feet shoulder-width apart.
2) Practice pound dribbles and crossovers by pushing the ball firmly against the floor at knee and waist heights.
3) Pair up, facing each other, and tap your own ball twice then the partner's ball twice.
4) Shoot toward the rim by fully extending the elbow and snapping the index and middle fingers.
pe-07939:
1) Step forward with the left foot, draw the right arm back, toss the ball vertically above the head, and hit it with the lower palm.
2) For underhand pass, stand shoulder-width apart, clasp hands with thumbs parallel, and contact the ball between the wrist and forearm.
3) For overhand set, form a triangle with thumbs and index fingers above the forehead and push the ball upward using the fingers rather than palms.
4) Practice by bouncing and moving quickly under the ball with a partner or against a wall.
pe-07940:
1) Practice catching a tossed towel with both hands.
2) Catch the tossed towel with the head without using hands and freeze in place.
3) Sit with legs apart and roll a ball forward between legs, stopping it right at the limit before bringing it back.
4) Dodge balls rolled toward you while staying inside the marked cone square.
5) Create a body tunnel and let the rolled ball pass directly through the center between your legs.
pe-07941:
1) Place a ball of appropriate size on the gym mat.
2) Look at your navel and perform a forward roll over the ball without touching it.
3) Increase difficulty by using larger balls or placing multiple obstacles as skill improves.
pe-07942:
1) Two partners face each other or stand back-to-back and squeeze a ball between their bodies
2) Stand up simultaneously without dropping the ball or touching the floor with hands
3) Work together to slowly squat back down while maintaining pressure on the ball
pe-07943:
1) Move only by skipping, galloping, or speed walking without running.
2) Turtles tagged by a ninja stick must freeze in place like a ninja.
3) When delivered a pizza by a teammate, perform 10 lunge jumps to unfreeze and pass the pizza to another frozen player.
4) Shredder taggers touched by Splinter's power ball must tiptoe to the fitness area, complete 10 jumping jacks, and return.
pe-07944:
1) Set up multiple cones on the floor and stand behind the line.
2) Toss a hula hoop to ring or knock down a cone.
3) Bring the captured cone back behind your line.
pe-07945:
1) On the start signal, race to the center, grab bean bags, and return behind your 10-foot line
2) Slide the bean bags along the floor toward the feet of opposing players
3) A player who hits an opponent's foot earns the right to run to the opposite mat and pick up a football
4) Throw the football to a teammate; if caught, place it in the team basket, otherwise return it to the mat and go back
5) The first team to collect all three footballs in their basket wins the round
pe-07946:
1) A partner or parent holds a cushion.
2) Kick the cushion as fast as possible for 20 seconds upon the signal.
3) Count the total number of kicks completed within 20 seconds.
pe-07947:
1) Set up start and finish lines using 4 cones and give every student a basketball.
2) When the coach shouts "Green", players dribble as fast as they can toward the finish line.
3) When the coach shouts "Red", every player must stop dribbling and freeze immediately.
4) Anyone still dribbling after "Red" must take two steps back, and the first player to cross the finish line wins.
pe-07948:
1) Place sheets of newspaper along the floor like stepping stones.
2) Tap a tape-reinforced balloon up into the air.
3) Step with both feet on each newspaper sheet while continuously hitting the balloon to keep it off the ground.
pe-07949:
1) Draw a 4x4 grid of 16 squares on the floor measuring about 2 meters across.
2) Two players stand outside facing each other at the right side of the grid.
3) Surrounding players sing the rhythm song 'wash-a, scotch-scotch'.
4) On 'wash-a' jump forward into the squares with each foot, and on 'scotch' jump laterally left and right to navigate the grid.
pe-07950:
1) Choose between low-impact and high-impact movements based on tempo.
2) Learn basic steps such as the V-step, A-step, kick step, and side step.
3) Practice connecting various applied steps like turns and jumping jacks to the count.
pe-07951:
1) Students scatter across the playing field.
2) Within a set time (e.g., 30 seconds), touch as many classmates' backs as possible.
3) You cannot continuously touch the same person's back and must touch different classmates.
4) When time is up, the teacher calls out score ranges (0-10, 11-20, 21-30) and students raise their hands.
pe-07952:
1) Set up a starting line and a finish line, and divide the class into several teams.
2) Give each team a hoop representing a boat, held by all team members with their hands.
3) On the teacher's start signal, all teams move forward until the teacher shouts 'Náufrago' (Castaway).
4) Teams must stop, place the hoop on the ground, and fit all team members inside it.
5) They pick up the hoop again and continue forward, repeating on signal.
6) Points are awarded based on arrival order at the finish line (1st: 3 pts, 2nd: 2 pts, 3rd: 1 pt).
pe-07953:
1) Scatter all students across the playing area, and assign one student wearing a pinnie to be the reindeer (tagger).
2) The tagger attempts to chase and tag other students.
3) When tagged, the student must go to the side of the field and touch one corner and then the other corner of the field.
4) After touching both corners, the student can return to the playing field and rejoin the game.
pe-07954:
1) Divide the class into two teams on both sides of the yard and draw lines dividing areas with point values (1st area: 3 pts, 2nd area: 6 pts, 3rd area: 10 pts).
2) Set up throwers and catchers; catchers position themselves in whichever scoring zone they think they can catch the frisbee.
3) The thrower launches the frisbee, and if the catcher catches it within their chosen zone, the team earns those points.
4) No points are awarded if the frisbee is dropped or fails to reach the zone.
5) After the throw, the catcher becomes the next thrower, the thrower moves to the back of the line, and the first person in line becomes the catcher.
pe-07955:
1) Place three cones well separated in a line, form teams of three students, and have each student stand at a cone.
2) Give a frisbee to one person on the outside cone and a hoop to the person in the middle cone.
3) The student with the frisbee throws it toward the opposite side, aiming for it to pass through the center of the hoop held by the middle student.
4) The middle student holding the hoop is only allowed to take one step to the left or one step to the right to count the score.
5) If the frisbee passes through the hoop, the team scores a point and calls out their current total score.
6) The student at the opposite end retrieves the frisbee and moves to the throwing spot, the thrower rotates to the middle, and the middle person moves to the retriever's cone.
pe-07956:
1) Choose 3 taggers, and all other students receive a scarf.
2) When tagged, a student must stop, surrender their scarf to the tagger, and raise their hands.
3) The tagger takes the scarf to the circle, protecting it from being taken back.
4) Free players can safely enter the circle to retrieve a scarf and deliver it to free a captured player.
pe-07957:
1) Two teams stand on their halves, each placing designated 'mothers' behind the opponent's endline.
2) The teacher throws a ball that must bounce three times before anyone can touch it.
3) Players hit directly by a thrown ball are out and move behind their mother's endline.
4) Catching a ball thrown directly in the air allows the team to bring back one eliminated player.
pe-07958:
1) Select one student to be the wolf, while the remaining students are sheep.
2) Wolves move on all fours (hands and feet), while sheep run on two feet.
3) Any sheep touched by a wolf turns into a wolf and must crawl on all fours to catch others.
pe-07959:
1) Place plenty of ribbons near the teacher to start the game.
2) In the preliminary round, hitting an opponent earns a ribbon from the teacher; hit players are not eliminated.
3) Once all ribbons are taken, the main game starts with a fixed time limit (e.g., 5 minutes).
4) During the main game, hitting an opponent allows you to take a ribbon directly from them.
5) The player with the most ribbons when time expires wins.
pe-07960:
1) Place safety landing mats around the pommel horse.
2) Mount the pommel horse by holding onto the pommels.
3) Rotate vertically completely around the horse body without letting feet touch the floor.
pe-07961:
1) Place benches in the four gym corners to serve as low goals and split students into four teams.
2) Each team defends its own bench goal while attacking any of the other three goals to score.
3) Since goals are low, players focus on combination passing rather than taking wild shots.
4) The team with the most goals scored when time expires wins.
pe-07962:
1) Practice bunny hops over a small obstacle to emphasize the arm support phase.
2) Extend the standard forward roll by reaching far forward and pushing off strongly with the legs.
3) Combine the movements into a diving forward roll with a brief airborne phase where limbs leave the ground.
4) Place a springboard in front of safety mats to take off and achieve greater airborne distance.
pe-07963:
1) Students pair up and stand facing each other in two lines.
2) One group receives a task from the teacher to act out a person or animal in pantomime.
3) Students then invent figures themselves and their partners guess.
4) In an advanced variation, students think of a four-letter word, act out each letter in pantomime, and switch roles once the partner guesses the word.
pe-07964:
1) Start from the first cone at a walking pace, focusing on lifting the knee on the shooting hand side.
2) Practice carrying and guiding the ball with one hand, then incorporate dribbling according to step rules.
3) The player shoots a layup, moves to the second cone, and collects the rebound from the next shooter.
4) Pass the rebound to the third cone, run to that spot, receive and return the ball to the first cone, continuing the rotation.
pe-07965:
1) Form groups of three where one student is the mechanic and two act as robots.
2) The mechanic controls robots by tapping: head to start/stop, right shoulder for a 90-degree right turn, left shoulder for left turn, and back to reverse.
3) Robots must move only in a steady robot-walking gait without running.
4) When the palms of the two partner robots touch each other, they automatically shut down and complete the task.
pe-07966:
1) All students start by standing on a long bench or balance beam.
2) The teacher gives a sorting criterion such as height or age.
3) Students cooperate to swap positions and sort themselves without stepping off the bench.
pe-07967:
1) Two players sit back-to-back on a mat and try to push each other off.
2) In a push-up position facing each other, players try to lightly tap each other's fingers.
pe-07968:
1) Two teams face each other with a box element containing tennis balls in front of each team.
2) On signal, runners take only one ball at a time and run to place it in the opposing team's box.
3) When the countdown timer (e.g., 5 minutes) ends, the team with fewer tennis balls in their own box wins.
pe-07969:
1) A designated mastermind in each team sets up a secret sequence of 4 different colored cones behind a vaulting box.
2) Team members take turns running up to arrange cones and guess the correct combination.
3) The mastermind checks against the original and tells them which ones are correct until the team completes the sequence.
pe-07970:
1) In dribble relay, two players move together facing each other without dropping the ball.
2) In linear relay, players sprint ahead at the speed of the ball into defensive formation.
3) In dribble-set-hit, players form a triangle facing each other to set and strike the ball.
4) In sliding drills, players practice diving and sliding toward the falling ball.
pe-07971:
1) Side-step back and forth between two rolls of toilet paper placed on the floor and touch them.
2) Roll one toilet paper roll like a bowling ball to hit the target roll.
3) Blow an airborne sheet of toilet paper upward to prevent it from touching the ground.
pe-07972:
1) In balloon shot put, spin your body in place to launch the balloon as far as possible.
2) In balloon rocket, hold the tied nozzle and flick it forward to launch.
3) In balloon basketball, hit the balloon into a box target from increasing distances.
4) In balloon volleyball, set up a towel net and volley back and forth within three touches.
pe-07973:
1) Stand in front of the cone obstacle course connected with bars.
2) Step carefully on top of each cone one foot at a time while balancing.
3) Upon reaching the end of the course, jump safely down onto the mat.
pe-07974:
1) Divide into attack and defense teams with 6 players each.
2) The attacking team forms a circle, takes half a step back, and sits down, while the defending team stands freely inside.
3) Attackers throw or roll the ball to eliminate defenders below the knee.
4) Hit defenders wait outside the circle in line for revival.
5) Defenders revive if the ball goes out of the circle, hits above the knee without bouncing, stops unreachable in the circle, or an attacker lifts both hips off the floor.
6) Switch sides when all defenders are out, and the team eliminating faster wins.
pe-07975:
1) Choose a theme that peers can relate to, such as seasons or school life.
2) Divide the chosen theme into about four sequential scenes or story segments.
3) Create varied movements using elements like size, speed, and repetition.
4) Practice connecting movements smoothly, then present and appreciate the performances.
5) Conclude the session by stretching the body parts used during the activity.
pe-07976:
1) Insert your finger into the air valve to hold the ball, toss it up, and slide in matching the timing.
2) A helper bounces the ball by hand and tosses it up, while you slide in matching the timing.
3) Slide with the instep fully extended forward rather than pulling the toes toward the shins to pop the ball above your head.
4) Run toward a ball thrown or kicked by a helper and slide to keep it in play.
pe-07978:
1) Focus on the direction of the arrow card shown by the instructor.
2) Stand up when the arrow points up, and sit down when it points down.
3) Quickly move your body in that direction when the arrow points right or left.
4) React promptly to the changing arrows as the musical tempo speeds up.
pe-07979:
1) In stage 1, perform 10 consecutive lifts in order: foot twice, knee twice, head twice, knee twice, and foot twice.
2) In stage 2, continue without catching the balloon while sitting on a chair, lifting with feet twice and head twice.
3) In stage 3, lift with feet twice and head twice, then trap the balloon between both legs.
pe-07980:
1) Pass balloon from left to right hand 8 times: behind head x2, waist x2, legs x2, and left foot forward x2.
2) Pass from right to left hand 8 times stepping right foot forward to reach 16 combo.
3) Move balloon between legs in a figure-eight pattern 4 times front-to-back and 4 times back-to-front.
4) Place balloon between legs and switch hand positions front-and-back 4 times.
5) Clap once and switch hands to catch the balloon 4 times.
6) Close eyes, clap, and catch the balloon 4 times to complete the 36 combo.
pe-07981:
1) Roll a pair of socks into a round sock ball.
2) Complete levels 1 through 5 consecutively within the designated time limit.
3) Level 1: Place on foot, toss up, clap twice (front and back), and catch with opposite hand.
4) Level 2: Toss from hand, kick once with foot, and catch with opposite hand.
5) Level 3: Toss up, spin 360 degrees, and catch with opposite hand.
6) Level 4: Toss behind back and catch with opposite hand.
7) Level 5: Toss overhead from front and catch behind back.
pe-07982:
1) Place a sheet of tissue paper on top of one foot and hold chopsticks in the corresponding hand.
2) Pick up the tissue with the chopsticks, move it to the opposite knee, and switch the chopsticks to the other hand.
3) Continue transferring the tissue diagonally through shoulders and knees down to the foot across 10 levels.
pe-07983:
1) In stage 1, toss the rolled sock from the cup, pass it under the opposite arm, and catch it back in the cup with both hands.
2) In stage 2, toss the sock behind the back and catch it in the cup.
3) In stage 3, pass the sock under each leg and catch it in the cup.
4) In stage 4, kick the sock up with the foot and catch it in the cup.
pe-07984:
1) Lie down and lift a thick pillow using only both feet.
2) Turn the pillow 360 degrees in one direction using feet without hands to return to starting position.
3) Rotate it 360 degrees in the opposite direction for a total of 720 degrees.
pe-07985:
1) Hold a capped pen like a fencing foil and prepare a roll of toilet paper taped shut.
2) Toss the paper roll lightly so it rotates a half turn.
3) Insert the pen tip precisely into the center core of the falling roll (elementary students target 4 successes).
pe-07986:
1) Toss a balloon into the air and spike it with an extended arm toward the ceiling.
2) A balloon rebounding from the ceiling can be touched up to two times before spiking again.
3) If the balloon fails to touch the ceiling or hits the floor, restart from stage 1 and try to reach the target count.
pe-07987:
1) Prepare a paper split into two and a toilet paper roll
2) Mission 1: alternate palm and fist while clapping on 3, 6, and 9
3) Mission 2: jump twice continuously, skip claps on multiples of 3, and rotate onto the paper
4) Mission 3: step on the paper with a roll on your head, recite the 9 times table, drop the paper, and pick it up with one hand
5) Mission 4: drop the roll, clap 4 times front and back, and catch it with your foot
6) Complete all 4 missions within 40 seconds
pe-07988:
1) Place a rolled sock ball on the forehead and lie down then stand up without dropping it
2) Clamp a second sock ball between the knees while keeping one on the forehead, then lie down and stand up
3) Stand up on one leg without using hands to push off the floor
4) Kneel on one knee, open the other leg at 90 degrees or more, and stand up
5) Kick a sock ball upward and catch it between the thighs or knees
pe-07989:
1) Fold a towel lengthwise and place it in the center of the floor.
2) Stage 1: Dribble the balloon back and forth across the towel 7 times smoothly from a fixed spot.
3) Stage 2: Dribble twice on each side, traveling back and forth across the towel for 7 repetitions.
4) Stage 3: Move your entire body across the towel alongside the balloon, dribbling twice on each side for 7 repetitions.
5) Complete Stages 1 through 3 consecutively without touching the towel within the time limit (50 seconds for elementary).
pe-07990:
1) Fold a 3m rope twice to shorten it, hook ropes with a partner, shake left and right, and turn around to warm up.
2) Prepare rope bundles tied with figure-eight knots and play rock-paper-scissors facing each other.
3) The winner takes one rope from the loser, and the player with the most ropes wins the game.
pe-07991:
1) Pair up to practice foot and thigh trapping 10 times each while absorbing impact.
2) Practice inside, instep, infront, and outfront kicks focusing on plant foot and ball center.
3) Divide into 4 groups and have each player take turns shooting on goal using only the kick called by the teacher.
4) The group that scores the most points using the designated kicks wins the game.
pe-07992:
1) As a warm-up, play Don-Jan by running along a line, playing rock-paper-scissors upon meeting, and touching the opponent's cone upon winning.
2) Dribble through the river defenders who only move sideways, bypass them, and shoot on goal.
3) Enter the court when your number is called (1-3 players) to compete in shooting while side players serve as rebound walls.
4) Play 3v3 mini games rotating every 1-2 minutes while wall players quickly return balls into play.
pe-07993:
1) Relax the body and lightly jump in place for 30 seconds.
2) Rotate arms forward and backward in large circles for 30 seconds each.
3) Perform knee bends lightly for 30 seconds to warm up the joints.
4) Rotate knees smoothly in both directions for 30 seconds.
5) Bend one knee deeply with toes pointed up for side lunges on both sides.
6) Step back and gently bounce to stretch each Achilles tendon.
pe-07994:
1) Stand inside a hoop and perform upper body twists holding the ball.
2) Lift the ball overhead while doing banzai squats.
3) Pass the ball around the waist in a circular motion.
4) Toss the ball upward and catch it with both hands.
5) Drop the ball downwards and catch it on the bounce.
6) Lift the thigh up to bounce the ball off the thigh and catch it.
7) Alternate tapping the top of the ball with the soles of your feet.
8) Bounce the ball inside the hoop, spin 360 degrees, and catch it.
9) Stand outside the hoop, bounce the ball, spin around, and catch it. 10) Alternately tap the ball upward with palms to do hand lifting.
pe-07995:
1) Adjust rope length to chest or armpit height while stepping on it with both feet.
2) Place a cone or marker, swing rope from back to front to catch it, then jump.
3) Increase speed of single jumps to achieve 5 consecutive jumps within 10 seconds.
4) Practice running jumps by swinging the rope forward while running.
pe-07996:
1) Kneel on the balance ball and bounce 10 times while maintaining balance.
2) Place chest on the ball, walk forward to the toes, and hold for 10 seconds.
3) Walk forward on the ball to lift one leg or high-five a partner.
4) Practice knocking away a partner-held ball and crawling under the ball.
5) Cling to the ball with hands and feet off the ground, then balance on all fours and kneeling.
pe-07997:
1) Decide taggers and runners through rock-paper-scissors.
2) The tagger counts to 10 while runners flee.
3) Tagged runners extend an index finger like ET and freeze.
4) Teammates touch index fingertips together and vocalize together to revive them.
pe-07998:
1) Sprint to the first hurdle to take off with the designated takeoff foot.
2) Over the hurdle, lean the upper body forward, swing the lead leg straight out, and pull the trail leg smoothly forward in rhythm.
3) Run through the interval with a consistent 3 to 5-step rhythm.
4) Choose the appropriate lane according to personal skill level, selecting hurdle height and intervals (5m, 6m, 6.5m).
5) Conclude the session with an 8-second hurdle run challenge or by measuring team-based progress.
pe-07999:
1) Four-court dodgeball divides the court into 4 zones with diagonal teams partnering up using multiple balls.
2) In tee-ball, all team members bat twice per half-inning, and runners are out when a fielder touches home base with the ball.
3) Line soccer restricts active field players and places outside helpers who can use their hands to pass into play.
pe-08000:
1) Touch your toes to the cone and take two steps backward to face your partner.
2) Place both hands on the body parts called out by the teacher, such as head, shoulders, or knees.
3) When the teacher shouts 'Cone', quickly grab the cone first and hold it up.
pe-08001:
1) Focus your eyes in the direction you are travelling.
2) Change direction by pushing off your outside foot.
3) Lower your body during the change of direction.
4) Ensure your change of direction occurs in a single step.
pe-08002:
1) Stand upright on the gymnastics mat.
2) Bend your knees and lower your body down low.
3) Place your hands on the ground to support your body weight in a stable squat hold.
pe-08003:
1) Perform roll-overs by rolling the body across the floor over and around disc cones
2) Strengthen core muscles by collecting disc cones while holding stability on the ground
3) Throw matching colored bean bags onto designated colored disc cones as target practice
4) Practice 180-degree jumps over cones and hold single-leg balance poses to train motor control
pe-08004:
1) Practice ball control and volleying with Four Square at station 1.
2) Practice underhand placement and serving motions inside hoops at station 2 (Hoop Volley).
3) Stand on comfortable poly spots and aim underhand serves at targets over the net at station 3.
4) Keep a beach ball in the air with teammates without letting it drop at station 4 (Keep It Up).
pe-08005:
1) Divide the gym with cones, place 6 pins on poly spots along each end line, and set up a mat for jail.
2) Attackers throw or roll balls to knock down enemy pins, while defenders protect their own pins.
3) Players crossing the center line go to jail if tagged, but return if they catch a ball thrown by a rescuer.
4) A jailed player can shoot into the basketball hoop to trigger a jailbreak and free all prisoners at once.
5) The team that knocks down all six opponent pins first wins.
pe-08006:
1) Divide students into groups of 4 to 6 and line them up facing each other across the gym.
2) When music plays, the first runner jogs across, gives a high-five to the opposite teammate, and relays.
3) When the music stops, active runners caught in the snake pit go to the center circle and perform an exercise.
pe-08007:
1) Line up 10 balls on the half-court line and set up a safe zone marked with 4 cones and a bucket on each side.
2) Invade the opponent's territory while avoiding tags below the head; tagged players must touch their wall to re-enter.
3) Players inside the opponent's safe zone cannot be tagged and must score by gently placing the ball into the bucket.
4) Scoring grants a free walk back to your side, and the first team to place 3 balls in the bucket wins.
pe-08008:
1) Divide into two teams at opposite walls and have each team choose one catcher to stand behind the opposing basketball baseline.
2) On the go signal, both teams race to collect as many dodgeballs as possible.
3) Players throw the ball across the gym for their catcher to catch.
4) If the catcher makes the catch, the thrower joins them behind the baseline, and the first team to get all players across wins the round.
pe-08009:
1) Split the class into two teams (pennies team and shirt team) and give each team two dodgeballs.
2) Play using the entire gym, and players cannot run while holding the ball but must pass to get closer and hit opponents.
3) When hit, players must sit down on the floor where it happens; sitting players can get back into play if they catch the ball and pass to an active teammate who hits an opponent.
4) Out players can pass the ball to each other to form a chain, and when an active teammate lands a hit, everyone in the chain returns to the game.
5) The team wins when all opponents on the other team are eliminated.
pe-08010:
1) The chaser holds an orange cone on their head and runs to tag other players.
2) When tagged, that runner immediately becomes a new chaser.
3) The tagged runner retrieves an orange cone from the side, places it on their head, and joins in tagging until everyone is caught.
pe-08011:
1) Two players stand opposite each other across a wall or designated box area.
2) Play rock-paper-scissors; the loser flees and the winner chases to tag.
3) When the coach calls out a change command, players immediately switch roles.
4) Move with side-steps while solving math equations called by the coach to determine who chases based on even/odd answers.
pe-08012:
1) Played with eyeshades on a court divided into team areas and a neutral area.
2) The ball must bounce at least once before the high ball line and within the neutral area.
3) Teams must launch an attack crossing the center or sideline within 10 seconds of gaining possession.
4) Making noise during an attack or committing infractions results in a penalty throw defending a 9-meter goal alone.
pe-08013:
1) Warm up with Safety Pair tag where a partner joining one hand forces the person on the other hand to release and flee.
2) Practice shooting at two goals from before the shoot line and retrieve own ball.
3) Play 3v1 ball keeping for 15 seconds progressing from hands to feet.
4) Play a 4v4 game using waiting players as wall rebounders, starting without goalkeepers.
pe-08014:
1) Cone Trio: Runners are safe while touching a cone, but must vacate the cone when an incoming teammate calls for it.
2) Ball Control & Gate Passing: Pairs pass through cone gates and move around the field to clear as many gates as possible.
3) 3v3 Mini-Game: Three players per team compete to score on goals or cone targets, while other students act as wall players to keep play active.
pe-08015:
1) Use the upper body to lift upward during takeoff rather than relying only on legs.
2) Extend the lead leg forward as if kicking a can with the sole of the foot.
3) Open the trail leg outward and pull it forward to form a triangle with the knee.
pe-08016:
1) The first thrower throws the white jack ball into the court area.
2) The red team throws their first ball followed by the blue team.
3) The team farther from the jack ball continues to throw the next ball.
4) After both teams have thrown all 6 balls each, points are calculated and the team closest to the jack ball wins the end.
5) Score 1 point for each ball closer to the jack ball than the opponent's closest ball.
pe-08017:
1) Attackers evade defenders using cut-in direction changes, sweeping arcs, change-of-pace speed bursts, and dummy passes.
2) Teams utilize tactics such as cross attacks, dummy crosses, skip passes, and blind-side plays.
3) Defenders counter with individual marking, full-back deep defense, and flat horizontal defensive lines to pull tags.
4) When the match ends, players observe no-side and shake hands.
pe-08018:
1) Form a fist or open your palm depending on which grip feels more comfortable.
2) Prepare to strike with the flat surface of your fist or the lower heel of your palm.
3) Swing from low to high, making contact slightly below the center of the ball.
4) Place the tossing hand in line with the striking arm and toss the ball gently without throwing it too high.
5) Begin serving from a short distance and gradually increase to longer distances.
pe-08019:
1) The pitcher rolls the ball toward home base.
2) The kicker kicks the rolling ball and runs around the bases.
3) Teams switch between offense and defense to score runs.
pe-08020:
1) Set up three straight lines and align runners starting from the first and second runners.
2) Runner 1 starts and passes the baton to Runner 2.
3) Runner 2 runs in the opposite direction to pass to Runner 3, repeating this cycle with the final runner passing back to Runner 1 for continuous practice.
pe-08021:
1) Jump up onto the vaulting box using hands and dismount forward to get familiar
2) Place hands on taped marks and jump to straddle-sit on the box
3) Run up and take off with both feet using a board to vault over the box with spotting
pe-08022:
1) In Revival Dodgeball, hit players complete a specific mission to rejoin the court.
2) Fireball Dodgeball uses one standard ball and one designated fireball.
3) Only girls can touch the fireball; boys are out immediately if they contact it.
pe-08023:
1) The defending team forms a pyramid in lines, placing a single 'King' at the final stage.
2) Attackers start simultaneously from the start line and play rock-paper-scissors against the first-line defender.
3) If they win, they advance to the next line; if they lose, they must return all the way to the start line regardless of progress.
4) Defeating the King counts as a clear, and the team with the most cleared runners within the time limit wins after switching sides.
pe-08024:
1) Establish a low power stance with feet wider than shoulder width
2) Keep the pivot foot planted and execute front turns or reverse turns
3) In pairs play 1-on-1 where the offensive player shields the ball using pivots while the defender attempts to steal.
pe-08025:
1) If a ball leaves the court into the dead zone without contact, possession goes to the other team.
2) To restart play, hold the ball overhead and wait for the referee's whistle before throwing.
3) Players transitioning between infield and outfield must move around the outside without stepping into the opponent's court.
4) Passing between players in the same area (infield-to-infield or outfield-to-outfield) is prohibited.
5) A maximum of 4 consecutive passes is allowed, requiring an attack on or before the 5th attempt.
6) A player holding the ball must throw it within 5 seconds.
pe-08026:
1) Run directly towards the easiest target to strike without passing.
2) Target the outer edges of the opponent court to sustain continuous attacks with outfielders.
3) Pass between inner and outer fielders to disrupt defense before attacking.
pe-08027:
1) Place various balls in the center of the court and position each team inside their circle.
2) On the signal, players run to the center and dribble balls back into their team's circle.
3) Players can take balls from opposing circles, but cannot steal from a player currently dribbling.
4) The team with the most balls in their circle at the end wins.
pe-08028:
1) Warm up with team running and tag, followed by 5 right-hand dribbles and 5 ball wraps around the body in each direction.
2) In pairs, practice chest passes to your partner and switch to using your non-dominant hand once comfortable.
3) Spread across the court to practice moving passes utilizing open space.
4) Practice dynamic jump shots toward the goal, then transition to full-court passing and scoring drills.
pe-08029:
1) Two teams of six players face each other across a net, starting play with a serve.
2) Return the ball over the net within three touches before it hits the floor.
3) If a team drops the ball or fails to return it within three hits, the opposing team scores a point, and the first to 25 points wins a set.
pe-08030:
1) Keep eyes up rather than looking down at the take-off board.
2) Accelerate the run-up by increasing stride cadence as if running up stairs.
3) Lock the ankle, knee, and hip joints at take-off while driving the free thigh upward quickly.
pe-08031:
1) Divide the approach into three phases to build speed toward the takeoff.
2) Widen the stride two steps before takeoff to maintain posture and push firmly off the support leg.
3) Beginners should practice the tuck jump as their primary flight technique.
pe-08032:
1) Position yourself outside the 6-meter line with the ball.
2) For a step shot, step forward with the foot opposite your throwing hand and throw.
3) For a jump shot, take off with the foot opposite your throwing hand (left foot for right-handers) and jump into the air to shoot.
4) Shoot into the goal past the defenders and goalkeeper to score.
pe-08033:
1) Grip the bar overhand and pass feet between arms to practice backward rotation.
2) Grip underhand and pull the entire body tight against the bar in a tuck hold.
3) Maintain the tucked body position close to the bar for 5 seconds without letting go.
pe-08034:
1) Determine the starting mark (e.g., 12 steps) by running back from the takeoff board.
2) Gradually accelerate towards the takeoff board during the approach run.
3) Adjust step cadence along markers placed 2 steps and 1 step before takeoff to increase jump rhythm.
4) Drive the non-takeoff knee and arms vigorously upward to gain flight height.
pe-08035:
1) Practice the backswing swing motion using an airplane balance by lowering the head and lifting the leg back.
2) Hold onto a support box, place the plant foot next to the ball, tilt the body slightly, and strike with the instep.
3) Execute a cross touch by raising the kicking foot high to touch the opposite hand for a proper follow-through.
4) Step in with a one-step jump, transition from airplane balance to cross touch, and gradually increase kick power.
pe-08036:
1) Stand sideways facing the throwing direction in a starting stance with the left hand extended.
2) On count 1, bring the ball to the left hand, and on count 2, swing the arm downwards in a large circle until the arms and shoulders form a straight line.
3) Pull the left hand back firmly, rotate the body, and throw the ball forcefully on count 3.
pe-08037:
1) Without a running approach, place hands on a small mat and bunny-hop over it with legs spread to develop hand-placement sensation.
2) Leap over a partner lying prone by placing hands on their back to bridge the height sensation of a 5-tier vault.
3) Set two vaults with different heights (e.g., 2 tiers in front and 4 tiers in back) to practice thrusting the body forward and landing stably.
pe-08038:
1) The match lasts 5 minutes per set and is played with 12 players on each side.
2) Each team starts with 1 to 11 outfielders, who can only return to the infield by eliminating an opponent.
3) The game begins with a jump ball, and targeting the jumper on the very first throw is prohibited.
4) A player hit on the fly is out, but head or face hits are ruled safe and award ball possession to the hit player's team.
5) Players must throw the ball within 5 seconds of receiving it, and attack on or before the 5th throw after up to 4 passes.
pe-08039:
1) Progress defense practice step by step starting from rolling balls to underhand throws and overhand throws
2) Bend knees with feet shoulder-width apart, tuck the chin, and round the body into the ball shape
3) Move directly in front of the ball, tuck elbows in, and scoop upward from below like gathering water
pe-08040:
1) Place hands on an elevated box or cushion to learn hand placement order and finger direction.
2) Learn the leg swing order by kicking up the rear leg first.
3) Push off the box to land correctly, then progress to continuous rotations along circular hoops while gradually straightening knees.
pe-08041:
1) Teams are split into 3 attackers and 2 defenders wearing flags on both sides of their waists.
2) Play begins inside the start zone on the call 'Ready Go', where unlimited handoffs and backward passes are allowed, but only 1 forward pass is permitted.
3) Advancing the ball forward earns increasing points of 1, 2, 3, or 6 points.
4) An attack ends if a flag is pulled, the runner steps out of bounds, or the ball is dropped, and possession switches after 4 downs.
pe-08042:
1) Form two teams of 5 players each to play the game.
2) The total game time is 40 minutes, divided into four 10-minute quarters with intervals.
3) Scoring a shot from outside the 3-point line awards 3 points.
4) Scoring a shot from inside the 3-point line awards 2 points.
5) When fouled, take free throws from the designated spot in front of the basket with no defense, scoring 1 point per basket.
pe-08043:
1) Keep your knees straight without bending them excessively, using them as cushions only upon landing before extending for the next jump.
2) The jumper watches the rope and jumps when it reaches a 90-degree angle.
3) Turners lower their hips, brace their legs, keep one hand as a pivot, and turn the rope with the other hand.
pe-08044:
1) Accelerate fully during the 12-meter approach by swinging arms strongly
2) Sprint toward the first hurdle without fear and extend the lead leg straight
3) Lift the trail leg knee high with toes pointing sideways to clear the bar smoothly
pe-08045:
1) Open all ten fingers wide and create a triangle shape with your thumbs and index fingers.
2) Keep thumbs slightly apart without touching, and position hands about one fist away from your forehead.
3) Practice catching a stationary ball with all ten fingers and bringing it in front of your forehead.
4) Place your dominant foot slightly forward wider than shoulder-width, bend knees, and lean slightly forward.
5) Toss the ball upward using both hands and practice pushing it directly above your head alone.
pe-08046:
1) Attackers wear flag belts and carry oval footballs at the starting line.
2) On the signal, attackers run through the tagger zone to the goal line to deliver the balls.
3) If an attacker reaches the goal without losing a flag, they score; if a flag is pulled, they reattach it from the sideline and restart.
pe-08047:
1) Divide players into two teams of 5 for offense and defense.
2) The offense starts at their goal line with a snap, passing the ball backward through the legs.
3) The offensive team passes or hands off the ball within their territory to advance toward the end zone within 4 downs.
4) Defenders stop the play by pulling the flag from the waist of the ball carrier.
5) Teams score a touchdown by reaching the end zone within 4 downs, and the team with more touchdowns after two 20-minute halves wins.
pe-08048:
1) Warm up with a snake run and partner reaction exercises
2) Drop the ball from shoulder height and catch it with hands or a cone after one bounce
3) Roll the ball on the floor with rackets or hit forehands over the net to each other
pe-08049:
1) Perform warm-up movements including jogging, sidesteps, high-knee skips, and running backwards based on called numbers.
2) Play mountains and valleys cone-turning game and practice inside-foot passing.
3) Practice catching the bounced ball in a warrior position.
4) Catch the ball between two rackets and practice backhand hits and rallies over the net.
pe-08050:
1) The kicker must kick the ball forward past the line.
2) Base runners can leave or stay at any base at any time, and multiple runners can fit inside each hula hoop.
3) A runner is out if the kicked ball is caught in the air or if they get tagged or hit by the ball, with half innings ending at 3 outs.
4) Runners cannot steal on base five until the ball is kicked, and reaching base six scores a point before returning to base one to keep running.
pe-08051:
1) Each participant stands in a circle holding a pool noodle upright on the floor.
2) When the leader calls 'one, two, three, go', participants release their noodle and run to catch the next noodle before it falls.
3) Switch directions between clockwise and counterclockwise as instructed.
4) If a noodle falls to the floor, complete 3 tuck jumps (or squats).
pe-08052:
1) One player starts as the pitcher/outfielder while all other players line up to kick
2) Kickers kick the ball and advance around the bases without having their kick caught or getting tagged with the ball to survive and rejoin the kicking line
3) If a kicker hits the ceiling or gets put out, that player immediately joins the outfield to play defense
4) As the outfield fills up, play continues until only one survivor remains, who then becomes the starting pitcher for the next round.
pe-08053:
1) Divide into two teams, combining the rules of dodgeball and capture the flag.
2) Players are eliminated if hit by a thrown ball or tagged.
3) Players can invade the opponent's territory to grab their flag.
4) The game ends immediately once a player gets the flag and returns safely.
5) The first team to eliminate all opponents or capture the flag wins.
pe-08054:
1) Start with an underhand toss and catch drill without paddles to get used to the ball's bounce and coordination.
2) Pick up paddles and practice soft, controlled dinks hitting 2-3 feet in front of the child.
3) Set up yellow and orange cones as targets and hit balls toward the designated color.
4) Mark Zone 1 (kitchen), Zone 2 (transition), and Zone 3 (baseline) with cones to practice zoning and conclude with a fun singles game.
pe-08055:
1) Net Game: Use the service line as the back boundary and rally without attacking kills to practice net touch and spins
2) Half Court without Net: Use the court center line as the net within the boundary box, keeping the shuttle as low as possible with low footwork
3) Half Court with One Lift: Play a standard half-court rally where each player is restricted to only one high lift per rally.
pe-08056:
1) The fielding team stays behind the line and the kicker kicks the ball past the fielding line before running bases.
2) Runners are out if the ball is caught in the air or if the pin is knocked down while they are off a base.
3) Fielders cannot travel with the ball and must attack the pin from outside the pin zone.
4) Multiple runners are allowed on a single base at the same time without limit.
pe-08057:
1) Set up cones hiding dice underneath in the center and prepare cards in a tub.
2) Place the ball on the line and kick using the inside of the foot to touch a cone.
3) Retrieve the kicked ball first so it does not roll away, then go to the touched cone.
4) Lift the cone, check the number on the die, roll the die once to change it, and cover it back up.
5) Go to the center tub, collect that number of cards, and return to the baseline.
6) Alternate turns with a partner if playing in pairs and collect cards.
pe-08058:
1) Stack two 12-inch cones (one upside down on top of the other) to build skyscrapers in the center.
2) Students partner up and stand along the baseline of the gym with a foam ball.
3) Take turns kicking the ball from the baseline to knock down the skyscraper cones.
4) After kicking, run out to retrieve the ball, return to the baseline, and hand off to the partner.
