5) The game continues until a team knocks down the very last skyscraper.
pe-08059:
1) Jedi Ball: Perimeter players pass the ball to knock over an object defended by a Jedi in the center.
2) Rob the Nest: Four teams pass and gather balls from the center and opponent nests to reach four balls first.
3) Tallyball: Teams complete four consecutive passes without interception to score a point, aiming for five points.
pe-08060:
1) Warm up with foot dribbling and foot skills around spot markers and cones, then practice passing and dribbling with a partner.
2) Set up a personal bowling pin on the floor and take a defensive stance.
3) Kick soccer balls around the area to knock over other players' bowling pins.
4) Defend your own bowling pin with your feet to keep it standing.
pe-08061:
1) Jump to Hoop Race: Jump from hoop to hoop to the finish line; the first team to have all seated players wins.
2) Sun and Ice: Ice taggers tag with pool noodles to freeze runners, and Sun Savers drop a hula hoop over frozen players to unfreeze them.
3) Jumping Jack Hoop Challenge: Spin a hoop upright on the ground, complete jumping jacks, and catch it before it falls.
4) Capture the Bean Bag: Run to the hoop, throw a bean bag to a teammate to catch and keep it.
pe-08062:
1) Bottle Flip: land the bottle upright to advance across all 6 sections.
2) Cardboard Balance: tilt the platform together to guide balls into the center hole and box.
3) Boom Clap Snatch: react to floor taps and claps to snatch the object, and Game of Pulse: squeeze hands down the line on heads.
pe-08063:
1) In the relay race, players run forward building stacks of 6 cups, place the final cup, return to tag the next teammate, and the first team to finish the tower and sit down wins
2) In Speedway Stacks, a runner circles the gym lines while the partner tries to stack and tear down 7 times; if the stacker reaches 7 first the runner does an extra lap, but if the runner finishes before 1 stack is done the stacker runs two laps
3) In the rectangle run, players retrieve one cup at a time from three floor areas, collect all 6 cups, complete a 3-6-3 stack, and raise their hand first to win
4) In Tower Ball, teams build cup towers and throw balls to knock down the opponent's towers.
pe-08064:
1) Start a 2-on-1 game with one defender and two offensive players.
2) Move without dribbling and pass into open lanes.
3) The player who attempts a shot rotates to become the next defender.
pe-08065:
1) A batter hits a pitched ball with a tennis racket into open space.
2) The batter drops the racket and runs back and forth between two pylons to score points.
3) The four fielders relay the ball back to the home hula hoop to stop the runner and record an out.
pe-08066:
1) Form groups of three, placing five cut pool noodles on the floor in front of the runner.
2) One runner progresses forward by stepping only on the noodles toward the far end.
3) The two teammates pick up the noodles behind the runner once passed and quickly place them in front.
4) The runner must reach the opposite end without ever touching the floor.
pe-08067:
1) Jump on colored mats with two feet together and pass through a hula hoop.
2) Lie flat on the mat with arms crossed over the chest and log-roll sideways.
3) Tuck knees tightly to the chest and perform rock-and-roll forward and backward.
4) Finish with a freeze dance game where children pick up a stuffed toy when music stops.
pe-08068:
1) Divide into 4 quads (blue, red, yellow, green) and sit around your team's hula hoop.
2) On go, sneak into other quads and take their flags.
3) Keep one foot inside your hoop and throw the flag to a teammate on your side instead of walking it over.
4) If the teammate catches it, place it in your hoop; if dropped, return the flag.
5) If tagged while capturing a flag, return to your quad, do 3 jumping jacks, and re-enter.
6) The first team to capture all the flags wins.
pe-08069:
1) Each student rides a scooter with a cone and a tennis ball placed on top, starting from their team's side.
2) Players navigate to the center circle to collect one coin while keeping their tennis ball balanced.
3) Opponents throw soft-skinned balls spread around the gym to knock the tennis ball off other players' scooters.
4) If the tennis ball falls off, the balloon pops and the player must return any collected coin and head back to their starting location before re-entering.
5) Successfully returning across the sideline with the tennis ball intact adds the coin to the team's pile, and the team with the most coins wins.
pe-08070:
1) Form small teams in relay lines and place red (1 pt), yellow (2 pts), and green (3 pts) hoops at increasing distances.
2) The first runner runs to their chosen hoop while the second student acts as quarterback and throws a pass.
3) Catching the ball scores points matching the hoop's value, after which roles rotate and the receiver goes to the back.
pe-08071:
1) Guard dogs hold hands in a circle to defend the bone located inside.
2) One hungry dog stands outside the defensive circle.
3) On start, guard dogs move together to protect the bone from being reached.
4) The hungry dog maneuvers around the circle and attempts to grab the bone.
pe-08072:
1) Station 1: Perform a jump pattern, land, and count beads behind to measure distance.
2) Station 2: Pick a word card and hopscotch through poly dots (purple for one foot, orange/red for two feet) spelling the letters.
3) Station 3: Leap over the river from one foot to the other to drop matching colored medicine flowers into buckets.
pe-08073:
1) Play singles (1v1) or doubles (2v
2) on opposite sides of a net.
2) Toss to determine the first server and court side.
3) Hit the shuttlecock over the net into the opponent's court.
4) Score points when the opponent fails to return or hits out/net; the first to reach 21 points wins.
pe-08074:
1) Each team has 7 players, and the match begins with a pull thrown from one side to the other.
2) Teams score points by passing the disc through the air to a teammate standing in the opponent's end zone.
3) A player who catches the disc is not allowed to run or move and must stop immediately.
4) Possession turns over if a pass touches the ground, is intercepted, or goes out of bounds.
5) The thrower must pass the disc within 10 seconds, and defenders must maintain at least 3 meters of distance without physical contact.
pe-08075:
1) Two teams line up on opposite ends with 3 to 10 balls placed along the center line.
2) When the game begins, players rush to the center line to grab the balls and roll them back to teammates.
3) Players throw balls to hit opponents below the shoulders on the fly to eliminate them.
4) If a thrown ball is caught, the thrower is eliminated and one eliminated teammate may re-enter.
5) Players can only hold a ball for up to 10 seconds before it must be turned over to the opposing team.
6) The team that eliminates all opposing players or wins the most rounds within the time limit wins.
pe-08076:
1) Form 4v4 or 3v3 small-sided groups across divided gym zones set to a 5-minute timer.
2) After each goal, restart the game with a 3-tap face-off (tap sticks 1-2-3).
3) Rotate players and teams every 5 minutes when the timer expires to play with different peers.
pe-08077:
1) On the climbing wall, traverse across keeping feet below the red line and hands above the red line.
2) Perform tumbling on mats, and at the trampoline station, grab a ball from the bucket, jump off the trampoline, and shoot.
3) Run and leap to touch flags at varying heights, and throw balls at projected targets on the screen.
4) Rotate through bars, DDR dance, jump ropes, and an obstacle course carrying an 8-10 lb medicine ball across balance beams and BOSU balls.
pe-08078:
1) Players hit a badminton birdie with a short paddle aiming to land it inside a hula hoop.
2) Each time the birdie lands inside the hoop, flip the hoop forward one turn to increase distance.
3) Continue advancing the hoop over time or distance, switching to overhand strokes as it moves farther away.
pe-08079:
1) Set up an arched area with cones under each basketball goal.
2) Players holding the ball cannot take steps (pivot only) and must complete at least three passes before shooting.
3) Defenders cannot guard the ball carrier directly, and players may shoot at either goal.
4) A point is scored if the ball rebounds off the backboard and lands outside the cones without being caught by the defense.
pe-08080:
1) Players scatter within the boundaries and three balls are thrown into the area to start.
2) Players who grab a ball must freeze in place, pivot only, and throw at other players.
3) Hit players go out of bounds and can switch places by hitting active players with rolled-out balls or tagging them.
pe-08081:
1) Players must sit down if they run with the ball, walk with the ball, or get hit by a ball.
2) Sitting players can stand back up by hitting a standing player who approaches them with a ball.
3) Alternatively, sitting players can get back up by completing 5 consecutive catches with a partner.
4) Standing players can run anywhere in the gym to retrieve balls or assist sitting players by sharing balls.
pe-08082:
1) Serve underhand below the waist cross-court into the opposite service box.
2) The ball must bounce once on each side before any player can volley it out of the air.
3) Players cannot volley while standing inside the kitchen (no-volley zone).
4) Only the serving team scores points, and the game is played to 11 points (must win by 2).
pe-08083:
1) Stand with feet hip-width apart and place hands under shoulders on the mat
2) Tuck the chin to look at the belly button and push through legs to roll on shoulders
3) Bring knees to a tuck and reach arms forward to stand up smoothly
pe-08084:
1) Choose two learners from the class to be cats, and everyone else is a mouse.
2) Mice wear a colored tail band in the back of their shorts.
3) Mice run around and cats chase them to pull their tails out.
4) Count the collected tails at the end, and the cat with the most tails wins.
pe-08085:
1) Throw or hit the ball so it bounces into the opponent's circle of cones.
2) Catch the ball only after allowing it to bounce once.
3) Place a ball on a cone to score when it lands in the circle, winning by filling all cones.
pe-08086:
1) Return to the ready position with the paddle centered after every single shot.
2) Eliminate backswing on dinks and volleys to keep the paddle out in front at the kitchen line.
3) Stay on your toes and shuffle laterally to cover the court quickly.
4) Hold your ground at the kitchen line and take balls out of the air instead of backing up.
pe-08087:
1) During a face-off, the ball must hit the ground before players make contact with sticks.
2) When a corner ball is called, trailing players must back off one stick length and give 3 seconds to pass.
3) The goalie must keep at least one foot in the crease and can drop the caught ball behind the net for 3 seconds of safe play.
4) Hand passes and sliding are violations that turn over possession, while dangerous plays like high sticking result in a 2-minute penalty.
pe-08088:
1) On the teacher's call to dribble, students control the puck using both sides of the stick while moving into open space.
2) When the teacher calls freeze, students immediately stop and get low into a shooting position.
3) On the call to shoot, students locate an open wall and shoot their puck so it hits the wall.
4) After shooting, students quickly retrieve their puck and immediately return to dribbling in open space away from classmates.
pe-08089:
1) Jog into open space holding the stick with only the weak hand when jogging is called.
2) Get into a low position with knees bent and hand at the bottom of the stick on 'freeze'.
3) Sweep to simulate a shot on 'shoot' and immediately return to jogging into open space.
pe-08090:
1) Played 7 on 7 starting with a pull throw-off towards the opponent.
2) The person with the disc cannot run and must establish a pivot foot to pass within 7 seconds.
3) Turnovers happen immediately without stoppage if the disc hits the ground, goes out of bounds, or is intercepted.
4) A team scores by completing a pass into the opponent's end zone.
pe-08091:
1) Each team has 5 players on offense and defense starting at their own 5-yard line
2) The offense has 4 plays to cross midfield and another 4 plays to score
3) Pulling the flag of the ball carrier stops the play while tackling and blocking are prohibited
pe-08092:
1) Players start in two lines positioned about 25 yards apart.
2) The player in one line throws the disc and then cuts towards the opposite line.
3) Players alternate throwing and catching across the two lines.
pe-08093:
1) Set two parallel lines of 6 cones 2 meters apart and place balls on top of one row.
2) Players start at the end of the empty cone line and move between the cones.
3) Pick up one ball at a time and place it on the next cone on the opposite line.
4) Compete in teams to see which team finishes the relay fastest.
pe-08094:
1) Divide into 3 teams of 4 players (Blue, Grey, Black) where the designated defending team must catch the ball before it hits the floor.
2) The attacking team calls Omnikin followed by a team color and strikes the ball forward or circularly.
3) Three players kneel and form a stable triangle with palms facing upward to hold the ball for the hitter.
4) If the ball drops or goes out of bounds, the other two teams each receive 1 point.
pe-08095:
1) Students form two concentric circles with a running track space between the inner and outer circles.
2) Five runners enter the lane between the circles and run to evade the ball.
3) Students on the circles strike the large omnikin ball to roll it and tag runners, with hit runners joining the circle lines.
pe-08096:
1) [Dribble Tag] Players dribble freely; if tagged, sit down until the tagger is tagged or jailbreak is called.
2) [Tap 7] Two shooters tap balls together, shoot from the foul line, and race to 7 points (2 points initial shot, 1 point rebound).
3) [NBA 2-Ball] Partners take turns shooting from different poly spots (2, 3, 5, 7 points) to score maximum points in 1 minute.
4) [Basketball Bowling] Teams of 4-5 make 5 baskets total, then the final scorer stands inside a hula hoop and rolls the ball to knock the baseball off the center cone.
pe-08097:
1) Play a standard half-court singles game using the entire half court including tramlines.
2) Restrict the play area to the middle box excluding front and rear tramlines for fast, flat play.
3) Apply various zone restrictions such as removing the front net area or back boundary to practice tactical control.
pe-08098:
1) Hold the shot in fingers, press it against the neck under the chin, and raise the elbow high.
2) Stand side-on, point high, lean back, and push out finishing with a high-five motion.
3) Bend low aligning chin, knee, and toe, then untwist and push from low to high.
pe-08099:
1) Lie on the stomach and push the floor away with flat hands to make a hollow body
2) Place knees on a raised surface in a tuck position and push the floor away
3) Kick up to a handstand with a spotter holding the upper legs and practice balancing
pe-08100:
1) As soon as a team member hits the ball, the team rotates positions in a square.
2) React to high sky balls over the net to sustain the rally.
3) A player who causes an error loses their racket, reducing team rackets.
pe-08101:
1) Divide the class into two teams: fielders and runners.
2) Fielders wear gloves and spread across the field; set up four hoops as running bases in a circuit.
3) The batter throws three balls simultaneously toward the fielders instead of using a bat, then runs through the hoops.
4) If fielders collect all three balls into the first hoop before the runner completes the circuit, the fielding team wins that round; otherwise the runner wins.
pe-08102:
1) Each pair takes a position at the yellow, blue, red, or green cone.
2) Pairs attempt target rallies: 4 on yellow, 6 on blue, 8 on red, and 10 on green.
3) Upon reaching the target rally, players shout 'Bump' and move one court up.
4) The pair previously at the higher court moves down one position.
pe-08103:
1) Partner Around the World: Stand back-to-back with a partner and pass a rugby ball or cone around the body, racing to complete 10 transfers before holding it overhead
2) Back-to-Back Elevators: Stand back-to-back, creep feet forward into a triangle, communicate to squat down like an elevator, pause, and rise back up
3) Triple Extension Rockets: Sit down in a squat with the ball in front, explode upward like a rocket, and launch the ball or cone as far behind as possible.
pe-08104:
1) Divide into two even groups on either side of the ring and place cones on the transverse line.
2) Players take turns shooting, rebound their own shot, and pass back to the next player.
3) If the shot goes in, the player runs to the opposing group's cones to steal one.
4) The first team to steal all of the opposing cones and return wins.
pe-08105:
1) Set up partners with one ball per pair, placing one player outside the goal circle and the partner inside facing them.
2) When the coach calls 'feeding time at the zoo,' inside players act as seals and try to receive as many passes as possible from outside zookeepers in one minute.
3) After each completed pass, inside players must move to find a different zookeeper for their next pass.
4) Switch roles after the first round so everyone gets a turn.
pe-08106:
1) Space cones 1 to 2 meters apart across the court to serve as islands.
2) In pairs, player one passes from an island to partner player two on another island.
3) Player one relocates to a vacant island to receive a pass back, with only one player allowed per island at a time.
4) Complete as many passes as possible within one minute.
pe-08107:
1) Lie down and lift your feet and shoulders off the floor into a hollow position.
2) Keep arms shoulder-width and feet together while maintaining body tension and twisting shoulders and hips to roll.
3) Transition through an arch position keeping feet and chest off the floor, then return to hollow.
pe-08108:
1) When the leader calls out one, two, three, each player chooses to be either a Head (hands on head) or a Butt (hands on buttocks)
2) Players with hands on their heads chase those with hands on their butts, and vice versa
3) As soon as a player is tagged, they immediately swap allegiances and join the tagger's team
4) The game continues until everyone becomes part of the same team (all Heads or all Butts).
pe-08109:
1) When the leader says go, every player becomes "it" at the same time and attempts to tag everyone else
2) Players make a tag by lightly touching someone on the shoulder
3) Once a player is tagged, they must immediately crouch down in place and wait
4) Quick rounds are repeated to see who remains standing without being tagged.
